fields.definition: "Abnormally increased excretion of porphyrins in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Bladder stones
fields.definition: "Buildups of minerals that form in the urinary bladder." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cloacal exstrophy
fields.definition: "Cloacal exstrophy is a severe anterior abdominal wall defect in which the two hemibladders are visible and are separated by a midline intestinal plate, an omphalocele, and an imperforate anus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the bladder
fields.definition: "Absence or underdevelopment of the urinary bladder." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent/small bladder; Absent/underdeveloped bladder

fields.label: Aplasia of the bladder
fields.definition: "Aplasia (absence) of the urinary bladder." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent bladder

fields.label: Abnormality of the urachus
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the urachus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Patent urachus
fields.definition: "Persistence of the urachal canal resulting in a canal between the bladder and the umbilicus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Persistent urachus

fields.label: Urethral fistula
fields.definition: "The presence of an abnormal connection between the urethra and another organ or the skin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Urethral valve
fields.definition: "The presence of an abnormal membrane obstructing the urethra." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Acromelia of the upper limbs
fields.definition: "Shortening of the arms predominantly affecting terminal parts of the arm in relation to the upper and middle limb segments." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Amniotic constriction rings of arms
fields.definition: "Amniotic constriction rings affecting the arms." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hypertrophy of the upper limb
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase in size of the upper limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased size of upper limb

fields.label: Hyperextensibility at elbow
fields.definition: "The ability of the elbow joint to move beyond its normal range of motion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormality of the hypothenar eminence
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the hypothenar eminence, i.e., of the muscles on the ulnar side of the palm of the hand (i.e., on the side of the little finger)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Small hypothenar eminence
fields.definition: "Reduced muscle mass on the ulnar side of the palm, that is, reduction in size of the hypothenar eminence." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplasia of the hypothenar eminence; Hypothenar hypoplasia

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the palmar creases
fields.definition: "Absence or underdevelopment of the palmar creases." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent/small palm crease; Absent/underdeveloped palm crease

fields.label: Absent palmar crease
fields.definition: "The absence of the major creases of the palm (distal transverse crease, proximal transverse crease, or thenar crease)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absence of the palmar creases; Absent palm lines; Aplasia of the palmar creases

fields.label: Abnormality of the palmar creases
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the creases of the skin of palm of hand." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the palm lines

fields.label: Digital constriction ring
fields.definition: "A narrow segment of significantly reduced circumference of a digit." [PMID:19125433]
fields.synonyms_concat: Amniotic constriction rings of digits

fields.label: Osseous finger syndactyly
fields.definition: "Webbing or fusion of the fingers, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual finger bones." [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]
fields.synonyms_concat: Osseous syndactyly of the fingers

fields.label: Long metacarpals
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased length of the metacarpal bones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elongated long bone of hand; Increased length of metacarpals

fields.label: Acromelia of the lower limbs
fields.definition: "Shortening of the legs predominantly affecting terminal parts of the leg in relation to the upper and middle arm segments." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Amniotic constriction rings of legs
fields.definition: "Amniotic constriction rings affecting the legs." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hypertrophy of the lower limb
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase in size of the lower limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Sirenomelia
fields.definition: "A developmental defect in which the legs are fused together." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sympodia

fields.label: Bipartite patella
fields.definition: "A developmental defect that occurs if the two halves of the patella fail to fuse in early childhood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Patellar subluxation
fields.definition: "The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar subluxation refers to an unstable kneecap that does not slide centrally within its groove, i.e., a partial dislocation of the patella." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Partial knee cap dislocation; Subluxation of patella

fields.label: Hyperextensibility of the knee
fields.definition: "The ability of the knee joint to extend beyond its normal range of motion (the lower leg is moved beyond a straight position with respect to the thigh)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Limitation of knee mobility
fields.definition: "An abnormal limitation of knee joint mobility." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Limitation of knee mobility; Limited knee movement

fields.label: Fibular bowing
fields.definition: "A bending or abnormal curvature of the fibula." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bowed calf bone

fields.label: Fibular duplication
fields.definition: "Duplication of the fibula. This may occur as a part of diplopodia (accessory tarsal or metatarsal bone). Diplopodia with double fibula is an extremely rare condition." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Duplicated calf bone

fields.label: Increased length of the tibia
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the length of the tibia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased length of shankbone; Increased length of shinbone

fields.label: Limitation of movement at ankles
fields.definition: "An abnormal limitation of the mobility of the ankle joint." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal plantar dermatoglyphics
fields.definition: "An abnormality of dermatoglyphs on the toes and soles, i.e., an abnormality of the patterns of ridges of the skin of sole of foot." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal dermatoglyphics on feet; Abnormal prints on feet

fields.label: Foot asymmetry
fields.definition: "A difference in size or shape between the left and right foot." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Metatarsus valgus
fields.definition: "A condition in which the anterior part of the foot rotates outward away from the midline of the body and the heel remains straight." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Aplasia of the tarsal bones
fields.definition: "Absence of the tarsal bones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent ankle bone; Absent tarsals

fields.label: Hypermobility of toe joints
fields.definition: "An ability of the toe joints to move beyond their normal range of motion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Long toe
fields.definition: "Toes that appear disproportionately long compared to the foot." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased length of toes; Long toe; Long toes

fields.label: Adrenal calcification
fields.definition: "Calcification within the adrenal glands." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Pituitary calcification
fields.definition: "Deposition of calcium salts in the pituitary gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hyperpituitarism
fields.definition: "Hypersecretion of one or more pituitary hormones. This can occur in conditions in which deficiency in the target organ leads to decreased hormonal feedback, or as a primary condition most usually in connection with a pituitary adenoma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the thymus
fields.definition: "Absence or underdevelopment of the thymus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent/small thymus; Absent/underdeveloped thymus; Thymic hypoplasia or aplasia

fields.label: Thymus hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the thymus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Enlarged thymus; Thymic hyperplasia

fields.label: Ectopic thymus tissue
fields.definition: "The presence of ectopic thymus tissue. Normally, cells of the ventral bud of the third pharyngeal pouch detach and migrate in the eighth gestational week caudally and medially towards the location of the mature thyroid. They migrate further retrosternally into the superior mediastinum. There are two main ways ectopic thymus tissue can develop. Either cells detach along the descensus path and proliferate, thereby forming accessory thymus tissue, or the entire gland fails to descend." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal thymus position

fields.label: Thyroglossal cyst
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the thyroid gland owing to the presence of a fibrous cyst resulting from the persistence of the thyroglossal duct." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Thyroglossal duct cyst

fields.label: Increased fetal movement
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in quantity or strength of fetal movements." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fetal hyperkinesia; Foetal hyperkinesia; Increased foetal movement

fields.label: Gait apraxia
fields.definition: "Gait apraxia affecting the ability to make walking movements with the legs." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Dyslexia
fields.definition: "A learning disorder characterized primarily by difficulties in learning to read and spell. Dyslectic children also exhibit a tendency to read words from right to left and to confuse letters such as b and d whose orientation is important for their identification. Children with dyslexia appear to be impaired in phonemic skills (the ability to associate visual symbols with the sounds they represent)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reading disability

fields.label: Alexia
fields.definition: "An acquired type of sensory aphasia where damage to the brain leads to the loss of the ability to read." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Text blindness; Word blindness

fields.label: Disturbed sensory perception
fields.definition: "Alteration or impairment in the processing or interpretation of sensory information can lead to abnormal perceptions or experiences." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Agnosia

fields.label: Finger agnosia
fields.definition: "The examiner identified the inability to name, move, or touch specific fingers." []

fields.label: Dysgraphia
fields.definition: "A writing disability in the absence of motor or sensory deficits of the upper extremities, resulting in an impairment in the ability to write regardless of the ability to read and not due to intellectual impairment." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Agraphia

fields.label: Astereognosis
fields.definition: "Tactile agnosia refers to the inability to recognize objects by touch, while the inability to discriminate shape and size by touch is also a related condition." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Astereognosis; Somatosensory agnosia

fields.label: Prosopagnosia
fields.definition: "Inability to recognize faces of familiar persons." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Face blindness; Facial agnosia

fields.label: Echolalia
fields.definition: "Echolalia is the automatic imitative repetition of sounds, words, or phrases in the absence of explicit awareness. The repeated words or phrases are typically odd or used in a non-social manner. These can be words or phrases that the affected individual has heard or invented." [PMID:31651053]
fields.synonyms_concat: Echoing another person's speech; Echologia; Echophrasia; Repeated speech

fields.label: Palatal tremor
fields.definition: "Palatal tremor (PT) is an involuntary, rhythmic and oscillatory movement of the soft palate. PT is a rare type of tremor involving the soft palate. It can be unilateral or bilateral." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:33101766]
fields.synonyms_concat: Palatal myoclonus

fields.label: Spinal myoclonus
fields.definition: "Spinal myoclonus is generally due to a tumor, infection, injury, or degenerative process of the spinal cord, and is characterized by involuntary rhythmic muscle contractions, usually at a rate of more than one per second. Myoclonus occurs synchronously in several muscles and can be increased in severity and frequency by fatigue or stress, but is usually unaffected by sensory stimuli. Spinal myoclonus ceases during sleep or anesthesia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Paroxysmal vertigo
fields.definition: "Paroxysmal episodes of vertigo." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Spasmus nutans
fields.definition: "The combination of pendular nystagmus, head nodding, and torticollis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7499100]

fields.label: Transient global amnesia
fields.definition: "A paroxysmal, transient loss of memory function with preservation of immediate recall and remote memory but with a severe impairment of memory for recent events and ability to retain new information." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Sleep apnea
fields.definition: "An intermittent cessation of airflow at the mouth and nose during sleep is known as sleep apnea. Apneas that last at least 10 seconds are considered significant, but individuals with sleep apnea may experience apneas lasting from 20 seconds up to 2 or 3 minutes. Patients may have up to 15 events per hour of sleep." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pauses in breathing while sleeping; Sleep apnea; Sleep apnoea

fields.label: Central sleep apnea
fields.definition: "Sleep apnea results from a temporary loss of the central drive to the muscles responsible for breathing." [PMID:35551411, PMID:36031317]
fields.synonyms_concat: Central sleep apnoea

fields.label: Wide cranial sutures
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased width of the cranial sutures for age-related norms (generally resulting from delayed closure)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Broad cranial sutures; Diastasis of cranial sutures; Large cranial suture; open cranial sutures; Persistent open cranial sutures; Sutural diastasis; Widened cranial sutures

fields.label: Small sella turcica
fields.definition: "An abnormally small sella turcica." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplasia of hypophseal fossa; Hypoplasia of pituitary fossa; Hypoplasia of sella turcica; Small hypophyseal fossa; Small pituitary fossa

fields.label: Thin calvarium
fields.definition: "The presence of an abnormally thin calvarium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Thin cranial bone; Thin skull bone

fields.label: Advanced pneumatization of cranial sinuses
fields.definition: "A degree of pneumatization that is increased compared to age-related norms." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cutis gyrata of scalp
fields.definition: "The presence of convoluted folds and furrows formed from thickened skin of the scalp, resembling cerebriform pattern. The scalp has convoluted and elevated folds, 1 to 2 cm in thickness. The convolutions generally cannot be flattened by traction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Furrows in thickened skin on top of scalp
Thickened folds on top of scalp
fields.synonyms_concat: Cutis verticis gyrata; Furrows in thickened skin on top of scalp; Scalp folds; Scalp furrows; Scalp rugae; Thickened folds on top of scalp; Thickening of the scalp

fields.label: Vestibular nystagmus
fields.definition: "Nystagmus due to disturbance of the vestibular system; eye movements are rhythmic, with slow and fast components." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Opsoclonus
fields.definition: "Bursts of large-amplitude multidirectional saccades without intersaccadic interval" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Vertical nystagmus
fields.definition: "Vertical nystagmus may present with either up-beating or down-beating eye movements or both. When present in the straight-ahead position of gaze it is referred to as upbeat nystagmus or downbeat nystagmus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Downbeat nystagmus
fields.definition: "Downbeat nystagmus is a type of fixation nystagmus with the fast phase beating in a downward direction. It generally increases when looking to the side and down and when lying prone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21505601]

fields.label: Muscle fibrillation
fields.definition: "Fine, rapid twitching of individual muscle fibers with little or no movement of the muscle as a whole as ascertained by electromyography (EMG). If a motor neuron or its axon is destroyed, the muscle fibers it innervates undergo denervation atrophy. This leads to hypersensitivity of individual muscle fibers to acetyl choline so that they may contract spontaneously. Isolated activity of individual muscle fibers is generally so fine it cannot be seen through the intact skin, although it can be recorded as a short-duration spike in the EMG." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: EMG: fibrillations on electromyogram; Twitching

fields.label: Muscle flaccidity
fields.definition: "A type of paralysis in which a muscle becomes soft and yields to passive stretching, which results from loss of all or practically all peripheral motor nerves that innervated the muscle. Muscle tone is reduced and the affected muscles undergo extreme atrophy within months of the loss of innervation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Percussion myotonia
fields.definition: "A localized myotonic contraction in a muscle in reaction to percussion (tapping with the examiner's finger, a rubber percussion hammer, or a similar object)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Transient swelling of muscle induced by percussion
fields.synonyms_concat: Transient swelling of muscle induced by percussion

fields.label: Weakness due to upper motor neuron dysfunction
fields.definition: "Paralysis of voluntary muscles means loss of contraction due to interruption of one or more motor pathways from the brain to the muscle fibers. Although the word paralysis is often used interchangeably to mean either complete or partial loss of muscle strength, it is preferable to use paralysis or plegia for complete or severe loss of muscle strength, and paresis for partial or slight loss. Paralysis due to lesions of the principle motor tracts is related to a lesion in the corticospinal, corticobulbar or brainstem descending (subcorticospinal) neurons." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Paralysis due to lesions of the principle motor tracts
fields.label_normalized: weakness due to upper motor neuron dysfunction
fields.synonyms_concat: Paralysis due to lesions of the principle motor tracts

fields.label: Paraplegia
fields.definition: "Severe or complete weakness of both lower extremities with sparing of the upper extremities." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Leg paralysis

fields.label: Paraplegia/paraparesis
fields.definition: "Weakness of both lower extremities with sparing of the upper extremities. Paraplegia refers to a severe or complete loss of strength, whereas paraparesis refers to a relatively mild loss of strength." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Oculogyric crisis
fields.definition: "An acute dystonic reaction with blepharospasm, periorbital twitches, and protracted fixed staring episodes. There may be a maximal upward deviation of the eyes in the sustained fashion. Oculogyric crisis can be triggered by a number of factors including neuroleptic medications." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cutaneous finger syndactyly
fields.definition: "A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal joint of the adjacent fingers." [PMID:19125433]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cutaneous syndactyly of fingers; Cutaneous syndactyly of hands; Webbed fingers; Webbed skin of fingers

fields.label: Overlapping fingers
fields.definition: "A finger resting on the dorsal surface of an adjacent digit when the hand is at rest." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]

fields.label: Abnormality of the clivus
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the clivus, which is the inclined bony region of the posterior cranial fossa located between the sella turcica and the foramen magnum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Vertical clivus
fields.definition: "An abnormal vertical orientation of the clivus (which normally forms a kind of slope from the sella turcica down to the region of the foramen magnum)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Undulate clavicles
fields.definition: "An abnormally wavy surface or edge of the clavicles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Wavy clavicles; Wavy collarbone

fields.label: Undulate ribs
fields.definition: "An abnormally wavy surface or edge of the ribs." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Wavy ribs

fields.label: Bifid epiglottis
fields.definition: "A midline anterior-posterior cleft of the epiglottis that involves at least two-thirds of the epiglottic leaf. It is a useful feature for clinical diagnosis because it appears to be very rare in syndromes other than Pallister-Hall-Syndrome and is also rare as an isolated malformation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the Epiglottis
fields.definition: "This term applies if the Epiglottis is absent or hypoplastic." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hamartoma
fields.definition: "A disordered proliferation of mature tissues that is native to the site of origin, e.g., exostoses, nevi and soft tissue hamartomas. Although most hamartomas are benign, some histologic subtypes, e.g., neuromuscular hamartoma, may proliferate aggressively such as mesenchymal cystic hamartoma, Sclerosing epithelial hamartoma, Sclerosing metanephric hamartoma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Y-shaped metatarsals
fields.definition: "Y-shaped metatarsals are the result of a partial fusion of two metatarsal bones, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Y-shaped metatarsals may be seen in combination with polydactyly." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Y-shaped long bone of foot

fields.label: Hamartoma of the eye
fields.definition: "A hamartoma (disordered proliferation of mature tissues) which can originate from any tissue of the eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Elevated circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated levels of cholesta-5,7-dien-3beta-ol

fields.label: Low maternal circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally low concentration of serum alpha-fetoprotein as compared to normal values for gestational-age." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Low maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein

fields.label: Elevated circulating phytanic acid concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal elevation of phytanic acid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated level of phytanic acid; Elevated levels of phytanic acid

fields.label: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the femoral head
fields.definition: "Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the femur." [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the innermost thighbone
Abnormality of the proximal femoral epiphysis
fields.label_normalized: abnormality of the epiphysis of the femoral head
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the end part of the innermost thighbone; Abnormality of the proximal femoral epiphysis

fields.label: Dysplasia of the femoral head
fields.definition: "The presence of developmental dysplasia of the femoral head." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of femoral head development; Dysplastic femoral head

fields.label: Intracranial cystic lesion
fields.definition: "A cystic lesion originating within the brain." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cerebral cystic malformation

fields.label: Absent epiphyses
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent end part of bone

fields.label: Bracket epiphyses
synonyms: Bracket shaped end part of long bone
fields.synonyms_concat: Bracket shaped end part of long bone

fields.label: Cone-shaped epiphysis
fields.definition: "Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. That is, the epiphysis has a cone-shaped distal extension resulting from increased growth of the central portion of the epiphysis relative to its periphery." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cone-shaped end part of bone; Cone-shaped epiphyses; Coned epiphyses

fields.label: Enlarged epiphyses
fields.definition: "Increased size of epiphyses." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Large end part of bone; Large epiphyses; Widened, distorted epiphyses

fields.label: Irregular epiphyses
fields.definition: "An alteration of the normally smooth contour of the epiphysis leading to an irregular appearance." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Irregular end part of long bone
fields.synonyms_concat: Irregular end part of long bone

fields.label: Ivory epiphyses
fields.definition: "Sclerosis of the epiphyses, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays." [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]
synonyms: Increased bone density in end part of bone
fields.synonyms_concat: Epiphyseal sclerosis; Increased bone density in end part of bone

fields.label: Small epiphyses
fields.definition: "Reduction in the size or volume of epiphyses." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Small end part of bone

fields.label: Triangular epiphysis
fields.definition: "Longitudinal epiphyseal bracket or bracket epiphysis is an uncommon disorder of growth. Alternatively known as a delta phalanx, it is due to an anomalous secondary ossification center that extends longitudinally along the diaphysis. Although rare, longitudinal epiphyseal bracket most commonly manifests in the hands as clinodactyly and in the feet as hallux varus." [PMID:24432108]

The skull is often, but not necessarily, affected, and any other bone or bones may be involved. Fibrous dysplasia can either effect isolated bones (Monostotic fibrous dysplasia) or also generalized all bones of the body (Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia)." [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]

fields.label: Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia

Radiographically sclerotic circular or ovoid lesions are usually symmetrically distributed in a periarticular location. Lesions can increase or decrease in size and number in serial radiographs or even disappear and do not have increased bone radiotracer uptake." [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]

fields.label: Osteopathia striata

Pathologic-anatomical studies revealed that these benign signs on x-rays are the result of a juvenile metaphyseal bone necrosis. fields.label: Erythema
fields.definition: "Redness of the skin, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6548-5200]
synonyms: Redness of skin or mucous membrane
fields.synonyms_concat: Redness of skin or mucous membrane

fields.label: Uterine neoplasm
fields.definition: "A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the uterus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Uterine cancer; Uterine neoplasia; Uterine tumor; Uterine tumour

fields.label: Gonadal neoplasm
fields.definition: "A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of a gonad." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gonadal neoplasia

fields.label: Urinary tract neoplasm
fields.definition: "The presence of a neoplasm of the urinary system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Urinary tract neoplasia

fields.label: Genital neoplasm
fields.definition: "A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the genital system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Genital neoplasia; Genital tumor; Genital tumour

fields.label: Testicular neoplasm
fields.definition: "The presence of a neoplasm of the testis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Testicular cancer; Testicular neoplasia; Testicular tumor; Testicular tumour

fields.label: Hypoplasia of the Leydig cells
fields.definition: "Underdevelopment of the interstitial (Leydig) cells of the testis. These cells produce testosterone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hyperplasia of the Leydig cells
fields.definition: "Hypertrophy or overdevelopment of the interstitial (Leydig) cells of the testis. These cells produce testosterone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Bifid nail
fields.definition: "A digit with two nails, with at least some soft tissue between them." [PMID:19125433]
fields.synonyms_concat: duplicated nail; Notched nail

fields.label: Impaired visuospatial constructive cognition
fields.definition: "Reduced ability affecting mainly visuospatial cognition which may be tested using pattern construction (for example by Differential Ability Scales, which test a person's strengths and weaknesses across a range of intellectual abilities)." [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:10521286]

fields.label: Cerebellar glioma
fields.definition: "A glioma affecting the cerebellum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Brainstem glioma
fields.definition: "A glioma affecting the brainstem." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hemangioblastoma
fields.definition: "A hemangioblastoma is a benign vascular neoplasm that arises almost exclusively in the central nervous system. Hemangioblastomas consist of a tightly packed cluster of small blood vessels forming a mass of up to 1 or 2 cm in diameter." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Haemangioblastoma

fields.label: Lip freckle
fields.definition: "Increased focal pigmentation of the vermilion of the lips." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ephelis of lip; Labial lentigo; Lip freckle; Lip lentigo

fields.label: Pinealoma
fields.definition: "A neoplasm of the pineal gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Absent cupid's bow
fields.definition: "Lack of paramedian peaks and median notch of the upper lip vermilion." [PMID:19125428]
synonyms: Failure of development of cupid's bow
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent cupid's bow; Agenesis of cupid's bow; Aplasia of cupid's bow; Failure of development of cupid's bow; Lack of cupid's bow; Missing cupid's bow

fields.label: Underdeveloped nasolabial fold
fields.definition: "Reduced bulkiness of the crease or fold of skin running from the lateral margin of the nose, where nasal base meets the skin of the face, to a point just lateral to the corner of the mouth (cheilion or commissure)." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Flat nasolabial fold; Nasolabial crease, hypoplastic; Nasolabial crease, underdeveloped; Nasolabial fold, hypoplastic; Shallow nasolabial fold

fields.label: Perioral hyperpigmentation
fields.definition: "Increased pigmentation, either focal or generalized, of the skin surrounding the vermilion of the lips." [PMID:19125428]
synonyms: Darkening of skin around the mouth
fields.synonyms_concat: Darkening of skin around the mouth; Increased pigmentation around the mouth

fields.label: Everted upper lip vermilion
fields.definition: "Inner aspect of the upper lip vermilion (normally apposing the teeth) visible in a frontal view, i.e., the presence of an everted upper lip." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Drooping upper lip; Eclabium of upper lip; Everted prominent upper lip; Everted upper lip; Outward turned upper lip; Protruding upper lip

fields.label: Tented upper lip vermilion
fields.definition: "Triangular appearance of the oral aperture with the apex in the midpoint of the upper vermilion and the lower vermilion forming the base." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Inverted V-shaped upper lip; Tented mouth; Tented upper lip

fields.label: Upturned corners of mouth
fields.definition: "Oral commissures positioned superior to the midline labial fissure." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Upturned corners of mouth; Upturned mouth; Upturned oral commisures

fields.label: U-Shaped upper lip vermilion
fields.definition: "Gentle upward curve of the upper lip vermilion such that the center is placed well superior to the commissures." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Carp-like mouth; Carp-shaped mouth; Fish mouth; Large, carp-shaped mouth; Wide, carp-shaped mouth

fields.label: Open bite
fields.definition: "Visible space between the dental arches in occlusion." [PMID:19125428]
synonyms: Absence of overlap of upper and lower teeth
Open bite between upper and lower teeth
fields.synonyms_concat: Absence of overlap of upper and lower teeth; Open bite; Open bite between upper and lower teeth

fields.label: Protruding tongue
fields.definition: "Tongue extending beyond the alveolar ridges or teeth at rest." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lingual prolapse; Lingual prominence; Lingual protrusion; Prolapse of tongue; Prominent tongue; Protruding tongue; Tongue protrusion; Tongue sticking out of mouth

fields.label: Broad uvula
fields.definition: "Increased width of the uvula (subjective finding)." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Wide uvula

fields.label: Long uvula
fields.definition: "Increased length of the uvula." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elongated uvula; Hyperplasia of uvula; Long palatine uvula

fields.label: Narrow uvula
fields.definition: "Decreased width of the uvula." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Narrow palatine uvula; Thin uvula

fields.label: Short uvula
fields.definition: "Decreased length of the uvula." [PMID:19125428]
fields.synonyms_concat: Blunt uvula; Hypoplastic uvula; Short palatine uvula

fields.label: Abnormal number of hair whorls
fields.definition: "More than two clockwise hair whorls." [PMID:19125436]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal number of hair swirls; Abnormal number of hair whorls; Double crown (hair whorls); Extra hair swirls; Extra hair whorl; Supernumary hair swirls; Supernumary hair whorl

fields.label: Abnormal position of hair whorl
fields.definition: "Hair growth from a single point on the scalp in any location other than lateral to the midline and close to the vertex of the skull." [PMID:19125436]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal location of hair swirl; Abnormal position of hair whorl

fields.label: Nevus sebaceous
fields.definition: "A congenital, hairless plaque consisting of overgrown epidermis, sebaceous glands, hair follicles, apocrine glands and connective tissue. They are a variant of epidermal naevi. Sebaceous naevi most often appear on the scalp, but they may also arise on the face, neck or forehead. At birth, a sevaceous nevus typically appears as a solitary, smooth, yellow-orange hairless patch. Sebaceous naevi become more pronounced around adolescence, often appearing bumpy, warty or scaly." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Naevus sebaceous; Organoid nevus; Sebaceous mole; Sebaceous naevus; Sebaceous nevus

fields.label: Epidermal nevus
fields.definition: "Epidermal naevi are due to an overgrowth of the epidermis and may be present at birth (50%) or develop during childhood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20542174]
fields.synonyms_concat: Epidermal nevi

fields.label: Linear nevus sebaceous
fields.definition: "A type of nevus sebaceous with a linear form, raised borders and yellowish color." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Generalized tonic seizure
fields.definition: "A generalized tonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening without a subsequent clonic phase. The tonic activity can be a sustained abnormal posture, either in extension or flexion, sometimes accompanied by tremor of the extremities." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Generalised hypertonic seizure; Generalised tonic seizure; Generalised tonic seizures; Generalized hypertonic seizure; Generalized tonic seizures; Hypertonic seizures

fields.label: Atonic seizure
fields.definition: "Atonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1 to 2 seconds, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11580774]
fields.synonyms_concat: Astatic seizure; Astatic seizures; Atonic seizures; Drop attacks; Drop seizures; Hypotonic seizure; Hypotonic seizures; Sudden loss of muscle tone

fields.label: Focal emotional seizure with crying
fields.definition: "Focal emotional seizure with crying (dacrystic) is characterized by the presence of stereotyped crying, this may be accompanied by lacrimation, sad facial expression and sobbing. The subjective emotion of sadness may or may not be present." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28276060, PMID:993803]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dacrystic seizure; Dacrystic seizures

fields.label: Focal emotional seizure with laughing
fields.definition: "Focal emotional seizure with laughing (gelastic) is characterized by bursts of laughter or giggling, usually without appropriate related emotion of happiness, and described as 'mirthless'." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gelastic seizure; Gelastic seizures

fields.label: Scintillating scotoma
fields.definition: "A scintillating scotoma is a common visual aura that can precede a migraine, whereby a spot of flickering light near the center of the visual fields occurs. The spot prevents vision, and is thus termed scotoma. The scotoma can extend into one or more shimmering arcs of white or colored flashing lights." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Ridged cranial sutures
fields.definition: "An overlap of the bony plates of the skull in an infant, with or without early closure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cranial suture ridges

fields.label: Abnormal fifth cranial nerve morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality of the fifth cranial nerve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Abnormality of the fifth cranial nerve
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal trigeminal nerve morphology; Abnormality of the fifth cranial nerve; Abnormality of the nervus trigeminus

fields.label: Abnormality of the eleventh cranial nerve
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the eleventh cranial nerve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: abnormality of the eleventh cranial nerve
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of cranial nerve XI; Abnormality of the accessory nerve

fields.label: Abnormality of the twelfth cranial nerve
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the twelfth cranial nerve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: abnormality of the twelfth cranial nerve
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of cranial nerve 12; Abnormality of cranial nerve xii; Abnormality of the hypoglossal nerve

fields.label: Abnormal seventh cranial physiology
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the seventh cranial nerve sometimes also referred to as the facial nerve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the facial nerve

fields.label: Hemifacial spasm
fields.definition: "Intermittent clonic or tonic contraction of muscles supplied by facial nerve. Muscles are relaxed in between contractions." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12145388]
synonyms: Spasms on one side of the face
fields.synonyms_concat: Hemifacial spasms; Spasms on one side of the face

fields.label: Impaired temperature sensation
fields.definition: "A reduced ability to discriminate between different temperatures." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of temperature sensation; Impaired temperature sensation; Impaired thermal sensitivity; Loss of temperature sensation

fields.label: Impaired tactile sensation
fields.definition: "A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation). This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal thigmesthesia; Impaired touch sensation; Loss of tactile sensation

fields.label: Impaired proprioception
fields.definition: "A loss or impairment of the sensation of the relative position of parts of the body and joint position." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of proprioception

fields.label: Abnormality of pain sensation
fields.definition: "Pain is an unpleasant sensation that can range from mild, localized discomfort to agony, whereby the physical part of pain results from nerve stimulation and is often accompanied by an emotional component. This term groups abnormalities in pain sensation presumed to result from abnormalities related to the specific nerve fibers that carry the pain impulses to the brain." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Spontaneous pain sensation
fields.definition: "Spontaneous pain is a kind of neuropathic pain which occurs without an identifiable trigger." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Trophic changes related to pain
fields.definition: "Trophic changes is a term used to describe abnormalities in the area of pain that include primarily wasting away of the skin, tissues, or muscle, thinning of the bones, and changes in how the hair or nails grow, including thickening or thinning of hair or brittle nails." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Trophic changes

fields.label: Dissociated sensory loss
fields.definition: "A pattern of sensory loss with selective loss of touch sensation and proprioception without loss of pain and temperature, or vice-versa." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating copper concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal concentration of copper." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal copper levels

fields.label: Decreased circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
fields.definition: "Decreased concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32119309]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased serum ceruloplasmin; Decreased serum ceruloplasminA; Hypoceruloplasminaemia; Hypoceruloplasminemia

fields.label: High nonceruloplasmin-bound serum copper
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of non ceruloplasmin bound copper in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Increased urinary copper concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of copper in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased urinary copper concentration

fields.label: Multifocal epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "An abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG) and being identified at multiple locations (foci)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multifocal EEG abnormality

fields.label: EEG with focal slow activity
fields.definition: "Focal (localized) slow activity reflects focal dysfunction, not diffuse dysfunction (i.e., encephalopathy)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG: focal slow activity; EEG: localised slow activity; EEG: localized slow activity

fields.label: EEG with multifocal slow activity
fields.definition: "Multifocal slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG)." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]

fields.label: EEG with generalized slow activity
fields.definition: "Diffuse slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG with generalised slow activity; EEG: generalised slow activity; EEG: generalized slow activity

fields.label: EEG with persistent abnormal rhythmic activity
fields.label_normalized: eeg with persistent abnormal rhythmic activity
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG: persistent abnormal rhythmic activity

fields.label: EEG with spike-wave complexes (<2.5 Hz)
fields.definition: "The presence of complexes of slow spikes and slow waves (<2.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Electroencephalogram demonstrated spike-slow wave discharges

fields.label: EEG with spike-wave complexes (2.5-3.5 Hz)
fields.definition: "The presence of complexes of spikes and waves (2.5-3.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: EEG with spike-wave complexes (>3.5 Hz)
fields.definition: "The presence of complexes of spikes and waves (>3.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG with 3-4-Hz spike waves

fields.label: EEG with spike-wave complexes
fields.definition: "Complexes of spikes (<70 ms) and sharp waves (70-200 ms), which are sharp transient waves that have a strong association with epilepsy, in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: EEG with burst suppression
fields.definition: "The burst suppression pattern in electroencephalography refers to a characteristic periodic pattern of low voltage (<10 microvolts) suppressed background and a relatively shorter pattern of higher amplitude slow, sharp, and spiking complexes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22323592]

fields.label: EEG with photoparoxysmal response
fields.definition: "EEG abnormalities (epileptiform discharges) evoked by flashing lights or black and white striped patterns." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Photoparoxysmal response on EEG

fields.label: EEG with periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges (PLEDs)are periodic, lateralized, and epileptiform. PLEDs show a relatively constant interval between discharges (0.5 to 3 seconds)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: eeg with periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG: periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges

fields.label: EEG with generalized low amplitude activity
fields.definition: "An abnormal generalized reduction in amplitude of the cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: EEG with generalised low amplitude activity
fields.label_normalized: eeg with generalized low amplitude activity
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG with generalised low amplitude activity; EEG: generalised low amplitude activity; EEG: generalized low amplitude activity

fields.label: EEG with localized low amplitude activity
fields.definition: "An abnormal localized reduction in amplitude of the cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: EEG with localised low amplitude activity
fields.label_normalized: eeg with localized low amplitude activity
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG with localised low amplitude activity; EEG: localised low amplitude activity; EEG: localized low amplitude activity

fields.label: EEG with periodic complexes
fields.definition: "Periodically occurring generalized periodic complexes." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG: periodic complexes; Radermecker complexes

fields.label: EEG with periodic abnormalities
fields.definition: "Periodically recurring abnormalities in the EEG." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: EEG: periodic abnormalities

fields.label: EEG with hyperventilation-induced epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Epileptiform discharges induced by hyperventilation (overbreathing) in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Frank breech presentation
fields.definition: "A kind of breech presentation in which the hips are flexed and the knees are extended." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Complete breech presentation
fields.definition: "A kind of breech presentation in which the hips are flexed and the knees are flexed." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Incomplete breech presentation
fields.definition: "A kind of breech presentation in which one or both hips are extended and one or both of the fetus' feet are pointing down and entering the birth canal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Delayed fine motor development
fields.definition: "A type of motor delay characterized by a delay in acquiring the ability to control the fingers and hands." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Receptive language delay
fields.definition: "A delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Severe intellectual disability
fields.definition: "Severe intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by severely sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 20-34." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Early and severe mental retardation; Intellectual disability, severe; Mental retardation, severe; Severe mental retardation

fields.label: Oppositional defiant disorder
fields.definition: "An enduring pattern of uncooperative, defiant, and hostile behavior towards authority figures that does not involve major antisocial violations, is not accounted for by the child's developmental stage, and results in significant functional impairment. A certain level of oppositional behavior is common in children and adolescents." []
fields.synonyms_concat: ODD

fields.label: Abdominal wall defect
fields.definition: "An incomplete closure of the abdominal wall." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abdominal wall defect; Congenital anterior abdominal wall defect

fields.label: Dyssynergia
fields.definition: "A type of ataxia characterized by the impairment of the ability to smoothly perform the elements of a voluntary movement in the appropriate order and speed. With dyssynergia, a voluntary movement appears broken down into its component parts." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Ocular dyssynergia
fields.definition: "A type of dyssynergia affecting eye movements and characterized by the inability to smoothly follow a visual target across the visual field." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Asynergia
fields.definition: "A type of dyssynergy characterized by the lack of the ability to smoothly perform the elements of a voluntary movement in the appropriate order and speed." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Sensory ataxia
fields.definition: "Incoordination of movement caused by a deficit in the sensory nervous system. Sensory ataxia can be distinguished from cerebellar ataxia by asking the patient to close his or her eyes. Persons with cerebellar ataxia show only a minimal worsening of symptoms, whereas persons with sensory ataxia show a marked worsening of symptoms." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Afferent ataxia; Ataxia, sensory; Spinal ataxia

fields.label: T-wave inversion
fields.definition: "An inversion of the T-wave (which is normally positive)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: EKG: T-wave inversion

fields.label: Cervical spinal cord atrophy
fields.definition: "Atrophy of the cervical segment of the spinal cord." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Tendon xanthomatosis
fields.definition: "The presence of xanthomas (intra-and extra-cellular accumulations of cholesterol) extensor tendons (typically over knuckles, Achilles tendon, knee, and elbows)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tendon xanthomas

fields.label: Chaddock reflex
fields.definition: "A diagnostic reflex elicited by stimulation of the skin over the surface of the lateral malleolus of the foot. The Chaddock refelx is present if there is extension of one or more or all of the toes with or without fanning of them when the external inframalleolar skin is stimulated. The Chaddock sign, similar to the Babinski sign, is taken to be an indication of disease of the spinocortical (pyramidal) tract." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating protein concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal level of a circulating protein in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal circulating protein level; Abnormality of circulating protein level; Blood protein disease; Serum protein abnormality

fields.label: Monocular strabismus
fields.definition: "A type of strabismus in which the fixating eye is always the same one, while the other eye is constantly deviated. Monocular strabismus is to be distinguished from alternating strabismus, in which either of the eyes 'squints' at different times." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Unilateral strabismus

fields.label: Fetal cystic hygroma
fields.definition: "The presence during the prenatal period of a cystic mass with multiple septa with multiple, asymmetric, thin-walled cysts near the posterior aspect of the neck. Fetal cystic hygroma can be defined as nuchal translucency with or without septations measuring greater than 3.0 mm. Increased NT refers to a measurement above the 95th centile, and the term is used irrespective of whether the collection of fluid is septated or not, and whether it is confined to the neck or envelopes the whole fetus. After 14 weeks, increased NT usually resolves, but in some cases it evolves into nuchal edema or cystic hygromas." [eMedicine:402757, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foetal cystic hygroma

fields.label: Increased nuchal translucency
fields.definition: "Nuchal translucency is the sonographic appearance of subcutaneous accumulation of liquid in the back of the fetal neck in the first trimester of pregnancy (11-14 gestational weeks of pregnancy)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12751779, PMID:15846173, PMID:28511453]

fields.label: Abnormality of the umbilical cord
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the umbilical cord, which is the cord connecting the developing embryo or fetus to the placenta." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Umbilical cord issue

fields.label: Pulmonary valve atresia
fields.definition: "A congenital disorder of the pulmonary valve in which the orifice of the valve fails to develop." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Aortic valve atresia
fields.definition: "A congenital disorder of the aortic valve in which the orifice of the valve fails to develop." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Bilateral fetal pyelectasis

fields.definition: "A typical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by its sudden onset, interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare, possibly a brief upward deviation of the eyes. Usually the patient will be unresponsive when spoken to. Duration is a few seconds to half a minute with very rapid recovery. Although not always available, an EEG would usually show 3 Hz generalized epileptiform discharges during the event." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064, PMID:6790275]

Duration is typically 10-60 s. Whilst impairment of consciousness may not be obvious the ILAE classified this seizure as a generalized non-motor seizure in 2017." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8486-0558, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064, PMID:9637609]

fields.synonyms_concat: Vacuum extraction; Vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery

fields.label: Shoulder dystocia
fields.definition: "Shoulder dystocia occurs when the fetal anterior shoulder impacts against the maternal symphysis following delivery of the vertex." [PMID:15086043]

fields.label: Hydropic placenta
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the placenta in which there are numerous cystic spaces within the placenta as well as placental enlargement." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hydrops of the placenta

fields.label: Calcified placenta
fields.synonyms_concat: Placental calcification

fields.label: Placental infarction
fields.synonyms_concat: Placental thromboembolism

fields.label: Long umbilical cord
fields.definition: "Increased length of the umbilical cord." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]
fields.synonyms_concat: Long umbilical cord

fields.label: Abnormal insertion of umbilical cord
fields.definition: "Anomalous location of the insertion of umbilical cord in the placenta. Normally, the insertion is at least two centimers distant from the edge of the placenta." []

fields.label: Placental abruption
fields.definition: "Separation of the placenta from the uterus wall before delivery." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abruptio placentae

fields.label: Age of death
fields.definition: "The age group when the cessation of life happens." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Death in adolescence
fields.definition: "Death during adolescence, the period between childhood and adulthood (roughly between the ages of 10 and 16 years)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Death in adolescence

fields.label: Abnormal blood chloride concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormality of chloride homeostasis or concentration in the body." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal blood Cl concentration; Abnormal blood Cl- concentration; Abnormality of chloride homeostasis

fields.label: Hyperchloremia
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased chloride concentration in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Increased serum zinc
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of zinc in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperzincemia

fields.label: Fetal ultrasound soft marker
fields.definition: "An finding upon obstetric ultrasound examination performed at around 16 to 20 weeks of gestation that is abnormal but not clearly identifiable as a fetal anatomic malformation or growth restriction. Such findings are known as soft markers since they are associated with increased risk for fetal aneuploidy or other disorders." [PMID:16100637]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foetal ultrasound soft marker

fields.label: Fetal choroid plexus cysts
fields.definition: "Fetal choroid plexus cysts (CPCs) are sonographically discrete, small cysts found in the choroid plexus within the lateral cerebral ventricles of the developing fetus at 14 to 24 weeks gestation. Imaging of the choroid plexus is performed in the transverse plane of the fetal head at the same level that the lateral cerebral ventricle is evaluated. The choroid plexus should be inspected bilaterally for the presence of cysts. The size of CPCs is not of clinical relevance (PMID:16100637)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:16100637, PMID:16809660]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foetal choroid plexus cysts

fields.label: Enlarged fetal cisterna magna
fields.definition: "The cisterna magna is measured on a transaxial view of the fetal head angled 15 degrees caudal to the canthomeatal line. The anterior/posterior diameter is taken between the inferior/posterior surface of the vermis of the cerebellum to the inner surface of the cranium. An enlarged cisternal magna is defined by an anterior/posterior diameter of 10 mm or more (PMID:16100637)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:16100637]
fields.synonyms_concat: Enlarged foetal cisterna magna

fields.label: Short fetal femur length
fields.definition: "A short femur length is defined as either a measurement below the 2.5th percentile for gestational age or a measurement that is less than 0.9 of that predicted by the measured biparietal diameter. The femur should be measured with the bone perpendicular to the ultrasound beam and with epiphyseal cartilages visible but not included in the measurement (PMID:16100637)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short fetal thigh bone length; Short foetal femur length; Short foetal thigh bone length

fields.label: Short fetal humerus length
fields.definition: "A short humerus length is defined as a length below the 2.5th percentile for gestational age or as a measurement less than 0.9 of that predicted by the measured biparietal diameter. The humerus should be measured with the bone perpendicular to the ultrasound beam and with epiphyseal cartilages visible but not included in the measurement (PMID:16100637)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637]
synonyms: Short fetal long bone in upper arm length
Short foetal long bone in upper arm length
fields.synonyms_concat: Short fetal long bone in upper arm length; Short foetal humerus length; Short foetal long bone in upper arm length

fields.label: Hypoplasia of fetal nasal bone
fields.definition: "On prenatal ultrasound, the nasal bone is a thin echogenic line within the bridge of the fetal nose. The fetus is imaged facing the transducer with the fetal face strictly in the midline. The angle of insonation is 90 degrees, with the longitudinal axis of the nasal bone as the reference line. Calibres are placed at each end of the nasal bone. Absence of the nasal bone or measurements below 2.5th percentile are considered significant (PMID:16100637)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplasia of foetal nasal bone; Underdeveloped fetal nose bone; Underdeveloped foetal nose bone

fields.label: Fetal fifth finger clinodactyly
fields.definition: "Fifth finger clinodactyly is defined by a hypoplastic or absent mid-phalanx of the fifth digit. Ultrasound identification of the fetal hand must first be undertaken and then appropriate magnification accomplished. The evaluation requires stretching of the 5 fingers. The diagnosis is established when the middle phalanx of the fifth finger is markedly smaller than normal or absent, which often causes the finger to be curved inward (PMID:16100637)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fetal little finger curvature; Fetal pinkie finger curvature; Fetal pinky finger curvature; Foetal fifth finger clinodactyly; Foetal little finger curvature; Foetal pinkie finger curvature; Foetal pinky finger curvature

fields.label: Elevated maternal circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
fields.definition: "Increase in the levels of maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein levels during pregnancy." [PMID:32039804]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein; High maternal circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration; High maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein; High maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein MoM; High MSAFP MoM; Increased maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein level; MSAFP MoM>2.5

fields.label: High maternal circulating chorionic gonadotropin concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally high concentration of maternal serum human chorionic gonadotropin as compared to normal values for gestational-age." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:2447576]
fields.label_normalized: high maternal circulating chorionic gonadotropin concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: High maternal serum chorionic gonadotropin; High maternal serum hCG

fields.label: Low maternal circulating chorionic gonadotropin concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally low concentration of maternal serum human chorionic gonadotropin as compared to normal values for gestational-age." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:2447576]
fields.label_normalized: low maternal circulating chorionic gonadotropin concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Low maternal serum chorionic gonadotropin; Low maternal serum hCG

fields.label: Low maternal circulating PAPP-A concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally low concentration of serum PAPP-A (pregnancy associated plasma protein A), as compared to normal values for gestational-age." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:19038077]
fields.synonyms_concat: Low maternal serum PAPP-A

fields.label: Abnormal maternal serum screening
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated or decreased level of a maternal serum marker analytes used in screening for aneuploidy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:19038077]

fields.label: Maternal autoimmune disease
fields.definition: "A medical history of a fetus or child born to a mother with an autoimmune disease." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]

fields.label: Maternal teratogenic exposure
fields.definition: "A medical history of exposure of the mother of a child or fetus to a teratogenic substance during pregnancy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]

fields.label: Anesthetic-induced rhabdomylosis
fields.definition: "Rhabdomyolysis induced by anesthesia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Alcohol-induced rhabdomyolysis
fields.definition: "Rhabdomyolysis induced by intake of alcohol." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal medulla oblongata morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the medulla oblongata, the lower half of the brainstem." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the medulla oblongata; Abnormality of the myencephalon

fields.label: Abnormal central motor function
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the control or production of movement in the central nervous system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of central motor function

fields.label: Abnormality of coordination
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of coordination; Coordination issue

fields.label: Decorticate rigidity
fields.definition: "A type of rigidity in which the arms are in flexion and adduction and the legs are extended. This signifies a lesion in the cerebral white matter, internal capsules, or thalamus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Athetoid cerebral palsy
fields.definition: "A type of cerebral palsy characterized by slow, involuntary muscle movement and mixed muscle tone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1511-5893]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dyskinetic cerebral palsy

fields.label: Abnormality of mental function
fields.definition: "Cognitive, psychiatric, or memory anomaly." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of higher mental function

fields.label: Hyposegmentation of neutrophil nuclei
fields.definition: "Hyposegmented (hypolobulated) or bilobed neutrophil nuclei." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Hyposegmentation of neutrophil nuclei in peripheral blood
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyposegmentation of neutrophil nuclei in peripheral blood; Pelger-Huet anomaly

fields.label: Ankle clonus
fields.definition: "Clonus is an involuntary tendon reflex that causes repeated flexion and extension of the foot. Ankle clonus is tested by rapidly flexing the foot upward." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal rhythmic movements of ankle

fields.label: Knee clonus
fields.definition: "Clonus is an involuntary tendon reflex that causes repeated flexion and extension of the foot. Knee clonus can be tested by rapidly pushing the patella towards the toes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Patellar clonus

fields.label: Unusual CNS infection
fields.definition: "A type of infection of the central nervous system that can be regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Central nervous system infection

fields.label: Primary microcephaly
fields.definition: "Head circumference below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender at birth." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Decreased head circumference present at birth
Head circumference small for gestational age
Small head circumference present at birth
fields.synonyms_concat: Congenital decreased head circumference; Congenital microcephaly; Congenital small head; Congenital small head circumference; Congenital small skull; Decreased head circumference present at birth; Head circumference small for gestational age; Microcephaly present at birth; Small cranium present at birth; Small head circumference present at birth; Small head present at birth; Small skull present at birth

fields.label: Functional abnormality of the middle ear
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the function of the middle ear." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Functional abnormality of the middle ear
fields.label_normalized: functional abnormality of the middle ear
fields.synonyms_concat: Functional abnormality of the middle ear

fields.label: Abnormal incus morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the incus, an ossicle in the middle ear." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the incus

fields.label: Abnormal malleus morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the malleus, an ossicle in the middle ear." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the malleus

fields.label: Absent malleus
fields.definition: "Aplasia of the malleus." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]

fields.label: Absent stapes
fields.definition: "Aplasia of the stapes." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]

fields.label: Loss of eyelashes
fields.definition: "This term refers to the loss of eyelashes that were previously present." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ciliary Madarosis; Eyelashes fell out; Loss of eyelashes; Milphosis; Missing eyelashes

fields.label: Abdominal symptom
fields.definition: "A subjective manifestation of disease localized to the abdomen." []

fields.label: Esophageal carcinoma
fields.definition: "The presence of a carcinoma of the esophagus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, NCIT:C3513]

fields.label: Embryonal onset
fields.definition: "Onset of disease at up to 8 weeks following fertilization (corresponding to 10 weeks of gestation)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]

fields.label: Fetal onset
fields.definition: "Onset prior to birth but after 8 weeks of embryonic development (corresponding to a gestational age of 10 weeks)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foetal onset

fields.label: Young adult onset
fields.definition: "Onset of disease at the age of between 16 and 40 years." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]

fields.label: Childhood onset
fields.definition: "Onset of disease at the age of between 1 and 5 years." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]
fields.synonyms_concat: Symptoms begin in childhood

fields.label: Aganglionosis of the small intestine
fields.definition: "A lack of intestinal ganglion cells (i.e., an aganglionic section of bowel) affecting the small intestine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]

fields.label: Duodenal aganglionosis
fields.definition: "A lack of intestinal ganglion cells (i.e., an aganglionic section of bowel) affecting the duodenum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the gallbladder
fields.definition: "Absence or underdevelopment of the gallbladder." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent/small gallbladder; Absent/underdeveloped gallbladder

fields.label: Absent gallbladder
fields.definition: "A developmental defect in which the gallbladder fails to form." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent gallbladder; Agenesis of the gallbladder; Aplasia of the gallbladder

fields.label: Facial tics
fields.definition: "Sudden, repetitive, nonrhythmic motor movements (spasms), involving the eyes and muscles of the face." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2958-5076]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cramping of facial muscles; Facial spasms; Facial tics; Involuntary facial muscle spasms; Jerking of facial muscles; Mimic spasms; Muscle spasm of face; Myoclonus of facial muscles; Spasms of facial muscles; Twitching of facial muscles

fields.label: Nasal regurgitation
fields.definition: "Regurgitation of milk through the nose." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Nasogastric tube feeding in infancy
fields.definition: "Feeding problem necessitating nasogastric tube feeding." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Gastrostomy tube feeding in infancy
fields.definition: "Feeding problem necessitating gastrostomy tube feeding." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
fields.synonyms_concat: PEG-fed in infancy

fields.label: Abnormal small intestinal villus morphology
synonyms: Abnormal shape of small intestinal villus
Abnormality of small intestinal villus morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal shape of small intestinal villus; Abnormality of small intestinal villus morphology

fields.label: Villous atrophy
fields.definition: "The enteric villi are atrophic or absent." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Small intestine biopsy shows villous atrophy
fields.synonyms_concat: Atrophy of small intestinal villi; Biopsy shows villous atrophy; Duodenal villous atrophy; Small intestine biopsy shows villous atrophy; Variable degree of villous atrophy; Villous degeneration

fields.label: Childhood onset sensorineural hearing impairment
fields.definition: "Sensorineural hearing impairment with childhood onset." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]

fields.label: Persistent stapedial artery
fields.definition: "Persistence of the stapedial artery, which normally regresses during embryonic life." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_mbitner-glidicz]

fields.label: Profound sensorineural hearing impairment
fields.definition: "Complete loss of hearing related to a sensorineural defect." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]

fields.label: Upbeat nystagmus
fields.definition: "In primary position, the eyes drift slowly downward and then spontaneously beat upward. Upward gaze accentuates the nystagmus. The associated oscillopsias are often very irritating, but the symptoms are usually transient." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21505601]

fields.label: True anophthalmia
fields.definition: "Absence of globe, optic nerve, chiasm and optic tracts. No evidence of ocular tissue on MRI scan or examination." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
fields.synonyms_concat: Complete anophthalmia; Complete anophthalmos; Completely missing eyeball; Total anophthalmia; Total anophthalmos

fields.label: Abnormal lacrimal punctum morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the lacrimal punctum, an opening on the eyelid close to the medial canthus that drains tears from the conjunctival sac into the lacrimal duct in the same eyelid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the lacrimal punctum

fields.label: Unilateral microphthalmos
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal smallness of one eye." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
synonyms: Abnormally small eyeball on one side
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormally small eyeball on one side; Unilateral nanophthalmos

fields.label: Abnormal lacrimal duct morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the lacrimal duct, a duct that drain tears from the conjunctiva, via the lacrimal puncta, into the lacrimal sac." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the lacrimal canaliculus; Abnormality of the lacrimal duct

fields.label: Abnormal lacrimal gland morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the lacrimal gland, i.e., of the almond-shaped gland that secretes the aqueous layer of the tear film for each eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the lacrimal gland

fields.label: Anterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
fields.definition: "Adhesions between the iris and the cornea." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
fields.label_normalized: anterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
fields.synonyms_concat: Anterior synechiae; Cornea-iris adhesion; Iridocorneal adhesions; Iridocorneal synechia

fields.label: Posterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
fields.definition: "Adhesions between the iris and the lens." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
