fields.label_normalized: posterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
fields.synonyms_concat: Iridolenticular adhesions; Posterior synechiae

fields.label: Corneolenticular adhesion
fields.definition: "Developmental abnormality in which the lens and cornea are not separated." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Abnormal corneal thickness
fields.definition: "An abnormal anteroposterior thickness of the cornea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of corneal thickness

fields.label: Increased corneal thickness
fields.definition: "A increased anteroposterior thickness of the cornea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal corneal endothelium morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the corneal endothelium, that is, the single layer of cells on the inner surface of the cornea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of corneal endothelium

fields.label: Abnormal migration of corneal endothelium
fields.definition: "Abnormal migration of corneal endothelium." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Abnormal Descemet membrane morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormality of Descemet's membrane, which is the basement membrane of the corneal endothelium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of Descemet's membrane

fields.label: Reduced number of corneal endothelial cells
fields.definition: "A reduction in the number of corneal endothelial cells." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
fields.label_normalized: reduced number of corneal endothelial cells

fields.label: Abnormal corneal stroma morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the stroma of cornea, also known as the substantia propria of cornea." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of corneal stroma

fields.label: Central opacification of the cornea
fields.definition: "Reduced transparency of the central portion of the corneal stroma." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Generalized opacification of the cornea
fields.definition: "Generalized reduced transparency of the stroma of the cornea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Generalised opacification of the cornea

fields.label: Abnormal corneal epithelium morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the corneal epithelium, that is of the epithelial tissue that covers the front of the cornea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of corneal epithelium

fields.label: Corneal neovascularization
fields.definition: "Ingrowth of new blood vessels into the cornea." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, PMID:22898649]
synonyms: New blood vessel formation in cornea
fields.synonyms_concat: Corneal neovascularisation; Corneal pannus; Corneal vascularization; Limbal neovascularization; New blood vessel formation in cornea

fields.label: Rubeosis iridis
fields.definition: "Formation of new blood vessels on the iris. The new vessels do not display the typical radially symmertic growth pattern of normal iris blood vessels, but rather appear disorganized. Rubeosis usually starts from the pupillary border with tiny tufts of dilated capillaries or red spots that can only be appreciated with high magnification." [PMID:27895936, PMID:29881517]
synonyms: New blood vessel formation in iris
fields.synonyms_concat: Iris neovascularization; Neovascularization of the iris; New blood vessel formation in iris

fields.label: Mydriasis
fields.definition: "Abnormal dilatation of the iris." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dilated pupil

fields.label: Polycoria
fields.definition: "Multiple pupils." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multiple pupils

fields.label: Anterior lenticonus
fields.definition: "A conical projection of the anterior surface of the lens, occurring as a developmental anomaly." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]

fields.label: Posterior lenticonus
fields.definition: "A conical projection of the posterior surface of the lens, occurring as a developmental anomaly." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]

fields.label: Aplasia of the fovea
fields.definition: "Congenital absence of the fovea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent fovea

fields.label: Bull's eye maculopathy
fields.definition: "Progressive maculopathy characterized by concentric regions of hyper- and hypopigmentation, with an initial foveal sparing and whose appearance is said to resemble the central target of a dart board." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592, PMID:31704701]

fields.label: Cystoid macular edema
fields.definition: "Cystoid thickening of the retina that takes place due to accumulation of extracellular fluid in the macula as a nonspecific response to blood-retinal barrier breakdown. Histological studies show that radially orientated cystoid spaces consisting of ophthalmoscopically clear fluid are often clinically detectable in the macula area." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, PMID:19668445]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cystoid macular edema

fields.label: Choroidal neovascularization
fields.definition: "Choroidal neovascularization (CNV) is the inward growth of new blood vessels arising from the choriocapillaris. Depending on the stage of development, they can be external (type 1 NV) or internal (type 2 NV) to the retinal pigment epithelium." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
fields.synonyms_concat: Choroidal neovascular membrane

fields.label: Macular flecks
fields.definition: "Pale, often indistinct, multiple lesions of the macula, of variable shape that is not round. The lesions can be notched, angular, or pisciform (said to resemble a fish)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]

fields.label: Macular hole
fields.definition: "A macular hole is a full thickness gap in the macula, located in the center of the retina." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Macular hyperpigmentation
fields.definition: "Increased amount of pigmentation in the macula." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Drusen
fields.definition: "Drusen (singular, 'druse') are tiny yellow or white accumulations of extracellular material (lipofuscin) that build up in the Bruch membrane of the eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]

fields.label: Macular schisis
fields.definition: "Splitting of the retina in the macular region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]

fields.label: Fundus hyperpigmentation
fields.definition: "Increased pigmentation of the fundus" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperpigmentation of the fundus; Hyperpigmented fundi; Hyperpigmented fundus

fields.label: Retinal cavernous hemangioma
fields.definition: "A benign tumor of the retina that appears as a grouping of blood-filled saccules within the inner retinal layers or on the surface of the optic disc. Retinal cavernous hemangioma are described as having a 'cluster of grapes' appearance." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20844673]
fields.synonyms_concat: Retinal cavernous angioma; Retinal cavernous haemangioma

fields.label: Abnormality of binocular vision
fields.definition: "An abnormality of binocular vision, that is of the ability to synthesize the visual inputs from both eyes to a single image with perception of depth." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Abnormal stereopsis
fields.definition: "Inability to make fine depth discriminations from parallax provided by the two eyes' different positions on the head." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]

fields.label: Achromatopsia
fields.definition: "A condition where the retina contains no functional cone cells, so that in addition to the absence of color discrimination, vision in lights of normal intensity is difficult." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592, PMID:12015282]
fields.synonyms_concat: Rod monochromacy; Rod monochromatism

fields.label: Cone monochromacy
fields.definition: "The condition of having both rods and cones, but only a single kind of cone. Affected individuals have good pattern vision in daylight, but cannot distinguish between colors." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Dichromacy
fields.definition: "Individuals affected by dichromacy possess only two types of cones, instead of three." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Anomalous trichromacy
fields.definition: "Individuals with anomalous trichromacy possess three types of cones, but one of the three types of cones has an abnormal spectral sensitivity compared to normal cones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Deuteranomaly
fields.definition: "A type of anomalous trichromacy associated with abnormal M photopigment, such that the absorption spectrum is shifted toward L wavelengths. Affected individuals have difficulties distinguishing between red and green." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Deuteranomoly; Green-weak

fields.label: Deuteranopia
fields.definition: "Complete lack of the M photopigment, which is replaced with the L photopigment. Affected individuals tend to confuse red and green." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Green-blind

fields.label: Protanopia
fields.definition: "Blue and green cones only; no functional red cones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Red-blind

fields.label: Iris cyst
fields.definition: "An iris cyst is composed of a single cell layer of epithelium and is filled with fluid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]

fields.label: Iris melanoma
fields.definition: "Malignant tumor of melanocytes affecting the iris." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]

fields.label: Iris nevus
fields.definition: "A benign brown pigmented area over the iris representing proliferation of melanocyte cells in the stromal layer of the iris. An iris nevus can be flat or occasionally slightly elevated." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eye freckle

fields.label: Abnormality of lens shape
fields.definition: "An abnormal shape of the lens." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of lens shape

fields.label: Lentiglobus
fields.definition: "Exaggerated curvature of the lens of the eye, producing an anterior or posterior spherical bulging." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bulging of eye lens

fields.label: Solitary congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
fields.definition: "Sharply demarcated hyperpigmentation of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) that is congenital and of no functional significance." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
synonyms: Single isolated congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
fields.label_normalized: solitary congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
fields.synonyms_concat: Single isolated CHRPE; Single isolated congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium

fields.label: Multiple congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
fields.definition: "Unilateral or bilateral small, well-demarcated pigmented lesions localized in the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE). Lesions are dark in the center, with a pale circumference and are mostly located in the periphery." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]
synonyms: Multiple bilateral congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
fields.label_normalized: multiple congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
fields.synonyms_concat: Multiple bilateral CHRPE; Multiple bilateral congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium

fields.label: Retinal hole
fields.definition: "A full-thickness defect in the retina." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Retinal holes

fields.label: Vitritis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the vitreous body, characterized by the presence of inflammatory cells and protein exudate in the vitreous cavity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyalitis; Vitreitis

fields.label: Subretinal exudate
fields.definition: "A type of retinal exudate located in the subretinal space between the sensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Snowflake vitreoretinal degeneration
fields.definition: "The appearance of yellow/white crystalline-like (hence the name) spots in the retina and thickening of the peripheral part of the vitreous." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, PMID:18179896]
fields.synonyms_concat: Snowflake retinal degeneration

fields.label: Abnormal spatial orientation of the cardiac segments
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the spatial relationship of the cardiac segments to other components of the heart." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal spatial orientation of the cardiac segments

fields.label: Abnormal atrial arrangement
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the spatial relationship of the atria to other components of the heart." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal location of heart atrium

fields.label: Right atrial isomerism
fields.definition: "Right atrial isomerism is characterized by bilateral triangular, morphologically right atrial, appendages, both joining the atrial chamber along a broad front with internal terminal crest." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:3408620]

fields.label: Left atrial isomerism
fields.definition: "In left atrial isomerism there is a bilateral small finger-shaped morphologically left atrial appendage joining the atrial chamber along a narrow front without an internal terminal crest." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:3408620]

fields.label: Atrial situs inversus
fields.definition: "Mirror image atrial arrangement, with morphologic right atrium on the left hand side and morphologic left atrium on the right hand side." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Atrial situs ambiguous
fields.definition: "Common atrium without defining morphologic features." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Atrial heterotaxy; Atrial situs ambiguus

fields.label: Levotransposition of the great arteries
fields.definition: "Congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries (ccTGA) is a discordance of atrioventricular (AV) and ventriculoarterial connections. The anatomy of ccTGA involves systemic venous drainage to the morphologic right atrium (mRA), which is connected via the mitral valve to the morphologic left ventricle (mLV) whose outflow is the pulmonary arterial system. The pulmonary venous drainage arrives at the morphologic left atrium (mLA), which crosses the tricuspid valve into the morphologic right ventricle (mRV) with outflow into the systemic arterial system. In isolation, ccTGA has an in-series circulation without mixing; therefore, the presence or absence of associated defects dictates the patient's clinical presentation." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:21569592, PMID:27777298, PMID:32274202]
synonyms: Congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries
Physiologically corrected transposition of the great vessels
fields.synonyms_concat: Atrioventricular and ventriculo-arterial discordance; ccTGA; ccTGV; Congenitally corrected TGA; Congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries; cTGA; cTGV; Discordant atrioventricular a ventriculo-arterial connections; L-TGA; L-transposition; L-transposition of the great arteries; Physiologically corrected transposition of the great vessels; Ventricular inversion

fields.label: Criss-cross atrioventricular valves
fields.definition: "Crossing of the inflow streams of the two ventricles, due to an apparent twisting of the heart about its long axis." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Criss-cross atrioventricular valves with superior-inferior ventricles
fields.definition: "Criss-cross atrioventricular valves with a rare cardiac malformation characterized by the two ventricles lying one above the other instead of side by side." [PMID:11789809]
fields.label_normalized: criss-cross atrioventricular valves with superior-inferior ventricles

fields.label: Superior-inferior ventricles without criss-cross atrioventricular valves
fields.label_normalized: superior-inferior ventricles without criss-cross atrioventricular valves

fields.label: Abnormal connection of the cardiac segments
fields.definition: "A deviance in the normal connections between two cardiac segments." [PMID:24876921]
synonyms: Abnormal connexion of the cardiac segments
Discordant connection of the cardiac segments
fields.label_normalized: abnormal connection of the cardiac segments
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal connexion of the cardiac segments; Discordant connection of the cardiac segments

fields.label: Abnormal atrioventricular connection
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the circulatory connection between atria and ventricles." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal atrioventricular connexion

fields.label: Absent left sided atrioventricular connection
fields.definition: "A defect where there is no connection between the left atrium and left ventricle." [PMID:7104116]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent left sided atrioventricular connexion

fields.label: Absent right sided atrioventricular connection
fields.definition: "A defect where there is no connection between the right atrium and right ventricle." [PMID:7104116]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent right sided atrioventricular connexion

fields.label: Univentricular heart with absent left sided atrioventricular connection
synonyms: Univentricular heart with absent left sided atrioventricular connexion
fields.label_normalized: univentricular heart with absent left sided atrioventricular connection
fields.synonyms_concat: Univentricular heart with absent left sided atrioventricular connexion

fields.label: Biventricular heart with straddling right sided atrioventricular valve and absent left sided atrioventricular connection
fields.label_normalized: biventricular heart with straddling right sided atrioventricular valve and absent left sided atrioventricular connection

fields.label: Right sided atrium to left ventricle and absent left sided atrioventricular connection
synonyms: Right sided atrium to left ventricle and absent left sided atrioventricular connexion
fields.label_normalized: right sided atrium to left ventricle and absent left sided atrioventricular connection
fields.synonyms_concat: Right sided atrium to left ventricle and absent left sided atrioventricular connexion

fields.label: Ambiguous atrioventricular connection
fields.definition: "With left or right cardiac isomerism in a biventricular, the atrioventricular connections are perforce ambiguous, in that one of the connections is concordant (e.g., right-sided morphologic right atrium connected to a morphologic right ventricle) and one of the connections is discordant (e.g., left-sided morphologic right atrium connected to a morphologic left ventricle)." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ambiguous atrioventricular connexion

fields.label: Discordant atrioventricular connection
fields.definition: "Connection of the right atrium to the left ventricle and of the left atrium to the right ventricle in a biventricular heart." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23804932]
fields.synonyms_concat: Discordant atrioventricular connexion

fields.label: Double inlet atrioventricular connection
fields.definition: "The condition in which both atria are joined to a single ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Double inlet atrioventricular connexion

fields.label: Double inlet left ventricle
fields.definition: "The condition in which both atria are joined to the left ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve. Usually there is a hypoplastic right ventricle, which may be on the opposite side of the heart as usual." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Double inlet right ventricle
fields.definition: "The condition in which both atria are joined to the right ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve. Usually, the left ventricle is hypoplastic." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Double inlet to single ventricle of indeterminate morphology
fields.definition: "The condition in which both atria are joined to a single ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve. The morphology of this ventricle does not allow one to determine if it corresponds to the left or right ventricle." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: double inlet to single ventricle of indeterminate morphology

fields.label: Double inlet to single ventricle with common atrioventricular orifice
fields.label_normalized: double inlet to single ventricle with common atrioventricular orifice

fields.label: Double inlet to single ventricle with two atrioventricular valves
fields.label_normalized: double inlet to single ventricle with two atrioventricular valves

fields.label: Mitral atresia
fields.definition: "A congenital defect with failure to open of the mitral valve orifice." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mitral valve atresia

fields.label: Overriding atrioventricular valve
fields.definition: "An atrioventricular valve that empties into both ventricles. The valve overrides the interventricular septum above a ventricular septum defect." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7295418]

fields.label: Straddling atrioventricular valve
fields.definition: "Anomalous insertion of the chordae tendinae or papillary muscles into the contralateral ventricle in the presence of a ventricular septum defect." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7295418]

fields.label: Abnormal ventriculoarterial connection
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the circulatory connection between the ventricles and the pulmonary artery and aorta." [PMID:15227248, PMID:18805185, PMID:24750982]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal ventriculo-arterial connection; Abnormal ventriculoarterial connexion

fields.label: Mitral valve arcade
fields.definition: "Anomalous mitral valve arcade is diagnosed based on the following features (1) An adequately sized mitral valve orifice; (2) short, thick, and poorly differentiated chordae with direct union of the papillary muscles to the anterior leaflet; (3) narrow or nearly nonexistent spaces between the abnormal chordae; and (4) greater differentiation of the chordae attached to the posterior papillary muscle." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:20404264]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hammock mitral valve

fields.label: Common atrium
fields.definition: "Complete absence of the interatrial septum with common atrioventricular valve and two atrioventricular connections." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Single atrium

fields.label: Cor triatriatum dexter
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly with partitioning of the right atrium to form a triatrial heart caused by persistence of the right valve of the sinus venosus. Typically, the right atrial partition is due to exaggerated fetal eustachian and thebesian valves, which together form an incomplete septum across the lower part of the atrium. This septum may range from a reticulum to a substantial sheet of tissue." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17948095]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cor triatriatum dextrum

fields.label: Sinus venosus atrial septal defect
fields.definition: "An interatrial communication caused by a deficiency of the common wall between the superior vena cava (SVC) and the right-sided pulmonary veins. SVASD is commonly associated with anomalous pulmonary venous connection (APVC) of some or all of the pulmonary veins, which produces additional left-to-right shunting." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16172274]

fields.label: Double orifice mitral valve
fields.definition: "The left atrio-ventricular connection consists of two anatomically distinct orifices separated by accessory fibrous tissue." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20851840]

fields.label: Cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet
fields.definition: "Cleft in the anterior mitral valve leaflet not associated with an atrioventricular canal defect." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:6829465]

fields.label: Congenital mitral stenosis
fields.definition: "Mitral stenosis with congenital onset." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Parachute mitral valve
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the mitral valve apparatus, whereby chordae attach to a single papillary muscle or hypoplastic papillary muscles." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Supramitral ring
fields.definition: "A congenital stenotic mitral valvular anomaly with a ring of tissue above the mitral valve." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Membranous supravalvular mitral stenosis; Supravalvular mitral ring

fields.label: Hypoplastic tricuspid valve
fields.definition: "Congenital defect characterized by underdevelopment of the tricuspid valve." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tricuspid valve hypoplasia; Underdeveloped tricuspid valve

fields.label: Imperforate atrioventricular valve
fields.definition: "An atrioventricular valve that has failed to open (atretic)." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Unopened atrioventricular valve

fields.label: Imperforate tricuspid valve
fields.definition: "A tricuspid valve that has failed to open." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:7066117]
fields.synonyms_concat: Unopened tricuspid valve

fields.label: Intermediate atrioventricular canal defect
fields.definition: "A specific combination of heart defects with a primum atrial septal defect, cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet, and inlet ventricular defect. There is one valve annulus and two valve orifices." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intermediate atrioventricular septal defect

fields.label: Partial atrioventricular canal defect
fields.definition: "A specific combination of heart defects including a primum atrial septal defect and cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet. There is not an inlet ventricular septal defect present. There are two valve annuluses and two valve orifices." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Incomplete atrioventricular septal defect; Incomplete AVSD; Partial atrioventricular septal defect; Partial AVC defect; Partial AVSD; PAVSD

fields.label: Transitional atrioventricular canal defect
fields.definition: "A specific combination of heart defects with a primum atrial septal defect, cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet, and an inlet ventricular septal defect. There are two valve annuli and two valve orifices." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Unbalanced atrioventricular canal defect
fields.definition: "Anatomic features of unbalanced atrioventricular septal defect (AVSD) include varying amounts of ventricular hypoplasia, as well as malalignment of the atrioventricular junction. In complete AVSD, the common AV valve can be situated either equally over the right and left ventricles (balanced) or unequally over the ventricles (unbalanced)." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:20837915]
fields.synonyms_concat: AVC defect unbalanced; AVC unbalanced; Unbalanced atrioventricular septal defect; Unbalanced AVC; Unbalanced AVC defect; Unbalanced AVSD

fields.label: Short chordae tendineae of the mitral valve
fields.definition: "Abnormally short chordae tendineae of the mitral valve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: short chordae tendineae of the mitral valve

fields.label: Double outlet left ventricle
fields.definition: "A congenital defect of heart development characterized by origin of both pulmonary artery and aorta from the morphological left ventricle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abdominal ectopia cordis
fields.definition: "Displacement of the heart outside the thoracic cavity and into the abdomen." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Cervical ectopia cordis
fields.definition: "A type of ectopia cordis with the heart partially in the cervical region and without a defect of the sternum." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Thoracocervical ectopia cordis
fields.definition: "A type of ectopia cordis with the heart partially in the cervical region with a defect of the superior portion of the sternum." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Thoracic ectopia cordis
fields.definition: "Congenital malformation of the thoracic wall with partial or total displacement of the heart outside the thoracic cavity. This feature is associated with sternal cleft or absence of the sternum." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Thoracoabdominal ectopia cordis
fields.definition: "Congenital malformation of the ventral wall with partial or total evisceration of the heart outside the thoracic cavity and displacement partially into the abdominal cavity." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19479716]

fields.label: Abnormal branching pattern of the aortic arch
fields.definition: "A deviance from the norm of the origin or course of the right brachiocephalic artery, the left common carotid artery, the left subclavian artery or the proximal vertebral arteries." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal branching pattern of the aortic arch

fields.label: Cervical aortic arch
fields.definition: "The aortic arch extends into the soft tissues of the neck before turning down into to become the descending aorta." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Common origin of the right brachiocephalic artery and left common carotid artery
fields.definition: "The left common carotid artery has a common origin with the innominate artery." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17138027]
fields.label_normalized: common origin of the right brachiocephalic artery and left common carotid artery
fields.synonyms_concat: Bovine arch; Common brachiocephalic trunk; Ovine arch

fields.label: Double aortic arch
fields.definition: "A conenital abnormality of the aortic arch in which the two embryonic aortc arches form a vascular ring that surrounds the trachea or esophagus and then join to form the descending aorta. Double aortic arch can cause symptoms because of compression of the esophagus (dysphagia, cyanosis while eating) or trachea (stridor)." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15148283, PMID:15564538]

fields.label: Left aortic arch with cervical origin of the right subclavian artery
fields.label_normalized: left aortic arch with cervical origin of the right subclavian artery

fields.label: Left aortic arch with isolated subclavian artery
fields.definition: "The subclavian artery arises from ductus arteriosus. While the ductus arteriosus is patent its blood supply comes from the ductus, hence from the pulmonary artery. After it closes, the blood supply is retrogradely from the vertebral artery via the circle of Willis." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: left aortic arch with isolated subclavian artery

fields.label: Left aortic arch with retroesophageal diverticulum of Kommerell
fields.definition: "A patent ductus arteriosus or ductal ligament completes the ring." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: left aortic arch with retroesophageal diverticulum of kommerell
fields.synonyms_concat: Kommerell diverticulum

fields.label: Right aortic arch with retroesophageal diverticulum of Kommerell
fields.definition: "Aortic arch crosses the right mainstem bronchus. The left carotid artery is the first branch, right carotid artery the second branch and right subclavian artery as the third branch." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:12075866]
fields.label_normalized: right aortic arch with retroesophageal diverticulum of kommerell

fields.label: Left aortic arch with retroesophageal right subclavian artery
fields.definition: "Aortic arch crosses the left mainstem bronchus. The first branch is the right carotid artery, the second branch is the left carotid artery, the third branch is the subclavian artery, the fourth branch is the right subclavian artery arising from the posteromedial aspect of the distal aortic arch and continuing posterior to the esophagus to the right hand side of the body." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: left aortic arch with retroesophageal right subclavian artery

fields.label: Left aortic arch with right descending aorta and right ductus arteriosus
fields.definition: "The ring may be completed by the ductal ligament." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: left aortic arch with right descending aorta and right ductus arteriosus

fields.label: Right aortic arch with left descending aorta and left ductus arteriosus
fields.label_normalized: right aortic arch with left descending aorta and left ductus arteriosus

fields.label: Right aortic arch with retroesophageal left subclavian artery
synonyms: Right aortic arch with aberrant left subclavian artery
Right aortic arch with anomalous left subclavian artery
fields.label_normalized: right aortic arch with retroesophageal left subclavian artery
fields.synonyms_concat: Right aortic arch with aberrant left subclavian artery; Right aortic arch with anomalous left subclavian artery

fields.label: Mesocardia
fields.definition: "Mesocardia is an abnormal location of the heart in which the heart is in a midline position and the longitudinal axis of the heart lies in the mid-sagittal plane." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal direction of ventricular apex
fields.definition: "Abnormal plane of direction of the heart from the base to the apex. Left sided is normal." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Rightward direction of ventricular apex
fields.definition: "Abnormal plane of direction of the heart from the base to the apex towards the right. Left sided is normal." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Midline direction of ventricular apex
fields.definition: "Abnormal plane of direction of the heart from the base to the apex in the midline. Left sided is normal." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Congenital malformation of the great arteries
fields.definition: "Defect or defects of the morphogenesis of the aorta and pulmonary arteries." []
fields.label_normalized: congenital malformation of the great arteries

fields.label: Aortopulmonary window
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly with an abnormal connection between the aorta and the main pulmonary artery resulting in an aortopulmonary shunt." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Type II truncus arteriosus
fields.definition: "Truncus arteriosus (single great artery leaving the base of the heart, giving rise to the coronary, pulmonary, and systemic arteries) with each pulmonary artery arising separate from each other on the posterior or lateral aspect of the truncus." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Persistent truncus arteriosus type II; Type 2 truncus arteriosus

fields.label: Type III truncus arteriosus
fields.definition: "Truncus arteriosus (single great artery leaving the base of the heart, giving rise to the coronary, pulmonary, and systemic arteries) whereby one of the two pulmonary artery branched does not arise from the common pulmonary trunk, but instead from the ductus arteriosus or directly from the aorta." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Persistent truncus arteriosus type III; Type 3 truncus arteriosus

fields.label: Type IV truncus arteriosus
fields.definition: "Truncus arteriosus (single great artery leaving the base of the heart, giving rise to the coronary, pulmonary, and systemic arteries) whereby the aortic arch is hypoplastic or interrupted, and a large patent ductus arteriosus is present." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Persistent truncus arteriosus type IV; Type 4 truncus arteriosus

fields.label: Interrupted aortic arch
fields.definition: "Non-continuity of the arch of aorta with an atretic point or absent segment." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aortic arch obstruction; Atretic transverse aortic arch

fields.label: Interrupted aortic arch type A
fields.definition: "Non-continuity of the aortic arch with an atretic point or absent segment at the level of the isthmus." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Interrupted aortic arch type B
fields.definition: "Non-continuity of the aortic arch with an atretic point or absent segment between the left carotid and subclavian arteries." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Interrupted aortic arch, type b

fields.label: Interrupted aortic arch type C
fields.definition: "Non-continuity of the aortic arch with an atretic point or absent segment between the innominate and left carotid arteries." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary situs morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the pulmonary situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the morphological right and left lungs, which is defined by characteristics such as the number of lobes per lung and the relationship of the pulmonary arteries to their bronchi." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of pulmonary situs

fields.label: Pulmonary situs inversus
fields.definition: "Mirror image arrangement of the mainstem bronchi with the right pulmonary artery posterior to the right upper lobe bronchus and the left pulmonary artery anterior to the left upper lobe bronchus." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Pulmonary situs ambiguus
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the pulmonary situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the morphological right and left lungs, in which the morphology of both left and right lungs is the same." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Pulmonary situs ambiguus with bilateral morphologic right lungs
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the pulmonary situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the morphological right and left lungs, in which both lungs have the morphology of a right lung." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: pulmonary situs ambiguus with bilateral morphologic right lungs

fields.label: Pulmonary situs ambiguus with bilateral morphologic left lungs
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the pulmonary situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the morphological right and left lungs, in which both lungs have the morphology of a left lung." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: pulmonary situs ambiguus with bilateral morphologic left lungs

fields.label: Abnormality of abdominal situs
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the abdominal situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the abdomen and its organs." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Gerbode ventricular septal defect
fields.definition: "A type of ventricular septal defect communicating directly between the left ventricle and right atrium. This is anatomically possible because the normal tricuspid valve is more apically displaced than the mitral valve." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:19561249]
fields.synonyms_concat: Left ventricular - right atrial communication

fields.label: Inlet ventricular septal defect
fields.definition: "A ventricular septal defect that involves the inlet of the right ventricular septum immediately inferior to the AV valve apparatus." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:17101870]
synonyms: Atrioventricular canal type ventricular septal defect
fields.synonyms_concat: Atrioventricular canal type ventricular septal defect; Type 3 ventricular septal defect

fields.label: Muscular ventricular septal defect
fields.definition: "The trabecular septum is the largest part of the interventricular septum. It extends from the membranous septum to the apex and superiorly to the infundibular septum. A defect in the trabecular septum is called muscular VSD if the defect is completely rimmed by muscle." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:17101870]
fields.synonyms_concat: Type 4 ventricular septal defect; Ventricular septal defect, muscular

fields.label: Apical muscular ventricular septal defect
fields.definition: "A muscular ventricular septal defect located at the apex of the heart." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Multiple muscular ventricular septal defects
fields.definition: "A type of muscular ventricular septal defect characterized by the presence of multiple small defects in the ventricular septum." [PMID:22718060]
fields.synonyms_concat: Swiss cheese ventricular septal defect

fields.label: Scimitar anomaly
fields.definition: "Right pulmonary venous return to the inferior vena cava." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:16638549]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pulmonary venolobar syndrome; Scimitar syndrome

fields.label: Aorto-ventricular tunnel
fields.definition: "Aorto-ventricular tunnel is a congenital, extracardiac channel which connects the ascending aorta above the sinotubular junction to the cavity of the left, or (less commonly) right ventricle." [PMID:17922908]

fields.label: Congenital defect of the pericardium
fields.definition: "A developmental defect of the pericardium with congenital onset." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Total absence of the pericardium
fields.definition: "No pericardium around the heart, occurring as a congenital defect, not the result of a surgical pericardectomy." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent pericardium; Congenital absence of the pericardium

fields.label: Complete diaphragmatic absence of pericardium
fields.definition: "No pericardium over the diaphragmatic surface of the heart. It is a congenital defect, not the result of a pericardectomy. Pericardium is present on other parts of the heart." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Complete right sided absence of pericardium
fields.definition: "No pericardium is present on the righthand side of the heart. It is a congenital absence of pericardium rather than the result of a pericardectomy." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: complete right sided absence of pericardium

fields.label: Partial right sided absence of pericardium
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly with lack of part of the pericardium on the righthand side of the heart." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: partial right sided absence of pericardium

fields.label: Complete left sided absence of pericardium
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly with complete lack of the pericardium on the lefthand side of the heart." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
synonyms: Absent lining around of left side of heart
fields.label_normalized: complete left sided absence of pericardium
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent lining around of left side of heart

fields.label: Partial left sided absence of pericardium
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly with lack of part of the pericardium on the lefthand side of the heart." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: partial left sided absence of pericardium

fields.label: Partial diaphragmatic absence of pericardium
fields.definition: "Lack of a part of the pericardium over the diaphragmatic surface of the heart. It is a congenital defect, not the result of a pericardectomy. Pericardium is present on other parts of the heart." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Abnormal coronary artery origin
fields.definition: "Isolated abnormalities of the coronary artery origins. This may be in associated with other structural heart malformations but not the patterns of complex structural heart malformations which result in abnormal course of the coronary arteries." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Anomalous origin of coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
fields.definition: "A coronary artery begins (branches off from) the pulmonary artery rather than as normal from the root of the aorta." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous origin of coronary artery from the pulmonary artery

fields.label: Anomalous origin of left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
fields.definition: "Left main coronary artery begins (branches off from) the pulmonary artery rather than as normal from the root of the aorta, above the left cusp of the aortic valve." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27358682]
synonyms: Anomalous left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
fields.label_normalized: anomalous origin of left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
fields.synonyms_concat: ALCAPA; Anomalous left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery; Bland-Garland-White syndrome

fields.label: Anomalous origin of right coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
fields.definition: "Right coronary artery begins (branches off from) the pulmonary artery rather than as normal from the root of the aorta, above the right cusp of the aortic valve." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous origin of right coronary artery from the pulmonary artery

fields.label: Single coronary artery origin
fields.definition: "The presence of a single coronary artery ostium from which both coronary arteries arise." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:4547578]

fields.label: Coronary artery fistula
fields.definition: "A congenital malformation with abnormal connection between one of the coronary arteries and a heart chamber or another blood vessel." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20513726]
fields.synonyms_concat: Coronary fistula

fields.label: Abnormal coronary sinus morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the coronary sinus, which is formed by the union of the great cardiac vein and the left marginal vein and terminates in the right atrium. The coronary sinus functions to o collect deoxygenated blood from the myocardium of the heart and drain it into the right atrium." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the coronary sinus

fields.label: Coronary sinus atrial septal defect
fields.definition: "An atrial septal defect characterized by a deficiency in the tissue separating the coronary sinus from the left atrium (LA). This results in partial or complete unroofing of the coronary sinus leading to a predominantly left-to-right shunt through the coronary sinus (LA to coronary sinus to right atrium [RA]). The orifice of the ostium is frequently large because of the increased flow. From the RA side, the defect is located at the level of the coronary sinus ostium and may also include some deficiency in atrial tissue around the ostium. From the LA side, the size can be variable depending on the degree of unroofing of the coronary sinus. There is partial (either focal or fenestrated) or complete absence of the roof of the CS, which results in a communication between the CS and the LA. Unroofed CS is the rarest type of atrial septal defect. It is often associated with persistent left superior vena cava (LSVC) and other forms of complex congenital heart disease, usually heterotaxia syndromes." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18806021, PMID:19398672, PMID:40843896]
fields.synonyms_concat: Unroofed coronary sinus

fields.label: Coronary sinus diverticulum
fields.definition: "A venous pouch within the left ventricular wall, with a neck opening into the coronary sinus." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:3138904]
fields.synonyms_concat: Diverticulum of the coronary sinus

fields.label: Dilatation of the sinus of Valsalva
fields.definition: "Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation of one of the anatomic dilations of the ascending aorta, which occurs just above the aortic valve." []
fields.label_normalized: dilatation of the sinus of valsalva
fields.synonyms_concat: Aneurysm of the aortic sinus; Aortic sinus aneurysm; Sinus of Valsalva aneurysm

fields.label: Juxtaductal coarctation of the aorta
fields.definition: "Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized at the insertion of the ductus arteriosus, i.e., to the juxtaductal region of aortic arch." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Postductal coarctation of the aorta
fields.definition: "Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized distal to the ductus arteriosus, i.e., to the postductal region of aortic arch." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Postductal aortic coarctation

fields.label: Patent ductus arteriosus after birth at term
fields.definition: "Abnormal persistent patency of the ductus arteriosus in postnatal life when birth was at 37 completed weeks of gestation or greater." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: patent ductus arteriosus after birth at term

fields.label: Patent ductus arteriosus after premature birth
fields.definition: "Abnormal persistent patency of the ductus arteriosus when birth was at less than 37 weeks completed gestation." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: patent ductus arteriosus after premature birth

fields.label: Bilateral ductus arteriosus
fields.definition: "The presence of both a left and a right ductus arteriosus." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bilateral ductus botalli

fields.label: Double outlet right ventricle with doubly committed ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A double outlet right ventricle with a subaortic ventricular septal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that extends anterosuperiorly and are closely related to the pulmonary artery as well, are considered to be doubly committed. There is associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches." [PMID:6193702]
synonyms: DORV with doubly committed VSD and pulmonary stenosis
fields.label_normalized: double outlet right ventricle with doubly committed ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
fields.synonyms_concat: DORV with doubly committed VSD and pulmonary stenosis

fields.label: Double outlet right ventricle with doubly committed ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A double outlet right ventricle with a subaortic ventritricular septal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that extends anterosuperiorly and are closely related to the pulmonary artery as well, are considered to be doubly committed. There is not associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches." [PMID:6193702]
synonyms: Double outlet right ventricle, doubly committed ventricular septal defect
fields.label_normalized: double outlet right ventricle with doubly committed ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
fields.synonyms_concat: DORV with doubly committed VSD; Double outlet right ventricle, doubly committed ventricular septal defect

fields.label: Double outlet right ventricle with non-committed ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A double outlet right ventricle with a non-committed ventricular septal defect (VSD), which is a VSD that is anatomically related to, or close to, neither great vessel, being separated from both by considerable muscle, and also has a pulmonary stenosis; abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches." [PMID:10431853]
synonyms: DORV with non-committed VSD and pulmonary stenosis
fields.label_normalized: double outlet right ventricle with non-committed ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
fields.synonyms_concat: DORV with non-committed VSD and pulmonary stenosis

fields.label: Double outlet right ventricle with non-committed ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A double outlet right ventricle with a non-committed ventricular septal defect (VSD), which is a VSD that is anatomically related to, or close to, neither great vessel, being separated from both by considerable muscle, but there is not accompanying pulmonary stenosis; the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches." [PMID:10431853]
synonyms: DORV with non-committed VSD without pulmonary stenosis
Double outlet right ventricle, noncommitted ventricular septal defect
fields.label_normalized: double outlet right ventricle with non-committed ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
fields.synonyms_concat: DORV with non-committed VSD without pulmonary stenosis; Double outlet right ventricle, noncommitted ventricular septal defect

fields.label: Double outlet right ventricle with subaortic ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A double outlet right ventricle with a ventricular spetal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that is considered to be closely related to the aortic origin. There is associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches." [PMID:6193702]
synonyms: DORV with subaortic VSD and pulmonary stenosis
fields.label_normalized: double outlet right ventricle with subaortic ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
fields.synonyms_concat: DORV with subaortic VSD and pulmonary stenosis

fields.label: Double outlet right ventricle with subaortic ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A double outlet right ventricle with a ventricular spetal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that is considered to be closely related to the aortic origin. There is not associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches." [PMID:6193702]
synonyms: DORV with subaortic VSD without pulmonary stenosis
fields.label_normalized: double outlet right ventricle with subaortic ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
fields.synonyms_concat: DORV with subaortic VSD without pulmonary stenosis

fields.label: Double outlet right ventricle with subpulmonary ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A double outlet right ventricle with a ventricular spetal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that is considered to be closely related to the pulmonary origin. There is associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches." [PMID:6193702]
synonyms: DORV with subpulmonary VSD and pulmonary stenosis
fields.label_normalized: double outlet right ventricle with subpulmonary ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
fields.synonyms_concat: DORV with subpulmonary VSD and pulmonary stenosis

fields.label: Double outlet right ventricle with subpulmonary ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A double outlet right ventricle with a ventricular spetal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that is considered to be closely related to the pulmonary origin. There is not associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches." [PMID:20069085, PMID:6193702]
synonyms: DORV with subpulmonary VSD without pulmonary stenosis
fields.label_normalized: double outlet right ventricle with subpulmonary ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
fields.synonyms_concat: DORV with subpulmonary VSD without pulmonary stenosis; Taussig-Bing anomaly

fields.label: Tetralogy of Fallot with absent pulmonary valve
fields.definition: "Features of tetralogy of Fallot with either rudimentary ridges or the complete absence of pulmonic valve tissue." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
synonyms: Tetralogy of Fallot with absent pulmonary valve syndrome
fields.label_normalized: tetralogy of fallot with absent pulmonary valve
fields.synonyms_concat: Tetralogy of Fallot with absent pulmonary valve syndrome

fields.label: Anomalous origin of one pulmonary artery from ascending aorta
fields.definition: "Anomalous origin of one pulmonary artery from the ascending aorta with the contralateral pulmonary artery arising from the right ventricle." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:2590592]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous origin of one pulmonary artery from ascending aorta
fields.synonyms_concat: Hemitruncus

fields.label: Anomalous origin of left pulmonary artery from ascending aorta
fields.definition: "The left pulmonary artery originates from the ascending aorta in the presence of a pulmonary valve and main pulmonary artery." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous origin of left pulmonary artery from ascending aorta

fields.label: Tricuspid atresia
fields.definition: "Failure to develop of the tricuspid valve and thus lack of the normal connection between the right atrium and the right ventricle." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tricuspid valve atresia

fields.label: Right ventricular cardiomyopathy
fields.definition: "Right ventricular dysfunction (global or regional) with functional and morphological right ventricular abnormalities, with or without left ventricular disease." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17916581]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cardiomyopathy, esp. right ventricular; Cardiomyopathy, right ventricular

fields.label: Left ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy
fields.definition: "Left ventricular non-compaction (LVNC) is characterized by prominent left ventricular trabeculae and deep inter-trabecular recesses. The myocardial wall is often thickened with a thin, compacted epicardial layer and a thickened endocardial layer. In some patients, LVNC is associated with left ventricular dilatation and systolic dysfunction, which can be transient in neonates." [PMID:17916581]
fields.synonyms_concat: Left ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy

fields.label: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy
fields.definition: "Transient left ventricular apical ballooning syndrome or takotsubo cardiomyopathy is characterized by transient regional systolic dysfunction involving the left ventricular apex and/or mid-ventricle in the absence of obstructive coronary disease on coronary angiography. Patients present with an abrupt onset of angina-like chest pain, and have diffuse T-wave inversion, sometimes preceded by ST-segment elevation, and mild cardiac enzyme elevation." [PMID:17916581]
fields.synonyms_concat: Broken-heart syndrome

fields.label: Absent right superior vena cava
fields.definition: "Absence of the right superior vena cava (RSVC). An absent RSVC is always associated with a persistent left superior vena cava (PLSVC). During normal fetal development, the left-sided anterior venous cardinal system regresses, leaving the coronary sinus (CS) and the ligament of Marshall. Failure of the closure of the left anterior cardinal vein results in PLSVC. In general, PLSVC is associated with the right superior vena cava (RSVC) and drains into the RA via a dilated CS. When developmental arrest occurs at an earlier stage, the CS is absent and the PLSVC drains into the left atrium." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:17578953, PMID:19808620, PMID:20532458]

fields.label: Bilateral superior vena cava with bridging vein
fields.label_normalized: bilateral superior vena cava with bridging vein

fields.label: Bilateral superior vena cava with no bridging vein
fields.label_normalized: bilateral superior vena cava with no bridging vein

fields.label: Left superior vena cava draining directly to the left atrium
fields.definition: "A persistent left superior vena cava (PLSVC) that drains into the left atrium instead of the right atrium via the coronary sinus, resulting in a right to left sided shunt." [PMID:18847480]
fields.label_normalized: left superior vena cava draining directly to the left atrium

fields.label: Left superior vena cava draining to coronary sinus
fields.definition: "A persistent left superior vena cava (PLSVC) that drains into the right atrium via the coronary sinus. This is the case in 80-92% of cases of PLSVC and results in no hemodynamic consequence." [PMID:18847480]
fields.label_normalized: left superior vena cava draining to coronary sinus

fields.label: Interrupted inferior vena cava with azygous continuation
fields.definition: "Interrupted inferior vena cava with azygous continuation is the result of connection failure between the right subcardinal vein and the right vitelline vein. Consequently, venous blood from the caudal part of the body reaches the heart via the azygous vein and superior vena cava." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:10550884]
fields.label_normalized: interrupted inferior vena cava with azygous continuation

fields.label: Cardiac myxoma
fields.definition: "A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) of the heart. Cardiac myxomas consist of stellate to plump, cytologically bland mesenchymal cells set in a myxoid stroma. Cardiac myxomas are of endocardial origin and general project from the endocardium into a cardiac chamber." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7477198]

fields.label: Cardiac hemangioma
fields.definition: "Abnormal proliferation of blood vessels within the cardiac cavities attached to the endocardium." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Cardiac teratoma
fields.definition: "A teratoma within the heart. Most commonly, these tumors are detected in the pericardial cavity attached to the pulmonary artery and aorta. The tumor size within the heart varies from 2 to 9 cm in diameter, and intrapericardial tumors as large as 15 cm have been reported. Intracardiac tumors arise from the atrial or ventricular wall as nodular masses protruding into the cardiac chambers. Cardiac and pericardial teratomas are easily detected in the fetus and neonate by two-dimensional echocardiography as heterogeneous and encapsulated cystic masses. Histologically, cardiac teratomas contain multiple immature elements including epithelium, neuroglial tissue, thyroid, pancreas, smooth and skeletal muscle, cartilage and bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17331235]

fields.label: Arrhythmia
fields.definition: "Any cardiac rhythm other than the normal sinus rhythm. Such a rhythm may be either of sinus or ectopic origin and either regular or irregular. An arrhythmia may be due to a disturbance in impulse formation or conduction or both." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:19063792]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal heart rate; Arrhythmias; Cardiac arrhythmia; Cardiac arrhythmias; Cardiac rhythm disturbances; Heart rhythm disorders; Irregular heart beat; Irregular heartbeat

fields.label: Tetralogy of Fallot with absent subarterial conus
fields.label_normalized: tetralogy of fallot with absent subarterial conus

fields.label: Tetralogy of Fallot with atrioventricular canal defect
fields.label_normalized: tetralogy of fallot with atrioventricular canal defect

fields.label: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia and major aortopulmonary collateral arteries
fields.definition: "A type of tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia in which all pulmonary blood flow is derived from major aortopulmonary collateral arteries (MAPCA)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22368654]
fields.label_normalized: tetralogy of fallot with pulmonary atresia and major aortopulmonary collateral arteries

fields.label: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "The commonest form of tetralogy of Fallot characterized by pulmonary stenosis, overriding aorta, ventricular septum defect, and right ventricular hypertrophy, without pulmonary atresia, absent pulmonary valve, atrioventricular canal defect or absent subarterial conus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: tetralogy of fallot with pulmonary stenosis

fields.label: Subarterial ventricular septal defect
fields.definition: "A ventricular septal defect that lies beneath the semilunar valve(s) in the conal or outlet septum." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:10798413]
fields.synonyms_concat: Conal ventricular septal defect; Doubly committed ventricular septal defect; Infundibular ventricular septal defect; Supracristal ventricular septal defect; Type 1 ventricular septal defect

fields.label: Perimembranous ventricular septal defect
fields.definition: "A ventricular septal defect that is confluent with and involves the membranous septum and is bordered by an atrioventricular valve, not including the type 3 VSDs." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:10798413]
fields.synonyms_concat: Conoventricular ventricular septal defect; Membranous ventricular septal defect; Paramembranous ventricular septal defect; Perimembraneous ventricular septal defect; Type 2 ventricular septal defect; Ventricular septal defect, perimembranous

fields.label: Restrictive ventricular septal defect
fields.definition: "Any ventricular septal defect (VSD) that is small enough to restrict flow across it such that a pressure gradient exists between the two sides of the VSD." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:10798413]

fields.label: Non-restrictive ventricular septal defect
fields.definition: "Any ventricular septal defect (VSD) that does not restrict flow across it sufficiently to generate a pressure gradient between the two sides of the VSD." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Infra-aortic superior vena cava
fields.definition: "The superior vena cava passes below the aortic arch." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Abnormal coronary artery course
fields.definition: "An abnormal path of a coronary artery." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anomalous coronary artery course

fields.label: AV nodal tachycardia
fields.definition: "A type of supraventricular tachycardia that originates in the atrioventricular node." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, PMID:20733110]
fields.synonyms_concat: Atrioventricular nodal tachycardia; AV nodal tachycardia

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with an accessory connection mediated pathway
fields.definition: "Supraventricular tachycardia in which an accessory pathway connecting the atria and ventricles, apart from the AV node, participates as a necessary part of a reentrant mechanism." [PMID:22459483]
synonyms: Supraventricular tachycardia with an accessory connexion mediated pathway
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with an accessory connection mediated pathway
fields.synonyms_concat: Atrioventricular re-entry tachycardia; Supraventricular tachycardia with an accessory connexion mediated pathway

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory connection
fields.definition: "Supraventricular tachycardia with an accessory connection mediated pathway that is called concealed because it is not seen on the ECG during sinus rhythm." [PMID:22459483]
synonyms: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory connexion
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory connection
fields.synonyms_concat: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory connexion

fields.label: Permanent junctional reciprocating tachycardia
fields.definition: "An incessant orthodromic tachycardia with anterograde conduction over the atrioventricular node and by retrograde conduction via an accessory pathway usually located in the posteroseptal region with slow and decremental conduction." [PMID:15831598]

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the left free wall
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the left free wall

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the right free wall
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the right free wall

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the septum
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the septum

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway

fields.label: Cerebellar hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Hemorrhage into the parenchyma of the cerebellum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cerebellar haemorrhage

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the left free wall
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the left free wall

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the right free wall
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the right free wall

fields.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the septum
fields.label_normalized: supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the septum

fields.label: Automatic atrial tachycardia
fields.definition: "Chronic supraventricular tachycardia predominantly seen in childhood." [PMID:4019927]

fields.label: Multifocal atrial tachycardia
fields.definition: "Multifocal atrial tachycardia is a rare supraventricular arrhythmia in neonates and young infants that is characterized by multiple P waves with varying P wave morphology and is usually asymptomatic." [ORPHA:3282]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chaotic atrial tachycardia; Ectopic atrial tachycardia

fields.label: Abnormal electrophysiology of sinoatrial node origin
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the sinoatrial (SA) node in the right atrium. THe SA node acts as the pacemaker of the heart." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal electrophysiology of sinoatrial node origin

fields.label: Sinus tachycardia
fields.definition: "Heart rate of greater than 100 beats per minute." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Sinus tach; Sinus tachy

fields.label: Sick sinus syndrome
fields.definition: "An abnormality involving the generation of the action potential by the sinus node and is characterized by an atrial rate inappropriate for physiological requirements. Manifestations include severe sinus bradycardia, sinus pauses or arrest, sinus node exit block, chronic atrial tachyarrhythmias, alternating periods of atrial bradyarrhythmias and tachyarrhythmias, and inappropriate responses of heart rate during exercise or stress." [PMID:17420362]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sinoatrial node disease

fields.label: First degree atrioventricular block
fields.definition: "Delay of conduction through the atrioventricular node, which is manifested as prolongation of the PR interval in the electrocardiogram (EKG). All atrial impulses reach the ventricles." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Second degree atrioventricular block
fields.definition: "An intermittent atrioventricular block with failure of some atrial impulses to conduct to the ventricles, i.e., some but not all atrial impulses are conducted through the atrioventricular node and trigger ventricular contraction." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Mobitz I atrioventricular block
fields.definition: "Progressive PR interval prolongation with the subsequent occurrence of a single nonconducted P wave that results in a pause. The pause that follows the nonconducted impulse is less than fully compensatory (less than the sum of two normal sinus intervals)." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mobitz type 1 atrioventricular block; Wenckebach block

fields.label: Mobitz II atrioventricular block
fields.definition: "A type of second degree atrioventricular (AV) block characterized by sudden failure to conduct an impulse through the AV node without a preceding change in the PR interval." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mobitz type 2 atrioventricular block

fields.label: Atrioventricular dissociation
fields.definition: "Atrioventricular (AV) dissociation is present if the atria and the ventricles are under the control of two separate pacemakers. AV dissociation can occur in the absence of a primary AV conduction disturbance." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Bundle branch block
fields.definition: "Block of conduction of electrical impulses along the Bundle of His or along one of its bundle branches." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bundle-branch block

fields.label: Left anterior fascicular block
fields.definition: "Conduction block in the anterior division of the left bundle branch of the bundle of His." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Left anterior hemiblock

fields.label: Complete right bundle branch block
fields.definition: "A conduction block of the right branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a prolongation of the QRS complex (greater than 0.12 s) with delayed activation of the right ventricle and terminal delay on the EKG." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Right bundle branch block; Right bundle-branch block

fields.label: Left bundle branch block
fields.definition: "A conduction block of the left branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a generalized disturbance of QRS morphology on EKG." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Libman-Sacks lesions
fields.definition: "Libman-Sacks valvular lesions are sterile fibrofibrinous vegetations that favor the left-sided heart valves and usually form on the ventricular surface of the mitral valve." [PMID:18421506]

fields.label: Trifascicular block
fields.definition: "Abnormal conduction in all three divisions of the intraventricular conducting tissue." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]

fields.label: Junctional ectopic tachycardia
fields.definition: "Junctional ectopic tachycardia (JET) is a unique type of supraventricular arrhythmia defined by narrow QRS complex and atrioventricular (AV) dissociation or retrograde atrial conduction in a 1:1 pattern." [PMID:22826742]

fields.label: Atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia
fields.definition: "Accessory pathway-related atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia (AVRT) involves an abnormal electrical conduction of the accessory pathway. The accessory pathway connecting impulses between the atrium and the ventricle can be seen at any site in the AV groove." []
fields.synonyms_concat: AV nodal reentry tachycardia

fields.label: Abnormality of the pulmonary veins
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the pulmonary veins." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of lung veins

fields.label: Supracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.definition: "Type 1 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
synonyms: Supracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connexion
Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection, supracardiac
Type 1 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.label_normalized: supracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.synonyms_concat: Supracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connexion; Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection, supracardiac; Type 1 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection

fields.label: Cardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.definition: "Type 2 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
synonyms: Cardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connexion
Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection, intracardiac
Type 2 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.label_normalized: cardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.synonyms_concat: Cardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connexion; Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection, intracardiac; Type 2 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection

fields.label: Infracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.definition: "Type 3 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
synonyms: Infracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connexion
Type 3 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.label_normalized: infracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.synonyms_concat: Infracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connexion; Type 3 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection

fields.label: Mixed total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.definition: "Type 4 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
synonyms: Mixed total anomalous pulmonary venous connexion
Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection, mixed
Type 4 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.label_normalized: mixed total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
fields.synonyms_concat: Mixed total anomalous pulmonary venous connexion; Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection, mixed; Type 4 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection

fields.label: Congenital malformation of the right heart
fields.definition: "Defect or defects of the morphogenesis of the right heart identifiable at birth." []
fields.label_normalized: congenital malformation of the right heart

fields.label: Uhl's anomaly
fields.definition: "Uhl anomaly of the right ventricle refers to the almost complete absence of right ventricular myocardium, normal tricuspid valve, and preserved septal and left ventricular myocardium." [PMID:10859296, PMID:16322929]

fields.label: Persistent fetal circulation
fields.definition: "Systemic desaturation of a liveborn baby resulting from persistent pulmonary hypertension with a patent ductus arteriosus and patent foramen ovale, such that the circulation in postnatal life follows the fetal course." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]
fields.synonyms_concat: Persistent foetal circulation

fields.label: Peroneal muscle weakness
