fields.definition: "Weakness of the peroneal muscles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fibularis muscle weakness

fields.label: Elbow clonus
fields.definition: "Clonus at the elbow joint, i.e., an exaggerated phasic stretch reflex characterized by repetitive, rhythmic contractions at the elbow, generated by rapid passive stretch at the elbow joint." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormality of joint mobility
fields.definition: "An abnormality in the range and ease of motion of joints across their normal range." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal central sensory function
fields.definition: "An abnormality of sensation related to CNS function. Assuming the primary sensory modalities are intact and the patient is alert and cooperative, the presence of an abnormality of sensory function may indicate a lesion of a parietal cortex, the thalamocortical projections to the parietal cortex, or the spinal cord." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of central sensory function

fields.label: Abnormality of circulating cortisol level
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the concentration of cortisol in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal adrenal morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the adrenal glands." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of adrenal morphology

fields.label: Abnormality of adrenal physiology
fields.definition: "A functional abnormality of the adrenal glands." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Central adrenal insufficiency
fields.definition: "A form of adrenal insufficiency related to a lack of ACTH, which leads to a decrease in the production of cortisol by the adrenal glands. Aldosterone production is not usually affected." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Secondary adrenal insufficiency

fields.label: Adrenocorticotropin deficient adrenal insufficiency
fields.definition: "Adrenal insufficiency secondary to a defect in ACTH production." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: ACTH deficient adrenal insufficiency

fields.label: Primary hyperaldosteronism
fields.definition: "A form of hyperaldosteronism caused by a defect within the adrenal gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]

fields.label: Corticotropin-releasing hormone deficient adrenal insufficiency
fields.definition: "Adrenal insufficiency secondary to a defect in corticotropin-releasing hormone production." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: CRH deficient adrenal insufficiency; Tertiary adrenal insufficiency

fields.label: Corticotropin-releasing hormone receptor defect
fields.definition: "Adrenal insufficiency secondary to a defect in the corticotropin-releasing hormone receptor." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Corticotropin-releasing hormone receptor (CRHR) resistance; CRHR defect

fields.label: Dexamethasone-suppressible primary hyperaldosteronism
fields.definition: "A form of primary hyperaldosteronism in which the overproduction of aldosterone can be suppressed by the administration of dexamethasone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Familial primary hyperaldosteronism type 1; Glucocorticoid-remediable familial primary aldosteronism

fields.label: Glucocortocoid-insensitive primary hyperaldosteronism
fields.definition: "A form of primary hyperaldosteronism in which the overproduction of aldosterone cannot be suppressed by the administration of dexamethasone or similar glucocorticoids." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Familial primary hyperaldosteronism type 2

fields.label: Secondary hyperaldosteronism
fields.definition: "A form of hyperaldosteronism caused by abnormally increased renin levels." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperreninemic hyperaldosteronism

fields.label: Ectopic adrenal gland
fields.definition: "Abnormal anatomical location of the adrenal gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal adrenal gland position

fields.label: Adrenal gland agenesis
fields.definition: "Absent development of the adrenal gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]

fields.label: Secondary hypercortisolism
fields.definition: "Hypercortisolemia associated with a overproduction of ACTH (often from a tumor), leading secondarily to overproduction of cortisol." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: ACTH-dependent hypercortisolemia

fields.label: Non-secretory adrenocortical adenoma
fields.definition: "An hormonally inactive adrenocortical adenoma, that is, an adenoma that does not secrete excessive amounts of adrenal hormones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Non-secretory adrenal adenoma

fields.label: Secretory adrenocortical adenoma
fields.definition: "An hormonally active adrenocortical adenoma, that is, an adenoma that secretes excessive amounts of adrenal hormones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Secretory adrenal adenoma

fields.label: Abnormality of the anterior pituitary
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the adenohypophysis, which is also known as the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pituitary disease

fields.label: Adrenocorticotropic hormone deficiency
fields.definition: "A reduced ability to secrete adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), a hormone that stimulates the adrenal cortex to secrete of glucocorticoids such as cortisol." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: ACTH deficiency; Corticotropin deficiency

fields.label: Adrenocorticotropic hormone excess
fields.definition: "Overproduction of adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), which generally leads secondarily to overproduction of cortisol by the adrenal cortex." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: ACTH excess

fields.label: Neoplasm of the anterior pituitary
fields.definition: "A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the adenohypophysis, which is also known as the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neoplasm of the adenohypophysis; Neoplasm of the pars anterior

fields.label: Abnormal posterior pituitary morphogenesis
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the neurohypophysis, which is also known as the posterior lobe of the hypophysis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the neurohypophysis; Abnormality of the posterior pituitary

fields.label: Neoplasm of the posterior pituitary
fields.definition: "The presence of a neoplasm (tumor) in the neurohypophysis, which is also known as the posterior lobe of the hypophysis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neoplasm of the neurohypophysis

fields.label: Posterior pituitary dysgenesis
fields.definition: "Abnormal development of the neurohypophysis during embryonic growth and development." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neurohypophysis dysplasia; Posterior pituitary dysplasia

fields.label: Pituicytoma
fields.definition: "A solid, low grade, spindle cell, glial neoplasm of adults that originates in the neurohypophysis or infundibulum. Clinical signs and symptoms include visual disturbance, headache and features of hypopituitarism. Pituicytomas are well-circumscribed, solid masses that can measure up to several centimeters. Histologically, they show a compact architecture consisting of elongate, bipolar spindle cells arranged in interlacing fascicles or assuming a storiform pattern." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, PMID:17618441, PMID:19109577]

fields.label: Ectopic posterior pituitary
fields.definition: "An abnormal anatomical location of the posterior lobe of the hypophysis, also known as the neurohypophysis. The posterior pituitary is normally present in the dorsal portion of the sella turcica, but when ectopic is usually near the median eminence. This defect is likely to be due to abnormal migration during embryogenesis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ectopic neurohypophysis; Ectopic posterior pituitary lobe

fields.label: Posterior pituitary agenesis
fields.definition: "Absence of the neurohypophysis owing to a developmental defect." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neurohypophysis agenesis

fields.label: Posterior pituitary hypoplasia
fields.definition: "Underdevelopment of the neurohypophysis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neurohypophysis hypoplasia

fields.label: Pituitary gonadotropic cell adenoma
fields.definition: "A type of pituitary adenoma that produces gonadotropins." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pituitary gonadotropinoma

fields.label: Pituitary growth hormone cell adenoma
fields.definition: "A type of pituitary adenoma that produces growth hormone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pituitary somatotropinoma

fields.label: Pituitary null cell adenoma
fields.definition: "A type of pituitary adenoma that is of unknown cellular origin and that lacks immunocytochemical or fine structural markers. Null cell adenomas are not associated with hormone excess." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Clinically silent pituitary adenoma; Hormonally silent pituitary adenoma; Non-functional pituitary adenoma; Silent pituitary adenoma

fields.label: Pituitary thyrotropic cell adenoma
fields.definition: "A type of pituitary adenoma that produces thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pituitary thyrotropinoma

fields.label: Pituitary carcinoma
fields.definition: "A pituitary tumor with subarachnoid, brain, or systemic metastasis. The diagnosis of a pituitary carcinoma requires evidence of metastatic disease, either outside the central nervous system (CNS) or as separate noncontiguous foci within the CNS." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, NCIT:C4536, PMID:15741248]

fields.label: Pituitary spindle cell oncocytoma
fields.definition: "A spindled-to-epithelioid, oncocytic, nonendocrine neoplasm of the anterior hypophysis that manifests in adults and follows a benign clinical course. Pituitary spindle cell oncocytomas are firm, fibrous, and adherent to surrounding structures and are highly vascular." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, PMID:21886889]

fields.label: Abnormal parathyroid morphology
fields.definition: "A structural abnormality of the parathyroid gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the parathyroid morphology

fields.label: Abnormality of the parathyroid physiology
fields.definition: "A functional abnormality of the parathyroid gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Parathyroid dysfunction; Parathyroid issue

fields.label: Parathyroid dysgenesis
fields.definition: "Abnormal embryonic development of the parathyroid gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]

fields.label: Ectopic parathyroid
fields.definition: "An abnormal anatomical location of the parathyroid gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]

fields.label: Tertiary hyperparathyroidism
fields.definition: "A type of hyperparathyroidism that occurs following kidney transplantation, which is a treatment for secondary hyperparathyroidism. Although kidney transplantation leads to a normalization of serum calcium and parathyroid hormone in most patients. The state of persistent hypercalcemia and hyperparathyroidism is referred to as tertiary hyperparathyroidism." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]

fields.label: Autoimmune hypoparathyroidism
fields.definition: "A type of hypoparathyroidism with circulating antiparathyroid or anti-calcium sensing receptor antibodies indicative of autoimmunity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, PMID:19328421]

fields.label: Abnormal thyroid morphology
fields.definition: "A structural abnormality of the thyroid gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal shape of thyroid gland; Abnormality of thyroid morphology

fields.label: Uninodular goiter
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the thyroid gland related to a singular nodule in the thyroid gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Uninodular goitre

fields.label: Thyroid hemiagenesis
fields.definition: "Absence of a lobe of the thyroid gland related to a failure of its embryologic development." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]

fields.label: Thyroid C cell hyperplasia
fields.definition: "An abnormal growth of parafollicular (C-cells) cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Thyrotoxicosis with diffuse goiter
fields.synonyms_concat: Thyrotoxicosis with diffuse goiter

fields.label: Thyrotoxicosis with toxic multinodular goiter
fields.synonyms_concat: Thyrotoxicosis with toxic multinodular goitre

fields.label: Thyrotoxicosis with toxic single thyroid nodule
fields.label_normalized: thyrotoxicosis with toxic single thyroid nodule

fields.label: Central hypothyroidism
fields.definition: "A type of hypothyroidism due to an insufficient stimulation of an otherwise normal thyroid gland. Central hypothyroidism is caused by either pituitary (secondary hypothyroidism) or hypothalamic (tertiary hypothyroidism) defects." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, PMID:18415684]

fields.label: Increased circulating free T3
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of free 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating free triiodothyronine; Increased serum free T3; Increased serum free triiodothyronine; Increased serum fT3

fields.label: Impaired sensitivity to thyroid stimulating hormone
fields.definition: "Reduced sensitivity of thyroid follicle cells to stimulation by biologically active thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH)." [PMID:28648507]
fields.label_normalized: impaired sensitivity to thyroid stimulating hormone
fields.synonyms_concat: Thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor defect; TSHR defect

fields.label: Activating thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor defect
fields.definition: "Gain-of-function thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor (TSHR) defect." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Activating TSHR defect

fields.label: Inactivating thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor defect
fields.definition: "Loss-of-function thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor (TSHR) defect." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]
fields.synonyms_concat: Inactivating TSHR defect

fields.label: Neoplasm by histology
fields.definition: "Neoplasm categorized according to type of histological abnormality." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9113-2978]

fields.label: Neoplasm by anatomical site
fields.definition: "Neoplasm categorized according to the anatomical site of origin of the neoplasm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9113-2978]

fields.label: Embryonal renal neoplasm
fields.definition: "The presence of an embryonal neoplasm of the kidney that primarily affects children." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9113-2978]

fields.label: Intralobar nephroblastomatosis
fields.definition: "Presence of persistent islands of renal blastema in the postnatal kidney, anywhere within a renal lobe (a portion of a kidney consisting of a renal pyramid and the renal cortex above it)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9113-2978]

fields.label: Perilobar nephroblastomatosis
fields.definition: "Abnormally persistent foci of embryonal immature blastema located in the superficial cortical region (perilobar)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9113-2978]

fields.label: Papillary renal cell carcinoma type 1
fields.definition: "A type of papillary renal cell carcinoma that is characterized by small cuboidal cells covering thin papillae with a single line of uniform nuclei and small nucleoli." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9113-2978, PMID:12429790]

fields.label: Renal oncocytoma
fields.definition: "A renal tumor originating from an oncocyte, which is an epithelial cell characterized by an excessive amount of mitochondria, resulting in an abundant acidophilic, granular cytoplasm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9113-2978]

fields.label: Abnormality of facial soft tissue
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of facial soft tissue; Anomaly of facial soft tissue; Deformity of facial soft tissue; Malformation of facial soft tissue

fields.label: Midface retrusion
fields.definition: "Posterior positions and/or vertical shortening of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased concavity of the face and/or reduced nasolabial angle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9602-2321, PMID:19125436]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased projection of midface; Decreased size of midface; Flat midface; Hypoplasia of midface; Hypotrophic midface; Midface deficiency; Midface hypoplasia; Midface retrusion; Midface, flat; Retrusive midface; Small midface; Underdevelopment of midface

fields.label: Enlargement of parotid gland
fields.definition: "Increased size of the parotid gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9602-2321]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperplasia of parotid gland; Hypertrophy of parotid gland; Increased size of parotid gland

fields.label: Hamartoma of tongue
fields.definition: "A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the tongue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17667541]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lingual hamartoma

fields.label: Bifid nose
fields.definition: "Visually assessable vertical indentation, cleft, or depression of the nasal bridge, ridge and tip." [PMID:19152422]
synonyms: Indentation or clefting of the nose
fields.synonyms_concat: Bifid nasal bridge; Cleft nasal bridge; Cleft nose; Indentation or clefting of the nose; Indented bridge of nose

fields.label: Abnormal muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional abnormality of a skeletal muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of muscle physiology; Issue with muscle function

fields.label: Abnormal skeletal muscle morphology
fields.definition: "A structural abnormality of a skeletal muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal muscle morphology; Abnormality of muscle morphology; Abnormally shaped muscle; Issue with muscle structure

fields.label: Type 1 muscle fiber atrophy
fields.definition: "Atrophy (wasting) affecting primary type 1 muscle fibers. This feature in general can only be observed on muscle biopsy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Type 1 muscle fibre atrophy

fields.label: Decreased patellar reflex
fields.definition: "Decreased intensity of the patellar reflex (also known as the knee jerk reflex)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased knee jerk reflex; Decreased patellar reflexes

fields.label: Paradoxical myotonia
fields.definition: "A type of myotonia that worsens with repeated muscle contractions." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7678441]

fields.label: Impaired two-point discrimination
fields.definition: "A reduced ability to distinguish tactile sensations at points that are very close to one another. This can be tested by using special calipers whose points can be set from 2mm to several centimeters apart." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Impaired touch localization
fields.definition: "A reduced ability to identify precisely the site of a touch. This test is usually carried out by asking a patient, whose eyes are closed or covered, to touch the same site with a fingertip." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Impaired topognosis; Impaired touch localisation

fields.label: Agraphesthesia
fields.definition: "Impaired ability to recognize letters or numbers drawn by an examiner's fingertip on the patient's skin (the patients eyes are closed or covered throughout this examination)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Increased cerebral lipofuscin
fields.definition: "Lipofuscin (age pigment) is a brown-yellow, electron-dense, autofluorescent material that accumulates progressively over time in lysosomes of postmitotic cells, such as neurons and cardiac myocytes. This term pertains if there is an increase in the accumulation of lipofuscin (also known as autofluorescent lipoprotein) more than expected for the age of the patient." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:9531959]

fields.label: Increased urinary hypoxanthine level
fields.definition: "The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cephalocele
fields.definition: "A congenital defect in the skull, whereby there is a protrusion of part of the cranial contents through a congenital defect in the cranium, usually covered with skin or mucous membrane. The term encephalocele refers to a subclass of these lesions in which brain tissue protrudes through the defect." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24931720]

fields.label: Parietal encephalocele
fields.definition: "An encephalocele located between bregma and lambda." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2972-5481, PMID:2773494]

fields.label: Basal encephalocele
fields.definition: "Basal encephalocele is an encephalocele that occurs along the cribriform plate or through the sphenoid bone. The mass may appear in the nasal cavity, nasopharynx, epipharynx, sphenoid sinus, posterior orbit, or pterygopalatine fossa. The important distinction from other types is that no external tumor is visible except in those rare instances of herniations so large that they protrude through the mouth or nares." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:4966739]

fields.label: Nasofrontal encephalocele
fields.synonyms_concat: Naso-frontal encephalocele

fields.label: Submucous cleft soft palate
fields.definition: "A cleft of the muscular (soft) portion of the palate that is covered by mucous membrane. Soft-palate submucous clefts are characterized by a midline deficiency or lack of muscle tissue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Partial thickness cleft soft palate; Submucous cleft velum

fields.label: Membranous choanal atresia
fields.definition: "Absence of the normal opening of the choana (the posterior nasal aperture) as a result of an obstructing choanal membrane that may be thin and strandlike or thick and pluglike." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_jhurst]

fields.label: Abnormal facial skeleton morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of one or more of the set of bones that make up the facial skeleton." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2972-5481]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of facial bones; Abnormality of facial skeleton; Anomaly of facial bones; Anomaly of facial skeleton; Deformity of facial skeleton; Deformity of the facial bones; Malformation of facial bones; Malformation of facial skeleton

fields.label: Broad chin
fields.definition: "Increased width of the midpoint of the mandible (mental protuberance) and overlying soft tissue." [PMID:19125436]
fields.synonyms_concat: Broad chin; Increased width of chin; Increased width of menton region; Wide chin

fields.label: Chin with horizontal crease
fields.definition: "Horizontal crease or fold situated below the vermilion border of the lower lip and above the fatty pad of the chin, with the face at rest." [PMID:19125436]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chin with horizontal crease; Chin with horizontal furrow; Chin with horizontal groove; Chin with horizontal sulcus; Horizontal chin skin cleft; Horizontal menton crease

fields.label: Chin with H-shaped crease
fields.definition: "H-shaped crease in the fat pad of the chin." [PMID:19125436]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chin with H-shaped crease; Chin, H-Shaped Crease; Chin, H-shaped groove; H-shaped dimple of the chin

fields.label: Tented philtrum
fields.definition: "Prominence of a triangular soft tissue area of the philtrum with the apex to the columella." [PMID:19152422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Philtrum, Tented

fields.label: Philtrum with midline raphe
fields.definition: "Narrow ridge in the midline of the philtral groove." [PMID:19152422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Philtrum with central raphe; Philtrum with midline ridge; Philtrum, midline raphe

fields.label: Malaligned philtral ridges
fields.definition: "Absence of the usual parallel position of philtral ridges." [PMID:19152422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Asymmetric philtral columns; Asymmetric philtral ridges; Malaligned philtral columns; Philtral Ridges, Malaligned

fields.label: Midline sinus of philtrum
fields.definition: "Pit in the midline of the philtral groove." [PMID:19152422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Central sinus of philtrum; Philtrum, Midline Sinus

fields.label: Narrow philtrum
fields.definition: "Distance between the philtral ridges, measured just above the vermilion border, more than 2 standard deviations below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased distance between the ridges of the philtrum." [PMID:19152422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased breadth of philtrum; Decreased horizontal dimension of philtrum; Decreased transverse dimension of philtrum; Decreased width of philtrum; Philtrum, Narrow; Thin philtrum

fields.label: Abnormal oral mucosa morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormality of the oral mucosa." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of lining of mouth; Abnormality of mucosa of mouth; Abnormality of oral mucosa; Abnormality of oral mucous membrane

fields.label: Deviated nasal tip
fields.definition: "Nasal tip positioned to one side of the midline." [PMID:19152422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Asymmetry of nasal tip; Asymmetry of tip of nose; Crooked nasal tip; Crooked tip of nose; Deviated nasal tip; Deviated tip of nose; Distortion of the nasal tip; Nasal tip, deviated

fields.label: Narrow nasal tip
fields.definition: "Decrease in width of the nasal tip." [PMID:19152422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Narrow nasal tip; Narrow tip of nose; Nasal tip, narrow; Nasal tip, pinched; Pinched nasal tip; Pinched tip of nose; Thin nasal tip; Thin tip of nose

fields.label: Overhanging nasal tip
fields.definition: "Positioning of the nasal tip inferior to the nasal base." [PMID:19152422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Drooping nasal tip; Hooked tip of nose; Low hanging nasal tip; Nasal tip, overhanging; Overhanging nasal tip

fields.label: Moyamoya phenomenon
fields.definition: "A noninflammatory, progressive occlusion of the intracranial carotid arteries owing to the formation of netlike collateral arteries arising from the circle of Willis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Absent scaphoid
fields.definition: "Congenital absence of the scaphoid.." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_jcampbell]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent scaphoid bone; Missing scaphoid bone

fields.label: Delayed talus ossification
fields.definition: "Delayed maturation and calcification of the talus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Partial IgA deficiency
fields.definition: "Detectable but decreased IgA levels that are more than 2 standard deviations below normal age-adjusted means." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Sclerodactyly
fields.definition: "Localized thickening and tightness of the skin of the fingers or toes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal total T cell count
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of absolute number of T cells or of a subset of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22420532]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal number of T cells; Abnormal T cell count; Abnormality of T cell number

fields.label: Abnormal T cell physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of T cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of T cell physiology; Impaired T cell function

fields.label: Ventricular flutter
fields.definition: "A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia characterized by an extremely rapid, hemodynamically unstable ventricular tachycardia (150-300 beats/min) with a large oscillating sine-wave appearance." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal skeletal morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the form, structure, or size of the skeletal system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of skeletal morphology; Abnormally shaped skeletal

fields.label: Abnormal musculoskeletal physiology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the function of the skeletal system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of musculoskeletal physiology

fields.label: Abnormal appendicular skeleton morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the appendicular skeletal system, consisting of the of the limbs, shoulder and pelvic girdles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Short second metatarsal
fields.definition: "Short (hypoplastic) second metatarsal bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short 2nd long bone of foot

fields.label: Osteoblastoma
fields.definition: "A benign, painful, tumor of bone characterized by the formation of osteoid tissue, primitive bone and calcified tissue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Giant cell tumor of bone
fields.definition: "A bone tumor composed of cellular spindle-cell stroma containing scattered multinucleated giant cells resembling osteoclasts." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Giant cell tumour of bone

fields.label: Abdominal colic
fields.definition: "A type of abdominal pain that comes and goes in waves, most often starting and ending suddenly and being of severe intensity." []

fields.label: Abnormal bone ossification
fields.definition: "Any anomaly in the formation of bone or of a bony substance, or the conversion of fibrous tissue or of cartilage into bone or a bony substance." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18157903]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal bone maturation

fields.label: Parotitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the parotid gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hemopericardium
fields.definition: "Accumulation of blood within the pericardial sac." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10882282]

fields.label: Chylopericardium
fields.definition: "Accumulation of chyle (the whitish fluid taken up by the lacteals in the intestine, consisting of an emulsion of lymph and triglyceride fat thatpasses into the veins by the thoracic duct) in the pericardium. Chylopericardium is generally caused by obstruction of or trauma to the thoracic duct." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Serous pericardial effusion
fields.definition: "Accumulation of serous fluid (pale yellow and transparent fluid) in the pericardial sac." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hemoperitoneum
fields.definition: "Accumulation of blood in the peritoneal cavity owing to internal hemorrhage." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hematoperitoneum

fields.label: Pharyngeal edema
fields.definition: "Abnormal accumulation of fluid leading to swelling of the pharynx." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pharyngeal oedema; Swollen throat; Throat swelling

fields.label: Pica
fields.definition: "An appetite for and the persistent ingestion of non-food substances such as clay. In order to diagnose pica, this behavior must have persisted over a period of at least one month." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Plasmacytoma
fields.definition: "A discrete mass of neoplastic monoclonal plasma cells either in the bone marrow or in an extramedullary location." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Reduced factor IX activity
fields.definition: "Decreased activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Low factor IX activity

fields.label: Punctate keratitis
fields.definition: "A type of keratitis characterized by inflammation in pinpoint areas of the corneal epithelium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Metaphyseal dappling
fields.definition: "The presence of spots or rounded patches of abnormally increased density of metaphyseal bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dappled metaphyseal sclerosis

fields.label: Bilateral trilobed lung
fields.definition: "Both lungs have three lobes. Normally, the left lung has two lobes, whereas the right lung has three lobes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bilateral trilobed lungs

fields.label: Abnormal bone collagen fibril morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of bone tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, MP:0011642]

fields.label: Abnormal sternal ossification
fields.definition: "Any anomaly in the formation of the bony substance of the sternum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal maturation of breastbone; Sternal ossification center abnormalities; Sternal ossification centre abnormalities

fields.label: Elevated plasma pyrophosphate
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased diphosphate(4-) concentration in the blood. Diphosphate(4-), as ester with two phosphate groups, is also known as pyrophosphate." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal iliac wing morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the ilium ala. This is the large expanded portion of the ilum which bounds the greater pelvis laterally." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Abnormality of the wing of the ilium
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the wing of the ilium

fields.label: Sciatica
fields.definition: "Pain in the lower back and hip radiating in the distribution of the sciatic nerve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17872935]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet function
fields.definition: "Any anomaly in the function of thrombocytes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Impaired arachidonic acid-induced platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Abnormal response to arachidonic acid as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of arachidonic acid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]

fields.label: Impaired ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ristocetin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]

fields.label: Impaired thrombin-induced platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Abnormal response to thrombin or thrombin mimetics as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thrombin (or thrombin mimetics)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet count
fields.definition: "Abnormal number of platelets per volume of blood. In a healthy adult, a normal platelet count is between 150,000 and 450,000 per microliter of blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4381-2442]

fields.label: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia
fields.definition: "Low platelet count following administration of unfractionated or (less commonly) low-molecular weight heparin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16928996]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly in platelet form, ultrastructure, or intracellular organelles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4381-2442]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal shape of platelets

fields.label: Abnormal platelet volume
fields.definition: "Anomalous size of platelets. Most normal sized platelets are 1.5 to 3 micrometers in diameter. Large platelets are 4 to 7 micrometers. Giant platelets are larger than 7 micrometers and usually 10 to 20 micrometers." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Increased mean platelet volume
fields.definition: "Average platelet volume above the upper limit of the normal reference interval." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]
fields.synonyms_concat: Large platelets

fields.label: Abnormal platelet membrane protein expression
fields.definition: "Presence of reduced amount of a membrane protein on the cell membrane of platelets. This feature is typically measured by flow cytometry." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]

fields.label: Decreased platelet glycoprotein Ib-IX-V
fields.definition: "Decreased cell membrane concentration of the glycoprotein complex Ib-IX-V." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790, PMID:10605725]

fields.label: Acute disseminated intravascular coagulation
fields.definition: "An acute form of disseminated intravascular coagulation. Acute DIC can occur following sudden exposure of blood to procoagulants, with the compensatory hemostatic mechanisms becoming overwhelmed." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Decreased platelet glycoprotein VI
fields.definition: "Decreased cell membrane concentration of glycoprotein VI." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]

fields.label: Decreased platelet P2Y12 receptor
fields.definition: "Decreased cell membrane concentration of P2Y12 receptor." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790, PMID:14755328]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet granules
fields.definition: "An anomaly of alpha or dense granules or platelet lysosomes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790, PMID:18041654]

fields.label: Abnormal umbilical stump bleeding
fields.definition: "Abnormal bleeding of the umbilical stump following separation of the cord at approximately 7-10 days after birth." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]

fields.label: Hemorrhage of the eye
fields.definition: "Bleeding from vessels of the various tissues of the eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bleeding from the eye; Haemorrhage of the eye

fields.label: Hyphema
fields.definition: "Bleeding in the anterior chamber of the eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Choroid hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Hemorrhage from the vessels of the choroid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Choroid haemorrhage; Choroidal haemorrhage; Choroidal hemorrhage

fields.label: Bleeding requiring red cell transfusion
fields.definition: "Bleeding sufficiently severe as to require red cell transfusion (WHO Grade 3 or 4)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bleeding requiring red cell transfusion

fields.label: Bleeding with minor or no trauma
fields.definition: "Significant bleeding or hemorrhage without significant precipitating factor." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4381-2442]
synonyms: Bleeding with minor or no trauma
fields.label_normalized: bleeding with minor or no trauma
fields.synonyms_concat: Bleeding with minor or no trauma; Easy bleeding

fields.label: Prolonged bleeding following procedure
fields.definition: "Prolonged or protracted bleeding following an invasive procedure or intervention." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
fields.synonyms_concat: Prolonged bleeding following procedure

fields.label: Post-partum hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Significant maternal hemorrhage/blood loss following deilvery of a child." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bleeding post-delivery; Post-partum hemorrhage

fields.label: Decreased circulating vitamin K concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of vitamin K in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Low levels of vitamin K

fields.label: Abnormal leukocyte count
fields.definition: "Number of leukocytes per volume of blood beyond normal limits." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal white blood cell count

fields.label: Impaired thromboxane A2 agonist-induced platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Abnormal response to thromboxane as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thromboxane A2 receptor agonists." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]
fields.label_normalized: impaired thromboxane a2 agonist-induced platelet aggregation

fields.label: Anemia due to reduced life span of red cells
fields.definition: "A type of anemia related to a reduction in the average life span of red blood cells in the peripheral circulation, which is normally around 120 days." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
synonyms: Anaemia due to reduced life span of red cells
fields.label_normalized: anemia due to reduced life span of red cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Anaemia due to reduced life span of red cells

fields.label: Subconjunctival hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Bleeding beneath the mucous membrane that lines the inner surface of the eyelid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
fields.synonyms_concat: Subconjunctival haemorrhage

fields.label: Increased total neutrophil count
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase of absolute number of neutrophils in the blood, per microliter, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased blood neutrophil counts; Neutrophilia

fields.label: Abnormality of circulating fibrinogen
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the level of activity of circulating fibrinogen." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]

fields.label: Hyperfibrinogenemia
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]

fields.label: Hypofibrinogenemia
fields.definition: "Decreased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Low fibrinogen activity; Low fibrinogen level

fields.label: Dysfibrinogenemia
fields.definition: "Qualitatively abnormal fibrinogen." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dysfibrinogenaemia

fields.label: Abnormal hemoglobin
fields.definition: "Anomaly in the level or the function of hemoglobin, the oxygen-carrying protein of erythrocytes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal haemoglobin; Abnormal Hb

fields.label: HbH hemoglobin
fields.definition: "Hemoglobin H (HbH) contains four beta-globin chains. It is normally not present at all in blood, but may make up about 1-40 percent of all hemoglobin in HbH disease, a subform of alpha thalassemia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21345100]
fields.synonyms_concat: Haemoglobin H; HbH haemoglobin; Hemoglobin H

fields.label: Persistence of hemoglobin F
fields.definition: "Hemoglobin F (HbF) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin gamma chains. It is the main form of hemoglobin in the fetus during the last seven months of intrauterine development and in the half year of postnatal life. In adults it normally makes up less than one percent of all hemoglobin. This term refers to an increase in HbF above this limit. In beta thalassemia major, it may represent over 90 percent of all hemoglobin, and in beta thalassemia minor it may make up between 0.5 to 4 percent." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased haemoglobin F; Increased hemoglobin F; Persistence of haemoglobin F; Persistence of HbF

fields.label: Reduced hemoglobin A
fields.definition: "Hemoglobin A (HbA) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin beta chains. HbA is normally the main adult hemoglobin, representing about 96-98 percent of all hemoglobin. This term represents a decreased in the proportion of HbA below this limit, and can be seen in various forms of thalassemia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced haemoglobin A; Reduced HbA

fields.label: Reduced beta/alpha synthesis ratio
fields.definition: "A reduction in the ratio of production of beta globin to that of alpha globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of beta thalassemia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:1060068]

fields.label: Reduced alpha/beta synthesis ratio
fields.definition: "A reduction in the ratio of production of alpha globin to that of beta globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of alpha thalassemia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Unilateral radial aplasia
fields.definition: "Missing radius bone on one side only associated with congenital failure of development." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Flattened metacarpal heads
fields.definition: "Abnormally flat shape of the heads of the metacarpal bones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Flattened head of long bone of hand
fields.synonyms_concat: Flattened head of long bone of hand

fields.label: Shortening of all phalanges of fingers
fields.definition: "Abnormal reduction in length affecting all phalanges." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: shortening of all phalanges of fingers
fields.synonyms_concat: Shortening of all finger bones

fields.label: Abnormal metacarpophalangeal joint morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of a metacarpophalangeal joint." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of metacarpophalangeal joint; Abnormality of the knuckle

fields.label: Abnormality of the glenoid fossa
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Lumbar hypertrichosis
fields.definition: "Excessive, increased hair growth located in the lumbar region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Thoracic hypertrichosis
fields.definition: "Excessive, increased hair growth located in the thoracic region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cardiovascular calcification
fields.definition: "Abnormal calcification in the cardiovascular system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Toe extensor amyotrophy
fields.definition: "Atrophy of the extensor digitorum longus muscles, which mediate extension of the toes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Short 5th toe
fields.definition: "Underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the fifth toe." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short fifth toe; Short little toe; Short pinkie toe; Short pinky toe

fields.label: Clinodactyly of the 4th toe
fields.definition: "Bending or curvature of a fourth toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: 4th toe clinodactyly; Curvature of 4th toe

fields.label: Pleural empyema
fields.definition: "Accumulation of pus in the pleural cavity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pyothorax

fields.label: Transudative pleural effusion
fields.definition: "A type of pleural effusion with a transudate (extravascular fluid with low protein content and a low specific gravity). Pleural effusions can be classified as transudates or exudates based on Light's criteria, which classify an effusion as exudate if one or more of the following are present: (1) the ratio of pleural fluid protein to serum protein is greater than 0.5, (2) the ratio of pleural fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to serum LDH is greater than 0.6, or (3) the pleural fluid LDH level is greater than two thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_tkuijpers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16623208]

fields.label: Exudative pleural effusion
fields.definition: "A type of pleural effusion with a exudate (extravascular fluid that has exuded out of a tissue or its capillaries due to injury or inflammation). Pleural effusions can be classified as transudates or exudates based on Light's criteria, which classify an effusion as exudate if one or more of the following are present: (1) the ratio of pleural fluid protein to serum protein is greater than 0.5, (2) the ratio of pleural fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to serum LDH is greater than 0.6, or (3) the pleural fluid LDH level is greater than two thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_tkuijpers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16623208]

fields.label: Bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia
fields.definition: "Bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia (BOOP) is and interstitial lung abnormalitiy characterized histopathologically by plugs of granulation tissue lying within small airways, alveolar ducts, and alveoli and by chronic inflammatory cell infiltration in alveolar walls. Patients with BOOP generally present with subacute illness, including shortness of breath, fever, malaise, and weight loss." fields.label: Respiratory tract infection

fields.label: Bronchiolitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the bronchioles." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_tkuijpers]

fields.label: Nodular regenerative hyperplasia of liver

fields.label: Hepatic granulomatosis

fields.label: Intestinal lymphoid nodular hyperplasia
fields.definition: "A lymphoproliferative abnormality of the intestine characterized by numerous visible mucosal nodules measuring up to, and rarely exceeding, 0.5 cm in diameter Histologically, hyperplastic lymphoid follicles with large germinal centers are seen in the lamina propria and superficial submucosa. There is enlargement of the mucosal B cell follicles caused by hyperplasia of the follicle centers; surrounded by a normal appearing mantle zone. Disease may involve the stomach, the entire small intestine, and the large intestine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21481240]

fields.label: Abnormal pectoral muscle morphology

fields.label: Retinal perforation

fields.label: Non-obstructive azoospermia

fields.label: Obstructive azoospermia

fields.label: Pretesticular azoospermia

fields.label: Feeding difficulties

fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased oral intake; Feeding difficulties; Feeding problems; Poor feeding

fields.label: Cerebral amyloid angiopathy

fields.synonyms_concat: Dermatographism; Dermographism; Skin writing

fields.label: Brown pigment gallstones
