fields.label: Abnormal circulating ornithine concentration
fields.definition: "Deviation from the normal concentration of ornithine in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hyperornithinemia
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of ornithine in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: High blood ornithine levels

fields.label: Laryngeal edema
fields.definition: "An abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling in the tissues of the larynx." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Laryngeal oedema

fields.label: Hepatocellular adenoma
fields.definition: "A benign tumor of the liver of presumably epithelial origin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hepatic adenoma; Liver cell adenoma

fields.label: Abnormal urine hormone level
fields.definition: "An abnormal concentration of a hormone in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of urine hormone level

fields.label: Increased urinary cortisol level
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased concentration of cortisol in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: High urine cortisol level

fields.label: Lipomatous tumor
fields.synonyms_concat: Lipomatous tumour

fields.label: Lipoma
fields.definition: "Benign neoplasia derived from lipoblasts or lipocytes of white or brown fat. May be angiomatous or hibernomatous." [MPATH:417]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fatty lump; Noncancerous fatty lump

fields.label: Sacral lipoma
fields.definition: "Presence of a lipoma in the region of the sacrum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:30264029]

fields.label: Liposarcoma
fields.definition: "Malignant neoplasms which probably originate in primitive mesenchymal stem cell populations differentiating down a lipomatous pathway." [MPATH:418]

fields.label: Steatocystoma multiplex
fields.definition: "Multiple, localized or widespread, asymptomatic or inflammatory dermal cysts involving the pilosebaceous units. Lesions can appear anywhere on the body, but steatocystoma multiplex is more commonly involved with those areas of the skin with a high density of developed pilosebaceous units (e.g., the axilla, groin, neck, and proximal extremities)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20631281]

fields.label: Sternocleidomastoid amyotrophy
fields.definition: "Wasting of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, the muscle in the anterior part of the neck that acts to flex and rotate the head." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Pectoralis amyotrophy
fields.definition: "Wasting of the pectoral muscles, i.e., of the pectoralis major and pectoralis minor. This finding is often manifested by prominent axillary creases or double axillary creases." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Wasting of pec muscles

fields.label: Corneal guttata
fields.definition: "Corneal guttata are droplet-like accumulations of non-banded collagen on the posterior surface of Descemet's membrane. The presence of focal thickenings of Descemet's membrane histologically named guttae. Cornea guttata can be easily diagnosed in vivo and ex vivo by means of specular microscopy as it gives dark areas where no endothelial cells are visible." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10611102, PMID:11222329]
fields.synonyms_concat: Corneal endothelial guttata; Corneal guttae

fields.label: Descemet Membrane Folds
fields.definition: "Presence of folds in the Descemet membrane, which is the basement membrane of the endothelial (inner) cell layer of the cornea. Descemet membrane folds are generally a manifestation of inflammation or edema of the cornea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Corneal stromal edema
fields.definition: "Abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling of the stroma of cornea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Corneal stromal oedema

fields.label: Decreased fertility in males
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased fertility in males

fields.label: Aspirin-induced asthma
fields.definition: "A type of asthma in which aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) that inhibit cyclooxygen-ase 1 (COX-1) exacerbate bronchoconstriction." [PMID:12743549]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aspirin-induced asthma

fields.label: Pendular nystagmus
fields.definition: "Rhythmic, involuntary sinusoidal oscillations of one or both eyes. The waveform of pendular nystagmus may occur in any direction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Nystagmus, continuous pendular; Nystagmus, pendular

fields.label: Seesaw nystagmus
fields.definition: "Seesaw nystagmus is a type of pendular nystagmus where a half cycle consists of the elevation and intorsion of one eye, concurrently with the depression and extortion of the fellow eye. In the other half cycle, there is an inversion of the ocular movements." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Retinal flecks
fields.definition: "Presence of multiple yellowish-white lesions of various size and configuration on the retina not related to vascular lesions." [PMID:7952338]

fields.label: Areflexia of upper limbs
fields.definition: "Inability to elicit tendon reflexes in the upper limbs." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hemeralopia
fields.definition: "A visual defect characterized by the inability to see as clearly in bright light as in dim light. The word hemeralopia literally means day blindness." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Day blindness

fields.label: Oromandibular dystonia
fields.definition: "A kind of focal dystonia characterized by forceful contractions of the face, jaw, and/or tongue causing difficulty in opening and closing the mouth and often affecting chewing and speech." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cranial dystonia

fields.label: Laryngeal dystonia
fields.definition: "A form of focal dystonia that affects the vocal cords, associated with involuntary contractions of the vocal cords causing interruptions of speech and affecting the voice quality and often leading to patterned, repeated breaks in speech." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Spasmodic dysphonia

fields.label: Anasarca
fields.definition: "An extreme form of generalized edema with widespread and massive edema due to effusion of fluid into the extracellular space." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Extreme generalised oedema; Extreme generalized edema

fields.label: Reactive hypoglycemia
fields.definition: "Hypoglycermia following a meal (or more generally, after intake of glucose)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Low blood sugar after a meal
fields.synonyms_concat: Low blood sugar after a meal; Postprandial hypoglycemia

fields.label: Low serum calcitriol
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration of calcitriol in the blood. Calcitriol is also known as 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol or 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Low serum 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol; Low serum 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3

fields.label: Decreased circulating calcifediol concentration
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration of calcifediol in the blood. Calcifediol is also known as calcidiol, 25-hydroxycholecalciferol and 25-Hydroxyvitamin D3." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased 25-hydroxyvitamin D3; Low serum 25-hydroxycholecalciferol; Low serum calcidiol; Low serum calcifediol

fields.label: Choroidal melanoma
fields.definition: "Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the choroid. The classic appearance of choroidal melanoma is a pigmented dome-shaped or collar button-shaped tumor with an associated exudative retinal detachment. Choroidal melanoma is usually pigmented, but can be variably pigmented and even amelanotic (non-pigmented)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22557869]

fields.label: Ciliary body melanoma
fields.definition: "Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the ciliary body." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cutaneous melanoma
fields.definition: "The presence of a melanoma of the skin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Superficial spreading melanoma
fields.definition: "A type of melanoma that is flat and irregular in shape and color, with different shades of black and brown." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Nodular melanoma
fields.definition: "A type of melanoma that starts as a raised area that is usually dark blackish-blue or bluish-red but may not have any color." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Lentigo maligna melanoma
fields.definition: "A subtype of melanoma in situ that typically develops on sun-damaged skin. The lesion is typically a large, irregularly pigmented macule that has developed from an ordinary lentigo (a small pigmented spot on the skin with a clearly-defined edge). Change to a malignant lentigo typically takes place over 20 years or more, and many patients accept the change as a consequence of aging." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Acral lentiginous melanoma
fields.definition: "A type of cutaneous melanoma localized to the palm, sole, or beneath the nail (subungual melanoma). Acral lentiginous melanoma starts as a slowly-enlarging flat patch of discolored skin and usually displays a size above 6 mm and often several centimeters or more in diameter upon diagnosis and variable pigmentation with a mixutre of colors including brown, and blue-grey, black and red. The surface of the lesion is initially smooth but later in the course may become thicker and irregular, and may ulcerate or bleed." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Urinary excretion of sialylated oligosaccharides
fields.definition: "Excretion of oligosaccharides conjugated to sialic acid in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased urinary sialyloligosaccharides

fields.label: Bone cyst
fields.definition: "A fluid filled cavity that develops with a bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bone cyst; Bone cysts

fields.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
fields.definition: "Radiographic features include a dilated, radiolucent lesion typically located eccentrically within the metaphyseal portion of the bone, with fluid levels visible on magnetic resonance imaging." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22474093, PMID:7863874]

fields.label: Unicameral bone cyst
fields.definition: "A benign fluid filled simple cyst of bone filled with serous fluid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Multiple bony cystic lesions
fields.definition: "Presence of multiple cystic changes in multiple areas or multiple bones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multiple bony cystic lesions

fields.label: Increased urinary disaccharide excretion
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of disaccharide in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Glycopeptiduria
fields.definition: "Increased excretion of glycopeptides in the urine. Glycopeptides are peptides with carbohydrate moieties covalently attached to the side chains of the amino acid residues." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: High urine glycopeptide levels

fields.label: Aspartylglucosaminuria
fields.definition: "Excretion of excess amounts of aspartylglucosamine in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: High urine aspartylglucosamine levels

fields.label: Keratan sulfate excretion in urine
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of keratan sulfate in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Keratan sulphate excretion in urine

fields.label: Chondroitin sulfate excretion in urine
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of chondroitin sulfate (CHEBI:37397) in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chondroitin sulphate excretion in urine

fields.label: Abnormal circulating acylcarnitine concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an acylcarnitine, which is produced by reversible esterification of the 3-hydroxyl group of carnitine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18281923, PMID:23258903, PMID:6348429]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal acetylcarnitine profile; Abnormal circulating esterified carnitine concentration

fields.label: Aciduria
fields.definition: "Excretion of urine with an acid pH, i.e., having an increased hydrogen ion concentration." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Acidic urine

fields.label: Abnormal urinary acylglycine profile
fields.definition: "An abnormal distribution of N-acylglycines in the urine. There are numerous different N-acylglycines, and this term refers to pathological alterations in their level or distribution." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10870848]

fields.label: Tonic pupil
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the pupillary light reaction characterized by a marked slowing of the light reaction of usually just one pupil. The pupil tends to be relatively dilated, and there is reduced accommodation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Adie pupil; Adie's tonic pupil

fields.label: Personality disorder
fields.definition: "A personality disorder is a deeply ingrained pattern of behavior of a specified kind that deviates markedly from the norms of generally accepted behavior. It is typically apparent by the time of adolescence and causes long-term difficulties in personal relationships or functioning in society." []

fields.label: Borderline personality disorder
fields.definition: "A personality disorder characterized by impulsive behavior and unpredictable, capricious mood. Affected individuals show a tendency to have outbursts of emotion and an inability to control these behavioral explosions. They generally experience an intense fear of abandonment or instability and also struggle with feelings of emptiness." []
fields.synonyms_concat: BPD; Emotionally unstable personality disorder; EUPD

fields.label: Histrionic personality disorder
fields.definition: "A personality disorder characterized by shallow and labile affectivity, self-dramatization, theatricality, exaggerated expression of emotions, suggestibility, egocentricity, self-indulgence, lack of consideration for others, easily hurt feelings, and continuous seeking for appreciation, excitement and attention." [ICD-10:F60.4]

fields.label: Motor conduction block
fields.definition: "Blockade of impulses at a focal site along the course of a motor axon." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormality of central motor conduction
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the conduction of motor nerve impulses in the central nervous system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:3572430]

fields.label: Cerebellar granular layer atrophy
fields.definition: "Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the granular cell layer." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Enlarged cerebellum
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased size of the cerebellum compared to other brain structures." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cerebellar Purkinje layer atrophy
fields.definition: "Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the Purkinje cell layer." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Ubiquitin-positive cerebral inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates that show positive staining with antibodies against ubiquitin within cells of the brain." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormality of skeletal muscle fiber size
fields.definition: "Any abnormality of the size of the skeletal muscle cell." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Abnormality of skeletal muscle fibre size
fields.label_normalized: abnormality of skeletal muscle fiber size
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of skeletal muscle fibre size

fields.label: Pyuria
fields.definition: "The presence of 10 or more white cells per cubic millimeter in a urine specimen, 3 or more white cells per high-power field of unspun urine, a positive result on Gram staining of an unspun urine specimen, or a urinary dipstick test that is positive for leukocyte esterase." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25760357]
fields.synonyms_concat: High urine neutrophil count; Leukocyturia

fields.label: Abnormal urinary color
fields.definition: "An abnormal color of the urine, that is, the color of the urine appears different from the usual straw-yellow color." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal urinary color; Abnormal urine color; Abnormal urine colour

fields.label: Abnormal mitochondrial shape
fields.definition: "An anomaly in the surface contour of mitochondria." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, MP:0011633]

fields.label: Abnormal urinary odor
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal odor of the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal urinary odor; Abnormal urine smell

fields.label: Arteritis
fields.definition: "Arterial inflammation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Inflammation of artery

fields.label: Abnormal pancreas morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of pancreas morphology; Abnormally shaped pancreas

fields.label: Abnormality of pancreas physiology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the function of the pancreas." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormality of exocrine pancreas physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the acinar gland portion of the pancreas that secretes digestive enzymes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal exocrine pancreatic function

fields.label: Abnormality of endocrine pancreas physiology
fields.definition: "A function abnormality of the endocrine pancreas." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal pancreas size
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal size of the pancreas." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal pancreas size

fields.label: Multiple joint dislocation
fields.definition: "Dislocation of many joints." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multiple joint dislocations

fields.label: Intracranial epidermoid cyst
fields.definition: "A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from ectodermal cells that normally form skin cells being left behind in the nervous system during development." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16714456]

fields.label: Intracranial dermoid cyst
fields.definition: "A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from the inclusion of ectodermally committed cells at the time of neural tube closure (3rd-5th week of embryogenesis). The capsule of dermoid cysts consists of simple epithelium supported by collagen. In thicker parts, the lining is supplemented with dermis containing hair follicles, sebaceous glands, and apocrine glands." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16714456]

fields.label: Edema of the dorsum of feet
fields.definition: "An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the feet." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Oedema of the dorsum of feet
fields.label_normalized: edema of the dorsum of feet
fields.synonyms_concat: Edema of dorsum of feet; Oedema of dorsum of feet; Oedema of the dorsum of feet

fields.label: Abnormality of circulating catecholamine level
fields.definition: "An abnormal catecholamine concentration in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Catecholamine levels abnormal

fields.label: Abnormal circulating creatinine concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal concentration of creatinine in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal blood creatinine level; Abnormal circulating creatinine level; Creatinine levels abnormal

fields.label: Decreased serum creatinine
fields.definition: "An abnormally reduced amount of creatinine in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased serum creatinine; Low blood creatinine level; Reduced creatinine levels

fields.label: Abnormal mitochondrial number
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal number of mitochondria per cell." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormality of the mitochondrion
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the mitochondrion, the membranous cytoplasmic organelle the interior of which is subdivided by cristae. The mitochondrion is a self replicating organelle that is the site of tissue respiration." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mitochondrial abnormalities

fields.label: Parietal cortical atrophy
fields.definition: "Atrophy of the parietal cortex." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Occipital cortical atrophy
fields.definition: "Atrophy of the occipital cortex." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Rhizomelic leg shortening
fields.definition: "Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of the leg (i.e. the femur)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Increased fibular diameter
fields.definition: "Increased width of the cross sectional diameter of the fibula." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, MP:0008159]
fields.synonyms_concat: Thick fibula; Thick fibulae; Wide calf bone; Wide fibula

fields.label: Open angle glaucoma
fields.definition: "A type of glaucoma defined by an open, normal appearing anterior chamber angle and raised intraocular pressure," [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11815354]
fields.synonyms_concat: Primary open angle glaucoma

fields.label: Angle closure glaucoma
fields.definition: "A type of glaucomatous optic neuropathy in an eye that has evidence of angle closure (i.e. significant iridotrabecular contact)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:11815354]
fields.synonyms_concat: Closed-angle glaucoma; Narrow angle glaucoma; Primary angle closure glaucoma

fields.label: Hypoplasia of the pons
fields.definition: "Underdevelopment of the pons." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pontine hypoplasia

fields.label: Abnormality of circulating glucocorticoid level
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the concentration of a glucocorticoid in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating corticosterone level
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the concentration of corticosterone in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of circulating corticosterone level

fields.label: Abnormal circulating creatine concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of creatine in the blood circulation. Creatine is a derivative of glycine having methyl and amidino groups attached to the nitrogen. Creatine is naturally produced from amino acids, primarily in liver and kidney, and acts as an energy source for cells, primarily for muscle cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of creatine metabolism; Creatine metabolism abnormal

fields.label: Endometrial carcinoma
fields.definition: "A carcinoma of the endometrium, the mucous lining of the uterus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, NCIT:C7558]

fields.label: Hepatitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the liver." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Liver inflammation

fields.label: Abnormal circulating albumin concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of albumin in the blood circulation outside of the normal range." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal albumin level

fields.label: Hyperalbuminemia
fields.definition: "Concentration of albumin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: High albumin; High blood albumin levels; Hyperalbuminaemia; Increased circulating abumin concentration

fields.label: Laryngeal carcinoma
fields.definition: "A carcinoma of the larynx." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, NCIT:C4855]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cancer of the larynx; Laryngeal cancer

fields.label: Methemoglobinemia
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased levels of methemoglobin in the blood. In this form of hemoglobin, there is an oxidized ferric iron (Fe +3) rather than the reduced ferrous form (Fe 2+) that is normally found in hemoglobin. Methemoglobin has a reduced affinity for oxygen, resulting in a reduced ability to release oxygen to tissues." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Methylmalonic aciduria
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of methylmalonic acid in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: High blood methylmalonic acid levels; Methymalonicaciduria

fields.label: Panuveitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the uveal tract in which inflammation affects the anterior chamber, vitreous, retina or choroid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Anterior uveitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the anterior chamber." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Posterior uveitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the retina or choroid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Choroiditis

fields.label: Intermediate uveitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the vitreous." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Prostate cancer
fields.definition: "A cancer of the prostate." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Prostatic cancer

fields.label: Stomach cancer
fields.definition: "A cancer arising in any part of the stomach." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gastric cancer

fields.label: Uraciluria
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of uracil in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: High urine uracil levels

fields.label: Basal ganglia necrosis
fields.definition: "Death of cells in the basal ganglia. This finding can be confirmed by autopsy. It can be suspected with hyperintensities within the basal ganglia on FLAIR and T2-sequences on magnetic resonance imaging." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:33198265]

fields.label: Abnormality of bone marrow stromal cells
fields.label_normalized: abnormality of bone marrow stromal cells

fields.label: Abnormal erythroid lineage cell morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of erythroid lineage cells, that is, of the erythropoietic cells in the lineage leading to and including erythrocytes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
synonyms: Abnormality of cells of the erythroid lineage
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of cells of the erythroid lineage

fields.label: Abnormal number of erythroid precursors
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]

fields.label: Erythroid hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Increased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
synonyms: Bone marrow biopsy shows erythroid hyperplasia
Bone marrow smear shows erythroid hyperplasia
fields.synonyms_concat: Bone marrow biopsy shows erythroid hyperplasia; Bone marrow smear shows erythroid hyperplasia

fields.label: Erythroid hypoplasia
fields.definition: "Decreased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
synonyms: Erythroid hypoplasia in the bone marrow
fields.synonyms_concat: Erythroblastopenia; Erythroid hypoplasia in the bone marrow

fields.label: Abnormal granulocytopoietic cell morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of cells involved in the formation of a granulocytes, that is, of the granulocytopoietic cell." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]
synonyms: Abnormality of cells of the granulocytic lineage
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of cells of the granulocytic lineage

fields.label: Granulocytic hypoplasia
fields.definition: "Decreased number of granulocyte precursors in the bone marrow." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]

fields.label: Pancreatic squamous cell carcinoma

fields.label: Abnormal cerebral vein morphology

fields.label: Cerebral venous angioma
fields.definition: "A congenital malformation of veins which drain normal brain characterized by a caput medusae or an umbrellalike convergence of multiple venules on a single, or occasionally multiple, enlarged parenchymal or medullary vein, like the trunk of a tree or the shank of an umbrella. This dilated terminal vein penetrates the cortex to drain either (a) superficially to cortical veins or sinuses, (b) deeply to subependymal veins of the lateral ventricle and then into the galenic system, (c) to the fourth ventricle and then to the pontomesencephalic vein, or (d) to the precentral cerebellar vein and into the galenic system." fields.label: Abnormal surface-connected open canalicular system

fields.label: Myelitis

fields.label: Cerebellopontine angle arachnoid cyst

fields.label: Intraventricular arachnoid cyst

fields.label: Suprasellar arachnoid cyst
fields.definition: "An arachnoid cyst that progressively enlarges from an abnormality in the membrane of Liliequist or in the interpeduncular cistern, and typically, expands from the prepontine space, displacing the floor of the third ventricle upwards, the pituitary stalk and optic chiasm upwards and forwards, and the mammillary bodies upwards and backwards." fields.label: Panniculitis

fields.label: Abnormal dense tubular system

fields.label: Cerebral artery stenosis

fields.synonyms_concat: Extra-axial CSF accumulation

fields.label: Temporal optic disc pallor

fields.synonyms_concat: Leg pain; Lower limb pain

fields.label: Abnormal circle of Willis morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the circle of Willis, also known as the cerebral arterial circle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplastic posterior communicating arteries

fields.definition: "Increased dimensions of the Virchow-Robin spaces (also known as perivascular spaces), which surround the walls of vessels as they course from the subarachnoid space through the brain parenchyma. This term refers to an increase of size of these spaces such that they are visible on neuroimaging (usually magnetic resonance imaging). The dilatations are regular cavities that always contain a patent artery." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:17620468, PMID:23867200, PMID:25564639]

Characteristically, compression of the central arteriole causes the entire lesion to blanch, and the lesion quickly refills once the compression is released." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22356347]

fields.label: Oral aversion
fields.definition: "Reluctance or refusal of a child to be breastfed or eat, manifested as gagging, vomiting, turning head away from food, or avoidance of sensation in or around the mouth (i.e. toothbrushing or face-washing)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet shape

fields.synonyms_concat: Gray platelets; Grey platelets

fields.label: Abnormal number of dense granules

fields.definition: "Painful sensations elicited by a nonpainful cutaneous stimulus such as a light touch or gentle stroking over affected areas of the body. fields.synonyms_concat: Dysaesthesia; Dysesthesias; Hyperalgesia; Hyperpathia

fields.label: Abnormal synaptic transmission
fields.definition: "An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse. fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of neurotransmitter metabolism

fields.label: Maternal anticardiolipin antibody positive

fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced aldolase level

fields.label: Skewed maternal X inactivation
fields.definition: "A deviation from equal (50%) inactivation of each parental X chromosome in maternal cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18097476]

fields.label: Unicuspid aortic valve

fields.label: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in hand
fields.definition: "Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the hand, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in foot
fields.definition: "Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the foot, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in tibia
fields.definition: "Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the tibia, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in fibula

fields.definition: "Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the radius, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Lower eyelid edema

fields.synonyms_concat: Cellulitis of lower eyelid; Fullness of lower eyelid; Lower eyelid oedema; Puffiness of lower eyelid; Swelling of lower eyelid

fields.synonyms_concat: Delayed start of first period

fields.label: Mesangial hypercellularity
fields.definition: "Increased numbers of mesangial cells per glomerulus, defined as more than 3 nuclei fully surrounded by matrix in one or more mesangial areas, not including perihilar region, on a standard 3-micron-thick tissue section, best evaluated on periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) stain." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Abnormal nephron morphology

fields.label: Glomerular C3 deposition
fields.definition: "The presence of complement 3 deposits in the glomerulus." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_ewuehl]
fields.synonyms_concat: C3 nephropathy; Renal C3 deposition

fields.label: Thin glomerular basement membrane
fields.definition: "Decreased thickness of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to a decrease in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations less than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals. fields.label: Membranous nephropathy
fields.definition: "A type of glomerulonephropathy characterized by thickening of the basement membrane and deposition of immune complexes in the subepithelial space." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]

fields.label: Minimal change glomerulonephritis

fields.label: Pseudoexfoliation

fields.label: Renal calcium wasting

fields.label: Abnormal CSF dopamine concentration

fields.label: Moderately reduced left ventricular ejection fraction

fields.definition: "A vasovagal episode or vasovagal syncope is the most common form of reflex syncope. Reflex syncope is a general term used to describe types of syncope resulting from a failure in autoregulation of blood pressure, and ultimately, in cerebral perfusion pressure resulting in transient loss of consciousness. The mechanisms responsible for this are complex and involve both depression of cardiac output as well as a decrease in vascular tone." [PMID:29262088]

fields.label: Aplasia of the upper vagina

fields.label: Pineal gland calcification
fields.definition: "Accumulation of calcium salts in the pineal gland." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal pineal volume
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase or decrease in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]

fields.label: Decreased pineal volume

fields.label: Increased pineal volume

fields.label: Abnormality of pineal physiology

fields.label: Enlarged thalamic volume

fields.label: Decreased thalamic volume

However, with appropriate imaging or intraoperatively, rudimentary remains of this structure can usually be detected. Therefore, the term clinical congenital anophthalmos seems more appropriate and denotes a phenotypic range between microphthalmos and anophthalmos." [PMID:36670585]

fields.label: Ileal stricture

fields.label: Embryo developmental arrest

Arrested embryo development is characterized by downregulation of metabolic activity and cessation of cell division. In order for an embryo to be characterized as non-viable, i.e., arrested, it should present with a lack of cleaving activity and fail to show a sign of mitotic cellular division for at least 24 hours. One can observe failure of a zygote to cleave, cleavage stage arrest either on day 2 or day 3 when the embryo is expected to be between the 2 and 8-cell stage, failure to compact to morula, or failure to form a blastocyst." [PMID:34361119, PMID:39607653]

fields.label: Ciliary body coloboma
fields.definition: "A coloboma of the ciliary body." []

fields.label: Abnormal affect regulation
fields.definition: "A disturbance in the processes by which emotional responses are initiated, modulated, sustained, or terminated in a contextually appropriate manner. Abnormal affect regulation involves maladaptive patterns in the generation, intensity, or control of affective experience and expression, leading to inconsistent, excessive, or insufficient modulation of emotion relative to situational demands." [PMID:23216067, PMID:37925091]

fields.label: History of disease onset in winter
fields.definition: "The initial manifestation of a disease or symptom occurring during the winter season." []
fields.label_normalized: history of disease onset in winter

fields.label: History of disease onset in summer
fields.definition: "The initial manifestation of a disease or symptom occurring during the summer season." []
fields.label_normalized: history of disease onset in summer

fields.label: Cutaneous lesion morphology
fields.definition: "A description of structural or physical characteristics of a skin lesion, describing how the lesion appears or is composed." []

fields.label: Bleeding into skin lesions
fields.definition: "Presence of bleeding within (pre-existing) cutaneous lesions such as blisters or vesicles, resulting in blood-filled lesions." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hemorrhagic nature to skin lesions

fields.label: Crusted skin lesions
fields.definition: "Lesions covered by a hardened layer of dried exudate, blood, or serum." []

fields.label: Slough
fields.definition: "Slough is a type of necrotic skin lesion that is characterized as being yellow, tan, green or brown in color and may be moist, loose and stringy in appearance." [PMID:16455730]

fields.label: Local paresthesia at bite site
fields.definition: "Abnormal tingling, burning, or itching sensation localized to the site of an animal bite, typically occurring after the wound has healed." [PMID:15043965, PMID:29188797]

fields.label: Amyloid deposition by anatomical site
fields.definition: "Amyloid deposition categorized according to the anatomical site of deposition." []

fields.label: Amyloid deposition by type of amyloid
fields.definition: "Amyloid deposition categorized according to the category of pathological amyloid fiber being deposited." []
fields.label_normalized: amyloid deposition by type of amyloid

fields.label: Transthyretin amyloid deposition
fields.definition: "Deposition of misfolded transthyretin (TTR) protein in tissue." [PMID:34662045]

fields.label: Cerebral transthyretin amyloid deposition
fields.definition: "Accumulation of misfolded transthyretin protein in brain tissue." [PMID:36198883]

fields.label: Abnormal CSF 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above or below the limits of normal." []

fields.label: Decreased CSF 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Hip external rotation contracture
fields.definition: "A condition where the hip joint is limited in its range of motion due to the shortening of muscles that externally rotate the hip, causing the leg and foot to point outward when standing or walking. The knee is turned past neutral in the direction moving away from the midline, where the neutral position for the hip is with knee pointing directly anteriorly." [PMID:40176701]

fields.label: Hip abduction contracture
fields.definition: "Abduction contracture of the hip is characterized by the limitation of active and/or passive adduction of the hip joint in the coronal plane; a chronic reduction in the ability to move the proximal segment of the lower extremity actively or passively medially towards the body midline past the sagittal plane of the body." []

fields.label: Hip adduction contracture
fields.definition: "Inability of hip to bring from medial side to neutral position, where the neutral position for the hip is with the thigh segment in line with the anatomic plane of the pelvis, both in the coronal and sagittal planes." [PMID:40176701]

fields.label: Hip extension contracture
fields.definition: "Inability to flex the hip past the extension range from the neutral position, where the neutral position for the hip is with the hip and thigh segment in line in the same coronal plane as the pelvis." [PMID:40176701]

fields.label: Hip flexion contracture
fields.definition: "The inability to bring a flexed hip to neutral in the sagittal plane, where the neutral position for the hip is with the thigh segment in line with the anatomic plane of the pelvis, both in the coronal and sagittal planes." [PMID:40176701]

fields.label: Positive Coombs test
fields.definition: "A positive (abnormal) result of the direct antiglobulin test (DAT; sometimes referred to as the Coombs test). The test is a method of demonstrating the presence of antibody or complement bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes by the use of anti-human globulin to form a visible agglutination reaction. The DAT tests for antibodies or complement bound directly to erythrocytes, indicating in vivo sensitization." []

fields.label: Direct antiglobulin test positive for IgG
fields.definition: "Demonstration of the presence of IgG antibodies bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes by the use of anti-human globulin to form a visible agglutination reaction." []
fields.label_normalized: direct antiglobulin test positive for igg
fields.synonyms_concat: IgG+ Coombs test

fields.label: Direct antiglobulin test positive for IgM
fields.definition: "Demonstration of the presence of IgM antibodies bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes by the use of anti-human globulin to form a visible agglutination reaction." []
fields.label_normalized: direct antiglobulin test positive for igm
fields.synonyms_concat: IgM+ Coombs test

fields.label: Abnormal spinal cord white matter morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality affecting the white matter of the spinal cord, including sensory tracts (dorsal columns) and motor tracts (corticospinal tracts). Abnormalities may involve myelin, axons, or tract organization and can result in sensory, motor, or autonomic deficits." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal spinal cord white matter morphology

fields.label: Abnormal spinal cord lateral corticospinal tract morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality affecting the lateral corticospinal tracts of the spinal cord, which may involve axonal loss, demyelination, or tract degeneration, and can result in motor deficits such as weakness, spasticity, or impaired voluntary movement." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal spinal cord lateral corticospinal tract morphology

fields.label: Direct antiglobulin test positive for C3d
fields.definition: "Demonstration of the presence of C3d complement fragments bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes using anti-human globulin (Coombs reagent), which produces a visible agglutination reaction." []
fields.label_normalized: direct antiglobulin test positive for c3d

fields.label: Hyperreflective retinal dots on OCT
fields.definition: "Abnormal hyperreflective dots (HRDs) detected in Optical coherence tomography (OCT) scans. The HRDs are scattered, punctiform, small in size, mainly located in the outer retinal layers and/or around pockets of fluid accumulation and are typically not confluent." [PMID:25926902]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperreflective retinal foci on OCT

fields.label: Irregularity of the retinal pigment epithelium layer on OCT
fields.definition: "Lack of uniformity in the morphology of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) layer observed on optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging. The RPE lies between the neurosensory retina (photoreceptors) and Bruch membrane/choroid, and normally appears as a thin, hyperreflective (bright) band on OCT imaging. This term comprises irregularities which may manifest as thickening, thinning, undulations, or loss of normal reflectivity, potentially affecting retinal structure or function." [PMID:19797228]
fields.label_normalized: irregularity of the retinal pigment epithelium layer on oct

fields.label: Diffuse
fields.definition: "A spatial pattern that is spread out, i.e., not localized." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Lower limb dysmetria
fields.definition: "A lack of coordination of leg movement manifested by undershoot or overshoot of the intended position of the leg." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2353-596X, PMID:25573808]

fields.label: Upper limb dysmetria
fields.definition: "A lack of coordination of arm movement manifested by undershoot or overshoot of the intended position of the arm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2353-596X, PMID:20301629]

fields.label: Astasia
fields.definition: "A postural abnormality characterized by the inability to stand without external support despite having sufficient muscle strength." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2353-596X, PMID:27821973]

fields.label: Vertebrobasilar dolichoectasia
fields.definition: "Elongation, dilatation, and/or tortuosity of the vertebrobasilar segment. The definition of VBD includes: (i) diameter of basilar or vertebral artery over 4.5 mm; or (ii) deviation of any portion more than 10 mm from the shortest expected course; and (iii) length of basilar artery over 29.5 mm or length of intracranial vertebral artery over 23.5 mm." [PMID:24765483]

fields.label: Retinal thickening on OCT
fields.definition: "Anteroposterior thickness of the retina above the upper limit of normal. This phenotype can be appreciated by retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT)." []

fields.label: Abnormal anteroposterior retina thickness on OCT
fields.definition: "Anteroposterior thickness of the retina outside the limits of normal. This phenotype can be appreciated by retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal anteroposterior retina thickness on oct

fields.label: Double elevator palsy
fields.definition: "A type of incomitant strabismus in which both elevator muscles (i.e., the inferior oblique and superior rectus muscles) of the same eye are weak leading to restricted elevation and hypotropia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:23479532]

fields.label: Double depressor palsy
fields.definition: "An ocular movement abnormality characterized by simultaneous weakness of the inferior rectus muscle and superior oblique muscle of the same eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Vertical incomitant strabismus
fields.definition: "A type of incomitant strabismus in which the angle of deviation varies as the patient's gaze shifts upwards and/or downwards." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Esodeviation
fields.definition: "A manifest or latent ocular deviation in which one or both eyes tends to deviate nasally." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Convergent squint; Convergent strabismus

fields.label: Accommodative esotropia
fields.definition: "A form of esotropia (convergent deviation of the eyes) associated with activation of the accommodative reflex." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal myeloid cell morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of a cell of the monocyte, granulocyte, mast cell, megakaryocyte, or erythroid lineage." []

fields.label: Reduced bone-marrow pro-B cell count
fields.definition: "A reduction in the numbers of pro-B cells (defined by coexpression of CD34 and CD19). Earlier B-cell precursors are defined by expressing surface CD34 and cytoplasmic TdT in the absence of CD19." []

fields.label: Exodeviation
fields.definition: "A manifest or latent ocular deviation in which one or both eyes tends to deviate temporally." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Divergent strabismus

fields.label: Anti-granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor." [PMID:23509356]
fields.label_normalized: anti-granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor antibody positivity
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-GM-CSF antibody positivity

fields.label: Abnormal seminiferous tubule morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly in the structure or density (count of tubules per volume) of the seminiferous tubules, i.e., the coiled structures within the testis that contain Sertoli cells, which support and nurture germ cells as they develop into mature spermatozoa." []

fields.label: Necrotizing lymph node granuloma
fields.definition: "A granuloma located within a lymph node that is associated with necrosis. Usually, the necrosis is surrounded by collections of histiocytes. A granuloma is a focal aggregate of immune cells that forms in response to a persistent inflammatory stimulus. It characteristically demonstrates the compact organization of mature macrophages, which may or may not be associated with other inflammatory cell types." []

fields.label: Abnormal marker expression
fields.definition: "Aberrant marker expression is a phenomenon of abnormal gain or loss of lineage specific or associated antigens. It involves changes in the presence, absence, quantity, or localization of molecular or immunohistochemical markers." []

fields.label: Abnormal erythrocyte physiology
fields.definition: "Any functional abnormality of erythrocytes (red-blood cells)." []

fields.label: Diminished MLH1 expression
fields.definition: "Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrating loss of expression of the mismatch repair gene product mutL homolog 1 (MLH1)." []

fields.label: Diminished MSH2 expression
fields.definition: "Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrating loss of expression of the mismatch repair gene product mutS homolog 2 (MSH2)." []

fields.label: Diminished MSH6 expression
fields.definition: "Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrating loss of expression of the mismatch repair gene product mutS homolog 6 (MSH6)." []

fields.label: Abnormal red blood cell count
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal number of red blood cells per volume in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal RBC count

fields.label: Increased red blood cell count
fields.definition: "An abnormal elevation above the normal number of red blood cells per volume in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased RBC count

fields.label: Decreased red blood cell count
fields.definition: "An abnormal reduction below the normal number of red blood cells per volume in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased RBC count

fields.label: Abnormal hemoglobin concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of hemoglobin in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal haemoglobin concentration; Abnormal Hb concentration

fields.label: Decreased hemoglobin concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal reduction below normal hemoglobin concentration in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased haemoglobin concentration; Decreased Hb concentration

fields.label: Abnormal total eosinophil count
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of absolute number of eosinophils in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []

fields.label: Diminished PMS2 expression
fields.definition: "Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrating loss of expression of the mismatch repair gene product PMS1 homolog 2 (PMS2)." []

fields.label: Pathological inclusion body by subcellular location
fields.label_normalized: pathological inclusion body by subcellular location

fields.label: Pathological inclusion body by anatomical location
fields.label_normalized: pathological inclusion body by anatomical location

fields.label: Intranuclear inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "Inclusion bodies (deposits of stainable material, usually misfolded proteins) localized in the nucleus." []

fields.label: Appendicular location
fields.definition: "Applies to a lesion that is localized on the arm or leg." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Skin lesions on limbs

fields.label: Exposure to humid conditions
fields.definition: "A history of living in an environment characterized by excess moisture and heat, tropical conditions, or muggy weather." []

fields.label: Viremia
fields.definition: "The presence of virus in the blood." []

fields.label: Persistent EBV viremia
fields.definition: "Persistent presence of Epstein-Barr virus in the blood." []

fields.label: Hypopigmented macule
fields.definition: "A white or lighter patch of skin that may appear anywhere on the body and are caused by decreased skin pigmentation." [PMID:24023426]

fields.label: Crystalluria
fields.definition: "The presence of crystals in the urine." [PMID:26509782]

fields.label: Leucine crystalluria
fields.definition: "The presence of leucine crystals in the urine." [PMID:8671802]

fields.label: Wrist ganglion
fields.definition: "A benign soft tissue tumor of the wrist usually found in the dorsal aspect of the wrist and communicate with the joint via a pedicle. This pedicle usually originates not only at the scapholunate ligament, but also may arise from a number of other sites over the dorsal aspect of the wrist capsule." [PMID:17488856, PMID:19468907]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ganglion cyst of the wrist

fields.label: Carnitinuria
fields.definition: "An elevated level of carnitine in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:11196742]
fields.synonyms_concat: Carnitine high in urine

fields.label: Alaninuria
fields.definition: "An increased level of alanine in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased urinary alanine

fields.label: Beta-alaninuria
fields.definition: "The amount of beta-alanine in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:7936305]
fields.synonyms_concat: Beta-alanine high in urine; Elevated urinary beta-alanine level; Hyper-beta-alaninuria

fields.label: Erythrocyte inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of substances in red blood cells." []

fields.label: Pappenheimer bodies
fields.definition: "A type of erythrocyte inclusion characterized by basophilic stippling of erythrocytes, that is, by numerous very small coarse or fine blue granules within the cytoplasm with the additional stipulation that the stippled particles are due to iron granules (demonstrable by the Prussian blue stain)." [PMID:15054821, PMID:21250106]

fields.label: Heinz bodies
fields.definition: "A type of erythrocyte inclusion composed of denatured hemoglobin." [PMID:21250106, PMID:24713708]

fields.label: Furuncle
fields.definition: "An infection of a hair follicle that extends subcutaneously, forming an abscess." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Boil

fields.label: Carbuncle
fields.definition: "A pustular lesion of the skin emerging from group of infected hair follicles, characterized by a deep location and dissecting through tissue planes. A carbuncle is larger and deeper than a furuncle." [PMID:32119346]

fields.label: Infection following live vaccination
fields.definition: "An infection resulting from live attenuated vaccines (LAV), that is, a vaccine prepared from living viruses or bacteria that have been weakened under laboratory conditions. LAV vaccines will replicate in a vaccinated individual and produce an immune response but usually cause mild or no disease. are derived from disease-causing pathogens." []

fields.label: BCGitis
fields.definition: "Local or regional infection with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination." [PMID:24722620]

fields.label: BCGosis
fields.definition: "Distant, or disseminated infection with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination associated with failure to contain thebacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination leading to spread of BCG to many sites in the body. The tuberculosis vaccine BCG contains live attenuated Mycobacterium bovis." [PMID:21412596, PMID:24722620]
fields.synonyms_concat: BCGiosis; Disseminated Bacillus Calmette-Guerin infection

fields.label: Post-vaccination measles
fields.definition: "Infection with the measles virus of the live-attenuated vaccine. This is an extremely rare event and may indicate immunocompromise in some cases." [PMID:29152266]
fields.synonyms_concat: Vaccine associated measles

fields.label: Post-vaccination rubella
fields.definition: "Infection with the rubella virus of the live-attenuated vaccine." []

fields.label: Post-vaccination polio
fields.definition: "Infection with live attenuated polio vaccine following vaccination. This is an extremely rare event that may indicate immunocompromise." [PMID:25285130]

fields.label: Post-vaccination rotavirus infection
fields.definition: "Infection with live attenuated rotavirus vaccine following vaccination." [PMID:21477676]

fields.label: Histopathological abnormality
fields.definition: "Any microscopic alteration in the cellular or tissue morphology of a biospecimen, identified through histologic examination, including changes in differentiation, organization, or cytologic features." []

fields.label: Recurrent deep organ abscess formation
fields.definition: "Repeated episodes of the formation of abscesses in organs. An abscess is a circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the parenchyma or an organ." []

fields.label: Squamous metaplasia
fields.definition: "Metaplasia of an epithelium (normally a unilayer of cuboidal or columnar cells) with squamous epithelium (squamous means scale-like). Metaplastic squamous epithelium becomes stratified (i.e., has multiple layers)." [PMID:28860646]

fields.label: Prolonged need of intravenous antibiotic therapy
fields.definition: "Clinical assessment of a requirement to treat with intravenous antibiotics over an unusually prolonged period of time." []
fields.label_normalized: prolonged need of intravenous antibiotic therapy

fields.label: Recurrent streptococcal infections
fields.definition: "Increased susceptibility to streptococcal infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of streptococcal infections." []

fields.label: Infection due to encapsulated bacteria
fields.definition: "An infection by an encapsulated bacterial agent. Isolates which cause invasive disease are usually surrounded by a polysaccharide capsule, which is a major virulence factor and the key antigen in protective protein-polysaccharide conjugate vaccines." [PMID:30515161]

fields.label: Severe norovirus infection
fields.definition: "An unusually severe course of infection with Human norovirus, previously known as Norwalk virus. Norovirus, an RNA virus of the family Caliciviridae, is a human enteric pathogen. Norovirus infection-associated illness may also be more prolonged and severe in immunocompromised individuals and may be associated with remarkably persistent viral excretion in some of these individuals." [PMID:25567225]

fields.label: Unusual fungal infection
fields.definition: "An unusual fungal infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a fungal agent." []

fields.label: Invasive fungal infection
fields.definition: "Fungal infection characterized by invasion of host tissues." [PMID:24718393]

fields.label: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
fields.definition: "An opportunistic disease caused by invasion of unicellular fungus Pneumocystis jirovecii. Transmission of P. jirovecii cysts takes place through the airborne route, and usually, its presence in lungs is asymptomatic. However, people with impaired immunity, especially those with CD4+ T cell count below 200/microliter, are still at risk of the development of Pneumocystis pneumonia due to P. jirovecii invasion. Symptoms induced by this disease are not specific: progressive dyspnea, non-productive cough, low-grade fever, arterial partial pressure of oxygen below 65 mmHg, and chest radiographs demonstrating bilateral, interstitial shadowing." [PMID:26281787]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia

fields.label: Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis
fields.definition: "Infection of the lungs with aspergillus. In the respiratory mucosa, the spores may germinate into hyphae, which in turn can invade the mucosa leading to invasive pulmonary aspergillosis." [PMID:25656673]

fields.label: Unusual protozoan infection
fields.definition: "An unusual protozoan infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a protozoal agent." []

fields.label: Severe toxoplasmosis
fields.definition: "Toxoplasmosis is a widespread parasitic infection that is frequently asymptomatic in immunocompetent patients. However, this obligate intracellular protozoan parasite can evade the immune system and persist for the life of its host in cyst form, predominantly in the brain, retina, and muscles. Reactivation of latent cysts may occur when the immune system fails to maintain cytokine pressure, which mainly relies on gamma interferon (IFN-gamma). Toxoplasmosis is a life-threatening infection in immunocompromised patients (ICPs)." [PMID:25762774]

fields.label: Severe giardiasis
fields.definition: "An unusually severe infection due to Giardia lamblia, also called Giardia duodenalis or Giardia intestinalis, which is a protozoan parasite of the small intestine that causes extensive morbidity worldwide." [PMID:11148005, PMID:17042927]

fields.label: Unusual helminthic infection
fields.definition: "An unusual helminthic infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a worm (helminth)." [PMID:18382743]

fields.label: Unusual parasitic infection
fields.definition: "An unusual parasitic infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a parasite." [PMID:16148530]

fields.label: Glomerular basement membrane duplication
fields.definition: "Glomerular basement membrane duplication (GBM-DP) can be seen with Periodic acid-Schiff and silver stains. This appearance results from the presence of subendothelial deposits and the so-called mesangial interposition whereby mesangial cells, infiltrating mononuclear cells, or even portions of endothelial cells interpose themselves between the endothelium and basement membrane, with new, inner GBM-like material being laid down. This produces a double contour or tram-track appearance on light or electron microscopy. This finding often reflects splitting of the lamina densa and is associated with disease processes such as membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis, transplant glomerulopathy, and diabetic nephropathy." [PMID:19908070, PMID:30467801]
synonyms: Double contour of glomerular basement membrane
fields.synonyms_concat: Double contour of glomerular basement membrane; GBM duplication; GBM reduplication; Tram-track appearance of GBM

fields.label: Bone fracture
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the continuity of a bone." []

fields.label: Abnormal regulatory T cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of the regulatory (Treg) CD4+ T cell subpopulation, commonly characterized by the CD127lowCD25hi phenotype, with the optional additional positivity for FoxP3, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." [PMID:19751267]
synonyms: Abnormal CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cell proportion
Abnormal CD4-positive, CD25-positive regulatory T cell count
Abnormal proportion of regulatory T cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cell proportion; Abnormal CD4+CD25+ Treg cell proportion; Abnormal CD4-positive, CD25-positive regulatory T cell count; Abnormal proportion of regulatory T cells; Abnormal regulatory T cell proportion; Abnormal Treg proportion

fields.label: Increased regulatory T cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase of the regulatory (Treg) CD4+ T cell subpopulation, commonly characterized by the CD127lowCD25hi phenotype, with the optional additional positivity for FoxP3, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." synonyms: Elevated CD4-positive, CD25-positive regulatory T cell count

Increased proportion of CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cells
Increased proportion of CD4+CD25+ Treg cells
Increased proportion of regulatory T cells

fields.label: Decreased regulatory T cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal decrease of the regulatory (Treg) CD4+ T cell subpopulation, commonly characterized by the CD127lowCD25hi phenotype, with the optional additional positivity for FoxP3, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." Decreased proportion of CD4+CD25+ Treg cells

Reduced proportion of CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cells
