fields.label: Persistent human papillomavirus infection
fields.definition: "Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) are small oncogenic viruses. HPV has been shown to cause a variety of lesions and malignancies, which predominantly affect the anogenital region. Low-risk, non-oncogenic HPV types are associated with anogenital warts and recurrent respiratory papillomatosis while high-risk, oncogenic types are associated with cervical, penile, anal, vaginal, vulvar, and oropharyngeal cancers. Infection with anogenital HPV is usually asymptomatic and resolves spontaneously without consequences in the immunocompetent host. When disease does occur, the most common manifestation is genital warts, which may be small papules, or flat, smooth or pedunculated lesions. This resolution of HPV lesions is not generally seen in the immunosuppressed, resulting in severe, persistent and extensive manifestations of HPV disease." [PMID:24643184, PMID:26239127]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chronic HPV infection; Persistent HPV infection

fields.label: Abnormal CD8+ T cell subset proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of any CD8+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD8+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal cd8+ t cell subset proportion
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal CD8+ T cell subsets

fields.label: Subcutaneous abscess
fields.definition: "A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris located in the subcutaneous tissue (subcutaneous fat layer), below the dermis." []

fields.label: Hypoplastic dermoepidermal hemidesmosomes
fields.definition: "Underdeveloped hemidesmosomes at the dermoepidermal junction. Hemidesmosomes are the specialized junctional complexes, that contribute to the attachment of epithelial cells to the underlying basement membrane in stratified and other complex epithelia, such as the skin." [PMID:11851880, PMID:25487405]

fields.label: Radial artery aplasia
fields.definition: "Congenital absence of the radial artery." [PMID:24650137]

fields.label: Abnormal retinal nerve fiber layer morphology
fields.definition: "A structural abnormality of the retinal nerve fiber layer" []
synonyms: Abnormal retinal nerve fibre layer morphology
fields.label_normalized: abnormal retinal nerve fiber layer morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal retinal nerve fibre layer morphology

fields.label: Retinal nerve fiber edema
fields.definition: "Swelling (edema) of the retinal nerve fibers." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Retinal nerve fibre oedema

fields.label: Conception by assisted reproductive technology
fields.definition: "A history of conception by an assisted reproductive technology such as in vitro fertilization (IVF), intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), and cryopreservation." [PMID:28844405]

fields.label: Bite cells
fields.definition: "Red blood cells that appear to have parts of them bitten away." [ISBN:978-0-07174889-6]
fields.synonyms_concat: Blister cells; Degmacytes

fields.label: Tympanosclerosis
fields.definition: "A stiffening of the tympanic membrane due to calcification, typically presents as white plaque-like lesions, involving discrete regions of the tympanic membrane and/or middle ear." [PMID:27656306]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tympanic calcification

fields.label: Spontaneous conjunctival filtering bleb
fields.definition: "Avascular cystic elevations of the superior conjunctiva not related to ocular surgery or trauma." [PMID:24768550, PMID:8749053]
fields.synonyms_concat: Conjunctival avascular cysts (filtering blebs); Spontaneous filtering bleb

fields.label: Prostate mass
fields.definition: "A lump detected in the prostate. In this context, mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction." []

fields.label: Periarticular soft-tissue mass
fields.definition: "A lump detected in the region that surrounds a joint. In this context, mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction." []

fields.label: Aplasia of the olfactory tract
fields.definition: "Aplasia (congenital absence) of the olfactory tract, which causes anosmia, a complete loss of the sense of smell." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:27863011]

fields.label: Abnormal urine protein level
fields.definition: "Any deviation of the concentration of one or more proteins in the urine." []

fields.label: Increased urinary neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin in the urine (there is no generally accepted threshold, but some studies choose a threshold of above 150 nanogram per milliliter)." [PMID:18725016]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased urinary NGAL

fields.label: Abnormal tubular basement membrane morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structure of the basement membrane of the renal tubulus." []

fields.label: Thickening of the tubular basement membrane
fields.definition: "Increase in thickness of the basement membrane of the tubulus of the kidney." [PMID:20142905]
fields.label_normalized: thickening of the tubular basement membrane

fields.label: Podocyte hypertrophy
fields.definition: "Increased visceral epithelial cell size, with or without cytoplasmic protein droplets." [PMID:15610239, PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Glomerular visceral epithelial cell hypertrophy; Hypertrophy of visceral epithelial cells

fields.label: Increased urine neutrophil count
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased count of neutrophils in urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7941-2961]

fields.label: Myofibromatosis
fields.definition: "A mesenchymal neoplasm characterized by solitary or multiple nodules involving the skin, striated muscles, bones and, sometimes, viscera. It usually appears as a subcutaneous nodule, but can also appear as an ulcer, pedunculated lesion, or similar to a hemangioma. Histology shows well-circumscribed tapered cell lobes, resembling smooth muscle cells. At its center, perivascular round cells (hemangiopericitoides) are usually observed, giving a biphasic appearance." [NCIT:C3742, PMID:29364448]

fields.label: Anticardiolipin IgG antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of circulating IgG autoantibodies to cardiolipin." [PMID:30256771]

fields.label: Anticardiolipin IgM antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of circulating IgM autoantibodies to cardiolipin." [PMID:30256771]

fields.label: History of recent animal bite
fields.definition: "Medical history of a recent bite injury due to an animal." [PMID:26179017]

fields.label: History of recent insect bite
fields.definition: "Medical history of a recent bite injury due to an insect." [PMID:24364549]

fields.label: History of recent tick bite
fields.definition: "Medical history of a recent bite injury due to a tick." [PMID:24364549]

fields.label: Blood pressure substantially higher in legs than arms
fields.definition: "An abnormal blood pressure discrepancy between the upper and lower extremities with the blood pressure measured in the legs being much higher than the blood pressure measure in the arms. In healthy individuals, ankle systolic blood pressures are only slightly higher than the systolic blood pressure measured in the arm." [PMID:12101189]
synonyms: Blood pressure substantially higher in lower than upper extremities
Blood pressure substantially lower in arms than legs
Blood pressure substantially lower in upper than lower extremities
fields.label_normalized: blood pressure substantially higher in legs than arms
fields.synonyms_concat: Blood pressure substantially higher in lower than upper extremities; Blood pressure substantially lower in arms than legs; Blood pressure substantially lower in upper than lower extremities

fields.label: Blood pressure substantially higher in arms than legs
fields.definition: "An abnormal blood pressure discrepancy between the upper and lower extremities with the blood pressure measured in the arms being much higher than the blood pressure measure in the legs. In healthy individuals, ankle systolic blood pressures are only slightly higher than the systolic blood pressure measured in the arm." [PMID:28377475]
synonyms: Blood pressure substantially higher in upper than lower extremities
fields.label_normalized: blood pressure substantially higher in arms than legs
fields.synonyms_concat: Blood pressure substantially higher in upper than lower extremities; Increased arm-leg blood pressure gradient

fields.label: Tracheal duplication cyst
fields.definition: "A cyst in the trachea, whose wall is made up by tissue similar to the bronchial tree, including cartilage and smooth muscle, and is lined by secretory respiratory epithelium composed of cuboid or columnar ciliated epithelium." [PMID:25313910]

fields.label: Calcium phosphate crystalluria
fields.definition: "The presence of calcium phosphate crystals in the urine." [PMID:26509782, PMID:3599249, PMID:8671802]

fields.label: Calcium oxalate crystalluria
fields.definition: "The presence of calcium oxalate crystals in the urine." [PMID:26509782, PMID:3599249, PMID:8671802]

fields.label: Calcium carbonate crystalluria
fields.definition: "The presence of calcium carbonate crystals in the urine." [PMID:26509782, PMID:8671802]

fields.label: 2-Methylbutyryl glycinuria
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of 2-methylbutyryl glycine in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:17883863]

fields.label: Increased circulating mead acid level
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration od mead acid in the blood circulation." [PMID:25440954]

fields.label: Elevated circulating succinate
fields.definition: "An increase concentration of succinate in the blood circulation." [PMID:29434314]

fields.label: Elevated urinary uromodulin level
fields.definition: "The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:28781372]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urinary Tamm-Horsfall protein concentration

fields.label: Anti-dsDNA antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against double-stranded DNA." [PMID:15804704]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-double-stranded DNA antibody positivity

fields.label: Distal joint hypermobility
fields.definition: "Lack of stability of a distal joint (e.g., finger)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Distal joint laxity

fields.label: Positive blood 1,3 beta glucan test
fields.definition: "Beta-1,3-glucan is a major constituent of all of the characterized fungal cell walls, making up between 30-80 percent of the mass of the wall. It is a biomarker of fungal infections such as invasive pulmonary aspergillosis." [PMID:27475024]

fields.label: Nevus comedonicus
fields.definition: "A type of epidermal nevus characterized by closely arranged, dilated follicular openings with keratinous plugs resembling classical comedones." [PMID:23888253]

fields.label: Abnormal oocyte morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormal structure of the female germ cell (egg cell)." []

fields.label: Abnormal zona pellucida morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structure of the oocyte extracellular matrix region known as the zona pellucida." [PMID:26329136]

fields.label: Thin zona pellucida
fields.definition: "Reduced thickness of the zona pellucida." [PMID:7657763]

fields.label: Increased circulating adrenic acid concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of adrenic acid (also known as cis-7,10,13,16-Docosatetraenoic acid) in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:28456640]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating docosatetraenoate level

fields.label: Reduced response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test
fields.definition: "Failure of the gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) stimulation test to induce an appropriate increased in luteinizing hormone (LH), follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) levels." [PMID:22723321]
synonyms: Reduce response to GnRH stimulation test
fields.label_normalized: reduced response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduce response to GnRH stimulation test

fields.label: GM1-ganglioside accumulation
fields.definition: "Cellular accumulation of GM1 gangliosides." [PMID:9063740]

fields.label: Branch retinal artery occlusion
fields.definition: "Blockage of a branch of the retinal artery. This can cause loss of a section of visual field." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:19376586]

fields.label: Abnormal neoplastic cell morphology
fields.definition: "A morphological abnormality of of tumor or neoplastic cells, characterized by atypical size, shape, cytoplasmic or nuclear features, or other deviations from normal cellular architecture." []

fields.label: Cilioretinal arteriolar hypoperfusion
fields.definition: "Ischemia in the territory of the cilioretinal artery causing opacification of the inner retina and visual loss. This is most commonly seen in central retinal vein occlusion in the young." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:28058169]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cilioretinal artery occlusion

fields.label: Ophthalmic artery occlusion
fields.definition: "Acute complete obstruction of the ophthalmic artery (branch of the internal carotid artery) that may lead to severe ischemia of the affected globe and associated ocular tissues. It can present with a similar picture to central retinal artery occlusion associated with choroidal ischemia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:30148234]

fields.label: Branch retinal vein occlusion
fields.definition: "Blockage of a branch of the retinal vein. It may present with sudden-onset of painless vision loss or visual field defect correlating to the area of perfusion of the obstructed vessels." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:30570991]
fields.synonyms_concat: Branch retinal vein obstruction

fields.label: Central retinal vein occlusion
fields.definition: "Central retinal vein occlusion is an occlusion of the main retinal vein posterior to the lamina cribrosa of the optic nerve and is typically caused by thrombosis." [PMID:30252241]

fields.label: Hemiretinal vein occlusion
fields.definition: "A variant of central retinal vein occlusions that involves the superior or inferior half of the retina." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:22069354]

fields.label: Tumor signet ring cell
fields.definition: "A signet ring has a flattened surface at the top of the ring with an engraved or raised symbol, historically used to stamp a seal into correspondence. Comparatively, these cells acquire a signet cell morphology due to accumulation of abundant mucin in cytoplasm, leading to nuclei dislocation to the periphery." []

fields.label: Abnormal drug response
fields.definition: "An anomalous response to a medication related to individual variation in metabolic or immune response to drugs varying from potentially from potentially life-threatening adverse drug reactions to alteration of therapeutic efficacy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:16948615]

fields.label: Increased blood drug concentration
fields.definition: "High plasma concentration of a drug as compared to previously measured thresholds given the expected concentration for the applied dosage regime." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:26075072]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated blood drug concentration; Elevated plasma drug concentration; Elevated serum drug concentrations; Increased plasma drug concentration; Increased serum drug concentration

fields.label: Decreased blood drug concentration
fields.definition: "Low plasma concentration of a drug as compared to previously measured thresholds given the expected concentration for the applied dosage regime." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:26075072]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased plasma drug concentration; Decreased serum drug concentration; Reduced blood drug concentration; Reduced plasma drug concentration; Reduced serum drug concentrations

fields.label: Adverse drug response
fields.definition: "An unpleasant or harmful reaction resulting from treatment with a drug." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:11072960]
fields.synonyms_concat: Adverse drug reaction; Drug-induced reaction; Drug-induced response; Toxic drug response

fields.label: Reduced drug efficacy
fields.definition: "Decreased response to a drug intervention in comparison to the expected response." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:26178435]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased drug efficacy

fields.label: Refractory drug response
fields.definition: "Absent or significantly reduced efficacy of drug intervention characterized by lack of measurable benefit or deterioration of disease course." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:29188449]
fields.synonyms_concat: Drug resistance

fields.label: Reduced circulating cholinesterase activity
fields.definition: "Activity or concentration of cholinesterase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:29853783]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced cholinesterase level

fields.label: Cholesterol crystalluria
fields.definition: "The presence of cholesterol crystals in the urine." [PMID:8671802]

fields.label: Abnormal proportion of CD8-positive TEMRA T cells
fields.definition: "An abnormal proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta effector memory RA TEMRA T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative." []
synonyms: Abnormal CD8-positive TEMRA T cell proportion
Abnormal proportion of effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells, terminally differentiated
fields.label_normalized: abnormal proportion of cd8-positive temra t cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal CD8-positive TEMRA T cell proportion; Abnormal proportion of effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells, terminally differentiated

fields.label: Abnormal dendritic cell count
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal count of dendritic cells in the peripheral blood circulation. Dendritic cells are of hematopoietic origin, typically resident in particular tissues, specialized in the uptake, processing, and transport of antigens to lymph nodes for the purpose of stimulating an immune response via T cell activation. These cells are lineage negative (CD3-negative, CD19-negative, CD34-negative, and CD56-negative)." [CL:0000451, PMID:15795906]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating haptoglobin concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of haptoglobin in the blood circulation." [PMID:24809098]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal haptoglobin level

fields.label: Elevated haptoglobin level
fields.definition: "An abnormally high concentration of haptoglobin in the blood circulation. Haptoglobin is an acute-phase reactant whose levels can become elevated in the presence of infection and inflammation." [PMID:24809098]

fields.label: Reduced haptoglobin level
fields.definition: "An abnormally low concentration of haptoglobin in the blood circulation. Decreased haptoglobin in conjunction with increased reticulocyte count and anemia may indicate hemolysis. Decreased haptoglobin levels can also occur in the absence of hemolysis, due to cirrhosis of the liver, disseminated ovarian carcinomatosis, pulmonary sarcoidosis, and elevated estrogen state." [PMID:24809098]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating A-type atrial natriuretic peptide concentration
fields.definition: "A measurable change in circulating levels of Atrial natriuretic peptide hormone, a protein which plays an important role in the regulation of body fluid volume and blood pressure." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_SJWang, PMID:28552863]
synonyms: Abnormal A-type atrial natriuretic peptide level
fields.label_normalized: abnormal circulating a-type atrial natriuretic peptide concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal A-type atrial natriuretic peptide level

fields.label: Increased circulating A-type natriuretic peptide concentration
fields.definition: "A measurable elevation in circulating levels of Atrial natriuretic peptide hormone, a protein which plays an important role in the regulation of body fluid volume and blood pressure." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_SJWang, PMID:28552863]
synonyms: Increased circulating A-type natriuretic peptide level
fields.label_normalized: increased circulating a-type natriuretic peptide concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating A-type natriuretic peptide level

fields.label: Decreased circulating A-type natriuretic peptide concentration
fields.definition: "A measurable reduction in circulating levels of Atrial natriuretic peptide hormone, a protein which plays an important role in the regulation of body fluid volume and blood pressure." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_SJWang, PMID:28552863]
synonyms: Decreased circulating A-type natriuretic peptide level
fields.label_normalized: decreased circulating a-type natriuretic peptide concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating A-type natriuretic peptide level

fields.label: Superior cerebellar dysplasia
fields.definition: "Abnormal morphological development of the superior part of the cerebellum." []

fields.label: Multilobulated spleen
fields.definition: "The fetal spleen is lobulated, and these lobules normally disappear before the birth. Lobulation of the spleen may persist into adult life and be typically seen along the medial part of the spleen. A persisting lobule results in a variation in shape of the spleen." [PMID:23710135]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multi-lobulated spleen

fields.label: Thick pachygyria
fields.definition: "Pachygyria with a very thick cerebral cortex measuring 10-20 mm. Note that cortical thickness cannot be measured reliably on scans done between 3 and 24 months of age." [PMID:28440899]
synonyms: Pachygyria with cortical thickness above 10 mm
fields.synonyms_concat: Pachygyria with cortical thickness > 10 mm; Pachygyria with cortical thickness above 10 mm

fields.label: Anterior predominant pachygyria with 5-10 mm cortical thickness
fields.definition: "Pachygyria with cortical thickness between 5 and 10 mm with and a posterior predominant severity gradient. The severity gradient is determined based on the gyral width, with gyri typically over 5mm over the more severely affected regions. Posterior predominant gradient indicates pachygyria more severe other the occipital lobes but also includes a rare perisylvian-predominant pachygyria and a temporal predominant pachygyria." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:28440899]
fields.label_normalized: anterior predominant pachygyria with 5-10 mm cortical thickness

fields.label: Posterior predominant thick cortex pachygyria
fields.definition: "Pachygyria with cortical thickness above 10 mm with and a posterior predominant severity gradient. The severity gradient is determined based on the gyral width, with gyri typically wider than 5mm over the more severely affected regions. Posterior predominant gradient indicates pachygyria more severe other the occipital lobes but also includes a rare perisylvian-predominant pachygyria and a temporal predominant pachygyria." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:28440899]
synonyms: Pachygyria with cortical thickness over 10 mm posterior predominant
fields.synonyms_concat: Occipital predomimant classic pachygyria; Pachygyria with cortical thickness over 10 mm posterior predominant

fields.label: Perisylvian predominant thick cortex pachygyria
fields.definition: "Pachygyria with cortical thickness greater than 10 mm and a perisylvian predominant severity gradient. The severity gradient is determined based on the gyral width, with gyri typically wider than 5mm over the more severely affected regions. Perisylvian predominant gradient indicates pachygyria more severe other the occipital lobes but also includes a rare perisylvian-predominant pachygyria and a temporal predominant pachygyria." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:28440899]
synonyms: Pachygyria with cortical thickness > 10 mm perisylvian predominant
fields.synonyms_concat: Pachygyria with cortical thickness > 10 mm perisylvian predominant

fields.label: Anterior predominant thick cortex pachygyria
fields.definition: "Pachygyria with cortical thickness greater than 10 mm and an anterior predominant severity gradient. The severity gradient is determined based on the gyral width, with gyri typically wider than 5mm over the more severely affected regions. Anterior predominant gradient indicates pachygyria more severe over the frontal and temporal lobes." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458]
synonyms: Pachygyria with cortical thickness > 10 mm anterior predominant
fields.synonyms_concat: Pachygyria with cortical thickness > 10 mm anterior predominant

fields.label: Pachygyria with 5-10 mm cortical thickness
fields.definition: "Pachygyria with a mildly thickened cerebral cortex measuring 5-10 mm. Note that cortical thickness cannot be measured reliably on scans done between 3 and 24 months of age." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:28440899]

fields.label: Prolonged reptilase time
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased duration of the reptilase time. Reptilase time is a functional plasma clotting assay, which is based on the enzymatic activity of batroxobin. By specifically cleaving fibrinogen A from fibrinogen, batroxobin leads to the formation of a stable fibrin clot. The time, starting from the addition of batroxobin to the plasma sample, until clot formation is the reptilase time and is given in seconds." [PMID:23546720]

fields.label: IgA heavy chain paraproteinemia
fields.definition: "An abnormal IgA heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells." [PMID:25125965]
fields.synonyms_concat: Alpha heavy chain disease

fields.label: IgG heavy chain paraproteinemia
fields.definition: "An abnormal IgG heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells." [PMID:22301495]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gamma heavy-chain disease

fields.label: IgM heavy chain paraproteinemia
fields.definition: "An abnormal IgM heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells." [PMID:17403946]

fields.label: Increased circulating arachidonic acid concentration
fields.definition: "An increased circulation of arachidonic acid in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:30034875]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating arachidonate level; Increased circulating arachidonic acid level

fields.label: Abnormal circulating 18-hydroxycorticosterone level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of 18-Hydroxycorticosterone level in the blood circulation." [PMID:2669615]

fields.label: Decreased circulating 18-hydroxycortisone level
fields.definition: "A subnormal concentration of 18-Hydroxycorticosterone level in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Increased circulating 18-hydroxycortisone level
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration of 18-Hydroxycorticosterone level in the blood circulation." [PMID:22238407]

fields.label: Abnormal sarcomere morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the sarcomere, which is unit of a myofibril in a muscle cell, composed of an array of overlapping thick and thin filaments between two adjacent Z disks." []

fields.label: Abnormal Z disk morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the Z disk, which is the platelike region of a muscle sarcomere to which the plus ends of actin filaments are attached." [PMID:22028589]

fields.label: Z-band streaming
fields.definition: "Streaming or smearing of the Z band, which is then no longer confined to a narrow zone which bisects the I band. The Z disk may extend across the I band or the entire sarcomere in a zigzag manner. Focal thickening, smudging, and blurring of the Z band takes place concurrently. Myofibrillar disorganization is a frequent but not invariable accompanying change." [PMID:1180479, PMID:22028589]

fields.label: Tubulointerstitial bacterial infiltration
fields.definition: "Tubulointerstitial infiltration of bacteria identified on routine and/or special (Brown-Hopps) stains." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal tubulointerstitial bacterial organisms

fields.label: Tubulointerstitial fungal infiltration
fields.definition: "Tubulointerstitial infiltration of yeast or hyphal-microrganisms identified on routine and/or special (PAS, silver) stains." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal tubulointerstitial fungal organisms

fields.label: Simple ear
fields.definition: "The pinna has fewer folds and grooves than usual." [PMID:15523657]

fields.label: Reflex seizure
fields.definition: "Seizures precipitated by exogenous stimuli." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]

fields.label: Eating-induced seizure
fields.definition: "A seizure precipitated by aspects of anticipating food, eating itself, or the post-prandial period." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]

fields.label: Hot water-induced seizure
fields.definition: "A seizure precipitated by pouring cupfuls of very hot water (40 to 50 degrees Celsius) in rapid succession over the head. Bathing in this manner is the most common trigger." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]

fields.label: Praxis-induced seizure
fields.definition: "A seizure precipitated by complex, cognition-guided tasks often involving visuomotor coordination and decision-making." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340, PMID:24512781]

fields.label: Proprioceptive-induced seizure
fields.definition: "A seizure precipitated by movement or a change in posture." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]

fields.label: Reading-induced seizure
fields.definition: "A seizure precipitated by reading." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]

fields.label: Somatosensory-induced seizure
fields.definition: "A somatosensory reflex seizure is a seizure precipitated by somatic stimulation of a specific part of the body in the absence of startle or surprise." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]

fields.label: Startle-induced seizure
fields.definition: "Startle-induced seizures are triggered by multiple and non-specific stimuli (auditory, somatosensory, and rarely visual) and are characterized by their sudden unexpected nature. Sudden noise rather than pure sound is the most effective acoustic stimulus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]

fields.label: Thinking-induced seizure
fields.definition: "Seizures induced by thinking and decision-making." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cognition induced seizure

fields.label: Visually-induced seizure
fields.definition: "Seizures evoked by visual stimuli. This includes clinical seizures induced by strobe lighting, television and other screens, flickering environmental lighting and self-induction by causing a strobe effect." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11422340]
fields.synonyms_concat: Photosensitive seizure

fields.label: Focal aware motor seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal motor seizure in which awareness is retained throughout the seizure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal motor aware seizure

fields.label: Focal aware atonic seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal atonic seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Motor seizure
fields.definition: "A motor seizure is a type of seizure that is characterized at onset by involvement of the skeletal musculature. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal atonic seizure
fields.definition: "A focal seizure characterized at onset by sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic activity, typically lasting more than 500 ms but less than 2 seconds. It may involve the head, trunk, jaw or limb musculature." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Localised atonic seizure; Localised hypotonic seizure; Localized atonic seizure; Localized hypotonic seizure; Partial atonic seizure; Partial hypotonic seizure; Segmental atonic seizure; Segmental hypotonic seizure

fields.label: Clonic seizure
fields.definition: "A clonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by sustained rhythmic jerking, that is regularly repetitive." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11580774]

fields.label: Hypohomocysteinemia
fields.definition: "A decreased concentration of homocysteine in the blood." [PMID:29018201]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lower blood homocysteine

fields.label: Dermal sinus tract
fields.definition: "A dermal sinus tract is an abnormality present at birth over the dorsal midline where an abnormal epithelialized connection from the skin tracks inwards towards the spine, most commonly seen in the lumbosacral region." [PMID:31484633]

fields.label: Mammary duct ectasia
fields.definition: "A non-proliferative inflammatory disorder of the large duct (milk duct) of the breast; as such, it affects nipple and areola complex. The condition is characterized by focal dilatation of the lactiferous duct system is due to endoluminal changes, as well as the loss of duct wall elastin, leading to abnormally dilated and tortuous lactiferous ducts with associated periductal inflammation and fibrosis. Mammary duct ectasia may present with nipple discharge or palpable mass." [PMID:32491597]

fields.label: Breast abscess
fields.definition: "A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the breast." []

fields.label: Nipple tenderness
fields.definition: "Pain or discomfort produced by touching the nipple." []

fields.label: Floating gallbladder
fields.definition: "An abnormal configuration in which the gallbladder is pedunculated, hanging free of the liver, and attached only by the cystic mesentery," [PMID:20529542]

fields.label: Biospecimen phenotypic feature
fields.definition: "A phenotypic abnormality obvserved in a biospecimen such as a biopsy or an extirpated tumor or tissue." []

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node biospecimen
fields.definition: "Any abnormal phenotypic feature observed in a biospecimen derived from a lymph node, generally obtained by lymph node biopsy (removal of lymph node tissue for microscopic examination)." [PMID:17067938]

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node tissue architecture
fields.definition: "Any phenotypic abnormality of the architecture of the tissue of a lymph node." []

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node cellular finding
fields.definition: "Any phenotypic abnormality within cells located in a lymph node." []

fields.label: Abnormal Q wave
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the Q wave of the electrocardiogram." [PMID:31747210]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pathological Q wave

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node cellular antigen expression
fields.definition: "Abnormal expression of an antigen (marker) by cells located in a lymph node." []

fields.label: Altered lymph-node tissue architecture
fields.definition: "An alteration that affects multiple components of the architecture of a lymph node." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Distorted lymph node architecture

fields.label: Effaced lymph-node architecture
fields.definition: "Effacement of architecture typically refers to a cellular infiltrate destroying the normal follicular architecture of a lymph node. This effacement may result in sheets of cells that do not form clear architecture (seen in many lymphomas) or may lead to replacement of the normal architecture by atypical architecture, for example effacement of normal lymph node architecture (including normal follicles and patent lymph node sinuses) by many abnormal follicles in follicular lymphoma." []

fields.label: Vaguely nodular lymph-node architecture
fields.definition: "In contrast to normal lymph node architecture or that of follicular lymphoma, where follicles are typically distinct and readily identifiable on H&E stained biopsy sections, the cells within an atypical lymph node may show what appear to groups of cells forming vague nodules but not forming clear follicles." []

fields.label: Lymph-node capsular invasion by lymphocytes
fields.definition: "Migration of substantial numbers of lymphocytes into the capsule of a lymph node." []

fields.label: Lymph-node extracapsular extension by lymph-node lymphocytes
fields.definition: "Migration of lymphocytes into the soft tissues surrounding the lymph node." []
fields.label_normalized: lymph-node extracapsular extension by lymph-node lymphocytes

fields.label: Increased lymph-node epithelioid histiocyte count
fields.definition: "Number of epithelioid histiocytes (histiocytes are tissue-resident macrophages) located within a lymph node above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Scattered lymph node individual epithelioid histiocytes
fields.definition: "Many individual (not clustered) epithelioid histiocytes throughout at least part of a lymph node." []
fields.label_normalized: scattered lymph node individual epithelioid histiocytes

fields.label: Clustered lymph node epithelioid histiocytes
fields.definition: "Formation of clusters (group of cells positioned near each other) of epithelioid histiocytes within a lymph node." []

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node follicle architecture
fields.definition: "Any phenotypic abnormality of the architecture of follicles of a lymph node." [PMID:17067937]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal follicular lymph-node architecture

fields.label: Floral-pattern lymph node follicles
fields.definition: "Atypical lymph node follicles that have mantle zone cells invaginating/infiltrating into the follicle centers, which is said to confer a flower-like appearance." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Floral follicular lymph node architecture; Floral growth pattern

fields.label: Colonization of follicles by lymphoma cells
fields.definition: "In contrast to follicular lymphoma, which typically is a lymphoma that forms follicles or potentially completely replaces normal follicles, some lymphomas (most commonly marginal zone lymphoma) can infiltrate normal follicles so both normal lymphocytes and the infiltrating lymphoma cells are present. This is called colonization of follicles by the lymphoma cells." []
fields.label_normalized: colonization of follicles by lymphoma cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Follicular colonisation; Follicular colonization

fields.label: Crowded lymph-node follicles
fields.definition: "Reduction in the average distance between adjacent lymph node follicles." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Crowded follicles

fields.label: Lymph-node follicular lysis
fields.definition: "An abnormal morphology of hyperplastic lymph node follicles characterized by distortion of the follicular architecture by tongues and clusters of dark blue mantle cells impinging on and invading the reactive germinal center (Mostly T cells and mantle-zone B cells)." [PMID:14502795]
fields.synonyms_concat: Follicular lysis

fields.label: Non-polarized lymph node germinal centers
fields.definition: "A loss of the typical polarization of the architecture of a lymph node germinal center." []

fields.label: Irregularly shaped lymph node germinal centers
fields.definition: "A deviation from the typically fairly round or oval form of a lymph node germinal center." []
fields.label_normalized: irregularly shaped lymph node germinal centers

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node marginal or mantle zone morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the structure of the mantle or marginal zone of a lymph node." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal lymph-node marginal or mantle zone morphology

fields.label: Abnormal lymph node marginal zone morphology
fields.label_normalized: abnormal lymph node marginal zone morphology

fields.label: Abnormal lymph node mantle zone morphology
fields.label_normalized: abnormal lymph node mantle zone morphology

fields.label: Abnormal bursal fluid morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the synovial-like fluid found within a bursa, which is a small, closed sac lined by synovial membrane that reduces friction between tissues such as tendons, muscles, ligaments, and bones." []

fields.label: Lymph node with expanded mantle zones
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the typical outer ring of small lymphocytes (mantle zone) surrounding a germinal center of a lymph node." []
synonyms: Germinal centers with expanded mantle zones
Germinal centres with expanded mantle zones
fields.label_normalized: lymph node with expanded mantle zones
fields.synonyms_concat: Germinal centers with expanded mantle zones; Germinal centres with expanded mantle zones

fields.label: Lymph node with poorly defined germinal center borders
fields.definition: "Reduced demarcation of the border between germinal centers and mantle zones. This border is typically seen as a crisp line on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained lymph node sections." []
fields.label_normalized: lymph node with poorly defined germinal center borders

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node germinal center morphology
fields.definition: "Any phenotypic abnormality of germinal centers of a lymph node." [PMID:30410492]

fields.label: Elevated bursal fluid leukocyte count
fields.definition: "The count of leukocytes per unit volume in a bursa aspirate specimen is above the uppper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Mantle zone pattern
fields.definition: "This refers to an architectural pattern of infiltration where atypical lymphocytes surround germinal centers, often expanding the mantle zones but without effacing architecture." []

fields.label: Germinal centers with absent marginal zones
fields.label_normalized: germinal centers with absent marginal zones

fields.label: Decreased biparietal diameter
fields.definition: "Fetal head width measurement, taken between the outer edge of the proximal parietal bone and the inner edge of the distal parietal bone, below the lower limit of normal, usually taken to be two standard deviations below the norm or above the 3rd percentile for the gestational age." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased BPD

fields.label: Increased biparietal diameter
fields.definition: "Fetal head width measurement, taken between the outer edge of the proximal parietal bone and the inner edge of the distal parietal bone, above the upper limit of normal, usually taken to be two standard deviations above the norm or above the 97th percentile for the gestational age." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased BPD

fields.label: Poorly defined primary lymph-node follicles
fields.definition: "Lack of the typical easily recognized delineation of primary follicles within lymph nodes." []

fields.label: Progressive transformation of germinal centers
fields.definition: "This is a condition sometimes seen in a subset of germinal centers of reactive lymph nodes where germinal centers become enlarged and infiltrated by benign mantle zone cells and some T cells." [PMID:14502795]
fields.synonyms_concat: PTGC

fields.label: Absent germinal center tingible body macrophages
fields.definition: "Lack of observable tingible body macrophages (TBMs) in germinal centers (GCs) of secondary lymphoid follicles. TBMs represent unique, large phagocytic cells that reside and are a subset of mononuclear phagocytes." [PMID:33967475]
fields.label_normalized: absent germinal center tingible body macrophages

fields.label: Lack of germinal center mitotic figures
fields.definition: "Absence of extreme paucity of mitotic figures in a lymph node germinal center." []
fields.label_normalized: lack of germinal center mitotic figures

fields.label: Non-polarized mantle zones
fields.definition: "Lack of the typical polarization of the outer ring of small lymphocytes (mantle zone) surrounding a germinal center of a lymph node." []

fields.label: Hyalinized lymph-node vessels
fields.definition: "Hyalinized means to become clear/translucent such as collagen becoming more pale staining (collagen is typically quite eosinophilic, meaning attracted to the pink/red dye eosin); however, with regard to vessels in the lymph node, hyalinization is often used to describe vessel walls that appear markedly thickened or surrounded by eosinophilic material such as collagen, not necessarily translucent appearing." []

fields.label: Lymph-node follicular sclerosis
fields.definition: "Collagen deposition, typically with decreased cellularity, within lymph-node follicles." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Follicular sclerosis

fields.label: Compressed lymph-node sinuses
fields.definition: "Loss of the typical patency (openness) of lymph node sinuses." []

fields.label: Lymph-node proliferation centers
fields.definition: "Proliferation centers are a finding specific to chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma where regions (typically relatively small, comparable to the size of a lymph node follicle) appear more pale on H&E stained sections (though they may become enlarged to merge together). These areas contain increased numbers of enlarged lymphoma cells with nucleoli (prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts) and show a higher proliferation rate (readily visualized with a Ki-67 immunohistochemical stain) than surrounding lymphoma cells. They can be mistaken as vague follicle formation and are therefore sometimes referred to as pseudofollicles." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pseudofollicles

fields.label: Cytologic atypia in mantle cells
fields.definition: "Lymphocytes in the mantle zones of lymph node secondary follicles show cellular atypia such as enlarged size, increased cytoplasm, atypical distribution of chromatin, or irregular nuclear contours." []

fields.label: Increased lymph-node eosinophils
fields.definition: "Eosinophils count within a lymph node above normal limits." []

fields.label: Increased lymph-node plasma cells
fields.definition: "Number of plasma cells per lymph node above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: High lymph node non-germinal center mitotic activity
fields.definition: "Increased numbers of mitotic figures outside of germinal centers." []
fields.label_normalized: high lymph node non-germinal center mitotic activity

fields.label: Lymph-node lymphocyte monocytoid morphology
fields.definition: "Lymphocytes that show morphologic features resembling monocytes, such as increased cytoplasm and slightly enlarged nuclei that are more irregular than most lymph node lymphocytes." []

fields.label: Reduced lymph node lymphocyte morphological variability
fields.definition: "Decreased morphological variability of lymph node lymphocytes as compared to the typically somewhat heterogeneous morphology of populations of benign lymph node lymphocytes." []
fields.label_normalized: reduced lymph node lymphocyte morphological variability
fields.synonyms_concat: Monomorphic cells

fields.label: Increased large lymphocytes in lymph node
fields.definition: "An increased number of large lymphocytes within a lymph node compared to a normal non-reactive lymph node." []
fields.label_normalized: increased large lymphocytes in lymph node

fields.label: Hodgkin morphology cells
fields.definition: "Hodgkin cells are typically large and often show very large nucleoli and sometimes binucleation or multinucleation. Reed-Sternberg cells are a type of Hodgkin cell that is binucleated with very large nucleoli that stains slightly red on H&E stained sections (often said to mimic owl eyes). Other Hodgkin cell morphologies include cells that are dying with dark basophilic (blue) nuclei that appear somewhat smudged (mummified cells) and cells with a large space around or adjacent to the nuclei and retracted cytoplasm after tissue fixation (lacunar cells). Hodgkin cells are characteristic of Hodgkin lymphoma, however several non-Hodgkin lymphomas and noN-neoplastic conditions are known to sometimes show a few similar morphology cells." [PMID:31194473]

fields.label: Irregular lymph-node lymphocyte nuclei
fields.definition: "Lymph node lymphocyte nuclei that are more irregular than the typical round to slightly oval shapes of the majority of lymph node lymphocytes." []

fields.label: Lymph-node Dutcher bodies
fields.definition: "Dutcher bodies are collections of immunoglobulin protein that overlie or invaginate into the nucleus of plasma cells. These nuclear pseudoinclusions can occasionally be seen in reactive states and may be increased in specific neoplastic conditions." [PMID:31309083]

fields.label: Finely dispersed lymph node lymphocyte chromatin
fields.definition: "Nuclei of lymphocytes with less dense, evenly distributed chromatin than the normal densely packed, often clumped chromatin of mature lymphocytes." []
fields.label_normalized: finely dispersed lymph node lymphocyte chromatin

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node lymphocyte chromatin
fields.definition: "Any phenotypic abnormality of the chromatin (complex of DNA and protein which comprises chromosomes) of lymphocytes that are located within a lymph node." []

fields.label: Clumping of lymph node lymphocyte chromatin
fields.definition: "Nuclei of lymphocytes show multiple small densely packed areas of chromatin that appear as relatively evenly spaced clumps of basophilic (blue) staining within the nuclei on Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stained sections." []
fields.label_normalized: clumping of lymph node lymphocyte chromatin

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node lymphocyte cytoplasm morphology
fields.definition: "Any phenotypic abnormality of the cytoplasm (material located within the cell membrane but excluding the nucleus) of lymphocytes that are located within a lymph node." []

fields.label: Decreased lymph node lymphocyte cytoplasm
fields.definition: "The amount of cytoplasm in lymphocytes is even less than the relatively little cytoplasm found in the majority of lymphocytes within lymph nodes." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Scant lymph node lymphocyte cytoplasm

fields.label: Increased lymph node lymphocyte cytoplasm
fields.definition: "Increased amount of cytoplasm compared to the majority of lymphocytes in a benign lymph node." []

fields.label: Abnormal level of lymph-node cellular CD19 expression
fields.definition: "Detection of an abnormal level of CD19 on the cell(s) of interest in a lymph node with the use of anti-CD19 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal level of lymph-node cellular cd19 expression

fields.label: Abnormal lymph-node cellular B-cell marker expression
fields.definition: "Abnormal expression of an antigen (marker) that is normally expressed by B lymphocytes." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal lymph-node cellular b-cell marker expression

fields.label: Abnormal level of lymph-node cellular CD20 expression
fields.definition: "Detection of abnormal levels of CD20 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD20 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal level of lymph-node cellular cd20 expression

fields.label: CD79a expression
fields.definition: "Detection of the presence of CD79a on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD79a antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry)." []

fields.label: Increased lymph-node cellular CD20 expression
fields.definition: "Increased levels of CD20 expression compared to normal B cells." []

fields.label: Decreased lymph-node cellular CD20 expression
fields.definition: "Decreased levels of CD20 expression compared to normal B cells." []

fields.label: Decreased lymph-node cellular CD19 expression
fields.definition: "Decreased levels of CD19 expression compared to normal B cells." []

fields.label: Increased lymph-node cellular CD19 expression
fields.definition: "Increased levels of CD19 expression compared to normal B cells." []

fields.label: PAX5 expression
fields.definition: "Detection of the presence of PAX5 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-PAX5 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry)." []

fields.label: Germinal center B-lymphocyte BCL2 expression
fields.definition: "Positive staining for BCL2 apoptosis regulator protein in lymph-node germinal center B cells." []

fields.label: Abnormal occipitofrontal diameter
fields.definition: "Abnormal occipitofrontal diameter (OFD) refers to a fetal head width measurement, taken between the root of the nose to the most prominent part of the occiput on an ultrasound image that lies outside the expected range for a given gestational age. The expected range typically falls between the 3rd percentile (or more than 2 standard deviations below the mean) and the 97th percentile (or more than 2 standard deviations above the mean)." []

fields.label: Decreased occipitofrontal diameter
fields.definition: "Occipitofrontal diameter, measured with fetal sonography, below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Increased occipitofrontal diameter
fields.definition: "Occipitofrontal diameter, measured with fetal sonography, above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Abnormal elbow morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the joint that connects the upper and the lower arm." []

fields.label: Abnormal elbow physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the joint that connects the upper and the lower arm." []

fields.label: Restrictive eating
fields.definition: "A behavioral pattern characterized by a deliberate and sustained limitation of food intake, often involving avoidance of certain foods, restriction of portion size, or prolonged fasting, resulting in reduced energy or nutrient consumption relative to physiological needs." [PMID:26310991]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anorexia nervosa

fields.label: Abnormal fetal abdominal circumference
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the fetal abdominal circumference, which is typically measured sonographically in a transverse view using the outer borders of the skin line at the plane where the fetal stomach, umbilical vein and portal sinus is visible. Abnormal fetal abdominal circumference is defined as less than the 10th or greater than the 90th percentile for gestational age." []

fields.label: Increased fetal abdominal circumference
fields.definition: "The distance around the abdomen of a fetus, generally as measured by prenatal sonography, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Abnormal fetal head circumference
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the fetal head circumference, which is typically measured sonographically in the axial plane at the level of the thalami and cavum septic pellucidi, using the outer border of the bony calvarium. Abnormal fetal head circumference is defined as less than the thrid percentile or 2 standard deviations below the mean or greater than the 97the percentile or 2 standard deviations above the mean." [PMID:35928073]

fields.label: Decreased fetal head circumference
fields.definition: "Fetal head circumference less than the third percentile or 2 standard deviations below the mean." [PMID:35928073]

fields.label: Increased fetal head circumference
fields.definition: "Fetal head circumference above the 97th percentile or 2 standard deviations above the mean." []

fields.label: Increased anteroposterior lens thickness
fields.definition: "Increase in the anteroposterior (axial) dimension of the crystalline lens relative to the overall length of the globe." [PMID:21397065]

fields.label: Ankle instability
fields.definition: "Failure of ligamentous and muscular structures of the ankle to maintain normal joint alignment during movement, resulting in excessive motion that causes manifestations such as subjective or objective feeling of clunking/clicking in the ankle with movement, ankle 'giving way' or sensation of ankle dislocating." [PMID:40188228]

fields.label: Retinal phlebitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of retinal venules as manifested by perivascular sheathing or cuffing, vascular leakage and/or occlusion." [PMID:40445440]

fields.label: Ophthalmic artery hypoperfusion
fields.definition: "Chronic hypoperfusion due to large vessel disease e.g. carotid artery stenosis, Takayasu disease. Typically presents dilated veins, low retinal arterial pressure, peripheral microaneurysms, ocular hypotension and may lead to iris neovascularisation. Patients may have postural hypotension." [PMID:12121370]

fields.label: Focal hyperpigmented area associated with subretinal scar tissue
fields.definition: "Localized hyperpigmented areas, in the context of subretinal scar tissue, as seen after subretinal neovascularisation." []
fields.label_normalized: focal hyperpigmented area associated with subretinal scar tissue

fields.label: Discrete fundus hypopigmentation
fields.definition: "Well-demarcated areas of the fundus, with relative reduction in pigment, with respect to the rest of the fundus." []

fields.label: Abnormal cecum morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the cecum, which is the proximal blind pouch of the ascending colon, is located at the ileocecal junction in the right iliac fossa." [PMID:29261962]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal caecum morphology

fields.label: Flail chest
fields.definition: "Flail chest is a physical exam finding that can be present in the setting of chest wall trauma or injury. When multiple adjacent ribs are fractured in 2 or more places, this can create a focal \"free-floating\" segment of the chest wall that moves independently from the rest of the chest." [PMID:28363365, PMID:39282924]

fields.label: Hallux rigidus
fields.definition: "Osteoarthritis of the metatarsophalangeal joint of the first toe." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24649409]
fields.synonyms_concat: Arthritis of the big toe

fields.label: Thickening of glomerular capillary wall
fields.definition: "Widening of the wall of capillary blood vessels in the glomerulus. This feature may be produced by deposits and other changes affecting either subepithelial and subendothelial regions or the glomerular basement membrane itself." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:6879730]

fields.label: Abnormal glomerular capillary morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the capillary blood vessels in the renal glomerulus." []
synonyms: Abnormalities of the glomerular capillary wall
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormalities of the glomerular capillary wall

fields.label: Ectopic fovea
fields.definition: "An abnormal anatomic position of the fovea." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ectopic macula

fields.label: Tracheal tug on inspiration
fields.definition: "Downward movement of the trachea during inspiration due to downward traction on the tracheobronchial tree." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Forward slanting upper incisors
fields.definition: "The upper incisors deviate from the normal angle of being roughly parallel to the surface of the face and instead slant outwards." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Forward directed upper incisors; Proclination of the upper incisors; Protruding upper incisors

fields.label: Foveal atrophy
fields.definition: "A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and neurosensory retinal cells in the fovea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Pyriform aperture stenosis
fields.definition: "Narrowing of the anterior nasal aperture (piriform or pyriform aperture), which is a pear-shaped opening in the skull that forms the bony inlet of the nose." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Status cribrosum
fields.definition: "Diffusely widened perivascular spaces in the basal ganglia, affecting especially the corpus striatum. Status cribrosum is usually symmetrical, with the perivascular spaces showing CSF signal and without diffusion restriction. The word cribriform means sievelike, with multiple perforations." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Decerebrate rigidity
fields.definition: "A type of rigidity that is manifested by an exaggerated extensor posture of all extremities." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decerebrate posturing

fields.label: Subcutaneous spheroids
fields.definition: "Small, hard cyst-like nodules, freely moveable in the subcutis over the bony prominences of the legs and arms, which have an outer calcified layer with a translucent core on x-ray." [PMID:20847697]

fields.label: Abnormal capillary morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the tiny blood vessels that connect arterioles with venules and whose walls act as semipermeable membranes that mediate the diffusion of fluids and gases between the blood circulation and body tissues." []

fields.label: Capillary fragility
fields.definition: "Reduced resistance to rupture of capillary blood vessels. Capillary fragility may manifest as a bleeding diathesis with spontaneous ecchymoses (bruises)." []

fields.label: Abnormal capillary physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the tiny blood vessels that connect arterioles with venules and whose walls act as semipermeable membranes that mediate the diffusion of fluids and gases between the blood circulation and body tissues." []

fields.label: Arterial rupture
fields.definition: "Sudden breakage of an artery leading to leakage of blood from the circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Elevated prostate-specific antigen level
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of prostate specific antigen (PSA) in the circulation." [PMID:26366236]

fields.label: Abnormal erythrocyte sedimentation rate
fields.definition: "A deviation from normal range of the erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), a test that measures the distance that erythrocytes have fallen after one hour in a vertical column of anticoagulated blood under the influence of gravity. The ESR is a nonspecific finding. An elevation may indicate inflammation or may be caused by any condition that elevates fibrinogen. A decreased ESR may be seen in polycythemia or in certain blood diseases in which red blood cells have an irregular or smaller shape that causes slower settling." [PMID:10524488]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal ESR; Abnormal Westergren sedimentation rate

fields.label: Decreased erythrocyte sedimentation rate
fields.definition: "A reduced erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR). The ESR is a test that measures the distance that erythrocytes have fallen after one hour in a vertical column of anticoagulated blood under the influence of gravity. The ESR is a nonspecific finding. A decreased ESR may be seen in polycythemia or in certain blood diseases in which red blood cells have an irregular or smaller shape that causes slower settling." [PMID:10524488]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased ESR; Low ESR

fields.label: Rectal atresia
fields.definition: "A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the lumen of the rectum. That is, there is an abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the rectum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20006038]
fields.synonyms_concat: Atresia of the rectum

fields.label: Megarectum
fields.definition: "An abnormal dilation of the rectum. There is a large filled rectum as a result of underlying innervation or muscular abnormalities, which remains after disimpaction of the rectum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10869000]

fields.label: Rectovestibular fistula
fields.definition: "A congenital malformation characterized by an abnormal connection (fistula) between the rectum and the vulval vestibule, at the lower aspect of the vaginal opening." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Vestibular fistula

fields.label: H-type rectovestibular fistula
fields.definition: "Rectovestibular fistula with a normal anus is known as H-type fistula or double termination of the alimentary tract." [PMID:20223314]

fields.label: Osteoma cutis
fields.definition: "The term osteoma refers to the anomalous presence of ossification (bone formation) in the interior of the dermis or epidermis. The dermal or subcutaneous bone formation presents as stony hard nodules. The osteomata appear as irregular, hardened small nodules that are well circumscribed and generally of the same color as the skin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21152797, PMID:26273166]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cutaneous osteosis; Miliary osteoma; Osteomatosis

fields.label: Abnormal enteric nervous system morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of nerves of the enteric nervous system." []
synonyms: Abnormality of enteric nervous system morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of enteric nervous system morphology

fields.label: Abnormal enteric neuron morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of enteric neuron morphology

fields.label: Enteric neuronal degeneration
fields.definition: "Deterioration of enteric neurons with impairment of enteric neuronal structure. Typical neuropathological findings include qualitative (e.g., neuronal swelling, intranuclear inclusions, axonal degeneration) and quantitative (e.g., reduction in the number of neurons) abnormalities of the enteric neurons." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Degenerative enteric neuropathy

fields.label: Abnormality of digestive system physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the digestive system." []

fields.label: Abnormal digestive system morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the digestive system." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of digestive system morphology

fields.label: Abnormal morphology of erythroid progenitor cell
fields.definition: "Abnormal form of the progenitor cells committed to the erythroid lineage." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal morphology of erythroid progenitor cell

fields.label: Abnormal proerythroblast morphology
fields.definition: "Anomalous form of the proerythroblast, i.e., the immature, nucleated erythrocyte occupying the stage of erythropoeisis that follows formation of erythroid progenitor cells. This cell is CD71-positive, has both a nucleus and a nucleolus, and lacks hematopoeitic lineage markers." []

fields.label: Type I radial ray deficiency
fields.definition: "A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by short distal radius. The distal radial epiphysis is present but delayed in appearance. The growth of the distal radial epiphysis is decreased causing a normal appearing but short radius. There is little radial deviation of the hand due to adequate radial carpal support. The radius has normal proximal epiphyseal growth. Thumb hypoplasia is almost always present." [PMID:3559066]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short distal radius

fields.label: Hypothalamic gliosis
fields.definition: "Focal proliferation of glial cells in the hypothalamus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26530930]

fields.label: Intratesticular abscess
fields.definition: "A collection of pus within a testicle. Ultrasonographic features include shaggy, irregular walls, intratesticular location, low-level internal echoes, and occasionally, hypervascular margins." [PMID:11598263]
fields.synonyms_concat: Testicular abscess

fields.label: Basal ganglia edema
fields.definition: "Swelling within the basal ganglia due to the accumulation of fluid." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Basal ganglia edema; Edema of the basal ganglia; Oedema of the basal ganglia

fields.label: Thalamic edema
fields.definition: "Swelling within the thalamus due to the accumulation of fluid." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Edema of the thalamus; Oedema of the thalamus; Thalamic edema

fields.label: Thalamic calcification
fields.definition: "Calcium deposition in the thalamus." []

fields.label: Abnormality of mesenteric lymph nodes

fields.label: Lung abscess
fields.definition: "A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in lung parenchyma, which leads to a cavity, and after formation of bronchopulmonary fistula, can manifest as an air-fluid level inside the cavity." [PMID:26366400]
