fields.label: Type II radial ray deficiency
fields.definition: "A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by a hypoplastic radius. The radius has both proximal and distal epiphyses but growth is defective in both. This type is essentially a radius in miniature. Growth of the radius proceeds at a decreased rate." [PMID:3559066]

fields.label: Type III radial ray deficiency
fields.definition: "A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by partial absence of the radius. The radius is partially absent. The defect can be in the proximal, middle, or distal third. All have been reported , but the most frequent is the absence of the distal one or two thirds. The hand is radially displaced . The ulna is thickened, shortened , and bowed radially, and the wrist is unsupported." [PMID:3559066]

fields.label: Type IV radial ray deficiency
fields.definition: "A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by total absence of the radius. This represents the most common type of radial deficiency. The hand is unsupported and is usually severely radially displaced." [PMID:3559066]

fields.label: Abnormal olfactory lobe morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the olfactory lobe, the structure within the brain that receives neural input from the nasal cavity and thereby processes the sense of smell." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of olfactory lobe morphology

fields.label: Hypothalamic atrophy
fields.definition: "Partial or complete wasting (loss) of hypothalamus tissue that was once present." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Atrophy of the hypothalamus

fields.label: Splenic abscess
fields.definition: "A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the parenchyma of the spleen." [PMID:21319348]

fields.label: Multifocal splenic abscess
fields.definition: "Multiple abscess lesions in the spleen." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Multilocular splenic abscess

fields.label: Unifocal splenic abscess
fields.definition: "Single (solitary) abscess in the spleen." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Solitary splenic abscess; Unilocular splenic abscess

fields.label: Geophagia
fields.definition: "The practice of eating earth or soil-like substrates such as clay or chalk." [PMID:23816735]
fields.synonyms_concat: Geophagy

fields.label: Scaphoid abdomen
fields.definition: "The anterior abdominal wall is sunken and presents a concave rather than a convex contour." []

fields.label: Thalamic hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Bleeding in the thalamus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Thalamic hemorrhage

fields.label: Abnormal mean corpuscular volume
fields.definition: "A deviation from normal of the mean corpuscular volume, or mean cell volume (MCV) of red blood cells, usually taken to be 80 to 100 femtoliters." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal erythrocyte volume; Abnormal MCV

fields.label: Decreased mean corpuscular volume
fields.definition: "A reduction from normal of the mean corpuscular volume, or mean cell volume (MCV) of red blood cells (usually defined as an MCV below 80 femtoliters)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased MCV; Microcytosis; Reduced erythrocyte volume

fields.label: Recurrent sepsis
fields.definition: "Repeated bouts of sepsis, defined as life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection." []

fields.label: Incomitant strabismus
fields.definition: "Strabismus in which the angle of deviation differs depending upon the direction of gaze or according to which eye is fixing, associated with: (i) defective movement of the eye, (ii) asymmetrical accommodative effort." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Concomitant strabismus
fields.definition: "Strabismus in which the angle of deviation of the squiting eye remains the same in relation to the other eye, in all directions of gaze, and whichever eye is fixing." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Comitant strabismus

fields.label: Abnormal U wave
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the U wave of the electrocardiogram (EKG). The U wave is a small (0.5 mm) deflection immediately following the T wave, usually in the same direction as the T wave. It is best seen in leads V2 and V3." [PMID:22665396]

fields.label: U wave inversion
fields.definition: "Direction of the U wave opposite to the T wave (i.e., below baseline) in leads with upright T waves." []

fields.label: Prominent U wave
fields.definition: "Increased amplitude of the U wave, defined as an amplitude greater than 1-2mm or 25 percent of the height of the T wave." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased U wave amplitude

fields.label: Exercise-induced U wave inversion
fields.definition: "U wave inversion that is induced by exercise stress testing." [PMID:22665396]

fields.label: Abnormal QRS complex
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the complex formed by the Q, R, and S waves, which occur in rapid succession on the electrocardiogram." []

fields.label: Increased QRS voltage
fields.definition: "Elevation of the voltage (height) of the QRS complex. There are several criteria in use, but the most common is the Sokolov-Lyon criterion (S wave depth in V1 + tallest R wave height in V5-V6 greater than 35 mm)." []

fields.label: Abnormal QRS voltage
fields.definition: "Abnormal amplitude of the QRS complex of the electrocardiogram (EKG)." []

fields.label: Decreased QRS voltage
fields.definition: "Reduced amplitude (height) of the QRS complex of the electrocardiogram (EKG), defined as amplitudes of all the QRS complexes in the limb leads are less than 5 mm or amplitudes of all the QRS complexes in the precordial leads less than 10 mm." []

fields.label: Electrical alternans
fields.definition: "The QRS complexes of the electrocardiogram alternate in height." [PMID:8222799]

fields.label: Pancreatic abscess
fields.definition: "A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the parenchyma of the pancreas." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pancreas abscess

fields.label: Orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis
fields.definition: "A form of hyperkeratosis characterized by thickening of the cornified layer without retained nuclei." []

fields.label: Darier's sign
fields.definition: "A skin change elicited by briskly rubbing the skin lesion in urticaria pigmentosa (UP), whereby the area begins to itch and becomes raised and surrounded by erythema. Unlike other forms of dermatographism, Darier's sign refers to urtication that is limited to the UP involved areas and, as in this case, spares the skin unaffected by UP." [PMID:24701633]

fields.label: Abnormal cutaneous elastic fiber morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the elastic fibers of the skin. Elastic fibers are the essential extracellular matrix macromolecules comprising an elastin core surrounded by a mantle of fibrillin-rich microfibrils." [PMID:12082143, PMID:21738362]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal cutaneous elastic fibre morphology

fields.label: Elevated dermal desmosine content
fields.definition: "An increased amount of desmosine measure in the skin. Desmosine is a cross-linking amino acid formed from lysyl residues in elastin." [PMID:2307214]

fields.label: Folliculitis
fields.definition: "Inflammatory cells within the wall and ostia of the hair follicle, creating a follicular-based pustule." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Follicular pustule; Hair follicle inflammation

fields.label: Bloody diarrhea
fields.definition: "Passage of many stools containing blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Blood in stool; Bloody bowel movement; Bloody diarrhea; Bloody stool

fields.label: Bloody mucoid diarrhea
fields.definition: "Passage of many stools containing blood and mucus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bloody mucoid diarrhea

fields.label: Delayed recoil upon stretching of skin
fields.definition: "Area of skin requiring an increased amount of time to return to its original shape after being stretched." []
fields.label_normalized: delayed recoil upon stretching of skin

fields.label: Onychomadesis
fields.definition: "Complete shedding (separation) of the nail from the proximal matrix. Onychomadesis is the proximal separation of the nail plate from the nail matrix due to a temporary cessation of nail growth." [PMID:24882996, PMID:25473242, PMID:28207011]

fields.label: Feculent vomiting
fields.definition: "Vomiting of material that is of fecal origin." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Faecal vomiting; Fecal vomiting; Stercoraceous vomiting; Vomiting faecal matter; Vomiting fecal matter

fields.label: Abnormal large intestinal mucosa morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the mucous lining of the large intestine." []

fields.label: Wrist sign
fields.definition: "The wrist sign is positive when the tip of the thumb covers the entire fingernail of the fifth finger when wrapped around the contralateral wrist." [PMID:11711445]

fields.label: Epidermal acanthosis
fields.definition: "Diffuse hypertrophy or thickening of the stratum spinosum of the epidermis (prickle cell layer of the skin)." []
synonyms: Thickening of upper layer of skin
fields.synonyms_concat: Acanthosis; Acanthotic epidermis; Epidermal hyperplasia; Thickening of upper layer of skin

fields.label: Peripapillary exudate
fields.definition: "A retinal exudate in the area surrounding the optic nerve head." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Peripapillary exudation

fields.label: Disciform macular scar
fields.definition: "A scar with a disc-like shape localized in the macula." [PMID:24965122]

fields.label: Sneeze
fields.definition: "A sudden violent, spasmodic, audible expiration of breath through the nose and mouth." []

fields.label: Paroxysmal sneezing
fields.definition: "Unprovoked explosive pathological sneezing." [PMID:17388999]

fields.label: Eyelid myoclonus
fields.definition: "Marked, involuntary jerking of the eyelids." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Blepharoclonus; Eyelid myoclonia

fields.label: Dysgenesis of the hypothalamus
fields.definition: "Structural abnormality of the hypothalamus related to defective development." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypothalamic dysgenesis

fields.label: Dysgenesis of the thalamus
fields.definition: "Structural abnormality of the thalamus related to defective development." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Thalamic dysgenesis

fields.label: Abnormal hippocampus morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the hippocampus," []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal morphology of the hippocampus; Abnormality of hippocampus morphology

fields.label: Dysgenesis of the hippocampus
fields.definition: "Structural abnormality of the hippocampus related to defective development." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hippocampal dysgenesis

fields.label: Dysgenesis of the basal ganglia
fields.definition: "Structural abnormality of the basal ganglia related to defective development." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Basal ganglia dysgenesis

fields.label: Umbilicated nodule
fields.definition: "A type of skin nodule that has a small depression that resembles a navel (i.e., is umbilicated)." [PMID:24050295]

fields.label: Capillary malformation
fields.definition: "A capillary malformation is a flat, sharply defined vascular stain of the skin. It may cover a large surface area or it may be scattered and appear as little islands of color. In a capillary maformation, the predominant vessels are small, slow-flow vessels (i.e., arterioles and postcapillary venules)." [PMID:22483320, PMID:25864701]

fields.label: Nevus anemicus
fields.definition: "A congenital skin lesion characterized by irregular hypopigmented macules that coalesce to form plaques and occur particularly on the chest. It is generally present at birth or develops in the first days of life. It is more common in females. Diagnosis is confirmed by applying gentle friction to the lesion and the surrounding skin and checking that the erythema produced in the healthy skin does not appear in the hypopigmented lesion. This pale macule becomes more conspicuous when the lesion and its surroundings are rubbed. The margin of the naevus is ill-defined and consists of an archipelago of small anemic spots." [PMID:22483320, PMID:25864701]
fields.synonyms_concat: Naevus anaemicus

fields.label: Nevus roseus
fields.definition: "A variant of port-wine stain characterized by a pale red or even pink tone, in contrast to the darker hue of the port-wine stain. By analogy with the term port-wine stain, this variant rose-wine stain, or nevus roseus. Nevus roseus, however, cannot be definitely diagnosed until adulthood as port-wine stains are sometimes pink in children. While the natural history of port-wine stains includes hypertrophy, darkening, and nodularity, nevus roseus remains unchanged for life." [PMID:22483320, PMID:25864701]

fields.label: Cutis marmorata telangiectatica congenita
fields.definition: "A congenital vascular malformation that presents as localized or generalized erythematous-telangiectatic lesions with a reticular pattern; the lesions are almost always present at birth or develop in the first days of life. Cutis marmorata telangiectatica congenita (CMTC) appears as marble-like pattern (mottling) on the surface of the skin. In contrast to cutis marmorata, the marbling is more severe and always visible." [PMID:22483320, PMID:25864701]

fields.label: Angioma serpentinum
fields.definition: "Angioma serpiginosum consists of punctate, tightly packed telangiectatic lesions. Characteristic histopathological features are dilated and tortuous capillaries involving the uppermost part of the dermis." [PMID:25864701]

fields.label: Reduced red cell pyruvate kinase level
fields.definition: "Decrease in the level of pyruvate kinase (PK) within erythrocytes. PK catalyzes the reaction: ATP + pyruvate = ADP + phosphoenolpyruvate." [PMID:7949104]
fields.label_normalized: reduced red cell pyruvate kinase level
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced erythrocyte pyruvate kinase activity

fields.label: Placoid macular lesion
fields.definition: "Large yellow/white, sharply delineated lesion, typically of inflammatory nature, involving the macula, more specifically at the outer retinal level (RPE/photoreceptor)." []

fields.label: Acquired aphakia
fields.definition: "Absence of the crystalline lens in the eye known to be the result of a non-congenital condition, e.g., following surgical removal of the lens for cataracts or trauma." []

fields.label: Auditory sensitivity
fields.definition: "Decreased tolerance to sound." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Noise sensitivity

fields.label: Misophonia
fields.definition: "Misophonia is characterized by strong physiological, emotional, and behavioral reactions to auditory, visual, and/or kinesthetic stimuli of different nature regardless of their physical characteristics. These misophonic responses include anger, general discomfort, disgust, anxiety, and avoidance and escape behaviors." [PMID:35682372]

fields.label: Hypergranulosis
fields.definition: "Hypergranulosis is an increased thickness of the stratum granulosum." []

fields.label: Civatte bodies
fields.definition: "Eosinophilic hyaline ovoid bodies which are often found in the subepidermal papillary regions or sometimes in the epidermis. Civatte bodies (CBs) are seen as rounded, homogenous, eosinophilic masses on routine H and E staining lying in the deeper parts of epidermis/epithelium and more frequently in dermis/connective tissue. They are known as CBs (in epithelium/epidermis), colloid bodies, or hyaline bodies (in connective tissue). They are 10-25 micrometers in diameter and situated mostly within or above the inflammatory cell infiltrate. In lichen planus, the number of necrotic keratinocytes may be so large that they are seen lying in clusters in the uppermost dermis. These bodies show a positive periodic acid Schiff reaction and are diastase resistant" [PMID:23919028]
fields.synonyms_concat: Colloid bodies; Colloid bodies of Civatte; Cytoid bodies; Hyaline bodies

fields.label: Fetal distress
fields.definition: "An intrauterine state characterized by suboptimal values in the fetal heart rate, oxygenation of fetal blood, or other parameters indicative of compromise of the fetus. Signs of fetal distress include repetitive variable decelerations, fetal tachycardia or bradycardia, late decelerations, or low biophysical profile." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Foetal distress

fields.label: Rete ridge flattening
fields.definition: "Rete pegs (or ridges) are the epithelial extensions that project into the underlying connective tissue in both skin and mucous membranes. Rete ridge flattening refers to the loss of these projections so that the skin epithelium acquires a relatively flat appearance." [PMID:20548894]
fields.synonyms_concat: Flattened rete pegs; Flattened rete ridges

fields.label: Lip discoloration
fields.definition: "Lightening or darkening of the lips from their usual coloring." []

fields.label: Violet lip discoloration
fields.definition: "An alteration of the color of the lip to take on a violet color. This term does not include cyanosis." [PMID:24346922]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating reverse T3 concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of reverse T3 (3,3',5'-triiodothyronine or rT3) in the blood circulation is ouside of the limits of normal." []

fields.label: Sawtooth acanthosis
fields.definition: "A type of epidermal acanthosis characterized by a jagged (sawtooth) appearance of the rete ridges of the epidermis." [PMID:19061615]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sawtoothed acanthosis

fields.label: White streaks/specks on enamel.
fields.definition: "Areas of white discoloration visible on the surface of the teeth (enamel) in the form of streaks or specks." []

fields.label: Fragile teeth
fields.definition: "A tendency of teeth to fracture as manifested by a history of repeated fracture of the dental enamel without adequate trauma." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Enamel with tendency to chip; Spontaneous tooth fracture

fields.label: White lesion of the oral mucosa
fields.definition: "White lesions of the oral mucosa are generally caused by a condition that increases the thickness of the epithelium. This increases the distance to the vascular bed and thereby tends to change the usual reddish color of the oral mucosa to white. Common causes include hyperkeratosis (thickening of the keratin layer), acanthosis (thickening of the spinous cell layer), increased edema in the epithelium (leukoedema), and reduced vascularity of the underlying lamina propria. Additionally, fibrin caps or surface ulcerations and collapsed bullae can appear white." []
fields.label_normalized: white lesion of the oral mucosa

fields.label: Oral hairy leukoplakia
fields.definition: "A corrugated white lesion of the oral mucosa that usually occurs on the lateral or ventral surfaces of the tongue and may have a shaggy or frayed appearance." []

fields.label: Actinic keratosis
fields.definition: "A scaly, crusty lesion caused by damage from the ultraviolet radiation of the sun, with typical location on sun-exposed areas of the skin. Actinic keratosis lesions are often elevated, rough, and wartlike, and may be red, or occasionally tan, pink, or flesh-toned in color." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Solar keratosis

fields.label: Reduced intraabdominal adipose tissue
fields.definition: "An abnormally reduced amount of adipose tissue in the abdominal cavity." []

fields.label: Abnormal small intestinal mucosa morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the mucous lining of the small intestine." []

fields.label: Decreased small intestinal mucosa lactase level
fields.definition: "Lactase is produced in the small intestine in humans, Lactase is a member of the beta-galactosidase family of enzymes, and hydrolyzes D-lactose to form D-galactose and D-glucose, which can be absorbed by the small intestine. There are many ways of assessing lactase activity. In one test, an endoscopic biopsy from the postbulbar duodenum is incubated with lactose on a test plate, and a color reaction develops within 20 min as a result of hydrolyzed lactose (a positive result) in patients with normolactasia, whereas no reaction (a negative result) develops in patients with severe hypolactasia. Other, less direct, tests include the hydrogen breath test, and blood tests following lactose challenges." []
fields.label_normalized: decreased small intestinal mucosa lactase level
fields.synonyms_concat: Lactase deficiency

fields.label: Finger swelling
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the soft tissues of one or more fingers." [PMID:16269085, PMID:19946526, PMID:24758199, PMID:9715244]
fields.synonyms_concat: Swelling of fingers; Swollen finger; Swollen fingers

fields.label: Abnormal circulating estrogen level
fields.definition: "A deviation from normal concentration of the hormone estrogen in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal circulating estrogen level; Abnormal estrogen level; Abnormal oestrogen level

fields.label: Abnormal serum estradiol
fields.definition: "A deviation from normal concentrations of estradiol in the circulation." []

fields.label: Increased serum estradiol
fields.definition: "An elevation above normal limits of the concentration of estradiol in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased estradiol level; Increased serum oestradiol

fields.label: Abnormal serum estriol
fields.definition: "A deviation from normal concentration of estriol in the circulation." []

fields.label: Increased serum estriol
fields.definition: "An elevation above normal limits of estriol concentration in the circulation." []

fields.label: Decreased serum estriol
fields.definition: "A reduction below normal limits of estriol in the circulation." []

fields.label: Abnormal serum estrone
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of circulating estrone." []

fields.label: Increased serum estrone
fields.definition: "An elevation above normal limits of the concentration of estrone in the circulation." []

fields.label: Decreased serum estrone
fields.definition: "A reduction below normal limits of the concentration of estrone in the circulation." []

fields.label: Gingival calcification
fields.definition: "Ectopic deposition of calcium salts found in the gingiva." [PMID:25928877]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gingival calcifications

fields.label: Constitutional symptom
fields.definition: "A symptom or manifestation indicating a systemic or general effect of a disease and that may affect the general well-being or status of an individual." []

fields.label: Chills
fields.definition: "A sudden sensation of feeling cold." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Chills

fields.label: Shivering
fields.definition: "Involuntary contraction or twitching of the muscles." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Shivering; Shuddering

fields.label: Rigors
fields.definition: "Severe chills with violent shivering. A rigor is an episode of shaking or exaggerated shivering which can occur with a high fever." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Rigours

fields.label: Foveal degeneration
fields.definition: "A nonspecific term denoting progressive loss of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and/or neurosensory retinal cells within the fovea." []

fields.label: Beaten bronze macular sheen
fields.definition: "An irregular grayish appearance of the macula, which is said to resemble beaten bronze or hammered metal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Beaten metal macular appearance; Beaten-bronze macular appearance; Beaten-bronze macular sheen

fields.label: Dark choroid
fields.definition: "A fluorescein angiographic finding of absence of the normal background fluorescence (a dark choroid)." [PMID:27739528, PMID:7248243]

fields.label: Atrophic muscularis propria
fields.definition: "Partial or complete wasting (loss) of muscularois propria tissue that was once present. The atrophy may involve a marked vacuolar degeneration of myocytes, loss of muscle fibers and some cases a highly characteristic honeycomb fibrosis." [PMID:18329691]
fields.synonyms_concat: Autonomic visceral myopathy; Degenerative enteric myopathy

fields.label: Hypoganglionosis
fields.definition: "Sparse and small myenteric ganglia" []

fields.label: Ganglioneuromatosis
fields.definition: "Hyperplastic submucosal and myenteric plexus containing an increased number of ganglion cells, glial cells and nerve fibers." [PMID:26361414]

fields.label: Poor visual behavior for age
fields.definition: "Lack of visual responsiveness or decrease in visual capabilities suggesting a lack of visual responsiveness or decrease in visual capabilities in an infant or young child in which visual behavior fails to meet normal developmental milestones." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal visual behavior for age; Abnormal visual behaviour for age; Poor visual behavior for age

fields.label: Transient
fields.definition: "Short-lived and not permanent. This term applies to a phenotypic abnormality that is temporary and of short duration." []

fields.label: Portosystemic collateral veins
fields.definition: "Presence of biliary veins that serve as a collateral channel to the systemic circulation" []
fields.synonyms_concat: Collateral biliary circulation; Collateral biliary veins

fields.label: Abnormal hepatobiliary system physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the hepatobiliary system" []

fields.label: Dependency on intravenous nutrition
fields.definition: "Inability to be weaned from intravenous (parenteral) nutrition, as judged by the hydration status (urine output, blood urea nitrogen, creatinine, urine sodium concentration), ability to maintain weight, stool output, and serum electrolyte status." [PMID:16770168]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dependency on IV nutrition

fields.label: Increased urinary sedoheptulose
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of sedoheptulose in the urine. Sedoheptulose is a monosaccharide with seven carbon atoms and a ketone functional group." []

fields.label: Hyperautofluorescent retinal lesion
fields.definition: "Increased amount of autofluorescence in the retina as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Retinal lipofuscin accumulation

fields.label: Hypoautofluorescent retinal lesion
fields.definition: "Decreased amount of autofluorescence in the retina as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypo-autofluorescent retinal lesion

fields.label: Abnormal temper tantrums
fields.definition: "Temper tantrums are brief episodes of extreme, unpleasant, and sometimes aggressive behaviors in response to frustration or anger, which are a normal part of development in toddlers. Temper tantrums that occur more frequently in a given time and/or are more severe in symptomatology and/or longer in duration and/or inappropriate for the given age compared to a temper tantrum that naturally occurs as a part of the developmental process are classified as abnormal temper tantrums." []

fields.label: Frequent temper tantrums
fields.definition: "Temper tantrums that occur more frequently compared to the temper tantrums that are a part of the normal developmental process." []

fields.label: Severe temper tantrums
fields.definition: "Temper tantrums, which occur with more severe symptomatology compared to a temper tantrum that occurs as a part of normal developmental process." []

fields.label: Abnormal optic chiasm morphology
fields.definition: "A structural abnormality of the optic chiasm.The optic chiasm, located below the hypothalamus, is a partial crossing of the optic nerves." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of optic chiasm morphology

fields.label: Increased number of elastic fibers in the dermis
fields.definition: "An elevated number of elastic fibers, that is of bundles of proteins and glycoproteins in the extracellular matrix in the reticular dermis. Elastic fibers can stretch and recoil back to their original length. This feature can be appreciated on histology with hematoxylin and eosin or other staining methods." [PMID:25072684]
synonyms: Increased number of elastic fibres in the dermis
fields.label_normalized: increased number of elastic fibers in the dermis
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased number of elastic fibres in the dermis

fields.label: Clumping of elastic fibers in the dermis

fields.synonyms_concat: Fragmented elastic fibres in the dermis

fields.label: Left ventricular diastolic dysfunction
fields.definition: "Abnormal function of the left ventricule during left ventricular relaxation and filling." [PMID:12527689, PMID:14594874]

fields.label: Left ventricular systolic dysfunction
fields.definition: "Abnormality of left ventricular contraction, often defined operationally as an ejection fraction of less than 40 percent." []

fields.label: Neuronal/glioneuronal neoplasm of the central nervous system
fields.definition: "A central nervous system neoplasm with neuronal and, less consistently, glial differentiation." []
fields.label_normalized: neuronal/glioneuronal neoplasm of the central nervous system
fields.synonyms_concat: Glioneuronal tumor; Glioneuronal tumour; Neuronal and mixed neuronal-glial tumor; Neuronal and mixed neuronal-glial tumour; Neuronal/glioneuronal neoplasm of the CNS

fields.label: Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumor
fields.definition: "A tumor of the central nervous system that has components of both neurocytic and glial areas, whereby usually the glial component of the tumor predominates. Rossette-forming glioneuronal tumors (RGNT) have biphasic cytoarchitecture with two elements; neurocytic rosettes resembling Homer-Wright rosettes, and astrocytic component resembling a pilocytic astrocytoma. RGNTs are low-grade tumors that lack histopathological signs of malignancy." [PMID:27179225]
synonyms: Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumor of the fourth ventricle
Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumour of the fourth ventricle
fields.synonyms_concat: Rosette-forming glioneuronal neoplasm; Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumor; Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumor of the fourth ventricle; Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumour of the fourth ventricle

fields.label: Smooth septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with a smooth appearance of the interlobular septa." []
fields.label_normalized: smooth septal thickening on pulmonary hrct

fields.label: Nodular septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with a nodular or beaded appearance of the interlobular septa." []
fields.label_normalized: nodular septal thickening on pulmonary hrct

fields.label: Irregular septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with an irregular appearance of the interlobular septa. THis feature is often associated with distortion of lung architecture." []
fields.label_normalized: irregular septal thickening on pulmonary hrct

fields.label: Honeycomb lung
fields.definition: "Honeycombing represents destroyed and fibrotic lung tissue containing numerous cystic airspaces with thick fibrous walls, representing the late stage of various lung diseases, with complete loss of acinar architecture. The cysts range in size from a few millimeters to several centimeters in diameter, have variable wall thickness, and are lined by metaplastic bronchiolar epithelium. On chest radiographs, honeycombing appears as closely approximated ring shadows, typically 3-10 mm in diameter with walls 1-3 mm in thickness, that resemble a honeycomb; the finding implies end-stage lung disease. On CT scans, the appearance is of clustered cystic air spaces, typically of comparable diameters on the order of 3-10 mm but occasionally as large as 2.5 cm. Honeycombing is usually subpleural and is characterized by well-defined walls. It is a CT feature of established pulmonary fibrosis. Because honeycombing is often considered specific for pulmonary fibrosis and is an important criterion in the diagnosis of usual interstitial pneumonia, the term should be used with care, as it may directly impact patient care." [PMID:18195376]
fields.synonyms_concat: Honeycomb cysts; Honeycombing

fields.label: Intralobular interstitial thickening
fields.definition: "A fine reticular pattern on high-resolution computed tomography, with the visible lines separated by a few millimeters. Regions of the lung with intralobular interstitial thickening characteristically show a fine lacelike or netlike appearance." []

fields.label: Peribronchovascular interstitial thickening
fields.definition: "Thickening of the peribronchovascular interstitium, a connective tissue sheath that surrounds the central bronchi and pulmonary arteries. The peribronchovascular interstitium extends from the level of the pulmonary hila into the peripheral lung. This feature may be ascertained on high-resolution computer tomography." []

fields.label: Subpleural interstitial thickening
fields.definition: "Increase in thickness of the subpleural interstitium." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Subpleural scarring

fields.label: Ground-glass opacification
fields.definition: "On chest radiographs, ground-glass opacity appears as an area of hazy increased lung opacity, usually extensive, within which margins of pulmonary vessels may be indistinct. On CT scans, it appears as hazy increased opacity of lung, with preservation of bronchial and vascular margins. It is caused by partial filling of airspaces, interstitial thickening (due to fluid, cells, and/or fibrosis), partial collapse of alveoli, increased capillary blood volume, or a combination of these, the common factor being the partial displacement of air. Ground-glass opacity is less opaque than consolidation, in which bronchovascular margins are obscured." [PMID:18195376, PMID:23247773]
fields.synonyms_concat: GGO; Ground glass opacities; Ground-glass opacification on pulmonary HRCT

fields.label: Centrilobular ground-glass opacification on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "A hazy area of increased attenuation in centrilobular areas of the lung with preserved bronchial and vascular markings seen on a computer tomography scan. Centrilobular refers to a location that is central within secondary pulmonary lobules." []
fields.label_normalized: centrilobular ground-glass opacification on pulmonary hrct
fields.synonyms_concat: Centrilobular groundglass opacification; Centrilobular groundglass opacity

fields.label: Abdominal aseptic abscess
fields.definition: "An abscess-like lesion located within the abdomen. The lesions are localized in the spleen, liver, abdominal lymph nodes. The lesions represent visceral sterile collections of mature neutrophils that do not respond to antibiotics but regress quickly when treated with corticosteroids, but relapses occur frequently." [PMID:22526827]

fields.label: Localized area of pendulous skin
fields.definition: "A confined region of lax skin that hangs below the level of the surrounding skin. Histopatholigically, there is a loss of elastic fibers in the dermis of the affected region." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Localised area of pendulous skin

fields.label: Abnormal CD4+ T cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population." []

fields.label: Arousal parasomnia
fields.definition: "An altered state of arousal during sleep that may be reported by the individual or an observation of others." [PMID:22965264]
fields.synonyms_concat: Arousal related sleep disturbance

fields.label: Marcus Gunn jaw winking synkinesis
fields.definition: "Unilateral ptosis with associated upper eyelid contraction and contraction of either the external or the internal pterygoid muscle. It is thought to occur because of congenital miswiring of a branch of the fifth cranial nerve into the branch of the third cranial nerve supplying the levator muscle. In Marcus Gunn jaw winking synkinesis, elevation and even retraction of the affected eyelid is triggered by chewing, suction, lateral mandible movement, smiling, sternocleidomastoid contraction, protruding tongue, Valsalva maneuver and even by breathing." [PMID:23345532, PMID:25754805]
fields.synonyms_concat: Marcus Gunn jaw-winking syndrome; Pterygoid-levator synkinesis; Trigemino-oculomotor synkinesis

fields.label: Sleep talking
fields.definition: "Vocalization (production of recognizable words or other sounds) during sleep with lack of awareness." [PMID:30594004]

fields.label: Retinal vasculitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of retinal blood vessels as manifested by perivascular sheathing or cuffing, vascular leakage and/or occlusion. It can affect veins, arteries or both." [PMID:38925285]

fields.label: Hypnic jerks
fields.definition: "Hypnic jerks are characterized by sudden and brief (less than 1 second), non-periodic simultaneous contractions of the whole body or one or more extremities at the onset of sleep." [PMID:26329450]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sleep starts

fields.label: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalized onset
fields.definition: "A bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalized onset is a type of bilateral tonic-clonic seizure characterized by generalized onset; these seizures rapidly engage networks in both hemispheres at the start of the seizure." [PMID:20196795, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064, PMID:6790275]
synonyms: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalised onset
Generalised tonic-clonic seizure without focal onset

fields.label: Subtentorial periventricular white matter hyperdensity
fields.definition: "Areas of brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter that surrounds the fourth cerebral ventricle (which is located beneath the tentorium of the cerebellum)." []

fields.label: Posterolateral diaphragmatic hernia
fields.definition: "A posterolateral defect in the diaphragm, commonly referred to as a Bochdalek hernia, which is often accompanied by herniation of the stomach, intestines, liver, and/or spleen into the chest cavity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bochdalek hernia

fields.label: Morgagni diaphragmatic hernia
fields.definition: "An anterior retrosternal or parasternal hernia that can result in the herniation of liver or intestines into the chest cavity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Morgagni hernia

fields.label: Central diaphragmatic hernia
fields.definition: "A congenital diaphragm defect involving the central tendinous (e.g., amuscular) portion of the diaphragm, whereby the entire rim of diaphragmatic musculature is present." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Central hernia

fields.label: Increased total iron binding capacity
fields.definition: "An elevation in the total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added. A high TIBC corresponds to a high transferrin concentration. The latent (or free) iron binding capacity is the difference between the TIBC and the measured serum iron, corresponding to the transferrin not bound to iron, i.e., free iron binding capacity." [PMID:3542299]

fields.label: Inclusion body fibromatosis
fields.definition: "A benign tumor made up of mostly myofibroblasts that appears almost exclusively on the digits of the hands and feet, rarely involving the thumb or big toe. The lesion displays a proliferation of bland intradermal spindle cells arranged in whorls, fascicles, or a storiform pattern in a collagenous background of varying degrees. Also usually present are perpendicular tumor cell fascicles that extend to the epidermis. The small intracytoplasmic inclusions are said to appear similar to red blood cells. The inclusion bodies have been shown to be made up of densely packed vimentin and actin filaments. The tumor often causes a dome-shaped elevation of the overlying structures, forming a protuberant or polypoid nodule. The overlying epidermis can display a host of changes, including acanthosis, hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, rete ridge flattening, entrapment of adnexal structures, and, rarely, ulceration." [NCIT:C3456, PMID:27684985]
fields.synonyms_concat: Digital fibrous tumor of Reye; Digital fibrous tumour of Reye; Infantile digital fibroma; Infantile digital fibromatosis

fields.label: Inflammatory cap polyp
fields.definition: "A non-malignant sessile or pedunculated polyp in the colon and rectum that displays a cap of inflammatory granulation tissue with fibrinopurulent exudate that covers the polyp." []

fields.label: Fragmented sleep
fields.definition: "Sleep characterized by frequent interruptions, stopping and starting, which disrupt the normal progression of sleep stages." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Broken sleep; Fitful sleep; Interrupted sleep; Restless sleep

fields.label: Muscle fiber actin filament accumulation
fields.definition: "Accumulation in muscle cells of filaments composed of actin." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Muscle fibre actin filament accumulation

fields.label: Abnormal circulating apolipoprotein concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration in blood of an apolipoprotein, i.e., of a protein that binds lipids to form lipoprotein and is thereby responsible for the transport of lipids in the blood and lymph circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal apolipoprotein level

fields.label: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein A-IV concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration in blood of apolipoprotein A-IV, a major component of HDL and chylomicrons that has a role in VLDL secretion and catabolism and is required for efficient activation of lipoprotein lipase by ApoC-II." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated apolipoprotein A-IV level

fields.label: Caput medusae

fields.synonyms_concat: Palm tree sign

fields.synonyms_concat: Heavy meal triggered symptoms; Triggered by overeating

fields.label: Triggered by high-fat diet
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating a diet high in lipids." []
fields.synonyms_concat: High-fat diet triggered symptoms; Triggered by high-fat diet

fields.label: Triggered by hyperventilation
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by excessively rapid and deep breathing." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperventilation triggered symptoms; Triggered by hyperventilation

fields.synonyms_concat: Triggered by immunisation; Triggered by immunization; Triggered by vaccination; Vaccination triggered symptoms

fields.synonyms_concat: Menstruation triggered symptoms; Triggered by monthly period; Triggered by period

fields.synonyms_concat: Sleep deprivation triggered symptoms; Triggered by sleep deprivation

fields.label: Triggered by smoking
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by smoking." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Smoking triggered symptoms; Triggered by cigarette consumption; Triggered by smoking; Triggered by tobacco use

fields.label: Triggered by sodium ingestion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking sodium." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Sodium ingestion triggered symptoms; Sodium intake triggered attacks; Triggered by Na ingestion; Triggered by Na+ ingestion; Triggered by salt ingestion; Triggered by sodium intake

fields.label: Triggered by sound
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to sound or noise." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Sound triggered symptoms; Triggered by sound

fields.label: Triggered by stress
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a physical, mental, or emotional factor associated with bodily or mental tension." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Stress triggered symptoms; Triggered by stress

fields.label: Triggered by excitement
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a a state of excitement or by being startled." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Excitement triggered symptoms; Triggered by excitement; Triggered by startle

fields.label: Triggered by sudden movement
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a sudden movement." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Kinesigenic; Sudden movement triggered symptoms; Triggered by sudden movement

fields.label: Triggered by vestibular stimulation
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by vestibular stimulation, including head turning, cold calorics, postural changes, or rotating chair." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Vestibular stimulation triggered attacks; Vestibular stimulation triggered symptoms

fields.label: Tendonitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of a tendon." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Teninitis

fields.label: Abnormal synovial bursa morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of a synovial bursa, which is a synovium-lined, sac-like structure found throughout the body near bony prominences and between bones, muscles, tendons, and ligaments. The bursa itself is a synovial lining that represents a potential space insofar as it is collapsed upon itself until a resulting trigger causes the bursa to become irritated and fill with synovial fluid." [PMID:30020712]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of synovial bursa morphology

fields.label: Bursitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of a synovial bursa." []

fields.label: Sleep paralysis
fields.definition: "Inability to move trunk and limbs and inability to speak during transition into or out of sleep; awareness is preserved and recall is present." [PMID:32965993]

fields.label: Parasomnia
fields.definition: "A clinically observable or self-reported abnormal behavior, experience, or physiological event that occurs in association with sleep, specific sleep stages, or sleep-wake transitions." [PMID:22965264, PMID:35956054, PMID:40132982]
fields.synonyms_concat: Event that disrupts sleep

fields.label: NREM parasomnia
fields.definition: "A parasomnia that occurs during non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep." [PMID:31375204]
fields.synonyms_concat: Disturbance in NREM; Non-rapid eye movement parasomnia; NREM parasomnia

fields.label: Sleep walking
fields.definition: "Ambulation during sleep with lack awareness and limited or no recall of the event." [PMID:30458142, PMID:32644427]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sleep walking; Somnambulism

fields.label: Foot pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the foot." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Foot pain

fields.label: Preretinal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "An accumulation of blood that is located between the retina and the detached posterior hyaloid, or in the vitreous cavity. Subhyaloid premacular hemorrhage is typically characterized by a circumscribed, round or dumb-bell shaped, bright red mound of blood beneath the internal limiting membrane (ILM) or between the ILM and hyaloid face, in or near to the central macular area." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:27090882]
fields.synonyms_concat: Premacular hemorrhage; Preretinal haeme; Preretinal haemorrhage; Preretinal heme; Subhyaloid haemorrhage; Subhyaloid heme; Subhyaloid hemorrhage

fields.label: Flame-shaped retinal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of retinal hemorrhage that is located within the nerve fiber layer (NFL) of the retina and that exhibits a characteristic flame shape which results from constraints by the structure of the NFL (axons of the ganglion cells)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Feathered retinal heme; Flame-shaped retinal haemorrhage; Linear retina heme

fields.label: Dot-and-blot retinal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Accumulation of blood located in the retina's inner nuclear and outer plexiform layers, and having a dot-like or blot-like shape. THe shape results from intraretinal compression, restricting the hemorrhages within a specific location." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Dot-and-blot retinal haemorrhage; Round retinal heme

fields.label: Subretinal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Accumulation of blood located beneath the neurosensory retina in the space between the neurosensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Subretinal haemorrhage; Subretinal heme

fields.label: Sub-retinal pigment epithelium haemorrhage
fields.definition: "An accumulation of blood located between the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and Bruch membrane." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Sub-RPE hemorrhage; Subretinal pigment epithelium haemorrhage; Subretinal pigment epithelium hemorrhage

fields.label: Cutaneous cyst
fields.definition: "A hollow mass located in the skin that is surrounded by an epithelium-lined wall and is well demarcated from the adjacent tissue. Cysts are often said to be sac-like and may contain serous liquid or semisolid material." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Skin cyst

fields.label: Trichilemmal cyst
fields.definition: "Nontender, round and firm, but slightly compressible, intradermal or subcutaneous cyst measuring 0.5-5 cm in diameter. Trichilemmal cysts are acquired rather than congenital, and tend to appear on the scalp rather than the face, and to be intradermal rather than subcutaneous." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pilar cyst

fields.label: Dermoid cyst
fields.definition: "A congenital subcutaneous cyst that arises from entrapment of skin along the lines of embryonic fusion. In contrast to epidermal cysts, dermoid cysts tend to contain various adnexal structures such as hair, sebaceous, eccrine or apocrine glands. Dermoid cysts are present at birth, and are indolent, firm, deep, subcutaneous nodules. They are often located on the head and neck, and rarely in the anogenital area. Dermoid cysts are slowly progressive and can grow to a size of 1 to 4 cm." []

fields.label: Eruptive vellus hair cyst
fields.definition: "A cutaneous cyst that is small (one or two millimeters in diameter) and painless, presenting as a follicular papule that usually is skin colored but may have a reddish or brownish tinge." []

fields.label: Comedo
fields.definition: "A clogged cutaneous sebaceous follicle, which is a cutaneous gland that secretes sebum (usually into a hair follicle)." []

fields.label: Closed comedo
fields.definition: "A comedo in which the top of the pore is not stretched open and thus does not expose the clogged portion (which would appear black), hence the name whitehead." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Whitehead

fields.label: Open comedo
fields.definition: "A comedo in which the part of the pore at the surface of the skin is stretched and open, exposing the contents of the comedo, which appear black." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Blackhead

fields.label: Geographic tongue
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the tongue characterized by loss (atrophy) of filiform papillae of the tongue, leaving areas of erythema (redness), surrounded by a serpiginous, white, hyperkeratotic border. The name geographic tongue refers to an appearance that is said to be similar to a map." [PMID:32119353]
fields.synonyms_concat: Annulus migrans; Benign migratory glossitis; Glossitis areata exfoliativa; Lingual erythema migrans; Wandering rash of the tongue

fields.label: Claustrophobia
fields.definition: "An abnormal fear of being in a closed or narrow space with no escape is called claustrophobia." []

fields.label: Ameliorated by
fields.definition: "An ameliorating factor is defined as an external factor that leads to a sign or symptom that is already present improving or becoming more bearable" []
fields.synonyms_concat: Improved by

fields.label: Ameliorated by pregnancy
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by pregnancy in a female." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pregnancy relieves symptoms

fields.label: Ameliorated by heat
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by heat (including fever)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Fever improves condition; Heat improves condition; Heat improves symptom

fields.label: Ameliorated by carbohydrate ingestion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by eating or drinking carbohydrates including glucose (sugar)." []

fields.label: Stiff neck
fields.definition: "A sensation of tightness in the neck when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity. Neck stiffness often involves soreness and difficulty moving the neck, especially when trying to turn the head to the side." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Neck stiffness; Stiff neck

fields.label: Stiff elbow
fields.definition: "A sensation of tightness in the elbow joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elbow stiffness; Stiff elbow

fields.label: Stiff wrist
fields.definition: "A sensation of tightness in the wrist joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Stiff wrist; Wrist stiffness

fields.label: Stiff finger
fields.definition: "A sensation of tightness in a finger joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Finger stiffness; Stiff finger

fields.label: Stiff hip
fields.definition: "A sensation of tightness in the hip joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hip stiffness; Stiff hip

fields.label: Stiff knee
fields.definition: "A sensation of tightness in the knee joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Knee stiffness; Stiff knee

fields.label: Stiff ankle
fields.definition: "A sensation of tightness in the ankle joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ankle stiffness; Stiff ankle

fields.label: Stiff toe
fields.definition: "A sensation of tightness in a toe joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Stiff toe; Toe stiffness

fields.label: Snoring
fields.definition: "Deep, noisy breathing during sleep, accompanied by hoarse or harsh sounds, is caused by the vibration of respiratory structures, especially the soft palate. This vibration results in sound due to obstructed air movement during breathing while sleeping." [PMID:35216759]
fields.synonyms_concat: Snore; Snores; Snoring symptoms

fields.label: Stuttering
fields.definition: "Disruptions in the production of speech sounds, with involuntary repetitions of words or parts of words, prolongations of speech sounds, or complete blockage of speech production for several seconds." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Stammering; Stuttering

fields.label: Panic attack
fields.definition: "A sudden episode of intense fear in a situation where there is no danger or apparent cause." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Panic attack

fields.label: Abnormal esophagus physiology
fields.definition: "Any physiological abnormality of the esophagus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of esophagus physiology; Abnormality of oesophagus physiology; Functional abnormality of the esophagus; Functional abnormality of the oesophagus

fields.label: Esophageal spasms
fields.definition: "Involuntary contractions of the esophagus that are irregular, uncoordinated, and painful." []

fields.label: Melasma
fields.definition: "Symmetrical, blotchy, brownish facial pigmentation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Chloasma; Facial melanosis

fields.label: Achilles tendonitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the Achilles tendon." []

fields.label: Ovarian dermoid cyst
fields.definition: "An cystic ovarian teratoma composed of dermal and epidermal elements and containing tissue components including hair, teeth, bone, thyroid, and others." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Mature cystic ovarian teratoma

fields.label: Lateral
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is located farther from the median plane or midline of the body or of the referenced structure." []

fields.label: Abnormality of skin adnexa physiology
fields.definition: "Any functional anomaly of the skin adnexa (skin appendages), which are specialized skin structures located within the dermis and focally within the subcutaneous fatty tissue, comprising three histologically distinct structures: (1) the pilosebaceous unit (hair follicle and sebaceous glands); (2) the eccrine sweat glands; and (3) the apocrine glands." []

fields.label: Gustatory sweating
fields.definition: "Hyperhidrosis that occurs with gustatory stimulation (e.g., moisture on face from sweating that occurs after eating)." [PMID:22798976]

fields.label: Cold-induced sweating
fields.definition: "Sweating provoked by cold temperature rather than by heat." []

fields.label: Pain characteristic
fields.definition: "A pain characteristic is defined as a subjective category or type of pain." []

fields.label: Sharp
fields.definition: "Applied to pain that is described as sharp, i.e., sudden and severe." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Stabbing pain

fields.label: Dull
fields.definition: "Applied to pain that is dull, i.e., not severe but that continues over a long period of time." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Dull pain

fields.label: Tender
fields.definition: "Applied to pain that is tender, i.e., elicited by touching the affected body part." []

fields.label: Sleep-interrupting
fields.definition: "Applied to pain that wakes the affecting individual from sleep." []

fields.label: Aggravated by
fields.definition: "An aggravating factor is defined as an external factor that leads to a sign or symptom that is already present getting worse or becoming more severe." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Exacerbated by

fields.label: Aggravated by activity
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by activity, exertion, or exercise." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Aggravated by exercise; Aggravated by exertion; Worse with activity; Worsened by activity

fields.label: Axial
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the central part of the body, in the head and trunk as distinguished from the limbs." []

fields.label: Excessive sleep
fields.definition: "A clinical phenomenon characterized by sleeping longer than what is typical or necessary for a person's age and context, or by recurrent episodes of sleep that intrude upon the waking hours. Excessive sleep is identified through self-reports or observations and may involve prolonged nighttime sleep, frequent daytime naps, or episodes of unintentional sleep." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Prolonged sleep duration; Sleeping too much

fields.label: Cervical lymphadenopathy
fields.definition: "Enlarged lymph nodes in the neck." []
synonyms: Swollen lymph nodes in the neck
fields.synonyms_concat: Swollen lymph nodes in the neck

fields.label: Upper-body predominance
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that affects the arms, trunk, head more than the legs." []

fields.label: Lower-body predominance
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that affects the legs more than the arms, trunk, head." []

fields.label: Acral
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that affects the distal portions of limbs (hand, foot) and head (ears, nose)." []

fields.label: Distributed along Blaschko lines
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose localization corresponds to the lines of Blaschko, which correspond to the lineage of epithelia cells. Blaschko lines are normally invisible but may become apparent with certain skin diseases and then can be seen to be distributed in lines horizontal to the body." [PMID:17061271]

fields.label: Dermatomal
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose localization corresponds to the dermatomes, i.e., the nerve root distribution." [PMID:19772560]
fields.synonyms_concat: Radicular

fields.label: Herpetiform
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles that of the grouped umbilicated vesicles seen in herpes simplex and herpes zoster infections." []

fields.label: Morbilliform
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles that of measles, i.e., maculopapular lesions that are red and roughly 2 to 10 mm in diameter and may be partially confluent." []

fields.label: Prolonged
fields.definition: "Applied to an abnormality whose duration is extended over a longer period of time than is expected or usual (e.g., prolonged fever lasts longer than one usually sees with an infection)." []

fields.label: Extended nighttime sleep
fields.definition: "Sleeping for a longer duration than usual during the night." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Long nighttime sleep; Prolonged nocturnal sleep

fields.label: Frequent napping
fields.definition: "Regular episodes of sleep that occur during the day outside of the main sleep period." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Frequent daytime naps

fields.label: Malar rash
fields.definition: "An erythematous (red), flat facial rash that affects the skin in the malar area (over the cheekbones) and extends over the bridge of the nose." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Butterfly rash; Cheekbone rash

fields.label: Nocturnal
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that occurs in or is exacerbated during the night." []

fields.label: Diurnal
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign, symptom, or other abnormality that occurs in or is exacerbated in the day time." []

fields.label: Episodic
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign, symptom, or other manifestation that occurs multiple times at usually irregular intervals. The occurrences are separated by an interval in which the sign, symptom, or manifestation is not present." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Now and then

fields.label: Periodic
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign, symptom, or other manifestation that recurs with a fixed time interval, i.e., the symptom-free periods are always of the same length." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cyclic; Cyclical

fields.label: Quotidian
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign, symptom, or other manifestation that is episodic with a fixed time interval of one day (24 hours)." []

fields.label: Acute emergence over minutes
fields.definition: "Acute appearance of disease manifestations in a period of minutes." []

fields.label: Acute emergence over hours
fields.definition: "Acute appearance of disease manifestations in a period of hours." []

fields.label: Acute emergence over days
fields.definition: "Acute appearance of disease manifestations in a period of days." []

fields.label: Abnormal pupil shape
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal circular shape of the pupil" []
fields.synonyms_concat: Irregular pupil

fields.label: Oval pupil
fields.definition: "An abnormal pupil shape that is elliptical, i.e., egg-like." []

fields.label: Anterior chamber cyst
fields.definition: "A closed sac, having a distinct membrane and division compared to the nearby tissue located within the anterior chamber. The sac that may contain air, fluids, or semi-solid material." []

fields.label: Esophoria
fields.definition: "A form of strabismus with both eyes turned inward to a relatively mild degree, usually defined as less than 10 prism diopters." []

fields.label: Exophoria
fields.definition: "A form of strabismus with one or both eyes deviated outward to a milder degree than with exotropia." []

fields.label: Choroidal nevus
fields.definition: "A benign, flat or slightly elevated melanocytic lesions of the posterior uvea with clearly defined margins. Choroidal nevi tend to remain stable in size, and to display features such as overlying drusen as well as retinal pigment epithelial atrophy, hyperplasia or fibrous metaplasia." []

fields.label: Exacerbated by head trauma
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is worsened, aggravated, or exacerbated by head trauma." []

fields.label: Cubitus varus
fields.definition: "A deformity of the elbow in which there is a deviation of the forearm toward the midline of the body." []

fields.label: Ovarian carcinoma
fields.definition: "A malignant neoplasm originating from the surface ovarian epithelium." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ovarian epithelial cancer

fields.label: Leakage of dye on fundus fluorescein angiography
fields.definition: "Leakage of fluorescein dye observed upon retinal fluorescein angiography. Areas of leakage can be appreciated as showing gradual enlargement with blurring of margins." []
fields.label_normalized: leakage of dye on fundus fluorescein angiography
fields.synonyms_concat: Fluorescein leakage

fields.label: Copper accumulation in liver
fields.definition: "An anomalous build up of copper (Cu) in the liver." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Liver copper accumulation

fields.label: Venous occlusion
fields.definition: "Blockage of venous return (flow of blood from the periphery back towards the right atrium) in a vein." []

fields.label: Abnormal arterial physiology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of arterial function." []

fields.label: Arterial occlusion
fields.definition: "Blockage of blood flow through an artery." []

fields.label: Sparse medial eyebrow
fields.definition: "Decreased density/number and/or decreased diameter of medial eyebrow hairs." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Medial thinning of eyebrow

fields.label: Retinal arterial occlusion
fields.definition: "Blockage of the retinal artery, generally associated with interruption of blood flow and oxygen delivery to the retina." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Retinal artery occlusion

fields.label: Decreased renal parenchymal thickness
fields.definition: "Reduced dimension of the solid part of the kidney (parenchyma, the renal cortex and medulla) as measured from the collecting system (renal calyces and pelvis) to the border of the kidney. This measurement can be performed by measuring the thickness of the parenchyma in computed tomography scans." [PMID:19254392, PMID:2117353]

fields.label: Antepartum hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Significant maternal hemorrhage/bleed in the second half of pregnancy and prior to the birth of the baby." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Antepartum haemorrhage; Prepartum haemorrhage; Prepartum hemorrhage

fields.label: Anti-glutamic acid decarboxylase antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against glutamic acid decarboxylase." [PMID:27356651]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-GAD antibody positivity

fields.label: Downgaze palsy
fields.definition: "A limitation of the ability to direct one's gaze below the horizontal meridian." [PMID:8913186]
fields.synonyms_concat: Downgaze paresis; Supranuclear downgaze palsy

fields.label: Upgaze palsy
fields.definition: "A limitation of the ability to direct one's gaze above the horizontal meridian." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Supranuclear upgaze palsy; Upgaze paresis

fields.label: Abnormality of foot cortical bone
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the outer shell (cortex) of a foot bone." []
synonyms: Abnormality of the cortex of foot bones
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the cortex of foot bones

fields.label: Cortical thinning of foot bones
fields.definition: "A reduction in the thickness of the outer shell (cortex) of foot bones." [PMID:24055421]

fields.label: Triggered by emotion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a strong spontaneously arising mental state, reaction or feeling (emotion)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Emotion triggered symptoms

fields.label: Delayed ability to stand
fields.definition: "A failure to achieve the ability to stand up at an appropriate developmental stage. Most children begin to walk alone at 11 to 15 months of age. On average, children can stand while holding on at the age of 9 to 10 months, can pull up to stand and walk with one hand being held at 12 months, and can stand alone and walk well at 18 months." [PMID:23321410, PMID:27354457]

fields.label: Delayed ability to sit
fields.definition: "A failure to achieve the ability to sit at an appropriate developmental stage. Most children sit with support at 6 months of age and sit steadily without support at 9 months of age." [PMID:23321410, PMID:27354457]

fields.label: Red eye
fields.definition: "A reddish appearance over the white part (sclera) of the eye ranging from a few enlarged blood vessels appearing as wiggly lines over the sclera to a bright red color completely covering to sclera." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Red eye; Red eyes

fields.label: Circumlimbal hyperemia
fields.definition: "A ring of redness at the limbus of the eye, the border between the cornea and the sclera." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ciliary limbus; Circumlimbal hyperaemia

fields.label: Superficial episcleral hyperemia
fields.definition: "Prominence of blood vessels of the superficial episcleral tissues." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Superficial episcleral hypaeremia

fields.label: Deep episcleral hyperemia
fields.definition: "Prominence of blood vessels of the deep episcleral tissues." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Deep episcleral hyperaemia

fields.label: Corneal keratic precipitates
fields.definition: "An inflammatory cellular deposit deposited on the corneal endothelium and visible as spots on the cornea." []

fields.label: Central retinal artery occlusion
fields.definition: "Blockage of the main artery in the retina. In the acute phase, the fundus may show cherry red spot and stasis of retinal flow. The typical presentation is one of profound monocular visual loss." [PMID:23470793]

fields.label: Lupus anticoagulant
fields.definition: "Presence of lupus anticoagulant (LA) autoantibodies. LA represent a heterogeneous group of autoantibodies, IgG, IgM, or a mixture of both classes, that interfere with standard phospholipid-based coagulant tests (this is only an in vitro phenomenon, LA do not cause reduction of coagulation in vivo). The antibodies are directed against plasma proteins which also bind to phospholipid surfaces." [PMID:27331311]

fields.label: Interlobular bile duct destruction
fields.definition: "Damage to and obliteration of intrahepatic bile ducts (bile ducts that transport bile between the Canals of Hering and the interlobar bile ducts)." [PMID:16177252]

fields.label: Abnormality of circulating beta-2-microglobulin level
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of beta-2-microglobulin in the blood." [PMID:16166103]
synonyms: Abnormality of circulating beta2 microglobulin level
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of circulating B2M level; Abnormality of circulating beta2 microglobulin level; Abnormality of circulating beta2-m level; Abnormality of circulating beta2m level

fields.label: Increased circulating beta-2-microglobulin level
fields.definition: "Elevated concentration of beta-2-microglobulin in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating beta-2-microglobulin level

fields.label: Decreased circulating beta-2-microglobulin level
fields.definition: "Reduced concentration of beta-2-microglobulin in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced circulating beta-2-microglobulin level

fields.label: Abnormal corneal limbus morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the margin of the cornea overlapped by the sclera." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the corneal limbus

fields.label: Limbal edema
fields.definition: "Swelling of the margin of the cornea overlapped by the sclera." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Limbal oedema

fields.label: Giant conjunctival papillae
fields.definition: "Conjunctival papillae with a diameter greater than 1 millimeter. They characteristically have flattened tops which sometimes demonstrate staining with fluorescein." [PMID:26278858]

fields.label: Recurrent interdigital mycosis
fields.definition: "A history of repeated fungal infections located between the fingers or toes, usually manifested by scaling, maceration, and itching. The toes are more commonly affected than the fingers." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Recurrent interdigital tinea

fields.label: Typically de novo
fields.definition: "Description of conditions that are exclusively or predominantly observed to display de novo variants. In some cases, this may be due to the limited reproductive fitness of affected individuals." [PMID:22805709]
synonyms: Autosomal dominant germline de novo mutation
fields.synonyms_concat: Autosomal dominant germline de novo mutation

fields.label: Anti-multiple nuclear dots antibody positivity
fields.definition: "A type of antinuclear antibody (ANA) positivity revealed by indirect immunofluorescence (IFL). The multiple nuclear dots (MND) pattern is immunomorphologically characterized by the staining of 3-20 dots of variable size distributed all over the cell nucleus, but sparing the nucleoli, and, in contrast to the anticentromere pattern, MND reactivity does not stain the chromosomes in mitotic cells." [PMID:11882049, PMID:12848948]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-MND antibodies

fields.label: Abnormal cellular phenotype
fields.definition: "An anomaly of cellular morphology or physiology." []

fields.label: Retinal arteriolar macroaneurysms
fields.definition: "Acquired focal dilatations of branches of the retinal artery, usually second-order retinal arterioles, that range in size from 100 to 200 micrometers in diameter. Macroaneurysms are generally located at the temporal retina and may be hemorrhagic or exudative." []

fields.label: Erratic myoclonus
fields.definition: "A type of myoclonus in which the myoclonias shift from body region to another in a random and asynchronous fashion. Erratic myoclonus can affect the face or limbs, are brief, single or repetitive, very frequent and nearly continuous." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Fragmentary myoclonus

fields.label: Uveal ectropion
fields.definition: "Presence of iris pigment epithelium on the anterior surface of the iris." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ectropion uveae

fields.label: Polygonal renal calices
fields.definition: "An abnormal polygonal shape of the calices of the kidney (which normally have a rounded or cup-shaped appearance)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Polygonal calices; Polygonal-shaped calices

fields.label: Polycalycosis
fields.definition: "Increased number of calices of the kidney." [PMID:19002724]

fields.label: Abnormal medullary pyramid morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the pyramid of the adult kidney, cone-shaped structures with a broad base adjacent to the renal cortex and the narrow apex that is termed papilla." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of medullary pyramid morphology

fields.label: Renal medullary pyramid hypoplasia
fields.definition: "Undergrowth of the pyramid of the adult kidney, cone-shaped structures with a broad base adjacent to the renal cortex and the narrow apex that is termed papilla." [PMID:16293636]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplasia of the medullary pyramids

fields.label: Glomerular endocapillary hypercellularity
fields.definition: "Hypercellularity due to increased number of cells within glomerular capillary lumina, causing narrowing of the lumina." [PMID:19571790, PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Endocapillary hypercellularity

fields.label: Glomerular extracapillary hypercellularity
fields.definition: "Hypercellularity (increased number of cells) in the renal glomerulus but external to the glomerular capillaries, i.e., in the Bowman space or more than one layer of parietal or visceral epithelial cells." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Extracapillary glomerular hypercellularity; Extracapillary hypercellularity

fields.label: Free-running sleep pattern
fields.definition: "A condition in which the intrinsic circadian rhythm is no longer entrained to the 24-h schedule. Normal individuals who are exposed to an environment devoid of zeitgebers develop free-running rhythms with a period longer than 24 h." [PMID:21344043]
fields.synonyms_concat: Non-24 sleep pattern

fields.label: Trichoepithelioma
fields.definition: "A benign hair follicle tumor whose tumor cells form rudimentary hair follicles but not actual hair shafts. A trichoepithelioma is usually less than one centimeter, firm, round, and shihy with yellow, pink, brown, or bluish color. They may occur multiply, usually on the face, and may gradually increase in number with age." []

fields.label: Abnormal growth plate morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the growth plates (epiphyseal plates), areas of cartilage located near the ends of long bones that are located between the metaphysis (widened part of the shaft of the bone) and the epiphysis (end of the bone) and in which growth occurs in the developing bone. After conclusion of bone growth, the growth plates ossify (harden into solid bone)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of growth plate morphology

fields.label: Thick growth plates
fields.definition: "Increased thickness (dimension along the axis of the bone) of the growth plate." []

fields.label: Abnormal ossification of the sacrum
fields.definition: "Abnormal bone tissue formation (ossification) affecting the sacrum." []

fields.label: Delayed ossification of the sacrum
fields.definition: "Formation of the sacrum bone tissue occurs later than age-adjusted norms." []

fields.label: Loud snoring
fields.definition: "Snoring at a particularly loud or abnormally high volume." [PMID:36592569]
fields.synonyms_concat: Has loud snoring; Have loud snoring; Heavy snoring; Snores loudly

fields.label: Interictal EEG abnormality
fields.definition: "Interictal refers to a period of time between epileptic seizures. Electroencephalographic (EEG) patterns are important in the differential diagnosis of epilepsy, and the EEG is almost always abnormal during a seizure. Some persons with seizures may show EEG abnormalities between seizures, while others do not. In some cases, multiple interictal EEGs must be recorded before an abnormality is observed. In most cases the electrographic pattern of seizure onset is completely different from the activity recorded during interictal discharge." [PMID:15961864, PMID:25012363]

fields.label: Duplicated odontoid process
fields.definition: "The presence of two distinct odontoid processes. The odontoid process, also known as the dens of the axis, is a protuberance of the C2 vertebral body around which the first vertebra rotates." []

fields.label: Orthotopic os odontoideum
fields.definition: "Os odontoideum is classified into two anatomic types (orthotopic and dystopic). Os odontoideum is defined as an ossicle that consists of smooth and separate caudal portions of the odontoid process.With dystopic os odontoideum, the ossicle is located near the basion or is fused with the clivus." []

fields.label: Hyperglutaminuria
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of glutamine in the urine." [PMID:11283793]
fields.synonyms_concat: Glutamine high in urine; Glutaminuria

fields.label: Triggered by exertion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exertion or physical exercise." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Exertion triggered symptoms; Triggered by physical exercise

fields.label: Anti-thyroid peroxidase antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against thyroid peroxidase." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:33144894, PMID:33796145]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-TPO antibody positivity; Antimicrosomal antibodies; Antimicrosomal antibody positivity; TPOAbs

fields.label: Increased circulating androstenedione concentration
