fields.definition: "Increased concentration of androstenedione in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased serum androstenedione

fields.label: Anti-pituitary antibody positivity
fields.definition: "Circulating antipituitary antibodies (APA) are markers of autoimmune hypophysitis, which may cause deficient pituitary function." [PMID:17341554]

fields.label: Hypodipsia
fields.definition: "Reduced fluid intake (drinking) in a clinical situation where the plasma molarity or sodium concentration normally would induce greater fluid intake." [PMID:25949488]

fields.label: Dorsocervical fat pad
fields.definition: "An area of fat accumulation at the back of the neck in the form of a hump." [PMID:22301856]
fields.synonyms_concat: Buffalo hump

fields.label: Diet-resistant subcutaneous adipose tissue
fields.definition: "Areas of subcutanous fat tissue that are resistant to (do not respond as expected to) diet, life-style alteration, or bariatric surgery." [PMID:22301856]

fields.label: Diet-resistant subcutaneous adipose tissue below waist
fields.definition: "Areas of subcutanous fat tissue below the waist that are resistant to (do not respond as expected to) diet, life-style alteration, or bariatric surgery." []
fields.label_normalized: diet-resistant subcutaneous adipose tissue below waist

fields.label: Bitemporal hollowing
fields.definition: "Depression of profile in both temporal regions." []

fields.label: Pill-rolling tremor
fields.definition: "A type of resting tremor characterized by simultaneous rubbing movements of thumb and index fingers against each other." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pill rolling

fields.label: Thyroid nodule
fields.definition: "A nodular lesion that develops in the thyroid gland. The term \"thyroid nodule\" refers to any abnormal growth that forms a lump in the thyroid gland." []

fields.label: Pulmonary interstitial high-resolution computed tomography abnormality
fields.definition: "High-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) can distinguish findings that characterize characterize interstitial lung diseases in a way not possible with other modalities." [PMID:23247773]
fields.label_normalized: pulmonary interstitial high-resolution computed tomography abnormality
fields.synonyms_concat: Pulmonary interstitiatial HRCT abnormality

fields.label: Reticular pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "On pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography, reticular pattern is characterized by innumerable interlacing shadows suggesting a mesh." [PMID:23247773]

fields.label: Crazy paving pattern
fields.definition: "The so-called crazy paving pattern appears as thickened interlobular septa and intralobular lines superimposed on a background of ground-glass opacity, resembling irregularly shaped paving stones. The crazy-paving pattern is often sharply demarcated from more normal lung and may have a geographic outline. It was originally reported in patients with alveolar proteinosis and is also encountered in other diffuse lung diseases that affect both the interstitial and airspace compartments, such as lipoid pneumonia." [PMID:18195376, PMID:23247773]
synonyms: Crazy paving pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.synonyms_concat: Crazy paving pattern on pulmonary HRCT; Crazy-paving pattern

fields.label: Nodular pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "A nodular pattern is characterized on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography by the presence of numerous rounded opacities that range from 2 mm to 1 cm in diameter, with micronodules defined as smaller than 3 mm in diameter." [PMID:23247773]

fields.label: Reticulonodular pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "Co-occurrence of reticular and micronodular patterns on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography." [PMID:23247773]

fields.label: Cystic pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "On pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography, the cystic pattern is composed by well-defined, round and circumscribed air-containing parenchymal spaces with a well-defined wall and interface with normal lung. The wall of the cysts may be uniform or varied in thickness, but usually is thin (less than 2 mm) and occurs without associated emphysema." [PMID:23247773]

fields.label: Combined cystic and ground-glass pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "Co-occurrence of the cystic pattern and the ground-glass pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography," [PMID:23247773]
fields.label_normalized: combined cystic and ground-glass pattern on pulmonary hrct

fields.label: Decreased attenuation pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "Areas of low density corresponding to parenchymal destruction and reduced perfusion, and attenuation of the pulmonary vasculature, as visualized on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography." [PMID:23247773]
synonyms: Black lung pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.label_normalized: decreased attenuation pattern on pulmonary hrct
fields.synonyms_concat: Black lung pattern on pulmonary HRCT

fields.label: Mosaic attenuation pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "A patchwork of intermingled areas of increased and decreased attenuation visualized on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography." [PMID:23247773]
fields.label_normalized: mosaic attenuation pattern on pulmonary hrct

fields.label: Nodular-perilymphatic pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography that has a perilymphatic distribution." [PMID:23247773]

fields.label: Nodular-centrilobular with tree-in-bud pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography that displays a tree-in-bud pattern, representing centrilobular branching structures that resemble a budding tree." [PMID:23247773]
fields.label_normalized: nodular-centrilobular with tree-in-bud pattern on pulmonary hrct

fields.label: Nodular-random pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography that has an apparently random pattern." [PMID:23247773]

fields.label: Staring gaze
fields.definition: "An abnormality in which the eyes are held permanently wide open." [PMID:22675666]
fields.synonyms_concat: Episodes of staring; Staring episodes; Staring eyes

fields.label: Square-wave jerks
fields.definition: "Square wave jerks are saccadic eye movements which, when recorded with open eyes are considered to be a pathological sign, caused by fixation instability, and pointing to a central neurological lesion." [PMID:6443573]

fields.label: Stooped posture
fields.definition: "A habitual positioning of the body with the head and upper back bent forward." []

fields.label: Abnormal visual fixation
fields.definition: "Any anomaly in the process of ocular fixation, which is the maintaining of the visual gaze on a single location." []

fields.label: Visual fixation instability
fields.definition: "A deficit in the ability to fixate eye movements in order to stabilize images on the retina" [PMID:28242738]
fields.synonyms_concat: Instability of ocular fixation

fields.label: Asthenia
fields.definition: "A state characterized by a feeling of weakness and loss of strength leading to a generalized weakness of the body." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Lack of energy and strength; Prostration; Weakness

fields.label: Rectourethral fistula
fields.definition: "An abnormal connection (fistula) between the rectum and the urethra." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Urethrorectal fistula

fields.label: Abnormal spleen morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the structure of the spleen." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Splenic lesion

fields.label: Abnormal spleen physiology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the function of the spleen." []

fields.label: Splenogonadal fusion
fields.definition: "Joining of the spleen and a gonad during embryological development." [PMID:24137272]

fields.label: Fossa navicularis urethral stricture
fields.definition: "A type of urethral stricture affecting the fossa navicularis, which is the spongy part of the male urethra located at the glans penis." [PMID:22022062]

fields.label: Pendulous urethral stricture
fields.definition: "A type of urethral stricture affecting the pendulous urethra, which is straight and fixed to the corpora cavernosa." [PMID:22022062]

fields.label: Bulbar urethral stricture
fields.definition: "A type of urethral stricture affecting the bulbar urethra, which is the part of the urethra that traverses the root of the penis." []

fields.label: Vaginal stricture
fields.definition: "A narrowing of the vagina owing to scar formation." []

fields.label: Patulous urethra
fields.definition: "Urethra more open or expanded than normal." []

fields.label: Renal cortical necrosis
fields.definition: "Patchy or diffuse ischemic destruction of all the elements of renal cortex resulting from significantly diminished renal arterial perfusion. Coagulative necrosis may be present, involving all tubular segments and glomeruli. Nuclei may be pale and pyknotic, or may no longer be apparent. Thrombi may be present in vessels at the edge of the infarct." [PMID:26558184, PMID:27091021]
fields.synonyms_concat: Necrosis of the kidney cortex

fields.label: Pulmonary pneumatocele
fields.definition: "A pneumatocele is a thin walled, gas-filled space in the lung. It is most frequently caused by acute pneumonia, trauma, or aspiration of hydrocarbon fluid and is usually transient. The mechanism is believed to be a combination of parenchymal necrosis and check-valve airway obstruction. A pneumatocele appears as an approximately round, thin-walled airspace in the lung." [PMID:18195376]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pulmonary pneumatocoele

fields.label: Diffuse alveolar hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of of pulmonary hemorrhage that originates from the pulmonary microcirculation, including the alveolar capillaries, arterioles, and venules. It presents with hemoptysis, anemia, diffuse lung infiltration, and acute respiratory failure. The diagnosis is confirmed by the observation of the accumulation of red blood cells, fibrin, or hemosiderin-laden macrophage in the alveolar space on pathologic biopsy. Hemosiderin, a product of hemoglobin degradation, appears at least 48-72 hours after bleeding and is helpful in distinguishing diffuse alveolar hemorrhage from surgical trauma. Mild interstitial thickening, organizing pneumonia, or diffuse alveolar damage can also be seen." [PMID:23678356]
fields.synonyms_concat: Diffuse alveolar haemorrhage

fields.label: Pneumomediastinum
fields.definition: "The presence of free air in the mediastinum." [PMID:28217437]

fields.label: Pleural cyst
fields.definition: "A closed sac-like structure originating from the pleura that contains a liquid, gaseous, or semisolid substance." [PMID:12162234, PMID:18493546]

fields.label: Abnormal larynx morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the structure of the larynx." []

fields.label: Abnormal larynx physiology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the function of the larynx." []

fields.label: Laryngospasm
fields.definition: "A spasm (involuntary contraction) of the vocal cords that can make it difficult to speak or breathe." []

fields.label: Abnormal bronchus morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the bronchi, i.e., of the airways leading from the trachea to the lungs." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the bronchi

fields.label: Abnormal bronchus physiology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the function of the bronchi." []

fields.label: Abnormal cry
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the vocalizing of an infant's crying, i.e.,the typically loud voice production that is accompanied by tears and agitation." []

fields.label: High-pitched cry
fields.definition: "A type of crying in an abnormally high-pitched voice." []

fields.label: Staccato cry
fields.definition: "A type of cry that is abnormal because it is consists of unusually shortened and detached vocalizations." []

fields.label: Acanthoma
fields.definition: "A benign epithelial skin tumor manifesting as a slightly elevated circular plaque or nodule with a red, pink or brown color and a diameter up to 22 mm." []

fields.label: Decreased lecithin cholesterol acyl transferase level
fields.definition: "Reduced level of the enzyme lecithin cholesterol acyl transferase." [PMID:25172171]
fields.label_normalized: decreased lecithin cholesterol acyl transferase level

fields.label: Reduced circulating CH50 activity
fields.definition: "A diminished activity of the classical complement pathway as measured by the assay for 50% haemolytic complement (CH50) activity of serum." [PMID:20351687]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased total hemolytic complement activity; Reduced CH50; Reduced circulating 50% hemolytic complement (CH50) activity; Reduced hemolytic complement activity

fields.label: Increased circulating lactate dehydrogenase concentration
fields.definition: "An elevated level of the enzyme lactate dehydrogenase in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating LDH concentration; Increased lactate dehydrogenase level

fields.label: Elevated serum 11-deoxycortisol
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of 11-deoxycortisol in the circulation. 11-deoxycorticosterone, which is also known as simply deoxycorticosterone and 21-hydroxyprogesterone, is a steroid hormore that is produces in the adrenals and is a precursor to aldosterone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated serum 21-hydroxyprogesterone; Elevated serum deoxycorticosterone

fields.label: Macrozoospermia
fields.definition: "Increased size of the head of sperm." [PMID:16500351]
fields.synonyms_concat: Macrocephalic sperm head

fields.label: Pharyngitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation (due to infection or irritation) of the pharynx." []

fields.label: Warm reactive autoantibody positivity
fields.definition: "Warm reactive autoantibodies are RBC-directed immune responses that are maximally reactive at 37 degrees C." [PMID:15491963]

fields.label: Achilles tendon calcification
fields.definition: "Ectopic deposition of calcium salts in the Achilles tendon." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Calcification of the Achilles tendon

fields.label: Abnormal cardiac atrial physiology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the function of the cardiac atria." []

fields.label: Reduced amygdala volume
fields.definition: "A decrease in the volume (size) of the amygdyla." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decrease in amygdala volume

fields.label: Abnormal papillary muscle morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the papillary muscles of the left ventricle." [PMID:9034636]
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the papillary muscles
fields.synonyms_concat: Morphological abnormality of the papillary muscles

fields.label: Anomalous insertion of papillary muscle directly into anterior mitral leaflet
fields.definition: "A congenital malformation in which one or both of the papillary muscles (posteromedial or anterolateral) insert directly (that is, without interpositioned chordae tendineae) into the anterior mitral leaflet." [PMID:1884449]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous insertion of papillary muscle directly into anterior mitral leaflet

fields.label: Displacement of the papillary muscles
fields.definition: "Abnormal location of the insertion of a papillary muscle into the left ventricular wall." []

fields.label: Anterior displacement of the papillary muscles
fields.definition: "Abnormally anterior location of the papillary muscles of the left ventricle." [PMID:7850958]
fields.label_normalized: anterior displacement of the papillary muscles
fields.synonyms_concat: Anteriorly displaced papillary muscles

fields.label: Apically displaced anterolateral papillary muscle
fields.definition: "Abnormal location of the insertion of the anterolateral papillary muscle near to the apex of the left ventricle. This feature may be appreciated by noting that this muscle is usually not seen in the apical level of the parasternal short-axis echocardiographic view," []
fields.synonyms_concat: Apically displaced papillary muscles

fields.label: Testicular adrenal rest tumor
fields.definition: "Testicular adrenal rest tumor (TART) is a abenign tumor of the testis. TART generally occurs multiply and bilaterally within the rete testis. Histologically, TART resemble adrenocortical tissue, which led to the name. The tumous are not encapsulated and consist of sheets or confluent cords of large polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm." [PMID:19956703]
fields.synonyms_concat: Testicular adrenal rest tumour

fields.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
fields.definition: "A deep skin ulcer with a well defined border, which is usually violet or blue. The ulcer edge is often undermined (worn and damaged) and the surrounding skin is erythematous and indurated. The ulcer often starts as a small papule or collection of papules, which break down to form small ulcers with a so called cat's paw appearance. These coalesce and the central area then undergoes necrosis to form a single ulcer." [PMID:16858047]

fields.label: Delayed adrenarche
fields.definition: "Occurrence of adrenarche at a later than normal age. Adrenarche normally occurs between six and eight years of age with increased adrenal androgen secretion; its exact biologic role is not well understood. It is accompanied by changes in pilosebaceous units, a transient growth spurt and the appearance of axillary and pubic hair in some children, but no sexual development." [PMID:10414639]

fields.label: Abnormal CSF metabolite concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of concentration of a metabolite in the cerebrospinal fluid." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal cerebrospinal fluid metabolite concentration; Abnormal CSF metabolite level

fields.label: Decreased CSF 5-hydroxyindolacetic acid concentration
fields.definition: "5-HIAA (5-hydroxyindolacetic acid) concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159, PMID:27388694]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased CSF 5-HIAA; Low CSF 5-HIAA; Low CSF 5-hydroxyindolacetic acid

fields.label: Abnormal CSF protein concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of a protein concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal CSF protein level

fields.label: Decreased CSF protein concentration
fields.definition: "CSF total protein level is below the lower limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159, PMID:27388694]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased cerebrospinal fluid total protein; Decreased CSF protein; Hypoproteinorrhachia; Low CSF total protein

fields.label: Decreased CSF albumin concentration
fields.definition: "CSF albumin level is below the lower limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159, PMID:27388694]
fields.synonyms_concat: Low CSF albumin

fields.label: Increased CSF/serum albumin ratio
fields.definition: "An increase above normal limits of the ratio of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) albumin concentration to serum albumin concentration." []

fields.label: High myoinositol in brain by MRS
fields.definition: "An elevated level of myoinositol in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159, PMID:20951217]
synonyms: High myo-inositol in brain by MRS
fields.label_normalized: high myoinositol in brain by mrs
fields.synonyms_concat: High myo-inositol in brain by MRS

fields.label: Abnormal cell morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of cell structure." []

fields.label: Abnormality of redox activity
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the processes that maintain the redox environment of a cell or compartment within a cell, that is, the balance between reduction and oxidation chemical reactions." []

fields.label: Increased reactive oxygen species production
fields.definition: "An accumulation of free radical groups in the body inadequately neutralized by antioxidants, which creates a potentially unstable and damaging cellular environment linked to tissue damage." [PMID:26950655]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased ROS production; Oxidative stress

fields.label: Abnormal circulating beta globulin concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of beta globulin in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Beta 2-microglobulinuria
fields.definition: "Increased level of beta 2-microglobulins in the urine." []

fields.label: Anagen effluvium
fields.definition: "An abnormal loss of anagen (growth phase) hairs." [PMID:28332382]

fields.label: Telogen effluvium
fields.definition: "A type of hair loss characterized by an abnormal increase in dormant, telogen stage hair follicles." []

fields.label: Congenital panfollicular nevus
fields.definition: "A hamartomatous proliferation containing malformed hair follicles in various stages of development. Panfolliculomas are well-circumscribed lesions demonstrating all stages of follicular differentiation." [PMID:26822169]

fields.label: Recurrent plantar mycosis
fields.definition: "A history of repeated fungal infections located on the sole of the foot, usually manifested by scaling, maceration, and itching." []

fields.label: Hyperpigmented papule
fields.definition: "A papule (circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid, varying in size from a pinhead to less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point) that exhibits increased pigmentation (is darker) compared to the surrounding skin." []

fields.label: Erythematous plaque
fields.definition: "A plaque (a solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter) with a red or reddish color often associated with inflammation or irritation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Violaceous plaque

fields.label: Erythematous macule
fields.definition: "A macule (flat, distinct, discolored area of skin less than 1 cm wide that does not involve any change in the thickness or texture of the skin) with a red or reddish color often associated with inflammation or irritation." []

fields.label: Testicular lipomatosis
fields.definition: "Multiple foci of adipocytes within the testicular interstitium, usually presenting as multiple bilateral ill-defined hyperechoic intratesticular lesions of different sizes but generally with maximum diameter of 4 mm." []

fields.label: Periarticular calcification
fields.definition: "Calcified deposits in soft tissue structures outside a joint." []

fields.label: Atrial standstill
fields.definition: "Atrial standstill or silent atrium is a rare condition presenting with the absence of electrical and mechanical activity in the atria. It presents with the absence of P waves, bradycardia, and wide QRS complex in the electrocardiogram." [PMID:23074623]
fields.synonyms_concat: Silent atrium

fields.label: Self-neglect
fields.definition: "A pathological neglect of personal needs and well-being that includes attending to self-grooming, personal care and the attention to cleanliness of personal space." []

fields.label: Lipomyelomeningocele
fields.definition: "A type of spinal dysraphism presenting as a subcutaneous fatty mass, that is, a spinal defect associated with lipomatous tissue, and covered by skin. The most usual location for lipomyelomeningocele is at the gluteal cleft." []

fields.label: Cervical hemivertebrae
fields.definition: "Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the cervical spine." []

fields.label: Positive perchlorate discharge test
fields.definition: "An abnormal result of the perchlorate discharge test. In this test, first radioactive iodine is administered, sufficient time is allowed to pass so that the radioactive iodine is captured by the thyroid,and then, perchlorate is administered orally. The perchlorate displaces non-organified iodide from the thyroid. The perchlorate discharge test is considered positive (abnormal) if there is an abnormally rapid loss of radioactive iodine from the thyroid." [PMID:25394566]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating thyroglobulin concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of thyroglobulin, a protein produced in the thyroid gland that acts as a precursor to thyrroid hormones." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal circulating thyroglobulin level

fields.label: Increased circulating thyroglobulin concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal elevation of the concentration of thyroglobulin, a protein produced in the thyroid gland that acts as a precursor to thyrroid hormones." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating thyroglobulin level

fields.label: Vaginal adenosis
fields.definition: "Vaginal adenosis is defined by the presence of metaplastic cervical or endometrial epithelium within the vaginal wall, thought to be derived from persistent Müllerian (synonymous with paramesonephric) epithelium islets in postembryonic life." [PMID:9764164]

fields.label: Fused labia majora
fields.definition: "The outer labia are sealed together." []

fields.label: Abnormal bladder morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the bladder." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of bladder morphology

fields.label: Detrusor sphincter dyssynergia
fields.definition: "A urodynamic anomaly characterized by bladder outlet obstruction from detrusor muscle contraction with concomitant involuntary urethral sphincter activation." [PMID:26904418]

fields.label: Bladder duplication
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of two bladders." [PMID:25657554]

fields.label: Myocardial bridging
fields.definition: "A congenital variant of a coronary artery in which a portion of an epicardial coronary artery (most frequently the middle segment of the left anterior descending artery) takes an intramuscular course." [PMID:25999138]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intramyocardial coronary artery course

fields.label: Venous stenosis
fields.definition: "Narrowing of a vein due to intimal hyperplasia and fibrosis." []

fields.label: Microcoria
fields.definition: "A small pupil (typically diameter less than 2 mm) that dilates poorly or not at all in response to topically administered mydriatic drugs." [PMID:25772937]

fields.label: Palmoplantar erythema
fields.definition: "Redness of the skin of the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin." []

fields.label: Coated aorta
fields.definition: "Regular circumferential periaortic fibrosis involving the whole aorta and leading to a coated aorta appearance on computed tomography scans" [PMID:25017251]

fields.label: Descending aorta hypoplasia
fields.definition: "Significant luminal narrowing of a long segment of the descending aorta." [PMID:12368748, PMID:24516866]

fields.label: Abnormal coronary artery physiology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the function of a coronary artery." []

fields.label: Coronary artery spasm
fields.definition: "A brief and sudden narrowing of a coronary artery." [PMID:19433770]
fields.synonyms_concat: Coronary artery vasospasm

fields.label: Aceruloplasminemia
fields.definition: "Absence of ceruloplasmin in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Aceruloplasminaemia

fields.label: Class I obesity
fields.definition: "Obesity with a body mass index of 30 to 34.9 kg per square meter." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Obesity grade 1

fields.label: Class II obesity
fields.definition: "Obesity with a body mass index of 35 to 39.9 kg per square meter." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Obesity grade 2

fields.label: Class III obesity
fields.definition: "Obesity with a body mass index of 40 kg per square meter or higher." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Obesity grade 3

fields.label: Overweight
fields.definition: "Increased body weight with a body mass index of 25-29.9 kg per square meter." []

fields.label: Anomalous coronary artery arising from the opposite sinus
fields.definition: "Origin of the right coronary artery (RCA) from the left sinus of Valsalva or of the left main (LM) or left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery from the right sinus of Valsalva." [PMID:27358682, PMID:28374180]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous coronary artery arising from the opposite sinus

fields.label: Anomalous origin of the circumflex artery from the right sinus of Valsalva
fields.definition: "The circumflex coronary artery originates from the right aortic sinus of Valsalva." [PMID:25104986]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous origin of the circumflex artery from the right sinus of valsalva

fields.label: Coronary artery sandwich anomaly
fields.definition: "Origin of the right coronary artery (RCA) from the left sinus of Valsalva or of the left main (LM) or left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery from the right sinus of Valsalva, with the additional feature that the artery passes between the two great arteries. This carries a risk of the artery being compressed by these two vessels," [PMID:24424336]
synonyms: Anomalous coronary artery with aortic origin and course between the great arteries
fields.synonyms_concat: Anomalous coronary artery with aortic origin and course between the great arteries

fields.label: Yellow papule
fields.definition: "A papule with yellow color." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Yellow-orange papule

fields.label: Gottron's papules
fields.definition: "Violaceous papules overlying the dorsal and lateral aspects of the metacarpophalangeal and proximal interphalangeal joints." [PMID:28058540]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gottron papules

fields.label: Piezogenic pedal papules
fields.definition: "Flesh-colored or yellowish papules, 2 mm or larger, that are responses to internal mechanical pressure and weakness in the connective tissue in the dermis, appear commonly over the medial aspect of the heel, but in some cases on the wrists. They are thought to represent herniations of adipose tissue through the plantar fascia retinaculum." []

fields.label: Nevus spilus
fields.definition: "A tan, regularly bordered patch with darker macules within the lesion." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Speckled lentiginous Nevus

fields.label: Nevus sebaceus
fields.definition: "A solitary yellow-orange slightly raised plaque typically on scalp or face. The plaque typically thickens and becomes more verrucous or pebbly during childhood." []

fields.label: Skin-colored papule
fields.definition: "A papule with the same color as the surrounding skin." [PMID:15686304]
fields.synonyms_concat: Flesh-colored papule

fields.label: Scleral rupture
fields.definition: "Breakage of the sclera." []

fields.label: Morning glory anomaly
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the optic nerve in which the optic nerve is large and funneled and displays a conical excavation of the optic disc. The optic disc appears dysplastic." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Morning glory disc anomaly; Morning glory disk anomaly; Morning glory optic disc

fields.label: Delayed thelarche
fields.definition: "Later than normal development of the breasts." []

fields.label: Coronary-pulmonary artery fistula
fields.definition: "A congenital malformation with abnormal connection between one of the coronary arteries and the pulmonary artery." [PMID:24605242]

fields.label: Hypoplastic hippocampus
fields.definition: "Underdevelopment of the hippocampus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Small hippocampus; Underdeveloped hippocampus

fields.label: Visual gaze preference
fields.definition: "An abnormality of gaze that can be observed following an acute supranuclear cerebral lesion (e.g., stroke) that is characterized by an acute inability to direct gaze contralateral to the side of the lesion and is accompanied by a tendency for tonic deviation of the eyes toward the side of the lesion." []

fields.label: Multiple biliary hamartomas
fields.definition: "Multiple biliary hamartomas are a rare clinicopathologic entity, consisting of small (less than 1.5cm), usually multiple and nodular cystic lesions in the liver." [PMID:22110302]
fields.synonyms_concat: Biliary hamartoma; Multiple bile duct hamartomas; Von Meyenburg complexes

fields.label: Calcinosis cutis
fields.definition: "Deposition of calcium in the skin." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cutaneous calcification

fields.label: Increased body fat percentage
fields.definition: "The percentage of fat as a part of total body weight above the norm, usually defined as 32% for females and 25% for males." []

fields.label: Elongated chordae tendinae of the mitral valve
fields.definition: "Abnormal increased in length of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve." []
fields.label_normalized: elongated chordae tendinae of the mitral valve

fields.label: Abnormal morphology of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve, whose main function is to transmit the contraction and relaxation of the papillary muscles during the cardiac cycle, thus ensuring the closing of the leaflets of the mitral valve." [PMID:23304176]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal morphology of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve

fields.label: Palmoplantar scaling skin
fields.definition: "Loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in large, scale-like flakes localized to the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot." [PMID:26990340]
fields.synonyms_concat: Palmoplantar psoriasis

fields.label: Scaling skin on fingertip
fields.definition: "Loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in large, scale-like flakes localized to one or more fingertips." []

fields.label: Psoriasiform lesion
fields.definition: "A skin lesions that resembles the lesions observed in psoriasis, viz., an erythematous plaque covered by fine silvery scales. Psoriasiform lesions can be observed in psoriasis as well as in other conditions including allergic contact dermatitis, seborrhoeic dermatitis, Atopic dermatitis, pityriasis rubra, and lichen simplex chronicus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Erythemato-squamous plaque; Erythematosquamous plaque; Psoriatic-like lesion

fields.label: Serpiginous cutaneous lesion
fields.definition: "A skin lesion with a snake- or serpent-like distribution." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Serpiginous eruption

fields.label: Annular cutaneous lesion
fields.definition: "A lesion of the skin with a ring-like distribution." []

fields.label: Hyperpigmented nodule
fields.definition: "A nodule of the skin that exhibits an increased amount of pigmentation." []

fields.label: Xanthomas of the palmar creases
fields.definition: "The presence of multiple xanthomas (xanthomata) in the skin distributed in the creases of the palm of the hand. Xanthomas are yellowish, firm, lipid-laden nodules in the skin." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Xanthoma palmare striatum; Xanthoma striatum palmare

fields.label: Harlequin phenomenon
fields.definition: "The Harlequin phenomenon consists of a sudden change in skin color, resulting in two different body colors, one on each half of the body." [PMID:21575077]

fields.label: Positive pathergy test
fields.definition: "With the pathergy test, a small, sterile needle is inserted into the skin of the forearm. The site of injectionis circuled and observed after one and two days. If a small red bump or pustule at the site of needle insertion occurs, the pathergy test is considered to have a positive (abnormal) result." []

fields.label: Ocular melanocytosis
fields.definition: "A congenital lesion of the sclera characterized by unilateral patchy but extensive slate-gray or bluish discoloration of the sclera . The conjunctiva are spared." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Melanosis oculi; Ocular melanosis

fields.label: Shawl sign
fields.definition: "Erythematous, poikilodermatous macules distributed in a shawl pattern over the shoulders, arms and upper back." [PMID:11730311]

fields.label: V-sign
fields.definition: "Erythematous, poikilodermatous macules distributed in a V-shaped distribution over the anterior neck and chest." [PMID:11730311]

fields.label: Plantar edema
fields.definition: "An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on sole of the foot." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Plantar oedema

fields.label: Palmar edema
fields.definition: "An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the palm of the hand." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Palmar oedema

fields.label: Abnormal B cell subset distribution
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of any B cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD19+ or CD20+ B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []

fields.label: Abnormal T cell subset distribution
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of any T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal alpha-beta T cell morphology

fields.label: Abnormal mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal range of the average amount of hemoglobin per red blood cell (27 to 31 picograms/cell). A reduced mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH) may indicate a hypochromic anemia, but the MCH may be normal if both the total hemoglobin and the red blood cell count are reduced." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal MCH; Abnormal MCHC; Abnormal mean corpuscular haemoglobin; Abnormal mean corpuscular haemoglobin concentration; Abnormal mean corpuscular Hb concentration

fields.label: Decreased mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction from the normal range of the average amount of hemoglobin per red blood cell (27 to 31 picograms/cell). A reduced mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH) may indicate a hypochromic anemia, but the MCH may be normal if both the total hemoglobin and the red blood cell count are reduced." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased MCH; Decreased MCHC; Decreased mean corpuscular haemoglobin; Decreased mean corpuscular haemoglobin concentration; Decreased mean corpuscular Hb concentration

fields.label: Increased mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration
fields.definition: "An elevation over the normal range of the average amount of hemoglobin per red blood cell (27 to 31 picograms/cell)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased MCH; Increased MCHC; Increased mean corpuscular haemoglobin; Increased mean corpuscular haemoglobin concentration; Increased mean corpuscular Hb concentration

fields.label: Eccentric visual fixation
fields.definition: "A uniocular condition in which there is fixation of an object by a point other than the fovea. This point adopts the principal visual direction. The degree of the eccentric fixation is defined by its distance from the fovea in degrees." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eccentric fixation

fields.label: Elevated circulating ribitol concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of ribitol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
synonyms: Increased level of ribitol in serum
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating ribitol concentration; Increased level of ribitol in serum

fields.label: Optic nerve misrouting
fields.definition: "Abnormal decussation of the visual pathways, typically identified using visual evoked potentials (VEP) (asymmetrical distribution of the VEP over the posterior scalp)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Optic pathway misrouting; Visual pathway misrouting

fields.label: Periorbital purpura
fields.definition: "Multiple red/purple spots on the skin that surrounds the eyes that do not blanch (whiten) upon pressure. Purpura is caused by subcutaneous bleeding." []

fields.label: Periorbital ecchymosis with tarsal plate sparing
fields.definition: "Subcutaneous bleeding with a diameter greater than 1 cm (ecchymosis). The bleeding does not extend into the tarsal plate (the comparatively thick, elongated plates of dense connective tissue within the eyelid) due to an anatomic structure called the orbital septum, which limits extravasation of blood beyond the tarsal plate." [PMID:20411091]
fields.label_normalized: periorbital ecchymosis with tarsal plate sparing
fields.synonyms_concat: Raccoon eyes

fields.label: Yellow nodule
fields.definition: "A type of skin nodule (a lesions that is greater than either 10mm in both width and depth, and most frequently centered in the dermis or subcutaneous fat) with a yellowish coloration (that reflects a high lipid content of the lesion)." [PMID:22223978]

fields.label: Periungual teleangiectasia
fields.definition: "Telangiectasia (small dilated blood vessels) located near to the fingernails or toenails." []

fields.label: Lamellar cataract with riders
fields.definition: "Lamellar cataracts with associated linear lens opacities radially extending towards the periphery of the lens." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Coronary cataract
fields.definition: "A type of cataract characterized by club-shaped and dot opacities distributed radially in the deep cortex. These lens opacities surround the nucleus in an appearance that is though to resemble a crown." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Anterior chamber cells
fields.definition: "Tiny deposits corresponding to cells floating in the anterior chamber of the eye. This appearance is typically associated with intraocular inflammation leading to breakdown of the blood-aqueous barrier and resulting in an increase in the number of cells and in the aqueous humor. Grading (SUN Working Group) is performed by estimating the number of cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:16196117]

fields.label: Anterior chamber cells grade 1+
fields.definition: "Anterior chamber cells with 6-15 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp." [PMID:16196117]

fields.label: Anterior chamber cells grade 0.5+
fields.definition: "Anterior chamber cells with 1-5 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp." [PMID:16196117]

fields.label: Anterior chamber cells grade 0
fields.definition: "Anterior chamber cells with less than one cell in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp." [PMID:16196117]

fields.label: Anterior chamber cells grade 2+
fields.definition: "Anterior chamber cells with 16-25 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp." [PMID:16196117]

fields.label: Anterior chamber cells grade 3+
fields.definition: "Anterior chamber cells with 26-50 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp." []

fields.label: Anterior chamber cells grade 4+
fields.definition: "Anterior chamber cells with more than 50 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp." [PMID:16196117]

fields.label: Central serous chorioretinopathy
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the retina with serous detachment of the neurosensory retina secondary to one or more focal lesions of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE), and associated with blurred vision, usually in one eye only and perceived typically by the patient as a dark spot in the center of the visual field with associated micropsia and metamorphopsia. Normal vision often recurs spontaneously within a few months." [PMID:17662099]

fields.label: Abnormal morphology of the choroidal vasculature
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal anatomy of the choroid." [PMID:38432349]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal morphology of the choroidal vasculature

fields.label: Polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy
fields.definition: "The presence of aneurysmal 'polypoidal' lesions in the choroidal vasculature. The aneurysmal dilatations, also known as polyps, may be found at subfoveal, juxtafoveal, extrafoveal, peripapillary or even peripheral regions. These polypoidal dilatations may be visible as reddish-orange subretinal nodules during ophthalmoscopic examination. The polypoidal lesions are best detected on indocyanine green angiography (ICGA) and might be associated with a branching vascular network (BVN) of neovascularization." [PMID:24653824]

fields.label: Choroidal vascular hyperpermeability
fields.definition: "Increased tendency of choiroidal blood vessels to allow fluids to leak characterized by multifocal choroidal hyperfluorescence on indocyanine green angiography (ICGA)." [PMID:25709392]
fields.synonyms_concat: Choroidal hyperpermeability

fields.label: Christmas tree cataract
fields.definition: "A type of cataract that shows a spectacular display of multiple colors that glitters with the change of incident light like an illuminated Christmas tree." [PMID:27190856]

fields.label: Punctal stenosis
fields.definition: "Punctal stenosis is a condition in which the external opening of the lacrimal canaliculus is narrowed or occluded." [PMID:22848141]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lacrimal punctum stenosis; Stenosis of the lacrimal punctum

fields.label: Mild myopia
fields.definition: "A mild form of myopia with up to -3.00 diopters." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Macular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Bleeding occurring within the macula lutea of the retina." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Macular haemorrhage

fields.label: Abnormal superior vena cava morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the principal vein draining blood from the upper portion of the body and delivering it to the right ventricle of the heart." [MP:0006064]

fields.label: Abnormal inferior vena cava morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the principal vein draining blood from the lower portion of the body." [MP:0006063]

fields.label: Aortic valve prolapse
fields.definition: "Aortic valve prolapse can be diagnosed when either or both of the right or non-coronary aortic valve cusps (seen in the cross sectional echocardiographic long axis view) show backward bowing towards the left ventricle beyond a line joining the points of attachment of the aortic valve leaflets to the annulus." [PMID:4015927]

fields.label: Abnormal left atrium morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality of the left atrium." []

fields.label: Abnormal right atrium morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality of the right atrium." []

fields.label: Foveal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Bleeding occurring within the fovea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foveal haemorrhage

fields.label: Submacular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Bleeding between the neurosensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) arising from the choroidal or retinal circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:23202390]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sub-macular haemorrhage; Sub-macular hemorrhage; Submacular haemorrhage

fields.label: Tapetal-like fundal reflex
fields.definition: "Golden, scintillating, particulate reflection noted on fundus examination (typically in the macula and sparing the fovea). The term tapetal is used to describe this 'metallic' sheen appearance as it is thought to be similar to the 'tapetal' reflex seen in the eyes of certain animals." []

fields.label: Hypotropia
fields.definition: "A form of manifest strabismus (heterotropia) in which one eye is deviated downwards when both eyes are open." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Hyperphoria
fields.definition: "Tendency for the visual axis of one eye to be higher than that of the other." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Hypertropia
fields.definition: "A type of strabismus characterized by permanent upward deviation of the visual axis of one eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Hyperdeviation
fields.definition: "A type of strabismus in which the visual axis of one eye is higher than that of the other." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Hypodeviation
fields.definition: "A type of strabismus in which the visual axis of one eye is lower than that of the other." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Cyclodeviation
fields.definition: "Cyclodeviation is defined as the rotation of an eyeball along the anteroposterior axis and cyclotropia as a misalignment of cyclodeviation between the two eyes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:15731772]

fields.label: Abnormal extraocular muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the muscles of the eye." []

fields.label: Abnormal superior oblique muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the superior oblique muscle, a fusiform muscle that originates in the upper, medial side of the orbit. The superior oblique muscle abducts, depresses and internally rotates the eye, and is the only extraocular muscle innervated by the fourth cranial nerve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Superior oblique muscle weakness
fields.definition: "Decreased strength of the superior oblique muscle." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Superior oblique palsy

fields.label: Superior oblique muscle restriction
fields.definition: "Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the superior oblique muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Superior oblique muscle overaction
fields.definition: "An ocular motility abnormality characterized by an overacting superior oblique muscle resulting to vertical incomitance of the eyes in lateral gaze. On examination, this is commonly seen as a downshoot of the adducting eye occurring when gaze is directed into the field of action of the inferior oblique muscle, producing a greater downward excursion of the adducted eye than of the abducted eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:11545636]

fields.label: Superior oblique muscle underaction
fields.definition: "Reduced ocular movement of the superior oblique muscle which improves on testing ductions, typically associated with neurogenic palsy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Under-depression in adduction

fields.label: Abnormal inferior oblique muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the inferior oblique muscle, an extraocular muscle that has its origin on the maxillary bone just posterior to the inferior medial orbital rim and lateral to the nasolacrimal canal and that is innervated by the inferior branch of the oculomotor nerve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Inferior oblique muscle restriction
fields.definition: "Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the inferior oblique muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Inferior oblique muscle weakness
fields.definition: "Decreased strength of the inferior oblique muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Inferior oblique palsy

fields.label: Inferior oblique muscle overaction
fields.definition: "A common ocular motility disorder characterized by vertical incomitance of the eyes in lateral gaze. In primary inferior oblique muscle overaction, an upshoot of the adducting eye occurs when gaze is directed into the field of action of the inferior oblique muscle, producing a greater upward excursion of the adducted eye than of the abducted eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:11545636]

fields.label: Abnormal inferior rectus muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the inferior rectus muscle, which is innervated by the inferior division of oculomotor nerve and functions in the depression, adduction, and lateral rotation (extortion) of the eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Inferior rectus muscle weakness
fields.definition: "Decreased strength of the inferior rectus muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Inferior rectus muscle restriction
fields.definition: "Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the inferior rectus muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal superior rectus muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the superior rectus muscle, an extraocular muscle that is innervated by the superior division of the oculomotor nerve, and whose primary function is the elevation of the globe." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Orbital schwannoma
fields.definition: "A schwannoma (benign, usually encapsulated slow growing tumor composed of Schwann cells) located in the orbit." []

fields.label: Lid lag on downgaze
fields.definition: "Delayed descent of the upper eyelid on downgaze. Also described by some authors as von Graefe sign." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eyelid lag; Lid lag; von Graefe sign

fields.label: Abnormal medial rectus muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the medial rectus muscle, an extraocular muscle that is innervated by the inferior division of the oculomotor nerve and whose sole action is the adduction of the eyeball." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Upper eyelid entropion
fields.definition: "An inward turning (inversion) of the margin of the upper eyelid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Cicatricial ectropion
fields.definition: "An outward turning (eversion) or rotation of the eyelid margin (i.e., ectropion) caused by shortening or contraction of the anterior or middle lamellae related to scarring." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Anterior blepharitis
fields.definition: "A type of blepharitis that affects the eyelid skin, base of the eyelashes, and the eyelash follicles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Posterior blepharitis
fields.definition: "A type of blepharitis that affects the meibomian glands and meibomian gland orifices. This abnormality can be associated with a spectrum of appearances ranging from meibomian seborrhoea (foaming meibomian gland secretions) and meibomianitis (inflamed meibomian glands), to chalazia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Meibomian gland disease; Meibomian gland dysfunction

fields.label: Epicanthus superciliaris
fields.definition: "A type of epicanthus in which more extensive epicanthal folds with their origins in the eyebrow cover, pass in front of and lateral to the medial canthus (middle corner of the eye)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Corneal astigmatism
fields.definition: "A type of refractive error related abnormal curvatures on the anterior or posterior surface of the cornea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Focal emotional seizure
fields.definition: "Seizures presenting with an emotion or the appearance of having an emotion as an early prominent feature, such as fear, spontaneous joy or euphoria, laughing (gelastic), or crying, (dacrystic). These emotional seizures may occur with or without objective clinical signs of a seizure evident to the observer." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Affective seizure; Emotional seizure; Focal affective seizure; Partial emotional seizure

fields.label: Abscess
fields.definition: "An abscess is a localized collection of purulent material surrounded by inflammation and granulation." [PMID:35125157]

fields.label: Sterile abscess
fields.definition: "An abscess not caused by infection with pyogenic bacteria. Operationally, a sterile abscess is inferred if investigations of an abscess fail to reveal evidence of pathogenic organisms." []

fields.label: Abnormal plasma cell count
fields.definition: "An abnormal number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are the the effector cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies." []

fields.label: Reduced plasma cell count
fields.definition: "An abnormally low number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are the the effector cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies." []

fields.label: Elevated plasma cell count
fields.definition: "An abnormally high number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are the the effector cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies." []

fields.label: Decreased CD4+ effector memory T cell proportion
fields.definition: "An abnormally decreased proportion of effector memory CD4+ T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These are memory cells that are short-lived cells that migrate to the site of an infection and attempt to eliminate the pathogen. These cells have the phenotype CD3-positive, CD4-positive, CD62L-negative, CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative." [PMID:22343568]
synonyms: Decreased proportion of CD4+ effector memory T cells
Decreased proportion of CD4-positive effector memory T cells
Decreased proportion of effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
fields.label_normalized: decreased cd4+ effector memory t cell proportion
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased proportion of CD4+ effector memory T cells; Decreased proportion of CD4-positive effector memory T cells; Decreased proportion of effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells

fields.label: Increased CD4+ effector memory T cell proportion
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased proportion of effector memory CD4+ T cells. These are memory cells that are short-lived cells that migrate to the site of an infection and attempt to eliminate the pathogen. These cells may have a CD3/CD4/CD62L-/CD45RA phenotype." []
synonyms: Increased CD4+ effector memory T cell proportion
Increased proportion of CD4+ effector memory T cells
Increased proportion of CD4-positive effector memory T cells
Increased proportion of effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
fields.label_normalized: increased cd4+ effector memory t cell proportion
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased CD4+ effector memory T cell proportion; Increased proportion of CD4+ effector memory T cells; Increased proportion of CD4-positive effector memory T cells; Increased proportion of effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells

fields.label: Increased circulating oleate level
fields.definition: "An abnormally high concentration of oleic acid (oleate) in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:18772370]

fields.label: Increased circulating octadecanoate level
fields.definition: "An abnormally high concentration of octadecanoate in the blood circulation. Octadecanoate is a fatty acid anion 18:0 that is the conjugate base of octadecanoic acid (stearic acid)." []

fields.label: Increased circulating myristoleate level
fields.definition: "An abnormally high concentration of myristoleate in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Anti-myelin-associated glycoprotein antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against myelin-associated glycoprotein (MAG)." [PMID:16969155]

fields.label: Argininosuccinic aciduria
fields.definition: "Increased amount of argininosuccinate in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:30158522]

fields.label: Alpha-aminobutyric aciduria
fields.definition: "Increased amount of alpha-aminobutyric acid in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049]

fields.label: Abnormal ureter morphology
fields.definition: "A structural abnormality of the ureter. The ureter is the duct by which urine passes from the kidney to the bladder." []

fields.label: Abnormal ureter physiology
fields.definition: "A functional abnormality of the ureter. The ureter is the duct by which urine passes from the kidney to the bladder." []

fields.label: Ureteral polyp
fields.definition: "A growth protruding from the mucous membrane of the ureter. Ureteral polyps can be attached to the ureter by a broad base or a thin stalk." [NCIT:C4530]
fields.synonyms_concat: Polyp of the ureter; Ureter polyp

fields.label: Endometritis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the inner lining of the uterus (endometrium)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:29960704]
synonyms: Inflammation of the inner lining of the uterus
fields.synonyms_concat: Endometrial inflammation; Inflammation of the inner lining of the uterus

fields.label: Vasospasm
fields.definition: "Narrowing of an artery due to constriction of the blood vessels." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:20557770]
fields.synonyms_concat: Angiospasm; Blood vessel spasm; Vascular spasm

fields.label: Elevated urinary N-butyrylglycine
fields.definition: "An increased level of N-butyrylglycine in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049]

fields.label: Increased urinary zinc level
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated amount of zinc in the urine, typically as assessed by a 24 hour urine collection." []

fields.label: Abnormal urinary mineral level
fields.definition: "An abnormal concentration or amount of a mineral in the urine. Medically relevant minerals include calcium, phosphorus, potassium, sodium, chloride, magnesium, iron, zinc, iodine, chromium, copper, fluoride, molybdenum, manganese, and selenium." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating glycolate concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of glycolate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:2002628]

fields.label: Tarlov cyst
fields.definition: "A cerebrospinal fluid-filled nerve root cyst most often localized in the sacral spine." [PMID:26435653]
fields.synonyms_concat: Perineural cyst

fields.label: Fixation-off epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Fixation off sensitivity (FOS) is characterized by posterior or generalized epileptiform discharges that consistently occur with conditions that eliminate central vision, such as closed eyes, complete darkness, modified Ganzfeld stimulation (using a large white surface without visual cues), and Frenzel lenses. The FOS electroencephalogram (EEG) pattern usually consists of spikes/polyspikes and waves localized in occipital regions (bilateral or unilateral) or generalized discharges. It is usually inhibited by fixation of gaze, observing patterns, or intermittent photic stimulation (e.g., flashing light or patterns used as stimuli during the recording of the EEG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:22925838, PMID:24099056]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fixation-off sensitivity

fields.label: Bilateral polymicrogyria
fields.definition: "Polymicrogyria that affects all or some of both cerebral hemispheres." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]

fields.label: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome
fields.definition: "A type of nephrotic syndrome in which complete remission (albumin urine dipstick negative/trace or proteinuria <4mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio <200mg/g (<20 mg/mmol) for 3 consecutive days) is achieved within initial 4 weeks of corticosteroid therapy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:29910038]
fields.synonyms_concat: SSNS

fields.label: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome with infrequent relapses
fields.definition: "A type of steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome in which relapses occur at a frequency of one relapse (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria over 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) within 6 months of initial response, or one to three relapses in any 12-month period." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:29910038]
fields.label_normalized: steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome with infrequent relapses

fields.label: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome with frequent relapses
fields.definition: "A type of steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome in which relapses occur at a frequency of two or more relapses (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria over 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) within 6 months of initial response or four or more relapses in any 12-month period." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:29910038]
fields.label_normalized: steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome with frequent relapses

fields.label: Steroid-dependent nephrotic syndrome
fields.definition: "A type of nephrotic syndrome in which two consecutive relapses (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria greater than 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) occur during corticosteroid therapy, or within 14 days of ceasing therapy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:29910038]
fields.synonyms_concat: SDNS

fields.label: Abnormal placental adhesion into the uterine wall
fields.definition: "Abnormal placental adhesion is characterized by an anomalous adherence of the placenta to the uterine wall. Based on the degree of adhesion, placental invasion can be classified into accreta, increta, or percreta." [PMID:30210239]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal placental adhesion into the uterine wall

fields.label: Placenta percreta
fields.definition: "Placenta percreta is a rare form of morbidly adherent placenta with penetration through the myometrium reaching serosa and even adjacent pelvic organs." [PMID:30210239]
synonyms: Abnormal placental pentration beyond the uterine wall
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal placental pentration beyond the uterine wall

fields.label: Placenta accreta
fields.definition: "Abnormally firm adherence of the placenta to the uterine wall." [PMID:15145367]

fields.label: Placenta increta
fields.definition: "Abnormal placental pentration into but not beyond the uterine wall." []

fields.label: Prenatal double bubble sign
fields.definition: "Sonographic detection of a double bubble sign in the upper abdomen is strongly indicative of duodenal obstruction. One bubble represents fetal stomach, and the other is attributed to a dilated proximal part of the duodenum; continuity between both bubbles is required for the sign." [PMID:31167209]

fields.label: Decreased circulating creatine kinase concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction in the level of the enzyme creatine kinase (also known as creatine phosphokinase (CK; EC 2.7.3.2) in the blood." [PMID:20460152, PMID:31536231]

fields.label: Chiari type II malformation
fields.definition: "A type of Chiari malformation that consists of brainstem herniation and a towering cerebellum in addition to the herniated cerebellar tonsils and vermis due to an open distal spinal dysraphism/myelomeningocele." [PMID:28613730, PMID:32706613]
fields.synonyms_concat: Arnold-Chiari type II malformation

fields.label: Chiari type III malformation
fields.definition: "A type of Chiari malformation that involves herniation of the hindbrain (cerebellum with or without the brainstem) into a low occipital or high cervical meningoencephalocele." [PMID:28613730]
fields.synonyms_concat: Arnold-Chiari type III malformation

fields.label: Abnormal fetal skeletal morphology
fields.definition: "An anomalous structural finding of the fetal skeleton. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other terms from the skeletal hierarchy can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes." []

fields.label: Reduced fetal femur/foot length ratio
fields.definition: "This ratio relates the length of the fetal femur to that of the fetal foot. The ratio is approximately 1 throughout the age range of 14 to 40 weeks of gestation. A substantial reduction in the raio can help differentiate fetuses that have dysplastic limb reduction from those whose limbs are short because of constitutional factors or IUGR. It can reduce the problem of an unknown gestational age and help to distinguish between fetal skeletal dysplasia and intrauterine growth retardation caused by other factors." [PMID:2406168, PMID:3292975]

fields.label: Moderate to late preterm birth
fields.definition: "Birth at 32 to 36 completed weeks of gestation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157]

fields.label: Extremely preterm birth
fields.definition: "Birth before 28 completed weeks of gestation (up to and including 27 weeks and 6 days of gestation)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157]

fields.label: Very preterm birth
fields.definition: "Birth before 32 completed weeks of gestation (28 up to but not including 32 weeks)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157, PMID:27743648]

fields.label: Fetal neck anomaly
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly in the fetal neck region. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes." []

fields.label: Abnormal neck morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the neck region." []

fields.label: Abnormal neck physiology
fields.definition: "Any functional anomaly of the neck region." []

fields.label: Syntelencephaly
fields.definition: "Syntelencephaly is a rare malformation that consists of an abnormal midline connection of the cerebral hemispheres in the posterior frontal and parietal regions, with interhemispheric separation of the basal forebrain, anterior frontal lobes, and occipital regions." [PMID:11827888]

fields.label: Fetal pericardial effusion
fields.definition: "An abnormal accumulation of fluid in which the heart is partially or completely surrounded by fluid that is seen in all views and the thickness of the fluid as observed by prenatal ultrasound is above age-dependent norms." [PMID:16098320, PMID:33781717]

fields.label: Fetal skin edema
fields.definition: "A separation of skin in one or more regions of the body or even along the entire length of body wall (to a degree greater than gestational-age related norms) related to pathologically increased fluid accumulation in the subcutaneous tissue." [PMID:23696062]

fields.label: Loculated ascites
fields.definition: "A type of ascites (peritoneal fluid collection) that is divided into loculi (compartments) by septa (fibrous walls). Ascites fluid can become loculated when confined by adhesions, malignancy or infection." [PMID:14981382, PMID:28567101]
fields.synonyms_concat: Septated ascites

fields.label: Meconium pseudocyst
fields.definition: "A meconium-containing cyst in the peritoneal space . Meconium pseudocysts form in the presence of meconium peritonitis, which is defined as a sterile peritonitis caused by escape of meconium from the intestinal tract into the general peritoneal cavity during the fetal or perinatal period. When the extruded meconium becomes walled off, it can form a rim-calcified mass representing the meconium pseudocyst." [PMID:19293041]

fields.label: Premature closure of the ductus arteriosus
fields.definition: "A prenatal partial or complete closure of the ductus arteriosus (i.e., prior to delivery)." [PMID:34304616]
synonyms: Idiopathic constriction of the fetal ductus arteriosus
Idiopathic constriction of the foetal ductus arteriosus
fields.label_normalized: premature closure of the ductus arteriosus
fields.synonyms_concat: Fetal arterial duct narrowing-closure; Fetal ductus arteriosus narrowing-closure; Fetal PAD narrowing-closure; Fetal PDA narrowing-closure; Foetal arterial duct narrowing-closure; Foetal ductus arteriosus narrowing-closure; Foetal PAD narrowing-closure; Foetal PDA narrowing-closure; Idiopathic constriction of the fetal ductus arteriosus; Idiopathic constriction of the foetal ductus arteriosus; PCDA

fields.label: Fetal pleural effusion
fields.definition: "Fetal pleural effusion is the accumulation of excess fluid in the layers of tissue (pleura) lining the lungs and wall of the chest. It may be primary, also termed hydrothorax, occurring as an isolated finding or it may be secondary, most commonly resulting from non-immune hydrops." [PMID:18280793]

fields.label: Fetal chylothorax
fields.definition: "The presence of chyle (a type of lipid-rich lymph) in the pleural space (the space surrounding the lung) as observed in a fetus." [PMID:10472400, PMID:28351595]

fields.label: Fetal hydrothorax
fields.definition: "Accumulation of lymphatic fluid in the pleural space. This finding is usually observed by prenatal sonography. Once neonatal feeding is established and the lymphatic fluid contains chyle, transformation to chylothorax may be observed." [PMID:25721226]

fields.label: Diskitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of an intervertebral disk or disk space." [PMID:31082091]
fields.synonyms_concat: Discitis

fields.label: Compound muscle action potential amplitude facilitation
fields.definition: "Compound muscle action potential amplitude (CMAP) facilitation denotes an increase in tendon reflexes, strength, or CMAP amplitude after 10 seconds of maximal voluntary contraction." [PMID:25192047]
fields.label_normalized: compound muscle action potential amplitude facilitation
fields.synonyms_concat: CMAP facilitation

fields.label: Distal clavicular thinning
fields.definition: "Abnormally reduced diameter (cross section) of the clavicles that is limited to the distal region." []

fields.label: Crouch gait
fields.definition: "A gait disturbance that is characterized by excessive ankle dorsiflexion, knee and hip flexion during the stance phase." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157, PMID:26709688, PMID:28279852]

fields.label: Abnormal amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Amyloid beta is a peptide of 36-43 amino acids that is processed from the Amyloid precursor protein. ABeta42, which is 42 amino acids in length, is the longer form." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:27025652]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal amyloid beta 42 peptide csf concentration

fields.label: Decreased amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:15992827, PMID:31391004]
fields.label_normalized: decreased amyloid beta 42 peptide csf concentration

fields.label: Increased amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
fields.definition: "An elevation above the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226]
fields.label_normalized: increased amyloid beta 42 peptide csf concentration

fields.label: Abnormal amyloid beta 40 peptide CSF concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Amyloid beta is a peptide of 36-43 amino acids that is processed from the Amyloid precursor protein. ABeta40, which is 40 amino acids in length, is the shorter form." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:29420472]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal amyloid beta 40 peptide csf concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal Abeta 40 level; Abnormal beta amyloid 40 level

fields.label: Increased amyloid beta 40 peptide CSF concentration
fields.definition: "An elevation above the normal concentration of amyloid beta 40 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:19273758]
fields.label_normalized: increased amyloid beta 40 peptide csf concentration

fields.label: Abnormal amyloid beta peptide CSF concentration
fields.definition: "Any anomaly in the concentration of a cleaved APP amyloid beta protein fragment in the cerebrospinal fluid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:31391004]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal amyloid beta peptide csf concentration

fields.label: Extra-abdominal umbilical vein varix
fields.definition: "Focal dilatation of the extra-abdominal portion of the umbilical vein. An extra-abdominal umbilical varix is difficult to diagnose prenatally as it can appear like a cyst on ultrasound prior to birth." [PMID:33099808]

fields.label: Fetal intra-abdominal umbilical vein varix
fields.definition: "Fetal intra-abdominal umbilical vein varix (FIUVV) is defined by the focal dilatation of the fetal umbilical vein between its entry in the abdomen and its ending in the portal system. The dilatation can be defined using one of the following criteria: a portion of intra-abdominal umbilical vein that is at least 50% wider than the non-dilated portion; a dilatation of 9 mm or more, or a dilatation greater than 2 SD above the mean value for gestational age." [PMID:24883288, PMID:28876490]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fetal umbilical vein dilatation; FIUVV; Foetal umbilical vein dilatation

fields.label: Impaired fasting glucose
fields.definition: "Impaired fasting glucose (IFG) is indicated by a fasting plasma glucose above normal but below the diabetic range. Levels between 110 mg/dl (6.1 mmol/l) to 125 mg/dl (6.9 mmol/l) are diagnostic of IFG." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7505-5418, PMID:17327355, PMID:29763085]

fields.label: Atelencephaly
fields.definition: "A defect of development of the brain characterized by absence of the telencephalon (embryonic structure from which the mature cerebrum develops)." [PMID:26260203]

fields.label: Pituitary macroadenoma
fields.definition: "A pituitary gland adenoma that is larger than 10mm." [PMID:32119338]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pituitary gland macroadenoma

fields.label: Pituitary microadenoma
fields.definition: "A pituitary adenoma that is less than 10 mm in diameter." [PMID:32119338]

fields.label: Mucus plug
fields.definition: "Mucus that is abnormally thick in consistency (ie, inspissated) and plugs the airway is known as a mucus plug. Mucus plugs consist of mucins and cells and can partially or completely obstruct one or more airways and cause serious consequences, including atelectasis and recurrent infection." []

fields.label: Airway casts
fields.definition: "A replicate of airways from accumulated and condensed mucous and cellular material. These semisolid occlusions take the shape of the airway within they are formed, leading to obstruction of the tracheobronchial tree with consecutive respiratory insufficiency. Based on their principal composition, one can differentiate fibrin casts and mucin casts. Plastic bronchitis is the name of the condition characterized by the formation of airway casts." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:34713989]

fields.label: Fibrin casts
fields.definition: "A type of airway casts that consist of plasma components and inflammatory cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cellular airway casts; Diphtheroid membranes; Pseudomembranes; Type I airway casts

fields.label: Mucin casts
fields.definition: "A type of airway casts that consist of impacted mucus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]
fields.synonyms_concat: Acellular airway casts; Type II airway casts

fields.label: Perisylvian FDG hypermetabolism
fields.definition: "18F-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography and computed tomography (FDG-PET/CT) evaluates the glucose metabolism of the brain. FDG uptake is interpreted to represent glycolysis. This term therefore represents an abnormally increased FDG uptake (increased glucose metabolism) in the region of the brain that surrounds the Sylvian fissure." [PMID:33452041]
fields.synonyms_concat: Perisylvian hypermetabolism in FDG PET

fields.label: Anhydramnios
