fields.definition: "A complete or near-complete lack of amniotic fluid surrounding a fetus. This finding can be observed sonographically in the third trimesters if the deepest pocket of amniotic fluid is less than or equal to 2 cm." [PMID:34230606]

fields.label: Distended jugular lymphatic sacs
fields.definition: "The jugular lymphatic sacs (JLS) are a physiological and temporary part of fetal lymphatic development. They are formed from small buds of lymphatic endothelial cells arising from the internal jugular veins. By 14 weeks gestation they have developed into lymphatic nodes which drain into the systemic circulation. Visibility of JLS on ultrasound past 14 weeks of gestation implies distension and this may be associated with raised nuchal translucency." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7653-4653, PMID:19248150, PMID:20227670, PMID:23718767]

fields.label: Type 1 schizencephaly
fields.definition: "A type of Schizencephaly in which there is a trans-mantle column of abnormal gray matter but no evidence of a CSF-containing cleft on MR imaging." [PMID:30027296, PMID:3111205]
fields.synonyms_concat: Trans-mantle schizencephaly

fields.label: Type 2 schizencephaly
fields.definition: "A type of Schizencephaly in which CSF-containing cleft is present with abutting lining lips of abnormal gray matter that are opposed to each other." [PMID:30027296]

fields.label: Type 3 schizencephaly
fields.definition: "A type of Schizencephaly in which CSF-containing cleft present with non-abutting lining lips of abnormal gray matter." [PMID:30027296]

fields.label: Abnormal fetal nasal bone visualization
fields.definition: "Abnormal appearance or non-visualization (apparent absence) of the nasal bone of a fetus in first trimester sonographic screening. Assessment of the fetal nasal bone is generally performed at 11-14 weeks gestational age." [PMID:16813740]

fields.label: Absent fetal nasal bone
fields.definition: "The nasal bone is considered absent when it is not visualized on a midsagittal view of the profile. In the second trimester, a true midsagittal view of the fetal profile is obtained and magnified to fill the majority of the image space. The nasal bone appears as an echogenic linear structure below the skin edge. The optimal angle of insonation is 45 degrees to the longitudinal axis of the fetal nasal bone. If the angle of insonation is 0 or 180 degrees, the nasal bone may appear artificially absent. The presence or absence of the nasal bone may be determined at the time of the 11- to 14-week ultrasound examination and used as part of the risk assessment for aneuploidy." [PMID:23324624, PMID:31679594]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absence of fetal nasal bone; Absence of foetal nasal bone; Unossified nasal bone

fields.label: Hypoplastic fetal nasal bone
fields.definition: "Length of the nasal bone below a predetermined cut-off as seen on antenatal ultrasound using standard imaging techniques." []

fields.label: Early young adult onset
fields.definition: "Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 16 to under 19 years." []

fields.label: Intermediate young adult onset
fields.definition: "Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 19 to under 25 years." []

fields.label: Late young adult onset
fields.definition: "Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 25 to under 40 years." []

fields.label: Convergence-retraction nystagmus
fields.definition: "Convergence-retraction nystagmus is an irregular, jerky nystagmus in which both eyeballs rhythmically converge and retract into the orbit, particularly on attempting an upward gaze." [PMID:27169871]
fields.synonyms_concat: Convergence retraction nystagmus

fields.label: Spontaneous chorioamniotic separation
fields.definition: "Persistence separation of the chorionic and amnionic membranes after the 16th week of gestation (not as a result of a procedure such as amniocentesis)." [PMID:27683622]
fields.synonyms_concat: Amnion-chorion separation

fields.label: Neurite dystrophy
fields.definition: "Dystrophic neurites are abnormal neuronal processes characterized microscopically by aberrant sprouting, dystrophic expansion, and accumulation of various cellular organelles and cytoskeletal/signaling proteins." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:30899091]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dystrophic neurite

fields.label: Cerebral cortical microinfarct
fields.definition: "An infarct located on the outer layer of the cerebrum that can only be observed microscopically. Cerebral microinfarcts are typically defined as sharply delimited microscopic regions of cellular death or tissue necrosis, sometimes with cavitation (that is, a central fluid-filled cavity). The term microscopic denotes that these lesions are not visible by gross inspection of the brain but seen by light microscopy. The term infarct is most commonly used for ischemia-related tissue loss, and indeed the pathologic appearance of microinfarcts is consistent with that of known ischemic infarctions." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:10867785]

fields.label: Abnormal umbilical artery doppler waveform during pregnancy
fields.definition: "Abnormal waveforms the Doppler sonographic examination of bloodflow in the umbilical artery. vUmbilical arterial Doppler assessment is used in surveillance of fetal health in the third trimester." [PMID:12768548]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal umbilical artery doppler waveform during pregnancy

fields.label: Fetal anemia
fields.definition: "Low hemoglobin/hematocrit in a fetus as evidenced by percutaneous umbilical cord sampling and Doppler ultrasonographic assessment of the peak velocity of systolic blood flow in the middle cerebral artery." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8593-2186, PMID:30718211]

fields.label: Skeletal muscle autophagosome accumulation
fields.definition: "Abnormal accumulation of autophagosomes in skeletal muscle tissue." [PMID:20040311]
fields.synonyms_concat: Autophagic material in muscle biopsy

fields.label: Skeletal muscle hyperechogenicity
fields.definition: "An increased echo intensity of muscle tissue on sonography, defined as an increased amount of returning echoes per square area of muscle tissue. On cross-section, normal muscle appears as a relatively anechoic structure with hyperechoic speckles within the tissue representing perimysial septa, giving it a starry night appearance. The boundaries of each muscle are delineated by the presence of hyperechoic fascia. In muscle disorders, one of the hallmark findings is replacement of healthy muscle with fat and fibrosis, manifested by an increase in echogenicity from higher sound transitions in the muscle. This increase in echogenicity is most distinct in conditions that lead to chronic pathology, such as long-standing muscle inflammation, dystrophy, or denervation." [PMID:32989482]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperechoic muscle; Muscle ultrasound hyperechogenicity

fields.label: Maternal vascular malperfusion
fields.definition: "Gross findings of maternal vascular malperfusion include placental hypoplasia, placental infarction, and retroplacental hemorrhage. If information is available, it is preferable to annotate using the HPO terms that corresponding to the specific abnormalities." [PMID:30129127]

fields.label: Limited horizontal extraocular movement
fields.definition: "Limited mobility of the eye to move from side to side (horizontally) within its socket." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3302-4610]

fields.label: Limited vertical extraocular movement
fields.definition: "Limited mobility of the eye to move up and down (vertically) within its socket." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3302-4610]

fields.label: Cerebral infarct
fields.definition: "A necrotic lesion in the cerebrum resulting from a sudden insufficiency of arterial or venous blood supply due to emboli, thrombi or mechanical factors." [PMID:10867785]

fields.label: Abnormal fetal skin morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the skin of the fetus or newborn. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes." []

fields.label: Caseous vernix-like desquamation
fields.definition: "Vernix caseosa is a physiological, viscous biofilm that is produced by desquamated fetal skin and sebaceous glands covering the fetus at the third trimester in-utero. The substance's gross morphology in post-partum is described by the etymology, as vernix means varnish, and caseosa means cheesy-like matter. This finding refers to an abnormally thick and greasy vernix caseosa-like scale present at birth." [PMID:21856041]
fields.synonyms_concat: Greasy, thick vernix caseosa-like scale

fields.label: Type 1 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
fields.definition: "A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by multiple large cysts or a single dominant cyst." [PMID:27070354]

fields.label: Type 2 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
fields.definition: "A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by multiple evenly spaced cysts (sponge-like appearance)." [PMID:27070354]

fields.label: Type 3 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
fields.definition: "A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by a bulky firm mass with an adenomatoid appearance." [PMID:27070354]

fields.label: Periventricular pseudocyst
fields.definition: "Pseudocysts that lack an epithelial lining, PVPCs are frequently observed in the caudothalamic groove or in the infero-lateral aspect of the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles, but may also be located elsewhere along the periventricular germinal matrix, as in the temporal or occipital horns." [PMID:12423480, PMID:32277778]

fields.label: Fetal vascular malperfusion
fields.definition: "The term fetal vascular malperfusion (FVM) is used to describe placental pathology that is thought to result from an obstruction in fetal blood flow that could result from a number of conditions (eg, umbilical cord lesions, hypercoagulability, complications of fetal cardiac dysfunction, such as hypoxia, etc.)." [PMID:27223167]

fields.label: Foramen ovale aneurysm
fields.definition: "Foramen ovale aneurysm (FOA) or atrial septal aneurysm is abnormal redundancy of the atrial septum primum, with bulging of the septum by at least half the width of the atrial chamber, or by at least 10 mm beyond the level of the atrial septum. The abnormal protrusion of the interatrial septum results in decreased left atrial volume. On color Doppler there is reduced left ventricular inflow." [PMID:30601441]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fetal atrial septal dilatation; Foetal atrial septal dilatation; Redundant septum primum flap

fields.label: Anti-glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchored high-density lipoprotein binding protein 1 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchored high-density lipoprotein binding protein 1." [PMID:28402248, PMID:32948662, PMID:35185060, PMID:36402671]
fields.label_normalized: anti-glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchored high-density lipoprotein binding protein 1 antibody positivity
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-GPIHBP1 antibody positivity

fields.label: Abnormal social development
fields.definition: "A substantial lag in the achievement of or divergence from typical milestones in social interaction and communication skills. Social-emotional competencies in young children include helping, sharing, comforting, and exhibiting empathy and compliance." [PMID:30623038]

fields.label: Streak gonad
fields.definition: "A type of gonadal dysgenesis in which the gonadal tissue is underdeveloped and appears as fibrous, streak-like structures instead of fully formed ovaries or testes." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxyhexanoic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of 5-hydroxyhexanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:32550677]

fields.label: Abnormal third cranial nerve morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality of the third (oculomotor) cranial nerve." []

fields.label: Long-bone fracture
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of a lone bone (e.g., the femur, tibia, fibula, humerus, radius, and ulna)." []

fields.label: Abnormal subthalamic nucleus morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the subthalamic nucleus, a small lens-shaped structure located within the diencephalon near the junction with the midbrain. The subthalamic nucleus composes the majority of the subthalamus along with the subthalamic fasciculus, ansa lenticularis, and several other smaller structures." [PMID:32644428]

fields.label: Ring-enhancing cerebral lesion
fields.definition: "An abnormal neuroimaging finding consisting in an area of decreased density surrounded by a bright rim from concentration of the enhancing contrast dye." [PMID:28198691]

fields.label: Optic nerve mass
fields.definition: "A swelling or enlargement localized to the optic nerve. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." []

fields.label: Elevated brain succinate level by MRS
fields.definition: "An increase in the level of succinate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS)." []
synonyms: Elevated brain succinate level by magnetic resonance spectroscopy
fields.label_normalized: elevated brain succinate level by mrs
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated brain succinate level by magnetic resonance spectroscopy

fields.label: Brainstem lucency
fields.definition: "A lesion located in the brainstem that appears areas less dense on magnetic resonance imaging or lighter on computed tomography." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Brainstem lucencies

fields.label: Elevated urine L-xylulose level
fields.definition: "The amount of L-xylulose in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urine biliverdin level
fields.definition: "The amount of biliverdin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urine dodecanedioic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of dodecanedioic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Diminished urine glutamine level
fields.definition: "The amount of glutamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Tongue spasticity
fields.definition: "Spasticity (velocity-dependent increase in tonic stretch reflexes with increased muscle tone and hyperexcitable tendon reflexes) in the muscles of the tongue." []

fields.label: Restricted tongue movement
fields.definition: "Limited ability to move the tongue related to mechanical restrictions such as akyloglossia and not associated with tongue muscle weakness." []

fields.label: Asymmetric blood pressure between limbs
fields.definition: "A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left limb (arm or leg or both)." []

fields.label: Asymmetric blood pressure between legs
fields.definition: "A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left legs." [PMID:34907753]

fields.label: Reduced anterior scleral thickness
fields.definition: "A reduction in the height of the anterior portion of the sclera." [PMID:32271887]

fields.label: Reduced posterior scleral thickness
fields.definition: "A reduction in the height of the posterior portion of the sclera." [PMID:32271887]

fields.label: Elevated urinary 2-aminoisobutyric acid
fields.definition: "The amount of 2-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Reduced beta-hexosaminidase A activity
fields.definition: "The concentration or activity of beta hexosaminidase A in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hexosaminidase A deficiency

fields.label: Abnormal nail shape
fields.definition: "An abnormality affecting the outline (shape) or contour of the nail." [PMID:25821724]

fields.label: Abnormal nail attachment
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the connection of the nail to the nailbed." [PMID:25821724]

fields.label: Abnormal nail surface
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the surface of the nail." [PMID:25821724]

fields.label: Characteristic of mass
fields.definition: "A mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction. This term refers to a property (characteristic) of a mass." []

fields.label: Mobile lump
fields.definition: "This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that can be moved or shifted under the skin when pressed or manipulated." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Mobile mass

fields.label: Immobile lump
fields.definition: "This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that cannot be moved or shifted under the skin when pressed or manipulated." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Immobile mass

fields.label: Painless mass
fields.definition: "This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that does not elicit pain upon palpation." []

fields.label: Anti-ganglionic acetylcholine receptor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against acetylcholine receptors of the ganglionic type." [PMID:18474849]

fields.label: Positive urine anion gap
fields.definition: "The urine anion gap (UAG), calculated as [(Na+ + K+) - (Cl-)] has been used to roughly estimate whether urine ammonium is increased or decreased in the evaluation of hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis. The more ammonium in the urine, the lower the UAG is, which achieves negative values within a wide range (0 to -200 mEq/L) during hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis. In patients with distal renal tubular acidosis (RTA) of several etiologies, the UAG is positive, despite the prevailing metabolic acidosis, and this is a useful bedside diagnostic index of impaired ammonium excretion." [PMID:29311217]

fields.label: Nasoethmoidal encephalocele
fields.definition: "A type of encephalocele that is characterized by herniation through the foramen cecum into the prenasal space and nasal cavity under the nasal bones and above the nasal septum." [PMID:32965839]

fields.label: Rubber-like lump
fields.definition: "This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that has a rubber-like consistency, that is, it is soft and somewhat compressible." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Rubber-like mass

fields.label: Abnormal affect
fields.definition: "An anomaly in intensity, frequency, or duration of the verbal or behavioral expression of emotions, feelings, or thoughts." [PMID:37925091]

fields.label: Disordered formal thought process
fields.definition: "An abnormality in the dynamic mode, rate, or form of thought processes as recognized from the flow of ideas expressed in speech. Successive thoughts and speech are easily diverted by external stimuli or internal superficial associations. Unable to maintain a constant train of thought and loose themselves in side issues, losing the thread and are unable to recover it. Superficial connections appear to drive the subject matter." [PMID:30416391, PMID:31582814]
fields.synonyms_concat: Disordered formal thought processes; Disorganized speech or communication; Formal thought disorder

fields.label: Ruminations
fields.definition: "Recurrent thoughts that have a thematic thread that is typically familiar to the individual and are often willfully brought forth or occur in the context of an anxious preoccupation or worry about a relevant concern which may be out of proportion to the context. Ruminations may be of normal thinking rate and are characterized by a recurring theme that usually has a negative connotation." []

fields.label: Abnormal lexical patterns
fields.definition: "A persistent abnormality in patterns or meanings of expressed language. Words and phrases are disorganized in relationship to each other and often used incorrectly or inappropriately for the context and background culture of the person." []

fields.label: Abnormal semantics
fields.definition: "Odd use of words that are out of context and inappropriate for the social situation." []

fields.label: Idiosyncratic use of words
fields.definition: "Words or phrases and their expression that are used in a manner that is not consistent with the current and accepted meaning for the context and social circumstance. This does not apply to peer or culture driven novel uses of words that are accepted within the given social circles." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ascribing novel meanings to words

fields.label: Tangential speech
fields.definition: "Patterns of expressed speech that have many words to describe a feature, but are themselves vague and approximations. The speech does not get to the point, but rather seems to go around and around and is inconcise and difficult to grasp the primary issue or purpose of the communicated words." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Circumstantiality; Tangentiality

fields.label: Thought insertion
fields.definition: "The experience that thoughts are forced into the conscious awareness by external and foreign entities. The affected individual typically does not recognize the thoughts as coming from themselves and may develop secondary delusional ideas to explain the source of the process." []

fields.label: Thought broadcasting
fields.definition: "The experience that thoughts are being broadcasted from their head/conscious experience, some report that their thoughts are escaping, while others may believe that their thoughts are being picked up by a nearby receiver only to be further propagated. The person subsequently believes that everyone knows what they are thinking and feels that they have no privacy." []

fields.label: Thought echo
fields.definition: "The personal experience that thoughts are echoing around them and that they are hearing their own thoughts as they are experiencing them internally." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Echo de pensee; Gedankenlautverden

fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly characterized by a joining (fusion) of two or more thoracic vertebral bodies with one another." []

fields.label: Fused lumbar vertebrae
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly characterized by a joining (fusion) of two or more lumbar vertebral bodies with one another." []

fields.label: Schmorl's node
fields.definition: "A Schmorl's node is the herniation of nucleus pulposus through the cartilaginous and bony end plate into the body of the adjacent vertebra." [PMID:22544358]
fields.synonyms_concat: Schmorl's nodes

fields.label: Incomplete ossification of pubis

fields.label: Hip subluxation

fields.label: Flexion contracture of digit
fields.definition: "A bent (flexed) finger or toe joint that cannot be straightened actively or passively. It is thus a chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement of joints." []

fields.label: Serpentine fibula

fields.label: Hypoglycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan

fields.label: Abnormal lateral ventricle morphology

fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of lateral ventricle

fields.label: Colpocephaly
fields.definition: "Colpocephaly is an anatomic finding in the brain manifested by occipital horns that are disproportionately enlarged in comparison with other parts of the lateral ventricles." [PMID:4058748]

fields.label: Brain abscess
fields.definition: "A collection of pus, immune cells, and other material in the brain." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Brain abscess

fields.label: Tip-toe gait

fields.synonyms_concat: Tiptoe gait; Toe walking; Walking on tiptoes

fields.label: Inguinal freckling
fields.definition: "The presence in the inguinal region (groin) of an increased number of freckles, small circular spots on the skin that are darker than the surrounding skin because of deposits of melanin." []

fields.label: Stiff skin

fields.label: Perifollicular fibrosis

fields.label: Hyperconvex toenail

fields.label: Uncombable hair
fields.definition: "Hair that is disorderly, stands out from the scalp, and cannot be combed flat." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Uncombable hair

fields.label: Autoimmune antibody positivity

fields.label: Sickled erythrocytes

fields.label: Mitochondrial depletion

fields.label: Nervous tissue neoplasm

fields.label: Neuroectodermal neoplasm
fields.definition: "A neoplasm arising in the neuroectoderm, the portion of the ectoderm of the early embryo that gives rise to the central and peripheral nervous systems, including some glial cells." []

fields.label: Craniopharyngioma
fields.definition: "A benign pituitary-region neoplasm that originates from Rathke's pouch. Craniopharyngiomas are benign slow growing tumors that are located within the sellar and para sellar region of the central nervous system." [PMID:17425791]

fields.label: Neuroepithelial neoplasm
fields.definition: "A neoplasm composed of neural epithelium, not necessarily a neoplasm located in the neural epithelium or neuroepithelium." []

fields.label: Neurocytoma
fields.definition: "A benign brain tumor composed of neural elements which most often arise from the septum pellucidum and the walls of the lateral ventricles." []

fields.label: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor
fields.definition: "A tumor that originates in cells from the primitive neural crest. This group of tumors is characteirzed by the presence of primitive cells with elements of neuronal and/or glial differentiation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Primitive neuroectodermal tumour

fields.label: Ependymoblastoma
fields.definition: "A highly malignant embryonal tumor of infancy and young childhood characterized by neuroectodermal elements organized in distinctive multilayered rosettes. fields.label: Peripheral primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm
fields.definition: "A primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm that occurs extracranially in soft tissue and bone." []

fields.label: Olfactory esthesioneuroblastoma
fields.definition: "A malignant olfactory neuroblastoma arising from the olfactory epithelium of the superior nasal cavity and cribriform plate." []

fields.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
fields.definition: "A form of extranodal, high-grade non-Hodgkin B-cell neoplasm, usually large cell or immunoblastic type that originates in the brain, leptomeninges, spinal cord, or eyes and typically remains confined to the CNS." [PMID:23696924]

fields.label: Central primitive neuroectodermal tumor

fields.synonyms_concat: Central primitive neuroectodermal tumour

fields.label: Medulloepithelioma

fields.label: Paranasal sinus neoplasm

fields.label: Chemodectoma

fields.synonyms_concat: Chemodectomas

fields.label: Ductal carcinoma in situ

fields.label: Bronchial neoplasm

fields.label: Cervix cancer

fields.label: Burkitt lymphoma

fields.label: Abnormal drinking behavior

While only one gene encoding the small subunit has been demonstrated, there are many genes for the large one. CAPN3 is similar to ubiquitous Calpain 1 and 2 (m-calpain and micro-calpain), but contains specific insertion sequences (NS, IS1 and IS2). Calpains cleave target proteins to modify their properties, rather than breaking down the substrates." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24843229]

fields.label_normalized: abnormality of central nervous system electrophysiology

fields.label: Oppenheim reflex

fields.label: Tetraplegia/tetraparesis
fields.definition: "Loss of strength in all four limbs. Tetraplegia refers to a complete loss of strength, whereas Tetraparesis refers to an incomplete loss of strength." []

fields.label: Impaired visually enhanced vestibulo-ocular reflex
fields.definition: "The vestibulo-ocular reflex is responsible for the stabilization of the retinal image during movement. The visual vestibular ocular reflex (VVOR) or visual enhanced VOR, maintains ocular stability during head motion by generating compensatory eye movement opposite to head movement, and is a major component of visual vestibular interaction. This feature is an impairment of this reflex, manifested as the combined impairment of the three compensatory eye movement reflexes, namely the vestibulo-ocular reflex (VOR), smooth pursuit (SP) and optokinetic reflex (OKR)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16954982]
fields.synonyms_concat: Visually enhanced vestibulo-ocular reflex impairment; VVOR impairment

fields.label: Isometric tremor

fields.label: Kinetic tremor

fields.label: Fatigable weakness of bulbar muscles

fields.label: Fatigable weakness of chewing muscles

fields.label: Fatigable weakness of speech muscles

fields.label: Fatigable weakness of respiratory muscles

fields.label: Fatigable weakness of distal limb muscles

fields.label: Response to drugs acting on neuromuscular transmission
fields.definition: "Specific drugs interfere selectively with the different cellular mechanisms involved in neuromuscular transmission (synthesis, storage, release, action and inactivation of transmitter). fields.label: Increased jitter at single fiber EMG

fields.definition: "A compound muscle action potential (CMAP) is a type of electromyography (EMG). fields.label: Paradoxical respiration

It may be seen in children with respiratory distress of any cause, which leads to indrawing of the intercostal spaces during inspiration. Patients with chronic airways obstruction also show indrawing of the lower ribs during inspiration, due to the distorted action of a depressed and flattened diaphragm. Crush injuries of the chest, with fractured ribs and sternum, can lead to a severe degree of paradoxical breathing." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:tevangelista]
fields.synonyms_concat: Paradoxical breathing

fields.label: Emotional dearth

This state is often characterized by a pervasive sense of emotional disconnection or detachment, where the individual may report feeling \"numb\" or lacking emotional responses that were previously present. The reduction in emotional response can range from mild dampening of emotional responses to a near-total absence of emotional engagement. It is essential to consider the individual's baseline emotional capacity, as changes may be more significant in those who previously had a wide emotional range." [PMID:34008477]

fields.label: Increased proportion of marginal zone B cells

fields.label: Abnormal class-switched memory B cell proportion
fields.definition: "A deviation of the normal proportion of class-switched memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM-/IgD-) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. Marginal zone B cells undergo limited somatic hypermutation and produce high-affinity IgM and some IgG, whereas class-switched memory B cells synthetize IgG, IgM, and IgA." Marginal zone B cells undergo limited somatic hypermutation and produce high-affinity IgM and some IgG, whereas class-switched memory B cells synthetize IgG, IgM, and IgA." fields.label: Abnormal circulating thromboxane concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of a thromboxane. Thromboxanes are derived from prostaglandin precursors in platelets, and stimulate aggregation of platelets and constriction of blood vessels." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Reduced circulating leukotriene C4 concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally decreased concentration of leukotriene C4 in the blood circulation." [PMID:9820300]

fields.label: Spoken word recognition deficit
fields.definition: "Reduced ability of lexical discrimination, which refers to the process of distinguishing a stimulus word from other phonologically similar words. Lexical discrimination can be defined as the process of correctly identifying words in the mental lexicon to match the phonological input of a stimulus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Choroid plexus carcinoma
fields.definition: "Intraventricular papillary neoplasm derived from choroid plexus epithelium. Plexus tumors are most common in the lateral and fourth ventricles; while 80% of lateral ventricle tumors present in children, fourth ventricle tumors are evenly distributed in all age groups. Clinically, choroid plexus tumors tend to cause hydrocephalus and increased intracranial pressure. Histologically, choroid plexus papillomas correspond to WHO grade I, choroid plexus carcinomas to WHO grade III." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11135453]

fields.label: Endolymphatic sac tumor
fields.definition: "A low-grade papillary epithelial neoplasm (adenocarcinoma) with a slow growth pattern. The endolymphatic duct emerges from the posterior wall of the saccule (of the inner ear) and ends in a blind pouch, the endolymphatic sac. Endolymphatic sac tumors (ELSTs) are known under different names in the literature (Heffner tumor, aggressive papillary middle ear tumor, and low-grade adenocarcinoma of endolymphatic sac origin)." [PMID:24966979]
synonyms: Low-grade adenocarcinoma of endolymphatic sac origin
fields.synonyms_concat: Aggressive papillary middle ear tumor; Aggressive papillary middle ear tumour; Endolymphatic sac tumour; Heffner tumor; Heffner tumour; Low-grade adenocarcinoma of endolymphatic sac origin

fields.label: Fallopian tube carcinoma
fields.definition: "Carcinoma that originates in the Fallopian tube. It may be located in the wall or within the lumen as a growth attached to the wall by a stalk." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, NCIT:C3867]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet granule secretion
fields.definition: "Platelets are replete with secretory granules, which are critical to normal platelet function. Among the three types of platelet secretory granules - alpha-granules, dense granules, and lysosomes - the alpha-granule is the most abundant. Granule contents must be released from their intracellular repository in order to achieve their physiologic function, and this term refers to a functional defect in granule secretion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19450911]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet dense granule secretion
fields.definition: "Abnormal release of dense granules from platelets." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet ATP dense granule secretion
fields.definition: "Abnormal secretion of the platelet dense-granule content adenosine triphosphate (ATP)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal platelet atp dense granule secretion

fields.label: Abnormal platelet alpha granule secretion
fields.definition: "Abnormal release of alpha granule contents from platelets." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet lysosome secretion
fields.definition: "Abnormal release of lysosome contents from platelets." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal platelet dense granule ATP/ADP ratio
fields.definition: "Deviation from normal of the ratio of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) to adenosine diphosphate (ADP) within platelets." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal platelet dense granule atp/adp ratio

fields.label: Abnormal platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "An abnormality in the rate and degree to which platelets aggregate after the addition of an agonist that stimulates platelet clumping. Platelet aggregation is measured using aggregometer to measure the optical density of platelet-rich plasma, whereby platelet aggregation causes the plasma to become more transparent." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Spontaneous platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Clumping together of platelets in the blood in a platelet aggregation test without addition of agents normally used to induce aggregation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Glucagonoma
fields.definition: "An endocrine tumor of the pancreas that secretes excessive amounts of glucagon." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Pancreatic endocrine tumor
fields.definition: "A neuroendocrine tumor originating in a hormone-producing cell (islet cell) of the pancreas." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pancreatic endocrine tumour

fields.label: Primary peritoneal carcinoma
fields.definition: "A type of cancer that originates in the peritoneum. It is to be distinguished from metastatic cancer of the peritoneum. Peritoneal cancer can occur anywhere in the abdominal space, and affects the surface of organs contained inside the peritoneum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Pineocytoma
fields.definition: "A type of pineal parenchymal cell neoplasm that is a mature well-differentiated tumor (WHO grade I)." []

fields.label: Pineoblastoma
fields.definition: "Pineoblastoma is a rare primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) arising in the pineal gland. Pineoblastomas are classified as a WHO grade IV tumor and comprise one-fourth to one-half of pineal parenchymal tumors. Pineoblastoma is a highly cellular tumor originating in the pineal gland and containing small, poorly differentiated cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21717450]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pinealoblastoma

fields.label: Renal transitional cell carcinoma
fields.definition: "A malignant tumor that arises from the transitional (urothelial) epithelial cells lining the urinary tract from the renal calyces to the ureteral orifice." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: renal TCC; Renal urothelial carcinoma; Transitional renal cell carcinoma

fields.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
fields.definition: "A carcinoma that arises in a sebaseous gland (an exocrine gland of the skin that secretes sebum, a waxy substance)" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sebaceous carcinoma

fields.label: Jejunal adenocarcinoma
fields.definition: "A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the jejunum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Ileal adenocarcinoma
fields.definition: "A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the ileum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue
fields.definition: "A carcinoma derived from a squamous epithelial cell of the tongue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue

fields.label: Verrucous cell carcinoma of the tongue
fields.definition: "A low-grade variant of squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue with a warty (verrucous) appearance." []
fields.label_normalized: verrucous cell carcinoma of the tongue

fields.label: Sarcomatoid carcinoma of the tongue
fields.definition: "Sarcomatoid (spindle cell) carcinomas of the tongue is a variant of squamous carcinoma of tongue that is monoclonal, having evolved from a conventional squamous carcinoma with dedifferentiation associated with sarcomatoid transformation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20730609]
synonyms: Spindle cell carcinoma of the tongue
fields.synonyms_concat: Spindle cell carcinoma of the tongue

fields.label: Vulvar neoplasm
fields.definition: "A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the female external genital tract (vulva)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neoplasm of the vulva; Tumor of the vulva; Tumour of the vulva

fields.label: Squamous cell carcinoma of the vulva
fields.definition: "A cancer that originates in the squamous cells that line the surface of the vulva." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25848321]
fields.label_normalized: squamous cell carcinoma of the vulva
fields.synonyms_concat: Vulval squamous cell carcinoma

fields.label: Vulvar melanoma
fields.definition: "A type of vulvar cancer that originates from melanocytes of the vulva." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:8723827]

fields.label: Bartholin gland carcinoma
fields.definition: "A cancer arising in a cell of the Bartholin gland, a racemose gland located slightly posterior to the opening of the vagina." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25013508]

fields.label: Vulvar adenocarcinoma
fields.definition: "An adenocarcinoma arising in the vulva." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23761517]

fields.label: Epididymal neoplasm

fields.synonyms_concat: Epididymal cysts

fields.label: Calcified ovarian cyst

fields.label: Ossifying fibroma
fields.definition: "A benign central bone tumor composed of fibrous connective tissue within which bone is formed." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Ossifying fibroma of the jaw
fields.definition: "A benign central bone tumor of the jaw composed of fibrous connective tissue within which bone is formed." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
fields.definition: "A benign but highly vascular nasopharyngeal neoplasm. The tumor originates from the sphenopalatine foramen and involves both the pterygopalatine fossa and the posterior nasal cavity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15661706]

fields.label: Neuroma
fields.definition: "A tumor made up of nerve cells and nerve fibers." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Nerve tumor; Nerve tumour; Pinched nerve

fields.label: Osteochondroma
fields.definition: "A cartilage capped bony outgrowth of a long bone. Osteochondroma arises on the external surface of bone containing a marrow cavity that is continuous with that of the underlying bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18271966]
fields.synonyms_concat: Osteocartilaginous exostoses; Osteochondromas

fields.label: Chondroblastoma
fields.definition: "A usually benign tumor composed of cells which arise from chondroblasts or their precursors and which tend to differentiate into cartilage cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19387641]

fields.label: Osteoid osteoma
fields.definition: "A bening tumor of bone composed of a central zone named nidus which is an atypical bone completely enclosed within a well vascularized stroma and a peripheral sclerotic reaction zone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23329939]

fields.label: Pilomatrixoma
fields.definition: "Pilomatricoma is an asymptomatic slowly growing benign cutaneous tumor, differentiating towards the hair matrix of the hair follicle. It is covered by normal or hyperemic skin, and usually varies in size from 0.5 to 3 cm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21430899]

fields.label: Fibrofolliculoma
fields.definition: "Fibrofolliculoma is a clinically asymptomatic, 2-4 mm, skin-colored, dome-shaped smooth papule. It usually arises in the form of multiple lesions in adults in different areas such as the scalp, forehead, face, and neck. According to histology, the lesion is a fibrotic hamartoma characterized by infundibular epithelial proliferation and perifollicular fibrous proliferation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17804924]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fibrofolliculomas

fields.label: Anal margin squamous cell carcinoma

fields.label: Pulmonary carcinoid tumor
fields.definition: "A malignant neuroendocrine tumor of the lung. According to histopathologic criteria (WHO 2004), carcinoids are divided into four groups i.e. typical and atypical carcinoids, large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma and small cell lung carcinoma." fields.label: Merkel cell skin cancer
fields.definition: "A malignant cutaneous tumor of the elderly that is characterized by an aggressive course with regional nodal involvement, distant metastases and a high rate of recurrence. Most patients present with rapidly growing, painless, firm, non-tender, dome-shaped red, occasionally ulcerated skin nodules, which have a red or bluish color, measuring up to several centimeters, on predominantly sun-exposed areas of the body. The overlying skin is smooth and shiny, sometimes exhibiting ulcerative, acneiform or telangiectatic features." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16565213]
synonyms: Merkel cell cancer of the skin

fields.label: Soft tissue sarcoma
fields.definition: "A type of sarcoma (A connective tissue neoplasm formed by proliferation of mesodermal cells) that develops from soft tissues like fat, muscle, nerves, fibrous tissues, blood vessels, or deep skin tissues." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Soft tissue sarcomas

fields.label: Therapeutic abortion
fields.definition: "Delivery by means of therapeutic termination of pregnancy. Therapeutic abortion may be done to end a pregnancy if the mother's life is in danger or if the baby has abnormalities involving the major organ systems and is not expected to survive after birth or by choice." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Chylolymphatic mesenteric cyst
fields.definition: "A type of mesenteric cyst that is lined with a thin endothelium or mesothelium and filled with chylous and lymphatic fluid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19946589]

fields.definition: "Moderate reduction of the ability to see. On the 6m visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 6/18 but at least 6/60. On the 20ft visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 20/70 but at least 20/200. On the decimal visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 0.3 but at least 0.1." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:28779882]
fields.synonyms_concat: Moderate reduction in visual acuity; Moderate vision loss; Moderate visual impairment; Moderate visual loss

fields.synonyms_concat: Heteronymous hemianopsia

fields.synonyms_concat: Congruous hemianopsia

fields.label: Mild constriction of peripheral visual field
fields.definition: "A diminution of the peripheral visual field whereby at least 50 degrees of central field are preserved in all meridians." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.label_normalized: mild constriction of peripheral visual field
fields.synonyms_concat: Mild peripheral visual field loss

fields.label: Moderate constriction of peripheral visual field
fields.definition: "Peripheral visual field constriction with 20-49 degrees binocular visual field preserved." []
fields.label_normalized: moderate constriction of peripheral visual field
fields.synonyms_concat: Moderate peripheral visual field loss

fields.label: Severe constriction of peripheral visual field
fields.definition: "Peripheral visual field constriction with 10-19 degrees central field preserved." []
fields.label_normalized: severe constriction of peripheral visual field
fields.synonyms_concat: Severe peripheral visual field loss

fields.label: Very severe constriction of peripheral visual field
fields.definition: "Peripheral visual field constriction with <10 degrees central field preserved." []
synonyms: Very severe peripheral visual field loss

fields.synonyms_concat: Very severe peripheral visual field loss

fields.label: Ring scotoma
fields.definition: "An annular field defect centered on fixation." [PMID:30581310]
fields.synonyms_concat: Annular scotoma

fields.label: Arcuate scotoma
fields.synonyms_concat: Arc-shaped blind spot

fields.label_normalized: visual acuity light perception with projection

fields.label: Visual acuity light perception without projection
fields.label_normalized: visual acuity light perception without projection

fields.label: Color vision test abnormality
fields.synonyms_concat: Colour vision test abnormality

fields.label: Abnormal visual field test
fields.definition: "Abnormal result of a test designed to test an individual's central and peripheral vision by determining the ability of the individual to perceive objects at differing locations of the visual field." []

fields.label: Abnormal Esterman grid perimetry test
fields.definition: "The Esterman grid test assays scores visual acuity. The grid consists of 100 units whose unequal size and distribution reflect the unequal functional value of different parts of the field-in effect a weighted or relative-value scale. Because each unit equals 1 percent, a simple count of units yields the functional score in percent." [PMID:5694282]

fields.label: Abnormal fundus autofluorescence imaging
fields.definition: "Fundus autofluorescence (FAF) is a non-invasive retinal imaging modality used in clinical practice to provide a density map of lipofuscin, the predominant ocular fluorophore, in the retinal pigment epithelium. Autofluorescent patterns result from the complex interaction of fluorophores such a lipofuscin, which release an autofluorescent signal, and elements such as melanin and rhodopsin, which absorb the excitation beam and attenuate autofluorescence. Other structures such as retinal vessels and the crystalline lens may also influence autofluorescence through blocking and interference." [PMID:27847630]

fields.label: Abnormal optical coherence tomography
fields.definition: "Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is an optical method for cross-sectional imaging with a resolution approaching that of histopathology and a depth of penetration of a few mm. In ophthalmology, OCT has become a standard of care for retinal imaging. This term groups abnormal findings that are considered OCT-specific." [PMID:36751306]

fields.label: Abnormal fundus fluorescein angiography
fields.definition: "An abnormality observed by retinal fluorescein angiography, which involves the intravenous injection of fluorescein dye followed by fluorescent imaging of the fundus immediately after injection and for up to ten minutes thereafter. It can be used to study various retinal abnormalities including especially anomalies of the choroidal and retinal circulation." []

fields.label: Photoreceptor layer loss on macular OCT
fields.definition: "Loss of the outer nuclear layer (photoreceptor layer) as assessed by ocular coherence tomography." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: photoreceptor layer loss on macular oct

fields.label: Photoreceptor outer segment loss on macular OCT
fields.label_normalized: photoreceptor outer segment loss on macular oct

fields.label_normalized: retinal pigment epithelial loss on macular oct

fields.label_normalized: abnormal retinal morphology on macular oct

fields.label_normalized: abnormal foveal morphology on macular oct

fields.label_normalized: foveal photoreceptor layer loss on macular oct

fields.label_normalized: foveal photoreceptor outer segment loss on macular oct

fields.label_normalized: foveal retinal pigment epithelial loss on macular oct

fields.label_normalized: foveal inner retinal layer loss on macular oct

fields.label: Hyperautofluorescent macular lesion
fields.definition: "Increased amount of autofluorescence in the macula as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging." [PMID:27847630]

fields.label: Hypoautofluorescent macular lesion
fields.definition: "Decreased amount of autofluorescence in the macula as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging." [PMID:27847630]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypo-autofluorescent macular lesion

fields.label: Perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence surrounded by normal autofluorescence
fields.label_normalized: perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence surrounded by normal autofluorescence

fields.label: Perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence surrounded by abnormal autofluorescence
fields.label_normalized: perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence surrounded by abnormal autofluorescence

fields.label: Retinal dystrophy with early macular involvement
fields.label_normalized: retinal dystrophy with early macular involvement

fields.label: Occult macular dystrophy
fields.definition: "Occult macular dystrophy is a, typically hereditary, abnormality of the macula associated with progressive foveal cone dysfunction and no apparent fundoscopic, full-field electroretinogram (ERG), or fluorescein angiogram abnormalities." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Congenital stationary cone dysfunction
fields.definition: "Retinal phenotype characterized by cone photoreceptor dysfunction and preserved rod system. The abnormality is typically stationary or very slowly progressive and findings may include reduced central vision, color vision abnormalities, nystagmus and photophobia." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cone dysfunction; Cone dysfunction syndrome

fields.label: Congenital stationary night blindness with normal fundus
fields.label_normalized: congenital stationary night blindness with normal fundus

fields.label: Congenital stationary night blindness with abnormal fundus
fields.label_normalized: congenital stationary night blindness with abnormal fundus

fields.label: Fundus albipunctatus
fields.definition: "Widespread white lesions of uniform, small and round appearance." []

fields.label: Blind-spot enlargement
fields.synonyms_concat: Blind spot enlargement

fields.label: Central
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is located close to the median plane or midline of the body or of the referenced structure." []

fields.label: Midperipheral
fields.synonyms_concat: Mid-peripheral

fields.label: Vitreous haze
fields.definition: "Vitreous haze is the obscuration of fundus details by vitreous cells and protein exudation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20719302]

fields.label: Umbilical cord cyst
fields.definition: "Any cystic lesion associated with the umbilical cord." [PMID:10206815, PMID:12666213]

fields.label: Umbilical cord knot
fields.definition: "An entwining of a segment of umbilical cord, usually without obstructing fetal circulation and commonly result from fetal slippage through a loop of the cord." [PMID:25184085]

fields.label: Umbilical vein varix
fields.definition: "Focal dilation of the umbilical vein." []

fields.label: Umbilical cord hematoma
fields.definition: "Bleeding from the vessels of the cord with extravasation of blood into the Wharton jelly surrounding the umbilical cord vessels." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Umbilical cord haematoma

fields.label: Marginal umbilical cord insertion
fields.definition: "Insertion of the umbilical cord within 2 cm from the placental edge." [PMID:26366000, PMID:29201670]
fields.synonyms_concat: Battledore placenta; Marginal cord insertion

fields.label: Velamentous cord insertion
fields.definition: "Insertion of the umbilical cord into the chorio-amniotic membranes of the placenta." [PMID:26366000]

fields.label: Furcate cord insertion
fields.definition: "Branching of the umbilical cord before its insertion into the placenta." []

fields.label: Vitreous snowballs
fields.definition: "Yellow-white inflammatory aggregates in the vitreous that are found in the midvitreous and inferior periphery." [PMID:20029143]

fields.label: Vitreous inflammatory cells
fields.definition: "The presence of inflammatory cells such as lymphocytes and macrophages in the vitreous." []

fields.label: Optically empty vitreous
fields.definition: "Vestigial vitreous gel occupying the immediate retrolental space and minimal to no discernible gel in the central vitreous cavity, giving the appearance of an empty vitreous cavity." [PMID:15557460, PMID:7867814]

fields.label: Beevor's sign
fields.definition: "Weakness of the inferior portion of the rectus abdominal muscle, which is ascertained clinically as follows. When a patient sits up or raises the head from a recumbent position, the umbilicus is displaced toward the head. This is the result of paralysis of the inferior portion of the rectus abdominal muscle, so that the upper fibers predominate pulling upwards the umbilicus." [PMID:2146943]

fields.label: Rubral tremor
fields.definition: "Rubral tremor is characterized by a slow coarse tremor at rest that is exacerbated by postural adjustments and by guided voluntary movements." [PMID:6568936]
fields.synonyms_concat: Holmes' tremor

fields.label: Retinal neovascularization
fields.definition: "In ischemic retinal disease, neovascularization (NV) involves the sprouting of new vessels from pre-existent vessels. Ischemia invariably leads to the upregulation of Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF) production. Most frequently the new vessels grow internal to the plane of the retina. However, intraretinal proliferation of new vessels can also occur." [PMID:23329331]
fields.synonyms_concat: Retinal vascular proliferation

fields.label: Peripheral retinal neovascularization
fields.definition: "A type of retinal neovascularization that affects the periphery of the retina." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22076700]

fields.label: Periorbital dermoid cyst
fields.definition: "A cyst that is localized in the region of the orbit and exhibits an epithelial lining with a keratin-filled lumen. Hair follicles are one of the adnexal structures that are commonly found in walls of dermoid cysts." []

fields.label: Abnormal ocular adnexa morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the adjacent structures (i.e., adnexa) of the eye, defined as the lacrimal apparatus, the extraocular muscles and the eyelids, eyelashes, eyebrows and the conjunctiva." []

fields.label: Hamartoma of the orbital region
fields.definition: "A hamartoma (disordered proliferation of mature tissues) which can originate from any tissue of the orbital region." []

fields.label: Abnormal common tendinous ring morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the ring of fibrous tissue that surrounds the optic nerve at its entrance at the apex of the orbit. The common tendinous ring, also known as the annulus of Zinn or annular tendon, is the origin for five of the seven extraocular muscles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
synonyms: Abnormality of the common tendinous ring
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the common tendinous ring

fields.label: Asteroid hyalosis
fields.definition: "The presence of small, white vitreous opacities consisting of calcium phosphate and complex, layered lipid deposits." []

fields.label: Erosive vitreoretinopathy
fields.definition: "A form of vitreoretinopathy characterized by thinning (erosion) of the retinal pigment epithelium that permits increased visualization of the choroidal vessels." [PMID:8152765]

fields.label: Antenatal onset
fields.definition: "Onset prior to birth." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intrauterine onset; Onset in utero; Prenatal onset

fields.label: Contracture of proximal interphalangeal joints of 2nd-5th fingers
fields.definition: "Chronic loss of joint motion of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th fingers due to structural changes in non-bony tissue." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jdavis]
fields.label_normalized: contracture of proximal interphalangeal joints of 2nd-5th fingers

fields.label: Satyr ear
fields.definition: "Sharp pointed superior portion of the ear, with variable overfolding of the helix." [PMID:19152421]
fields.synonyms_concat: Devil ear

fields.label: Mozart ear
fields.definition: "A congenital auricular deformity, which is mainly characterized by a bulging appearance of the anterosuperior portion of the auricle, a convexly protruded cavum conchae, and a slit-like narrowing of the orifice of the external auditory meatus." [PMID:21587051]

fields.label: Ash-leaf spot
fields.definition: "A hypopigmented spot in the shape of a leaf from the mountain ash tree." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23761491, PMID:9637809]

fields.label: Abnormal cardiovascular system morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the heart and blood vessels." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of cardiovascular system morphology; Cardiovascular malformations

fields.label: Abnormal morphology of myocardial trabeculae
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the right and left ventricles of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae)." []

fields.label: Left ventricular noncompaction
fields.definition: "Left ventricular noncompaction (LVNC) is defined by 3 markers: prominent left ventricular (LV) trabeculae, deep intertrabecular recesses, and the thin compacted layer." [PMID:16670098, PMID:25443708]

fields.label: Recurrent bacterial vaginosis
fields.definition: "Repeated symptomatic episodes of inflammation of the vagina that can result from a spectrum of conditions that cause vaginal and sometimes vulvar symptoms, such as itching, burning, irritation, odor, and vaginal discharge." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Vaginitis; Vulvovaginitis

fields.label: Abnormal adiponectin level
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue, and that plays a crucial role in the regulation of insulin sensitivity and glucose metabolism." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26221520]

fields.label: Decreased adiponectin level
fields.definition: "A reduced circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Increased adiponectin level
fields.definition: "An elevated circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue." []

fields.label: Abnormal glucagon level
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Increased glucagon level
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Decreased glucagon level
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Gingival cleft
fields.definition: "A fissure in the gingiva (gums), i.e., the mucosal tissue that lies over the mandible and maxilla." []

fields.label: Divergence nystagmus
fields.definition: "A condition in which both eyes beat outward simultaneously." []

fields.label: Brain neoplasm
fields.definition: "A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from or metastasizes to the brain." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Brain tumor; Brain tumour

fields.label: Supratentorial neoplasm
fields.definition: "A benign or malignant neoplasm that occurs within the intracranial cavity above the tentorium cerebelli." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pineal parenchymal tumor; Pineal parenchymal tumour

fields.label: Ranula
fields.definition: "A ranula is a mucocele that occurs in the floor of the mouth and usually involve the major salivary glands. Specifically, the ranula originates in the body of the sublingual gland, in the ducts of the sublingual gland, in the Wharton's duct of the submandibular gland or infrequently from the minor salivary glands at this location." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:23291329]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sublingual cyst; Sublingual ptyalocele

fields.label: Unilateral lung agenesis
fields.definition: "Lack of development of one lung." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Unilateral pulmonary agenesis

fields.label: Myeloschisis
fields.definition: "The severe form of a neural tube defect where the open neural tube appears as a flattened, plate-like mass of nervous tissue with no overlying membrane." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:20885122]

fields.label: Myelocystocele
fields.definition: "Myelocystocele is characterized by a large, ependyma-lined, cystic dilation of the caudal end of the central canal of the spinal cord; it projects dorsally through a lamina defect, with overlying varying amounts of lipomatous subcutaneous tissue. Myelocystoceles are associated with a tethered cord and meningocele, which communicates with the spinal subarachnoid space, but not with the central canal cyst." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:9514174]

fields.label: Lipomeningocele
fields.definition: "A form of closed neural tube defect in which the spinal tissue lies within the spinal cord having a junction between the spinal cord and the lipoma. Intact skin covers the defect. Neurologic findings first appear during the second year of life." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Hydrocolpos
fields.definition: "Distention of the vagina caused by accumulation of fluid due to congenital vaginal obstruction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Uterine synechiae
fields.definition: "Adhesions or scar tissue that form inside the cavity of the uterus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Asherman syndrome

fields.label: Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformation
fields.definition: "Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformation is a choroidal type of arteriovenous malformation that develops between 6 and 11 weeks of gestation. It results from 1 or more arteriovenous fistulas shunting blood toward the prosencephalic vein of Markowski, the embryonic precursor of the vein of Galen. This abnormal shunt leads to progressive dilation of the vein and prevents its involution and subsequent development into the vein of Galen." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:32706613, PMID:33168212]
fields.synonyms_concat: Median prosencephalic arteriovenous fistula; Vein of Galen aneurysm; Vein of Galen malformation

fields.label: Subchorionic thrombohematoma
fields.definition: "A large maternal clot that separates the chorionic plate from the villous chorion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:11125254]
fields.synonyms_concat: Breus' mole

fields.label: Bronchial atresia
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly characterized by focal obliteration of the proximal segment of a bronchus. The bronchial pattern is entirely normal distal to the site of stenosis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Congenital bronchial atresia

fields.label: Acrania
fields.definition: "Partial or complete absence of the flat bones of the cranial vault. The condition is frequently, though not always, associated with anencephaly." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Meconium peritonitis
fields.definition: "Peritonitis caused by intrauterine intestinal rupture and spillage of fetal meconium into the fetal peritoneal cavity. Intra-peritoneal meconium usually calcifies, sometimes within 24 hours. Ultrasound findings may include intraabdominal calcifications." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:3317498]

fields.label: Right atrial enlargement
fields.definition: "Increase in size of the right atrium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dilated right atrium; Enlarged heart right atrium; Right atrial dilatation

fields.label: Unguarded tricuspid valve
fields.definition: "A form of agenesis of the tricuspid valve in which (although the normal orifice between the right atrium and right ventricle exists) there is no tricuspid valvular tissue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:14246338]
fields.synonyms_concat: Rudimentary tricuspid valve leaflets; Unguarded tricuspid valve orifice

fields.label: Subchorionic septal cyst
fields.definition: "Cyst on the surface of the placenta consisting of amnion and chorion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Tetraphocomelia
fields.definition: "Phocomelia involving all four extremities." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Ectopic liver
fields.definition: "Ectopic liver is a rare developmental anomaly in which liver tissue is situated outside the liver. Thus, ectopic liver refers to autonomous islands of normal liver parenchyma located outside the liver. The term ectopic liver is also used, to include liver appendices attached to the native liver by a thin stalk although being fully separated from the latter." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11988792, PMID:637502]

fields.label: Congenital megalourethra
fields.definition: "Dilation and elongation of the penile urethra associated with absence or hypoplasia of the corpora spongiosa and cavernosa." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:20981865]

fields.label: Central nervous system cyst
fields.definition: "A fluid-filled sac (cyst) located within the central nervous system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11593239, PMID:24455569]
synonyms: Cyst of the central nervous system
fields.synonyms_concat: CNS cyst; Cyst of the central nervous system

fields.label: Neurenteric cyst
fields.definition: "The neurenteric cyst is a rare lesion composed of heterotopic endodermal tissue. During the third week of human embryogenesis, the neurenteric canal unites the yolk sac and the amniotic cavity as it traverses the primitive notochordal plate. Persistence of the normally transient neurenteric canal prevents appropriate separation of endoderm and notochord. This results in a variable degree of communication between neural and enteric epithelium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:20890417]

fields.label: Spinal neurenteric cyst
fields.definition: "A neurenteric cyst located in the spine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Intracranial neurenteric cyst
fields.definition: "A neurenteric cyst located within the skull." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Meromelia
fields.definition: "Partial absence of a free limb (excluding girdle). It can refer to the proximal, middle or distal segment of the upper or lower limb. The deficiency may be transverse or longitudinal. Thus, meromelia is a lack of a part, but not all, of one or more limbs with the presence of a hand or foot." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Frontoethmoidal meningocele
fields.definition: "A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull at the junction of the frontal and ethmoidal bones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Frontoethmoid meningocele

fields.label: Parietal meningocele
fields.definition: "A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull in the parietal region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Carcinoma
fields.definition: "A malignant tumor arising from epithelial cells. Carcinomas that arise from glandular epithelium are called adenocarcinomas, those that arise from squamous epithelium are called squamous cell carcinomas, and those that arise from transitional epithelium are called transitional cell carcinomas (NCI Thesaurus)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Dysplastic tricuspid valve
fields.definition: "A congenital malformation of the tricuspid valve characterized by leaflet deformation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:2007717, PMID:26059011]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tricuspid valve dysplasia

fields.label: Vesicoallantoic abdominal wall defect
fields.definition: "An abdominal wall defected related to a developmental anomaly of the allantois, which is an embryonic structure that develops as a diverticulum off the yolk sac at about 16 days post fertilization. During further development, the allantois becomes incorporated into the body of the embryo, connecting the ventral aspect of the urogenital sinus (which will develop into the upper pole of the urinary bladder) to the external portion of the umbilicus. Upon further development, the lumen of the allantois becomes obliterated and forms a thick fibrous cord called the urachus, which connects the apex of the bladder to the umbilicus. In adults, the urachus is known as the median umbilical ligament. Failure of the allantoic cavity to obliterate can result of one of four conditions: 1) congenital patent urachus (a completely open connection between bladder and umbilicus); 2) vesicourachal diverticulum (a diverticulum off the bladder but not communicating with the umbilicus); umbilical cyst and sinus (not communicating with the bladder); and 4) alternating urachal sinus. An abdominal wall defect can be associated with a urachal cyst." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:2521673]

fields.label: Ureterovesical junction obstruction
fields.definition: "Blockage at the level of the bladder and the ureter caused by stenosis of the ureteral valves or failure of a narrow juxtavesical ureteral segment to dilate due to segmented fibrosis or localized absence of muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Sacrococcygeal teratoma
fields.definition: "A teratoma arising in the sacro-coccygeal region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Altman type I sacrococcygeal teratoma
fields.definition: "A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly external and projects from the sacrococcygeal region and presents with distortion of the buttocks." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Altman type II sacrococcygeal teratoma
fields.definition: "A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly external but has a large intrapelvic component." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma
fields.definition: "A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly intrapelvic with a small external, buttock mass." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Anomalous muscle bundle of the right ventricle
fields.definition: "An accessory (not normally present) muscle bundle in the right ventricle which obstructs the right ventricular outflow tract." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous muscle bundle of the right ventricle
fields.synonyms_concat: Right ventricular anomalous muscle bundle

fields.label: Mediastinal teratoma
fields.definition: "A teratoma located within the mediastinum (the cavity between the pleural sacs that contains the heart and all of the thoracic viscera except the lungs)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Teratoma of the mediastinum

fields.label: Glial remnants posterior to lens
fields.definition: "This anomaly, also known as Mittendorf dot, is a benign, nonprogressive recognizable lesion that does not cause visual impairment. However, it can resemble a pathological congenital or acquired cataract lesion which may enlarge and cause visual impairment. The dot appears as a black speck that ranges in size from the dot made by a sharp pencil point to the size of a poppy seed. It is usually well defined, although occasionally there may be irregular, fine lines radiating outward from the dot." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Mittendorf dot

fields.label: Glial remnants anterior to the optic disc
fields.definition: "Persistence of a posterior remnant of the hyaloid artery located at the optic disc." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: glial remnants anterior to the optic disc
fields.synonyms_concat: Bergmeister papilla

fields.label: Hyaloid vascular remnant and retrolental mass
fields.definition: "A type of persistence of the hyaloid vascular system associated with a retrolental mass that may lead to fetal cataract." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: hyaloid vascular remnant and retrolental mass

fields.label: Dilatation of the ductus arteriosus
fields.definition: "Ductus arteriosus aneurysm (DAA) is a saccular dilatation of the ductus arteriosus. DAA can be either congenital or acquired (e.g. as a complication of surgical closure of a patent ductus arteriosus). Although the majority of patients with congenital DAA are asymptomatic and have a benign course, severe complications, such as rupture or thromboembolism, can occur. DAA is likely to emerge in the third trimester from the aortic junction of the DA, extending towards its pulmonary end." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:10898444, PMID:11788230, PMID:27433265, PMID:29656824]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aneurysm of the ductus arteriosus; Congenital ductus arteriosus aneurysm; Ductus arteriosus aneurysm

fields.label: Intraventricular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Bleeding into the ventricles of the brain." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intraventricular haemorrhage

fields.label: Preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a premature infant." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Preterm intraventricular haemorrhage

fields.label: Grade I preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that is restricted to subependymal region/germline matrix which is seen in the caudothalamic groove." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25371784]
fields.synonyms_concat: Germinal matrix haemorrhage; Germinal matrix hemorrhage; Grade I preterm intraventricular haemorrhage

fields.label: Grade II preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that has extension into normal-sized ventricles and typically fills less than 50% of the volume of the ventricle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade II preterm intraventricular haemorrhage

fields.label: Grade III preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that has extension into dilated ventricles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade III preterm intraventricular haemorrhage

fields.label: Grade IV preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that shows parenchymal extension." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade IV preterm intraventricular haemorrhage

fields.label: Dacryocystocele
fields.definition: "A nasolacrimal duct obstruction presenting as a grey-blue cystic swelling just below the medial canthus. Believed to be a result of concomitant upper obstruction of the Rosenmuller valve and lower obstruction of the Hasner valve." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:19205594]
fields.synonyms_concat: Timo cyst

fields.label: Intrauterine fetal demise of one twin after midgestation
fields.definition: "Loss of one twin occurring after midgestation (17 weeks gestation)." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jdavis, PMID:10732306, PMID:2187353, PMID:24361180, PMID:2704493, PMID:9699754]
synonyms: Intrauterine foetal demise of one twin after midgestation
fields.label_normalized: intrauterine fetal demise of one twin after midgestation
fields.synonyms_concat: Intrauterine foetal demise of one twin after midgestation; Single-twin demise

fields.label: Allantoic cyst
fields.definition: "A swelling formed at the base of umbilicus associated with a patent urachus which results from an allantoic remnant. The urachus is a fibrous remnant of the allantois which communicates from the apex of the urinary bladder to the umbilicus. Failed obliteration of the urachus can lead to various abnormalities: urachal cyst, urachal diverticulum, sinus or patent urachus - the most common type.
