Allantoic cysts in infants with patent urachus can be formed due to the drainage of urine into the umbilical cord, or in uncommon situations, after leakage of hypo-osmotic urine into the Wharton's jelly." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:24950576, PMID:26213613]

fields.label: Craniofacial teratoma
fields.definition: "A teratoma located in the craniofacial region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]

fields.label: Erythrodontia
fields.definition: "Reddish, brown opalescent discoloration of teeth in normal light." [PMID:21731282]
fields.synonyms_concat: Red teeth

fields.label: Tooth abscess
fields.definition: "A pocket of pus located within a region of a tooth." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dental abscess; Dentoalveolar abscess

fields.label: Periapical tooth abscess
fields.definition: "A tooth abscess that occurs at the tip of the root (apex) of a tooth." []

fields.label: Adipocyte hypertrophy
fields.definition: "An increase in mean adipocyte cell size. This feature can be measured by determining the average cell diameter of adipocytes microscopically using abdominal subcutaneous adipose tissue obtained by biopsy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25148116]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fat cell hypertrophy

fields.label: Renal fibrosis
fields.definition: "Renal fibrosis is the consequence of an excessive accumulation of extracellular matrix that occurs in virtually every type of chronic kidney disease." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16408108]
fields.synonyms_concat: Kidney fibrosis

fields.label: Mesangiolysis
fields.definition: "Partial or complete dissolution of the mesangial matrix, identified by reduced staining on a periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) or silver stain." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32866505, PMID:6353041]

fields.label: Amniotic Sheet
fields.definition: "A sheet like projection that can result from uterine synechiae that has been encompassed by the expanding chorion and amnion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Amniotic shelf

fields.label: Ochronosis
fields.definition: "Brown or blue-gray discoloration of the skin that can present on the axillary and inguinal areas, face, palms or soles. In addition, blue-black discoloration can be apparent on skin overlying cartilage in which the pigment is deposited, such as the ears. This is a characteristic manifestation of alkaptonuria, which is an autosomal recessively inherited deficiency of homogentisic acid oxidase that results in accumulation of homogentisic acid in collagenous structures. The sclerae are also typically involved." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24447956, PMID:26929770]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ochronotic arthritis

fields.label: Sleep terror
fields.definition: "Autonomic arousal, screaming, sweating, crying, outbursts during sleep, usually no recollection at the individual level; typically observed by others." [PMID:31612833]
fields.synonyms_concat: Night terror; Pavor nocturnus; Sleep terrors; Waking up screaming

fields.label: Ear pain
fields.definition: "Pain in the ear can be a consequence of otologic disease (primary or otogenic otalgia), or can arise from pathologic processes and structures other than the ear (secondary or referred otalgia)." [PMID:20736106]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ear pain; Otalgia; Pain in the ear

fields.label: Epignathus
fields.definition: "Epignathus is a teratoma originating from the upper jaw, usually connected with the sphenoid bone or hard palate." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:19240824]
fields.synonyms_concat: Palatine teratoma

fields.label: Exencephaly
fields.definition: "A malformation of the neural tube with a large amount of protruding brain tissue and absence of calvarium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:21887200]

fields.label: Craniorachischisis
fields.definition: "A neural tube defect in which both the brain and spinal cord remain open to varying degrees." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:22095531]

fields.label: Mallet finger
fields.definition: "Mallet finger refers to a condition in which the end joint of a finger bends but will not straighten by itself. In this situation, the joint can be pushed straight but will not hold that position on its own." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9353-549, PMID:24839413]

fields.label: Proximal femoral focal deficiency
fields.definition: "Proximal femoral focal deficiency is a deformity manifested by hypoplasia of a variable portion of the femur with shortening of the entire limb." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:21438051, PMID:23915863]

fields.label: Internuclear ophthalmoplegia
fields.definition: "An abnormality of conjugate lateral gaze in which the affected eye shows impairment of adduction. The pathognomonic clinical sign of internuclear ophthalmoplegia is an impaired adduction while testing horizontal saccades on the side of the lesion in the ipsilateral medial longitudinal fascicule." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:1344079, PMID:21687160, PMID:25145891]

fields.label: Mitochondrial swelling
fields.definition: "The mitochondrial matrix refers to the substance occupying the space enclosed by the inner membrane of a mitochondrion, which contains enzymes, DNA, granules, and inclusions of protein crystals, glycogen, and lipid. Mitochondrial swelling refers to an increase in size of the mitochondrial matrix. This phenomenon is thought to be related to a permeabilized inner membrane that originates a large swelling in the mitochondrial matrix. Mitochondrial swelling may distend the outer membrane until it ruptures." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22907871]

fields.label: Modic type vertebral endplate changes
fields.definition: "An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate according to a widely used classification published by Dr. Michael Modic." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24162519]

fields.label: Modic type I vertebral endplate changes
fields.definition: "An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a low signal on T1-weighted sequences and high signal on T2-weighted sequences. Modic type I changes are thought to represent bone marrow edema and inflammation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24162519]
fields.label_normalized: modic type i vertebral endplate changes
fields.synonyms_concat: Modic type 1 vertebral endplate changes

fields.label: Modic type II vertebral endplate changes
fields.definition: "An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a high signal on T1-weighted sequences and high- or isointense signal on T2 sequences. Modic type II signals are thought to indicate fatty replacement in the bone marrow." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24162519]
fields.label_normalized: modic type ii vertebral endplate changes
fields.synonyms_concat: Modic type 2 vertebral endplate changes

fields.label: Modic type III vertebral endplate changes
fields.definition: "An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a low signal on T1 and T2-weighted sequences. Modic type III signals are thought to correspond to subchondral sclerosis seen on plain radiographs." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24162519]
fields.label_normalized: modic type iii vertebral endplate changes
fields.synonyms_concat: Modic type 3 vertebral endplate changes

fields.label: Ethmocephaly
fields.definition: "Ethmocephaly is the rarest form of holoprosencephaly, which occurs due to an incomplete cleavage of the forebrain. Clinically, the disease presents with a proboscis, hypotelorism, microphthalmos and malformed ears." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:23248551]

fields.label: Abnormality of the protein C anticoagulant pathway
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the protein C anticoagulant pathway, which serves as a major system for controlling thrombosis, limiting inflammatory responses, and potentially decreasing endothelial cell apoptosis in response to inflammatory cytokines and ischemia. A natural anticoagulant system denoted the protein C pathway exerts its anticoagulant effect by regulating the activity of FVIIIa and FVa. The vitamin K-dependent protein C is the key component of the pathway. Activated protein C (APC) cleaves and inhibits coagulation cofactors FVIIIa and FVa, which result in downregulation of the activity of the coagulation system. The endothelial protein C receptor stimulates the T-TM-mediated activation of protein C on the endothelial cell surface. The two cofactors, protein S and the intact form of FV, enhance the anticoagulant activity of APC." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12970121, PMID:15943976]
fields.label_normalized: abnormality of the protein c anticoagulant pathway

fields.label: Increased circulating free fatty acid level
fields.definition: "A higher than normal levels of the fatty acids which can occur in plasma as a result of lipolysis in adipose tissue or when plasma triacyglycerols are taken into tissues." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.label_normalized: increased circulating free fatty acid level

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 6 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of interleukin-6 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:9883970]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased serum IL-6; Increased serum interleukin-6

fields.label: Anomic aphasia
fields.definition: "An inability to name people and objects that are correctly perceived. The individual is able to describe the object in question, but cannot provide the name." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18348092]
fields.synonyms_concat: Amnesic aphasia; Amnestic aphasia; Anomia; Nominal aphasia; Word-finding difficulty

fields.label: Mediastinal cystic lymphangioma
fields.definition: "A lymphangioma (congenital malformation consisting of focal proliferations of well-differentiated lymphatic tissue in multi cystic or sponge like structures) located within the mediastinum, i.e., the central compartment of the thoracic cavity that is surrounded by loose connective tissue. Mediastinal lymphangioma is a slow growing mass with benign features, and accounts for 1% of all mediastinal tumors." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:25821300]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intrathoracic cystic hygroma; Thoracic cystic lymphangioma

fields.label: Photopsia
fields.definition: "Perceived flashes of light." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10506812]

fields.label: Cerumen abnormality
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the cerumen (ear wax), the yellowish waxy substance secreted in the ear canal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Impacted cerumen
fields.definition: "Blockage of the external auditory canal by a buildup of earwax." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15256605]

fields.label: Excessive cerumen
fields.definition: "An increased quantity of earwax." [PMID:probinson]

fields.label: Abnormal cerumen color
fields.definition: "An anomalous earwax color. Earwax (cerumen) is usually light to dark brown or orange in color." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal cerumen color; Abnormal cerumen pigmentation

fields.label: Abnormal jaw morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the jaw, the bony structure of the mouth that consists of the mandible and the maxilla." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Jaw neoplasm
fields.definition: "A tumor originating in the jaw (mandible or maxilla)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Jaw swelling
fields.definition: "Abnormal enlargement in the upper jaw (maxilla) or in the lower jaw (mandible)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating C-peptide concentration
fields.definition: "An anomalous circulating concentration of the connecting (C) peptide, which links the insulin A and B chains in proinsulin, providing thereby a means to promote their efficient folding and assembly in the endoplasmic reticulum during insulin biosynthesis. After cleavage of proinsulin, C-peptide is stored with insulin in the soluble phase of the secretory granules and is subsequently released in equimolar amounts with insulin, providing a useful independent indicator of insulin secretion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15198367]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal C peptide level; Abnormal C-peptide level

fields.label: Reduced C-peptide level
fields.definition: "A decreased concentration of C-peptide in the circulation. Since C-peptide is secreted in equimolar amounts to insulin, this feature correlates with reduced insulin secretion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced C peptide level

fields.label: Increased C-peptide level
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of C-peptide in the circulation. Since C-peptide is secreted in equimolar amounts to insulin, this feature correlates with increased insulin secretion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased C peptide level

fields.label: Reduced volume of central subdivision of bed nucleus of stria terminalis
fields.definition: "A diminished volume of the central part of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7477289]
fields.label_normalized: reduced volume of central subdivision of bed nucleus of stria terminalis

fields.label: Abnormality of the bed nucleus of stria terminalis
fields.definition: "The stria terminalis is a slender, compact fiber bundle that connects the amygdala (amygdaloid body) with the hypothalamus and other basal forebrain regions. The bed nucleus of the stria terminalis is a limbic forebrain structure that receives heavy projections from, among other areas, the basolateral amygdala, and projects in turn to hypothalamic and brainstem target areas that mediate many of the autonomic and behavioral responses to aversive or threatening stimuli. This term refers to an anomaly of the bed nucleus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12600711]
fields.label_normalized: abnormality of the bed nucleus of stria terminalis

fields.label: Scaphocephaly
fields.definition: "Scaphocephaly is a subtype of dolichocephaly where the anterior and posterior aspects of the cranial vault are pointed (boat-shaped). Scaphocephaly is caused by a precocious fusion of sagittal suture without other associated synostosis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16156241, PMID:23960302]

fields.label: Abnormal visual accommodation
fields.definition: "An anomaly in the process of visual accommodation, which is the process of adjustment of the eye to enable sharp vision of objects at different distances. Accommodation is mediated by contraction of the ciliary muscles, which alter the convexity of the lens and, consequently, its refractive power." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Reduced visual accommodation
fields.definition: "A decreased ability of the eye to adjust and thereby enable sharp vision of objects at different distances." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Lower eyelid retraction
fields.definition: "Inferior malposition of the lower eyelid margin without eyelid eversion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10946945]

fields.label: Platonychia
fields.definition: "Abnormal flat nail." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Trachyonychia
fields.definition: "Excessive longitudinal ridging that gives the surface of the nail plate a rough appearance. It results from multiple foci of defective keratinization of the proximal nail matrix." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22016269, PMID:26273150]

fields.label: Absent lunula
fields.definition: "Lack of the lunula at the base of a nail. The lunula is the crescent-shaped whitish area of the bed of a fingernail or toenail." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent lunulae; Lunula absent; Lunulae absent

fields.label: Fast-growing nails
fields.definition: "Nails whose growth is quicker than normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal nail growth
fields.definition: "Nail whose growth pattern or speed deviates from normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Ragged cuticle
fields.definition: "The cuticle (properly known as the eponychium, or the medial nail fold or the proximal nail fold), is the thickened layer of skin surrounding fingernails and toenails. Its function is to protect the area between the nail and epidermis from exposure to bacteria. This term refers to the presence of and irregular edge or outline of the cuticle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal tongue morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the tongue." []

fields.label: Abnormal tongue physiology
fields.definition: "Any functional anomaly of the tongue." []

fields.label: Tongue pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the tongue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Painful tongue

fields.label: Enlarged tonsils
fields.definition: "Increase in size of the tonsils, small collections of lymphoid tissue facing into the aerodigestive tract on either side of the back part of the throat." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Enlargement of tonsils; Tonsillar hypertrophy; tonsils large/hypertrophy

fields.label: Absent tonsils
fields.definition: "Lack of observable tonsillar tissue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplastic tonsils; Tonsillar hypoplasia

fields.label: Orange discolored tonsils
fields.definition: "A phenomenon of orange colored oral tonsils. This feature is characteristic of Tangier disease and illustrated will by Figure 1 of PMID:19470903." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19470903]
fields.synonyms_concat: Orange colored tonsils; Orange coloured tonsils; Orange discoloured tonsils; Orange tonsils; Tonsils with orange deposits

fields.label: Lipoma of the tongue
fields.definition: "A lipoma localized to the tongue. May present as a nontender, soft, spherical mass of the tongue." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tongue lipoma

fields.label: Gingival recession
fields.definition: "The loss of gum tissue. The result is that gum tissue is recessed and its position on the tooth is lowered, exposing the roots of the teeth." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Gum recession; Receding gums

fields.label: Beaked nails
fields.definition: "Severe nail curvature, causing the tip of the nail to point downwards with respect to the axis of the finger. Beaked nails are caused by resorption of the distal digit." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Central nail canal
fields.definition: "The presence of a depressed line (canal) in the center of the nail." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Median nail dystrophy

fields.label: Ski jump nail
fields.definition: "Nails that slope upward at the free edge." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Upslanting nail; Upward angulation of nail

fields.label: Hooded eyelid
fields.definition: "Eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Hooded lower eyelid
fields.definition: "Lower eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open." []

fields.label: Hooded upper eyelid
fields.definition: "Upper eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open." []

fields.label: Scleral thickening
fields.definition: "Increased dimension of the sclera in the anterior-posterior axis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Thick sclera

fields.label: Mizuo phenomenon
fields.definition: "Change in the color of the fundus from red in the dark-adapted state to golden immediately or shortly after the onset of the light. The color of the fundus reflex in the light adapted state has also been described as golden-yellow, gray-white, and yellow-white. This reflex can appear either homogeneous or in streaks in the fundus. The retinal vessels appear to be protruding in contrast to the radiant background. Dark adaptation leads to disappearance of the unusual fundus coloration [Digital Journal of Ophthalmology 2008; Volume 14, Number 14]." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mizuo-Nakamura phenomenon

fields.label: Absent foveal reflex
fields.definition: "Absent reflectivity of the fovea, which normally is a bright pinpoint of light that is observed to move sideways or up and down in response to movement of the opthalmoscope." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27491360]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foveal reflex absent; Loss of foveal reflex

fields.label: Eyelid fasciculation
fields.definition: "Tiny, repetitive muscle contractions in the eyelids, causing the appearance of twitching." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eyelid fluttering; Fasciculation of the eyelid; Muscle twitches in eye lid; Muscle twitches in eyelid; Twitching around eyes

fields.label: Wheezing
fields.definition: "A high-pitched whistling sound associated with labored breathing." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26229557]
fields.synonyms_concat: Wheezing

fields.label: Abnormal breath sound
fields.definition: "An anomalous (adventitious) sound produced by the breathing process." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal lung auscultation finding

fields.label: Crackles
fields.definition: "Crackles are discontinuous, explosive, and nonmusical adventitious lung sounds normally heard in inspiration and sometimes during expiration. Crackles are usually classified as fine and coarse crackles based on their duration, loudness, pitch, timing in the respiratory cycle, and relationship to coughing and changing body position." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:26229557]
fields.synonyms_concat: Crepitations; Rales

fields.label: Rhonchi
fields.definition: "Abnormal breath sounds characterized by low-pitched, snoring or rattle-like sounds." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:26229557]

fields.label: Vitreous strands
fields.definition: "Fiber- or rope-like opacities located within the vitreous humor." []

fields.label: Neck pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the neck." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neck pain

fields.label: Shoulder pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the shoulder." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Shoulder pain

fields.label: Elbow pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the elbow." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elbow pain

fields.label: Wrist pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the wrist." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Wrist pain

fields.label: Finger pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the finger." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Finger pain

fields.label: Hip pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the hip." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hip pain

fields.label: Knee pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the knee." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Knee pain; Pain under knee cap

fields.label: Ankle pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the ankle." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ankle pain

fields.label: Toe pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the toe." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Toe pain

fields.label: Choking episodes
fields.definition: "Incidents in which a piece of food or other objects get stuck in the upper airway and provoke coughing, gagging, inability to talk, and difficulty breathing." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cardiac amyloidosis
fields.definition: "Extracellular deposition in cardiac tissue of a proteinaceous material that, when stained with Congo red, demonstrates apple-green birefringence under polarized light and that has a distinct color when stained with sulfated Alcian blue. Viewed with electron microscopy, the amyloid deposits are seen to be composed of a beta-sheet fibrillar material. These nonbranching fibrils have a diameter of 7.5 to 10 nm and are the result of protein misfolding." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16186440]
fields.synonyms_concat: Amyloid cardiomyopathy

fields.label: Undetectable pattern electroretinogram
fields.definition: "Absent response to a pattern electroretinogram (PERG)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Heliotrope rash of eyelid
fields.definition: "Heliotrope rash is a violaceous discoloration of the eyelids associated with periorbital edema." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12786876, PMID:25587479]

fields.label: Abnormality of venous physiology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of venous function." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal jugular venous pressure
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the jugular venous pressure. The internal jugular veins, being continuous with the superior vena cava, provide a visible measure of the degree to which the systemic venous reservoir is filled. The vertical height above the right atrium to which they are distended and above which they are in a collapsed state provides an imperfect reflection of the right atrial pressure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24085809]

fields.label: Elevated jugular venous pressure
fields.definition: "Increased jugular venous pressure." []

fields.label: Hepatojugular reflux
fields.definition: "The examiner applies firm but persistent pressure over the liver for 10 seconds while observing the mean jugular venous pressure. Normally there is either no rise or only a transient (i.e., 2 to 3 sec) rise in mean jugular venous pressure. A sustained increase in the mean venous pressure until abdominal compression is released is abnormal and indicates impaired right heart function. This abnormal response is called hepatojugular reflux." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24085809]

fields.label: Abnormal pulse pressure
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the pulse pressure, which is defined as the systolic pressured minus the diastolic pressure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Low pulse pressure
fields.definition: "Reduced amplitude of the pulse pressure (systolic blood pressure minus diastolic blood pressure)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: High pulse pressure
fields.definition: "Increased amplitude of the pulse pressure (systolic blood pressure minus diastolic blood pressure)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Heterotaxy
fields.definition: "An abnormality in which the internal thoraco-abdominal organs demonstrate abnormal arrangement across the left-right axis of the body." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21731561]
fields.synonyms_concat: Heterotaxia

fields.label: Scleral staphyloma
fields.definition: "A staphyloma is a localized defect in the eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22454726]
fields.synonyms_concat: Staphyloma

fields.label: Anterior staphyloma
fields.definition: "A localized defect in the anterior eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24600153]

fields.label: Posterior staphyloma
fields.definition: "A localized defect in the posterior eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25376120]

fields.label: Eye movement-induced pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eye that is worse in certain directions of gaze and during prolonged gaze holding." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12928305]

fields.label: Addictive behavior
fields.definition: "When an activity, substance, object, or behavior becomes a major focus of a person's life, excluding other activities, or has begun to harm the individual or others physically, mentally, or socially, it can be considered addictive behavior. A person can become addicted or compulsively engaged with anything." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Addictive behaviour

fields.label: Anti-topoisomerase I antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against topoisomerase I." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:16112028, PMID:31858335]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-Scl-70 antibody positivity; Top1 antibody positivity; Topoisomerase (DNA) I antibody positivity

fields.label: Abnormal CSF amyloid concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormal concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal CSF A[beta]42 level; Abnormal CSF amyloid level

fields.label: Decreased CSF amyloid concentration
fields.definition: "Reduced concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased CSF amyloid level

fields.label: Elevated CSF amyloid concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated CSF amyloid level

fields.label: Nasal flaring
fields.definition: "Widening of the nostrils upon inhalation as a manifestation of respiratory distress." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:25274969]

fields.label: Intercostal retractions
fields.definition: "A pulling inward of the soft tissues between the ribs upon inhalation. This is a sign of increased use of the chest muscles for breathing and is a manifestation of respiratory distress." [PMID:25274969]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chest retractions

fields.label: Large elbow
fields.definition: "Abnormal increased size of the elbow joint." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Prominent elbow

fields.label: Large knee
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased size of the knee joint." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Vertical orbital dystopia
fields.definition: "The orbits do not lie on the same horizontal plane, that is, one eye is lower than the other." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7795293]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eyes at different heights; Misaligned eyes; Unequal eye height

fields.label: Monorchism
fields.definition: "Having only one testis in the scrotum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Monorchidism

fields.label: Anorchism
fields.definition: "An abnormality of XY sexual development characterized by the absence of both testes at birth." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormality of spinal facet joint
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the small joints located between and behind adjacent vertebrae." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of apophyseal joint; Abnormality of Z-joint; Abnormality of zygapophyseal joint; Abnormality of zygapophysial joint

fields.label: Facet joint arthrosis
fields.definition: "Osteoarthritis of facet joints in the spine. Degeneration of cartilage in the facet joints results in bone rubbing on bone and reactive new bone formation visible on X-ray." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Facet arthritis

fields.label: Abnormal cardiac ventricular function
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the cardiac ventricular function." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667]

fields.label: Anti-centromere antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the centromeres or centromere components." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:17444587, PMID:31858335]
fields.synonyms_concat: ACA positivity; Anticentromere antibody positivity

fields.label: Oxygen desaturation on exertion
fields.definition: "Oxygen saturation less than 95% on exertion or arterial partial pressure of oxygen falling by more than 1kPa." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:24121092]
fields.synonyms_concat: O2 desaturation on exertion

fields.label: Abnormality of pulmonary circulation
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of that portion of the cardiosvascular system that carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs and returns oxygenated blood back to the heart." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal pulmonary circulation; Abnormality of respiratory circulation

fields.label: Increased pulmonary capillary wedge pressure
fields.definition: "Pulmonary capillary wedge pressure (PCWP) above 15mmHg." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased pulmonary arterial wedge pressure; Increased pulmonary artery occlusion pressure

fields.label: Reduced FEV1/FVC ratio
fields.definition: "Abnormally low FEV1/FVC (FEV1 - forced expiratory volume in 1 second; FVC forced vital capacity)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:22347750, PMID:24695507]
synonyms: Obstructive deficit on pulmonary function test
Obstructive deficit on pulmonary function testing
fields.synonyms_concat: Obstructive deficit on pulmonary function test; Obstructive deficit on pulmonary function testing

fields.label: Abnormality on pulmonary function testing
fields.definition: "Any anomaly measure by pulmonary function testing, which includes spirometry, measures of diffusing capacity, and plethysmography." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22347750, PMID:24695507]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal pulmonary function test; Abnormal spirometry test

fields.label: Interlobular septal thickening
fields.definition: "Presence of thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a CT scan." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:23247773]
synonyms: Interlobular septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
fields.synonyms_concat: Interlobular lines (pulmonary CT finding); Interlobular septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT; Peripheral lines (pulmonary CT finding); Septal lines (pulmonary CT finding); Septal thickening (pulmonary CT finding); Short lines (pumonary CT finding)

fields.label: Raynaud phenomenon
fields.synonyms_concat: Raynaud disease; Raynaud's phenomenon

fields.label: Shoulder impingement
fields.definition: "Trapping and compression of the rotator cuff tendons during shoulder movements." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Coronary artery aneurysm
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the diameter (cross-section) of a coronary artery as defined by a focal dilation of a segment at least 1.5 times larger than the reference vessel." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28374180]
fields.synonyms_concat: Coronary arterial dilatation; Coronary artery dilatation; Coronary artery ectasia

fields.label: Femoroacetabular impingement
fields.definition: "Femoroacetabular impingement (FAI) results from one or more bony abnormalities that lead to abnormal contact between the acetabulum and the femoral head or neck. The femoral abnormality is proposed to cause compression and shear stresses in the region between the labrum and cartilage, anterosuperiorly. These stresses cause a separation between the labrum and cartilage as the labrum is pushed outwards and the cartilage is pushed centrally. This eventually leads to articular degeneration and eventually global hip osteoarthritis." [PMID:22108232]
fields.synonyms_concat: Femoral acetabular impingement

fields.label: Gastrojejunal tube feeding in infancy
fields.definition: "Feeding problem necessitating gastrojejunal tube feeding." [PMID:11827911]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gastro-jejunal tube feeding in infancy

fields.label: Recurrent parasitic infections
fields.definition: "Increased susceptibility to parasitic infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of parasitic infection." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Abnormal T cell apoptosis
fields.definition: "Abnormal apoptosis by peripheral blood T cells in an in vitro culture, compared to a healthy control sample. May be either spontaneous, induced by UV, X-ray, FasL or other agens. Commonly measured by surface expression of phosphatidyl serine labelled by Annexin V, but other methods such as staning of cleaved Caspases may be used by different laboratories." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17562483]

fields.label: Increased T cell apoptosis
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase of apoptosis by peripheral blood T cells in an in vitro culture, compared to a healthy control sample. May be either spontaneous, induced by UV, X-ray, FasL or other agens. Commonly measured by surface expression of phosphatidyl serine labelled by Annexin V, but other methods such as staning of cleaved Caspases may be used by different laboratories." []

fields.label: C3 nephritic factor positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against C3 convertase (C3bBb)." []

fields.label: Congenital shortened small intestine
fields.definition: "Substantially shortened length of the small intestine as a result of a developmental defect." [PMID:18209785]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short bowel

fields.label: Hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
fields.definition: "A brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter." [PMID:15576652]
fields.label_normalized: hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on mri
fields.synonyms_concat: White matter hyperintensity

fields.label: Periventricular white matter hyperintensities
fields.definition: "Areas of brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter that surrounds the cerebral ventricles." [PMID:15576652]
fields.synonyms_concat: PVWMH

fields.label: Deep cerebral white matter hyperintensities
fields.definition: "Areas of brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from locations distant from the ventricular system." [PMID:15576652]
fields.synonyms_concat: DWMH

fields.label: Abnormal response to short acting pulmonary vasodilator
fields.definition: "Pulmonary vasodilator testing is performed during right-heart catheterization and involves a short-acting vasoactive agent such as adenosine, epoprostenol, or inhaled nitric oxide. The current definition of a normal (positive) response is a drop in mean pulmonary artery pressure of at least 10 mm Hg (or 20 percent) to below 40 mm Hg." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:20004088]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal response to short acting pulmonary vasodilator

fields.label: Insufficient response to short acting pulmonary vasodilator
fields.definition: "No fall in mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) falls by at least 10 mmHg to an absolute value less than 40 mmHg without a degradation in cardiac output (CO) in response to a short-acting vasoactive agent such as adenosine, epoprostenol, or inhaled nitric oxide." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667]
fields.label_normalized: insufficient response to short acting pulmonary vasodilator

fields.label: Abnormal gastrointestinal motility
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the muscular contractions that propel food though the gastrointestinal tract." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal GI motility

fields.label: Abnormal gastrointestinal transit time
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal amount of time required for food to pass through the intestines." [PMID:22206545]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal GI transit time

fields.label: Decreased intestinal transit time
fields.definition: "A reduction in the length of time required for food to pass through the intestines." [PMID:22206545]

fields.label: Pruritis on abdomen
fields.definition: "Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the abdomen." []

fields.label: Pruritis on hand
fields.definition: "Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the hand." []

fields.label: Pruritus on foot
fields.definition: "Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the foot." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Itchy feet; Itchy foot

fields.label: Pruritis on breast
fields.definition: "Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the breast." []

fields.label: Palmomental reflex
fields.definition: "A type of primitive reflex characterized by an involuntary contraction of the mentalis muscle of the chin caused by stimulation of the thenar eminence of the palm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12122165, PMID:21250236]

fields.label: Grasp reflex
fields.definition: "A type of primitive reflex that can be elicated when the hand of the examiner is gently inserted into the palm of the patient's hand. The palmar surface is stroked or simply touched. The flexor surfaces of the fingers may be stimulated also by the examiner's fingers. The stimulus should be in a distal direction. With a positive response, the patient grasps the examiner's hand with variable strength and continues to grasp as the examiner's hand is moved. Ability to release the grip voluntarily depends on the activity of the reflex; some patients can do so readily, while others can even be lifted off the bed, since the grasp has such power [NCBI Books:NBK395]." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12700289]
fields.synonyms_concat: Palmar grasp reflex

fields.label: Glabellar reflex
fields.definition: "A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by repetitive tapping on the forehead. Normal subjects usually blink in response to the first several taps, but if blinking persists, the response is abnormal and considered to be a sign of frontal release. Persistent blinking is also known as Myerson's sign." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Myerson's sign

fields.label: Snout reflex
fields.definition: "A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by tapping the upper lip lightly. The contraction of the muscles causes the mouth to resemble a snout." [PMID:21250236]

fields.label: Suck reflex
fields.definition: "A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by lightly touching or tapping on the lips with an object such as a tongue blade, reflex hammer, or the examiner's finger. At times the reflex is obtained merely by approaching the lips with an object. A positive suck reflex consists of sucking movements by the lips when they are stroked or touched." [PMID:21250236]
fields.synonyms_concat: Persistent nutritive suckle swallow

fields.label: Thunderclap headache
fields.definition: "Severe head pain with sudden onset, reaching its maximum intensity in less than one minute and lasting from one hour to ten days." []

fields.label: Liver kidney microsome type 1 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against P450 2D6, a cytochrome P450 mono-oxygenase. Anti-LKM-1 antibodies are considered to be a diagnostic marker of autoimmune hepatitis type 2 (AIH2)." [PMID:29554146]
synonyms: Anti-liver kidney microsomal type 1 antibody positivity
Anti-type I liver-kidney microsomal antibody positivity
fields.label_normalized: liver kidney microsome type 1 antibody positivity
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-liver kidney microsomal type 1 antibody positivity; Anti-LKM-1 positive; Anti-LKM1 antibody positivity; Anti-type I liver-kidney microsomal antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-liver cytosolic antigen type 1 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against a 60-kd peptide contained in the liver cytosolic fraction." [PMID:7806169]
fields.label_normalized: anti-liver cytosolic antigen type 1 antibody positivity
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-liver cytosol antibody-1 positivity

fields.label: Bifid clitoris
fields.definition: "Two clitorides located side by side." [PMID:23650202]

fields.label: Duplicated clitoris
fields.definition: "Supernumerary clitoris." []

fields.label: Exaggerated rugosity of the labia majora
fields.definition: "Marked rugae formation of the skin of the labia majora." [PMID:23650202]
fields.label_normalized: exaggerated rugosity of the labia majora
fields.synonyms_concat: Scrotum-like labia majora

fields.label: Abnormal peristalsis
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the wave-like muscle contractions of the digestive tract." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cerebellar edema
fields.definition: "Swelling from fluid accumulation (serous fluid infiltration into the interstitial space) in the cerebellum." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cerebellar edema; Edema of the cerebellum; Oedema of the cerebellum

fields.label: Low 1-minute APGAR score
fields.synonyms_concat: Low one-minute APGAR score

fields.label: Low 5-minute APGAR score
fields.synonyms_concat: Low five-minute APGAR score

fields.label: Oral erythroplakia
fields.definition: "A velvety red but not ulcerated lesion of the oral mucosa. The texture may be roughened or normal, and the lesion is neither raised nor depressed." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Oral erythroplasia

fields.label: Abnormal intestinal smooth muscle morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the intestine." []
synonyms: Abnormality of intestinal smooth muscle morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of intestinal smooth muscle morphology

fields.label: Abnormal layering of muscularis propria
fields.definition: "Abnormal layering of the intestinal muscularis propria into three layers; (1) inner circular; (2) additional oblique; and (3) outer longitudinal layer." [PMID:18788889, PMID:26078585]
fields.synonyms_concat: Muscularis propria malformation; Segmental additional circular muscle coat

fields.label: Fibrotic muscularis propria
fields.definition: "The presence of excessive fibrous connective tissue in the muscularis propria of the intestine. Fibrosis is a reparative or reactive process." []

fields.label: Enteric intraneuronal nuclear inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "Aggregates of stainable substances (proteins) in the nuclei of enteric neurons." []

fields.label: Palpebral thickening
fields.definition: "An increased thickness of the eyelid not related to acute inflammation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Eyelid thickening; Thick eyelids; Thickened but nonswollen eyelids; Thickened eyelid

fields.label: Vulvodynia
fields.definition: "Pain in the vulvar area" []
fields.synonyms_concat: Vulvar pain

fields.label: Conjunctival papillae
fields.definition: "Raised tissue masses located on the palpebral conjunctiva with a central vessel. Papillae are created by a focal infiltration of inflammatory cells." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bumps under the upper eyelid; Tarsal papillae

fields.label: Conjunctival follicles
fields.definition: "Small, dome-shaped nodules without a prominent central vessel located on the conjunctiva. The lymphoid follicles are located in the subendothelial region of the conjunctiva. They consist of a germinal center that contains immature, proliferating lymphocytes, as well as a corona that contains mature lymphocytes and plasma cells." []

fields.label: Elevated gamma-glutamyltransferase level
fields.definition: "Increased level of the enzyme gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT). GGT is mainly present in kidney, liver, and pancreatic cells, but small amounts are present in other tissues." [PMID:26543300]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated serum GGT

fields.label: Glomerular deposits
fields.definition: "An abnormal accumulation of protein in the glomerulus." []

fields.label: Pulmonary venous hypertension
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in pressure in the pulmonary veins, usually as a result of left atrial hypertension." []

fields.label: Skeletal muscle fibrosis
fields.definition: "Excessive formation of fibrous bands of scar tissue in between muscle fibers." [PMID:21798099]
fields.synonyms_concat: Muscle biopsy: fibrosis

fields.label: Birdshot choroidal lesions
fields.definition: "Multiple cream-yellow colored hypopigmented lesions typically located at the level of the outer choroid. They are between 50 and 1,500 micrometers in size with a characteristic nasal, radial distribution in the postequatorial fundus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9114-8737, PMID:25667738, PMID:33845003]
fields.synonyms_concat: Birdshot choroidal lesions; Birdshot laesions; Birdshot lesions; Birdshot retinochoroidopathy

fields.label: Conjunctival hyperemia
fields.definition: "Dilatation of the blood vessels of the conjunctiva leading to a red appearance of the sclera." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Conjunctival hyperaemia; Conjunctival injection; Conjunctival vascular congestion

fields.label: Addictive alcohol use
fields.definition: "An addictive behavior is defined as drinking excessive amounts of alcohol over a prolonged period of time, having difficulty in reducing the amount of alcohol consumed, strongly desiring alcohol, and experiencing withdrawal symptoms when not drinking alcohol." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Alcohol addiction; Alcoholism

fields.label: Abnormality of cardiovascular system electrophysiology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the electrical conduction physiology of the heart." []

fields.label: Ventricular septal aneurysm
fields.definition: "A bowing (bulging to one side) of the interventricular septum of more than 15 mm on either side in adults and 5 mm in children during normal cardiac motion." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ventricular septal dilatation

fields.label: Membranous ventricular septal aneurysm
fields.definition: "Bowing (bulging out) of the membranous part of the interventricular septum of more than 10-15 mm into the cavity of an adjacent ventricle (usually into the right ventricle)." [PMID:5846101, PMID:6018320]
synonyms: Aneurysm of the membranous ventricular septum
fields.synonyms_concat: Aneurysm of the membranous ventricular septum; Interventricular septum membranous part aneurysm

fields.label: Muscular ventricular septal aneurysm
fields.definition: "Bowing (bulging out) of the muscular part of the interventricular septum of more than 10-15 mm into the cavity of an adjacent ventricle (usually into the right ventricle)." [PMID:5846101]
synonyms: Aneurysm of the muscular ventricular septum
fields.synonyms_concat: Aneurysm of the muscular ventricular septum

fields.label: Microspherophakia
fields.definition: "Microspherophakia is a rare congenital anomaly characterized by the abnormal spherical shape of the crystalline lens. It is characterized by an increased anteroposterior thickness of the lens associated with reduced equatorial diameter. The primary pathology lies in the development of zonules. The condition is often bilateral and is characterized by small, thick, and spherical lenses." [PMID:35015420]

fields.label: Abnormal morphology of the great vessels
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly affecting a blood vessel involved in the circulation of the heart, i.e., the superior or inferior vena cava, the pulmonary arteries, the pulmonary veins, and the aorta." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal morphology of the great vessels

fields.label: Aortic stiffness
fields.definition: "The elastic properties of the aorta allow the aorta to store half of the cardiac ejected blood volume per beat, whereby aortic recoil during diastole pushes the remaining stored volume forward into the peripheral circulation, a phenomenon known as the Windkessel function. Aortic stiffness occurs as the elastic fibers within the arterial wall become disrupted due to mechanical stress (with age or due to other factors). Aortic stiffness refers to a reduction in the elasticity of the aorta, which is associated with an elevated pulse pressure, increased wave reflection, and often hypertension." [PMID:28540066]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased aortic stiffness

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary artery morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the structure of the pulmonary artery." []

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary artery physiology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the function of the pulmonary artery." []

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary vein morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the structure of the pulmonary veins." []

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary vein physiology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the function of the pulmonary veins." []

fields.label: Abnormal vena cava physiology
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the function of the veins that return deoxygenated blood from the body into the heart, i.e., the superior vena cava and the inferior vena cava." []

fields.label: Abnormal systemic blood pressure
fields.definition: "A chronic deviation from normal pressure in the systemic arterial system." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal systemic BP

fields.label: Postexertional symptom exacerbation
fields.definition: "Post-exertional symptom exacerbation (PESE), also referred to as post-exertional malaise (PEM), is defined as the worsening of symptoms that can follow minimal cognitive, physical, emotional, or social activity, or activity that could previously be tolerated. Symptoms typically worsen 12 to 72 hours after activity and can last for days or even weeks, sometimes leading to a relapse." [PMID:25695122, PMID:26904705, PMID:32105793, PMID:33071931]
fields.synonyms_concat: Exercise-induced malaise; Postexertional malaise

fields.label: Cryptozoospermia
fields.definition: "A type of oligozoospermia in which spermatozoa can be detected in an ejaculate only after centrifugation and inspection of the pellet." [PMID:25780588]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cryptospermia

fields.label: Pontine tegmental cap
fields.definition: "An abnormal curved or vaulted (capped) structure covering the middle third of the dorsal pontine tegmentum and projecting into the fourth ventricle." [PMID:17690130, PMID:18842761, PMID:25691269]
fields.synonyms_concat: Vaulted pontine tegmentum

fields.label: Abnormal factor VIII activity
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal activity of coagulation factor VIII. Factor VIII (fVIII) is a cofactor in the intrinsic clotting cascade that is activated to fVIIIa in the presence of minute quantities of thrombin. fVIIIa acts as a receptor, for factors IXa and X." []

fields.label: Increased factor VIII activity
fields.definition: "Increased activity of the coagulation factor VIII. Factor VIII (fVIII) is a cofactor in the intrinsic clotting cascade that is activated to fVIIIa in the presence of minute quantities of thrombin. fVIIIa acts as a receptor, for factors IXa and X." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2826-3879]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated factor VIII level

fields.label: Decreased CSF/serum albumin ratio
fields.definition: "A reduction below normal limits of the ratio of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) albumin concentration to serum albumin concentration." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159, PMID:27388694]

fields.label: Dilatation of large choroidal vessels
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the large blood vessels in the choroid." [PMID:26026923]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dilated choroidal vessels

fields.label: Reduced brain glutamine level by MRS
fields.definition: "An decrease in the level of glutamine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159, PMID:24123328]
fields.label_normalized: reduced brain glutamine level by mrs

fields.label: Abnormal CSF/serum albumin ratio
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal range of the ratio of the albumin concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) to the concentration in serum (which may be defined as 3.2-9.0). This is an index of blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity, adjusted for the serum albumin concentration, and an increased ratio is taken as a sign of a loss of integrity of the BBB with leakage of albumin into the CSF." [PMID:27388694]

fields.label: Ovarian thecoma
fields.definition: "A sex cord-stromal tumor of the ovary. Thecomas range from small tumors to large solid or solid-cystic masses of up to 15 cm. They are unilateral in over 90 percent of cases and are rarely malignant. Thecomas are stromal tumors made up of cells that resemble theca cells, lutein cells and fibroblasts. They are traditionally classified within the sex cord-stromal tumor category of ovarian tumor types." [NCIT:C1882229, PMID:27284435]

fields.label: Abnormal serum bile acid concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of serum bile acid concentration." []

fields.label: Decreased serum bile acid concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction in the concentration of bile acid in the blood." []

fields.label: Biliary epithelial hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Hyperplasia of lining epithelia of the septal and large bile ducts manifesting as micropapillary projections or as a stratification of the epithelium with or without dilatation of the duct lumen." [PMID:21994886]

fields.label: Suppurative cholangitis
fields.definition: "Cholangitis characterized by the presence of numerous polymorphonuclear cells around and within the wall as well as within the lumen of the ducts. This may involve ducts of any size and is occasionally associated with abscess formation (cholangitic abscess)." [PMID:21994886]

fields.label: Granulomatous cholangitis
fields.definition: "Cholangitis characterized by the accumulation of granulomas. Granulomas are aggregates of modified macrophages (epithelioid cells) and other inflammatory cells that accumulate after chronic exposure to antigens. The underlying trigger may be exposure to noxious agents that cannot be biochemically degraded or to immune dysfunction. The ultimate result is a release of a variety cytokines that stimulate mononuclear cells that fuse to form multinucleated giant cells with a surrounding rim of lymphocytes and fibroblasts." [PMID:22333006]

fields.label: Lymphoid cholangitis
fields.definition: "Cholangitis characterized by a close association between duct branches, usually interlobular bile ducts, and lymphocytic aggregates, which may show a follicular arrangement." [PMID:21994886]

fields.label: Pleomorphic cholangitis
fields.definition: "Cholangitis associated with mixed inflammatory infiltrates and the presence of fibrosis or sclerosis of the biliary tree." []

fields.label: Sclerosing cholangitis
fields.definition: "Cholangitis associated with evident ductal fibrosis that develops as a consequence of long-standing bile duct inflammatory, obstruction, or ischemic injury; it can be obliterative or nonobliterative." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Fibrous cholangitis

fields.label: Abnormal pancreatic duct morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the pancreatic duct, which is the tubular structure that collects exocrine pancreatic secretions and transports them to the duodenum." [PMID:24265565]

fields.label: Duplication of pancreatic duct
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of two separate pancreatic ducts." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Duplicated pancreatic duct

fields.label: Pancreas divisum
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly of the pancreas that results from failed fusion of the dorsal and ventral ducts during embyological development. Three variants have been described: type 1 or classical divisum in which there is total failure of fusion; type 2 in which dorsal drainage is dominant in the absence of the duct of Wirsung; and type 3 or incomplete divisum where a small communicating branch is present." [PMID:24265565]

fields.label: Megaduodenum
fields.definition: "Dilation and elongation of the duodenum with hypertrophy of all layers of the duodenum." []

fields.label: Atretic vas deferens
fields.definition: "Abnormal closure or blockage of the vas deferens." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Atresia of the vas deferens; Vas deferens atresia

fields.label: Cerebrospinal fluid rhinorrhoea
fields.definition: "Drainage of cerebrospinal fluid through the nose. This can occur when there is a fistula between the dura and the skull base and discharge of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the nose." [PMID:17767107]
fields.synonyms_concat: CSF rhinorrhoea

fields.label: Abnormal vestibular saccule morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the saccule of the vestibule. The saccule is the otolith organ that senses motions in the sagittal plane (i.e., up-down movement)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal saccule morphology; Morphological abnormality of the saccule

fields.label: Vestibular saccular degeneration
fields.definition: "Deterioration or loss of the tissues of the saccule of the vestibule." []

fields.label: Minifascicle formation
fields.definition: "A nerve fascicle or fasciculus is a small bundle of axons, enclosed by the perineurium. A minifascule refers to a group of thinly myelinated and unmyelinated axons surrounded by a delicate perineurium, and with a smaller diameter than a normal nerve fascicle." []

fields.label: Neuritis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of a nerve." []

fields.label: Polyneuritis
fields.definition: "Simultaneous inflammation of multiple nerves." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Multiple neuritis

fields.label: Hemiareflexia
fields.definition: "Areflexia that is limited to one side of the body." [PMID:6722516]

fields.label: Acroparesthesia
fields.definition: "A type of paresthesia (tingling, pins-and-needles, burning or numbness or stiffness) that occurs in the hands and feet and particularly in the fingers and toes." []

fields.label: Orofacial action-specific dystonia induced by speech
fields.label_normalized: orofacial action-specific dystonia induced by speech
fields.synonyms_concat: Jaw dystonia induced by speaking

fields.label: Lingual dystonia
fields.definition: "Involuntary protrusions, movements, spams and contortions of the tongue." [PMID:24808861]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tongue dystonia

fields.label: Ainhum
fields.definition: "Development of a fibrotic constriction ring involving the base of one or more toes, conditioning eversion and absorption of distal structures, possibly progressing to spontaneous amputation." [PMID:26379327]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dactylolysis spontanea

fields.label: Hyperphalangy of the 3rd finger
fields.definition: "An accessory phalanx of the third (middle) finger that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges. Hyperphalangy results from an accessory ossification center at the metacarpophalangeal joint." [PMID:27738187, PMID:30728880]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperphalangy of third finger

fields.label: Fatty streak
fields.definition: "Yellow-colored streaks, patches, or spots on the intimal surface of arteries. Fatty streaks stain red with Sudan III or Sudan IV." [PMID:8181179]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sudanophilic lesion

fields.label: Thin-cap fibroatheroma
fields.definition: "Thin-cap fibroatheroma is characterized by a relatively large necrotic core with an overlying thin fibrous cap measuring less than 65 micrometers and typically containing numerous macrophages, and is considered to be the precursor lesion of plaque rupture which is the most common cause of coronary thrombosis." [PMID:27500096]
fields.synonyms_concat: TCFA

fields.label: Ankylosis
fields.definition: "A reduction of joint mobility resulting from changes involving the articular surfaces." []

fields.label: Intrahepatic portal vein sclerosis
fields.definition: "Sclerosis of the intrahepatic portal veins of the liver and generally accompanied by non-cirrhotic portal hypertension, features of which may include splenomegaly and varices." [PMID:25796481]
fields.synonyms_concat: Idiopathic non-cirrhotic portal hypertension; Incomplete septal cirrhosis; Non cirrhotic portal fibrosis; Obliterative portal venopathy

fields.label: Alternating radiolucent and radiodense metaphyseal lines
fields.definition: "Areas of radio-opaque sclerotic bands alternating with those of normal lucency give rise to stripes akin to a zebra." [PMID:28384951]
fields.label_normalized: alternating radiolucent and radiodense metaphyseal lines
fields.synonyms_concat: Zebra stripe sign

fields.label: Swiss cheese atrial septal defect
fields.definition: "Multiple defects in the atrial septum." [PMID:18559707]

fields.label: Eccrine syringofibroadenoma
fields.definition: "Eccrine syringofibroadenoma (ESFA) is a benign adnexal tumor arising most often on the extremities of elderly individuals characterized by anastomosing cords of cuboidal epithelial cells surrounded by a fibrovascular stroma containing plasma cells and ductal structures. ESFA stains positively with epithelial membrane antigen (EMA) and carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA)." [NCIT:CL017969, PMID:26937300]
fields.synonyms_concat: Acrosyringeal adenomatosis; Eccrine syringofibroadenomatous hyperplasia; Syringofibroadenoma

fields.label: Pyknotic bone marrow neutrophils
fields.definition: "Nuclear lobes of neutrophils in the bone marrow are thickened and condensed, and individual lobes are connected by unusually long chromatin filaments." []

fields.label: Bone marrow hypercellularity
fields.definition: "A larger than normal amount or percentage of hematopoietic cells relative to marrow fat." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Myeloid hyperplasia

fields.label: Squamous Papilloma
fields.definition: "A benign epithelial neoplasm characterized by a papillary growth pattern and a proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells without morphologic evidence of malignancy [NCI thesaurus]." []

fields.label: Oropharyngeal squamous papilloma
fields.definition: "A benign exophytic neoplasm that arises from the oropharynx. It is characterized by the presence of a connective tissue core covered by stratified squamous epithelium [NCI thesaurus]." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Squamous papilloma of the uvula

fields.label: Multiple mucosal neuromas
fields.definition: "Multiple painful, dome-shaped, translucent pink to skin-colored papules on oral mucosa. Histologically, the lesions may demonstrate dermal proliferation of well-demarcated nerve bundles associated with abundant mucin and surrounded by a distinct perineural sheath." [PMID:16702501]

fields.label: Cylindroma
fields.definition: "A benign skin adnexal tumor of eccrine differentiation." [NCIT:C27094, PMID:27294061]

fields.label: Gastric leiomyosarcoma
fields.definition: "A malignant neoplasm of the stomach that grows submucosally in the gastric wall. Necrosis and hemorrhage may be visible radiologically. Histologically, spindle cells with abnormal mitotic activity may be visible." [NCIT:C27200, PMID:25069607]

fields.label: Snail-like ilia
fields.definition: "The ilia is round and hypoplastic with a very flat acetabular roof and a very unusual medial projection of bone that is said to resemble the head of a snail. Figure 4 of PMID:3799723 illustrates this feature." [PMID:3799723]
fields.synonyms_concat: Schneckenbecken dysplasia; Snail-like pelvis; Snail-shaped ilia

fields.label: Internal notch of the femoral head
fields.definition: "A small V-shaped indentation on the internal aspect of the femoral head. This feature is well illustrated in Figure 5 of PMID:11694546." [PMID:11694546, PMID:24339047]
fields.label_normalized: internal notch of the femoral head

fields.label: Lactescent serum
fields.definition: "Serum sample with a grossly white (milk-like, i.e., lactescent) appearance. This feature is indicative of an extremely elevated serum triglyceride level." [PMID:15368719]
fields.synonyms_concat: Milk-like serum; Plasma lactescence

fields.label: Elevated circulating CEA concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of CEA (carcinoembryonic antigen) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated carcinoembryonic antigen level; Increased plasma CEA

fields.label: Elevated circulating carcinoma antigen 125 concentration
fields.definition: "An increased blood concentration of carcinoma antigen 125 (CA-125). CA-125, also known as mucin 16, can exhibit increased blood levels in certain types of cancer." [PMID:16343244, PMID:22542127, PMID:22729278]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated carcinoma antigen 125 level; Increased plasma CA125

fields.label: Abnormal circulating retinol-binding protein concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of retinol-binding protein in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating retinol-binding protein concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of retinol-binding protein in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Impaired urinary acidification
fields.definition: "The kidney contributes towards acid-base homeostasis by excreting H+ ions and retaining bicarbonate. This process is known as acidification of the urine. The pH of urine ranges normally from 4.5 to 8. The inability to reduce the pH of the urine in a situation where it would be otherwise expected is known as an acidification defect." [PMID:6876936]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal acidification defect

fields.label: Abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid-labile subunit concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal blood concentration of the insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit (IGFALS; Entrez Gene ID 3483). The acid-labile subunit (IGFALS) acts in the insulin-like growth (IGF) system by binding circulating IGF1 in a ternary complex with binding protein (IGFBP)-3 to prevent IGF1 from crossing the endothelial barrier. This term refers specifically to the circulating concentration of the acid-labile subunit." [PMID:14762184, PMID:20142246]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid-labile subunit concentration

fields.label: Chronic infection
fields.definition: "Presence of a protracted or persistent infection by a pathogen potentially related to an underlying abnormality of the immune system that is not able to clear the infection." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating GH-binding protein concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of GH-binding protein (= growth hormone-binding protein) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased plasma GH-binding protein

fields.label: Reduced insulin-like factor 3 level
fields.definition: "Blood concentration of insulin-like factor 3 (ILF3) is below normal limits." [PMID:24640568]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced plasma INSL3 level

fields.label: Spermatogenesis maturation arrest
fields.definition: "Maturation arrest (MA) is defined as germ cells that fail to complete maturation. Uniform MA is characterized by spermatogenic arrest at the same stage of spermatogenesis throughout the seminiferous tubules. MA is subcategorized into early MA, in which only spermatogonia or spermatocytes are found, and late MA, in which spermatids are detected without spermatozoa." [PMID:21684558]
fields.synonyms_concat: Meiotic maturation arrest of spermatogenesis

fields.label: Spermatocyte maturation arrest
fields.definition: "A type of spermatogenesis maturation arrest in which the block of developmental occurs in the spermatocyte stage. Testicular histology shows seminiferous tubules with Sertoli cells, spermatogonial cells and spermatocytes but no further differentiated cells like round spermatids." [PMID:21684558]
fields.synonyms_concat: Spermatocyte arrest; Spermatocyte meiotic arrest; Spermatocytic arrest

fields.label: Round spermatid arrest
fields.definition: "A failure of spermatogenesis to progress beyond the round spermatid stage. The round spermatid is the first haploid cells produced during spermatogenesis and normally further develop into mature spermatozoa. This abnormality can be visualized with testicular biopsy and is characterized seminiferous tubules with increased numbers of round spermatids with few or no mature spermatozoa." [PMID:21684558, PMID:9510006]
synonyms: Maturation arrest of spermatogenesis at spermatid stage
fields.synonyms_concat: Late spermatogenesis maturation arrest; Maturation arrest of spermatogenesis at spermatid stage

fields.label: Obstruction of the superior vena cava
fields.definition: "Blockage of blood flow through the superior vena cava (SVC). Because the venous drainage from the upper extremities, upper thorax and head is obstructed, SVC obstruction presents with symptoms related to engorgement of these areas. Both the degree of SVC compromise and the extent of collateral veins determine the varied clinical presentation, which can be as mild as slight facial and upper extremity edema or as dire as intracranial swelling, seizures, hemodynamic instability and tracheal obstruction." []
fields.label_normalized: obstruction of the superior vena cava
fields.synonyms_concat: Superior vena cava obstruction; Superior vena cava syndrome

fields.label: Strawberry tongue
fields.definition: "Inflamed tongue with hyperplastic (enlarged) fungiform papillae that is said to resemble a strawberry or raspberry." [PMID:26222562]
fields.synonyms_concat: Raspberry tongue

fields.label: Type A4 brachydactyly
fields.definition: "A type of brachydactyly characterized by brachymesophalangy affecting mainly the 2nd and 5th digits." [PMID:8387724]

fields.label: Type A5 brachydactyly
fields.definition: "A type of brachydactyly characterized by absent middle phalanges of digits 2 to 5." [PMID:18554391]

fields.label: Acral blistering
fields.definition: "Bullae (defined as fluid-filled blisters more than 5 mm in diameter with thin walls) of the skin with an acral distribution (affecting peripheral regions such as hands and feet)." []

fields.label: Absent soft palate
fields.definition: "A developmental defect characterized by lack of a soft palate." [PMID:11420024]
fields.synonyms_concat: Agenesis of the soft palate

fields.label: Paraproteinemia
fields.definition: "An abnormal immunoglobulin or part of an Ig (light chain) in the circulation. Paraproteins are typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells." [PMID:17403946]
fields.synonyms_concat: Monoclonal hypergammaglobulinemia

fields.label: Light-chain paraproteinemia
fields.definition: "An abnormal immunoglobulin light chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells." []

fields.label: Heavy-chain paraproteinemia
fields.definition: "An abnormal immunoglobulin heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells." [PMID:12057070]

fields.label: Whole-immunoglobulin paraproteinemia
fields.definition: "An abnormal immunoglobulin (heavy and light chain) in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells." []

fields.label: Tarsal sclerosis
fields.definition: "An elevation in bone density in one or more tarsal bones of the foot. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity." []

fields.label: Elevated vascular endothelial growth factor level
fields.definition: "Increased blood concentration of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF)." []
fields.label_normalized: elevated vascular endothelial growth factor level
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating VEGF concentration

fields.label: Coarctation in the transverse aortic arch
fields.definition: "Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized to the region of the transverse aortic arch." []
fields.label_normalized: coarctation in the transverse aortic arch

fields.label: Long segment coarctation of the aorta
fields.definition: "Coarctation of the aorta is a narrowing or constriction of a long segment of the arch of the aorta." [PMID:23909637]
fields.label_normalized: long segment coarctation of the aorta

fields.label: Abnormal branching pattern of left aortic arch
fields.definition: "A deviance from the norm of the origin or course of the right brachiocephalic artery, the left common carotid artery, the left subclavian artery or the proximal vertebral arteries, whereby the aortic arch descends on the left as normal (as opposed to right aortic arch)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal branching pattern of left aortic arch

fields.label: Fusiform cerebral aneurysm
fields.definition: "A localized circumferential (i.e., bulges on all sides) dilatation or ballooning of a cerebral artery." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Intracranial fusiform aneurysm

fields.label: Skin fissure
fields.definition: "A clearly-defined and roughly linear cleavage in the skin that usually extends to the dermis." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cracked skin; Skin fissuring

fields.label: Impairment of activities of daily living
fields.definition: "Difficulty in performing one or more activities normally performed every day, such as eating, bathing, dressing, grooming, work, homemaking, and leisure." []
fields.label_normalized: impairment of activities of daily living

fields.label: Impaired ability to bathe oneself
fields.definition: "This term applies to an individual who requires help to bathe more than one part of the body, get in or out of the tub or shower, or who requires total bathing." [PMID:10362969]

fields.label: Impaired ability to dress oneself
fields.definition: "This applies to an individual who needs help with dressing or needs to be completely dressed." [PMID:10362969]

fields.label: Impaired toileting ability
fields.definition: "This term applies to an individual who requires help transferring to the toilet, cleaning self or who uses bedpan or commode." []

fields.label: Impaired transferring ability
fields.definition: "Applies to an individual who needs help in moving from bed to chair or requires a complete transfer." [PMID:10362969]

fields.label: Impaired feeding ability
fields.definition: "Applies to an individual who needs partial or total help with feeding or requires parenteral feeding." []

fields.label: Impaired continence
