fields.definition: "Partial or total incontinence of bowel or bladder." []

fields.label: Abnormal ovarian physiology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of ovarian function." []

fields.label: Empty ovarian follicle
fields.definition: "A failure to collect oocytes after an apparently normal controlled ovarian hyperstimulation cycle for in vitro fertilization." [PMID:19562053]
fields.synonyms_concat: Empty follicle syndrome

fields.label: Abnormal femoral torsion
fields.definition: "Femoral torsion, also known as femoral rotation or femoral version, refers to the twist between the proximal and distal parts of the femur on the transverse plane. Femoral anteversion averages between 30-40 degrees at birth, and between 8-14 degrees in adults. This term applies if the amount of femoral torsion deviates from this range." []

fields.label: Abnormal endocrine morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the structure of an organ ofthe endocrine system." []

fields.label: Abnormal endocrine physiology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the function of the endocrine system." []

fields.label: Abnormal response to endocrine stimulation test
fields.definition: "An anomalous response to a test that is designed to probe the function of the endocrine system." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal response to endocrine stimulation test

fields.label: Abnormal response to ACTH stimulation test
fields.definition: "An anomalous response to stimulation by administration of the adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH). ACTH stimulation normally stimulates the adrenal glands to release cortisol and adrenaline." []
synonyms: Abnormal response to adrenocorticotropic-hormone stimulation test
Abnormal response to corticotropin stimulation test
fields.label_normalized: abnormal response to acth stimulation test
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal response to adrenocorticotropic-hormone stimulation test; Abnormal response to corticotropin stimulation test

fields.label: Abnormal response to insulin tolerance test
fields.definition: "An anomalous response to the insulin tolerance test (ITT), in which insulin is administered intravenously and blood glucose and potentially other compounds are measured at intervals. Insulin administration is intended to induce extreme hypoglycemia (bloodgluoce below 40 mg/dl), which in turn induces release of adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) and growth hormone (GH). ACTH induces the adrenal gland to release cortisol, which together with GH opposes the action of insulin on the blood glucose level." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal response to insulin tolerance test

fields.label: Impaired cortisol response to insulin stimulation test
fields.definition: "Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the insulin tolerance test (ITT)." []
fields.label_normalized: impaired cortisol response to insulin stimulation test

fields.label: Abnormal response to corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test
fields.definition: "An anomalous response to the corticotropin releasing hormone (CRH) stimulation test. Normally,CRH is released by the hypothalamus to induce adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) release by the anterior pituitary. In the stimulation test, CRH is administered intravenously and ACTH and cortisol are measured at intervals." []
synonyms: Abnormal response to CRH stimulation test
fields.label_normalized: abnormal response to corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal response to CRH stimulation test

fields.label: Impaired cortisol response to corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test
fields.definition: "Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test." []
fields.label_normalized: impaired cortisol response to corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test

fields.label: Impaired growth-hormone response to insulin stimulation test
fields.definition: "Failure of growth hormone levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the insulin tolerance test (ITT)." []
fields.label_normalized: impaired growth-hormone response to insulin stimulation test

fields.label: Abnormal response to glucagon stimulation test
fields.definition: "An anomalous response to the glucagon stimulation test, which like the insulin tolerance test (ITT) stimulates the release of both adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) and growth hormone (GH)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal response to glucagon stimulation test

fields.label: Impaired cortisol response to glucagon stimulation test
fields.definition: "Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the glucagon stimulation test." []
fields.label_normalized: impaired cortisol response to glucagon stimulation test

fields.label: Impaired growth-hormone response to glucagon stimulation test
fields.definition: "Failure of growth hormone levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the glucagon stimulation test." []
fields.label_normalized: impaired growth-hormone response to glucagon stimulation test

fields.label: Abnormal response to human chorionic gonadotrophin stimulation test
fields.definition: "An anomalous response to intravenous stimulation by human chorionic gonadotrophin. Stimulation with hCG stimulates testicular Leydig cells to secrete androgens via the Leydig hormone receptors." []
synonyms: Abnormal response to hCG stimulation test
fields.label_normalized: abnormal response to human chorionic gonadotrophin stimulation test
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal response to hCG stimulation test

fields.label: Excessive insulin response to glucagon test
fields.definition: "An abnormally high increase in insulin levels following a glucagon stimulation test." [PMID:21791970]
fields.label_normalized: excessive insulin response to glucagon test

fields.label: Decreased circulating prealbumin concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of prealbumin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Prealbumin, also known as transthyretin, has a half-life in plasma of about 2 days, much shorter than that of albumin. Prealbumin is therefore more sensitive to changes in protein-energy status than albumin, and its concentration closely reflects recent dietary intake rather than overall nutritional status." [PMID:11989633, PMID:17138848]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased prealbumin level

fields.label: Ectopic ovary
fields.definition: "Undescended or ectopic ovaries are characterized by the attachment of the upper pole of the ovary to an area above the level of the common iliac vessels." [PMID:12584384]
fields.synonyms_concat: Undescended ovary

fields.label: Absent pubertal growth spurt
fields.definition: "The abrupt and transient increase in the annual growth rate normally observed in adolescent individuals does not occur." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent adolescent growth spurt

fields.label: Vaginal dryness
fields.definition: "Persistent vaginal dryness." [PMID:21702402]

fields.label: Palatal edema
fields.definition: "Swelling related to fluid accumulation within the palate." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Palatal oedema; Palate edema; Palate oedema

fields.label: Finger dactylitis
fields.definition: "Fingers appear swollen and plump owing to inflammation of the complete finger." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Sausage fingers

fields.label: Toe dactylitis
fields.definition: "Toes appear swollen and plump owing to inflammation of the complete toe." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Sausage toes

fields.label: Spindle-shaped finger
fields.definition: "Swelling of the hand at the knuckles, that gives the fingers a spindle shape (i.e., a round stick with tapered end and a broader base)." []

fields.label: Abnormal breast morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the structure of the breast." []

fields.label: Abnormal breast physiology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the function of the breast." []

fields.label: Abnormal humerus morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the structure of the humerus (i.e., upper arm bone)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of the humerus

fields.label: Delayed vertebral ossification
fields.definition: "A decrease in the amount of mineralized bone in one or more vertebrae compared with that expected for a given developmental age." []

fields.label: Abnormal thyroid-stimulating hormone level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal amount of the thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), which is produced by the anterior pituitary gland and stimulates the function of the thyroid gland." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal circulating thyrotropin concentration; Abnormal thyrotropin level; Abnormal TSH level

fields.label: Decreased thyroid-stimulating hormone level
fields.definition: "Reduced amount of the thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), which is produced by the anterior pituitary gland and stimulates the function of the thyroid gland." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased plasma TSH; Decreased thyrotropin level

fields.label: Abnormal circulating inhibin level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of inhibins, which are heterodimeric protein hormones secreted by granulosa cells of the ovary in females and Sertoli cells of the testis in males. Inhibins suppress the secretion of pituitary follicle-stimulating hormone." [PMID:12790766]

fields.label: Decreased circulating inhibin B concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of inhibin B in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:11720872]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating antimullerian hormone concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the antimullerian hormone, a peptide produced by the granulosa cells of follicles. Anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH), also known as Mullerian inhibiting substance, is produced by the granulosa cells of small antral follicles of the ovary. AMH has an inhibiting role in the ovary, contributing to follicular arrest. AMH levels in women are low until the age of 8, rise rapidly until puberty and decline steadily from the age of 25 until menopause, when AMH production ceases." [PMID:22693172]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal antimullerian hormone level

fields.label: Increased circulating antimullerian hormone concentration
fields.definition: "An elevation above the normal range of the antimullerian hormone in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased antimullerian hormone level; Increased plasma AMH

fields.label: Decreased circulating antimullerian hormone circulation
fields.definition: "A reduction below the normal range of the antimullerian hormone in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-Mullerian hormone low; Decreased antimullerian hormone level; Decreased plasma AMH

fields.label: Insulin receptor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the insulin receptor." [PMID:3280181]

fields.label: Abnormal uterus morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the structure of the uterus" []

fields.label: T-shaped uterus
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the uterus characterized by a normal uterine outline but with an abnormal T-shaped uterine cavity with narrowing cavity due to thickened lateral walls with a correlation 2/3 uterine corpus and 1/3 cervix. The abnormlaity is said to resemble the letter T in hysterosalpingographic imaging." [PMID:23771171]

fields.label: Decreased fibular diameter
fields.definition: "Reduced width of the cross sectional diameter of the fibula." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Thin fibula

fields.label: Triceps weakness
fields.definition: "A lack of strength in the triceps muscle, which normally is responsible for extending (straightening) the elbow and mediating certain shoulder movements." []

fields.label: Agalactia
fields.definition: "Failure of secretion of milk following childbirth associated with an inability to breastfeed an infant." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Lactation incapacity

fields.label: Twin-to-twin transfusion
fields.definition: "As a result of sharing a single placenta, the blood supplies of monochorionic twin fetuses can become connected, so that they share blood circulation: although each fetus uses its own portion of the placenta, the connecting blood vessels within the placenta allow blood to pass from one twin to the other.Depending on the number, type and direction of the interconnecting blood vessels (anastomoses), blood can be transferred disproportionately from one twin (the donor) to the other (the recipient). This state of transfusion causes the donor twin to have decreased blood volume, retarding the donor's development and growth. The blood volume of the recipient twin is increased, which can strain the fetus's heart and eventually lead to heart failure." [PMID:19283655]
fields.synonyms_concat: Twin to twin transfusion syndrome

fields.label: Cutaneous hamartoma
fields.definition: "A hamartoma (tissue malformation consisting of an abnormal mixture of constitutive components) originating in the skin." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Skin hamartoma

fields.label: Purely bicuspid aortic valve
fields.definition: "A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by two equal-sized cusps, with no raphe and only two commissures. There is a lateral arrangement of the free edge of the cusps. Note that this differs from some other forms of BAV in which there are three commissures and two of the three cusps are joined by a raphe forming two functional leaflets. This type of BAV often is associated with aortic stenosis." [PMID:17467434]

fields.label: Single raphe bicuspid aortic valve
fields.definition: "A type of bicuspid aortic valvue (BAV) characterized by the presence of a single raphe that extends from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps, resulting in two leaflets of unequal size." [PMID:17467434, PMID:24827036]

fields.label: Bicuspid aortic valve with right-left cusp fusion
fields.definition: "A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the right and left cusps (RL fusion pattern). This results in two leaflefts with an anterior-posterior leaflet orientation (also called the typical pattern). There is thus one completely developed noncoronary cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped left and right coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure." [PMID:17467434, PMID:24827036]
fields.label_normalized: bicuspid aortic valve with right-left cusp fusion

fields.label: Bicuspid aortic valve with right-noncoronary cusp fusion
fields.definition: "A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the right and noncoronary cusps (RN fusion pattern). This results in two leaflets with right-left leaflet orientation (also called the atypical pattern). There is thus one completely developed left cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped right and noncoronary coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure." []
fields.label_normalized: bicuspid aortic valve with right-noncoronary cusp fusion

fields.label: Bicuspid aortic valve with left-noncoronary cusp fusion
fields.definition: "A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the left and noncoronary cusps (LN fusion pattern). There is thus one completely developed right cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped left and noncoronary coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure." []
fields.label_normalized: bicuspid aortic valve with left-noncoronary cusp fusion

fields.label: Two-raphe bicuspid aortic valve
fields.definition: "A type of bicuspid aortic valvue (BAV) characterized by the presence of two raphes that each extend from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps. This type of BAV has developmental anlagen of three cusps, commissures, and sinuses, but two commissures are more or less malformed and obliterated, giving rise to a raphe, a fibrous ridge, which extends from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps. This type of BAV is typically associated with a high degree of aortic stenosis." [PMID:17467434]

fields.label: Recurrent gastroenteritis
fields.definition: "Increased susceptibility to gastroenteritis, an infectious inflammationof the stomach and small intestines manifested by signs and symptoms such as diarheas and abdominal pain, as manifested by recurrent episodes of gastroenteritis." []

fields.label: Decreased platelet thromboxane A2 receptor
fields.definition: "Decreased cell membrane concentration of thromboxane A2 receptor that is stimulated by thromboxane A2 (TBXA2)." []

fields.label: Decreased platelet alpha-2A-adrenergic receptor
fields.definition: "Decreased cell membrane concentration of alpha-2A adrenergic receptor that is stimulated by epinephrine." []

fields.label: Impaired clot retraction
fields.definition: "Platelets contain contractile proteins (actin and myosin) that induce clot retraction. As the platelets contract, they pull on the surrounding fibrin strands, squeezing serum form the mass, compacting the clot and drawing the ruptured edges of the blood vessel more closely together. Clot retraction is directly proportional to the platelet count and inversely proportional to the fibrinogen concentration." []

fields.label: Impaired convulxin-induced platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Abnormal response to convulxin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of convulxin." []

fields.label: Impaired collagen-related peptide-induced platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Abnormal response to collagen-related peptide (CRP) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of CRP." []

fields.label: Impaired phorbol myristate acetate-induced platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Abnormal response to phorbol myristate acetate (PMA) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of PMA." []
fields.label_normalized: impaired phorbol myristate acetate-induced platelet aggregation

fields.label: Impaired calcium ionophore-induced platelet aggregation
fields.definition: "Abnormal response to calcium Ionophore (such as A23187) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of the ionophore." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Impaired Ca ionophore-induced platelet aggregation; Impaired Ca2+ ionophore-induced platelet aggregation

fields.label: Abnormal platelet phosphatidylserine exposure
fields.definition: "An abnormality of phosphatidylserine (PS) on activated platelets. PS is normally located on the cytoplasmic face of the resting platelet membrane but appears on the plasma-oriented surface of discrete membrane vesicles that derive from activated platelets. Thrombin, the central molecule of coagulation, is produced from prothrombin by a complex (prothrombinase) between factor Xa and its protein cofactor (factor V(a)) that forms on platelet-derived membranes. This complex enhances the rate of activation of prothrombin to thrombin by roughly 150,000 fold relative to factor X(a) in solution. The negatively charged surface of PS-containing platelet-derived membranes is at least partly responsible for this rate enhancement." [PMID:12814644]

fields.label: Impaired annexin V binding to platelet phosphatidylserine
fields.definition: "Reduced binding of annexin V to platelet membrane, which is mediated by exposed phosphatidylserine. This can be measured by flow cytometry." []
fields.label_normalized: impaired annexin v binding to platelet phosphatidylserine

fields.label: Increased annexin V binding to platelet phosphatidylserine
fields.definition: "Elevated binding of annexin V to platelet membrane, which is mediated by exposed phosphatidylserine. This can be measured by flow cytometry." []
fields.label_normalized: increased annexin v binding to platelet phosphatidylserine

fields.label: Cor triatriatum sinister
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly of the heart characterized by the presence of three atria because the left atrium is divided by an abnormal septum." [PMID:22379596]

fields.label: Triggered by physical trauma
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a trauma (injury to tissue)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Physical trauma triggered symptoms

fields.label: Decreased acrosin in sperm head
fields.definition: "A reduced amount of the enzyme acrosin in the sperm head acrosome. The acrosome is an organelle in the anterior half of the head of spermatozoa, and acrosin is a protease that contributes to the digestation of the zona pellucida in the fertilization process." []

fields.label: Storage in hepatocytes
fields.definition: "Hepatocytes (liver parenchymal cells) exhibit a bloated appearance because of expansion of the cytoplasm by accumulated material." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating B-type natriuretic peptide concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP)." [PMID:22145138]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal circulating b-type natriuretic peptide concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal B-type natriuretic peptide level

fields.label: Frog-leg posture
fields.definition: "A type of rest posture in an infant that indicated a generalized reduction in muscle tone. The hips are flexed and the legs are abducted to an extent that causes the lateral thigh to rest upon the supporting surface. This posture is said to resemble the legs of a frog." []

fields.label: Abnormal liver sonography
fields.definition: "An abnormal appearance of the liver or any of its components on sonography (ultrasound)." []

fields.label: Increased hepatic echogenicity
fields.definition: "Increased echogenicity of liver tissue on sonography, manifested as an increased amount of white on the screen of the sonography device." [PMID:21472065]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperechogenic liver

fields.label: Abnormal hepatic echogenicity
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal degree of echogenicity of the liver on sonography. Echogenicity refers to the ability of a tissue to reflect or transmit ultrasound waves in the context of surrounding tissues. Whenever there is an interface of structures with different echogenicities, a visible difference in contrast will be apparent on the screen. Based on echogenicity, a structure can be characterized as hyperechoic (white on the screen), hypoechoic (gray on the screen) and anechoic (black on the screen)." [PMID:21472065]

fields.label: Decreased hepatic echogenicity
fields.definition: "Reduced echogenicity of liver tissue on sonography, manifested as an increased amount of black on the screen of the sonography device." [PMID:21472065]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoechogenic liver

fields.label: Coarsened hepatic echotexture
fields.definition: "The appearance of the liver in sonographic images is normally uniform. This term applies when there is an irregular or non-uniform appearance of the liver parenchyma in liver sonography." []

fields.label: Starry sky appearance on hepatic sonography
fields.definition: "An abnormal echotexture visible in liver ultrasound manifesting as a diffuse hyperechoic liver echotexture with multiple, small hypoechoic lesions. The appearance is said to resemble a starry sky (multiple white spots on a dark background)." [PMID:26157918]
fields.label_normalized: starry sky appearance on hepatic sonography

fields.label: Impaired oral bolus formation
fields.definition: "An abnormality of swallowing characterized by reduced tongue coordination to form bolus after chewing. Food material spreads over the oral cavity instead of being concentrated into a bolus that is easily swallowed." [PMID:16776766]

fields.label: Vitreomacular adhesion
fields.definition: "Perifoveal vitreous separation with remaining vitreomacular attachment and unperturbed foveal morphologic features. It is an OCT finding that is almost always the result of normal vitreous aging, which may lead to pathologic conditions." [PMID:24053995]
fields.synonyms_concat: VMA

fields.label: Vitreomacular traction
fields.definition: "Vitreomacular traction is characterized by anomalous posterior vitreous detachment accompanied by anatomic distortion of the fovea, which may include pseudocysts, macular schisis, cystoid macular edema, and subretinal fluid. Vitreomacular traction can be subclassified by the diameter of vitreous attachment to the macular surface as measured by OCT, with attachment of 1500 micrometers or less defined as focal and attachment of more than 1500 micrometers as broad." [PMID:24053995]
fields.synonyms_concat: VMT

fields.label: Full-thickness macular hole
fields.definition: "Full-thickness macular hole (FTMH) is defined as a foveal lesion with interruption of all retinal layers from the internal limiting membrane to the retinal pigment epithelium. Full-thickness macular hole is primary if caused by vitreous traction or secondary if directly the result of pathologic characteristics other than vitreomacular traction. Full-thickness macular hole is subclassified by size of the hole as determined by OCT and the presence or absence of vitreomacular traction." [PMID:24053995]
fields.synonyms_concat: FTMH

fields.label: Membranous vitreous appearance
fields.definition: "Vitreous humor of the eye displaying consisting of a vestigial gel in the retrolental space bounded by a convoluted membrane." [PMID:20513134, PMID:21921955]
fields.synonyms_concat: Membranous anomaly; Membranous vitreous; Membranous vitreous phenotype

fields.label: Beaded vitreous appearance
fields.definition: "Vitreous humor of the eye displaying beaded bundles of irregular diameters." [PMID:20513134, PMID:21921955]

fields.label: Increased Arden ratio of electrooculogram
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the Arden ratio, which is the ratio between the light peak and the dark trough of the smoothed (physiologic) EOG record." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased Arden ratio of EOG

fields.label: Decreased platelet glycoprotein Ib
fields.definition: "Decreased platelet cell membrane concentration of glycoprotein Ib." [PMID:11157507]

fields.label: Carotid cavernous fistula
fields.definition: "An abnormal connection between a carotid artery and the cavernous sinus." [PMID:23571267]
fields.synonyms_concat: Caroticocavernous fistula

fields.label: Widened atrophic scar
fields.definition: "An atrophic scar (fibrous connective tissue resulting from incomplete healing of a wound) that has stretched (gotten wider), a manifestation of tissue fragility." [PMID:22353005]

fields.label: Thinning of Descemet membrane
fields.definition: "A reduction in the thickness of Descemet's membrane." []

fields.label: Myelokathexis
fields.definition: "Impaired egress of mature neutrophils from bone marrow causing neutropenia." [PMID:10607719, PMID:25662009]

fields.label: Reduced brain glutamate level by MRS
fields.definition: "An decrease in the level of glutamate (Glu) in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS)." [PMID:24123328]
fields.label_normalized: reduced brain glutamate level by mrs

fields.label: Impaired oropharyngeal swallow response
fields.definition: "Delay or absence of the swallow response, reflexes triggered by the contact the food bolus makes with the anterior faucial pillars." [PMID:27785002]

fields.label: Low femoral bone density
fields.definition: "Reduced bone mineral density of the femur." [PMID:19580459]
fields.synonyms_concat: Low femur bone density

fields.label: Growth arrest lines
fields.definition: "Growth arrest lines are alternating transverse rings of sclerosis at the metaphysis of a long bone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159]
fields.synonyms_concat: Growth resumption lines; Harris lines

fields.label: Multifocal seizures
fields.definition: "Seizures that start from several different areas of the brain (i.e., with multiple ictal onset locations)." [PMID:27091239]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multifocal onset seizures

fields.label: Eyelid myokymia
fields.definition: "Involuntary, fine, continuous, undulating contractions of the eyelid." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Myokymia orbicularis; Orbicularis myokymia

fields.label: Triggered by ingestion of potassium-rich food
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking foods rich in potassium." [PMID:19472919]
synonyms: Triggered by ingestion of K-rich food
fields.label_normalized: triggered by ingestion of potassium-rich food
fields.synonyms_concat: Potassium-rich food triggered symptoms; Triggered by ingestion of K-rich food

fields.label: Postterm pregnancy
fields.definition: "A pregnancy that extends to 42 weeks of gestation or beyond." [PMID:24753906]

fields.label: Female fetal virilization
fields.definition: "Fetal masculinization of female external genitalia." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Female foetal virilization

fields.label: Femoral spur
fields.definition: "A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from the femur, often in the medial femoral neck." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Spurring of femur

fields.label: Sectoral retinitis pigmentosa
fields.definition: "A variant of retinitis pigmentosa in which there is a regional distribution of the retinal degeneration." []

fields.label: Tibial spur
fields.definition: "A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from the tibia." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Spurring of tibiae

fields.label: Double-layered patella
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the patella characterized by two layers visible on lateral knee X-ray such that one layer is in front of the other in the sagittal orientation (See Figure 2A and 3B of PMID:12966518). This finding persists into adulthood." [PMID:12525546, PMID:12966518]

fields.label: Absent cervical vertebra
fields.definition: "A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies of the cervical spine." []

fields.label: Absent thoracic vertebra
fields.definition: "A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies of the thoracic spine." []

fields.label: Finger flexor weakness
fields.definition: "Reduced ability to flex (bend) the fingers. This can manifest as incomplete closure of the hand due to weakness in finger flexion." [PMID:15668452]

fields.label: Fixed head retroflexion
fields.definition: "Head is bent in the posterior direction in a permanent fashion." [PMID:25288843]

fields.label: Nuchal rigidity
fields.definition: "Resistance of the extensor muscles of the neck to being bent forwards (i.e., impaired neck flexion) as a result of muscle spasm of the extensor muscles of the neck. Nuchal rigidity is not a fixed rigidity. Nuchal rigidity has been used as a bedside test for meningism, although its sensitivity for this purpose has been debated." [PMID:12060874]
fields.synonyms_concat: Meningism

fields.label: Erythema migrans
fields.definition: "An expanding erythematous (red) skin lesion, usually round or oval, by definition at least 5 cm in size (in largest diameter)." [PMID:18452799]
fields.synonyms_concat: Erythema chronicum migrans

fields.label: Necrolytic migratory erythema
fields.definition: "Acral or periorificial lesions that evolve in recurrent crops, with an annular and migratory distribution." [PMID:20054043]

fields.label: Elevated circulating NT-proBNP concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of NT-proBNP (= N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide, = N-terminal prohormone of brain natriuretic peptide) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased NT-proBNP level

fields.label: Abnormal circulating deoxycorticosterone level
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the concentration of deoxycorticosterone in the blood. Deoxycorticosterone comprises 11-deoxycorticosterone and 21-deoxycorticosterone." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating pregnenolone concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the concentration of pregnenolone in the blood." [PMID:24849255]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality of circulating pregnenolone level

fields.label: Genital edema
fields.definition: "A buildup of fluid that causes swelling in the soft tissues of the genital area." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Genital oedema

fields.label: Wrist drop
fields.definition: "A condition in which the affected individual cannot extend the wrist, which hangs flaccidly." []

fields.label: Superficial dermal perivascular inflammatory infiltrate
fields.definition: "Numerous lymphocytes surrounding blood vessels in the superficial part of the dermis." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Superficial perivascular inflammatory infiltrate

fields.label: Deep dermal perivascular inflammatory infiltrate
fields.definition: "Numerous lymphocytes surrounding blood vessels in the deep part of the dermis." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Deep perivascular inflammatory infiltrate

fields.label: Abnormal morphology of left ventricular trabeculae
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the left ventricle of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal morphology of left ventricular trabeculae

fields.label: Abnormal morphology of right ventricular trabeculae
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the right ventricle of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal morphology of right ventricular trabeculae

fields.label: Increased density of left ventricular trabeculae
fields.definition: "An increased density (number and tightness) of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the left ventricles of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae)." []
fields.label_normalized: increased density of left ventricular trabeculae

fields.label: Apical hypertrabeculation of the left ventricle
fields.definition: "An increased number and density of the trabeculae in the apex (tip) of the left ventricle." []
fields.label_normalized: apical hypertrabeculation of the left ventricle

fields.label: Thin myocardium compact layer
fields.definition: "Reduced thickness of the outer, dense layer of the myocardium." []

fields.label: Cellular urinary casts
fields.definition: "A type of urinary cast composed of cells incorporated in a protein matrix. The cells can be those found in the urinary sediment (erythrocytes, leuklocytes, renal tubular epithelial cells)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cellular casts

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell casts
fields.definition: "A type of cellular urinary cast composed of renal tubular epithelial cells." []

fields.label: Acellular urinary casts
fields.definition: "A type of urinary cast composed of a proteinaceous matrix without a substantial number of cells." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Acellular casts

fields.label: Hyaline casts
fields.definition: "A type of acellular urinary cast that are composed only of Tamm-Horsfall glycoprotein, a fact which explains their low refractive index. Hyaline casts may display a spectrum of morphologies, which includes fluffy, compact, convoluted or wrinkled casts. Hyaline casts have a smooth texture and usually have parallel sides with clear margins and blunted ends." [PMID:26079824]

fields.label: Granular casts
fields.definition: "A type of acelluar casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented." [PMID:26079824]

fields.label: Waxy casts
fields.definition: "A type of acellular urinary casts that display a melted wax (waxy) appearance, which gives them a high refractive index. They are frequently dark, with blunt extremities, indented and cracked edges and a large size, which is often several times that of other types of casts." [PMID:26079824]

fields.label: Fatty casts
fields.definition: "A type of acellular urinary casts that contain lipid droplets, oval fat bodies or cholesterol crystals, and are often associated with the free forms of these elements. Their identification may require the use of polarized light microscopy, under which fatty particles embedded into the cast matrix appear as Maltese crosses." [PMID:26079824]

fields.label: Bacterial cell casts
fields.definition: "A type of urinary cast that contain bacteria. Bacterial casts can be difficult to identify and can be distinguished from other types of casts using phase contrast microscopy. Bacterial casts are diagnostic of acute pyelonephritis or intrinsic renal infection." [PMID:26079824]

fields.label: Reduced lysosomal acid lipase activity
fields.definition: "Reduction in the activity of lysosomal acid lipase (LAL) in the blood. Lysosomal lipase activity is measured. LAL hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters derived from cell internalization of plasma lipoproteins." [PMID:22227072]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced leukocyte acid lipase activity

fields.label: Striatal T2 hyperintensity
fields.definition: "Abnormally bright T2 signal from the striatum on brain magnetic resonance imaging." [PMID:27058447]

fields.label: Hepatic hemangioma
fields.definition: "A congenital vascular malformation in the liver composed of masses of blood vessels that are atypical or irregular in arrangement and size." [NCIT:C3869, PMID:21191518]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hemangioma of the liver; Liver hemangioma

fields.label: Increased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081). This alpha subunit is common to luteinizing hormone (LH) , follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) , thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), which are glycoprotein hormones composed of an identical alpha subunit together with a beta subunit that confers biological specificity. The alpha subunit is used as a marker for tumors that produce these hormones." []
synonyms: Increased pituitary glycoprotein alpha subunit level
Increased pituitary glycoprotein polypeptide alpha subunit level
fields.label_normalized: increased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased pituitary glycoprotein alpha subunit level; Increased pituitary glycoprotein polypeptide alpha subunit level

fields.label: Decreased circulating lipoprotein lipase concentration
fields.definition: "Reduction in the level of lipoprotein lipase in the blood." [PMID:18194851, PMID:30725725]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased lipoprotein lipase level

fields.label: Abnormal circulating hyaluronic acid concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of hyaluronic acid in the blood." [PMID:11861239]

fields.label: Elevated cholesterol ester level
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of circulating cholesterol esters, which are fatty acid esters of cholesterol and make up about two-thirds of total plasma cholesterol." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated cholesteryl ester level; Increased cholesterol esters; Increased cholesteryl esters

fields.label: Elevated circulating 17-hydroxyprogesterone concentration
fields.definition: "An increased level of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood. 17-hydroxyprogesterone is an intermediate steroid in the adrenal biosynthetic pathway from cholesterol to cortisol and is the substrate for steroid 21-hydroxylase." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating 17-hydroxyprogesterone; Elevated circulating 17-OHP

fields.label: Decreased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone level

fields.label: Decreased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate concentration
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate level

fields.label: Increased circulating progesterone
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of progesterone in the blood." []

fields.label: Hot flashes
fields.definition: "Sudden feelings of warmth that are generally most pronounced over the face, neck and chest." []

fields.label: Inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion
fields.definition: "A state of increased circulating antidiuretic hormone despite hyponatremia and hypo-osmolality with normal or increased plasma volume." []
synonyms: Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion
fields.synonyms_concat: Inappropriate ADH secretion; SIADH; Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion

fields.label: Reduced radioactive iodine uptake
fields.definition: "A decreased amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker." []

fields.label: Increased radioactive iodine uptake
fields.definition: "An elevated amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker." []

fields.label: Abnormal radioactive iodine uptake test result
fields.definition: "Any deviation from normal in the amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal radioactive iodine uptake test result

fields.label: Increased circulating thyroxine-binding globulin level
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Thyroxine-binding globulin high in blood

fields.label: Focal pancreatic islet hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans that affects only certain regions of the pancreas and not others." []

fields.label: Diffuse pancreatic islet hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans with a generalized distribution." []

fields.label: Intrapulmonary shunt
fields.definition: "Blood flow through a region of the lung in which little or no ventilation takes place, resulting in reduced oxygenation of the blood leaving the lungs." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Intrapulmonary shunting

fields.label: Perinephric fluid collection
fields.definition: "An accumulation of fluid in one or more of the perinephric spaces, which consist of the subcapsular, perirenal, anterior and posterior pararenal spaces. This abnormality can be demonstrated by cross-sectional imaging, particularly computed tomography." [PMID:12014928]

fields.label: Nasopharyngeal teratoma
fields.definition: "A teratoma arising in the nasopharyngeal region." [PMID:23056797]

fields.label: Abnormal incisura morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormal shape of the incisura, defined as the narrowed downward continuation of the conchal space bounded anteriorly by the borders of the tragus, posteriorly by the antitragus, and along its lower lateral margins and inferior boundary by the connection between the first two. The upper boundary is a somewhat arbitrary line crossing from the apices of the antitragus and the tragus." [PMID:20082456]

fields.label: Increased incisura length
fields.definition: "The length of the incisura from the upper to lower border is greater than that observed in the average population." [PMID:20082456]

fields.label: Decreased incisura length
fields.definition: "The length of the incisura from the upper to lower border is less than that observed in the average population." [PMID:20082456]

fields.label: Narrow incisura width
fields.definition: "Width of the incisura from the anterior to posterior border less than that observed in the average population." [PMID:20082456]

fields.label: Increased incisura width
fields.definition: "Breadth of the incisura from the anterior to posterior border greater than that observed in the average population." [PMID:20082456]

fields.label: Horizontal inferior border of scapula
fields.definition: "A morphological abnormality of the scapula in which there is a flat (horizontal) inferior edge of the scapula. The entire scapula is said to resemble a square, leading to the designation sqaring of the scapula (in Figure 1 of PMID:24706940 the scapulae have a roughly rectangular shape)." [PMID:24706940]
fields.synonyms_concat: Squaring of the inferior scapulae; Squaring of the scapula

fields.label: Neutrophilic infiltration of the skin
fields.definition: "A predominantly neutrophilic infiltrate of the dermis and or epidermis (i.e., a large number of neutrophils inferred to have migrated into the skin)." []

fields.label: Predominantly epidermal neutrophilic infiltrate
fields.definition: "Collection of neutrophils in the epidermis." [PMID:17675728]

fields.label: Predominantly dermal neutrophilic infiltrate
fields.definition: "Collection of neutrophils in the dermis." [PMID:17675728]

fields.label: Internally nucleated skeletal muscle fibers
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased proportion of nuclei of sarcomeres with an internal localization. Individual muscle fibers are syncytia, formed by embryonic fusion of many myoblasts or later, myosatellite cells. Each muscle fiber contains many nuclei, peripherally positioned immediately adjacent to the sarcolemmal membrane. In healthy muscle only 3-5% of fibers contain nuclei that are located internally, within the cell, but many disease processes lead to internal nuclei." [PMID:22938878]
fields.synonyms_concat: Internally nucleated skeletal muscle fibres

fields.label: Necklace skeletal muscle fibers
fields.definition: "A histological alteration of muscle fibers that resembles a necklace (necklace fibers). A substantial proportion of fibers (4-20% in PMID:19084976) show internalized nuclei aligned in a basophilic ring (necklace) at 3 micrometers beneath the sarcolemma. Ultrastructurally, such necklaces consist of myofibrils of smaller diameter, in oblique orientation, surrounded by mitochondria, sarcoplasmic reticulum and glycogen granules." [PMID:19084976]
fields.synonyms_concat: Necklace skeletal muscle fibres

fields.label: Extrafoveal choroidal neovascularization
fields.definition: "A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the nearest edge of the area of neovascularization is located 200 to 1500 micrometers from the center of the fovea." []

fields.label: Juxtafoveal choroidal neovascularization
fields.definition: "A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the nearest edge of the area of neovascularization is located 1 to 199 micrometers from the center of the fovea." []

fields.label: Subfoveal choroidal neovascularization
fields.definition: "A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the area of neovascularization overlaps with the center of the fovea." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating chylomicron concentration
fields.definition: "Reduced plasma concentrations of chylomicrons, the large lipid droplet (up to 100 mm in diameter) of reprocessed lipid synthesized in epithelial cells of the small intestine and containing triacylglycerols, cholesterol esters, and several apolipoproteins." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating chylomicron levels; Hypochylomicronemia

fields.label: Decreased VLDL cholesterol concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction in the amount of very-low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating very-low-density lipoprotein levels

fields.label: Swollen lip
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the lip typically due to fluid buildup or inflammation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]
fields.synonyms_concat: Edematous lip; Lip swelling; Swelling of the lip

fields.label: Productive cough
fields.definition: "A cough that produces phlegm or mucus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cough with mucus production; Wet cough

fields.label: Nonproductive cough
fields.definition: "A cough that does not produce phlegm or mucus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Dry cough; Dry coughing

fields.label: Whooping cough
fields.definition: "A type of cough characterized by a burst of numerous and rapid coughs followed by a long inhaling effort that is accompanied by a high-pitched whooping sound produced by the inhalation of air." [PMID:24219484]

fields.label: Palmar pruritus
fields.definition: "Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the palm(s) of the hand." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]
fields.synonyms_concat: Itchy palm

fields.label: Parageusia
fields.definition: "A distortion of the sense of taste, often characterized by the sensation of a metallic taste." [PMID:21075995]
fields.synonyms_concat: Altered sense of taste; Dysgeusia; Metallic taste; Metallic taste in mouth

fields.label: Lip fissure
fields.definition: "A severe crack in a lip. A lip fissure may be painful, may bleed and often is a recurring manifestation." []

fields.label: Abnormal subclavian artery morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of a subclavian artery." []

fields.label: Dilated left subclavian artery
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased caliber of the left subclavian artery." []

fields.label: Anomalous origin of left subclavian artery
fields.definition: "Origin of the left subclavian artery from an anomalous anatomical location." []
fields.label_normalized: anomalous origin of left subclavian artery

fields.label: Thalamic arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An arteriovenous malformation is a disruption of the normal vascular pattern in which arteries or arterioles connect directly to the venous collection system, bypassing any capillary bed. This term refers to an arteriovenous malformation located in the thalamus." [PMID:23125071]

fields.label: Hypothalamic arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An arteriovenous malformation is a disruption of the normal vascular pattern in which arteries or arterioles connect directly to the venous collection system, bypassing any capillary bed. This term refers to an arteriovenous malformation located in the hypothalamus." [PMID:23125071]

fields.label: Optic nerve arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An arteriovenous malformation is a disruption of the normal vascular pattern in which arteries or arterioles connect directly to the venous collection system, bypassing any capillary bed. This term refers to an arteriovenous malformation located in the optic nerve." [PMID:23125071]

fields.label: Arteriovenous malformation of the maxilla
fields.definition: "An arteriovenous malformation is a disruption of the normal vascular pattern in which arteries or arterioles connect directly to the venous collection system, bypassing any capillary bed. This term refers to an arteriovenous malformation located in the maxilla." [PMID:17082338, PMID:23125071]

fields.label: Delirium
fields.definition: "A state of sudden and severe confusion." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Altered consciousness or cognition

fields.label: Oophoritis
fields.definition: "An inflammation of the ovary or ovaries." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Inflammed ovary

fields.label: Triangular tibia
fields.definition: "A short, dysplastic tibia with a triangular shape. Instead of the normal shaft configuration of the tibia, the tibia forms a triangle with the longest side corresponding to the proximal-distal dimension, and the apex of the triangle directed laterally." [PMID:18616733]

fields.label: Bladder polyp
fields.definition: "An abnormal growth that projects from the mucous membrane of the urinary bladder." []

fields.label: Abnormal renal corpuscle morphology
fields.definition: "Any anomalous structure of the renal corpuscle, which is the initial component of the nephron that filters blood. The renal corpuscle consists of a knot of capillaries (glomerulus) that is surrounded by a double-walled capsule (Bowman capsule) that opens into a renal tubule." []

fields.label: Abnormal Bowman capsule morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the double-walled capsule (Bowman capsule) that opens into a renal tubule." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal morphology of Bowman capsule; Abnormal morphology of Bowman's capsule; Abnormal renal glomerular capsule morphology

fields.label: Abnormal glomerular visceral epithelial cell morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the podocyte, which is a highly specialized cell of the Bowman capsule and which forms multiple interdigitating foot processes. Podocytes are interconnected by slit diaphragms and cover the exterior basement membrane surface of the glomerular capillary." [PMID:10662721, PMID:26918173]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal glomerular visceral epithelial cell morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal podocyte morphology; Abnormal visceral epithelial cell morphology

fields.label: Podocyte foot process effacement
fields.definition: "An anomaly of podocyte morphology characterized by the loss of the interdigitating foot process pattern (generally called foot process effacement; FPE). The term FPE designates the loss of the usual interdigitating pattern of foot processes of neighboring podocytes, leading to relatively broad expanses of podocyte processes covering the glomerular basement membrane (GBM). It is widely viewed as a pathological derangement that is associated with leakage of macromolecules such as albumin through the glomerular filtration barrier." [PMID:23235479]
fields.synonyms_concat: Loss of primary podocyte processes

fields.label: Abnormal CD69 upregulation upon TCR activation
fields.definition: "Any abnormality in the upregulation of CD69 on T cells after activation via the T cell receptor (TCR). Upregulation of CD69 is one of the earliest and most sensitive measures of antigen recognition in the periphery, and transient expression of CD69 is associated with positive selection in the thymus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal cd69 upregulation upon tcr activation

fields.label: Decreased CD69 upregulation upon TCR activation
fields.definition: "Reduced or impaired upregulation of CD69 on T cells after activation via the T cell receptor (TCR)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]
fields.label_normalized: decreased cd69 upregulation upon tcr activation

fields.label: Abnormal CD25 upregulation upon TCR activation
fields.definition: "Any abnormality in the upregulation of CD25 on T cells after activation via the T cell receptor (TCR). CD25 is the alpha chain of the IL2 receptor. Ligation of the T cell antigen receptor leads to the induction of CD25 expression." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:12121224]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal cd25 upregulation upon tcr activation

fields.label: Decreased CD25 upregulation upon TCR activation
fields.definition: "Decreased or impaired upregulation of CD25 on T cells after activation via the T cell receptor (TCR)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]
synonyms: Poor CD25 upregulation upon TCR activation
Reduced IL2RA upregulation upon TCR activation
fields.label_normalized: decreased cd25 upregulation upon tcr activation
fields.synonyms_concat: Poor CD25 upregulation upon TCR activation; Reduced IL2RA upregulation upon TCR activation

fields.label: Absent ankle pulse
fields.definition: "The pulsation of the posterior tibial artery behind the internal malleolus, or of the dorsalis pedis artery, cannot be detected on physical examination." []

fields.label: Pulmonary arterial atherosclerosis
fields.definition: "Accumulation of lipids and inflammatory cells along the inner walls of the pulmonary artery." []

fields.label: Shock
fields.definition: "The state in which profound and widespread reduction of effective tissue perfusion leads first to reversible, and then if prolonged, to irreversible cellular injury." []

fields.label: Hypovolemic shock
fields.definition: "A state of shock characterized by decreased circulating blood volume in relation to total vascular capacity. This type of shock is characterized by a reduction of diastolic filling pressures." []

fields.label: Distributive shock
fields.definition: "A hyperdynamic process resulting from excessive vasodilatation. Impaired blood flow causes inadequate tissue perfusion, which can lead to end-organ damage" [PMID:28238385]

fields.label: Obstructive shock
fields.definition: "A type of shock characterized by inadequate cardiac preload due to obstructed venous return (e.g. pericardial tamponade, tension pneumothorax, abdominal compartment) or obstruction of arterial blood flow (e.g. pulmonary embolism)." [PMID:28785436]

fields.label: Abnormal thoracic duct morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the thoracic duct." []

fields.label: Abnormal response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test
fields.definition: "An abnormal response to the gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) stimulation test. This test typically involves intravenous administration of GnRH followed by repeated blood sampling at various time points to measure the levels of luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH)." [PMID:22016677]
synonyms: Abnormal response to GnRH stimulation test
fields.label_normalized: abnormal response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal response to GnRH stimulation test

fields.label: Increased LH response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test
fields.definition: "An abnormally high amount of luteinizing hormone (LH) is released upon gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test." [PMID:22016677]
fields.label_normalized: increased lh response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test

fields.label: Sialadenitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of a salivary gland." []

fields.label: Malalignment of the great toenail
fields.definition: "A lateral deviation of the nail plate of the great toe along the longitudinal axis due to the lateral rotation of the nail matrix. The nail plate grows out in ridges." [PMID:27171597]

fields.label: Tufted hairs
fields.definition: "The presence of tufts of 8-15 hairs that appear to emerge from a single follicular orifice." []

fields.label: Flushing
fields.definition: "Recurrent episodes of redness of the skin together with a sensation of warmth or burning of the affected areas of skin." []

fields.label: Abnormal perifollicular morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly in the areas surrounding the hair follicles." []

fields.label: Perifollicular erythema
fields.definition: "Redness surrounding the hair follicles." [PMID:24574696]

fields.label: Seborrheic keratosis
fields.definition: "A raised growth on the skin of older individuals. The lesion usually is initially light tan and may darken to dark brown or nearly black. The consistent feature of seborrheic keratoses is their waxy, pasted-on or stuck-on look." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Basal cell papilloma; Seborrheic verruca; Senile wart

fields.label: Cobblestone-like hyperkeratosis
fields.definition: "The presence of verrucous, cobblestone-like papules and nodules in a region of skin that is said to have an appearance like that of cobblestones." [PMID:18809899]

fields.label: White papule
fields.definition: "A papule with white color." []

fields.label: Tuberous xanthoma
fields.definition: "A type of xanthoma characterized by a nodular form. Tuberous xanthomas are firm subcutaneous nodules,whereby the overlying skin can have red or red-yellow color changes." []

fields.label: Ichthyosis follicularis
fields.definition: "Ichthyosis follicularis is characterized by widespread non inflammatory thorn-like follicular projections. Dyskeratotic papules are most pronounced over the extensor extremities and scalp and are symmetrically distributed." [PMID:14708109, PMID:21600032]

fields.label: Cutaneous abscess
fields.definition: "A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the skin (within the epidermis or dermis)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Skin abscess

fields.label: Digital pitting scar
fields.definition: "Pinhole-sized concave depressions with hyperkeratosis in the skin of a finger or toe." [PMID:8358096]

fields.label: Hypoplastic right atrium
fields.definition: "Underdeveloped, small right heart atrium." []

fields.label: Left atrial enlargement
fields.definition: "Increase in size of the left atrium." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Enlarged heart left atrium

fields.label: Atrial septal hypertrophy
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the thickness of the atrial septum." [PMID:12664819]

fields.label: Coronary sinus enlargement
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase in size of the coronary sinus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Coronary sinus dilatation; Enlarged coronary sinus

fields.label: Elevated left atrial pressure
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in magnitude of the pressure in the left atrium." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating properdin level
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of properdin in the blood." [PMID:16301317]

fields.label: Peripheral arterial calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall." [PMID:24402839, PMID:26811161]
fields.synonyms_concat: Peripheral artery calcification

fields.label: Lower extremity peripheral arterial calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the leg." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Lower extremity peripheral artery calcification

fields.label: Femoral arterial calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the femoral artery." []

fields.label: Iliac arterial calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the iliac artery." []

fields.label: Tibial arterial calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the tibial artery." []

fields.label: Intracranial arterial calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in an artery that is located within the skull (intracranial)." []

fields.label: Internal carotid artery calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the internal carotid artery." []

fields.label: Vertebral artery calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the vertebral artery." []

fields.label: Cerebral artery calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in a cerebral artery." []

fields.label: Basilar artery calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the basilar artery." []

fields.label: Middle cerebral artery calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the middle cerebral artery." []

fields.label: Abdominal aortic calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in abdominal aorta." []

fields.label: Carotid artery calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in a carotid artery." []

fields.label: External carotid artery calcification
fields.definition: "An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the external carotid artery." []

fields.label: Abnormal ventricular myocardium morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the muscle layer of the heart wall of a cardiac ventricle." []

fields.label: Fatty replacement of ventricular myocardial tissue
fields.definition: "Presence of an increased amount of fat tissue within a cardiac ventricle with corresponding reduction of muscle tissue." []
fields.label_normalized: fatty replacement of ventricular myocardial tissue
fields.synonyms_concat: Fatty infiltration of cardiac ventricle; Intramyocardial fat infiltration

fields.label: Myofiber disarray
fields.definition: "A nonparallel arrangement of cardiac myocytes." [PMID:7890275]
fields.synonyms_concat: Myocardial fiber disarray; Myocardial fibre disarray

fields.label: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophy
fields.definition: "An increase in cell size, enhanced protein synthesis, and heightened organization of the sarcomere within cardiac myocytes." [PMID:15066961, PMID:7626345]
fields.synonyms_concat: Myocyte cellular hypertrophy

fields.label: Cardiomyocyte mitochondrial proliferation
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the number of mitochondria per cardiac myocyte." []

fields.label: Myocardial immune cell infiltration
fields.definition: "An increase in the number of immune cells in myocardial tissue (which can be assumed to have migrated into the myocardium)." []

fields.label: Myocardial lymphocytic infiltration
fields.definition: "An increase in the number of lymphocytes in myocardial tissue." []

fields.label: Myocardial eosinophilic infiltration
fields.definition: "An increase in the number of eosinophils in myocardial tissue." []

fields.label: Myocardial multinucleated giant cells
fields.definition: "The presence of extremely large cells with multiple nuclei. The so-called giant cells are thought to be of macrophage origin." [PMID:26140040]

fields.label: Myocardial granulomatous infiltrates
fields.definition: "The presence of multiple granulomata (small nodular inflammatory lesions containing grouped mononuclear phagocytes) in the myocardium." []

fields.label: Monoclonal light chain cardiac amyloidosis
fields.definition: "A type of cardiac amyloidosis related to deposition of an immunoglobulin light chain. The current gold standard of amyloid typing is to determine the precursor protein using laser microdissection mass spectrometry." [PMID:28456755]

fields.label: Cardiac transthyretin amyloid deposition
fields.definition: "A type of cardiac amyloidosis related to deposition of transthyretin (TTR), which is identified by immunohistochemical staining." [PMID:22949539]
fields.synonyms_concat: Transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis; TTR cardiac amyloidosis

fields.label: Perivascular cardiac fibrosis
fields.definition: "A type of myocardial fibrosis characterized by excessive diffuse collagen accumulation concentrated in perivascular spaces." [PMID:10435025]

fields.label: Interstitial cardiac fibrosis
fields.definition: "A type of myocardial fibrosis characterized by excessive diffuse collagen accumulation concentrated in interstitial spaces." [PMID:10435025]

fields.label: Perivascular myocardial immune cell infiltration
fields.definition: "An increase in the number of immune cells in myocardial tissue concentrated in the spaces surrounding blood vessels." []

fields.label: Abnormal cardiomyocyte morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of cardiomyocytes, which are terminally differentiated muscle cells in the heart that are interconnected end to end by gap junctions, which allows coordinated contraction of heart tissue." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal cardiac muscle cell morphology

fields.label: Cardiomyocyte degeneration
fields.definition: "Deterioration of cardiomyocyte characterized by abnormal features such as loss of myofilaments, occurrence of cellular sequestration, decreased mitochondrial sizes and cellular debris." []

fields.label: Myocardial sarcomeric disarray
fields.definition: "A disruption of the structure of the sarcomeres of cardiomyocytes. The sarcomere is the repeating unit between two Z lines comprised largely of myosin and actin that mediates contractility, and normally sarcomeres are aligned with the long axis of cells, with the Z bands being in register throughout the length of the cardiac myocytes." [PMID:22311886, PMID:7788887]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cardiac biopsy: myocyte disarray; Cardiomyocyte disarray; Myocardial sarcomere disarray

fields.label: Cardiomyocyte inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within cardiomyocytes." []

fields.label: Abnormal cardiomyocyte mitochondrial morphology
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the structure of mitochondria within cardiomyocytes." []

fields.label: Intranuclear cardiomyocyte mitochondria
fields.definition: "Abnormal localization of mitochondria within the nuclei of cardiomyocytes." [PMID:22948484]

fields.label: Abnormal cardiomyocyte connexin43 staining
fields.definition: "Anomalous staining of Connexin43 in cardiomyocytes. Connexin43 (Cx43) is the primary gap junction protein in the working myocardium. Cx43 exhibits increased localization at the lateral membranes of cardiomyocytes in a variety of heart diseases." [PMID:20167932]

fields.label: Abnormal cardiomyocyte plakoglobin staining
fields.definition: "Anomalous staining of plakoglobin in cardiomyocytes. Plakoglobin is a component of desmosomes in cardiomyocytes." [PMID:25196244]

fields.label: Abnormal cardiomyocyte dystrophin staining
fields.definition: "Anomalous staining of dystrophin in cardiomyocytes." [PMID:23330010]

fields.label: Abnormal lysosomal morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of lysosomes, membrane-enclosed organelles that contain an array of enzymes capable of catabolizing proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids." []

fields.label: Gastric arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the stomach." []

fields.label: Duodenal arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the duodenum." []

fields.label: Jejunal arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the jejunum." []

fields.label: Pelvic arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the pelvis." [PMID:11292918]

fields.label: Colonic arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the colon." []

fields.label: Rectal arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the rectum." []

fields.label: Uterine arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the uterus." []

fields.label: Dextrotransposition of the great arteries
fields.definition: "A type of transposition of the great arteries (TGA) in which aorta is in front of and primarily to the right of the pulmonary artery. This is the most common kind of TGA." [PMID:25082585]
synonyms: D-loop transposition of the great arteries
fields.synonyms_concat: D-loop transposition of the great arteries; D-TGA

fields.label: Cardiac sarcoma
fields.definition: "A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the heart." [NCIT:C7723]

fields.label: Calcified amorphous tumor of the heart
fields.definition: "A non-neoplastic cardiac tumor characterized by calcification and eosinophilic amorphous material in the background of dense collagenous fibrous tissue." [PMID:24932362]
synonyms: Calcified amorphous tumour of the heart
fields.label_normalized: calcified amorphous tumor of the heart
fields.synonyms_concat: Calcified amorphous tumour of the heart

fields.label: Chest tightness
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation of tightness or pressure in the chest." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:16990972, PMID:18405952]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chest distress; Tightness in chest; Tightness of chest

fields.label: Otitis media with effusion
fields.definition: "Otitis media characterized by thick or sticky fluid behind the tympanic membrane." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fluid behind eardrum; Middle ear effusions; OME

fields.label: Sleep onset insomnia
fields.definition: "Difficulty initiating sleep, that is, increased sleep onset latency, refers to the condition where it takes 30 minutes or more to fall asleep." [PMID:35460140]
fields.synonyms_concat: Difficulty falling asleep; Early insomnia; Increased sleep latency; Sleep onset insomnia; Trouble falling asleep

fields.label: Maintenance insomnia
fields.definition: "Individuals affected by abnormal difficulty in staying asleep tend to wake up at night and struggle to return to sleep. This condition typically involves spending more than 30 minutes awake during the night." [PMID:35460140]
synonyms: Waking up several times during the night
fields.synonyms_concat: Difficulty staying asleep; Insomnia middle; Middle insomnia; Waking up several times during the night

fields.label: Terminal insomnia
fields.definition: "Waking up earlier than intended and being unable to return to sleep." [PMID:35460140]
fields.synonyms_concat: Early morning awakening; Late insomnia; Premature awakening

fields.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
fields.definition: "A histologically distinctive, cutaneous, benign vascular tumor that is characterized by a solitary or multiple blue-red papules and histologically resembles renal glomeruli." [PMID:23716835]

fields.label: Vegetative state
fields.definition: "The absence of wakefulness and consciousness, but in contrast to a coma, there is involuntary opening of the eyes and movements such as teeth grinding, yawning, or thrashing of the extremities." [PMID:18771395]
fields.synonyms_concat: Unresponsive wakefulness

fields.label: Cutaneous sclerotic plaque
fields.definition: "A solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter that is characterized by hardening (sclerosis) of the affected skin area (related to collagen thickening)." []

fields.label: Yellow skin plaque
fields.definition: "A solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter and that has a yellow color." []

fields.label: Zebra bodies
fields.definition: "Intralysosomal, osmiophilic, lamellated and sometimes concentric cytoplasmic inclusions comprised of broad transversely-stacked myelinoid membranes and said to resemble a zebra in electron microscopic images." [PMID:28499424]

fields.label: Palpable purpura
fields.definition: "A type of purpura in which the lesions are raised (and can therefore be appreciated upon palpation)." []

fields.label: Ecchymosis
fields.definition: "A purpuric lesion that is larger than 1 cm in diameter." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ecchymoses

fields.label: Macular purpura
fields.definition: "Purpura that is flat (non-palpable, not raised)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Flat purpura

fields.label: Palate neoplasm
fields.definition: "A neoplasm that affects the hard palate, soft palate, or uvula." [NCIT:C4402]

fields.label: Metaphyseal striations
fields.definition: "Longitudinal densities on radiographs located in a metaphysis (the narrow region of a long bone between the epiphysis and the diaphysis)." [PMID:18203204]
fields.synonyms_concat: Striated metaphysis

fields.label: Intestinal perforation
fields.definition: "A hole (perforation) in the wall of the intestine." []

fields.label: Colon perforation
fields.definition: "A hole (perforation) in the wall of the colon." [PMID:22334860]
fields.synonyms_concat: Perforation of the colon

fields.label: Small intestinal perforation
fields.definition: "A hole (perforation) in the wall of the small intestine." []

fields.label: Rectal perforation
fields.definition: "A hole (perforation) in the wall of the rectum." [PMID:28290145]

fields.label: Cold paresis
fields.definition: "Increased muscle weakness upon exposure to cold temperatures." [PMID:20803025]

fields.label: Stiff tongue
fields.definition: "Increased rigidity and reduced mobility of the tongue." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Tongue stiffness

fields.label: Ankle weakness
fields.definition: "Reduced strength of the muscles that lift or otherwise move the foot at the ankle." []

fields.label: Refractory
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is difficult to treat or cure." []

fields.label: Abnormal cell proliferation
fields.definition: "Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of cells, which may result in the expansion of a cell population." []

fields.label: Abnormal lymphocyte proliferation
fields.definition: "Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of lymphocytes, which results in the expansion of a cell population." []

fields.label: Abnormal T cell proliferation
fields.definition: "Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of T cells, which results in the expansion of a cell population." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Defective T cell proliferation

fields.label: Abnormal B cell proliferation
fields.definition: "Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of B cells, which results in the expansion of a cell population." []

fields.label: Decreased mitogen-induced T-cell proliferation
fields.definition: "Abnormal decrease of T cell proliferation in response to mitogenic stimuli. This is commonly measured through intracellular expression of Ki67, decreasing surface expression of carboxyfluorescein diacetate (CFSE), or 3H-thymidine incorporation. Length of incubation, specific stimulus and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories." []
synonyms: Decreased lymphocyte proliferation in response to mitogen
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased lymphocyte proliferation in response to mitogen; Reduced lymphocyte proliferation to mitogen
