fields.definition: "A form of divergent strabismus (exotropia) in which the eye turns outward at all distances and at all times." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Distance exotropia
fields.definition: "A type of divergent strabismus (exotropia) in which an eye tends to turn outwards (i.e., the eye squints) mainly when looking at distant objects. The eyes tend to remain straight when they look at near objects. Distance exotropia may be constant or intermittent." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Near exotropia
fields.definition: "An intermittent exotropia where there is binocular single vision on distance fixation and exotropia at near (intermittent or constant)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Cyclic exotropia
fields.definition: "A type of exotropia (divergent strabismus) in which binocular single vision alternates with large angle exotropia in rhythmic cycle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Alternating exotropia
fields.definition: "A type of exotropia in which either eye may be used for fixation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Alternating strabismus

fields.label: Consecutive exotropia
fields.definition: "Exotropia in an individual who has previously had esotropia or esophoria." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: True distance exotropia
fields.definition: "Exotropia (intermittent or constant) on distance fixation with binocular single vision on near fixation under all testing conditions. The accommodative convergence/accommodation (AC:A) ratio is within normal limits." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Simulated distance exotropia
fields.definition: "Exotropia (intermittent or constant) worse for distance fixation in which the near angle of deviation increases (or near exophoria becomes exotropia) with: (1) prolonged disruption of fusion and/or (2) elimination of accommodation." []

fields.label: Sensory exotropia
fields.definition: "A type of divergent strabismus (exotropia) that develops in a poorly seeing eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Secondary exotropia

fields.label: Near esotropia
fields.definition: "An intermittent esotropia where there is binocular single vision on distance fixation and esotropia at near even when the accommodation is relieved." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Non-accomodative convergence excess esotropia

fields.label: Secondary esotropia
fields.definition: "Convergent squint which follows loss or impairment of vision." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sensory esotropia

fields.label: Microtropia
fields.definition: "A small angle heterotropia (usually of 10 diopters or less) in which a form of binocular single vision occurs." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Hypophoria
fields.definition: "A form of latent strabismus (heterophoria) in which, on dissociation, the occluded eye deviates downwards." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Incyclotropia
fields.definition: "A type of cyclotropia (torsion of one or both eye around the visual axis of the eyes) in which the upper poles of the globes are rotated inward (medially) to each other." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Excyclotropia
fields.definition: "A type of cyclotropia (torsion of one or both eye around the visual axis of the eyes) in which the upper poles of the globes are rotated outward (laterally) to each other." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Mild hypermetropia
fields.definition: "A form of hypermetropia with not more than +2.00 diopters." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mild hyperopia

fields.label: Moderate hypermetropia
fields.definition: "A form of hypermetropia with more than +2.00 diopters but not more than +5.00 diopters." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Moderate hyperopia

fields.label: Axial myopia
fields.definition: "A form of myopia related to an axial length above the norm and too long for the refractive power of the whole optical system of the eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:24113300]

fields.label: Increased tear production
fields.definition: "Increased lacrimation owing to overproduction of tears." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Increased basal tear production
fields.definition: "A form of watery eye associated with overproduction of tears due to an increased parasympathetic drive to the secretory component of the lacrimal system (lacrimal gland); this could be due to pro-secretory drug use (e.g. pilocarpine) or autonomic disturbance." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Reflex tearing
fields.definition: "A form of watery eye associated with overproduction of tears due to reflex tearing in response to a local irritant (e.g. trichiasis or foreign body), chronic ocular surface disease (e.g. blepharitis) or systemic disease (e.g. thyroid eye disease)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Lacrimal pump failure
fields.definition: "A form of watery eye associated with abnormal lid tone and/or lid position. The former is due to lid laxity (common involutional change in the elderly) or a weak orbicularis muscle (e.g. due to VII cranial nerve palsy). The latter is typically associated with ectropion causing punctal eversion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Involutional entropion
fields.definition: "An abnormal inversion of the eyelid towards the globe resulting from inferior retractor muscle dysfunction with tissue laxity and, possibly, overriding of the preseptal orbicularis muscle over the pretarsal orbicularis muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Cicatricial entropion
fields.definition: "Abnormal inversion (turning inward) of the eyelid towards the globe associated with scarring that vertically shortens the posterior lamella of the eyelid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Mechanical entropion
fields.definition: "A type of entropion (abnormal inversion of the eyelid towards the globe) that is related to a mass effect of a lesion (e.g., a tumor) that pulls the eyelid margin away from the globe." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal oblique muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the inferior or superior oblique muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal horizontal rectus muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the medial rectus muscle or lateral rectus muscle." []

fields.label: Inferior oblique muscle underaction
fields.definition: "Reduced ocular movement by the inferior oblique muscle which improves on testing ductions, typically associated with neurogenic palsy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Inferior rectus muscle underaction
fields.definition: "Reduced movement by the inferior rectus muscle which improves on testing ductions, typically associated with neurogenic palsy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Inferior rectus muscle overaction
fields.definition: "Excessive action of the inferior rectus muscle caused by increased innervation typically as a consequence of palsy or limitation to the ipsilateral antagonist or contralateral synergist." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Superior rectus muscle weakness
fields.definition: "Decreased strength of the superior rectus muscle." []

fields.label: Superior rectus muscle overaction
fields.definition: "Excessive action of the superior rectus muscle caused by increased innervation typically as a consequence of palsy or limitation to the ipsilateral antagonist or contralateral synergist." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Superior rectus muscle restriction
fields.definition: "Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the superior rectus muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Superior rectus muscle underaction
fields.definition: "Reduced movement of the superior rectus muscle which improves on testing ductions, typically associated with neurogenic palsy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal vertical rectus muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the superior or inferior rectus muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal lateral rectus muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the lateral rectus muscle." []

fields.label: Lateral rectus muscle weakness
fields.definition: "Decreased strength (ability to move) of the lateral rectus muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Lateral rectus muscle underaction
fields.definition: "Reduced movement of the lateral rectus muscle which improves on testing ductions, typically associated with neurogenic palsy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Lateral rectus muscle overaction
fields.definition: "Excessive action of the lateral rectus muscle caused by increased innervation typically as a consequence of palsy or limitation to the ipsilateral antagonist or contralateral synergist." []

fields.label: Medial rectus muscle weakness
fields.definition: "Decreased strength of the medial rectus muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Medial rectus muscle overaction
fields.definition: "Excessive action of the medial rectus muscle caused by increased innervation typically as a consequence of palsy or limitation to the ipsilateral antagonist or contralateral synergist." []

fields.label: Abnormal rectus muscle physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of a vertical or horizontal rectus muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Medial rectus muscle underaction
fields.definition: "Reduced movement of the medial rectus muscle which improves on testing ductions, typically associated with neurogenic palsy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Medial rectus muscle restriction
fields.definition: "Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the medial rectus muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Lateral rectus muscle restriction
fields.definition: "Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the lateral rectus muscle." []

fields.label: Basic constant esotropia
fields.definition: "A form of convergent strabismus (esotropia) in which the deviation is present under all conditions (ie at all distances and at all times)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Basic (constant) esotropia

fields.label: Non-accomodative esotropia
fields.definition: "A form of esotropia in which the angle of deviation is not affected by accommodative effort." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Infantile constant esotropia
fields.definition: "Constant esotropia occurring before 6 months of age. It is typically associated with a large angle of deviation, alternating fixation (therefore low risk of amblyopia) and poor potential for binocular single vision. Other features that might be present in individuals with infantile (constant) esotropia include latent nystagmus or manifest latent nystagmus, dissociated vertical divergence, cyclotropia, abnormal head posture, limited abduction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Infantile (constant) esotropia

fields.label: Distance esotropia
fields.definition: "An intermittent esotropia where binocular single vision is present on near fixation and an esotropia on distance fixation. Often associated with myopia and aging." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Divergence insufficiency

fields.label: Cyclic esotropia
fields.definition: "Convergent strabismus in which normal binocular single vision is alternating with large angle esotropia in rhythmic cycle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Fully accomodative esotropia
fields.definition: "Esotropia in which normal binocular single vision is present for all distances when the hypermetropic refractive error is corrected. Esotropia is present for near and distance on accommodation without correction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Partially accomodative esotropia
fields.definition: "A form of constant esotropia in which the angle of deviation is partially affected by accommodative effort. Typically there is esotropia at near and distance with hypermetropic correction and the angle of deviation increases without glasses." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
synonyms: Constant esotropia with an accommodative component
Constant esotropia with an accommodative element
fields.synonyms_concat: Constant esotropia with an accommodative component; Constant esotropia with an accommodative element

fields.label: Convergence excess esotropia
fields.definition: "An intermittent esotropia with binocular single vision present at distance fixation but esotropia on accommodation for near fixation. Usually associated with hypermetropia but patients can be emmetropic and rarely myopic. Associated with a high accommodative convergence/accommodation (AC/A) ratio." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Consecutive esotropia
fields.definition: "Esotropia in a patient who has previously had exotropia or exophoria; may be constant or intermittent and usually follows surgical overcorrection." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Parafoveal fixation
fields.definition: "Fixation of an object in the area adjacent to the fovea." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Peripheral fixation
fields.definition: "Fixation of an object in a peripheral area of the retina." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Epicanthus palpebralis
fields.definition: "A type of epicanthus in which a medial vertical fold is present between upper and lower lids." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Epicanthus tarsalis
fields.definition: "A type of epicanthus in which a primarily upper lid fold is present." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal posterior circulating artery morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the posterior circulating artery (PCOM)." []

fields.label: Posterior communicating artery aneurysm
fields.definition: "A widening (ballooning) localized in the wall of the posterior communicating artery." []

fields.label: Posterior communicating artery infundibulum
fields.definition: "A funnel-shaped symmetrical enlargement of the origin of the posterior communicating artery at its junction with the internal carotid artery." [PMID:9848859]

fields.label: Neurogenic strabismus
fields.definition: "An ocular deviation caused by a palsy to one or more of the extraocular muscles or nerves supplying them." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Paralytic strabismus

fields.label: Cyclotropia
fields.definition: "A form of manifest strabismus (heterotropia) in which the one eye is wheel rotated so that the upper end of its vertical axis is nasal (incyclotropia) or temporal (excyclotropia)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Cyclophoria
fields.definition: "A form of latent strabismus (heterophoria) in which the occluded eye wheel-rotates on dissociation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Incyclophoria
fields.definition: "A type of cyclophoria (latent strabismus in which the occluded eye wheel-rotates on dissociation.) in which the upper poles of the globes are rotated inward (medially) to each other." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Excyclophoria
fields.definition: "A type of cyclophoria (latent strabismus in which the occluded eye wheel-rotates on dissociation.) in which the upper poles of the globes are rotated outward (laterally) to each other." []

fields.label: Eosinophilic ascites
fields.definition: "A type of ascites in which there are large numbers of eosinophils in the ascitis fluid." [PMID:27721930]

fields.label: Microtropia with identity
fields.definition: "A type of microtropia with no manifest movement on cover test, the eccentric fixation point coinciding with the angle of ARC." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:9602615]

fields.label: Microtropia without identity
fields.definition: "A type of microtropia in which the manifest movement is demonstrated on the cover-uncover test." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:9602615]

fields.label: Absent coronary sinus
fields.definition: "A developmental defect in which the coronary sinus fails to form." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:24551710]

fields.label: Abnormal ascending aorta morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the portion of the aorta that arises from the base of the left ventricle and extends upward to the aortic arch and from which the coronary arteries arise." [MP:0009867]

fields.label: Abnormal eyelid movement
fields.definition: "An abnormality in voluntary or involuntary eyelid movements or their control." []

fields.label: Cogan lid twitch
fields.definition: "Transient eyelid retraction during refixation from down to straight ahead." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cogan eyelid twitch; Eyelid twitch; Lid twitch

fields.label: Oblique astigmatism
fields.definition: "Astigmatism in which the refractive power of the vertical meridian is the greatest." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: With the rule astigmatism
fields.definition: "Refractive error in which the vertical meridian is relatively hypermetropic and the horizontal meridian is relatively myopic (or ocular astigmatism in which the refractive power of the horizontal meridian is the greatest)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Against the rule astigmatism
fields.definition: "Astigmatism with more plus power on the horizontal meridian." []

fields.label: Mixed astigmatism
fields.definition: "A type of astigmatism in which an unequal curvature of the cornea and some cases additionally of the lens causes one meridian of the eye to be hyperopic (farsighted) and a second meridian that is perpendicular to the first to be myopic (nearsighted)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Lenticular astigmatism
fields.definition: "A type of astigmatism related to an irregular shape of the lens." []

fields.label: Irregular astigmatism
fields.definition: "A type of astigmatism in which the principle meridians are not 90 degrees apart and which is associated with loss of vision." []

fields.label: Increased serum leptin
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of leptin in the blood." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_sjwang]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating leptin level

fields.label: Decreased circulating glycerol level
fields.definition: "A decrease below the normal concentration of glycerol in the blood." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating glycerol level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of glycerol in the blood." []

fields.label: Recurrent
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign, symptom or manifestation that occurs multiple times separated by intervals in which the sign, symptom, or manifestation is not present." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Intermittent

fields.label: Clinical course
fields.definition: "The course a disease typically takes from its onset, progression in time, and eventual resolution or death of the affected individual." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Natural history of disease

fields.label: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein B concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of apolipoprotein B in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated ApoB level; Elevated apolipoprotein B level

fields.label: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein A-I concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of apolipoprotein A-I below the lower limit of normal. Apolipoprotein A-I is the major protein component of high density lipoprotein (HDL) in plasma. Defects in this gene are associated with HDL deficiencies, including Tangier disease." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5356-4174]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased apo-AI level; Decreased apoA-I level; Decreased apolipoprotein AI level

fields.label: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein A-II concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration in blood of apolipoprotein A-II, a major component of HDL particles, associated with triglyceride and glucose metabolism." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5356-4174]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated Apo-AII level; Elevated apoA-II level; Elevated APOAII level; Elevated apolipoprotein A-II level

fields.label: Vocal cord dysfunction
fields.definition: "Any functional anomaly of the vocal cord." []

fields.label: Fundus hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Bleeding within the fundus of the eye." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Fundus haemorrhage

fields.label: Intraretinal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A subtype of fundus hemorrhage occurring within the neurosensory retina. Intraretinal hemorrhages may be 'dot' or' blot' shaped, flame shaped or confluent depending upon their depth within the retina." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intraretinal haemorrhage

fields.label: Abnormal total basophil count
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of absolute number of basophils in the blood, per microliter, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []

fields.label: Increased total basophil count
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase of absolute number of basophils in the blood, per microliter, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Basophilia; Increased basophil count

fields.label: Decreased total basophil count
fields.definition: "Abnormal decrease of absolute number of basophils in the blood, per microliter, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased basophil count

fields.label: Archibald's sign
fields.definition: "Shortening of the fourth and fifth metacarpals when the fist is clenched." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6469-1475, PMID:22075011, PMID:22629539]
fields.synonyms_concat: Archibald's metacarpal sign; Knuckle dimple

fields.label: Anti-ganglioside antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react to gangliosides." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:8027366]

fields.label: Bilirubinuria
fields.definition: "Presence of conjugated bilirubin in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610]

fields.label: Nitrituria
fields.definition: "Presence of nitrites in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:27377945]

fields.label: Colonic eosinophilia
fields.definition: "An excess of eosinophilic cells in colonic tissue, i.e., eosinophilic infiltration in the colon." [PMID:21922029]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eosinophilic colitis; Eosinophilic infiltration in the colon

fields.label: Palilalia
fields.definition: "Palilalia is the involuntary repetition of one's own phrases, words, or syllables 2 or more times in a row. Typically, palilalic utterances decrease in volume with the increasing number of repetitions. Sometimes, the repetitions are also uttered with an accelerating speed." [PMID:31651053]

fields.label: Abnormal oral physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the mouth (which is also known as the oral cavity)." []

fields.label: Abnormal oral morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the mouth, which is also known as the oral cavity." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating parathyroid hormone level
fields.definition: "An abnormally decreased concentration of parathyroid hormone." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_gthayman, PMID:1302009]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating PTH level; Decreased serum parathyroid hormone; Decreased serum parathyroid hormone level; Decreased serum PTH

fields.label: Abnormal waist to hip ratio
fields.definition: "A deviation from normal of the waist to hip ratio, defined as the waist measurement divided by hip measurement." []

fields.label: Increased waist to hip ratio
fields.definition: "Increased waist-to-hip ratio (WHR) is a measurement above the average for the dimensionless ratio of the circumference of the waist to that of the hips. WHR is calculated as waist measurement divided by hip measurement." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5356-4174, PMID:12872269]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased waist-hip ratio; Increased waist-to-hip ratio; Increased WHR

fields.label: Decreased waist to hip ratio
fields.definition: "Decreased waist-to-hip ratio (WHR) is a measurement below the average for the dimensionless ratio of the circumference of the waist to that of the hips. WHR is calculated as waist measurement divided by hip measurement." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_gthayman, PMID:12872269]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased waist-hip ratio; Decreased waist-to-hip ratio; Decreased WHR

fields.label: Abnormal hypoxanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase level
fields.definition: "Altered level of the enzyme that catalyzes conversion of hypoxanthine to inosine monophosphate and guanine to guanosine monophosphate via transfer of the 5-phosphoribosyl group from 5-phosphoribosyl 1-pyrophosphate." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_sjwang]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal 6-hydroxypurine phosphoribosyltransferase level; Abnormal GMP pyrophosphorylase level; Abnormal GPRT level

fields.label: Elevated hypoxanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase level
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased level of the enzyme that catalyzes conversion of hypoxanthine to inosine monophosphate and guanine to guanosine monophosphate via transfer of the 5-phosphoribosyl group from 5-phosphoribosyl 1-pyrophosphate." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_sjwang]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated 6-hydroxypurine phosphoribosyltransferase level; Elevated 6-mercaptopurine phosphoribosyltransferase level; Elevated GMP pyrophosphorylase level

fields.label: Reduced hypoxanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase level
fields.definition: "Abnormally decreased level of the enzyme that catalyzes conversion of hypoxanthine to inosine monophosphate and guanine to guanosine monophosphate via transfer of the 5-phosphoribosyl group from 5-phosphoribosyl 1-pyrophosphate." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_sjwang]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced 6-hydroxypurine phosphoribosyltransferase level; Reduced 6-mercaptopurine phosphoribosyltransferase level; Reduced GMP pyrophosphorylase level

fields.label: Hepatic mastocytosis
fields.definition: "Liver mast cell infiltration." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25009756]

fields.label: Freezing of gait
fields.definition: "Freezing of gait is defined as a brief, episodic absence or marked reduction of forward progression of the feet despite the intention to walk." [PMID:23625316, PMID:27770207]
fields.synonyms_concat: Freezing gait

fields.label: Abnormal reflex
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of a reflex, i.e., of an automatic response mediated by the nervous system (a reflex does not need the intervention of conscious thought to occur)." []

fields.label: Absent abdominal reflex
fields.definition: "Lack of contraction of abdominal muscles in the quadrant of the abdomen that is stimulated by scraping the skin tangential to or toward the umbilicus." [PMID:12531937, PMID:24785227]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abdominal reflex absent

fields.label: Abnormal superficial reflex
fields.definition: "An anomaly of a reflex that is elicited as a motor response to scraping of the skin. They are generally graded as present or absent. They differ from tendon reflexes in that the sensory signal must ascend the spinal cord to reach the brain and then descend the spinal cord to reach the motor neurons." []

fields.label: Absent cremaster reflex
fields.definition: "Lack of response to scratching of the skin of the medial thigh, which in males normally elicits a brisk, short elevation of the ipsilateral testis, a phenomenon that is referred to as the cremaster reflex." [PMID:12891505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent cremasteric reflex

fields.label: Pinguecula
fields.definition: "A pinguecula is a yellowish to brown protruding lesion in the conjunctiva that is easily seen on the nasal and temporal sides of the cornea." [PMID:24311926]

fields.label: Decreased serum zinc
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration of zinc in the blood." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_gthayman, PMID:16518702]

fields.label: Hypermetric downward saccades
fields.definition: "Overshoot of downward saccadic eye movements." []

fields.label: Hypometric upward saccades
fields.definition: "Saccadic undershoot of upward saccadic eye movements, i.e., an upward saccadic eye movement that has less than the magnitude that would be required to gain fixation of the object." []

fields.label: Aortopulmonary collateral arteries
fields.definition: "Small ectopic arteries or arterial branches that connect the aorta, aortic branches and/or subclavian artery regions directly to the lung parenchyma, usually seen in conjunction with pulmonary atresia, ventricular septal defect (VSD) and/or closed ductus arteriosus." [MP:0010635, PMID:26467877]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating superoxide dismutase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of superoxide dismutase is above or below the limits of normal in the blood circulation." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_gthayman, PMID:25276767]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal superoxide dismutase level; Abnormal superoxide:superoxide oxidoreductase activity

fields.label: Increased circulating superoxide dismutase concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of superoxide dismutase is above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_gthayman]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased superoxide dismutase level; Increased superoxide:superoxide oxidoreductase activity

fields.label: Decreased circulating superoxide dismutase concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of superoxide dismutase is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_gthayman, PMID:25276767]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased superoxide dismutase level; Decreased superoxide:superoxide oxidoreductase activity

fields.label: Presence of xenobiotic
fields.definition: "Presence of a chemical substance found within an individual that is not naturally produced or expected to be present in human tissues or bodily fluids." []

fields.label: Urine xenobiotic
fields.definition: "The presence of a xenobiotic in urine." []

fields.label: Positive urine methadone test
fields.definition: "Detection of methadone or its metabolite 2-ethylidene-1,5-dimethyl-3,3- diphenylpyrrolidine (EDDP) in urine." []

fields.label: Lymphangiectasis
fields.definition: "Dilation of the lymphatic vessels, the basic process that may result in the formation of a lymphangioma." [MP:0004038]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lymphangiectasia

fields.label: Abnormally slow thought process
fields.definition: "An inner sense from the self that thoughts are abnormally slow and the individual feels that they are unable to increase their rate of thinking. The primary pathology is the decreased rate and other qualities of thinking (e.g. naming of objects) are intact, just slowed. This may be associated with slowed speech, but may be internal and masked by speech that is limited to brief (yes or no) answers." [PMID:25850732]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormally slow thought processes; Bradyphrenia; Mental slowness; Slow thought processes; Slowed thinking; Slowed thoughts; Slowness of thought

fields.label: Euphoria
fields.definition: "Elevation of emotional tone or mood that significantly deviates from normative affective functioning. This state is characterized by an overwhelming and all-encompassing sense of joyous well-being; it is associated with unfounded grandiosity, or grossly inflated self-esteem, rapid speech, impulsivity, and an impaired capacity for self-regulation, irrespective of context." [PMID:37636238]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal positive emotional state; Abnormally elevated mood; Elevated positive affect; Emotional high; Emotional hyperexcitability; Enhanced pleasure response; Euphoric mood; Excessive joyfulness; Exhilaration; Extreme elation; Extreme hedonic state; Extreme positive valence; High emotions; High mood; Hyperthymia; Hyperthymic state; Inappropriate elation; Inappropriately happy; Jubilation; Pathological cheerfulness; Pathological emotional elevation; Revved

fields.label: Abnormal libido
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal sexual drive or desire for sexual activity." []

fields.label: Femur fracture
fields.definition: "A break or crush injury of the thigh bone (femur)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Femoral fracture

fields.label: Difficulty walking backward
fields.definition: "Reduced ability to walk (ambulate) in a backwards direction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Cock-walk gait
fields.definition: "An abnormality of gait that can be observed in individuals with dystonic posture in which the individual walks with an extended trunk and flexed arms, while strutting on the toes without the heels touching the floor." [PMID:24746291]

fields.label: Sleep-wake inversion
fields.definition: "A reversal of sleeping habits, with a tendency to sleep during the day and be awake at night." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Inverted sleep-wake cycle; Reversed sleep-wake cycle; Sleep rhythm inversion

fields.label: Abnormal hematocrit
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal ratio of the volume of red blood cells to the total volume of blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal Hct

fields.label: Reduced hematocrit
fields.definition: "A reduction below the normal ratio of the volume of red blood cells to the total volume of blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Low hematocrit; Reduced Hct

fields.label: Isomerism
fields.definition: "Isomerism in the context of the congenitally malformed heart is defined as a situation where some paired structures on opposite sides of the left-right axis of the body are, in morphologic terms, symmetrical mirror images of each other." [PMID:21731561]

fields.label: Left Isomerism
fields.definition: "A type of heterotaxy where some paired structures on opposite sides of the left-right axis of the body are symmetrical mirror images of each other, and have the morphology of the normal left-sided structures." [PMID:21731561]
fields.synonyms_concat: Left-sided isomerism

fields.label: Right isomerism
fields.definition: "A type of heterotaxy where some paired structures on opposite sides of the left-right axis of the body are symmetrical mirror images of each other, and have the morphology of the normal right-sided structures." [PMID:21731561]
fields.synonyms_concat: Right-sided isomerism

fields.label: Hobby horse gait
fields.definition: "An abnormal gait characterized by toe walking, stiff legs, and skipping. The gait pattern has some resemblance to cock-walk gait, but affected individuals are able to improve their dystonic gait by walking backward." [PMID:21956287]

fields.label: Ineffective esophageal peristalsis
fields.definition: "Reduced or inadequate esophageal peristalsis, with resultant slow passage of contents through the esophagus." [PMID:28665309]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ineffective esophageal motility

fields.label: Esophageal furrows
fields.definition: "Longitudinal grooves in the surface of the esophagus arranged in a longitudinal fashion (from top to bottom of the esophagus)." [PMID:25368745]

fields.label: Abnormal heart rate variability
fields.definition: "Any abnormality in the variability of the time interval between successive heartbeats." [PMID:8598068]

fields.label: Decreased heart rate variability
fields.definition: "Reduced variation of beat-to-beat intervals of the heart that occurs in conjunction with the respiratory cycle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5356-4174, PMID:8598068]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced heart rate variability

fields.label: Increased heart rate variability
fields.definition: "Increased variation of beat-to-beat intervals of the heart that occurs in conjunction with the respiratory cycle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5356-4174, PMID:8598068]

fields.label: Bloodstream infectious agent
fields.definition: "The presence of an infectious agent in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Bacteremia
fields.definition: "Presence of viable bacteria in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bacteria in blood culture; Bacteria in blood cultures

fields.label: Abnormal liver physiology
fields.definition: "Any functional anomaly of the liver." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal hepatic physiology

fields.label: Clasp-knife sign
fields.definition: "Clasp-knife phenomenon refers to increased muscle tone while bending or stretching a limb, whereby there is a sudden relaxation (decrease in resistance) as the muscle continues to be stretched. This phenomenon has been likened to opening a clasp knife." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Neck hypertonia
fields.definition: "Increased passive stiffness or tightness of the neck musculature." []

fields.label: Optic ataxia
fields.definition: "Difficulty reaching visually guided goals in peripheral vision, with the deficit, leaves voluntary eye movements largely unaffected." []

fields.label: Recurrent joint dislocation
fields.definition: "Dislocation of a given joint repeated times." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Recurrent joint dislocations

fields.label: Phosphohydroxylysinuria
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of phosphohydroxylysine in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23242558]

fields.label: Abnormal Langerhans cell morphology
fields.definition: "Any functional anomaly of Langerhans cells, which are dendritic cells in the epidermis and some other locations. Langerhans cells play roles in immune surveillance and homeostasis." [PMID:29449841]

fields.label: Absent Birbeck granules in Langerhans cells
fields.definition: "Birbeck granules (BG) are cytoplasmic organelles that are only found in Langerhans cells (LC). The function of BG is still not completely understood, although most studies point toward an active role in receptor-mediated endocytosis and participation in the antigen-processing/presenting function of LC. This feature refers to the absence of BG in LC, a feature that can be documented by means of electron microscopy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15816828]
fields.label_normalized: absent birbeck granules in langerhans cells

fields.label: Early chronotype
fields.definition: "A tendency towards rising very early in the morning and going to bed early in the evening." [PMID:31786494]
fields.synonyms_concat: Advanced sleep onset; Early sleep onset

fields.label: Late chronotype
fields.definition: "A tendency towards waking up very late in the morning and staying up late at night." [PMID:35360141]
fields.synonyms_concat: Delayed sleep onset; Late sleep onset

fields.label: Abnormal circulating hepcidin concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of hepcidin in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16450011]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal hepcidin level

fields.label: Decreased circulating hepcidin concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of hepcidin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16450011]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased hepcidin level

fields.label: Elevated circulating hepcidin concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of hepcidin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16450011]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated hepcidin level

fields.label: Acromicria
fields.definition: "Small hands and feet in proportion to the rest of the body." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22043168]

fields.label: Abnormal eyelid physiology
fields.definition: "Any functional abnormality of the eyelid." []

fields.label: Eyelid laxity
fields.definition: "Abnormally lax eyelid associated with tissue relaxation; it can be demonstrated by the eyelid distraction test and/or the eyelid snap test." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lid laxity

fields.label: Decreased tear drainage
fields.definition: "A form of watery eye associated with obstruction of the nasolacrimal system. This may arise at the level of the punctum, the canaliculi, the sac or the nasolacrimal duct." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Agyria
fields.definition: "A congenital abnormality of the cerebral hemisphere characterized by lack of gyrations (convolutions) of the cerebral cortex. Agyria is defined as cortical regions lacking gyration with sulci great than 3 cm apart and cerebral cortex thicker than 5 mm." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458]
fields.synonyms_concat: Agyria diffuse

fields.label: Increased proinsulin:insulin ratio
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of proinsulin (the prohormone precursor to insulin) to mature insulin in the circulation." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_gthayman]

fields.label: Abnormal CSF glucose concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from normal concentration of glucose content in the cerebrospinal fluid." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal CSF glucose level

fields.label: Hyperglycorrhachia
fields.definition: "Abnormally high glucose concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased CSF glucose

fields.label: Abnormal LDL cholesterol concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal LDL-C concentration; Abnormal LDL-C level; Abnormal LDLc concentration

fields.label: Abnormal chylomicron concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal circulating concentration of chylomicrons." []

fields.label: Abnormal HDL cholesterol concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL) in the blood." []

fields.label: Abnormal VLDL cholesterol concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of very-low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood." []

fields.label: Increased urine urobilinogen
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of urobilinogen in the urine." []

fields.label: Decreased total eosinophil count
fields.definition: "Abnormal decrease of absolute number of eosinophils in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased eosinophil count

fields.label: Rouleaux formation
fields.definition: "Increased amount of stacking of erythrocytes into long chains. Rouleaux (singular: rouleau) is derived from a French word that can refer to a stack of coins put into a cylindircal paper roll. Rouleaux formation is observed with increased serum proteins, particularly fibrinogen and globulins, and represents the cause of increased erythrocte sedimentation rate because rouleaux sediment more readily than isolated red blood cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16739263]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased rouleaux formation

fields.label: Abnormal coagulation factor V activity
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the activity of coagulation factor V." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal factor V activity

fields.label: Elevated total serum tryptase
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration of total tryptase (alpha and beta tryptase) in the blood circulation." [PMID:16372800, PMID:19522836, PMID:25169217, PMID:27749843, PMID:3295549]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating selenium concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal circulating concentration of selenium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26045617, PMID:29494512]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal serum selenium concentration

fields.label: Abnormal total hemolytic complement activity
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal total hemolytic complement activity in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal CH50

fields.label: Increased total hemolytic complement activity
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated total hemolytic complement activity in the circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]

fields.label: Anti-mitochondrial M2 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of M2 anti-mitochondrial antibody (immunoglobulins) in the serum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:30579751]
fields.synonyms_concat: AMA-M2 positive; Anti-pyruvate dehydrogenase antibody positivity

fields.label: Micrographia
fields.definition: "Abnormally small-sized handwriting is formally defined as an impairment of fine motor skills, which mainly manifests as a progressive or stable reduction in amplitude during a writing task." []

fields.label: Unicornuate uterus
fields.definition: "A uterus that has a single horn, with a banana-like shape that may or may not have a secondary rudimentary uterine horn." [PMID:28811816]

fields.label: Abnormal cranial nerve physiology
fields.definition: "A functional abnormality affecting one or more of the cranial nerves, which emerge directly from the brain stem." []

fields.label: Trigeminal anesthesia
fields.definition: "Decreased or absent sensation in the distribution of the trigeminal nerve, which provides tactile, proprioceptive, and nociceptive sensation in the area of the face and mouth." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3194-8625, PMID:10653422, PMID:2256843]
fields.synonyms_concat: Trigeminal anaesthesia

fields.label: Rhombencephalosynapsis
fields.definition: "Rhombencephalosynapsis is a rare brain malformation defined by midline fusion of the cerebellar hemispheres with partial or complete loss of the intervening vermis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3194-8625, PMID:22451504]

fields.label: Fluctuating
fields.definition: "Varying irregularly over time in severity, amount, or amplitude." []

fields.label: Stable
fields.definition: "This modifier can be applied to a phenotypic feature that does not vary in severity or amount over time." []

fields.label: Digital ulcer
fields.definition: "An open sore on the surface of the skin of a finger or toe." []

fields.label: Ovarian sex cord-stromal tumor
fields.definition: "A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is composed of granulosa cells, Sertoli cells, Leydig cells, theca cells, and fibroblasts." [NCIT:C4862, PMID:27858568]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ovarian sex cord-stromal tumour

fields.label: Juvenile type ovarian granulosa cell tumor
fields.definition: "Juvenile granulosa cell ovarian tumor (JGCOT) is a rare sex cord stromal tumor, occurring most frequently in premenarchal girls or young women. In contrast to adult granulosa cell tumor, JGCOT has a high mitotic index and more aggressive tumor growth. Microscopically it is seen as diffuse and regularly distributed neoplastic cells with a wide cytoplasm and pleomorphic hyperchromatic nucleus. Follicle formation, in various sizes and shapes, is important in JGCOT. Call-Exner bodies are infrequently seen in JGCOT in contrast to the adult type." [NCIT:C7289, PMID:25788847]
synonyms: Juvenile type ovarian granulosa cell tumour
fields.label_normalized: juvenile type ovarian granulosa cell tumor
fields.synonyms_concat: Juvenile type ovarian granulosa cell tumour; Ovarian juvenile granulosa cell tumor; Ovarian juvenile granulosa cell tumour

fields.label: Malignant ovarian granulosa cell tumor
fields.definition: "An aggressive granulosa cell tumor that arises from the ovary." [NCIT:C8403]
fields.synonyms_concat: Malignant ovarian granulosa cell tumour

fields.label: Gastrocnemius myalgia
fields.definition: "Pain of the gastrocnemius muscle." [PMID:29491286]
fields.synonyms_concat: Calf muscle pain; Calf myalgia

fields.label: Renal artery duplication
fields.definition: "The renal arteries carry blood from the aorta to the kidney; normally one renal artery is present on each side of the body. Renal artery duplication refers to the presence of two rather than one renal artery on a given side of the body." [PMID:15378279, PMID:21475502]
fields.synonyms_concat: Accessory renal artery; Double renal artery

fields.label: Hematocolpos
fields.definition: "Accumulation of blood in the vagina usually due to vaginal obstruction." [PMID:29479403]
fields.synonyms_concat: Haematocolpos

fields.label: Rope sign
fields.definition: "The presence of linear erythematous palpable cords, often on the lateral trunk." [PMID:16935918, PMID:26131871]

fields.label: Rosette
fields.definition: "A halo or spoke-wheel arrangement of cells surrounding a central core or hub. The central hub may consist of an empty-appearing lumen or a space filled with cytoplasmic processes. The cytoplasm of each of the cells in the rosette is often wedge-shaped with the apex directed toward the central core; the nuclei of the cells participating in the rosette are peripherally positioned and form a ring or halo around the hub." [PMID:16551982]

fields.label: Homer Wright rosette
fields.definition: "A type of rosette in which the central lumen or hub is filled with fiber-like processes." [PMID:16551982]

fields.label: Flexner-Wintersteiner rosette
fields.definition: "The tumor cells that form the Flexner-Wintersteiner rosette circumscribe a central lumen that contains small cytoplasmic extensions of the encircling cells; however, unlike the center of the Homer Wright rosette, the central lumen does not contain the fiber-rich neuropil." [PMID:16551982]

fields.label: True ependymal rosette
fields.definition: "A type of rosette in which a halo of cells surrounds an empty lumen." [PMID:16551982]

fields.label: Perivascular pseudorosette
fields.definition: "A type of rosette in which a spoke-wheel arrangement of cells with tapered cellular processes radiates around a wall of a centrally placed vessel." [PMID:16551982]

fields.label: Neurocytic rosette
fields.definition: "A type of rosette that is similar to the Homer Wright rosette, but the central fiber-rich neuropil island is larger and more irregular." [PMID:16551982]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pineocytomatous rosette

fields.label: Ocular flutter
fields.definition: "Ocular flutter is an abnormal eye movement consisting of repetitive, irregular, involuntary bursts of horizontal saccades without an intersaccadic interval. It is generally superimposed on normal oculomotor behavior and its occurrence may be favored by various events, such as blinks, the triggering of normal saccades or optokinetic stimulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:17314191]

fields.label: Aorto-left ventricular tunnel
fields.definition: "Aorto-left ventricular tunnel (ALVT) is a congenital extracardiac channel connecting the ascending aorta above the sino-tubular junction to either left or right ventricular cavity." [PMID:26085759]
fields.synonyms_concat: Left ventricle to aorta tunnel

fields.label: Aorto-right ventricular tunnel
fields.definition: "The presence of an extracardiac channel that connects the ascending aorta above the sinotubular junction to the cavity of the right ventricle." [PMID:27525240]
fields.synonyms_concat: Right ventricle to aorta tunnel

fields.label: Abnormal descending aorta morphology
fields.definition: "A structural abnormality of the part of the aorta that begins at the aortic arch and then descends through the chest and abdomen." []

fields.label: Ascending aorta hypoplasia
fields.definition: "Significant luminal narrowing of a long segment of or the entire ascending aorta." [PMID:13938144]

fields.label: Delayed ability to walk
fields.definition: "A failure to achieve the ability to walk at an appropriate developmental stage. Most children learn to walk in a series of stages, and learn to walk short distances independently between 12 and 15 months." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Delayed walking

fields.label: Tachylalia
fields.definition: "Speech that is abnormally fast as compared to the perceived cultural norm." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Fast speech; Tachylogia

fields.label: Abnormal conus terminalis morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the conus terminalis, which is the distal bulbous part of the spinal cord at the location where the spinal cord tapers and ends (usually between the L1 and L2 lumbar vertebrae)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal conus medullaris morphology

fields.label: Abnormal portal venous system morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the portal venous system, which comprises all of the veins draining the abdominal part of the digestive tract, including the lower esophagus but excluding the lower anal canal. The portal vein conveys blood from viscera and ramifies like an artery at the liver, ending at the sinusoids. Tributaries of the portal vein, which make up the portal venous system, are the splenic, superior mesenteric, left gastric, right gastric, paraumbilical, and cystic veins." [PMID:11796904]

fields.label: Congenital absence of portal vein
fields.definition: "Anomaly where the intestinal and the splenic venous drainage bypass the liver and drain into systemic veins through other possible venous shunts." [PMID:18932274, PMID:2053351]
fields.synonyms_concat: CAPV; Missing portal vein

fields.label: Akathisia
fields.definition: "A state of motor restlessness, usually in the lower extremities, that is often but not always accompanied by a subjective sense of inner restlessness, an urge to move, and anxiety or dysphoria." [PMID:17974927]

fields.label: Pleural thickening
fields.definition: "An increase in the thickness of the pleura, generally related to scarring of the pleural tissue." [PMID:23287997]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pleural incrassation

fields.label: Elevated circulating N,N-dimethylglycine concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of N,N-dimethylglycine in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated N,N-dimethylglycine level

fields.label: Elevated urinary N,N-dimethylglycine level
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of N,N-dimethylglycine in the urine." []

fields.label: Tongue tremor
fields.definition: "An unintentional, oscillating to-and-fro muscle movement affecting the tongue." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Jerky movements of the tongue

fields.label: Snowball lesion of corpus callosum
fields.definition: "Centrally located corpus callosum hyperintensities said to resemble snowballs upon magnetic resonance imaging (with T2 or Sagittal fluid attenuated inversion recovery [FLAIR] sequences). The central location in the callosum makes them pathognomonic for Susac syndrome." [PMID:24663235, PMID:26991403]

fields.label: Recurrent bacterial upper respiratory tract infections
fields.definition: "An increased susceptibility to bacterial upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent bacterial upper respiratory tract infections (running ears - otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis)." [PMID:26424818]
fields.label_normalized: recurrent bacterial upper respiratory tract infections
fields.synonyms_concat: Recurrent bacterial URI

fields.label: Usual interstitial pneumonia
fields.definition: "Temporal and spatial heterogeneity in lungs based on presence of fibrosis and honeycombing." [PMID:26666486, PMID:8697837]

fields.label: Nocturnal seizures
fields.definition: "Seizures that occur while the affected individual is sleeping." [PMID:22334817, PMID:23385697, PMID:25941204]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sleep seizures

fields.label: Neurogenic claudication
fields.definition: "Lumbar spinal stenoses may induce symptoms following an individually typical latency on standing or when walking due to swelling of the cauda equina, which leads to compression. This is referred to as neurogenic claudication. The symptoms of lumbar spinal stenosis can be explained by an increase in lumbar lordosis and spinal canal stenosis in an upright position compared to the sitting position or if spondylolisthesis is present by a shift of the vertebrae while standing and walking. Following an individually characteristic distance, walking becomes associated with deep muscular pain and with neurological deficits, such as sensory deficits and paresis in the lower limbs, which resolve within minutes when the affected person sits or lies down. Activities performed in a flexed posture, such as cycling often cause less problems than walking. For the same reason, walking uphill may be tolerated better than walking downhill. Clinical neurological examination at rest may be entirely normal but there is usually pain on hyperextension of the lumbar spine." [PMID:27770207]

fields.label: Cautious gait
fields.definition: "Cautious gait refers to an excessive degree of age-related changes in walking and fear of falling. The walking difficulties seem out of proportion when considering the patient's actual sensory or motor deficits. The gait appears slow, with a wider base than normal, reduced arm swing bilaterally and a slightly stooped posture. This type of gait change often occurs after the first time a patient has fallen." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Senile gait

fields.label: Dystonic gait
fields.definition: "Dystonic gait disorders frequently appear bizarre, particularly because activity increases dystonic tonus and posture. The abnormal posture of the foot in dystonic gait typically involves inversion, plantar flexion and tonic extension of the big toe. In many patients complex types of walking, such as walking backwards and running are paradoxically less impaired than walking forward and may seem completely unaffected. Sensory tricks, for instance, if the affected individual rests a hand on his or her neck, may improve or even normalize dystonic gait in some patients." [PMID:27770207]

fields.label: Antalgic gait
fields.definition: "To avoid pain weight is put on the affected leg for as short a time as possible, resulting in a limp. The patients appear to be walking as if there were a thorn in the sole of the foot. To reduce the load on the affected leg the patients lift and lower their foot in a fixed ankle position." [PMID:27770207]
fields.synonyms_concat: Limp

fields.label: Elevated circulating aspartate aminotransferase concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Aspartate aminotransferase increased; Elevated serum aspartate aminotransferase; Elevated serum AST; Elevated serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase

fields.label: Spastic hemiparetic gait
fields.definition: "Spastic hemiparesis is characterized by a dominance of the tonus in the upper limb flexor muscles: the arm is held in an adducted posture and is bent and rotated inwards, the forearm is pronated and the hand and the fingers are flexed. The leg is slightly bent at the hip, the knee cannot be extended fully at the end of the stance phase and the foot is inverted and in a plantar flexed position. Gait is slow, with a wide base and asymmetrical with a shortened weight-bearing phase on the paretic side. During the swing phase, the paretic leg performs a lateral movement (circumduction) which is characteristic of this gait disorder, also termed Wernicke-Mann gait. Spastic gait problems typically worsen on attempts to walk faster." [PMID:27770207]
fields.synonyms_concat: Wernicke-Mann gait

fields.label: Spastic paraparetic gait
fields.definition: "A type of spastic gait in which the legs are usually slightly bent at the hip and in an adducted position. The knees are extended or slightly bent and the feet are in a plantar flexion position. This posture requires circumduction of the legs during walking. The gait may appear stiff (spastic gait disorder) or stiff as well as insecure (spastic ataxic gait disorder). In spastic paraparetic gait, each leg appears to be dragged forward. If the muscle tone in the adductors is marked, the resulting gait disorder is referred to as scissor gait." [PMID:27770207]

fields.label: Leg dystonia
fields.definition: "A type of dystonia (abnormally increased muscular tone causing fixed abnormal postures) that affects muscles of the legs." []

fields.label: Arm dystonia
fields.definition: "A type of dystonia (abnormally increased muscular tone causing fixed abnormal postures) that affects muscles of the arms." []

fields.label: Abnormal serum anion gap
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal value of the serum anion gap, which is calculated from the electrolytes measured in the chemical laboratory, is defined as the sum of serum chloride and bicarbonate concentrations subtracted from the serum sodium concentration." [PMID:17699401]

fields.label: Elevated serum anion gap
fields.definition: "An abnormally high value of the serum anion gap (the sum of serum chloride and bicarbonate concentrations subtracted from the serum sodium concentration)." [PMID:17699401]

fields.label: Decreased serum anion gap
fields.definition: "An abnormally low value of the serum anion gap (the sum of serum chloride and bicarbonate concentrations subtracted from the serum sodium concentration)." [PMID:17699401]

fields.label: Elevated circulating alanine aminotransferase concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally high concentration in the circulation of alanine aminotransferase (ALT)." [PMID:18366115]
fields.synonyms_concat: Alanine aminotransferase increased; Elevated serum alanine aminotransferase; Elevated serum ALT; Elevated serum glutamic-pyruvic transaminase

fields.label: Increased RBC distribution width
fields.definition: "Red blood cell distribution width (RDW) is a simple parameter of the standard full blood count and a measure of heterogeneity in the size of circulating erythrocytes. It is provided by automated hematology analyzers and it reflects the range of the red cell size. It is calculated by dividing the standard deviation of erythrocyte volume by the mean corpuscular volume (MCV) and multiplied by 100 to convert to a percentage." [PMID:27867951, PMID:28683798]
synonyms: Increased red blood cell distribution width
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased red blood cell distribution width

fields.label: Cloudy urine
fields.definition: "The appearance of the urine having visible material in suspension, i.e., appearing cloudy." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Turbid urine

fields.label: Reduced blood urea nitrogen
fields.definition: "An abnormally low concentration of urea nitrogen in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced BUN

fields.label: Abnormal blood urea nitrogen concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of urea nitrogen in the blood." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal BUN concentration

fields.label: Subaortic ventricular septal bulge
fields.definition: "A localized hypertrophy of the subaortic segment of the ventricular septum has been frequently described in elderly persons, and variously termed subaortic ventricular septal bulge (VSB), sigmoid-shaped septum, localized or discrete upper septal hypertrophy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5835-5515, PMID:25129067, PMID:9203495]

fields.label: Presyncope
fields.definition: "Presyncope is a state of lightheadedness, muscular weakness, blurred vision, and feeling faint. Presyncope is most often cardiovascular in cause." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5835-5515]

fields.label: Increased vertical cup-to-disc ratio
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the ratio of the height of the cup of the optic nerve head to the height of the disk." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Increased vertical cup-to-disc ratio - 0.6
fields.definition: "Ratio of the height of the cup of the optic nerve head to the height of the disk is 0.6 (The normal cup-to-disc ratio is 0.3)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Increased vertical cup-to-disc ratio - 0.7
fields.definition: "Ratio of the height of the cup of the optic nerve head to the height of the disk is 0.7 (The normal cup-to-disc ratio is 0.3)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Increased vertical cup-to-disc ratio - 0.8
fields.definition: "Ratio of the height of the cup of the optic nerve head to the height of the disk is 0.8 (The normal cup-to-disc ratio is 0.3)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Increased vertical cup-to-disc ratio - 0.9
fields.definition: "Ratio of the height of the cup of the optic nerve head to the height of the disk is 0.9 (The normal cup-to-disc ratio is 0.3)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Increased vertical cup-to-disc ratio - 1.0
fields.definition: "Ratio of the height of the cup of the optic nerve head to the height of the disk is 1.0 (The normal cup-to-disc ratio is 0.3)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal urine carbohydrate level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of a carbohydrate in the urine." []

fields.label: Abnormal urine carboxylic acid level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of a carboxylic acid in the urine." []

fields.label: Elevated urine glycolate
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of glycolate in the urine." [PMID:2031609]

fields.label: Abnormal putamen morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the putamen, a brain nucleus which together with the caudate nucleus and fundus striati makes up the striatum." []

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary thoracic imaging finding
fields.definition: "This term groups terms representing abnormal findings derived from chest X-ray investigation of the lung. In general, lung abnormalities can manifest as opacities (areas of increased density) or as regions with decreased density." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal chest radiograph finding (lung)

fields.label: Esophageal food impaction
fields.definition: "A piece of food that has gotten stuck in the esophagus and prevents further swallowing." [PMID:21960934]

fields.label: Esophageal exudate
fields.definition: "An exudate is a mass of fluid and cells that has seeped out of blood vessels or an organ, usually related to inflammation. In the esophagus, exudates usually present as whitish plagues on the surface of the esophageal mucosa." [PMID:22919257]

fields.label: Polyminimyoclonus
fields.definition: "Minipolymyoclonus or polyminimyoclonus is a hyperkinetic movement disorder phenomenology characterized by intermittent, low-amplitude, arrhythmic movements of the hands, commonly of several fingers, with amplitudes just sufficient to produce visible and palpable movements of the joints. It is mostly noticed while the individual is maintaining a posture (commonly outstretched hands) or during action (especially the initial phase of movement)." [PMID:21339907, PMID:34062647, PMID:35609988]
fields.synonyms_concat: Facial-faucial-finger minimyoclonus; Minipolymyoclonus

fields.label: Diminished ability to concentrate
fields.definition: "The inability to focus or concentrate on a specific task, activity, or object. The subject may find themselves unable to grasp or understand written text and re-reads frequently without understanding. Familiar tasks or activities are severely compromised due to the lack of ability to concentrate. Thinking through multi-step problems is typically very difficult or impossible, leading to avoidance of such activities." [PMID:26386541]
fields.synonyms_concat: Concentration problems; Labored thinking; Lack of concentration; Poor concentration

fields.label: Perioral spasm
fields.definition: "A sudden involuntary contraction of the musculature surrounding the mouth." []

fields.label: Chvostek sign
fields.definition: "A contraction of ipsilateral facial muscles subsequent to percussion over the facial nerve." [PMID:22970971, PMID:29443134]

fields.label: Increased urinary excretion of galactosyl hydroxylysine
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of beta-1-galactosyl-O-hydroxylysine (Gal-Hyl) in the urine. This is a biochemical marker of bone resorption." [PMID:10222355]
fields.label_normalized: increased urinary excretion of galactosyl hydroxylysine

fields.label: Apical hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
fields.definition: "Apical hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (AHCM) is diastolic dysfunction due to abnormal stiffness of the left ventricle during diastole, with resultant impaired ventricular filling. In AHCM thickened apical segments produce a crowded, spade-shaped, small apical cavity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5835-5515, PMID:23109785, PMID:8685759]

fields.label: Hoffmann sign
fields.definition: "A Hoffmann test is performed by flicking the fingernail of the long finger, from dorsal to volar, on each hand while the hand was supported by the examiner's hand. The test was done with the neck in the neutral position and then with the neck maximally forward flexed. Any flexion of the ipsilateral thumb and/or index finger was interpreted as a positive test." [PMID:11813951, PMID:20229121]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hoffmann's sign

fields.label: Bronchial breath sound
fields.definition: "Bronchial breath sounds contain much higher frequency components than normal breath sounds due to alteration of the low pass filtering function of the alveoli, as occurs in consolidation. It is loud, hollow, and high pitch. Expiratory phase is longer than inspiratory phase with the inspiratory-expiratory ratio (I:E) changing from normal 3:1 to 1:2. There is distinct pause between inspiration and expiration due to absent alveolar phase. It is associated with whispering pectoriloquy." [PMID:26229557]

fields.label: Squawks
fields.definition: "Squawks are short inspiratory wheezes of less than 200 ms duration and are also known as squeaks. Acoustic analysis shows the fundamental frequency varying between 200 and 300 Hz. Squawks usually occur in late inspiration and are often preceded by late inspiratory crackles." [PMID:26229557]

fields.label: Inspiratory crackles
fields.definition: "Crackles that are heard during the inspiratory phase." [PMID:26229557]

fields.label: Early inspiratory crackles
fields.definition: "Crackles that appear at the beginning of inspiration and end before mid-inspiration." [PMID:26229557]

fields.label: Late inspiratory crackles
fields.definition: "Crackles that appear any time after the beginning of inspiration and last till the end of inspiration." [PMID:26229557]

fields.label: Expiratory crackles
fields.definition: "Crackles that occur during expiration." [PMID:26229557]

fields.label: Pleural rub
fields.definition: "An abnormal breath sound that is nonmusical, short and explosive. It is grating, rubbing, creaky, or leathery in character and present in both phases of respiration. Typically the expiratory component mirrors the inspiratory component. It occurs due to inflamed pleural surface rubbing each other during breathing. Clinically, it is important to differentiate it from crackles" [PMID:26229557]

fields.label: Pink urine
fields.definition: "An abnormal pink color of urine." []

fields.label: Orange urine
fields.definition: "An abnormal orange color of urine." [PMID:18613989, PMID:29967083]

fields.label: Green urine
fields.definition: "An abnormal green color of urine." [PMID:28413291]

fields.label: Pruritus vulvae
fields.definition: "A sensation of itching in the vulvar region." []

fields.label: Hemidystonia
fields.definition: "Hemidystonia refers to dystonia which involves the ipsilateral face, arm, and leg." [PMID:11784827, PMID:4031909]

fields.label: Lip tremor
fields.definition: "An unintentional, oscillating to-and-fro muscle movement affecting the lip." []

fields.label: Maceration
fields.definition: "A softening and breaking down of skin resulting from prolonged exposure to moisture. Macerated skin becomes soft and wrinkly and takes on a whitish hue." [PMID:12192848]
fields.synonyms_concat: Maceration of the skin; Skin maceration

fields.label: Pulmonary fat embolism
fields.definition: "The release of fat globules into the venous circulation, thereby blocking blood circulation to the lung." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:24468004]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fat embolism

fields.label: Infantile constant exotropia
fields.definition: "Constant exotropia occurring before 6 months of age.; often associated with a large angle of deviation and ocular/CNS abnormalities." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Infantile (constant) exotropia

fields.label: Basic constant exotropia
fields.definition: "Constant exotropia for near and distance, presenting after 6 months of age." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Basic (constant) exotropia

fields.label: Heterophoria
fields.definition: "Heterophorias are latent deviations that are controlled by fusion. In certain circumstances (specific visual tasks, fatigue, illness, etc.), fusion can no longer be maintained and decompensation occurs." []

fields.label: Heterotropia
fields.definition: "Manifest deviation of the visual axes not controlled by fusion." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Hypermetric horizontal saccades
fields.definition: "Overshoot of horizontal (sideways) saccadic eye movements." []

fields.label: Dysmetric vertical saccades
fields.definition: "Inaccurate saccades (rapid movement of the eye between fixation points) in the vertical direction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Dysmetric horizontal saccades
fields.definition: "Inaccurate saccades (rapid movement of the eye between fixation points) in the horizontal direction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal sputum
fields.definition: "Abnormal appearance of material expectorated (coughed up) from the respiratory system and that is composed of mucus but may contain other substances such as pus, blood, microorganisms, and fibrin." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal sputum morphology

fields.label: Sputum eosinophilia
fields.definition: "An increased proportion of eosinophils in sputum in the differentiated cell count." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23741092, PMID:29146301]

fields.label: Multiple mononeuropathy
fields.definition: "A type of peripheral neuropathy that happens when there is damage to two or more different nerve areas characterized by peripheral neuropathy of both the motor and sensory nerves of at least two different nerve trunks. Different nerves are affected either simultaneously or sequentially." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25494723]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mononeuritis multiplex

fields.label: Muscle eosinophilia
fields.definition: "Eosinophil infiltration of skeletal muscle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24424174, PMID:24803842]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eosinophilic infiltration of skeletal muscle

fields.label: Eosinophilic bladder infiltration
fields.definition: "Transmural inflammation of the bladder predominantly with eosinophils, associated with fibrosis with or without muscle necrosis." [PMID:15857336, PMID:28829677]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eosinophilic cystitis

fields.label: Eosinophilic liver infiltration
fields.definition: "Cellular infiltration of the liver parenchyma with a preponderance of eosinophils." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20457690, PMID:7835024]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eosinophilic hepatitis

fields.label: Eosinophilic dermal infiltration
fields.definition: "Presence of abnormally increased amounts of intraepidermal inflammatory cells with a predominance of eosinophils." [PMID:23730155, PMID:6724778]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eosinophilic dermatitis

fields.label: Eosinophilic gallbladder infiltration
fields.definition: "Cellular infiltrate confirmed by a cellular infiltrate comprised of mainly eosinophils in the gallbladder wall on histological examination." [PMID:27872806]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eosinophilic cholecystitis

fields.label: Ileal ulcer
fields.definition: "An erosion of the mucous membrane in a portion of the ileum." [PMID:28670609]

fields.label: Reduced circulating alpha-1-antitrypsin concentration
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration or activity of circulating alpha-1 antitrypsin, which is a 52-kDa glycoprotein mainly synthesized and secreted by hepatocytes into the bloodstream. Alpha-1 antitrypsin is a serine-proteinase inhibitor that it is crucial in maintaining protease-antiprotease homeostasis in the lungs." [PMID:24507836]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced serum alpha-1-antitrypsin

fields.label: Anetoderma
fields.definition: "Circumscribed area of flaccid skin due to the loss of elastic tissue in the dermis." [PMID:20652064, PMID:28116317]

fields.label: Retinal dots
fields.definition: "Yellow, white or grayish lesions in the retina that are well-defined/distinct, individual and mostly uniform in size." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Macular dots
fields.definition: "Yellow, white or grayish lesions in the macula that are well-defined/distinct, individual and mostly uniform in size." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Floppy eyelid
fields.definition: "Excessive eyelid tissue laxity, typically affecting both upper eyelids and associated with spontanteous tarsal eversion during sleep. It is more common in the obese, it may be associated with obstructive sleep apnea and it may result in corneal exposure or chronic papillary conjunctivitis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:26139650]

fields.label: Lateral canthal tendon laxity
fields.definition: "Laxity of the tendon stabilizing the lateral aspect of the tarsal plate to the zygomatic bone. This can result in rounded appearance of the lateral canthus. Also, when the eyelid is pulled medially, more than 2 mm movement of the canthal angle may be observed." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Medial canthal tendon laxity
fields.definition: "Laxity of the tendon stabilizing the medial aspect of the tarsal plate to the anterior and posterior lacrimal crests. This may lead to more than 2mm movement of the punctum when the eyelid is pulled laterally." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Horizontal eyelid laxity
fields.definition: "Abnormally lax eyelid associated with tissue relaxation, predominantly in the horizontal plane. It can be demonstrated by the horizontal eyelid distraction test (e.g. by pulling the eyelid medially and laterally). Medial and/or lateral canthal tendon laxity are often present." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Vertical eyelid laxity
fields.definition: "Abnormally lax eyelid associated with tissue relaxation, predominantly in the vertical plane. It can be demonstrated by vertical lid pull. Loosening of vertical stabilizing structures (e.g. lower lid retractors) or tarsal atrophy are often present." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Upper eyelid laxity
fields.definition: "Abnormally lax upper eyelid associated with tissue relaxation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Lower eyelid laxity
