fields.definition: "Abnormally lax lower eyelid associated with tissue relaxation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Reduced contrast sensitivity
fields.definition: "An abnormality in perception of contrast. Spatial contrast is a physical dimension referring to the light-dark transition of a border or an edge in an image that delineates the existence of a pattern or an object. Contrast sensitivity refers to a measure of how much contrast a person requires to see a target. Contrast-sensitivity measurements differ from acuity measurements; acuity is a measure of the spatial-resolving ability of the visual system under conditions of very high contrast, whereas contrast sensitivity is a measure of the threshold contrast for seeing a target." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:12809156]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal contrast sensitivity

fields.label: Mildly reduced visual acuity
fields.definition: "Mild reduction of the ability to see. On the 6m visual acuity scale, mild reduction is defined as less than 6/12 but at least 6/18. On the 20ft visual acuity scale, mild reduction is defined as less than 20/40 but at least 20/70. On the decimal visual acuity scale, mild reduction is defined as less than 0.5 but at least 0.3." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Mild reduction in visual acuity; Mild vision loss; Mild visual loss

fields.label: Abnormality of the ocular adnexa
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the adjacent structures (i.e., adnexa) of the eye, defined as the lacrimal apparatus, the extraocular muscles and the eyelids, eyelashes, eyebrows and the conjunctiva." []

fields.label: Abnormal ocular adnexa physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the adjacent structures (i.e., adnexa) of the eye, defined as the lacrimal apparatus, the extraocular muscles and the eyelids, eyelashes, eyebrows and the conjunctiva." []

fields.label: Vocal cord polyp
fields.definition: "A small growth on a vocal cord that may appear as pedunculated or sessile and have varying size, shape, and color." [PMID:26628451, PMID:29749984]

fields.label: Odynophagia
fields.definition: "Pain experienced with swallowing." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Painful swallowing

fields.label: Decreased vigilance
fields.definition: "A decrease in the ability to maintain sustained attention is characterized by reduced alertness." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased alertness

fields.label: Hypoplastic carotid canal
fields.definition: "Underdevelopment of the carotid canal, which normally is a circular aperture in the temporal bone of the skull through which the internal carotid artery and the carotid plexus of nerves traverse." []

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia
fields.definition: "A type of malformation of cortical development that primarily affects areas of neocortex. It can be identified on conventional magnetic resonance imaging as focal cortical thickening, abnormal gyration, and blurring between gray and white matter, often associated with clusters of heterotopic neurons." [PMID:12707084]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type I
fields.definition: "A type of focal cortical dysplasia that is characterized by abnormal cortical layering." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type Ia
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type I that is characterized by abnormal radial cortical lamination." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type Ib
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type I that is characterized by abnormal tangential cortical lamination." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type Ic
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type I that is characterized by abnormal radial and tangential cortical lamination." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type II
fields.definition: "A type of focal cortical dysplasia that is characterized by disrupted cortical lamination and specific cytological abnormalities." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type IIa
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type II that is characterized by dysmorphic neurons, which present with a significantly enlarged cell body and nucleus, malorientation, abnormally distributed intracellular Nissl substance and cytoplasmic accumulation of neurofilament proteins." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type IIb
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type II that is characterized by dysmorphic neurons (significantly enlarged with accumulation of neurofilament proteins) and balloon cells." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type III
fields.definition: "A type of focal cortical dysplasia that is characterized by cortical lamination abnormalities associated with a principal lesion, usually adjacent to or affecting the same cortical area/lobe." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type IIIa
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type III that is characterized by alterations in architectural organization (cortical dyslamination) or cytoarchitectural composition (hypertrophic neurons outside Layer 5) in patients with hippocampal sclerosis (also known as Ammon's horn sclerosis)." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type IIIb
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type III that is characterized by altered architectural (cortical dyslamination, hypoplasia without six-layered structure) and/or cytoarchitectural composition (hypertrophic neurons) of the neocortex, which occur adjacent to glial or glioneuronal tumor." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type IIIc
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type III that is characterized by alterations in architectural (cortical dyslamination, hypoplasia) or cytoarchitectural composition of the neocortex (hypertrophic neurons), which occur adjacent to vascular malformations (cavernomas, arteriovenous malformations, leptomeningeal vascular malformations, telangiectasias, meningioangiomatosis)." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Focal cortical dysplasia type IIId
fields.definition: "A subtype of focal cortical dysplasia type III that is characterized by altered architectural (cortical dyslamination, hypoplasia without six-layered structure) or cytoarchitectural composition (hypertrophic neurons) of the neocortex, which occur adjacent to other lesions acquired during early life (not included into FCD Type IIIa-c). These lesions comprise a large spectrum including traumatic brain injury, glial scarring after prenatal or perinatal ischemic injury or bleeding, and inflammatory or infectious diseases, i.e. Rasmussen encephalitis, limbic encephalitis, bacterial or viral infections." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Mild malformation of cortical development
fields.definition: "A malformation of cortical development characterized by mild abnormalities of the cortex: excessive heterotopic neurons in Layer 1 or microscopic neuronal clusters or excess of single neurons of normal morphology in deep white matter." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:21219302]

fields.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
fields.definition: "A benign neoplasm that includes blood vessel proliferation and a dense eosinophilic inflammatory infiltrate, manifesting as flesh/plum-colored pruritic nodules and papules, most commonly affecting the ear and the periauricular area." [NCIT:C4298, PMID:25484503, PMID:25927152]
fields.synonyms_concat: Angiolymphoid hyperplasia with eosinophilia

fields.label: Severely increased total eosinophil count
fields.definition: "Severe increase in circulating eosinophils, usually characterized as more than 1500 eosinophils per microlitre." [PMID:20538328]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypereosinophilia

fields.label: Mallory-Weiss tear
fields.definition: "Vomiting-induced mucosal laceration at the esophago-gastric junction." [PMID:22560400]

fields.label: Ankle joint effusion
fields.definition: "Abnormal accumulation of fluid in or around the ankle joint." []

fields.label: Gastrointestinal eosinophilia
fields.definition: "Eosinophilic infiltration of one or more gastrointestinal organs. Gastrointestinal eosinophilia is a broad term for abnormal eosinophil accumulation in the GI tract, involving many different disease identities. These diseases include primary eosinophil associated gastrointestinal diseases, gastrointestinal eosinophilia in HES and all gastrointestinal eosinophilic states associated with known causes. Each of these diseases has its unique features but there is no absolute boundary between them." [PMID:17868858, PMID:23964139]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eosinophilic enteritis; Eosinophilic gastroenteritis; Eosinophilic gastrointestinal disease; Eosinophilic gastrointestinal disorders; GI eosinophilia

fields.label: Abnormal serum bicarbonate concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of bicarbonate, HCO3[-], in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal serum HCO3 concentration

fields.label: Decreased serum bicarbonate concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal reduction of the concentration of bicarbonate, HCO3[-], in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased serum HCO3 concentration

fields.label: Elevated serum bicarbonate concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the concentration of bicarbonate, HCO3[-], in the circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated serum HCO3 concentration

fields.label: Increased urinary mucus
fields.definition: "An increased amount of urinary mucus. A small amount of mucus is produced by mucous membrane epithelial cells of the urinary tract. An increased amount of mucus can be detected upon urinalysis or other assays and may indicate conditions such as urinary tract infection, urinary tract reconstruction involving the use of bowel segments, or contamination of the urine sample prior to urinalysis." [PMID:8126784]

fields.label: Anti-thyroglobulin antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react to thyroglobulin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:21196203, PMID:33144894, PMID:33999913, PMID:34634575]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-thyroid globulin antibody positivity; TgAbs

fields.label: Leptomeningeal enhancement
fields.definition: "Contrast material enhancement of the pia mater or enhancement that extends into the subarachnoid spaces of the sulci and cisterns is leptomeningeal enhancement. Leptomeningeal enhancement is usually associated with meningitis, which may be bacterial, viral, or fungal. The primary mechanism of this enhancement is breakdown of the blood-brain barrier without angiogenesis." [PMID:17374867]

fields.label: Eosinophilic pneumonia
fields.definition: "The presence of eosinophils in lung tissue, generally as detected by tissue biopsy, with or without blood eosinophilia." [PMID:19618037, PMID:21428117]
fields.synonyms_concat: Eosinophilic pulmonary infiltration; Pulmonary eosinophilia; Pulmonary eosinophilic infiltrate; Pulmonary eosinophilic infiltration

fields.label: Popliteal synovial cyst
fields.definition: "A fluid-filled mass that is a distention of a preexisting bursa in the popliteal fossa, most commonly the gastrocnemio-semimembranosus bursa. This bursa is unique in that it communicates with the knee joint, unlike other periarticular bursae, via an opening in the joint capsule posterior to the medial femoral condyle." [PMID:25102502, PMID:26137182]
fields.synonyms_concat: Baker's cyst

fields.label: Aplasia of the fallopian tube
fields.definition: "Aplasia, that is failure to develop, of the fallopian tube." []

fields.label: Splenopancreatic fusion
fields.definition: "Fusion of the pancreatic tail and spleen." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:18398855]

fields.label: Male urethral meatus stenosis
fields.definition: "An abnormal narrowing of the urethral opening (meatus) of the penis." [PMID:28537045]
fields.synonyms_concat: Meatal stenosis; Meatus stenosis

fields.label: Angel-shaped phalanx
fields.definition: "A phalangeal malformation that is termed angel-shaped phalanx (ASP), because of its resemblance to the angels used for decoration of Christmas trees. The various components of an angel-shaped phalanx are: diaphyseal cuff (wings), surrounding a meta-diaphyseal core (body), which may appear empty or structured with a cone-shaped epiphysis (skirt) and pseudoepiphysis (head)." [PMID:8267010]

fields.label: Medial degeneration
fields.definition: "Medial degeneration of the aorta is to be used as an overarching term for any aortic surgical specimens that demonstrate one or more of the specific histopathologies mucoid extracellular matrix accumulation, elastic fiber fragmentation and/or loss, elastic fiber thinning, elastic fiber disorganization, smooth muscle cell nuclei loss, laminar medial collapse, smooth muscle cell disorganization, medial fibrosis. Grading of medial degeneration is based on the average overall severity of specific histopathologies as described, considering the worst area(s) sampled from multiple slides and aorta sections." [PMID:27031798]

fields.label: Intralamellar mucoid extracellular matrix accumulation
fields.definition: "A type of mucoid extracellular matrix accumulation in which the increase in mucoid extracellular matrix does not significantly alter the arrangement of the lamellar units." [PMID:27031798]

fields.label: Translamellar mucoid extracellular matrix accumulation
fields.definition: "A type of mucoid extracellular matrix accumulation in which the increase in mucoid extracellular matrix alters the arrangement of the lamellar units to varying degrees." [PMID:27031798]

fields.label: Aortic elastic fiber fragmentation
fields.definition: "Loss and/or fragmentation of elastic fibers of the media of the aorta creating increasingly extended translamellar spaces, with absence of elastic fibers, and increased gaps in elastic fiber lamellae as identified on a stain for elastic fibers." [PMID:27031798]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aortic elastic fibre fragmentation

fields.label: Aortic elastic fiber thinning
fields.definition: "A thinning out of elastic fibers of the media of the aorta that creates widening of intralamellar spaces, as identified on a stain for elastic fibers." [PMID:27031798]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aortic elastic fibre thinning

fields.label: Aortic elastic fiber disorganization
fields.definition: "Nonparallel arrangement/disarray of elastic fibers of the media of the aorta as identified on a stain for elastic fibers." [PMID:27031798]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aortic elastic fibre disorganisation

fields.label: Aortic smooth muscle cell nuclei loss
fields.definition: "A region of the aortic media in which smooth muscle cell nuclei, involving multiple lamellae, are not clearly identifiable on an hematoxylin and eosin stain." [PMID:27031798]
fields.label_normalized: aortic smooth muscle cell nuclei loss

fields.label: Aortic laminar medial collapse
fields.definition: "Architecturally, a compaction of aortic medial elastic fibers that creates thinning of the lamellar unit secondary to a band-like smooth muscle cell loss identified using a stain for elastic fibers." [PMID:27031798]

fields.label: Aortic smooth muscle cell disorganization
fields.definition: "Nonparallel arrangement/disarray of smooth muscle cells of the aortic media creating focal/multifocal disarray or sometimes nodular aggregates of smooth muscle cells." [PMID:27031798]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aortic smooth muscle cell disorganisation

fields.label: Aortic medial fibrosis
fields.definition: "An increase in collagen fibers creating areas of substitutive fibrosis or a widening of intralamellar spaces in the media of the aorta. This can be seen in conjunction with a loss to varying degrees of parallel arrangement of the elastic lamellae (or lamellar units)." [PMID:27031798]

fields.label: Intralamellar aortic medial fibrosis
fields.definition: "A type of aortic medial fibrosis in which the increase in collagen does not significantly alter the arrangement of the lamellar units." [PMID:27031798]

fields.label: Translamellar aortic medial fibrosis
fields.definition: "A type of aortic medial fibrosis in which the increase in collagen is more scar-like, altering the arrangement of the lamellar units." [PMID:27031798]

fields.label: Left ventricular outflow tract obstruction
fields.definition: "Left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) obstruction can occur at the valvular, subvalvular, or supravalvular level. In general, there is an obstruction to forward flow which increases afterload, and if untreated, can result in hypertrophy, dilatation, and eventual failure of the left ventricle." [PMID:29262119]

fields.label: Elevated circulating surfactant protein concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of surfactant protein in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased serum surfactant protein level

fields.label: Abnormal manganese concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal range of manganese in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Hypermanganesemia
fields.definition: "An elevation above the normal concentration of manganese in the blood." [PMID:29382362]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased blood manganese concentration

fields.label: Hypomanganesemia
fields.definition: "A reduction below the normal concentration of manganese in the blood." []

fields.label: Perioral radial furrowing
fields.definition: "The presence of radial grooves in the skin surrounding the mouth (see Figure 4 of PMID:27833976)." [PMID:27833976]

fields.label: Abnormal doll's eye reflex
fields.definition: "The doll's eye reflex (also known as oculocephalic reflex) is a test of brain function that is performed in comatose patients by elevating the head roughly 30 degrees and rapidly rotating the head from side to side with the eyes kept open. A normal response is for the eyes to move in the opposite direction. If the eyes do not move in the opposite direction this may indicate severe brain damage." [PMID:7299406]

fields.label: Unusual infection
fields.definition: "A type of infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection. There are five general subtypes. (i) Opportunistic infection, meaning infection by a pathogen that is not normally able to cause infection in a healthy host (e.g., pneumonia by Pneumocystis jirovecii or CMV); (ii) Unusual location (focus) of an infection (e.g., an aspergillus brain abscess); (iii) a protracted course or lack of adequate response to treatment (e.g., chronic rhinosinusitis); (iv) Unusual severity or intensity of an infection; and (v) unusual recurrence of infections." [PMID:22052638]

fields.label: Wilson sign
fields.definition: "Wilson sign is defined as the elicitation of pain by internally rotating the patient's tibia during knee extension between 90 degrees and 30 degrees of flexion and then relieving that pain by externally rotating the tibia." [PMID:12975201]

fields.label: Saccadic oscillation
fields.definition: "An involuntary abnormality of fixation in which there is an abnormal saccade away from fixation followed by an immediate corrective saccade." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Saccadic oscillations

fields.label: Macrosaccadic oscillations
fields.definition: "A type of saccadic oscillations with brief periods of fixation between saccades (intersaccadic interval approximately 200 msec). Macrosaccadic oscillations (up to 40 degrees) straddle the intended fixation position and show a crescendo-decrescendo pattern." [PMID:14681893]
fields.synonyms_concat: Macrosaccadic oscillation

fields.label: Conjunctival icterus
fields.definition: "Conjunctival icterus is a condition where there is yellowing of the whites of the eyes. This is most commonly seen in patients who have liver disease." []
synonyms: Yellowing of the whites of the eyes
fields.synonyms_concat: Scleral icterus; Yellow conjunctiva; Yellow sclera; Yellowing of the whites of the eyes

fields.label: Limbal stem cell deficiency
fields.definition: "A condition characterized by a loss or deficiency of the stem cells in the limbus that are vital for re-population of the corneal epithelium and to the barrier function of the limbus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:26788074]

fields.label: Mildly reduced contrast sensitivity
fields.definition: "A mild reduction in the ability to perceive visual contrast characterized by 0.20-0.59 log unit contrast sensitivity loss." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mild reduction in contrast sensitivity

fields.label: Moderately reduced contrast sensitivity
fields.definition: "A moderate reduction in the ability to perceive visual contrast characterized by 0.60-0.99 log unit contrast sensitivity loss." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.synonyms_concat: Moderate reduction in contrast sensitivity

fields.label: Severely reduced contrast sensitivity
fields.definition: "A severe reduction in the ability to perceive visual contrast characterized by 1.00 log unit or more contrast sensitivity loss." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal Vistech contrast sensitivity test
fields.definition: "An abnormality in perception of contrast as measured by the Vistech wall chart sine wave grating test." [PMID:1911660]

fields.label: Abnormal Pelli Robson contrast sensitivity chart test
fields.definition: "An abnormality in perception of contrast as measured by the Pelli-Robson contrast sensitivity chart, which is a large wall-mounted chart, with letters of a fixed size (comprising spatial frequencies appropriate for estimating peak contrast sensitivity) that decrease in contrast." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:16723494]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal pelli robson contrast sensitivity chart test

fields.label: Semidominant inheritance
fields.definition: "A mode of inheritance that is observed for traits related to a gene encoded on chromosomes in which a trait can manifest in a monoallelic (e.g. heterozygotes) and biallelic (e.g. homozygotes, compound heterozygotes) state, with similar or differing phenotype severity present dependent on the number of alleles affected." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5243-225X, https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5298-0168, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2650-2426, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5655-9589, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6647-5493, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6733-369X, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8016-0076, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8218-5111]
fields.synonyms_concat: Semidominant mode of inheritance

fields.label: Saccadic intrusion
fields.definition: "An involuntary abnormality of fixation in which there is an abnormal saccade away from fixation followed by a delayed corrective saccade." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Macrosquare-wave jerks
fields.definition: "Horizontal 10-40 degree excursions from fixation and back again." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, ISBN:978-0198804550]

fields.label: Retinitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the retina of the eye." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]

fields.label: Abnormal peripheral nervous system physiology
fields.definition: "Any functional abnormality of the part of the nervous system that consists of the nerves and ganglia outside of the brain and spinal cord." []

fields.label: Froment sign
fields.definition: "An abnormal result of a physical examination of the the hand that tests for palsy of the ulnar nerve. This nerve innervates the adductor pollicis and interossei muscles and thereby enables adduction of the thumb and extension of the interphalangeal joint. An abnormal result consists in reduced functionality and muscular weakness in the pinch grip between the thumb and index finger of the affected hand as the patient attempts to pinch a piece of paper that the examiner tries to pull away. The flexor pollicis longus muscle tries to compensate for the weakness by flexing the tip of the thumb at the interphalangeal joint." [PMID:12916637]
fields.synonyms_concat: Froment thumb sign

fields.label: Very low visual acuity
fields.definition: "A reduction in visual acuity with best corrected visual acuity between 1.40 (20/500) and 1.89 logMAR (up to roughly 20/1590)." []

fields.label: Ultra-low vision
fields.definition: "Best corrected visual acuity worse than 1.90 logMAR (roughly 20/1590)." []

fields.label: Abnormal unswitched memory B cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of the unswitched memory B cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD27+IgM+, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." [PMID:28882820]
synonyms: Abnormal proportion of non-class-switched memory B cells
Abnormal proportion of unswitched memory B cells
fields.label_normalized: abnormal unswitched memory b cell proportion
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal proportion of non-class-switched memory B cells; Abnormal proportion of unswitched memory B cells

fields.label: Increased unswitched memory B cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase of the unswitched memory B cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD27+IgM+, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []
synonyms: Elevated proportion of unswitched memory B cells
Increased proportion of non-class-switched memory B cells
Increased proportion of unswitched memory B cells
fields.label_normalized: increased unswitched memory b cell proportion
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated proportion of unswitched memory B cells; Increased proportion of non-class-switched memory B cells; Increased proportion of unswitched memory B cells

fields.label: Decreased unswitched memory B cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal reduction of the unswitched memory B cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD27+IgM+, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []
synonyms: Decreased proportion of non-class-switched memory B cells
Decreased proportion of unswitched memory B cells
Reduced proportion of unswitched memory B cells
fields.label_normalized: decreased unswitched memory b cell proportion
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased proportion of non-class-switched memory B cells; Decreased proportion of unswitched memory B cells; Reduced proportion of unswitched memory B cells

fields.label: Abnormal plasmablast proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of plasmablasts, commonly characterized as CD27+CD38hi and sometimes additionally as IgMlowCD24-, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." [PMID:22566959]

fields.label: Increased proportion of plasmablasts
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase of plasmablasts, commonly characterized as CD27+CD38hi and sometimes additionally as IgMlowCD24-, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []

fields.label: Decreased proportion of plasmablasts
fields.definition: "Abnormal decrease of plasmablasts, commonly characterized as CD27+CD38hi and sometimes additionally as IgMlowCD24-, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []

fields.label: Mycobacterium abscessus abscessus infection
fields.definition: "Mycobacterium abscessus complex comprises a group of rapidly growing, multidrug-resistant, nontuberculous mycobacteria that are responsible for a wide spectrum of skin and soft tissue diseases, central nervous system infections, bacteremia, and ocular and other infections." [PMID:26295364]

fields.label: Cervical dysplasia
fields.definition: "Cervical dysplasia is the precursor to cervical cancer. It is caused by the persistent infection of the human papillomavirus (HPV) into the cervical tissue. Affected cells develop morphologic features with immature basaloid- type squamous cells and mitotic figures in the upper half of the cervical epithelium." [PMID:12525422]
fields.synonyms_concat: Uterine cervix dysplasia

fields.label: Decreased circulating total IgG concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood." [PMID:17910333]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating total IgG

fields.label: Transient decreased circulating total IgG
fields.definition: "A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood." []

fields.label: Chronic decreased circulating total IgG
fields.definition: "A lasting reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood." []
synonyms: Chronic decreased total IgG in blood
fields.synonyms_concat: Chronic decreased total IgG in blood

fields.label: Decreased circulating IgG subclass concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction below the normal concentration of a subclass of immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood." [PMID:17910333]
synonyms: Decreased IgG subclass level in blood
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating IgG subclass level; Decreased IgG subclass level in blood

fields.label: Decreased circulating IgG1 concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG1 subclass in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating IgG1 level; Decreased IgG1 level in blood

fields.label: Decreased circulating IgG3 concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG3 subclass in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating IgG3 level; Decreased IgG3 level in blood

fields.label: Decreased circulating IgG4 concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG4 subclass in the blood circulation." [PMID:26929632]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating IgG4 level; Decreased IgG4 level in blood

fields.label: Reduced isohemagglutinin level
fields.definition: "Level of isohemagglutinin reduced below expected concentration. An isohemagglutinin refers to the naturally occurring antibodies in the ABO blood group system (i.e., anti-A in a group B person, anti-B in a group A person, and anti-A, anti-B, and anti-A,B in a group O person)." [PMID:25309532]
synonyms: Decreased natural antibody to blood group agents
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased natural antibody to blood group agents; Partial absence of isohemagglutinins

fields.label: Decreased specific antibody response to vaccination
fields.definition: "A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against toxoids and polysaccharides in vaccines, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination." [PMID:26018535]
fields.label_normalized: decreased specific antibody response to vaccination

fields.label: Precordial pain
fields.definition: "A type of chest pain that arises in the or under the left breast and often described as throbbing, stabbing, or burning, and lasting hours or longer. The pain may arise with or after effort, and may spread to the left arm or left side of the neck." [PMID:18122452]

fields.label: Fetor hepaticus
fields.definition: "Fetor hepaticus is the characteristic breath of patients with severe parenchymal liver disease, which has been said to resemble the odor of a mixture of rotten eggs and garlic." [PMID:10791209]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foetor hepaticus

fields.label: Burning mouth
fields.definition: "An intense sensation of burning, scalding, or tingling feeling of the tongue or other regions of the oral mucosa." [PMID:25952601]

fields.label: Coffee ground vomitus
fields.definition: "Vomit that has the appearance of coffee grounds, which occurs due to the presence of coagulated blood in the vomit." [PMID:19564091]
fields.synonyms_concat: Coffee grounds emesis; Coffee grounds vomiting

fields.label: Sural nerve atrophy
fields.definition: "Wasting of the sural nerve, a sensory nerve in the calf region of the leg." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Atrophy of sural nerve

fields.label: HbC hemoglobin
fields.definition: "Presence of an abnormal type of hemoglobin characterized by the substitution of a glutamic acid residue at position 7 following the initial methionine residue by a lysine (6GAG>6AAG). The presence of HbC can be determined by hemoglobin electrophoresis." [PMID:15215497, PMID:20301551]
fields.synonyms_concat: Haemoglobin C; HbC haemoglobin; Hemoglobin C

fields.label: Erythromelalgia
fields.definition: "Recurrent episodes of redness, burning pain, and warmth of the extremities following exposure to heat or exercise with symptoms predominantly involving the feet." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1089-1543, PMID:26419464]

fields.label: Episodic pain
fields.definition: "Intermittent pain, i.e., pain that occurs occasionally and at irregular intervals." []

fields.label: Breakthrough pain
fields.definition: "A episode of severe pain that breaks through (i.e., temporarily exacerbates) a period of persistent pain." [PMID:26438145]

fields.label: Paroxysmal rectal pain
fields.definition: "Excruciating burning pain in the rectal area that may be triggered by defecation." [PMID:29650526]

fields.label: Episodic eosinophilia
fields.definition: "Recurrent episodes of marked eosinophilia that resolve spontaneously." [PMID:25527564]

fields.label: Keratosis pilaris
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the hair follicles of the skin that typically presents as small, rough, brown folliculocentric papules distributed over characteristic areas of the skin, particularly the outer-upper arms and thighs." [PMID:22628989, PMID:27194977, PMID:30043128]
fields.synonyms_concat: Carpet tack sign; Chicken skin; Follicular keratosis; Follicular keratotic plug; Follicular plugging; Hyperkeratosis pilaris; Lichen pilaris

fields.label: Joint subluxation
fields.definition: "A partial dislocation of a joint." []

fields.label: Aphthous ulcer
fields.definition: "Oral aphthous ulcers typically present as painful, sharply circumscribed fibrin-covered mucosal defects with a hyperemic border." [PMID:25346356]
fields.synonyms_concat: Canker sore

fields.label: Abdominal cramps
fields.definition: "A type of abdominal pain characterized by a feeling of contractions and typically fluctuating in intensity." []

fields.label: Skin detachment
fields.definition: "Loss of sections of skin either spontaneously or after gentle handling." [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:RGD_gthayman, PMID:27656858]
fields.synonyms_concat: Detached skin; Epidermal detachment; Skin sloughing

fields.label: Recurrent genital herpes
fields.definition: "Recurrent episodes of genital herpes, typically characterized by stages of erythema, papules, short-lived vesicles, painful ulcers, and crusts on the skin of the genitals and surrounding area, and that typically resolve over a period of 2 to 3 weeks." [PMID:27532832]

fields.label: Unusual infection by anatomical site
fields.definition: "An unusual infection classified by the affected body part." []

fields.label: Fungal meningitis
fields.definition: "An infection of the meninges caused by a fungus. Generally, only individuals with deficiencies of the immune system contract fungal meningitis." [PMID:29244019]

fields.label: Cryptococcal meningitis
fields.definition: "A type of fungal meningitis caused by an encapsulated yeast that belongs to the genus Cryptococcus. Cryptococcus neoformans and Cryptococcus gattii are responsible for the majority of cases of human cryptococcosis." [PMID:24715488]

fields.label: Coccidioidal meningitis
fields.definition: "A type of fungal meningitis caused by dissemination of coccidioides to basilar meninges." [PMID:27927853]

fields.label: Unusual skin infection
fields.definition: "A type of infection of the skin that can be regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection." []

fields.label: Molluscum contagiosum
fields.definition: "Molluscum contagiosum is a cutaneous viral infection that is commonly observed in both healthy and immunocompromised children. The infection is caused by a member of the Poxviridae family, the molluscum contagiosum virus. Molluscum contagiosum presents as single or multiple small white or flesh-colored papules that typically have a central umbilication. The central umbilication may be difficult to observe in young children and, instead, may bear an appearance similar to an acneiform eruption. The lesions vary in size (from 1 mm to 1 cm in diameter) and are painless, although a subset of patients report pruritus in the area of infection. On average, 11-20 papules appear on the body during the course of infection and generally remains a self-limiting disease. However, in immunosuppressed patients, molluscum contagiosum can be a severe infection with hundreds of lesions developing on the body. Extensive eruption is indicative of an advanced immunodeficiency state." [PMID:24740746]

fields.label: Increased blood folate concentration
fields.definition: "An elevated circulating concentration of folic acid, which is also known as vitamin B9." []

fields.label: Placental mesenchymal dysplasia
fields.definition: "Placental mesenchymal dysplasia is a rare anomaly characterized by placentomegaly, dilatation of chorionic vessels and hydropic stem villi with cistern-like formation. It is often clinically mistaken for a partial hydatidiform mole but there is no trophoblastic proliferation. P57 immunohistochemical expression is discordant, showing a normal positive expression in the cytotrophoblastic cells, and loss of expression in the stromal cells." [PMID:17227114, PMID:25171710, PMID:28515588]

fields.label: Unusual gastrointestinal infection
fields.synonyms_concat: Unusual GI infection

fields.label: Clostridium difficile enteritis
fields.definition: "An infection of the small intestine (enteritis) by clostridium difficile." []
fields.synonyms_concat: C. difficile enteritis

fields.label: Clostridium difficile colitis
fields.definition: "An infection of the colon (colitis) by clostridium difficile." [PMID:22298971]

fields.label: Severe infection
fields.definition: "A type of infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection because of unusual severity or intensity of the infection." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Unusual course of infection

fields.label: Severe varicella zoster infection
fields.definition: "An unusually severe form of varicella zoster virus (VZV) infection. In the majority of the cases, especially in children, varicella is a very mild infection characterized by skin lesions, low grade fever and malaise. Severe infection is characterized by manifestations including VZV pneumonia, hepatitis, meningitis, and disseminated varicella." [PMID:21748081, PMID:23248376]

fields.label: Bladder pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the urinary bladder. Bladder pain may be more pronounced with a full bladder and relieved upon urination, but this is not always the case." []

fields.label: Continuous diaphragm sign
fields.definition: "This sign is seen in pneumomediastinum in which air accumulates between the lower border of the heart and the superior part of the diaphragm, which results in complete visualization of the diaphragm in chest X-ray, hence named continuous diaphragm sign." [PMID:26312141]

fields.label: Tree-in-bud pattern
fields.definition: "The tree-in-bud pattern represents centrilobular branching structures that resemble a budding tree. The pattern reflects a spectrum of endo- and peribronchiolar disorders, including mucoid impaction, inflammation, and/or fibrosis (See Figure 70 of PMID:18195376)." [PMID:18195376]

fields.label: Signet ring sign
fields.definition: "This finding is composed of a ring-shaped opacity representing a dilated bronchus in cross section and a smaller adjacent opacity representing its pulmonary artery, with the combination resembling a signet (or pearl) ring. It is the basic sign of bronchiectasis in pulmonary computed tomography imaging." [PMID:18195376]

fields.label: Apical pulmonary opacity
fields.definition: "An apical cap is a caplike lesion at the lung apex, usually caused by intrapulmonary and pleural fibrosis pulling down extrapleural fat or possibly by chronic ischemia resulting in hyaline plaque formation on the visceral pleura. The prevalence increases with age. It can also be seen in hematoma resulting from aortic rupture or in other fluid collection associated with infection or tumor, either outside the parietal pleura or loculated within the pleural space." [PMID:18195376, PMID:1994409]
fields.synonyms_concat: Apical cap; Apical pleural thickening

fields.label: Parenchymal consolidation
fields.definition: "Consolidation refers to an exudate or other product of disease that replaces alveolar air, rendering the lung solid (as in infective pneumonia)." [PMID:18195376]

fields.label: Flaky paint dermatosis
fields.definition: "A dermatosis characterized by generalized shiny, enamel-like, hyperpigmented scales in an irregular pattern. The scales may peel or desquamate, rather like old, sun-baked blistered paint, often with areas of underlying hypopigmentation. This has led to the terms peeling paint or flaky paint dermatosis (See the Figure in PMID:24285001)." [PMID:1764353, PMID:24285001]
fields.synonyms_concat: Flaky paint skin appearance

fields.label: Abnormal circulating globulin concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of globulins in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal circulating globulin level

fields.label: Abnormal circulating metabolite concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal level of an analyte measured in the blood." []

fields.label: Anomalous hepatic venous drainage into the left atrium
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the hepatic veins, which normally drain de-oxygenated blood from the liver into the inferior vena cava, whereby the hepatic veins drain into the left atrium." [PMID:12556263, PMID:16122505, PMID:20552624]
fields.label_normalized: anomalous hepatic venous drainage into the left atrium

fields.label: Abnormal memory T cell proportion
fields.definition: "An abnormal proportion of memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. Memory T cells have previously encountered and responded to their cognate antigen and upon a repeated encounter with the antigen can mount a faster and stronger response." [PMID:8450264]
synonyms: Abnormal proportion of memory T cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal proportion of CD4+CD29+ cells; Abnormal proportion of memory T cells

fields.label: Decreased memory T cell proportion
fields.definition: "An abnormally reduced proportion of memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood." [PMID:8450264]
synonyms: Decreased proportion of memory T cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased proportion of CD4+CD29+ cells; Decreased proportion of memory T cells

fields.label: Increased memory T cell proportion
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated proportion of memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood." []
synonyms: Increased proportion of memory T cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased proportion of CD4+CD29+ cells; Increased proportion of memory T cells

fields.label: Disseminated molluscum contagiosum
fields.definition: "The presence of molluscum contagiosum lesions across multiple areas of the body." [PMID:21894250]

fields.label: Anal neoplasm
fields.definition: "A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the anal canal or anal margin." [NCIT:C2877]

fields.label: Anal intraepithelial neoplasia
fields.definition: "Anal intraepithelial neoplasia (AIN) is a premalignant lesion of the anal mucosa that is a precursor to anal cancer." [NCIT:C4595, PMID:28255426]

fields.label: Cellular hypersensitivity to mitomycin C
fields.definition: "An increased cellular sensitivity to the DNA cross-linking agent, mitomycin C (MMC). In the presence of increased sensitivity, MMC causes increased cell death, chromosome breakage, and accumulation in the G2 phase of the cell cycle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:9650445]

fields.label: Cellular hypersensitivity to diepoxybutane
fields.definition: "An increased cellular sensitivity to the DNA cross-linking agent, diepoxybutane (DEB). In the presence of increased sensitivity, DEB causes cell death, chromosome breakage, and accumulation in the G2 phase of the cell cycle." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:14679584]

fields.label: Abnormal meniscus morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structure of the meniscus of the knee, two crescent shape fibrocartilaginous pads that disperse the weight of the body and reduce friction of the knee joint during movement." [PMID:26488288]

fields.label: Torn meniscus
fields.definition: "A tear in the cartilaginous pad (meniscus) of the knee." [PMID:21126396, PMID:26488288]

fields.label: Hydatidiform mole
fields.definition: "Hydatidiform mole (HM) is an aberrant human pregnancy with absence of, or abnormal embryonic development, hydropic degeneration of chorionic villi, and excessive proliferation of the trophoblast." [PMID:23232697, PMID:26421650]

fields.label: Decreased low-density lipoprotein particle size
fields.definition: "An abnormal decrease in the average size of low-density lipoprotein particle size in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5356-4174, PMID:10417486, PMID:9973300]

fields.label: Abnormal S wave
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of the S wave, which is the third component of the QRS wave complex. The S wave signifies the final depolarization of the ventricles at the base of the heart." []

fields.label: Prominent S wave in lead I
fields.definition: "Increased amplitude (0.1 mV or more) and/or duration (40 ms or more) of the S wave as measured in lead I of the electrocardiogram." [PMID:27012403]
fields.label_normalized: prominent s wave in lead i

fields.label: Deep S wave in lead V5
fields.definition: "Abnormal depth of the S wave in lead V5 of the electrocardiogram." [PMID:29279530]
fields.label_normalized: deep s wave in lead v5

fields.label: Decreased prothrombin time
fields.definition: "Abnormally short time to coagulation in the prothrombin time test, which is a measure of the extrinsic pathway of coagulation. The results of the prothrombin time test are often expressed in terms of the International normalized ratio (INR), which is calculated as a ratio of the patient's prothrombin time (PT) to a control PT standardized for the potency of the thromboplastin reagent developed by the World Health Organization (WHO) using the formula: INR is equal to Patient PT divided by Control PT." [PMID:21470390]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased INR; Decreased international normalised ratio; Decreased international normalized ratio; Decreased PT

fields.label: Abnormal prothrombin time
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal amount of time to coagulation in the prothrombin time test, which is a measure of the extrinsic pathway of coagulation. The results of the prothrombin time test are often expressed in terms of the International normalized ratio (INR), which is calculated as a ratio of the patient's prothrombin time (PT) to a control PT standardized for the potency of the thromboplastin reagent developed by the World Health Organization (WHO) using the formula: INR is equal to Patient PT divided by Control PT." [PMID:29939529]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal PT

fields.label: Perivascular fibrosis
fields.definition: "The presence of thick collagen bundles around blood vessels, often in an onion-skin type whorling pattern." [PMID:21502911, PMID:30363608]

fields.label: Rotator cuff tear
fields.definition: "The term rotator cuff describes the tendons connecting the infraspinatus, supraspinatus, teres minor, and subscapularis muscles to the humeral head.Traumatic tears of the rotator cuff tend to occur at the tendon-bone junction of the supraspinatus and greater tuberosity of the humerus whereas degenerative tears tend to be seen posteriorly at the junction of the supraspinatus and infraspinatu A rotator cuff tear is when one or more of these tendons tears or detaches from the humerus." [PMID:24932450, PMID:29229593]

fields.label: Vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia
fields.definition: "Vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia (VIN) is widely accepted as the precursor lesion of vulvar squamous cell carcinoma (VSCC). VSCC arises via either a human papilloma virus (HPV)-associated pathway, or more commonly, via a mechanism independent of HPV, often being linked to chronic inflammatory conditions such as lichen sclerosus (LS). Accordingly, two distinct subtypes of VIN are recognized: the HPV-associated high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion/usual VIN (HSIL/uVIN) and the non-HPV-associated differentiated VIN (dVIN). HSIL is clinically identified by its multifocal, warty appearance and on histology by conspicuous cytological and architectural atypia. Differentiated VIN, on the other hand, often produces ill-defined lesions, and on histology, notoriously mimics non-neoplastic epithelial disorders (NNED), particularly LS. As a result, dVIN is rarely identified in advance of a diagnosis of invasive malignancy, despite being the precursor lesion of the majority of VSCC." [NCIT:C4756, PMID:30187167]

fields.label: Lymphoid nodular hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Lymphoid nodular hyperplasia (LNH) of the terminal ileum and colon has been considered a mucosal response to nonspecific stimuli, most often infections, and consequently has been regarded as a pathophysiologic phenomenon during infancy and childhood. LNH can be ascertained by colonoscopy, whereby a lymphoid nodule is defined as an extruding follicle with a diameter of not more than 2 mm, and LNH is defined as a cluster of not more than 10 of such extruding lymphoid nodules (see Figure 1 of PMID:17368236)." [PMID:10400105, PMID:17368236]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lymphonodular hyperplasia of the colon

fields.label: Chronic active Epstein-Barr virus infection
fields.definition: "Chronic active Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection is an uncommon outcome of EBV infection and may present as a waxing and waning or fulminant syndrome. Unlike acute infectious mononucleosis, wherein EBV establishes lifelong infection and survives by maintaining a delicate balance with the host as a latent infection, in chronic active EBV infection the host-virus balance is disturbed." []

fields.label: Increased circulating galectin-3 level
fields.definition: "An increased circulation of galectin-3 in the blood circulation." [PMID:24065222]

fields.label: Increased urinary type 1 collagen N-terminal telopeptide level
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of type 1 collagen N-terminal telopeptide (NTx) level in the urine. Generally the test is performed over a period of time, for instance, 10 cc of morning urine can be collected following 12 hours overnight fasting or for 24 hours." [PMID:30572827]
synonyms: Increased collagen crosslinked N-telopeptide [Moles/volume] in 24 hour urine
fields.label_normalized: increased urinary type 1 collagen n-terminal telopeptide level
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased collagen crosslinked N-telopeptide [Moles/volume] in 24 hour urine; Increased urine NTx level

fields.label: Abnormal circulating free T3 concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration of free triiodothyronine (T3) in the blood circulation. A proportion of T3 is bound to plasma proteins in the blood, including mainly thyroxine binding globulin, transthyretin, and albumin. T3 that is not bound to a protein is referred to as free T3." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal circulating free T3 level; Abnormal circulating free triiodotyronine concentration

fields.label: Decreased circulating free T3
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration of free 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating free triiodothyronine

fields.label: Increased urinary epithelial cell count
fields.definition: "An increased number of epithelial cells per high-power field in urinanalysis." []

fields.label: Increased urinary squamous epithelial cell count
fields.definition: "An increased number of squamous epithelial cells per high-power field in urinanalysis." [PMID:26782662]
fields.label_normalized: increased urinary squamous epithelial cell count

fields.label: Increased urinary renal tubular epithelial cell count
fields.definition: "An increased number of renal tubular epithelial cells per high-power field in urinanalysis." []
fields.label_normalized: increased urinary renal tubular epithelial cell count

fields.label: Increased urinary transitional epithelial cell count
fields.definition: "An increased number of transitional epithelial cells per high-power field in urinanalysis." []
fields.label_normalized: increased urinary transitional epithelial cell count

fields.label: Disseminated cutaneous warts
fields.definition: "Multiple skin warts located in multiple parts of the body, e.g., neck, trunks, and extremities." [PMID:29730845]

fields.label: Lymphocytic infiltration of the colorectal mucosa
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased intraepithelial lymphocyte count. This finding may be appreciated as large numbers of surface intraepithelial lymphocytes as seen (for instance) with hematoxylin and eosin staining of a colonic biopsy sample taken during colonoscopy." [PMID:9824342]
fields.label_normalized: lymphocytic infiltration of the colorectal mucosa

fields.label: Indurated nodule
fields.definition: "A skin nodule that is unusually hard (indurated)." [PMID:16252032, PMID:23006954]

fields.label: Decreased CD4+ T cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal decrease of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population." []
synonyms: Decreased proportion of CD4+ T cells
Decreased proportion of CD4-positive helper T cells
Decreased proportion of CD4-positive T cells
Decreased proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
fields.synonyms_concat: CD4 T cell lymphopenia; Decreased helper T cell proportion; Decreased proportion circulating T-helper cells; Decreased proportion of CD4+ cells; Decreased proportion of CD4+ T cells; Decreased proportion of CD4-positive helper T cells; Decreased proportion of CD4-positive T cells; Decreased proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells; Reduced helper T cell proportion; Reduced proportion of CD4-positive cells

fields.label: Increased CD4+ T cell proportion
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population." []
synonyms: Elevated proportion of CD4-positive T cells
Increased proportion of CD4+ T cells
Increased proportion of CD4-positive T cells
Increased proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated helper T cell proportion; Elevated proportion of CD4-positive T cells; Increased helper T cell proportion; Increased proportion of CD4+ T cells; Increased proportion of CD4-positive T cells; Increased proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells

fields.label: Interface hepatitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the liver characterized by a mononuclear cell infiltrate whereby portal inflammatory cells extend through the limiting plate between the portal tract and liver parenchyma." []

fields.label: Periportal emperipolesis
fields.definition: "The engulfing of lymphocytes by hepatocytes, which typically occurs in the interface hepatitis area." [PMID:25654060, PMID:9420892]

fields.label: Serrated intestinal polyps
fields.definition: "The presence of multiple serrated polyps in the intestine. Unlike conventional adenomas, which are uniformly dysplastic, the vast majority of serrated lesions contain no dysplasia. The serrated class includes the hyperplastic polyps, which are not considered precancerous; sessile serrated polyps (also called sessile serrated adenomas); and traditional serrated adenomas. Sessile serrated polyps are larger on average and more often located in the proximal colon. Sessile serrated polyps have a more irregular surface, a pattern to the surface that has been called cloudlike, and indistinct edges compared with hyperplastic polyps. Sessile serrated polyps also have large open pits on the surface (type O pits) when viewed with magnification." [NCIT:C96470, PMID:27540339]
fields.synonyms_concat: Serrated polyposis

fields.label: Blood group
fields.definition: "Any of the various types of human blood whose antigen characteristics determine compatibility in transfusion. While the ABO and Rhesus systems are the most well known, there are in total about 300 different blood type antigens distributed across 34 different blood type systems." [PMID:26085552]

fields.label: ABO blood group
fields.definition: "The ABO system consists of A and B antigens and antibodies against these antigens." [PMID:15373665, PMID:26085552]

fields.label: Perifollicular fibroma
fields.definition: "Perifollicular fibroma is a rare cutaneous hamartoma that shows differentiation in the connective tissue sheath of hair follicles. It can occur as a solitary papule or as multiple lesions. Histologically, the lesion consists of a concentric arrangement of cellular fibrous tissue around a normal hair follicle." [PMID:21747629]

fields.label: Abnormal sebaceous gland morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the sebaceous glands." [PMID:17975220]

fields.label: Sebaceous hyperplasia
fields.definition: "A common, benign skin condition involving hypertrophy of the sebaceous glands characterized by single or multiple lesions that manifest as yellow, soft, small papules with umbilication. The lesions are located commonly on the central face (specifically, the nose, cheeks and forehead) but may also occur elsewhere, including the chest, mouth, scrotum, foreskin, penile shaft, vulva, and areola." [PMID:24759166]

fields.label: Trichodiscoma
fields.definition: "A small benign fibrovascular tumor of the dermal part of the hair disk. Trichodiscoma is rather simple in appearance and consists of a dome-shaped fibrous tumor with a prominent vascular component that fills the papillary dermis under an atrophic epidermis. As in a normal hair disk, a hair follicle may be present at one edge of the papular lesion." [NCIT:C43333, PMID:10522666]

fields.label: Perinuclear antineutrophil antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against proteins predominantly expressed in perinuclear region of neutrophils." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:24854381, PMID:27481040, PMID:28661185]
fields.synonyms_concat: p-ANCA positivity

fields.label: Cytoplasmic antineutrophil antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against proteins predominantly expressed in cytoplasmic granules of neutrophils." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:14646155, PMID:24854381, PMID:27481040, PMID:28661185]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody positivity; C-ANCA antibodies; Cytoplasmic antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies

fields.label: Hypochromia
fields.definition: "A qualitative impression that red blood cells have less color than normal when examined under a microscope, usually related to a reduced amount of hemoglobin in the red blood cells." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating CK-MB concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of CK-MB (= creatine kinase MB) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating CK MB isoform

fields.label: Increased circulating creatine kinase BB isoform
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of the BB isoform of creatine kinase in the blood circulation." [PMID:21448658]
fields.label_normalized: increased circulating creatine kinase bb isoform
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating CK BB isoform

fields.label: Increased circulating creatine kinase MM isoform
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of the MM isoform of creatine kinase in the blood circulation." [PMID:21448658]
fields.label_normalized: increased circulating creatine kinase mm isoform
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating CK MM isoform

fields.label: Anti-La/SS-B antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against La/SSB autoantigens." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:15804706, PMID:27431345]

fields.label: Increased circulating immature neutrophil count
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased number of immature neutrophils in the peripheral blood circulation." [PMID:25887201]

fields.label: Increased circulating myelocyte count
fields.definition: "The number of myelocytes in the peripheral blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Myelocytes are immature neutrophils with a size of 12-18 micrometers, a round or oval nucleus with no nucleoli, bluish-pink staining cytoplasm with primary and secondary granules, and a nucleus:cytoplasm ratio of 2:1." [PMID:25887201]

fields.label: Increased circulating metamyelocyte count
fields.definition: "The number of metamyelocytes in the peripheral blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Metamyelocytes are immature neutrophils with a size of 10-18 micrometers, an indented or kidney-shaped nucleus, pinkish-blue staining cytoplasm with secondary granules, and a nucleus:cytoplasm ratio of 1.5:1." [PMID:25887201]

fields.label: Increased circulating band cell count
fields.definition: "The number of band cells in the peripheral blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Band cells are immature neutrophils with a size of 10-18 micrometers, a horseshoe-shaped nucleus with no nucleoli, light-pink staining cytoplasm with many small secondary granules, and a nucleus:cytoplasm ratio of 1:2." [PMID:25887201]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating band form neutrophils; Left shift

fields.label: Elevated circulating E selectin level
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of E selectin in the blood circulation." [PMID:12591072]

fields.label: Cervical neoplasm
fields.definition: "A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the uterine cervix." [NCIT:C2940]

fields.label: Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia
fields.definition: "A precancerous condition characterized by dysplasia of the cervical epithelium. Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) 1, 2 and 3 based on its relationship with the prognosis. CIN 1 is mild dysplasia, which is mostly observed because it disappears as part of its natural course. CIN 3 includes severe dysplasia and carcinoma in situ, and management involves treatment because it is highly likely to develop into invasive cancer." [PMID:28453530]

fields.label: Abnormal tissue metabolite concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of a metabolite in a tissue." []

fields.label: Decreased serum thromboxane B2
fields.definition: "A reduction in the concentration of thromboxane B2 in the blood circulation." [PMID:6101498]

fields.label: Abnormal metabolism
fields.definition: "An abnormality in the function of the chemical reactions related to processes including conversion of food to enter, synthesis of proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and carbohydrates, or the elimination of waste products." []

fields.label: Persistent CMV viremia
fields.definition: "Lasting (uncontrolled) presence of cytomegalovirus in the blood circulation." [PMID:28130404]

fields.label: Persistent viremia
fields.definition: "Persistence of virus in the blood circulation longer than would be normal in an immunocompetent host." []

fields.label: Coccidioidomycosis
fields.definition: "Infection by a Coccidioides species fungus. These are dimorphic, soil-dwelling, fungi known to cause a broad spectrum of disease, ranging from a mild febrile illness to severe pulmonary manifestations or disseminated disease. The genus Coccidioides is comprised of two genetically distinct species: Coccidioides immitis and C. posadasii." [PMID:23843703]
fields.synonyms_concat: Valley fever

fields.label: Acinetobacter infection
fields.definition: "An infection by Acinetobacter baumannii, a Gram-negative bacillus that is aerobic, pleomorphic and non-motile. An opportunistic pathogen, A. baumannii has a high incidence among immunocompromised individuals, particularly those who have experienced a prolonged (over 90 d) hospital stay." [PMID:22546906]

fields.label: Granuloma
fields.definition: "A compact, organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes, which may be but is not necessarily accompanied by accessory features such as necrosis." [PMID:10908370, PMID:11168676, PMID:937513]

fields.label: Eosinophilic granuloma
fields.definition: "A type of granuloma characterized morphologically by the predominance of Langerhans cells with characteristic grooved, folded, indented nuclei in the appropriate milieu that includes variable numbers of eosinophils and histiocytes including multinucleated forms, often appearing similar to osteoclasts or touton like giant cells, neutrophils and small lymphocytes. The concentration of the eosinophilic infiltrate varies from scattered mature cells to sheet-like masses of cells. Occasionally, areas of bone necrosis may interrupt the cellular infiltrate. The foamy cells may also be amassed in clumps, which are of no clinical significance because these clumps represent phagocytosis of lipid debris." [PMID:21938183]

fields.label: Increased circulating copper concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration of copper in the blood circulation. This term refers to the total copper concentration." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated serum copper; Hypercupremia

fields.label: Opportunistic fungal infection
fields.definition: "An infection that is caused by a fungus that would generally not be able to cause an infection in a host with a normal immune system. Such fungi take advantage of the opportunity, so to speak, that is provided by a weakened immune system." []

fields.label: Histoplasmosis
fields.definition: "Histoplasmosis is caused by the fungus Histoplasma capsulatum and is consider to be an opportunistic infection in immunosuppressed persons." [PMID:26897068, PMID:30619685]

fields.label: Disseminated histoplasmosis
fields.definition: "Histoplasmosis infection involving multiple sites of the body. Disseminated histoplasmosis can involve various organs, including reticuloendothelial organs, gastrointestinal tract, adrenal glands, central nervous system, endovascular structures, kidney, and skin. It typically presents with systemic symptoms like fever, generalized fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and the symptoms related to the specific organ involved. Severe disseminated disease can manifest as septic shock, multi organ failure, and ARDS." [PMID:30619685]

fields.label: Pulmonary histoplasmosis
fields.definition: "Infection of the lungs with Histoplasma capsulatum. Symptoms may include fever, headache, weakness, chest pain and dry cough. When imaging is done, chest radiographs may show patchy pneumonia involving one or more lobes with adenopathy of the mediastinum or hilum." [PMID:21810958]

fields.label: Chronic tinea infection
fields.definition: "The term tinea means fungal infection, whereas dermatophyte refers to the fungal organisms that cause tinea. This term refers to a tinea infection that is chronic or recalcitrant to treatment and may be reflective of an immune defect." [PMID:25403034]

fields.label: Opportunistic bacterial infection
fields.definition: "An infection that is caused by a bacterium that would generally not be able to cause an infection in a host with a normal immune system. Such bacteria take advantage of the opportunity, so to speak, that is provided by a weakened immune system." []

fields.label: Nontuberculous mycobacterial pulmonary infection
fields.definition: "An infection of the lung caused by environmental mycobacteria. Such infections can occur in individuals with predisposing lung disease or immune disease." [PMID:24624285, PMID:7472715]

fields.label: Pulmonary tuberculosis
fields.definition: "A lung infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis a slightly curved non-motile, aerobic, non-capsulated and non-spore forming strains of mycobacteria." [PMID:30345099]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pulmonary TB

fields.label: Increased blood pressure
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase in blood pressure. An individual measurement of increased blood pressure does not necessarily imply hypertension. In practical terms, multiple measurements are recommended to diagnose the presence of hypertension." [PMID:9137951]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased BP

fields.label: Anti-NMDA receptor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the NMDA (N-methyl-D-aspartate)-type glutamate receptor." [PMID:24729779]
synonyms: Presence of anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate Receptor antibody in blood
Presence of anti-NMDAR antibody in blood

fields.label: CSF autoimmune antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of an antibody in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that is directed against the organism's own cells or tissues." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cerebrospinal fluid autoimmune antibody positivity

fields.label: CSF anti-NMDA receptor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against the NMDA (N-methyl-D-aspartate)-type glutamate receptor." [PMID:29651625]

fields.label: Empty delta sign
fields.definition: "This sign is created by a nonenhancing thrombus in the dural sinus surrounded by triangular enhancing dura as seen on cross-section. The sign, seen on contrast-enhanced CT scan images, suggests dural sinovenous thrombosis. It is best seen on wider window settings. It is a reliable sign of sinus thrombosis but is seen only in 25-30% of these cases." [PMID:19881070, PMID:29089832]

fields.label: Dural tail sign
fields.definition: "This sign represents thickening and enhancement of the dura mater in continuity with a mass, which on MR images, gives the appearance of a tail arising from the mass. The dural tail is thought to represent reactive change; however, it may also be due to tumor invasion. Three criteria need to be met for a positive dural tail sign: the tail should be seen on two successive images through the tumor, it should taper away from the tumor, and it must enhance more than the tumor." [PMID:19881070]

fields.label: Lemon sign
fields.definition: "The lemon sign refers to the shape of the fetal skull at ultrasonography (US) when the frontal bones lose their normal convex contour and appear flattened or inwardly scalloped. This gives the skull a shape that is said to resemble a lemon.. The sign is seen on transverse sonograms of the fetal cranium obtained at the level of the ventricles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8612-1062, PMID:12832584, PMID:29089832]

fields.label: Optic nerve tram-track sign
fields.definition: "A tram-track sign is composed of two enhancing areas of tumor separated from each other by the negative defect of the optic nerve. It is seen on contrast-enhanced CT scan and MRI images, in optic nerve sheath meningioma. The sign helps distinguish between optic nerve sheath meningioma and optic glioma. Optic glioma arises from glial cells within the optic nerve and there is no clear separation between the nerve and the tumor; hence the tram-track sign is not seen in optic gliomas. Calcification may be seen in optic nerve sheath meningiomas in 20-50% of cases and hence the tram-track sign may be seen on nonenhanced CT scan images as a linear calcification around the nerve, but this is less common." [PMID:19881070]

fields.label: Extrapulmonary tuberculosis
fields.definition: "A type of tubercular infection located outside of the lung, which is the most common location of tuberculosis. There are two types of clinical manifestation of tuberculosis (TB) are pulmonary TB (PTB) and extrapulmonary TB (EPTB). The former is most common. EPTB refers to TB involving organs other than the lungs (e.g., pleura, lymph nodes, abdomen, genitourinary tract, skin, joints and bones, or meninges). A patient with both pulmonary and EPTB is classified as a case of PTB." [PMID:16300038, PMID:25861336]
fields.synonyms_concat: Extrapulmonary TB

fields.label: Increased circulating N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:8412017]
synonyms: Increased circulating N-acetyl aspartic acid level

fields.label: Increased CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." [PMID:8412017]

fields.label: Recurrent shingles
fields.definition: "Repeated episodes of a localized, painful cutaneous eruption related to reactivation of varicella zoster virus (VZV) and characterized by a characteristic rash in one or two adjacent dermatomes." [PMID:24113666]

fields.label: Prominent subcalcaneal fat pad
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased prominence of the fat pad underneath the heal. This feature can be appreciated in figure 1 of PMID:26769062." [PMID:26769062]

fields.label: 2-hydroxyglutarate aciduria
fields.definition: "The concentration of 2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Abnormal base excess
fields.definition: "Deviation from the normal quantity of base excess, defined as the amount of strong acid (in millimoles per liter) that needs to be added in vitro to 1 liter of fully oxygenated whole blood to return a blood sample to standard conditions (pH of 7.40, Pco2 of 40 mm Hg, and temperature of 37 degrees C)." [PMID:30067929]

fields.label: Contact dermatitis
fields.definition: "An inflammatory process in skin caused by an exogenous agent that directly or indirectly injure the skin. If the offending agent is identified and removed, the eruption will resolve. An unusual or patterned eruption may be a clue to the presence of a contact dermatitis. Patch testing may be helpful in the differential diagnosis." []

fields.label: Disseminated nontuberculous mycobacterial infection
fields.definition: "An infection with nontuberculous mycobacteria that affects multiple body sites. Such infections can occur in individuals with immune disease." []

fields.label: Ultra-low vision with retained motion projection
fields.definition: "Ultra-low vision but with retained ability to identify a moving object (typically hand motion at distance of 30 cm)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.label_normalized: ultra-low vision with retained motion projection

fields.label: Ultra-low vision with retained light projection
fields.definition: "Ultra-low vision but with retained ability to perceive the difference between light and dark. Also when light is projected in each of the four quadrants of the visual field, the individual is able to correctly identify the origin of the light stimulus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.label_normalized: ultra-low vision with retained light projection

fields.label: Ultra-low vision with retained light perception
fields.definition: "Ultra-low vision but with retained ability to perceive the difference between light and dark." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.label_normalized: ultra-low vision with retained light perception

fields.label: Ultra-low vision with no light perception
fields.definition: "Ultra-low vision with complete lack of light and form perception." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]
fields.label_normalized: ultra-low vision with no light perception

fields.label: Polyclonal elevation of circulating IgG
fields.definition: "An increase in polyclonal immunoglobulins resulting from many different plasma cells. On serum electrophoresis, a polyclonal gammopathy is characterized by a broad diffuse band with one or more heavy chains and kappa and lambda light chains." [PMID:15663032]

fields.label: Oligoclonal elevation of circulating IgG
fields.definition: "An increase in circulating immunoglobulins characterized by two or more bands in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase in circulating immunoglobulins." []

fields.label: Monoclonal elevation of IgG
fields.definition: "An increase in circulating immunoglobulins characterized by a single band in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase in circulating immunoglobulins." []

fields.label: Monoclonal elevation of intact IgG
fields.definition: "A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has a normal structure with a light and heavy chain." []

fields.label: Monoclonal elevation of IgG light chain
fields.definition: "A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has an abnormal structure with a light chain but not a heavy chain." [PMID:10926917]
fields.label_normalized: monoclonal elevation of igg light chain

fields.label: Monoclonal elevation of IgG heavy chain
fields.definition: "A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has an abnormal structure with a heavy chain but not a light chain." []

fields.label: Monoclonal elevation of IgG kappa chain
fields.definition: "A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has an abnormal structure with a kappa light chain but not a heavy chain." []

fields.label: Monoclonal elevation of IgG lambda chain

fields.label: Increased circulating IgG subclass
fields.definition: "An elevation of circulating IgG level predominantly related to an elevation of one of the four IgG subclasses." [PMID:25368619]

fields.label: Increased circulating IgG3 level

fields.label: Increased circulating IgG1 level
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased concentration of the IgG1 subtype in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:25368619]

fields.label: Increased circulating IgG2 level
