fields.label: Increased circulating IgG4 level
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased concentration of the IgG4 subtype in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:25368619]

fields.label: Genital warts
fields.definition: "Warts affecting the skin in the genital area (penile shaft, scrotum, vagina, or labia majora). Warts can be small, beginning as a pinhead-size swelling that may become larger and take on a pedunculated appearance. Warts can spread and coalesce into large masses in the genital or anal area. Their color is variable but tends to be skin colored or darker, and they may occasionally bleed. Warts may cause itching, redness, or discomfort. An outbreak of genital warts may also cause psychological distress." [PMID:28722914]

fields.label: Kappa Bence Jones proteinuria
fields.definition: "The presence of free monoclonal kappa immunoglobulin light chains in the urine." []

fields.label: Lambda Bence Jones proteinuria
fields.definition: "The presence of free monoclonal lambda immunoglobulin light chains in the urine." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating mannose-binding protein concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of mannose-binding protein in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating mannose-binding protein concentration

fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased mannose-binding protein level

fields.label: Increased circulating procalcitonin concentration
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of procalcitonin in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:28794881, PMID:2933297]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating procalcitonin level

fields.label: Abnormal granulocyte count
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase or decrease of absolute number of granulocytes in the blood, per microliter, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group." []

fields.label: Increased total granulocyte count
fields.definition: "An increased count of granulocytes in the peripheral blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Granulocytosis

fields.label: Elevated circulating globulin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of globulins in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating globulin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of globulins in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Frontotemporal hypertrichosis
fields.definition: "Excessive, increased hair growth located in the region of the forehead and temple." []

fields.label: Abnormal areolar morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormal appearance or structure of the ring of pigmented skin that surrounds the nipple." []

fields.label: Areolar fullness
fields.definition: "The areola (ring of pigmented skin surrounding the nipple) is filled out so as to produce a rounded shape." []

fields.label: Family history
fields.definition: "Information about close relatives of an individual who is the proband of a study or who is being investigated with the goal of identifying a medical diagnosis. Usually, the family history includes information from three generations of relatives, including children, brothers and sisters, parents, aunts and uncles, nieces and nephews, grandparents, and cousins." []

fields.label: Family history of cancer
fields.definition: "A close blood relative had cancer." []

fields.label: Family history of heart disease
fields.definition: "A close blood relative had heart disease." []

fields.label: Health status
fields.definition: "Health status of a family member with respect to the disease being investigated in a proband." []

fields.label: Affected
fields.definition: "This term applies to a family member who is diagnosed with the same condition as the individual who is the primary focus of investigation (the proband)." []

fields.label: Unaffected
fields.definition: "This term applies to a family member in whom the diagnosis that is the primary focus of investigation is excluded." []

fields.label: Healthy
fields.definition: "No history of any serious disease, including the disease being investigated in the proband." []

fields.label: Periodic fever
fields.definition: "Episodic fever that recurs at regular intervals." []

fields.label: Non-periodic recurrent fever
fields.definition: "Episodic fever that recurs at irregular intervals." []

fields.label: Lacunar stroke
fields.definition: "A stroke related to a small infarct (2-20 mm in diameter) in the deep cerebral white matter, basal ganglia, or pons, that is presumed to result from the occlusion of a single small perforating artery supplying the subcortical areas of the brain." [PMID:15834013]

fields.label: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus infection
fields.definition: "Infection with staphylococcus aureus resistant to the antibiotic methicillin (MRSA). MRSA can infect any individual but is more common among hospitalized patients, and can also occur as an opportunistic infection." [PMID:16186732]
fields.synonyms_concat: MRSA infection

fields.label: Interhemispheric cyst
fields.definition: "Cystic collection (sac-like, fluid containing pocket of membranous tissue) located in the interhemispheric fissure, with or without communication with the ventricular system." [PMID:27195030]

fields.label: Temporomandibular joint adhesion
fields.definition: "Formation of one or more fibrous bands within the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) with resulting limitation of movement of the TMJ. Adhesions may be seen in degenerative processes that involve the TMJ." [PMID:12139272, PMID:19534789]

fields.label: Increased urinary 11-deoxycortisol level
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration of 11-deoxycortisol in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:10689646]

fields.label: Increased urinary 11-deoxycorticosterone level
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration or amount of 11-deoxycorticosterone in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:10689646]

fields.label: Increased urinary 11-deoxytetrahydrocorticosterone level
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration or amount of 11-deoxytetrahydrocorticosterone the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:10689646]

fields.label: Oligoclonal elevation of circulating IgM
fields.definition: "An increase in circulating IgM characterized by two or more bands in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase." []

fields.label: Polyclonal elevation of circulating IgA

fields.definition: "An abnormal increased in the amount of the carbohydrate antigen 19-9, a recognizable sialo-ganglioside in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Cutaneous lichen amyloidosis
fields.definition: "Lichen amyloidosis presents with multiple localized or rarely generalized, hyperpigmented grouped papules with a predilection for the shins, calves, ankles, and dorsa of the feet and thighs." [PMID:28342017, PMID:29630157]

fields.label: Cutaneous macular amyloidosis
fields.definition: "A type of cutaneous amyloidosis that is characterized by hyperpigmented patches with indefinite margins composed of grayish brown macules, often with a reticulated or rippled appearance." [PMID:26981113]
fields.synonyms_concat: Macular amyloidosis

fields.label: Cutaneous nodular amyloidosis
fields.definition: "A type of cutaneous amyloidosis that is characterized clinically by waxy, purpuric plaques and nodules and histologically by amyloid deposits in the dermis and subcutaneous tissue." [PMID:28537855]

fields.label: Serinuria

fields.label: Sulfocysteinuria
fields.definition: "A increased concentration of sulfocysteine in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:28980090]

fields.label: Leucinuria
fields.definition: "Increased level of leucine in urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049]

fields.label: Decreased peak expiratory flow
fields.definition: "A reduction in the maximum expiratory flow per minute, which can be used to measure how fast a subject can exhale as well as to judge the strength of the expiratory muscles and the condition of the large airways." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:28005993]

fields.label: Decreased pre-bronchodilator forced vital capacity
fields.definition: "An abnormal reduction in the amount of air a person can expel following maximal insipiration, with the test being performed before the administration of a bronchodilating medication." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:24695507]

fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration of corticosterone in the blood." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049]

fields.label: Decreased circulating corticosterone level
fields.definition: "An abnormally reduced concentration of corticosterone in the blood." []

fields.label: Exacerbated by aspirin exposure
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by ingestion of aspirin." []

fields.label: Positive direct antiglobulin test
fields.definition: "A positive result of the direct antiglobulin test (DAT), a method of demonstrating the presence of antibody or complement bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes by the use of anti-human globulin to form a visible agglutination reaction." [PMID:28134589]

fields.label: Abnormal growth hormone level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal level of growth hormone (GH) in the blood circulation. GH or somatotropin is a peptide hormone that stimulates growth, cell reproduction, and cell regeneration. Its secretion from the pituitary is regulated by the neurosecretory nuclei of the hypothalamus, which can release Growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH or somatocrinin) and Growth hormone-inhibiting hormone (GHIH or somatostatin) into the hypophyseal portal venous blood surrounding the pituitary. GH is secreted in a pulsatile manner, which is one of the reasons why an isolated measurement of its blood concentration is not meaningful." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal somatotropin level

fields.label: Acidemia
fields.definition: "An abnormally low blood pH (usually defined as less than 7.35)." [PMID:24381489]

fields.label: Alkalemia
fields.definition: "An abnormally high blood pH (usually defined as 7.41 or above)." [PMID:24381489]

fields.label: Blood group A

fields.definition: "An increased concentration of isoleucine in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperisoleucinuria; Isoleucine high in urine

fields.label: Increased peripheral blast count
fields.definition: "An increased count in the peripheral blood of cells that are precursors to mature circulating blood cells such as neutrophiles, monocytes, lymphocutes, and erythrocytes. Blasts are not usually found in significant numbers in the peripheral blood circulation, but can be observed in hematopoietic neoplasms such as leukemia, severe infections, and as a result of certain medications." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated blast count; Elevated circulating blasts; Increased peripheral myeloblast count

fields.label: Duffy blood group
fields.definition: "The Duffy blood group system is based on the presence of a glycoprotein termed Fy that is on the surface of erythrocytes and some other cells. There are two Duffy antigens named Fya and Fyb, and thus there are four Duffy phenotypes: a+b+, a+b-, a-b+,a-b-." [PMID:19480920]

fields.label: Duffy Fya positivity
fields.definition: "Presence of the Duffy Fya antigen." [PMID:19480920]

fields.label: Duffy Fyb positivity
fields.definition: "Presence of the Duffy Fyb antigen." [PMID:19480920]

fields.label: Anti-beta 2 glycoprotein I antibody positivity
fields.definition: "Presence of antibodies against beta 2 glycoprotein I in the circulation. Beta-2 glycoprotein I (beta2GPI) is the principal target of autoantibodies in the antiphospholipid syndrome (APS)." [PMID:28105326]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-B2GPI positivity

fields.label: Increased urinary orosomucoid
fields.definition: "An increased concentration in the urine of alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (AGP), also known as orosomucoid (ORM). AGP is a 41-43-kDa glycoprotein with a pI of 2.8-3.8. AGP is an acute-phase protein that has many activities including, but not limited to, acting as an acute-phase reactant and disease marker, modulating immunity, binding and carrying drugs, maintaining the barrier function of capillary, and mediating the sphingolipid metabolism." [PMID:25711902]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased urinary alpha-1-acid glycoprotein

fields.label: Immediate-type hypersensitivity drug reaction
fields.definition: "Hypersensitivity that is observed within 1 hr of exposures. A variety of adverse reactions can occur within minutes to hours of exposure to a drug. Some can be related to the pharmacological action of the drug (WHO Adverse Reaction Terminology type A for augmented) and usually have a low mortality. Others are not readily predictable based on the structure and pharmacological action of the drug and have a relatively high mortality risk (Type B for bizarre). The most serious form of immediate onset drug hypersensitivity reaction, anaphylaxis. Other reactions including itching, dizziness/light-headedness, nausea, chest discomfort but without any objective skin features, physical signs or physiological compromise. Skin only reactions include generalized erythema, urticaria or angioedema without any sentinel features (see below) of other organ involvement." [PMID:24286446]

fields.label: Polymorphous light eruption
fields.definition: "The cardinal symptom is severely pruritic skin lesions. Macular, papular, papulovesicular, urticarial, multiforme- and plaque-like variants are differentiated morphologically, hence the name polymorphous. Usually one morphology dominates in a single individual (monomorphous). The skin lesions develop a few hours to several days after sun exposure. Initially, patchy erythema develops, accompanied by pruritus. Distinct lesions then develop. The upper chest, upper arms, backs of the hands, thighs, and the sides of the face are the primary localizations. The skin lesions resolve spontaneously within several days of ceasing sun exposure and do not leave behind any traces." [PMID:21442060]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sun allergy

fields.label: Hydroa vacciniforme
fields.definition: "In response to the spring sun distinct inflamed reddened skin develops on the ears, nose, cheeks, fingers, backs of the hands, and the lower arms, on which blisters with serous or hemorrhagic content develop. These dry out with the formation of a blackish scab. After shedding of the scab, depressed, varioliform, often hypopigmented scars remain. In addition, hyper- and hypopigmentation are present together, resulting in a polymorphous skin presentation." [PMID:21442060]
synonyms: Acute vesiculation and crusting and scarring following sun exposure
fields.synonyms_concat: Acute vesiculation and crusting and scarring following sun exposure

fields.label: Uniparental isodisomy

fields.label: Periventricular nodular heterotopia
fields.definition: "Nodules of heterotopia along the ventricular walls. [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:22427329]

fields.label: Periventricular laminar heterotopia
fields.definition: "A large mass of heterotopia in a laminar configuration along the ventricular walls. Usually bilateral." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:22427329, PMID:22473091]

fields.label: Periventricular ribbonlike heterotopia

fields.label: Subcortical heterotopia

fields.label: Nodular subcortical heterotopia in peritrigonal regions

fields.label_normalized: nodular subcortical heterotopia in peritrigonal regions

fields.label: Diffuse ribbon-like subcortical heterotopia

fields.label: Mesial parasagittal subcortical heterotopia
fields.definition: "Subcortical heterotopia extending along the mesial aspect of the lateral ventricles, with direct connection to mesial polymicrogyria-like cortex at the anterior and posterior limits of the heterotopia." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:22578326]

fields.label: Curvilinear subcortical heterotopia
fields.definition: "Large subcortical heterotopia of variable morphology with streaks and swirls. These always connect to the overlying cortex in at least one, but usually in multiple, locations. fields.synonyms_concat: Giant heterotopia

fields.label: Transmantle columnar heterotopia

fields.label: Citrullinuria

fields.label: Airborn particle hypersensitivity
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased sensitivity to airborn particles. This can be diagnosed on the basis of the medical history, taking into account seasonality or a relationship to the concentration of airborn particles in the environment of the affected individual. Aerosol challenge is a gold standard of establishment of the symptom. There exist particle hypersensitivity (diesel exhaust, metals, inorganic material) vs. allergen (including pollen dander, etc) hypersensitivity. The responses are usually different and testing for allergen hypersensitivity is done in concert with serum IgE and or skin testing to the suspected allergen." [PMID:30408667, PMID:8077583]

fields.label: Past medical history
fields.definition: "In a medical encounter, the physician generally will interview the patient about his or her current problem, and may perform additional testing. The past medical history (PMH) in contrast records information about the patient's medical, personal and family history that might be relevant to the presenting illness or to provide optimal clinical management. The PMH generally includes (if relevant) other major illnesses, hospitalizations, surgeries, injuries, allergies, gynecologic and obstetric history, family history, personal history including occupational history, alcohol and drug use, etc." []

fields.label: Status post organ transplantation
fields.definition: "The affected individual has received an organ transplant previous to the current medical encounter." []

fields.label: Pulmonary cyst

fields.synonyms_concat: Lung cyst

fields.label: Pulmonary bulla
fields.definition: "Pulmonary bullae are rounded focal regions of emphysema with a thin wall which measure more than 1 cm in diameter. They are often subpleural in location and are typically larger in the apices. In some cases, bullae can be very large and result in compression of adjacent lung tissue. A giant bulla is arbitrarily defined as one that occupies at least one third of the volume of a hemithorax. When large, bullae can simulate pneumothorax. The most common cause is paraseptal emphysema but bullae may also be seen in association with centrilobular emphysema." [PMID:18195376, PMID:20028879, PMID:24106540]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pulmonary bullae

fields.label: Pulmonary bleb
fields.definition: "A bleb is a small gas-containing space within the visceral pleura or in the subpleural lung, not larger than 1 cm in diameter. CT findings show a bleb as a thin-walled cystic air space contiguous with the pleura." [PMID:12934786, PMID:18195376, PMID:20028879]

fields.label: Achlorhydria

fields.label: Abnormal dermoepidermal hemidesmosome morphology

fields.label: Positive blood arsenic test

fields.label: Oral melanotic macule

The lesions are small, solitary, well-circumscribed and often uniformly pigmented." [PMID:24034073, PMID:26538887]
fields.synonyms_concat: Melanotic macule of oral mucosa

fields.label: Oral melanoacanthoma

Although most lesions are heavily pigmented, the coloration may or may not be uniform. Any mucosal site may be affected, but buccal mucosal involvement is most common. Although typically solitary, rare patients may present with multifocal lesions." [PMID:24034073]

fields.label: Abnormal lip pigmentation
fields.definition: "Abnormal coloring of the lip, whereby the lip discolored, blotchy, or darker or lighter than normal." []

fields.label: Labial melanotic macule

fields.label: Reduced granulocyte CD18 level

fields.label: Unlayered lissencephaly

fields.label: 2-3-layered lissencephaly
fields.definition: "Pachygyria-agyria spectrum whereby at neuropathological examination the cortical plate consists of a two-three layered organization made up of a molecular layer, a relatively thin wavy layer with a higher cellular density and a third layer with lower cellularity." [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:28440899]

fields.label: Narrowing of medullary canal
