fields.label: Preimplantation lethality
fields.definition: "It is estimated that about 40-70 percent of human embryos produced in vitro fertilization (IVF) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) are viable embryos, whereas others arrest at different early stages of development. The phenotype of preimplantation lethality is inferred if IVF and ICSI cycles fail because all of an individual's embryos are arrested at early stages of development." [PMID:27545678]
fields.synonyms_concat: Early embryonic arrest; Preimplantation embryonic lethality

fields.label: Beta-aminoisobutyric aciduria
fields.definition: "An increased amount of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine. Beta-aminoisobutyric acid is a non-protein amino acid originating from the catabolism of thymine and valine." [PMID:30823446]

fields.label: Abnormal pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081)." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level

fields.label: Decreased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
fields.definition: "An reduced concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081)." []
synonyms: Decreased pituitary glycoprotein alpha subunit level
Decreased pituitary glycoprotein polypeptide alpha subunit level
fields.label_normalized: decreased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased pituitary glycoprotein alpha subunit level; Decreased pituitary glycoprotein polypeptide alpha subunit level

fields.label: Elevated fecal sodium
fields.definition: "An elevated concentration of sodium in feces." [PMID:26358773]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated faecal sodium

fields.label: Abnormal fecal osmolality
fields.definition: "Abnormal concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal faecal osmolality

fields.label: Elevated fecal osmolality
fields.definition: "Abnormally high concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated faecal osmolality

fields.label: Reduced fecal osmolality
fields.definition: "Abnormally low concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced faecal osmolality

fields.label: Abnormal fecal pH
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal pH of feces. The pH reflects the acidity or alkalinity of a solution on a logarithmic scale on which 7 is neutral, whereby lower values are more acid and higher values more alkaline." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal faecal pH

fields.label: Elevated fecal pH
fields.definition: "Abnormally high fecal pH, i.e., abnormal alkalinity of feces." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated faecal pH; Stool pH high

fields.label: Decreased fecal pH
fields.definition: "Abnormally low fecal pH, i.e., abnormal acidity of feces." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased faecal pH; Stool pH low

fields.label: Increased circulating argininosuccinic acid
fields.definition: "An increased level of the non-proteinogenic amino acid argininosuccinic acid in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:22241104]

fields.label: Anti-myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody positivity
fields.definition: "Presence of antibodies in the serum that react against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:28533781]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-MOG antibody positivity

fields.label: Elevated circulating trypsinogen concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of trypsinogen in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased immunoreactive trypsinogen

fields.label: Abnormal terminal:vellus ratio
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal proportion of terminal to vellus hairs." [PMID:12894995]

fields.label: Elevated terminal:vellus ratio
fields.definition: "An increased proportion of terminal hairs compared to vellus hairs." [PMID:23044568]

fields.label: Reduced terminal:vellus ratio
fields.definition: "A terminal:vellus ratio under 4:1 is characteristic of androgenetic alopecia." [PMID:23044568]

fields.label: Giant neutrophil granules
fields.definition: "The presence of abnormally large granules in neutrophils. This finding can be appreciated on a peripheral blood smear. The finding is characteristic of Chediak Higashi syndrome. The giant granules are derived from azurophil granules, whereas peroxidase-negative granules are not involved in their formation." [PMID:9665278]

fields.label: Exacerbated by tobacco use
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by smoking tobacco products." []
synonyms: Smoking or tobacco use exacerbates symptoms
fields.synonyms_concat: Aggravated by tobacco use; Exacerbated by smoking; Smoking or tobacco use exacerbates symptoms

fields.label: Exacerbated by contraceptive medication exposure
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by taking contraceptive medication." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Contraceptive pills aggravate symptoms

fields.label: Exacerbated by barbiturate exposure
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by taking barbituates." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Barbiturates produce worsening

fields.label: Ameliorated by ethanol ingestion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by drinking alcohol (ethanol)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ethanol reduces manifestations

fields.label: Lhermitte's sign
fields.definition: "An electric shock-like sensation that occurs on flexion of the neck. This sensation radiates down the spine, often into the legs, arms, and sometimes to the trunk." [PMID:26019410]
fields.synonyms_concat: Barber chair phenomenon; Lhermitte's phenomenon

fields.label: Hydrophobia
fields.definition: "The word hydrophobia has been used to describe the avoidance of drinking in the presence of hydrophobic spasms that can be observed in human rabies (described as a blockage in the throat with worsening of dyspnea). However, rarely, the same word has been used to describe panic reactions observed in a patient when offered a glass of water. This term does not refer to the latter meaning." [PMID:12121215, PMID:30564365]

fields.label: Alien limb phenomenon
fields.definition: "Alien limb phenomenon refers to involuntary motor activity of a limb in conjunction with the feeling of estrangement from that limb." [PMID:23572346]

fields.label: Labiomental fasciculations
fields.definition: "Fasciculations affecting the tongue muscle and the musculature of the chin." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Fasciculations, labiomental

fields.label: Polyembolokoilamania
fields.definition: "Habitual insertion of foreign bodies into bodily orifices." [PMID:22690353]

fields.label: Onychotillomania
fields.definition: "Onychotillomania is characterized by the compulsive or irresistible urge in patients to pick at, pull off, or harmfully bite or chew their nails." []

fields.label: Tendon pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to a tendon." []

fields.label: Superiorly positioned umbilicus
fields.definition: "The position of the umbilicus (belly button) is abnormally high (superior)." []

fields.label: Four-vessel umbilical cord
fields.definition: "Four-vessel umbilical cord containing two arteries and two veins." [PMID:21391749]

fields.label: Supernumerary lacrimal punctum
fields.definition: "A congenital developmental anomaly characterized by the presence of an additional lacrimal punctum in an eyelid." [PMID:19875171, PMID:25943682]
fields.synonyms_concat: Accessory puncta; Double lacrimal puncta; Double punctum; Lacrimal punctum, duplication; Punctum reduplication; Supernumerary punctum

fields.label: Deep dermatophytosis
fields.definition: "A type of invasive dermatophyte infection of the deep dermis characterized by extensive dermal infiltration by fungal elements." [PMID:20092423]

fields.label: Invasive dermatophyte infection
fields.definition: "Infection that extends deeply into the dermis by dermatophytes, fungi that typically cause different types of superficial infection (tinea) or skin, hair, or nails." [PMID:20092423]

fields.label: Majocchi's granuloma
fields.definition: "Majocchi's granuloma (MG) is an inflammatory and granulomatous, dermatophytic infection characterized by a granulomatous inflammation around the hair follicle. Histopathologically, MG demonstrates a nodular perifollicular granulomatous infiltrate of lymphoid cells, macrophages, epithelioid cells, multinucleated giant cells, and neutrophils. Unlike superficial dermatophytoses, fungal hyphae and spores can be detected not only on the surface of the epidermis but also within or around the hair follicles." [PMID:22435879, PMID:29861637]

fields.label: Disseminated dermatophytosis
fields.definition: "A type of invasive dermatophyte infection characterized by vascular involvement and dissemination to other organs." [PMID:20092423, PMID:29861637]

fields.label: Increased Burr cell count
fields.definition: "Burr cells, also known as echinocytes, have a speculated border over the entire cell surface. Burr cells are commonly found in both end-stage renal disease and liver disease. Small numbers of Burr cells are commonly found in healthy individuals." [PMID:5614071]

fields.label: Masseter muscular weakness
fields.definition: "Reduced strength of the masseter muscle, whose primary function is to elevate the mandible and thereby raise the mandible towards the maxilla, closing the jaw." []

fields.label: Self hugging
fields.definition: "Involuntary, tic-like movements consisted of crossing both arms across the chest and tensing the body or clasping the hands and squeezing the arms to the sides. The movements last a few seconds and may occur in series or flurries, generally accompanied by facial grimacing and occasional grunting." [PMID:8132119]
fields.synonyms_concat: Spasmodic upper-body squeeze

fields.label: Ameliorated by immunosuppresion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with immunosuppresive medication." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Immunosupressive therapy improves condition

fields.label: Tendon thickening
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the thickness (diameter) of a tendon." [PMID:24932450]

fields.label: Long thumb
fields.definition: "Length of the thumb is greater than normal." [PMID:7246605]

fields.label: Exacerbated by acetylcholinesterase inhibitor exposure
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor such as tensilon (edrophonium) or pyridostigmine (Mestinon)." []

fields.label: Ameliorated by acetylcholinesterase inhibitor
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor such as mestinon or tensilon." []

fields.label: Inferiorly positioned umbilicus
fields.definition: "The position of the umbilicus (belly button) is abnormally low (inferior)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Low set umbilicus; Low-set umbilicus

fields.label: Elevated urinary 4-hydroxybutyric acid
fields.definition: "An increased amount of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine." []

fields.label: Decreased tissue succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
fields.definition: "Reduced level of succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase (SSADH)." [PMID:25485164]
synonyms: Decreased succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
Decreased succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase leukocyte activity
fields.label_normalized: decreased tissue succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts; Decreased succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase leukocyte activity; Decreased succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase level

fields.label: Elevated CSF gamma-aminobutyric acid concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) high in CSF

fields.label: Elevated CSF 4-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased level of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." [PMID:25485164]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated CSF gamma-hydroxybutyric acid; Elevated CSF GHB levels

fields.label: Elevated circulating acetone concentration
fields.definition: "An increased level of acetone in the blood circulation. Acetone is one of the predominant ketone bodies." [PMID:28278308]

fields.label: Exacerbated by methylxanthine ingestion
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by ingestion of food containing a methylxanthine compound (for instance, coffee, caffeine, chocolate)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Methylxanthines produce worsening

fields.label: Cervical (neck)
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the neck." []

fields.label: Increased number of lymph nodes
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated number of lymph nodes in an anatomical region." [PMID:20301630]

fields.label: Delayed fracture healing
fields.definition: "A delay in healing of a fracture past the expected duration." [PMID:24857030]

fields.label: Pretibial dimple
fields.definition: "A groove or crease on the shins (pretibial, i.e., over the shin bone). Pretibial creases may be obvious at birth and may range from 3 cm to over 15 cm in length and lengthen as the limb grows. They appear as an elongated dimple because of the attachment of skin to underlying tissue (e.g., to the tibia). The dimple or crease grows in proportion to the growth of the leg." [PMID:23444103]

fields.label: Joint extensor surface localization
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in extensor surface of the joint. The extensor surface refers to the skin on the opposite side of a joint." []

fields.label: Joint flexor surface localization
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in flexor surface of the joint. The flexor surface refers to the skin that touches when a joint is bent (flexed)." []

fields.label: Knuckle pad
fields.definition: "Knuckle pads are benign fibrofatty subcutaneous pads located over the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints that can be mistaken for arthritis. Rarely they affect the dorsal aspect of the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints. Clinically they are painless and often affect both hands in an asymmetrical pattern." [PMID:26672439]
synonyms: Knuckle pads on dorsal aspect of finger joints
fields.synonyms_concat: DDN; Dorsal dupuytren nodules; Knuckle pads on dorsal aspect of finger joints

fields.label: Exacerbated by pregnancy
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by being pregnant." []

fields.label: Lithoptysis
fields.definition: "Expectoration (coughing up) of a broncholith. Broncholithiasis is defined as the presence of calculi in the tracheobronchial tree. It is a rare disease but can be characterized by clinical and radiological findings of a calcified lymph node eroding bronchial wall and opening into the bronchial lumen." [PMID:23949189, PMID:29970776]

fields.label: Predominant small joint localization
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that mainly affects the small joints, including fingers, toes, interphalangeal, metacarpophalangeal, metatarsophalangeal, wrists, ankles, vertebrae, and neck." []

fields.label: Abdominal rigidity
fields.definition: "Involuntary tightening of the abdominal musculature that occurs in response to touching the abdomen to avoid pain. Rigidity can occur in the presence of abdominal inflammation and usually involves only the inflamed area." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Rigid abdomen

fields.label: Abdominal guarding
fields.definition: "A voluntary contraction of the abdominal wall musculature to avoid pain." []

fields.label: Low intraocular pressure
fields.definition: "An abnormal decrease of the pressure within the eye." [PMID:26253854]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ocular hypotony

fields.label: Increased placental thickness
fields.definition: "Abnormally elevated placental thickness." [PMID:25077064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Placental thickness increased

fields.label: Persistent asymmetrical tonic neck reflex
fields.definition: "Persistence beyond the normal age (roughly the first half of the first year of life) of the asymmetric tonic neck reflex (ATNR), which is an easily elicited primitive reflex in the immediate newborn period. The ATNR refers to the phenomenon whereby when the face of an infant is turned to one side, the ipsilateral arm and leg extend and the contralateral arm and leg flex. This posture has been compared to a typical posture of fencers." [PMID:441119]
synonyms: Tonic neck reflex asymmetrical and persistent
fields.synonyms_concat: Persistent fencer's reflex; Tonic neck reflex asymmetrical and persistent

fields.label: Howell-Jolly bodies
fields.definition: "Howell-Jolly bodies are small, intra-erythrocytic remnants of erythrocyte nuclei. These inclusions are solitary in each erythrocyte and strongly basophilic. These are often confused with overlying platelets, but can be distinguished by the presence of a halo around overlying platelets." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:21250106, PMID:26331020]

fields.label: Hemorrhoids
fields.definition: "Enlarged, bulging blood vessels in and around the anus often associated with rectal bleeding, itching, and pain." [PMID:21766771]
fields.synonyms_concat: Haemorrhoids; Piles

fields.label: Abnormal pulse
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the rhythmic throbbing of an artery that reflects the widening of the artery as blood flows through it and is caused by successive contractions of the heart." []

fields.label: Weak pulse
fields.definition: "A diminution in the amplitude (strength) of the pulse such that the examiner has difficulty feeling the pulse." []

fields.label: Absent pulse
fields.definition: "The pulsation of an artery where the pulse is taken (e.g. the radial artery at the wrist) cannot be detected on physical examination." []

fields.label: Bounding pulse
fields.definition: "Increased amplitude (strength) of the pulse." []

fields.label: Circumoral cyanosis
fields.definition: "Persistent blue color of the skin that surrounds the mouth." [PMID:2797223]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bluish around mouth

fields.label: History of bone marrow transplant
fields.definition: "A past medical history of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation involving myeloablative chemoradiotherapy followed by stem cell rescue with autologous or human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-matched stem cells derived from a donor." [PMID:24198516]
synonyms: Status post haematopoietic stem cell transplantation
Status post hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
fields.synonyms_concat: Status post haematopoietic stem cell transplantation; Status post hematopoietic stem cell transplantation

fields.label: Absent sperm flagella
fields.definition: "Sperm cells lacking flagella." [PMID:30867909]

fields.label: Short sperm flagella
fields.definition: "Sperm cells with abnormally short flagella." [PMID:30867909]

fields.label: Coiled sperm flagella
fields.definition: "Sperm cells whose flagella are twisted (coiled)." [PMID:28552195]

fields.label: Microcephalic sperm head
fields.definition: "Decreased size of the head of sperm." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Small-head sperm

fields.label: Tapered sperm head
fields.definition: "Sperm with cigar-shaped heads that gradually dimish in diameter (taper)." [PMID:28692759]

fields.label: Dacryocytosis
fields.definition: "Presence of teardrop-shaped red blood cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:21250106]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dacryocytes; Tear-drop shaped erythrocytes

fields.label: Ileitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the ileum." [PMID:20532706]
fields.synonyms_concat: Inflammation of the ileum

fields.label: Oval macrocytosis
fields.definition: "Enlarged, oval-shaped erythrocytes (red blood cells)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:16988104, PMID:19202968, PMID:28821482]

fields.label: Lipiduria
fields.definition: "An increased lipid content in the urine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:26124059, PMID:29950951]
fields.synonyms_concat: Urinary lipid excretion

fields.label: Urinary mulberry cells
fields.definition: "Distal tubular epithelial cells in which globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) has accumulated. they are the characteristic feature of Fabry disease. Urinary mulberry bodies are a component of mulberry cells that can be distinguished easily from fat particles by their inner lamellar appearance." [PMID:28593486]

fields.label: Temporal bossing
fields.definition: "Prominence (bulging) in the temple region, which is the part of the skull where the frontal, parietal, temporal, and sphenoid bones join on the side of the head." []

fields.label: Pontine ischemic lacunes
fields.definition: "Lacunes are infarcts less than 15 mm in diameter in the cortical white matter or in the corona radiata, internal capsule, centrum semiovale, thalamus, basal ganglia, or pons." [PMID:16324092]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pontine ischaemic lacunes

fields.label: Increased oocyte death
fields.definition: "An increase in death of oocytes, the female germ cell (egg cell), which can be observed clinically in the setting of in vitro fertilization." [PMID:30918116]

fields.label: Abnormal urinary nucleobase concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal level of a nucleobase in the urine. Nucleobases are nitrogen-containing biological compounds that form nucleosides: adenine (A), cytosine (C), guanine (G), thymine (T), and uracil (U)." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary cytidine
fields.definition: "Increased levels of urinary cytidine, a pyrimidine nucleoside in which cytosine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N1 glycosidic bond." [PMID:30847922]

fields.label: Elevated urinary uridine level
fields.definition: "Increased levels of urinary uridine, a ribonucleoside composed of a molecule of uracil attached to a ribofuranose moiety via a beta-N1 glycosidic bond." [PMID:30847922]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated uridine in urine

fields.label: Decreased circulating 12-HETE
fields.definition: "A reduction in the concentration of 12-HETE in the blood circulation, a metabolite of arachidonic acid." [PMID:25102815]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating 12-Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acid concentration

fields.label: Intracellular accumulation of Dol-PP-GlcNAc2Man5
fields.definition: "Intracellular accumulation of the lipid-linked oligosaccharide intermediate Man5GlcNAc2-PP-dolichol." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:10581255, PMID:16053906, PMID:28575298]

fields.label: Clonal T cell receptor rearrangement
fields.definition: "Presence of a predominant T cell clone. In PCR-based assays, this finding is inferred on the basis of one or two prominent bands within a valid size range. In NGS-based assays, this finding is inferred on the basis of a high number of reads that map to a single T cell receptor clone." [PMID:24688753]

fields.label: Third ventricle colloid cyst
fields.definition: "An epithelial lined cyst filled with gelatinous material. The gelatinous material commonly contains mucin, old blood, cholesterol, and ions. Most colloid cysts identified are currently asymptomatic and identified incidentally on imaging. When a colloid cyst does cause issues, it most commonly causes obstructive hydrocephalus." [PMID:30542631]

fields.label: Vascular hamartoma
fields.definition: "A benign focal growth composed of vascular tissue." [NCIT:C3438]

fields.label: Abnormal bulbus cordis morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structure of the bulbus cordis, which is the single outflow tract of the heart during early embryogenesis." [PMID:25274757]

fields.label: Abnormal renal insterstitial morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the interstitium of the kidney. The renal interstitium is defined as the intertubular, extraglomerular, extravascular space of the kidney. It is bounded on all sides by tubular and vascular basement membranes and is filled with cells, extracellular matrix, and interstitial fluid." [PMID:25813241]

fields.label: Renal interstitial foam cells
fields.definition: "Accumulation of foam cells (FC) in the interstitium of the kidney. Renal FCs display phenotypic characteristics of macrophages and belong to the monocyte/macrophage lineage. Histologically, renal FCs are characterized by round cells with small nuclei and an abundant PAS-positive cytoplasm with lipid-containing vacuoles." [PMID:19672113, PMID:25887903]

fields.label: Renal interstitial neutrophil infiltration
fields.definition: "Increased numbers of neutrophils in the interstitial tissues of the kidney." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Renal interstitial eosinophil infiltration
fields.definition: "Increased numbers of eosinophils in the interstitial tissues of the kidney." [PMID:10052481, PMID:20336051]

fields.label: Renal interstitial plasma cell infiltration
fields.definition: "Increased numbers of plasma cells in the interstitial tissues of the kidney." [PMID:28904438]

fields.label: Renal interstitial calcium oxalate
fields.definition: "The presence of birefringent calcium- and oxalate deposits in interstitial cells of the kidney." [PMID:23221343]

fields.label: Hand apraxia
fields.definition: "Inability to perform purposeful (learned) movements with the hand upon command, even though the command is understood and there is a willingness to perform the movement. Hand apraxia includes the inability to grasp, pick up, and hold large and small objects." [PMID:20345957]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lack of purposeful hand use

fields.label: Renal lymphocytic tubulitis
fields.definition: "Infiltration of the renal tubular epithelium by lymphocytes." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Renal neutrophilic tubulitis
fields.definition: "Infiltration of the renal tubular epithelium by neutrophils." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Renal interstitial hemosiderin
fields.definition: "Deposition of hemosiderin (a golden-brown, granular pigment derived from ferritin) in interstitial cells of the kidney." [PMID:26491580]

fields.label: Aplasia of the right hemidiaphragm
fields.definition: "Congenital absence of the right-sided diaphragm." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Right diaphragmatic hernia

fields.label: Myoglobin casts
fields.definition: "A type of acelluar casts with positive myoglobin staining A that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented." [PMID:28398539]

fields.label: Renal tubular basement membrane denudation
fields.definition: "Naked basement membranes without tubular epithelium." [PMID:29875323]
fields.synonyms_concat: Denuded tubular basement membrane

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell detachment
fields.definition: "Tubular cross section with a space between the basolateral aspect of tubular epithelium and its basement membrane; classified as global when at least 2/3 circumference of the tubular cross section are involved and segmental when less than 2/3 are involved." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell cytoplasmic vacuolization
fields.definition: "Tubular cross section with intracytoplasmic vacuoles in at least one tubular epithelial cell. This feature is classified as isometric when vacuoles are round and similar in size and coarse when vacuoles were not round in shape or varied in size." [PMID:29537990]
fields.label_normalized: renal tubular epithelial cell cytoplasmic vacuolization

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell sloughing
fields.definition: "At least one free floating cell in the tubular lumen without attachment to adjacent cells or basement membrane in a tubular cross section without detachment. These cells must not aggregate into a tubular shape and completely fill the lumen, if so, it should be classified as a cast." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Blebbing of apical cytoplasm of renal tubular epithelial cells
fields.definition: "Tubular cross section with round/irregular cytoplasmic protrusion, shaped like the Greek capital letter Omega (or it may be more vertically elongated Omega), pinched off from apical membrane without apparent closure of the lumen, involving over 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section. The feature can be further classified into proximal or distal tubule." [PMID:29537990]
fields.label_normalized: blebbing of apical cytoplasm of renal tubular epithelial cells

fields.label: Abnormal renal tubular epithelial morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the renal tubular epithelial cells (RTEC), a layer of cells in the outer layer of the renal tubule. These cells play a role in the absorption of substances such as glucose and amino from the primary urine." []

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell hyaline droplets
fields.definition: "Tubular epithelium with round strongly PAS-positive cytoplasmic droplet material in at least one tubular epithelial cell." [PMID:29537990]
fields.label_normalized: renal tubular epithelial cell hyaline droplets

fields.label: Multinucleation of renal tubular epithelial cells
fields.definition: "Tubular epithelial cells with greater than 3 nuclei in a single epithelial cell, often overlapping with each other in a single plane of view." [PMID:29537990]
fields.label_normalized: multinucleation of renal tubular epithelial cells

fields.label: Prominent nucleoli of renal tubular epithelial cells
fields.definition: "Tubular epithelium with nucleoli clearly visible at 100-fold magnification." [PMID:29537990]
fields.label_normalized: prominent nucleoli of renal tubular epithelial cells

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell simplification
fields.definition: "Tubular cross section with flattened tubular cell cytoplasm (height unequivocally less than width), with complete loss of brush border involving greater than 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section, resulting in an apparent increase in the size of the lumen, without the presence of casts." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell mitosis
fields.definition: "Tubular epithelial cells in any mitotic phase, identified by distinctively visible chromosome in either prophase, metaphase, anaphase or telophase configuration." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: High renal tubular epithelial cell N/C ratio
fields.definition: "At least one tubular epithelial cell with average sized cytoplasmic area and a nuclear area 3 times greater than average sized nuclei." [PMID:29537990]
synonyms: High N/C ratio of renal tubular epithelial cells
fields.label_normalized: high renal tubular epithelial cell n/c ratio
fields.synonyms_concat: High N/C ratio of renal tubular epithelial cells

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial lipofuscin
fields.definition: "Presence of increased amount of lipofuscin, a yellow, granular cytoplasmic pigment in the renal tubules." [PMID:31076149]

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell swelling
fields.definition: "Tubular cross section lined entirely by tubular epithelium with convex apical cell membrane (i.e., cells are shaped like an upside down U, and lack a distinct smaller protrusion seen in blebbing as defined above) resulting in apparent complete closure of the lumen." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Thyroidization-type tubular atrophy
fields.definition: "A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by a thyroid-like appearance, with small round tubules with markedly flattened, simplified epithelium and uniform intratubular casts." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:27211375]

fields.label: Endocrine-type tubular atrophy
fields.definition: "A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by endocrine-like appearance of tubules, which are small and have narrow lumina, clear cells, and relatively thin basement membranes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:27211375, PMID:7906246]
fields.synonyms_concat: Endocrinization pattern of tubular atrophy; Renal tubular atrophy, endocrine-type

fields.label: Tubulointerstitial mycobacterial infiltration
fields.definition: "Renal tubulointerstitial infiltration of mycobacteria identified on acid-fast or Fite stains. Can be associated with granulomatous inflammation." [PMID:23303798]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal tubulointerstitial mycobacterial organisms

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell hemosiderin
fields.definition: "Tubular epithelial cells containing cytoplasmic hemosiderin, brown-golden granular pigment." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:25441434, PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Triphalangeal hallux
fields.definition: "A hallux (big toe) with three phalanges in a single, proximo-distal axis." [PMID:19760621, PMID:22486404]

fields.label: Renal interstitial amyloid deposits
fields.definition: "Deposition of amyloid in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Amyloid is is made up of 10 nm (on average) fibrils that are most commonly composed of monoclonal light chains (AL), transthyretin (TTR), amd LECT2, or occur in the setting of long standing systemic inflammation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:25852856]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal interstitial amyloid; Renal interstitial amyloid deposition; Renal interstitial amyloidosis

fields.label: Renal glomerular amyloid deposition
fields.definition: "Amyloid deposits located in the glomeruli in a focal segmental, diffuse segmental or diffuse global fashion. This abnormality can be accompanied by mesangial involvement and in later stages also involvement of the peripheral capillaries." [PMID:21427073]

fields.label: Abnormal diffusion weighted cerebral MRI morphology
fields.definition: "A diffusion abnormality observed in diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain. Molecular diffusion refers to the notion that any type of molecule in a fluid (eg, water) is randomly displaced as the molecule is agitated by thermal energy. Restricted diffusion of water appears bright on diffusion-weighted images." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7440-8864, PMID:11058626]
synonyms: Diffusion weighted magnetic resonance imaging (DWI) abnormality
MRI diffusion abnormality of the cerebrum
fields.label_normalized: abnormal diffusion weighted cerebral mri morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Diffusion weighted imaging (DWI) abnormality; Diffusion weighted magnetic resonance imaging (DWI) abnormality; MRI diffusion abnormality of the cerebrum

fields.label: Renal interstitial immunoglobulin deposits
fields.definition: "Accumulation of an immunoglobulin in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. The immunoglobulin may be a monoclonal Ig or the corresponding heavy-chain (HC) or light-chain (LC) subunit. By convention this definition excludes Ig-derived amyloidosis (amyloidosis can be distinguished by its affinity for Congo red staining)." [PMID:11423587, PMID:28509073]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal interstitial immunoglobulin deposition

fields.label: Renal interstitial hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A focal collection of 20 or more red blood cells within the interstitium, that is irregular in shape (i.e., collections do not conform to the shape of tubules or capillary networks), without surrounding endothelium or tubular epithelium, and is in an area of intact core." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:20709744, PMID:29537990]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal interstitial haemorrhage

fields.label: Renal necrosis
fields.definition: "Cell death (necrosis) affecting one or more parts of the kidney." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal parenchymal necrosis

fields.label: Perinephric abscess
fields.definition: "A perinephric abscess is a collection of suppurative material in the perinephric space (i.e., the connective and adipose tissues surrounding the kidney)." []

fields.label: Intrarenal abscess
fields.definition: "An encapsulated collection of pus and necrotic material within the renal parenchyma. The destruction of renal parenchyma is associated with suppurative/neutrophil-rich inflammation and necrosis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:27998164]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal abscess; Renal parenchymal abscess

fields.label: Hyperchromasia of renal tubular epithelial cells
fields.definition: "At least one tubular cross section with all tubular epithelial nuclei having a chromatin pattern resembling normal mature lymphocytes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29537990]
synonyms: Condensed chromatin of renal tubular epithelial cells
fields.label_normalized: hyperchromasia of renal tubular epithelial cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Condensed chromatin of renal tubular epithelial cells

fields.label: Tubular luminal dilatation
fields.definition: "Dilatation (expansion beyond the normal dimension) of the cavity (lumen) of tubules of the kidney. The tubular cross section displays an attenuated brush border (apical PAS positivity greater than 10 percent of the normal expected height, but unequivocally less than normal expected height), resulting in an apparent increase in the size of lumen." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29537990]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tubular ectasia

fields.label: Renal intratubular casts
fields.definition: "Urinary casts are formed in the distal convoluted tubule or the collecting duct by solidification of protein in the lumen of the kidney tubules. This term refers to casts located within the tubuli of the kidney. More precisely, casts are defined as a material that completely fills and expands the tubular lumen with simplification of surrounding tubular epithelium. Casts are classified as either nuclear debris/granular brown material, red blood cell, white blood cell, myeloma, or myoglobin cast." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29537990]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tubular casts

fields.label: Intratubular bilirubin casts
fields.definition: "A type of acelluar intratubular casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. On H&E (red brown), PAS (amaranth purple), trichrome (red with ragged contours), Hall (olive-emerald green)." [PMID:28398539]

fields.label: Intratubular erythrocyte cast
fields.definition: "Casts that contain red blood cells and are located within the tubuli of the kidney." [PMID:21959738]

fields.label: Intratubular vancomycin casts
fields.definition: "Intratubular casts composed of vancomycin aggregates and uromodulin." []

fields.label: Intratubular leukocyte casts
fields.definition: "Casts that contain white blood cells and are located within the tubuli of the kidney." []

fields.label: Intratubular dihydroxyadenuria crystals
fields.definition: "Intratubular crystals composed of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine are small needle-shaped brownish crystals that are highly birefringent under polarized light and black by Jones methenamine silver." [PMID:20064951]

fields.label: Intratubular light-chain casts
fields.definition: "The presence of casts containing immunoglobulin light chains within the lumina of the renal tubules." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:26916380]

fields.label: Intratubular hemoglobin casts
fields.definition: "A type of acelluar intratubular casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented. On H&E (red granular), PAS (purple), trichrome (red granular), Hall (yellow brown). Stain positively for Hemoglobin A." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:25441434]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intratubular haemoglobin casts

fields.label: Renal papillary necrosis
fields.definition: "Premature death of cells in the renal papilla (the apex of a renal pyramid which projects into the cavity of a calyx of the kidney and through which collecting ducts discharge urine). Histologically, one observes pale tissue with typical appearance of coagulative necrosis, affecting the renal papillae. Necrosis can be identified by pyknotic nuclei and simplified, flattened epithelium of proximal tubules. The tubular and glomerular basement membranes are still visible without viable nuclei." [PMID:28584810]

fields.label: Intratubular hyaline casts
fields.definition: "A type of acellular urinary cast located within the distal tubules of the kidney and that is composed only of Tamm-Horsfall glycoprotein. Correspondingly, these casts have a low refractive index. Hyaline casts may display a spectrum of morphologies, which includes fluffy, compact, convoluted or wrinkled casts. Hyaline casts have a smooth texture and usually have parallel sides with clear margins and blunted ends." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:393892]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intratubular Tamm-Horsfall (uromodulin) casts

fields.label: Intratubular myoglobin cast
fields.definition: "Casts located within the tubuli of the kidney and that contain myoglobin. Myoglobin casts are composed of round granules that may line up in chains or aggregate in clusters. Their color ranges from pink to red-brown with hematoxylin and eosin stain, light brown to black with Jones methenamine silver stain, pink to bright magenta with periodic acid-Schiff stain, and bright red with trichrome stain. Immunoperoxidase staining with antibody to myoglobin is stronglypositive in the casts.Electron microscopy shows globular casts with an electron-dense core and a somewhat less-intense periphery. Substructure is absent. This feature may be accompanied by acute tubular injury with variable flattening of tubular epithelial cells, loss of brush borders, and intratubular sloughed epithelial cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:28115066, PMID:29942498]

fields.label: Tubulointerstitial microganismal infiltration
fields.definition: "Infiltration of microorganisms into renal tubulointerstitial tissues as observed by appropriate staining procedures, e.g., bacteria on a bacterial stain (Brown and Hopps) or fungi on PAS or silver stain." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Tubulointerstitial viral infiltration
fields.definition: "Infiltration of viruses into renal tubulointerstitial tissues as demonstrated on renal biopsy by viral inclusions which can be seen on routine stains or with immunohistochemistry." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal tubulointerstitial viral inclusions

fields.label: Renal interstitial edema
fields.definition: "Edema is characterized but the acute swelling of the stroma, with expansion of the interstitial space without the a concurrent increase in interstitial cells or extracellular matrix. Histologically this change is appreciated as interstitial areas of lower optical density." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:24454932]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal interstitial oedema

fields.label: Elevated urine mevalonic acid level
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased amount of mevanolate in the urine. Mevanolate is that hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of mevalonic acid." [PMID:3680522]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urine mevalonate; Elevated urine mevalonate levels; Elevated urine mevalonic acid; Mevalonate aciduria

fields.label: Elevated leukocyte cystine
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of cystine within white blood cells." [PMID:27102039, PMID:31892015]

fields.label: Elevated circulating CCL18 level
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of C-C motif chemokine ligand 18 in the blood circulation." [PMID:15784687]
synonyms: Increased C-C motif chemokine ligand 18 concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased C-C motif chemokine ligand 18 concentration

fields.label: Renal interstitial granulomas
fields.definition: "Interstital aggregates of histiciocytes, occasionally multinucleated with associated lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined and multinucleated giant cells may be present." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:26413275]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal interstitial granulomata

fields.label: Renal interstitial necrotizing granulomas
fields.definition: "An organized collection of histiocytes (specifically macrophages) localized in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Through light microscopy, the activated histiocytes appear as epithelioid cells with round to oval nuclei, often with irregular contours and abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders. They may also coalesce to form multinucleated giant cells. Granulomas may be associated with a peripheral cuff of lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined. Granulomas can present as necrotizing or non-necrotizing. Microscopically, necrotizing granulomas distinctly have central necrosis with a palisaded lymphohistiocytic reaction and a cuff of chronic inflammation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:31723695]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal interstitial necrotizing granulomata

fields.label: Renal interstitial non-necrotizing granulomas
fields.definition: "Interstital aggregates of histiciocytes, occasionally multinucleated with associated lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined and multinucleated giant cells may be present with no necrosis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.synonyms_concat: Renal interstitial non-necrotizing granulomata

fields.label: Renal interstitial deposits
fields.definition: "Abnormal accumulation of a metabolite, protein, or protein-derived substance in the interstitial region of the kidney." []

fields.label: Renal interstitial mononuclear cell infiltration
fields.definition: "Presence of interstitial mononuclear leukocytes, i.e., white blood ceclls with a single round nucleus, including lymphocytes and monocytes but not including granulocytes (which have multilobed nuclei)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Renal interstitial xanthogranulomatous inflammation
fields.definition: "Inflammation of interstitial tissues of the kidney consisting of foamy macrophages admixed with plasma cells, lymphocytes and neutrophils and occasional giant cells." [PMID:21526966]

fields.label: Renal tubular epithelial cell apoptosis
fields.definition: "Increased apoptosis (programmed cell death) of tubular epithelial cells. The cells are rounded with increased eosinophilia and contain fragmented, densely basophilic nuclear debris." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Tubularization of Bowman capsule
fields.definition: "The presence of cuboidal to columnar epithelium (height greater than width) lining the Bowman capsule, in an absence of adjacent segmental sclerosis, crescents, or collapsing variant of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis; scored as present or absent in at least one glomerulus." [PMID:29537990]

fields.label: Skewfoot
fields.definition: "A type of flat-foot characterized by hindfoot abductovalgus, metatarsus adductus, and Achilles tendon shortening. The predominant radiographic findings include forefoot adduction with lateral subluxation of the navicular on the talus and heel valgus. Very abnormal shoe wear is noted on the medial side. Calluses occur under the metatarsal heads and the head of the plantar-flexed talus." [PMID:9916191]
fields.synonyms_concat: Skew foot; Skew-foot

fields.label: Elevated CSF glial fibrillary acidic protein concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of glial fibrillary acidic protein in cerebrospinal fluid." [PMID:31892365]
synonyms: Elevated CSF glial fibrillary acidic protein level
fields.label_normalized: elevated csf glial fibrillary acidic protein concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated CSF glial fibrillary acidic protein level

fields.label: Elevated CSF chitinase-3-like protein 1 concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of chitinase-3-like protein 1 in cerebrospinal fluid." [PMID:31892365]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated CSF chitinase-3-like protein 1 level

fields.label: Elevated CSF chitotriosidase 1 concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of chitotriosidase 1 in cerebrospinal fluid." [PMID:31892365]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated CSF chitotriosidase 1 level

fields.label: Elevated lactate:pyruvate ratio
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the molar ratio of lactate to pyruvate in the blood circulation." [PMID:28088395]

fields.label: Impaired flow-mediated arterial dilatation
fields.definition: "Flow-mediated dilatation is a noninvasive tests of endothelial function that leverages ultrasound to measure arterial diameter and its response to an increase in shear stress, which normally causes endothelium-dependent dilatation. This term pertains to an abnormal reduction in the magnitude of dilatation. Flow-mediated dilatation is usually measured at the brachial artery." [PMID:11069434]
fields.synonyms_concat: Endothelial dysfunction

fields.label: Decreased adipose tissue tocopherol level
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration of tocopherol in fat tissue." [PMID:27520363]

fields.label: Febrile status epilepticus
fields.definition: "A seizure lasting 30 minutes without fully regaining consciousness, provoked by fever (temperature greater than 38.0 degrees Celcius) at the time of seizure-onset, without a prior history of afebrile seizure and with no evidence of an acute central nervous system infection or insult." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:22742587, PMID:24502379, PMID:26336950]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fever-induced status epilepticus

fields.label: Elevated circulating lyso-globotriaosylsphingosine concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the level of globotriaosylsphingosine (Lyso-Gb3) in the blood circulation." [PMID:29288396, PMID:30875019]

fields.label: Status epilepticus with prominent motor symptoms
fields.definition: "Status epilepticus with prominent motor signs during the prolonged seizure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]
fields.label_normalized: status epilepticus with prominent motor symptoms

fields.label: Non-convulsive status epilepticus with coma
fields.definition: "A type of status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms and in the presence of coma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]
fields.synonyms_concat: Subtle status epilepticus

fields.label: Convulsive status epilepticus
fields.definition: "A type of status epilepticus characterized by a prolonged bilateral tonic-clonic seizure, or repeated bilateral tonic-clonic seizures without recovery between." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:22528274, PMID:26336950, PMID:26900382, PMID:9924914]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tonic-clonic status epilepticus

fields.label: Generalized convulsive status epilepticus
fields.definition: "A type of bilateral convulsive seizure of generalized onset that is sufficiently prolonged (or repeated without recovery) to reach the threshold for status epilepticus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]
fields.synonyms_concat: Generalised convulsive status epilepticus

fields.label: Focal-onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
fields.definition: "A type of bilateral convulsive seizure of focal onset (which could be with awareness or impaired awareness, either motor or non- motor) that is sufficiently prolonged (or repeated without recovery) to reach the threshold for status epilepticus." [PMID:26336950]
synonyms: Focal onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
Focal-onset seizure evolving into generalised convulsive status epilepticus
Focal-onset seizure evolving into generalized convulsive status epilepticus
Partial onset seizure evolving into convulsive status epilepticus
Partial-onset seizure evolving into convulsive status epilepticus
fields.label_normalized: focal-onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus; Focal-onset seizure evolving into generalised convulsive status epilepticus; Focal-onset seizure evolving into generalized convulsive status epilepticus; Partial onset seizure evolving into convulsive status epilepticus; Partial-onset seizure evolving into convulsive status epilepticus; Secondarily generalised convulsive status epilepticus; Secondarily generalised tonic-clonic status epilepticus; Secondarily generalized convulsive status epilepticus; Secondarily generalized tonic-clonic status epilepticus

fields.label: Focal motor status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Status epilepticus with focal motor signs originating within networks limited to one hemisphere. Involves musculature in any form. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Adversive status epilepticus
fields.definition: "A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by continuous neck or body rotation and conjugate gaze deviation in a direction contralateral to the responsible epileptic focus. This includes some forms of tonic status epilepticus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Repeated focal motor seizures
fields.definition: "A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repeated motor, typically clonic events repeatedly affecting the same segments of the body with spread of clonic movements through contiguous body parts unilaterally, and repeating over a sufficiently prolonged period to reach a diagnosis of status epilepticus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:21070217, PMID:26336950]
fields.synonyms_concat: Jacksonian status epilepticus

fields.label: Hyperkinetic status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Status epilepticus characterized by continuous hyperkinetic proximal limb or axial muscles producing irregular sequential ballistic movements such as pedaling pelvic thrusting, thrashing, or rocking movements." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Myoclonic status epilepticus
fields.definition: "A type of motor status epilepticus with repeating bilateral sudden brief (less than 100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Myoclonic status epilepticus without coma
fields.definition: "A type of myoclonic status epilepticus in the absence of coma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Myoclonic status epilepticus with coma
fields.definition: "A type of myoclonic status epilepticus in the presence of coma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Tonic status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Tonic status epilepticus is a type of status epilepticus characterized by focal or bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, which may be electrographically generalized or focal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
fields.definition: "A type of status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms in the absence of coma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Autonomic status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Autonomic status epilepticus is a type of non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma with prominent autonomic features regardless of whether it is electrographically generalized or focal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
fields.definition: "Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically focal. It is a prolonged focal non-motor seizure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]
fields.label_normalized: focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma

fields.label: Cutaneous wound
fields.definition: "A cutaneous wound is a defined as a disruption of normal anatomic structure and function of the skin that occurs owing to an injury of the skin. Wound healing is a dynamic, interactive process involving soluble mediators, blood cells, extracellularmatrix, and parenchymal cells. Wound healing has three phases: inflammation, tissue formation, and tissue remodeling, that overlap in time." [PMID:10471461]
fields.synonyms_concat: Skin wound

fields.label: Acute cutaneous wound
fields.definition: "A cutaneous wound that is proceeding through an orderly and timely reparative process that results in sustained restoration of the anatomic and functional integrity of the skin." [PMID:30475656]

fields.label: Chronic cutaneous wound
fields.definition: "A cutaneous wound that has failed to proceed through the orderly and timely process to produce an atomic and functional integrity, or proceeded through the repair process without establishing a sustained anatomic and functional result." [PMID:8166487]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chronic nonhealing cutaneous wound

fields.label: Generalized-onset motor seizure
fields.definition: "A generalized motor seizure is a type of generalized-onset seizure with predominantly motor (involving musculature) signs. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement." [PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Generalised onset motor seizure; Generalised-onset motor seizure; Generalized onset motor seizure

fields.label: Eyelid myoclonia seizure
fields.definition: "An eyelid myoclonia seizure is a type of generalized myoclonic seizure which may or may not be associated with loss of awareness." [PMID:19469840]

fields.label: Focal non-motor seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal-onset seizure characterized by non-motor signs or symptoms (or behavior arrest) as its initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal seizure without motor onset; Partial seizure without motor onset

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure involves an alteration in a cognitive function (which can be a deficit or a positive phenomenon such as forced thought), which occurs at seizure onset. To be classified as a focal cognitive seizure, the change in cognitive function should be specific and out of proportion to other relatively unimpaired aspects of cognition, because all cognition is impaired in a focal impaired awareness seizure." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cognitive aura; Cognitive seizure; Partial cognitive seizure

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure
fields.definition: "A focal aware cognitive seizure during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Focal aware non-motor seizure
fields.definition: "A focal non-motor seizure in which awareness is retained throughout the seizure." [PMID:20196795, PMID:23739099, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal non-motor aware seizure

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by auditory agnosia as the initial semiological manifestation. For example a person may hear a ringing sound, but may not connect this with the concept that the sound is from a telephone ringing." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with memory impairment
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with memory impairment

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by transient memory impairment as the initial semiological manifestation whilst other cognitive functions and awareness are preserved at seizure onset. The memory impairment may be an inability to recall events occurring prior to the seizure (retrograde amnesia), or failure to encode new memories for events occurring during the seizure (anterograde amnesia)." [PMID:17444534]
fields.label_normalized: focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment
fields.synonyms_concat: Amnestic aura; Amnestic seizure

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with dissociation
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with dissociation characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with dissociation

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with dissociation
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by an experience of being disconnected from, though aware of, self or environment as the initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with dyscalculia/acalculia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia and or acalculia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with dyscalculia/acalculia

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia/acalculia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dyscalculia / acalculia as the initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by forced thinking as the initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with neglect
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by neglect as the initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia/alexia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dyslexia / alexia as the initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia/aphasia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by receptive dysphasia / aphasia as the initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia/aphasia

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by conduction dysphasia / aphasia as the initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with dysgraphia/agraphia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dysgraphia / agraphia as the initial semiological manifestation." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal cognitive seizure with left-right confusion
