fields.synonyms_concat: Cephalic aura; Focal seizure with cephalic sensation; Partial seizure with cephalic sensation

fields.label: Neonatal electrographic only seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal electrographic only seizure is an electrographic event with sudden, repetitive, evolving stereotyped waveforms with a beginning and an end, which is not associated with a clinical manifestation." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure with predominant motor features." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is a regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups; it can be symmetric or asymmetric." [PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neonatal electroclinical clonic seizure

fields.label: Neonatal electro-clinical myoclonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal electro-clinical myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal)." [PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neonatal electroclinical myoclonic seizure

fields.label: Neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at multiple sites." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal focal myoclonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal focal myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) which occurs focally." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal focal clonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal focal clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the predominant motor feature is unilateral regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal bilateral clonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal bilateral clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the clonic jerking is bilateral." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal multifocal clonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal focal clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the predominant motor feature is a regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups, which occurs at multiple sites." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is a sustained increase in muscle tone, usually focal, that can be unilateral or bilateral, and lasting a few seconds to minutes." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal electro-clinical autonomic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal electro-clinical non-motor autonomic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure with predominant features of autonomic alterations, involving cardiovascular, pupillary, gastrointestinal, sudomotor, vasomotor, and thermoregulatory functions. May present as apnea." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure with behavior arrest
fields.definition: "Neonatal electro-clinical non-motor seizure with behavior arrest is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure characterized by an arrest of activities, freezing, immobilization, with or without apnea and/or other autonomic manifestations." [PMID:28276064]
synonyms: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure with behaviour arrest
Neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioral arrest
Neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioural arrest
fields.label_normalized: neonatal electro-clinical seizure with behavior arrest
fields.synonyms_concat: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure with behaviour arrest; Neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioral arrest; Neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioural arrest

fields.label: Neonatal focal tonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal focal tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure with a focal sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal electro-clinical sequential seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures." [PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Neonatal electroclinical sequential seizure

fields.label: Focal neonatal sequential seizure
fields.definition: "Focal neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic focal signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Multifocal neonatal sequential seizure
fields.definition: "Multifocal neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic multifocal signs." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure where the sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes, occurs at both sides of the body symmetrically." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure with automatism
fields.definition: "Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure with automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, and in association with other features." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
synonyms: Neonatal electroclinical motor seizure with automatism
fields.label_normalized: neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure with automatism
fields.synonyms_concat: Neonatal electroclinical motor seizure with automatism

fields.label: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism
fields.definition: "Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at both sides of the body asymmetrically." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.label_normalized: neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism

fields.label: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure where the sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes, occurs at both sides of the body but asymmetrically." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at both sides of the body asymmetrically." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal epileptic spasm
fields.definition: "A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. May occur in clusters." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Neonatal seizure with unilateral automatism
fields.definition: "Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatisms is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at one side of the body." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal seizure with bilateral symmetric automatism
fields.definition: "Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at both sides of the body symmetrically." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.label_normalized: neonatal seizure with bilateral symmetric automatism

fields.label: Neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure
fields.definition: "Neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at both sides of the body symmetrically." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Bilateral asymmetric neonatal sequential seizure
fields.definition: "Asymmetric neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting asymmetrically with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm
fields.definition: "Neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs at one side of the body." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Bilateral symmetric neonatal sequential seizure
fields.definition: "Symmetric neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting symmetrically but with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm
fields.definition: "Neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs symmetrically at both sides of the body." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm
fields.definition: "Neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs asymmetrically at both sides of the body." [PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Generalized-onset epileptic spasm
fields.definition: "A type of epileptic spasm of generalized onset." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Generalised onset epileptic spasm; Generalised-onset epileptic spasm; Generalized onset epileptic spasm

fields.label: Focal-onset epileptic spasm
fields.definition: "A type of epileptic spasm of focal onset." [PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal onset epileptic spasm

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness epileptic spasm
fields.definition: "A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure." [PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Focal aware epileptic spasm
fields.definition: "A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is preserved throughout the seizure." [PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus
fields.definition: "A type of focal motor seizure characterized by a sudden interruption in normal tonic muscle activity lasting 500 ms or less, without evidence of preceding myoclonus as the initial semiological manifestation. The interruption in muscle tone is briefer than seen in a focal atonic seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness hemifacial clonic seizure
fields.definition: "Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with impairment of awareness in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness hemifacial clonic seizure

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with neglect
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with neglect characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with neglect

fields.label: Aphasic status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Aphasic status epilepticus is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma characterized by a cognitive (rather than motor) language deficit." [PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia

fields.label: Focal aware sensory seizure with visual features
fields.definition: "A seizure characterized by elementary visual hallucinations such as flashing or flickering lights/colors, or other shapes, simple patterns, scotomata, or amaurosis." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware sensory seizure with visual features

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations
fields.definition: "A focal sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations

fields.label: Focal aware hemifacial clonic seizure
fields.definition: "Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with retained awareness throughout." [PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Photosensitive myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure
fields.definition: "Generalised myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure provoked by flashing or flickering light." [PMID:28276060]
fields.synonyms_concat: Photically induced myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure

fields.label: Focal aware bilateral motor seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal bilateral motor seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware motor seizure with negative myoclonus
fields.definition: "A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
synonyms: Focal motor aware seizure with negative myoclonus
fields.label_normalized: focal aware motor seizure with negative myoclonus
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal motor aware seizure with negative myoclonus

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with negative myoclonus
fields.definition: "A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
synonyms: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with negative myoclonus
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with negative myoclonus
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with negative myoclonus

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with paresis/paralysis
fields.definition: "A focal motor seizure with paresis / paralysis characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
synonyms: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with paresis/paralysis
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with paresis/paralysis
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with paresis/paralysis

fields.label: Generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
fields.definition: "Generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically generalized. It is a prolonged absence seizure." [PMID:26336950]
synonyms: Generalised non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
fields.label_normalized: generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
fields.synonyms_concat: Absence status epilepticus; Generalised non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma; Petit mal status epilepticus

fields.label: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness
fields.definition: "Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness is impaired." [PMID:28276060]
synonyms: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of awareness
fields.label_normalized: focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of awareness

fields.label: Status epilepticus with ictal paresis
fields.definition: "A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by prolonged ictal paresis or inhibitory motor seizures." [PMID:17116038, PMID:25667883, PMID:26336950]
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal inhibitory status epilepticus

fields.label: Typical absence status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Typical absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged typical absence seizure." [PMID:26336950]
fields.synonyms_concat: Simple absence status epilepticus

fields.label: Focal aware sensory seizure with auditory features
fields.definition: "A type of focal sensory seizure with auditory features during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware sensory seizure with auditory features

fields.label: Myoclonic absence status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Myoclonic absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged myoclonic absence seizure. Myoclonic absence status epilepticus consists of proximal, predominantly upper extremity myoclonic jerks corresponding with 3 Hz spike-wave discharges in the EEG." [PMID:26336950]

fields.label: Oculoclonic status epilepticus
fields.definition: "A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repetitive and rapid saccades, in association with epileptic discharges." [PMID:11967176, PMID:26336950, PMID:2912713]

fields.label: Refractory status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Refractory status epilepticus is defined as status epilepticus continuing despite two appropriately selected and dosed antiepileptic drugs, including a benzodiazepine." [PMID:19817823]

fields.label: Super-refractory status epilepticus
fields.definition: "Super-refractory status epilepticus is defined as refractory status epilepticus continuing for 24 h or more following initiation of anesthetic medications, including cases in which seizure control is attained after induction of anesthetic drugs but recurs on weaning the patient off the anesthetic agent." [PMID:21914716]

fields.label: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness
fields.definition: "Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness remains intact." [PMID:26336950]
synonyms: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with retained awareness
Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of awareness
fields.label_normalized: focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness
fields.synonyms_concat: Aura continua; Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with retained awareness; Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of awareness

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyslexia/alexia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyslexia/alexia

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with hallucination
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with hallucination

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with illusion
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with illusion characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with illusion

fields.label: Focal aware sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
fields.definition: "A seizure characterized by a sensation in the head such as light-headedness or headache." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware sensory seizure with cephalic sensation

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia

fields.label: Focal aware sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations
fields.definition: "A seizure characterized by sensations of feeling hot and then cold." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
fields.definition: "A focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with cephalic sensation

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness seizure with dissociation at onset
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive epileptic seizure with dissociation at the onset of the seizure and with impairment of awareness at at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness seizure with dissociation at onset

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with auditory features
fields.definition: "A focal sensory seizure with auditory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with auditory features

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu

fields.label: Focal aware cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu

fields.label: Focal aware sensory seizure with somatosensory features
fields.definition: "A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move. Awareness is retained throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware sensory seizure with somatosensory features

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with hallucination
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with hallucination

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia

fields.label: Generalized atonic seizure
fields.definition: "Generalized atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1-2 s, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]
fields.synonyms_concat: Generalised atonic seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with forced thinking
fields.definition: "A focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with forced thinking

fields.label: Focal aware sensory seizure with gustatory features
fields.definition: "A seizure characterized by taste phenomena including acidic, bitter, salty, sweet, or metallic tastes." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware sensory seizure with gustatory features

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with somatosensory features
fields.definition: "A focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with somatosensory features

fields.label: Focal aware motor seizure with version
fields.definition: "A focal motor seizure with version characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
synonyms: Focal motor aware seizure with version
fields.label_normalized: focal aware motor seizure with version
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal motor aware seizure with version

fields.label: Infection-related seizure
fields.definition: "Seizure associated with a presumed or proven infection (excluding infection of the central nervous system) or inflammatory state without an alternative precipitant such as metabolic derangement, and regardless of the presence or absence of a fever." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Gastroenteritis-related afebrile seizure
fields.definition: "Afebrile (less than 38.0 degrees Celcius), brief, and generalized seizures accompanying gastroenteritis without an alternative cause." [PMID:12453597, PMID:29935410]

fields.label: Seizure precipitated by febrile infection
fields.definition: "Any form of seizure occurring at the time of a fever (temperature at or above 38.0 degrees Celcius) without infection of the central nervous system, and without an alternative cause such as severe metabolic derangement, occurring at any age." [PMID:28276060]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fever induced seizure

fields.label: Febrile seizure outside the age of 3 months to 6 years
fields.definition: "Any type of seizure (most often a generalized tonic-clonic seizure) occurring with fever (at least 38.0 degrees Celsius) but in the absence of central nervous system infection, severe metabolic disturbance or other alternative precipitant in people beyond the typical arrange of 3 months-6 years with no prior history of afebrile seizure." [PMID:30078767, PMID:9126059]
fields.label_normalized: febrile seizure outside the age of 3 months to 6 years

fields.label: Music-induced seizure
fields.definition: "Seizure precipitated by listening to music or other complex sounds." [PMID:11422340]

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with gustatory features
fields.definition: "A focal sensory seizure with gustatory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with gustatory features

fields.label: Focal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A focal seizure characterized at onset by coordinated motor activity. This often resembles a voluntary movement and may consist of an inappropriate continuation of preictal motor activity." [PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Focal orofacial automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal manual automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal pedal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal perseverative automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal vocal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal verbal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal sexual automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal head nodding automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal undressing automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware undressing automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A focal seizure with automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure." [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]

fields.label: Focal aware automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware orofacial automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware manual automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware pedal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware perseverative automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware vocal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware verbal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal aware sexual automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness orofacial automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness orofacial automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal aware head nodding automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal aware head nodding automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness manual automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by manual automatisms at onset." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness manual automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness pedal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness pedal automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness perseverative automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness perseverative automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness vocal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness vocal automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness verbal automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness verbal automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness sexual automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness sexual automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness head nodding automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness head nodding automatism seizure

fields.label: Focal impaired awareness undressing automatism seizure
fields.definition: "A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset." [PMID:28276060]
fields.label_normalized: focal impaired awareness undressing automatism seizure

fields.label: Elevated CSF neurofilament light chain concentration
fields.definition: "Neurofilament light chain (NfL) is a neuronal cytoplasmic protein highly expressed in large caliber myelinated axons. Its levels increase in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and blood proportionally to the degree of axonal damage in a variety of neurological disorders, including inflammatory, neurodegenerative, traumatic and cerebrovascular diseases." [PMID:31182505]
fields.label_normalized: elevated csf neurofilament light chain concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated CSF neurofilament light chain

fields.label: Abnormal chondrocyte morphology
fields.definition: "Any abnormal structure of a chondrocyte, which is a polymorphic cell that forms cartilage." []

fields.label: Lacunar halos around chondrocytes
fields.definition: "Concentric rings around the chondrocytes." [PMID:8571951]

fields.label: Increased circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase level
fields.definition: "An increased level of triacylglycerol lipase in the blood circulation (can be measured in serum or plasma)." [PMID:28431198]
synonyms: Elevated circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase activity
fields.label_normalized: increased circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase level
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase activity

fields.label: Airway hyperresponsiveness
fields.definition: "An increased sensitivity of the airways to an inhaled constrictor agonist, a steeper slope of the dose-response curve, and a greater maximal response to the agonist." [PMID:12629006]

fields.label: Spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak
fields.definition: "A spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak (SCSFL) is a spontaneous and unexplained leak of the cerebrospinal fluid from the dura surrounding either the brain (cranial leak) or spine (spinal leak)." [PMID:19225307, PMID:22929030]

fields.label: Posterior crocodile shagreen of the cornea
fields.definition: "Grayish, polygonal pattern of opacities with intervening clear zones across the central cornea that resembles crocodile skin." [PMID:19682623]
fields.label_normalized: posterior crocodile shagreen of the cornea

fields.label: Intrusion symptom
fields.definition: "Unintentional re-experiencing of a traumatic event involves symptoms that typically include sensory impressions and emotional responses stemming from the trauma. These symptoms seem to lack a sense of time perspective and context." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Re-experiencing symptom

fields.label: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories
fields.definition: "After experiencing psychological trauma, individuals may repeatedly encounter sensory-perceptual impressions of the event that intrude into their consciousness involuntarily. These intrusive memories often manifest as visual images (such as mental pictures), but can also involve sounds, smells, tastes, and physical sensations. They are accompanied by a variety of negative emotions linked to the most intense moments of the traumatic memory." []
fields.label_normalized: recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories

fields.label: Recurrent trauma-related distressing dreams
fields.definition: "Recurrent distressing dreams occur when the content and/or emotional impact of the dream is connected to a traumatic event or events." []

fields.label: Physiological reactivity to cues
fields.definition: "Marked physiological reactions to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event(s)." [PMID:26611143]

fields.label: Dissociation
fields.definition: "Disruption or detachment of certain aspects of one's normal psychological functioning typically involves a disconnection or separation from thoughts, feelings, sensations, memories, or one's sense of identity or reality." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Dissociative reaction

fields.label: Intense psychological distress to cues
fields.definition: "Intense or prolonged psychological distress occurs when individuals are exposed to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event or events." []

fields.label: Avoidance of stimuli associated with traumatic event
fields.definition: "Avoidance of or efforts to avoid distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s). Avoidance of or efforts to avoid external reminders (people, places, conversations, activities, objects, situations) that arouse distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s)." []
fields.label_normalized: avoidance of stimuli associated with traumatic event

fields.label: Abnormal urine pH
fields.definition: "A deviation of urine pH from the normal range of 4.5 to 7.8." []

fields.label: Alkaline urine
fields.definition: "Urine pH of 8 or higher." []

fields.label: Renal interstitial inflammation
fields.definition: "Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium potentially involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic areas, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Renal cortical interstitial inflammation
fields.definition: "Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic renal cortex, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Renal medullary interstitial inflammation
fields.definition: "Histopathological findings of inflammation of the interstitium of the renal medulla, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Renal interstitial fibrosis
fields.definition: "The accumulation of collagen and related extracellular matrix (ECM) molecules in the interstitium of the kidney. The interstitium is expanded by the presence of collagen that stain blue on trichrome. Tubules are not back to back, but rather separated by fibrosis and can be atrophic." [PMID:22449945]

fields.label: Renal interstitial calcium phosphate deposits
fields.definition: "The presence of interstitial aggregates of purple finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate deposits." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:21804087]

fields.label: Abnormal renal tubular lumen morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structure or form of the lumen (opening) of kidney tubules." [PMID:23101152]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal renal tubular luminal morphology

fields.label: Renal tubular viral cytopathic changes
fields.definition: "Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage. Tubular destruction may be associated with necrotizing interstitial granulomas. Severe granulomatous tubulointerstitial nephritis appears to be characteristic of adenoviral infection and is quite rare in other viral infections. Focal wedge-shaped necrosis may occur in renal parenchyma. Immunostaining for adenovirus shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in infected cells." [PMID:21436288, PMID:29273157]

fields.label: Usual-type tubular atrophy
fields.definition: "A type of renal tubular atrophy in which the tubules show thick tubular basement membranes lined by small cuboidal or flat cells. Generally accompanied by fibrosis." [PMID:7906246]
fields.synonyms_concat: Common-type renal tubular atrophy

fields.label: Renal tubular cytomegalovirus inclusions
fields.definition: "Characteristic intranuclear glassy-appearing basophilic inclusions with surrounding halo (owl's eye-type inclusion) and marked increase in the size of the cell (cytomegaly), particularly in tubular epithelial cells and in endothelial cells. Often accompanied by cytopathic changes including patchy interstitial pleomorphic infiltrate with lymphocytes, plasma cells, and macrophages." []

fields.label: Renal tubular adenovirus inclusions
fields.definition: "Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. The inclusions stain positive for adenovirus (e.g., Figure 3 of PMID:29273157). Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. Occasionally glomerular visceral and parietal epithelial cells can be infected. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29273157]

fields.label: Renal tubular polyoma virus inclusions
fields.definition: "Renal tubular nuclear inclusions have a ground-glass appearance with irregular central clearing, or a coarse, vesicular appearance. Distal tubules are involved more often than proximal tubules. There may be only medullary involvement in early stages, and parietal epithelial cells may be involved in later stages of the infection. Infected epithelial cell nuclei stain with antibody to the large T antigen of the SV40 virus, which serves as a surrogate marker of human polyomavirus infection." []

fields.label: Renal tubular herpes simplex virus inclusions
fields.definition: "Renal tubular nuclear inclusions that stain positive for herpes simplex virus (HSV). HSV is typically associated with multinucleated giant cells with nuclear inclusions and may cause hemorrhagic interstitial nephritis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:27884285]
fields.label_normalized: renal tubular herpes simplex virus inclusions

fields.label: Dysmorphic hematuria
fields.definition: "The presence of dysmorphic urinary erythrocytes. This feature can be observed by phase-contrastmicroscopy, differential interference microscopy, and bright-field microscopy. The acanthocyte or G1 cell, which is a doughnut-shaped cell with one or more blebs, is reported to constitute a special form of dysmorphic erythro-cyte (D cell) specific for glomerular hematuria." [PMID:16362157]
fields.synonyms_concat: Acanthocyturia

fields.label: Urinary oval fat bodies
fields.definition: "The presence in the urine of desquamated tubular epithelial cells or macrophages filled with lipid droplets." [PMID:13171348]

fields.label: Intratubular calcium oxalate casts
fields.definition: "Birefringent calcium- and oxalate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Intratubular calcium phosphate casts
fields.definition: "Purple and finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Magnesium ammonium phosphate crystalluria
fields.definition: "Magnesium ammonium phosphate crystals in the urine." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Struvite urinary crystals

fields.label: Tubular microcystic change
fields.definition: "Dilated renal tubules (over twice the diameter of a normal proximal tubule) containing eosinophilic amorphous material. This feature is generally accompanied by scalloping of the cast profile. The epithelium lining the microcyst is generally flattened and does not reveal brush border." []

fields.label: Complex renal cyst
fields.definition: "A renal cyst characterized by epithelium lined space (squamous/columnar) with septations." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:18776117]

fields.label: Uric acid crystalluria
fields.definition: "The presence of uric acid crystals in the urine." [PMID:25045326, PMID:8671802]

fields.label: Interstitial emphysema
fields.definition: "Interstitial emphysema is characterized by air dissecting within the interstitium of the lung, typically in the peribronchovascular sheaths, interlobular septa, and visceral pleura. It is most commonly seen in neonates receiving mechanical ventilation. It is rarely recognized radiographically in adults and is infrequently seen on CT scans. It appears as perivascular lucent or low attenuating halos and small cysts." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:18195376]

fields.label: Centrilobular emphysema
fields.definition: "A type of emphysema characterized by destroyed centrilobular alveolar walls and enlargement of respiratory bronchioles and associated alveoli. This is the commonest form of emphysema in cigarette smokers. CT findings are centrilobular areas of decreased attenuation, usually without visible walls, of nonuniform distribution and predominantly located in upper lung zones." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:18195376, PMID:4014865, PMID:7976869]
fields.synonyms_concat: Centriacinar emphysema

fields.label: Panacinar emphysema
fields.definition: "Panacinar emphysema involves all portions of the acinus and secondary pulmonary lobule more or less uniformly. It predominates in the lower lobes and is the form of emphysema associated with1-antitrypsin deficiency. CT scans show a generalized decrease of the lung parenchyma with a decrease in the caliber of blood vessels in the affected lung. Severe panacinar emphysema may coexist and merge with severe centrilobular emphysema. The appearance of feature less decreased attenuation may be indistinguishable from severe constrictive obliterative bronchiolitis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:1395384, PMID:18195376, PMID:8370825]

fields.label: Expiratory air trapping
fields.definition: "Abnormal retention of gas within a lung or part of a lung, as a result of airway obstruction of abnormalities in lung compliance. In the classic presentation, the lung will appear normal at inspiration, but on exhalation, the diseased portions of the lung which have lost connective tissue recoil will remain lucent while the healthy portions of the lung will become more dense due to atelectasis. This helps distinguish it from mosaic attenuation due to patchy fibrosis, as occurs with nonspecific interstitial pneumonia, and in early usual interstitial pneumonitis (the hallmark imaging diagnosis of interstitial lung disease) in which there is no change with inspiration and expiration." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:10524809, PMID:18195376, PMID:7972745]

fields.label: Traction bronchiectasis
fields.definition: "Distortion of the bronchial airways due to mechanical traction on the bronchi resulting from fibrosis of the surrounding lung parenchyma. CT findings represent irregular bronchial dilatation caused by surrounding retractile pulmonary fibrosis. Dilated airways are usually identifiable as such but may be seen as cysts." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:18195376, PMID:3786716]

fields.label: Computed tomographic halo sign
fields.definition: "CT finding of ground-glass opacity surrounding a nodule or mass. It was first described as a sign of hemorrhage around foci of invasive aspergillosis. The halo sign is nonspecific and may also be caused by hemorrhage associated with other types of nodules or by local pulmonary infiltration by neoplasm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:18195376, PMID:3864189]
fields.synonyms_concat: CT halo sign

fields.label: Nodular-centrilobular without tree-in-bud pattern on pulmonary HRCT
fields.definition: "A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography which are anatomically located centrally within secondary pulmonary lobules. Centrilobular nodules may be dense (i.e., solid) and of homogeneous opacity or ground-glass opacity, and may range from a few millimeters to about 1 cm in size. Because of the similar size of secondary lobules, centrilobular nodules often appear to be evenly spaced. Centrilobular nodules are usually separated from the pleural surfaces, fissures, and interlobular septa by a distance of at least several millimeters. They may appear patchy or diffuse in different diseases." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X]
fields.label_normalized: nodular-centrilobular without tree-in-bud pattern on pulmonary hrct

fields.label: Abnormal bronchoalveolar lavage fluid morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal type or counts of nucleated immune cells and acellular components in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid. BAL us performed with a fiberoptic bronchoscope in the wedged position within a selected bronchopulmonary segment. BAL is commonly used to inform the differential diagnosis of interstitial lung disease or to monitor therapeutic interventions." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]

fields.label: Abnormal cellular composition of bronchoalveolar fluid
fields.definition: "Deviation from the commonly in healthy people observe cellular distribution. Normal ranges are macrophages over 80%, lymphocytes less than 15%, neutrophils less than 3%, eosinophils less than 0.5%, mast cells less than 0.5%." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, ISBN:0412792702, PMID:10678650, PMID:3396403]
synonyms: Abnormal cell differential of broncho-alveolar fluid
fields.label_normalized: abnormal cellular composition of bronchoalveolar fluid
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal cell differential of broncho-alveolar fluid

fields.label: Abnormal bronchoalveolar fluid protein level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of protein in the bronchoalveolar fluid." []
synonyms: Abnormal biochemical composition of broncho-alveolar fluid
Abnormal level of proteins in the broncho-alveolar fluid
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal biochemical composition of broncho-alveolar fluid; Abnormal level of proteins in the broncho-alveolar fluid

fields.label: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid lymphocyte proportion
fields.definition: "Usually, Lymphoycytes make up less than 15% of all cells found in the bronchoalveloar lavage fluid. This elevated cell proportion can be induced by virus or drugs, or is associated with specific diseases." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, ISBN:0412792702, PMID:10678650, PMID:3396403]
fields.label_normalized: elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid lymphocyte proportion

fields.label: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid neutrophil proportion
fields.definition: "Usually, Neutrophils make up less than 3% of all cells found in the broncho-alveloar lavage fluid. In children, standard value of neutrophils is higher depending on their age (children under the age of 5 show a maximum value of 10%). This elevated cell proportion is a sign for acute and chronic infections (HP:0012387, HP:0006538) and can be associated to specific diseases." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, ISBN:0412792702, PMID:10678650, PMID:3396403]
synonyms: Elevated level of neutrophils in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid
fields.label_normalized: elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid neutrophil proportion
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated level of neutrophils in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid

fields.label: Lipid-laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar fluid
fields.definition: "Accumulation of lipids in alveolar macrophages with droplet-shaped fat inclusions." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, ISBN:0412792702, PMID:11757629]

fields.label: Hemosiderin-laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar fluid
fields.definition: "Hemosiderin-laden macrophages (HLM) in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid were originally known as adiagnostic biomarker of alveolar hemorrhage, but have also been observed in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) with histopathological pattern of usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:16871595, PMID:23678356, PMID:25515792, PMID:28166761]
synonyms: Accumulation of hemosiderin laden alveolar macrophages
fields.synonyms_concat: Accumulation of hemosiderin laden alveolar macrophages; Siderophages in bronchoalveolar fluid

fields.label: Absent bronchoalveolar surfactant-protein C
fields.definition: "Significantly decreased level or failed detection of surfactant protein C in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid. Comment: Pulmonary surfactant is a highly surface-active mixture of proteins and lipids that is synthesized and secreted onto the alveoli by type II epithelial cells. The protein part of surfactant constitutes of four types of surfactant proteins (SP), SP-A, SP-B, SP-C and SP-D. SP-A and SP-D are hydrophilic proteins that regulate surfactant metabolism and have immunologic functions, whereas SP-B and SP-C are hydrophobic molecules, which play a direct role in the organization of the surfactant structure in the interphase and in the stabilization of the lipid layers during the respiratory cycle. Lack of SP-C may result of surfactant metabolism dysfunction and is also observed in patients with other diffuse parenchymal lung diseases, pathogenetically related to the alveolar surfactant region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:26375475]

fields.label: Absent bronchoalveolar dimeric surfactant-protein B
fields.definition: "Significantly decreased level or failed detection of surfactant protein B in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:26375475]

fields.label: Atoll sign
fields.definition: "CT finding of central ground-glass opacity surrounded by denser consolidation of crescentic shape (forming more than three-fourths of a circle) or complete ring of at least 2 mm in thickness. A rare sign, it was initially reported to be specific for cryptogenic organizing pneumonia, but was subsequently described in patients with paracoccidioidomycosis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:10414267, PMID:15908556, PMID:22553298]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reversed halo sign

fields.label: Abnormal alveolar macrophage morphology
fields.definition: "Alveolar macrophages usually make up the majority of cells in the bronchoalveolar space (over 80%). The may contain intracellular material depending on underlying diseases or due to exposition to inhaled particles." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, ISBN:0412792702.]

fields.label: Dust particle inclusion in alveolar macrophages
fields.definition: "Accumulation of inhaled, nondigestable particles in macrophages." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, ISBN:0412792702, PMID:3740951]
fields.label_normalized: dust particle inclusion in alveolar macrophages

fields.label: Smoker-inclusions in alveolar macrophages
fields.definition: "In otherwise healthy smokers, characteristic so called smoker-inclusion can be found within the macrophages in the bronchoalveolar fluid. These blue/ black/ round/ oval cytoplasmic inclusions consist of pigmented lipid deposits." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, ISBN:0412792702]

fields.label: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid eosinophil proportion
fields.definition: "Usually, eosinophils make up less than 0.5% of all cells found in the broncho-alveloar lavage fluid. But in eosinophilic lung disease, the eosinophil cell proportion typically represents more than 25%. Comment: An elevated level of eosinophil cells are also a result of infections, or an allergic reaction or can be drug-induced." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, ISBN:0412792702, PMID:10678650, PMID:3396403]
fields.label_normalized: elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid eosinophil proportion

fields.label: Persistent head lag
fields.definition: "The Premie-Neuro and the Dubowitz Neurological Examination score head lag in the same manner. Scoring for both is as follows: 0 = head drops and stays back, 1 = tries to lift head but drops it back, 2 = able to lift head slightly, 3 = lifts head in line with body, and 4 = head in front of body. This term applies if head lag persists beyond an expected age at a level of 0 or 1. Persistent head lag beyond age 4 mo has been linked to poor outcomes." [PMID:26709421]
fields.synonyms_concat: Head lag; Headlag

fields.label: Delayed ability to roll over
fields.definition: "Delayed achievement of the ability to roll front to back and back to front." []

fields.label: Localized pulmonary hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Circumscribed pulmonary hemorrhage originating from a single bleeding site in the lungs. This can be due to infections, tumorigenesis, foreign bodies, or vascular abnormalities. Patient often feel the site of bleeding, contrast CT scan or angiography may localize the bleeder." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X]
fields.synonyms_concat: Localised pulmonary haemorrhage

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary fissure morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormal form or number of the pulmonary fissures." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary fissure architecture
fields.definition: "An abnormal form or location of a pulmonary fissure." []

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary fissure count
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal number of pulmonary fissures." []

fields.label: Supernumerary pulmonary fissure
fields.definition: "Presence of a lung fissure that does not exist normally. Supernumerary fissures include the superior accessory fissure, the medial basal fissure, the left horizontal fissure, and the azygos fissure form supernumerary lobes." []
fields.synonyms_concat: increased pulmonary fissure count

fields.label: Decreased pulmonary fissure count
fields.definition: "Lack of one or more of the normal pulmonary fissures." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced pulmonary fissure count

fields.label: Abnormal cystatin C level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of cystatin C in serum or plasma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:24570004]

fields.label: Decreased circulating cystatin C concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of cystatin C in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:24570004]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased cystatin C level

fields.label: Increased cystatin C level
fields.definition: "A elevated concentration of cystatin C in the blood circulation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:24570004]

fields.label: Increased fecal porphyrin
fields.definition: "Abnormally high concentration of fecal porphyrins in feces." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:25372274]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased faecal porphyrin

fields.label: Subglottic laryngitis
fields.definition: "Narrowing of the larynx, commonly occurring during viral respiratory tract infections, in particular in children, leads to symptoms such as hoarseness, a barking cough, stridor, and sometimes dyspnea and respiratory failure." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:31680234]
fields.synonyms_concat: Croup; Laryngitis; Pseudocroup; Spasmodic croup; Viral croup

fields.label: Laryngeal papilloma
fields.definition: "A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on the larynx." [PMID:30828624]
fields.synonyms_concat: Laryngeal papillomas; Laryngeal papillomatosis

fields.label: Bronchial papilloma
fields.definition: "A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on a bronchus." [PMID:32309132]

fields.label: Tracheal papilloma
fields.definition: "A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on the trachea." [PMID:32309132]

fields.label: Palmar warts
fields.definition: "Multiple verrucous lesions on the skin of the palm. These lesions are raised, have a thickened and rough surface, and may display prominent black dots (thrombosed capillaries). Palmar warts are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV)." [PMID:17210977]

fields.label: Plantar warts
fields.definition: "Multiple verrucous lesions on the skin of the sole of the foot. These lesions are raised, have a thickened and rough surface, and may display prominent black dots (thrombosed capillaries). Palmar warts are caused by caused by human papillomavirus (HPV)." [PMID:17210977]

fields.label: Diffuse alveolar damage
fields.definition: "Diffuse alveolar damage (DAD) describes a common histologic injury pattern of the lung. The early stages are characterized by epithelial cell necrosis and sloughing, fibrous exsudate, edema, and hyaline membranes made of surfactant and proteins, filling the alveoli. This results in impaired gas exchange. In later stages, type II cells and myofibroblasts proliferate within the interstitium and airspaces. The corresponding clinical entity is acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). DAD may result from pulmonary drug toxicity, occurs in immunosuppressed, severe viral infections, acute interstial pneumonitis, and crack cocaine inhalation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:28570160, PMID:32364264]

fields.label: Architectural distortion of the lung
fields.definition: "Architectural distortion is characterized by abnormal displacement of bronchi, vessels, fissures, or septa caused by diffuse or localized lung disease, particularly interstitial fibrosis. This is visible in lung biopsy and CT scans in a distorted appearance and is usually associated with pulmonary fibrosis and accompanied by volume loss." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:25489125]

fields.label: Increased Z-disc width

fields.label: White oral mucosal macule

fields.label: Retinal peau d'orange

fields.label: Michaelis-Gutmann bodies

fields.synonyms_concat: Malakoplakia

fields.label: Body ache
fields.definition: "Body ache is a complaint that is often used to denote vague symptoms of mild fatigue, lethargy, or dull aches. We will define it here to mean a dull and poorly localizable pain that is described by the affected individual to affect multiple joints or body parts or even the entire body." []

fields.label: Substantia nigra hypointensity on susceptibility-weighted imaging
fields.definition: "Hypointence (dark) appearance of the substantia nigra inmagnetic resonance imaging using susceptibility weighted imaging (SWI)." []

fields.label: Pharyngalgia

fields.synonyms_concat: Pharyngodynia; Sore throat; Throat discomfort; Throat pain

fields.label: Impaired executive functioning
fields.definition: "A disturbance of executive functioning, which is broadly defined as the set of abilities that allow for the planning, executing, monitoring, and self-correcting of goal-directed behavior while inhibiting task-irrelevant behavior. At least some degree of executive skill is needed to complete most cognitive tasks, and deficits in executive abilities are central to many clinical conditions, including fronto-temporal dementia." [PMID:28631987]

fields.label: Non-epileptic seizure
fields.definition: "Psychogenic non-epileptic seizures (PNES) are not abnormal perceptions or abnormal beliefs/judgments, nor are they epileptic attacks. They are behaviors that simulate epileptic attacks, not fully consciously." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Functional seizure; Psychogenic non-epileptic seizure; Psychosomatic seizure

fields.label: Pseudoseizure
fields.definition: "Sudden, involuntary seizure-like attacks that, unlike epileptic seizures, are not related to electrographic ictal discharges." [PMID:23251092]

fields.label: Myoclonic tremor
fields.definition: "A tremor-like cortical myoclonus. The tremulous movements are in fact small, high-frequency myoclonic jerks, induced by posture or action. They can be mild, but can also be more incapacitating. When present in the lower limbs, these may lead to gait disorders and even drop attacks. These tremor-like movements during action can be mistaken for essential tremor or epileptic seizures." [PMID:29416935]

fields.label: Impaired ability to plan
fields.definition: "Impaired ability to anticipate future events, implement instructions or goals, and develop appropriate steps ahead of time in order to carry out a task or activity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, NCIT:C121469, PMID:26039846]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ineffective planning

fields.label: Impaired ability to organize
fields.definition: "Impaired ability to bring order to information, actions, or materials to achieve a goal or to follow an established organized routine." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, NCIT:C121469, PMID:26039846]
fields.synonyms_concat: Impaired ability to organise

fields.label: Decreased circulating terminal complement component concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration below the lower limit of normal of one or more components of the the terminal membrane attack complex (MAC) portion of complement, which represents the lytic, pore-forming part of the system. The MAC comprises seven components: C5b, C6, C7, C8 (a heterotrimer composed of C8alpha, C8beta and C8gamma) and multiple copies of C9." [PMID:26841934]

fields.label: Increased factor IX activity

fields.label: Abnormal factor IX activity
fields.definition: "Abnormal activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa." []

fields.label: Shortened sleep phase

fields.synonyms_concat: Short sleep

fields.label: Renal interstitial globotriaosylceramide inclusions
fields.definition: "Accumulation of globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) in kidney tissues, which can be quantified as the number of globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) inclusions/kidney interstitial capillary (KIC)." [PMID:32606714]

fields.label: Mild albuminuria
fields.definition: "The presence of mildly increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as an albumin-creatinine ratio (ACR) less than 30 mg/gm (less than 3.4 mg/mmol)." [PMID:30571025]

fields.label: Severe albuminuria
fields.definition: "The presence of severely increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as an albumin-creatinine ratio greater than 300 mg/gm (greater than 34 mg/mmol)." [PMID:30571025]
fields.synonyms_concat: Heavy albuminuria

fields.label: Medication crystalluria
fields.definition: "A variety of drugs may occasionally cause transient crystalluria, in isolation or in conjunction with other urinary abnormalities. Overdose, dehydration, or hypoalbuminaemia, which increases the unbound drug which is ultrafiltrated by the glomerulus, are the factors usually favoring the precipitation of crystals within the tubular lumina. In some cases, medication-induced crystalluria has a distinct phenotypic appearance. For instance, Sulphadiazine crystals appear as strongly birefringent 'shocks of wheat' or 'shells' with an amber color. Acyclovir crystals are birefringent and needle-shaped, and when present in abundance give to urine a silky and opalescent macroscopic appearance." [PMID:8671802]

fields.label: Renal interstitial IgG4+ plasma cell infiltration
fields.definition: "An increased number of IgG4+ plasma cells in the interstitial space of the kidney." [PMID:21719792, PMID:29359118]
fields.label_normalized: renal interstitial igg4+ plasma cell infiltration

fields.label: Impaired self monitoring

fields.label: Impaired task monitoring
fields.definition: "Impaired ability to keep track of one's problem-solving success or failure, and to identify and correct mistakes during performance of a goal." [NCIT:C121470, PMID:26039846]

fields.label: Abnormal macroscopic urine appearance
fields.definition: "Anomalous physical appearance (color, cloudiness, clarity) or odor of urine." []

fields.label: Urate tophus

fields.label: Abnormal TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test

Following administration of exogenous TRH, a transient increase in serum TSH is expected. This term refers to an abnormal response in the TRH stimulation test." []

fields.synonyms_concat: Triple rhythm

fields.label: Quadruple gallop rhythm
fields.definition: "A type of gallop rhythm in which both the third and the fourth sounds are present." [PMID:15886379]

fields.label: Elevated circulating tenascin-C concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of tenascin-C in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Duodenal gastric metaplasia
fields.definition: "Foci of gastric-type mucus-secreting cells interspersed between duodenal enterocytes. These foci of gastric epithelial cells contain Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive neutral mucin and lack a brush border." [PMID:16679353]

fields.label: Duodenitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the lining of the upper small intestine (duodenum)." [PMID:16679353]
fields.synonyms_concat: Duodenal inflammation

fields.label: Abnormal right ventricular function
fields.definition: "Anomalous physiology (function) of the right ventricle." []

fields.label: Elevated right ventricular systolic pressure
fields.definition: "Elevation of right ventricular systolic pressure (RVSP) above normal limits. In adults, RVSP is normally 20-30 mmHg." [PMID:18619825]

fields.label: Nummular eczema
fields.definition: "A type of eczema characterized by pruritic coin-shaped patches on the skin. Nummular eczema most commonly occurs on the extremities, particularly the legs, but may occur anywhere on the trunk, hands, or feet" [PMID:26091664]
fields.synonyms_concat: Discoid eczema; Nummular dermatitis

fields.label: Barking cough
fields.definition: "A cough with a characteristic sound that has been compared to a seal's bark." [PMID:16936230, PMID:28613724]
fields.synonyms_concat: Seal-like barking cough

fields.label: Absent P wave
fields.definition: "The P wave that normally precedes each QRS complex by a fixed PR interval of 120 to 200 milliseconds is not present." []
synonyms: Absence of P wave on electrocardiography
fields.synonyms_concat: Absence of P wave on electrocardiography

fields.label: Elevated circulating osteopontin level
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased level of osteopontin in the blood circulation" [PMID:12574077, PMID:15705633]

fields.label: Increased serum sorbitol concentration
fields.definition: "An increased level of sorbitol in the blood circulation." [PMID:32367058]

fields.label: Follicular lymphoma
fields.definition: "An indolent B cell lymphoproliferative disorder of transformed follicular center B cells. Follicular lymphoma is characterized by diffuse lymphadenopathy, bone marrow involvement, splenomegaly and less commonly other extranodal sites of involvement." [NCIT:C3209, PMID:29314206]

fields.label: Cutaneous necrosis
fields.definition: "Skin and subcutaneous tissue necrosis (tissue death). Clinically, cutaneous necrosis may present as a painful and extremely tender black eschar (dead tissue found in a full-thickness wound) surrounded by dusky grey-red colored skin or as slough (dead tissue, usually cream or yellow in colour)." [PMID:16455730, PMID:28470091]
fields.synonyms_concat: Skin necrosis; Skin necrotic patch

fields.label: Abnormality of the musculoskeletal system
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the musculoskeletal system, which consists of the bones of the skeleton, muscles, cartilage, tendons, ligaments, joints, and other connective tissue. The musculoskeletal system supports the weight of the body, maintains body position and produces movements of the body or of parts of the body." []

fields.label: Delayed ability to crawl
fields.definition: "A failure to achieve the ability to crawl at an appropriate developmental stage. Normal infant motor development is marked by a series of postural milestones including learning to crawl on hands and knees between the ages of 6 and 10 months." []

fields.label: Abnormal shoulder physiology
fields.definition: "Anopmalous function of the shoulder. The shoulder is a ball-and-socket joint that is made up of humerus, scapula and clavicle, which are connected by the sternoclavicular joint (SC), the acromioclavicular joint (AC), the glenohumeral joint (GH), and the scapulothoracic joint (ST). The GH, AC and SC joints link the upper extremity to the axial skeleton at the thorax and enable movement at the shoulder joint: flexion, extension, and rotation of the arm." []

fields.label: Abnormal renal echogenicity
fields.definition: "Anomalous echogenicity of the kidney on ultrasound examination." [PMID:24235286]

fields.label: Renal medullary hyperechogenicity
fields.definition: "Increased echogenecity of the medullary region of the kidney." [PMID:24235286]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased renal medullary echogenicity

fields.label: Renal cortical hyperechogenicity
fields.definition: "Increased echogenecity of the kidney cortex." [PMID:24235286]

fields.label: Renal cortical hypoechogeneity
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoechogenic renal cortex

fields.label: Abdominal adhesions
fields.definition: "Fibrous bands (i.e., bands of scar-like tissue) that span two or more intra-abdominal organs and/or the inner abdominal wall (i.e. peritoneal membrane)." [PMID:28203370]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intra-abdominal adhesion

fields.label: Hepatic infarction
fields.definition: "Hepatic infarction is defined as areas of coagulative necrosis from hepatocyte cell death caused by local ischemia. Liver infarctions appear as hypoechoic nonvascular regions on conventional and Doppler sonography." [PMID:30666665]
