fields.label: Lymph node abscess
fields.definition: "An inflamed lymph node that is filled with pus." []

fields.label: Abnormal pulmonary alveolar system morphology
fields.definition: "A structural abnormality of the pulmonary acinus, alveolar parenchyma, or alveoli." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]

fields.label: Right atrial thrombus
fields.definition: "A thrombus (i.e., a blood clot formed in situ within the vascular system) located in the right atrium of the heart." [PMID:28127133]

fields.label: Elevated circulating uracil concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of uracil in the blood circulation is above the normal range." []

fields.label: Blake's pouch cyst
fields.definition: "The presence of an upwardly displaced normal cerebellar vermis, normal appearance of the fastigium, tentorium and size of the cisterna magna." [PMID:25970099]

fields.label: Severe SARS-CoV-2 infection
fields.definition: "Unusually severe clinical course of SARS-CoV-2 infection, manifested clinically by features such as dyspnea and hypoxia with diffuse bilateral ground-glass opacities of the lungs on computed tomographic scan with progressive respiratory insufficiency necessitating oxygen supplementation or mechanical ventilation." [PMID:32706371]

fields.label: Long nasal bridge
fields.definition: "Increased superior-inferior length of the nasal bridge, which is the saddle-shaped area that includes the nasal root and the lateral aspects of the nose." []

fields.label: Jejunitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the lining of the middle section of the small intestine." [PMID:26420973]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation of the concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood from the normal range." [PMID:32119309]

fields.label: Increased circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
fields.definition: "Elevated concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood circulation." [PMID:32119309]

fields.label: Elevated circulating methylsuccinic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of methylsuccinic acid in the blood circulation." [PMID:29909962]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating short-chain fatty-acid concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of a short-chain fatty acid in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Increased circulating isovaleric acid concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of isovaleric acid, a C5, branched-chain saturated fatty acid, in the blood concentration." [PMID:16602101]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating isovalerate; Isovalericacidemia

fields.label: Intrahepatic bile duct dilatation
fields.definition: "Increased diameter (caliber) of intrahepatic bile ducts (bile ducts that transport bile between the Canals of Hering and the interlobar bile ducts)." [PMID:32386558]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dilatation of intrahepatic biliary ducts

fields.label: Anorectal abscess
fields.definition: "An abscess located at the junction of the anal canal and the rectum." []

fields.label: Abnormal pharynx morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the pharynx." []

fields.label: Abnormal pharynx physiology
fields.definition: "A functional anomaly of the pharynx." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating dodecenoylcarnitine concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased circulation of dodecenoylcarnitine, C12:1, in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated plasma dodecenoylcarnitine concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating deoxypyridinoline concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of lysyl-pyridinoline (deoxypyridinoline) cross-links in the blood circulation." [PMID:12661898]

fields.label: Elevated circulating L-alloisoleucine concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased concentration of L-alloisoleucine in the blood circulation." [PMID:10508118, PMID:28919799]

fields.label: Elevated urine L-alloisoleucine level
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased level of L-alloisoleucine in the urine." [PMID:28919799]

fields.label: Elevated circulating 3-methylhistidine concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase of the concentration of 3-methylhistidine in the blood circulation." [PMID:6780020]

fields.label: Reduced respiratory ciliary beating frequency
fields.definition: "An abnormal reduction in the number of beats per unit time of the respiratory cilia." [PMID:10722772]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dminished respiratory ciliary beat frequency

fields.label: Reduced urinary inosine level
fields.definition: "The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Inosine is a purine nucleoside in which hypoxanthine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond." [PMID:402573]

fields.label: Decreased urinary guanosine level
fields.definition: "The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Guanosine is a purine nucleoside in which guanine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond." []

fields.label: Abnormal urinary purine level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal amount of a purine compound in the urine. Purines are aromatic heterocyclic compounds containing a purine moiety, which is formed a pyrimidine-ring ring fused to an imidazole ring. Two of the four deoxyribonucleotides (deoxyadenosine and deoxyguanosine) and two of the four ribonucleotides (adenosine, or AMP, and guanosine, or GMP) are purines." []

fields.label: Abnormal urinary pyrimidine level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal amount of a pyrimidine compound in the urine. Pyrimidines and pyrimidine derivatives are compounds containing a pyrimidne ring, which is a six-member aromatic heterocycle which consists of two nitrogen atoms (at positions 1 and 3) and four carbon atoms. The nucleotides cytosine, thymine and uracil are pyrimidines." []

fields.label: Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth
fields.definition: "An increased number and/or abnormal type of bacteria in the small bowel. Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth has been defined as the presence of greater than one hundred thousand bacteria (i.e. colony-forming units, CFU) per mL of proximal jejunal aspiration. The normal value is ten thousand or few CFU/ml." [PMID:20572300]

fields.label: Focal active colitis
fields.definition: "Focal active colitis (FAC) is characterized by focal crypt damage caused by neutrophils. FAC is characterized by an inflammatory infiltrate consisting of intraepithelial neutrophils and/or neutrophils invading the lumen of the criptae, with no other microscopic alteration of the colonic mucosa and, in particular, without the presence of signs of chronic inflammation." [PMID:21880133, PMID:29254324, PMID:9191008]

fields.label: Necrotizing enterocolitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the intestine leading to bacterial invasion causing cellular damage and death which causes necrosis of the colon and intestine." [PMID:30020729]

fields.label: Recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections
fields.definition: "An increased susceptibility to viral upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections (otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis)." [PMID:30422556]
fields.label_normalized: recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections

fields.label: Neutrophilic urticarial dermatosis
fields.definition: "A neutrophilic interstitial, perivascular and/or perieccrine infiltrate with leukocytoclasia. Notably, leukocytoclastic vasculitis is not present." [PMID:32490121]

fields.label: Reduced mevalonate kinase activity
fields.definition: "Abnormally reduced activity of mevalonate kinase, which is a key enzyme in the mevalonate biosynthetic pathway that leads to the synthesis of both cholesterol and nonsterol isoprenoids." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3411-9598, PMID:27499643]

fields.label: Reduced total lung capacity
fields.definition: "Abnormally reduced volume of air in the lungs upon the maximum effort of inspiration." [PMID:28194273]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced TLC

fields.label: Abnormal skinfold thickness measurement
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of a skinfold thickness, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers." [PMID:7492193]

fields.label: Abnormal triceps skinfold thickness
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the thickness of the triceps skinfold, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers." [PMID:27669294]

fields.label: Increased triceps skinfold thickness
fields.definition: "Increased thickness of the triceps skinfold, which is measured halfway down the back of the upper arm is increased." [PMID:27669294]

fields.label: Milky appearance of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
fields.definition: "Return of lavage fluid with a milky appearance due to the accumulation of a mixture of pulmonary surfactant, which is a lipoprotein complex, in the alveolar space." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:26110014, PMID:28771412]
fields.label_normalized: milky appearance of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid

fields.label: Bloody bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
fields.definition: "Return of lavage fluid characteristically has a bloody appearance in pulmonary alveolar hemorrhage. This is due to admixture of blood, which typically increases with each consecutive lavage portion. Microscopically erythrocytes can be seen. After 24 to 48 h macrophages contain phagocytosed erythrocytes, indicating previous bleeding." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]

fields.label: Elevated circulating 5-oxoproline concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of L-pyroglutamic acid in the blood is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:8789605]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating L-pyroglutamic acid concentration

fields.label: Submandibular lymph node enlargement
fields.definition: "Increased size of the lymph nodes that are located beneath the mandible (lower jaw)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Submandibular lymphadenopathy

fields.label: Elevated circulating suberic acid concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of suberic acid in the blood circulation. Suberic acid is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is the 1,6-dicarboxy derivative of hexane." []

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 8 concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of interleukin-8 in the circulation." [PMID:15831231]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased serum IL-8; Increased serum interleukin 8; Increased serum interleukin-8

fields.label: Elevated circulating aconitic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of aconitic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Torsion of appendix of testis
fields.definition: "The appendix testis or hydatid of Morgagni, is a vestigial remnant of the Müllerian duct located on the superior pole of the testicle between the testis and epididymis. Although this appendage has no vital function, it is present in 50% of males. Torsion of twisting of this vestigial remnant can be incredibly painful, but usually requires no medical intervention." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:31550101]
synonyms: Twisted vestigial remnant of the Muellerian duct
fields.synonyms_concat: Twisted vestigial remnant of the Muellerian duct

fields.label: Spinal epidural abscess
fields.definition: "Spinal epidural abscess (SEA) is caused by a suppurative infection in the epidural space. The mass effect of the abscess can compress and reduce blood flow to the spinal cord, conus medullaris, or cauda equina." [PMID:24007734, PMID:26540492]
synonyms: A severe pyogenic infection of the epidural space
fields.synonyms_concat: A severe pyogenic infection of the epidural space

fields.label: Increased circulating cathepsin D level
fields.definition: "An increase in concentration of cathepsin D in the blood circulation." [PMID:26995190]

fields.label: Bilobed right lung
fields.definition: "A developmental defect of pulmonary lobation characterized by the presence of only two lobes of the right lung." [PMID:19500772]

fields.label: Triggered by EBV infection
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by the Epstein-Barr virus." [PMID:19425169]
synonyms: Triggered by Epstein Barr virus infection
fields.synonyms_concat: Triggered by Epstein Barr virus infection

fields.label: Misalignment of the pulmonary veins
fields.definition: "The term is commonly used to describe a putative abnormal location of pulmonary vein branches adjacent to pulmonary arteries within the same adventitial sheath. However, evidence has been provided that the vessels in question are not pulmonary veins, however represent dilated bronchial veins." [PMID:19500772, PMID:25052575, PMID:27071622]

fields.label: Hyperimidodipeptiduria
fields.definition: "Elevated levels of proline-containing dipeptides in urine." [PMID:9196362]
fields.synonyms_concat: Imidodipeptiduria

fields.label: Cystic acne
fields.definition: "A severe type of acne characterized by the formation of cysts enclosing a mixture of keratin and sebum." [PMID:9212761]

fields.label: Radiculomegaly
fields.definition: "Tooth root length more than 2 SD above mean, or subjectively apparently increased tooth root length." [PMID:29574060, PMID:31468724]
fields.synonyms_concat: Long dental root; Rhizomegaly; Root gigantism

fields.label: Hypertrichotic hyperpigmented patch
fields.definition: "A large nonpalpable spot of the skin over 1 cm in dimension with increased pigmentation and increased hair growth." [PMID:18410979]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cutaneous hyperpigmentation with overlying hypertrichosis

fields.label: Increased circulating selenium concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of selenium in the blood circulation." [PMID:25519493]

fields.label: Decreased circulating selenium concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally reduced concentration of selenium in the blood circulation." [PMID:25519493]

fields.label: Ballooning hepatocyte degeneration
fields.definition: "Swelling of the hepatocyte, rounding of its contour, and alteration of the cytoplasm, which takes on a reticulated, rarefied, or flocculant quality. The cytoplasm of the ballooned hepatocytes often contains clumps of eosinophilic ropey material known as Mallory-Denk bodies (MDBs) or Mallory hyaline, which is composed of hyperphosphorylated misfolded intermediate filaments, ubiquitin, and ubiquitin-binding protein P62." [PMID:31603713, PMID:31885839]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ballooning degeneration of hepatocytes

fields.label: Perioral erythema
fields.definition: "Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the mouth." []

fields.label: Perianal erythema
fields.definition: "Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the anus." []

fields.label: Portal inflammation
fields.definition: "Infiltration of portal fields by inflammatory cells." [PMID:16939061, PMID:19142989]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hepatic portal inflammation

fields.label: Hepatic lobular inflammation
fields.definition: "Infiltration of inflammatory cells in lobules of the liver. A focus of lobular inflammation can be defined as two or more inflammatory cells (neutrophils, lymphocytes and other mononuclear cells, eosinophils and microgranulomas) within the lobule present within the sinusoids or surrounding injured hepatocytes (ballooned or apoptotic hepatocytes)." [PMID:31583739]

fields.label: Triggered by viral infection
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by a virus." []

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 10 concentration
fields.definition: "An elevation of the concentration of interleukin 10 in the blood circulation." [PMID:18424693]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased serum interleukin 10

fields.label: Triceps hyporeflexia
fields.definition: "Reduced intensity of the triceps tendon reflex." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyporeflexia of triceps

fields.label: Biceps hyporeflexia
fields.definition: "Reduced intensity of the biceps tendon reflex." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyporeflexia of biceps

fields.label: Brachioradialis hyporeflexia
fields.definition: "Reduced intensity of the brachioradialis tendon reflex." [PMID:32119424]

fields.label: Brachioradialis hyperreflexia
fields.definition: "Increased intensity of the brachioradialis reflex." [PMID:32119424]

fields.label: Triceps hyperreflexia
fields.definition: "Increased intensity of the triceps reflex." [PMID:30285397]

fields.label: Biceps hyperreflexia
fields.definition: "Increased intensity of the biceps reflex." [PMID:30285397]

fields.label: Hyperactive Achilles reflex
fields.definition: "Increased intensity of the Achilles reflex." [PMID:30285397]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperactive ankle jerk reflex; Hyperactive ankle reflex

fields.label: Increased CD21low B cell proportion
fields.definition: "Increased proportion relative to B-lymphocytes of a subset of B lymphocytes characterized by dim/low levels of CD21, i.e., CD21-/low, in flow cytometry, and additionally enriched in autoreactive clones as determined for instance by clonse showing rheumatoid factor (anti-IgG) reactivity and antibodies recognizing cytoplasmic and to a lesser extent nuclear structures." [PMID:26119182]
synonyms: Increased proportion autoreactive unresponsive CD21-/low B cells
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased proportion autoreactive unresponsive CD21-/low B cells

fields.label: Alveolar capillary dysplasia
fields.definition: "A developmental defect of the alveolar airspace during cananicular lung development characterized by a decreased number of pulmonary capillaries located away from the alveolar epithelium, thickened alveolar septae, media hypertrophy of small pulmonary arteries and muscularization of distal arterioles, and in some cases lymphangiectasis." [PMID:21471096]

fields.label: Acinar dysplasia
fields.definition: "Arrest of lung development in the pseudoglandular stage (weeks 8 to 16 of human gestation) resulting in small sized lungs, predominantly composed of bronchial and bronchiolar structures embedded in abundant loose mesenchyme that is poorly vascularized. Acinar structures are essentially absent, with no significant formation of saccules and no alveoli." [PMID:31151956, PMID:31189067]

fields.label: Congenital alveolar dysplasia
fields.definition: "Arrest of lung development in the cananicular stage (weeks 18 to 26 of human gestation) resulting in simplified acinar spaces, frequently with abundant intervening mesenchyme and no alveoli. In later arrest growth stages early saccular formations may be seen. May resemble the lobular maldevelopment often seen in alveolar capillary dysplasia/misaligment of the pulmonary veins without vein misalignment or marked hypertensive changes of the pulmonary arteries." [PMID:31189067]

fields.label: Decreased total iron binding capacity
fields.definition: "A reduction in the total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added. The latent (or free) iron binding capacity is the difference between the TIBC and the measured serum iron, corresponding to the transferrin not bound to iron, i.e., free iron binding capacity." [PMID:3542299]

fields.label: Abnormal total iron binding capacity
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added." [PMID:3542299]

fields.label: Elevated urine suberic acid level
fields.definition: "The concentration of suberic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:6466694]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urine octanedioic acid level

fields.label: Recurrent viral pneumonia
fields.definition: "Increased susceptibility to viral pneumonia, as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral pneumonias." [PMID:27427983]

fields.label: Obliterative abnormality of the renal glomerulus
fields.label_normalized: obliterative abnormality of the renal glomerulus

fields.label: Glomerular hyalinosis
fields.definition: "Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus. Distribution can include vascular pole, perihilar, tip or neither tip, perihilar or vascular." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Perihilar glomerular hyalinosis
fields.definition: "Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the vascular pole/perihilum." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Glomerular hyalinosis at the tubular pole
fields.definition: "Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the tip/tubular pole." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.label_normalized: glomerular hyalinosis at the tubular pole

fields.label: Glomerular hyalinosis away from the vascular and tubular poles
fields.definition: "Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at neither tip nor perihilar/vascular poles. Both the vascular and the tubular pole are present in the glomerular cross section." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.label_normalized: glomerular hyalinosis away from the vascular and tubular poles

fields.label: 2-ethylhydracylic aciduria
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of 2-ethylhydracylic acid in the urine." [PMID:15615815]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urinary 2-ethylhydracylic acid; Elevated urinary 2-methylbutyrylglycine

fields.label: Increased CD4:CD8 ratio
fields.definition: "An abnormal elevation of the relative proportion of CD4+ to CD8+ T cells." []

fields.label: Inverted CD4:CD8 ratio
fields.definition: "CD4:CD8 ratio less than 1, measured either as proportion of total CD3+ T cells, or in absolute numbers per microliter. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population. Normally there are relatively more CD4+ than CD8+ T cells." [PMID:29095912]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased CD4:CD8 ratio; Inverted CD4/CD8 ratio

fields.label: Abnormal glomerular parietal epithelial cell morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality of the parietal epithelial cells that line the inside of Bowman's capsule and form an inconspicuous sheet of flat epithelial cells in continuity with the proximal tubular epithelial cells at the urinary pole and with the podocytes at the vascular pole." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:28361304]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal glomerular parietal epithelial cell morphology

fields.label: Glomerular parietal epithelial cell hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Increased number of parietal epithelial cells lining Bowman's capsule. Hyperplasia leads to the cells being present in 2 or more layers, often with crowding and multilayering." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
synonyms: Hyperplasia of the glomerular parietal epithelial cell
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperplasia of the glomerular parietal epithelial cell

fields.label: Glomerular parietal epithelial cell hypertrophy
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the glomerular parietal epithelial cells characterized by (1) Increased parietal epithelial cell size, with or without cytoplasmic protein droplets; or (2) enlarged nuclei with prominent nucleoli. Both features can be present" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
synonyms: Hypertrophy of the glomerular parietal epithelial cell
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypertrophy of the glomerular parietal epithelial cell

fields.label: Bowman capsular hyaline drops
fields.definition: "An insudative accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material protruding from Bowman's capsule into the urinary space. Although not always evident by light microscopy, this material is located between Bowman's capsule and the parietal epithelial cells, in some cases associated with newly formed matrix material." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]
synonyms: Capsular hyaline drops within Bowman's capsule
fields.synonyms_concat: Capsular hyaline drops within Bowman's capsule

fields.label: Glomerular synechial adhesion
fields.definition: "An area of basement membrane continuity between the glomerular tuft and Bowman's capsule, without intervening crescent and not adjacent to an area of segmental sclerosis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Triceps areflexia
fields.definition: "Inability to elicit triceps tendon reflex." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Areflexia of triceps

fields.label: Brachioradialis areflexia
fields.definition: "Inability to elicit brachioradialis tendon reflex." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Areflexia of brachioradialis

fields.label: Biceps areflexia
fields.definition: "Inability to elicit biceps tendon reflex." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Areflexia of biceps

fields.label: Abnormal glomerular mesangial cellularity
fields.definition: "Abnormal number of its constituent cells of the mesangium of the glomerulus of the kidney." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Abnormal glomerular mesangial matrix morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the glomerular matrix. Mesangial cells generate and embed in their own extracellular matrix. The mesangial matrix is different in composition from the glomerular basement membrane. Its constituents are type IV collagen (but only the alpha1 and alpha2 chains); type V collagen; laminin A, B1, and B2; and considerable amounts of fibronectin, heparan sulfate and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans, entactin, and nidogen. Furthermore, small amounts of the proteoglycans decorin and biglycan are found in the mesangial matrix." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:19470685]

fields.label: Paramesangial deposits
fields.definition: "Mesangial immune deposit located adjacent to the paramesangial glomerular basement membrane." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Mesangial hyaline deposition
fields.definition: "Extracellular mesangial accumulation of moderately electron-dense, generally homogenous, amorphous-appearing extracellular material." []

fields.label: Difficulty descending stairs
fields.definition: "Reduced ability to desscend stairs." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Difficulty walking down stairs

fields.label: Cognitive fatigue
fields.definition: "A failure to sustain attention that requires self-motivation to optimize performance." [PMID:21128132]
fields.synonyms_concat: Central fatigue

fields.label: Visceral epithelial cell detachment
fields.definition: "Detachment of visceral epithelial cells (podocytes) from underlying glomerular basement membrane with intervening new loose basement membrane material (pale on Hematoxylin and eosin, periodic acid-Shiff, trichrome, or silver stain) forming a so-called 'halo'." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Detachment of visceral epithelial cells; Podocyte detachment

fields.label: Podocyte microvillous transformation
fields.definition: "Cytoplasmic projections into the urinary space from the luminal side of the podocyte." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Visceral epithelial cell capping
fields.definition: "Layer of hypertrophied visceral epithelial cells overlying a sclerosed segment of the tuft of the glomerulus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Podocyte cap

fields.label: Elevated RV/TLC ratio
fields.definition: "An increase in the ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining aftermaximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in theungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and (3) body plethysmography. An elevated RV/TLC can be interpreted as a sign of air trapping and hyperinflation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:12934788]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperinflation on pulmonary function test; Overinflation on pulmonary function test

fields.label: Polyalveolar lobe
fields.definition: "An elevation of the total count of alveoli as determined by microscopic point-counting of randomly taken lung sections, not secondary to abnormalities in number, size and structure of the airways. In polyaveolar lobe, the number of alveoli is generally increased three to fivefold." [PMID:7463297]

fields.label: Horseshoe lung
fields.definition: "A horseshoe lung is an uncommon congenital abnormality caused by the partial fusion of the bases of both lungs behind the pericardial sac." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:29970781, PMID:3484566]

fields.label: Pulmonary necrosis
fields.definition: "Cellular death affecting one or more parts of the lung. Necrosis is caused by diverse external and internal factors which result in the unregulated digestion of cell components." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158]

fields.label: Glycogen accumulation in pulmonary interstitial cells
fields.definition: "Accumulation of immature interstitial cells containing abundant cytoplasmic glycogen defined by periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) positive cells." [PMID:29957271]
fields.label_normalized: glycogen accumulation in pulmonary interstitial cells

fields.label: Abnormal alveolar type II pneumocyte morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality of alveolar type 2 (ATII) cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:10445627, PMID:27792742]
synonyms: Abnormal alveolar epithelial type II cell morphology
Abnormal pulmonary type II cell morphology
fields.label_normalized: abnormal alveolar type ii pneumocyte morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal alveolar epithelial type II cell morphology; Abnormal pulmonary type II cell morphology; Abnormal type II pneumocyte morphology

fields.label: Type II pneumocyte hypertrophy
fields.definition: "Increase in size of type II pneumocytes, characterized by qualitative morphologic alterations, including cuboidal shapes, increased nucleocytoplasmic ratio, enlarged nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and various alterations in their nuclear chromatin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:17554398, PMID:2166657]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypertrophic alveolar type II cells; Hypertrophic alveolar type II pneumocytes

fields.label: Pulmonary amyloidosis
fields.definition: "Extracellular deposition in lung tissue of a proteinaceous material that, when stained with Congo red, demonstrates apple-green birefringence under polarized light and that has a distinct color when stained with sulfated Alcian blue. Viewed with electron microscopy, the amyloid deposits are seen to be composed of a beta-sheet fibrillar material. These nonbranching fibrils have a diameter of 7.5 to 10 nm and are the result of protein misfolding." []

fields.label: Multiple pulmonary interstitial hyalinized nodules
fields.definition: "Fibrosing nodules, consisting of either unilateral or bilateral central whorled deposits of lamellar collagen hyalin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:31538016]

fields.label: Focal substantia nigra T2 hyperintensity
fields.definition: "Hyperintense lesion in the substantia nigra on magnetic resonance T2 imaging." []
synonyms: Focal substantia nigra T2 hyperintense lesion
fields.synonyms_concat: Focal substantia nigra T2 hyperintense lesion

fields.label: Nailfold capillary tortuosity
fields.definition: "An increased number of turns of the blood vessels of the nailfold with a charactereistic winded or twisted appearance of the blood vessels." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25029335]

fields.label: Elevated residual volume
fields.definition: "Increase in the amount of air remaining in a person's lungs after full exhalation." [PMID:12934788]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated RV

fields.label: Palmar hyperlinearity
fields.definition: "Exaggerated skin markings (dermatoglyphics) on the palms of the hand." [PMID:23301728]

fields.label: Reduced circulating interferon gamma concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction in the concentration of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced circulating interferon gamma

fields.label: Anorectal stricture
fields.definition: "Narrowing of the anorectum associated with inflammation or scar tissue." [PMID:25109493]
fields.synonyms_concat: Stricture of the anorectum

fields.label: Congenital lobar overinflation
fields.definition: "A congenital malformation characterized by an overdistended segment of lung, affecting an party of a lobe or the entire one. It results in progressive overinflation of one or more lobes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:31118601]
fields.synonyms_concat: Congenital lobar emphysema

fields.label: Pancolitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the entire colon." [PMID:16189424]

fields.label: Delayed ability to walk with support
fields.definition: "A failure to achieve the ability to walk with support (cruise) at an appropriate developmental stage." []
fields.label_normalized: delayed ability to walk with support
fields.synonyms_concat: Delayed ability to cruise

fields.label: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy
fields.definition: "Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) is a sudden, unexpected, witnessed or unwitnessed, non-traumatic and non-drowning death, occurring in benign circumstances, in an individual with epilepsy, with or without evidence for a seizure and excluding documented status epilepticus, in which postmortem examination has not revealed a cause of death." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9588-2944, PMID:22191982]
fields.synonyms_concat: SUDEP

fields.label: Non-motor seizure
fields.definition: "A seizure with clinical manifestation but without motor signs (other than possible behavior arrest) as its initial clinical manifestation. The electrographic onset may be generalized, focal, or unknown." [PMID:2827606, PMID:28276060]

fields.label: Livedo racemosa
fields.definition: "Livedo racemosa describes a reddish-blue mottling of the skin in an irregular, reticular pattern. It differs from the more common livedo reticularis by its shape. Livedo racemosa consists of broken circular segments resulting in a seemingly larger pattern, as opposed to the fine, regular, complete network of livedo reticularis. Livedo racemosa results from permanent impairment of peripheral blood flow and, unlike livedo reticularis, it persists on warming." [PMID:26500860, PMID:31753828]

fields.label: Renal artery aneurysm
fields.definition: "Increase in diameter of a segment of the renal artery that can be defined as a focal, isolated dilatation of all three layers of the arterial wall over 1.5 times the diameter of the disease-free proximal adjacent arterial segment." [PMID:25537277]

fields.label: Transphyseal fracture of the distal humerus
fields.definition: "A fracture through the distal humeral physis that separates the entire distal humeral epiphysis from the metaphysis." [PMID:26808044]
fields.label_normalized: transphyseal fracture of the distal humerus
fields.synonyms_concat: Transphyseal distal humerus fracture

fields.label: Absent platelet dense granules
fields.definition: "Lack of platelet dense granules, a type of platelet organelles." [PMID:11809908]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent platelet dense bodies

fields.label: Enlarged platelet dense granules
fields.definition: "Increased size of platelet dense granules." [PMID:16551969]

fields.label: Podocyte myelin figures
fields.definition: "Lamellated intracytoplasmic lipid inclusions within podocytes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Podocyte myelin inclusions

fields.label: Glomerular pseudocrescent
fields.definition: "Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia with resulting cellular crowding of the the urinary space. In contrast with true crescents, these proliferations lack inflammatory cells and fibrin. The cells are typically plump (not spindle-shaped) and often vacuolated, and Bowman's capsule is usually intact." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Abnormal glomerular capillary lumen morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the capillary of the renal glomerulus." [PMID:24875196]

fields.label: Deflation of the glomerular tuft
fields.definition: "Wrinkling and folding of the capillaries without epithelial cell (podocyte) hyperplasia (formerly called ischemic type of collapse) involving o 80% of the glomerular tuft. The wrinkling is generally made by small regular folds of the glomerular basement membrane." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:27102348]

fields.label: Glomerular capillary collapse
fields.definition: "Collapse is generally accompanied by other descriptors such as hypertrophy and hyperplasia of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, halo, protein droplets in podocytes and glomerular parietal epithelial cells (PECs)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Collapse of glomerular capillary walls

fields.label: Glomerular capillary congestion
fields.definition: "Global distention of glomerular capillaries with intraluminal intact red blood cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Glomerular congestion

fields.label: Glomerular capillary microaneurysm
fields.definition: "Glomerular capillary dilatation due to loosening/detachment of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) from its anchoring points, usually in the context of mesangiolysis or nodular glomerulosclerosis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Abnormal glomerular endothelial cell morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormal structure of the glomerular endothelial cells, which are highly specialized cells with fenestrae and a charged luminal glycocalyx layer that contribute to the filtration barrier." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29629372]

fields.label: Loss of glomerular endothelial cell fenestration
fields.definition: "Loss of round to oval discontinuities normally present in the glomerular capillary endothelial cell cytoplasm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:19129259]
fields.label_normalized: loss of glomerular endothelial cell fenestration

fields.label: Glomerular endotheliosis
fields.definition: "Enlargement of glomerular endothelial cells by cytoplasmic swelling with resulting partial or complete occlusion of the lumen." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:14511965]

fields.label: Glomerular endothelial tubuloreticular inclusion
fields.definition: "Inter-anastomosing tubular structures located within cisternae of endoplasmic reticulum, most often within endothelial cells and associated with exposure to interferon." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:23957425]

fields.label: Glomerular fibrinoid necrosis
fields.definition: "Fibrin associated with glomerular basement membrane disruption and/or lysis of the mesangial matrix; this lesion does not require the presence of karyorrhexis." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29459092]

fields.label: Reduced CD95-induced lymphocyte apoptosis
fields.definition: "Reduced amount of programmed cell death in peripheral blood lymphocytes following exposure to CD95 (APO-1/Fas), which is a member of the death receptor family, a subfamily of the TNF-R superfamily. Crosslinking of CD95 with its natural ligand CD95L (CD178) or with agonistic antibodies such as anti-APO-1 induces apoptosis in sensitive cells." [PMID:21625644]

fields.label: Enterocutaneous fistula
fields.definition: "An abnormal connection (fistula) between the intra-abdominal intestinal tract and the skin." [PMID:27247538]

fields.label: Paratracheal lymphadenopathy
fields.definition: "Enlargement of lymph nodes surrounding the trachea." [PMID:4023240]

fields.label: Circulating nucleated red blood cells
fields.definition: "The presence of nucleated red blood cells in the peripheral blood circulation." [PMID:28633658]

fields.label: Abnormal glomerular basement membrane morphology
fields.definition: "Any abnormal sttructure of the glomerular basement membrane." [PMID:29435440]

fields.label: Segmentally thickened glomerular basement membrane
fields.definition: "Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting a segmental and increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Diffusely thickened glomerular basement membrane
fields.definition: "Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Thickened glomerular basement membranes with no electron dense deposits
fields.definition: "Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by electron microscopy." []
fields.label_normalized: thickened glomerular basement membranes with no electron dense deposits

fields.label: Thickened glomerular basement membranes with electron dense deposits
fields.label_normalized: thickened glomerular basement membranes with electron dense deposits

fields.label: Glomerular basement membrane lucencies
fields.definition: "Lucent zones within the glomerular basement membranes. May reflect remote/resolved deposits." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Glomerular basement membrane wrinkling
fields.definition: "Irregular folding of the glomerular basement membrane with an intact lamina densa." []

fields.label: Glomerular subendothelial widening
fields.definition: "Expansion of the space between the glomerular endothelium and lamina densa by electron-lucent material." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:21827618, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Glomerular karyhorrhectic debris
fields.definition: "Apoptotic, pyknotic, and fragmented nuclei within the glomerulus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Glomerular fibrin thrombus
fields.definition: "An aggregate of coagulated blood containing fibrin, with or without entrapped cellular elements, within a glomerular capillary lumen." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Glomerular hyaline pseudothrombus
fields.definition: "Intracapillary amorphous, eosinophilic material consisting of immune deposits." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Glomerular lipoprotein thrombus
fields.definition: "Intracapillary silver-positive material that is finely vacuolated and laminated, and stains with oil red O on frozen sections." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Mesangial Immune complex deposition
fields.definition: "Extracellular meangial accumulation of finely granular material corresponding to immunoglobulin and/or complement by immunofluorescence/immunohistochemistry; most typically electron-dense although this may decrease with resorption of the deposit." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Binucleated visceral epithelial cells
fields.definition: "Visceral epithelial cells with 2 nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.synonyms_concat: Binucleated podocytes

fields.label: Multinucleated visceral epithelial cells
fields.definition: "Visceral epithelial cells with more than two nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multinucleated podocytes; Podocyte multinucleation

fields.label: Abnormal circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal concentration in blood of factor H-related protein 1 (FHR-1)" [PMID:27814381]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal circulating complement factor h related protein 1 concentration

fields.label: Reduced circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration
fields.definition: "Decreased level of circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration in the blood circulation." []
fields.label_normalized: reduced circulating complement factor h related protein 1 concentration

fields.label: Increased circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration
fields.definition: "Elevated level of circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration in the blood circulation." []
fields.label_normalized: increased circulating complement factor h related protein 1 concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating 1-methylhistidine concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased level of 1-methylhistidine in the blood circulation. 1-methylhistidine is a derivative of L-histidine." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of 4-Hydroxyphenylacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary monocarboxylic acid level
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased amount of a monocarboxylic acid in the urine. Monocarboxylic acids are molecules with one COOH functional group." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating fetuin A concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of fetuin A in the blood circulation." [PMID:25468829]

fields.label: Decreased circulating fetuin A concentration
fields.definition: "A reduction below normal of fetuin A in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Increased circulating fetuin A concentration
fields.definition: "An elevation above normal of fetuin A in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Patellar overgrowth
fields.definition: "Excessive growth of the kneecap (patella)." []

fields.label: Ileoileal intussusception
fields.definition: "A type of intussusception of the small intestine in which one part of the ileum invaginates (telescopes) into another part of the ileum." [PMID:17872641]

fields.label: Osmotic diarrhea
fields.definition: "Osmotic diarrhea results from the presence of osmotically active, poorly absorbed solutes in the bowel lumen that inhibit normal water and electrolyte absorption." [PMID:22677080]

fields.label: Abdominal aortic dissection
fields.definition: "A tear in the intimal layer of the abdominal aorta causing a separation between the intima and the medial layers." [PMID:15902826]

fields.label: Abnormal Bowman space morphology
fields.definition: "Structural anomaly located in Bowman's space, which represents the beginning of the urinary space and is contiguous with the proximal convoluted tubule of the nephron." [PMID:32119361]

fields.label: Urinary space collagenization
fields.definition: "Acellular collagenous matrix within Bowman's space, not associated with extracapillary hypercellularity or necrosis, associated with sclerosis or deflation of the tuft." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Collagenization of the urinary space

fields.label: Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Increased number of visceral epithelial cells (2 or more layers), often with crowding and multilayering, but without continuity with the parietal epithelium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperplasia of visceral epithelial cells; Podocyte hyperplasia

fields.label: Visceral epithelial hyaline droplets
fields.definition: "Round to ovoid, Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, fuchsinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions within visceral epithelial cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Glomerular crescent formation
fields.definition: "Glomerular crescent refers hyperplastic lesions involving 10% or more of the circumference of Bowman's capsule. Crescents can be composed of a variable mixture of epithelial/leukocyte hypercellularity, fibrous matrix, and fibrin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32132388]

fields.label: Cellular crescent
fields.definition: "A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of greater than two cell layers and involving more than 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of greater than 75% cells with or without fibrin, and less than 25% fibrous matrix." [PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Fibrocellular crescent
fields.definition: "A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of more than 2 cell layers and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of 25% to 75% cells with or without fibrin, and the remainder fibrous matrix." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Fibrous crescent
fields.definition: "A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary fibrosis composed of greater than 75% matrix and of less than 25% cells with or without fibrin, usually associated with disruption of Bowman's capsule and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Mesangial cell loss
fields.definition: "Loss of mesangial cells segmentally or globally." []

fields.label: Glomerular obsolescence
fields.definition: "Globally sclerotic glomeruli are that are small and without hyalinosis and may appear with collapse of the tuft with collagenization of the urinary space. Bowman's capsule is completely or partially absent and there is no periglomerular fibrosis and glomerular size is decreased by more than 50% compared to all other glomeruli in the same biopsy. Obsolescent glomeruli may appear to be receding into the interstitium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Glomerular capillary wall duplication without cellular interposition
fields.definition: "Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix, with or without endocapillary hypercellularity and no evidence of interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.label_normalized: glomerular capillary wall duplication without cellular interposition

fields.label: Glomerular capillary wall duplication with cellular interposition
fields.definition: "Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix with interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.label_normalized: glomerular capillary wall duplication with cellular interposition

fields.label: Elevated circulating homovanillic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of homovanillic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating sebacic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of sebacic acid in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating hydroxyphenlyllactic acid concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of 4-hydroxyphenlyllactic acid in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Nail psoriasis
fields.definition: "Psoriatic nail abnormality characterized by the presence of neutrophils in the nail bed epithelium, hyperkeratosis with parakeratosis, presence of exudates on the corneal epithelium, focal hypogranulosis and psoriasiform hyperplasia of the nail bed." [PMID:24770509, PMID:27041288]

fields.label: Type II pneumocyte hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Increase in the number of type II pneumocytes." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:11079017]

fields.label: Abnormal postural reflex
fields.definition: "Anomaly of the physiological response to maintain the body's posture when movement and position is altered." [PMID:15246484]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal postural reaction

fields.label: Impaired neck-righting reflex
fields.definition: "Abnormal neck-righting response, which is said to be a physiological response when a child is placed flat on his or her back and the head is turned 90 degrees to the right or the left. With a normal neck-righting response, there follows a reflected torsion of the vertebral column in the same direction as the induced rotation of the neck. That is, the whole body follows the direction in which the head was turned. The response is present from birth to the age of five years." [PMID:13502822]

fields.label: Acute phase response
fields.definition: "Presence of one or more manifestations of the acute phase response. Acute phase proteins (APP) are blood proteins primarily synthesized by hepatocytes as part of the acute phase response (APR). The APR is part of the early-defense or innate immune system, which is triggered by different stimuli including trauma, infection, stress, neoplasia, and inflammation. The APR results in a complex systemic reaction with the goal of reestablishing homeostasis and promoting healing." [PMID:20034426, PMID:30137854]

fields.label: Elevated circulating amyloid A concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of serum amyloid A in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:30165816]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating amyloid A

fields.label: Jaw contracture
fields.definition: "Limitation of motion of the jaw due to structural changes in a muscle such as the massseter responsible for jaw movement." [PMID:12453260]

fields.label: Abnormal embryonic development
fields.definition: "An anomaly in the development of the embryo, that is, of the early developmental stage of development that follows the fertilization of an egg by sperm." [PMID:32680920]

fields.label: Abnormal preimplantation embryonic development
fields.definition: "An anomaly in the development of the embryo in a stage prior to implantation." []

fields.label: Zygotic cleavage failure
fields.definition: "Failure of a fertilized oocyte to undergo the first round of cell division." [PMID:32502391]
fields.synonyms_concat: Failure of zygotic cell division

fields.label: Abnormal gametogenesis
fields.definition: "An anomaly in the process by a a haploid cell is formed from a diploid cells through meiosis. In males, diploid spermatogonia produce two haploid cells (secondary spermatocytes) in meiosis I and four haploid spermatids in meiosis II. In females, primordial germ cells under meiosis II before birth to form primary oocytes. Once puberty cell begins, these cells form secondary oocytes through meiosis II." []

fields.label: Abnormal female meiosis
fields.definition: "Anomalous oocyte meiosis" []

fields.label: Increased circulating inosine concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of inosine in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Increased circulating guanosine concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of guanosine in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating sitosterol concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of beta-sitosterol in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating beta-sitosterol concentration

fields.label: Anti-aquaporin 4 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against aquaporin-4." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:24260168, PMID:24415568, PMID:25889963, PMID:31312230]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-AQP4 antibody positivity

fields.label: Mucoid diarrhea
fields.definition: "Passage of an increased number of stools containing mucus, a thick fluid substance secreted by mucous membranes." [PMID:31869107]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mucous diarrhea; Mucous diarrhoea

fields.label: Pleural cobblestoning
fields.definition: "A pleural cobblestone appearance characterized by irregular bumps surrounded by depressed lines in open lung biopsy. Caused by underlying scarring causing retraction of the interlobular septa where they insert on the pleura." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:27618319]

fields.label: Neuralgia
fields.definition: "Pain (An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience) along the course of a nerve." []

fields.label: Psychic epileptic aura
fields.definition: "Aura with affective, mnemonic or composite perceptual phenomena including illusory or composite hallucinatory events." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Psychic aura

fields.label: Cognitive epileptic aura
fields.definition: "A purely subjective manifestation of an epileptic seizure pertaining to altered cognition." []

fields.label: Epileptic aura
fields.definition: "An epileptic aura is a purely subjective clinical manifestation of an epileptic seizure. If an epileptic aura is not followed by loss of awareness or propagation to a bilateral tonic-clonic seizure then it is a type of focal aware non-motor seizure." []

fields.label: Seizure cluster
fields.definition: "A fourfold or greater increase of usual seizure frequency within a 3-day period, where the patient demonstrates full recovery between seizure events within the cluster. The seizure cluster should be recognizable by the primary clinician, carer or patient." [PMID:29871784, PMID:32305858]
fields.synonyms_concat: Acute repetitive seizures; Crescendo seizures; Cyclical seizures; Recurrent seizures; Seizure flurries; Serial seizures

fields.label: Elevated forced expiratory volume in one second
fields.definition: "An increase in the amount of air a person can forcefully expel in one second, compared to some standard or previous measure of same subject." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5361-6739, PMID:19671143]
fields.label_normalized: elevated forced expiratory volume in one second
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated FEV1

fields.label: Candida esophagitis
fields.definition: "Candida infections of the esophagus are considered opportunistic infections and are seen most commonly in immunosuppressed patients, the most common symptoms being dysphagia, odynophagia, and retrosternal pain." [PMID:30725953]
fields.synonyms_concat: Esophageal candidiasis

fields.label: Pulmonary hypertensive crisis
fields.definition: "Pulmonary hypertensive crisis involves sudden and potentially lethal increases in PAP and PVR that cause acute rise in right atrial and right ventricular end-diastolic pressure accompanied by low cardiac output." [PMID:27295157]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pulmonary arterial hypertension crisis

fields.label: Abnormal blood vessel morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of a blood vessel (artery, arteriole, capillary, venule, or vein)." []

fields.label: Abnormal urine metabolite level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal amount of a metabolite in urine." []

fields.label: Increased urine deoxypyridinoline level
fields.definition: "An increased level of deoxypyridinoline in the urine. Deoxypyridinoline is a crosslink product of collagen molecules found in bone and excreted in urine during bone degradation, has been described as a marker of bone turnover." [PMID:12661898, PMID:9127470]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urinary DPD

fields.label: Elevated circulating o-phosphoserine concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased level of o-phosphoserine in the blood circulation. o-phosphoserine is a derivative of serine." []

fields.label: Limited head rotation
fields.definition: "Reduced range of motion turning the head side to side." []

fields.label: Abnormal urine osmolality
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal range of concentration of particles in urine." []

fields.label: Hyperosthenuria
fields.definition: "An abnormally high urinary specific gravity, i.e., increased concentration of solutes in the urine." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urine osmolality; Elevated urine osmolarity

fields.label: Impaired ability to shift attention
fields.definition: "A behavioral abnormality whereby a person is unable to move freely from one situation, activity or aspect of aa problem to another as circumstances demand. Key aspects of shifting include the ability to make transitions, problem solve flexibly, switch or alternate attention, and change focus from one mind-set or topic to another. Mild deficits in the ability to shift compromise the efficiency of problem solving, whereas more severe difficulties are reflected in perseverative behaviors. Sometimes this is described as being rigid or inflexible." [PMID:23356593]
fields.synonyms_concat: Impaired task shifting

fields.label: Nasal ulcer
fields.definition: "An open sore of the nasal mucosa." [PMID:11314863, PMID:25441476, PMID:26657735]

fields.label: Recurrent coughing spasms
fields.definition: "Repeated occurrence of episodes of coughing, with each episode consisting of at least five minutes of continuous coughing." []

fields.label: Hyaline membranes
fields.definition: "Hyaline membranes are homogeneous eosinophilic material composed of cellular debris, plasma proteins, and surfactant plastered against alveolar ducts and alveolar walls. The hyaline membranes are deposited along the walls of the alveoli, where gas exchange typically occurs, thereby making gas exchange difficult." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:24224590]

fields.label: Lipoid pneumonia
fields.definition: "A specific form of lung inflammation that results from accumulation of lipids in the alveoli. Lipoid pneumonia can be either exogenous or endogenous in cause based on the source of the lipid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:20028911]

fields.label: Endogenous lipoid pneumonia
fields.definition: "A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is the body itself. When an airway is obstructed, it is often the case that distal to the obstruction, lipid-laden macrophages and giant cells fill the lumen of the disconnected airspace." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:20028911]

fields.label: Exogenous lipoid pneumonia
fields.definition: "A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is external to the body." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:20028911]

fields.label: Orthodeoxia
fields.definition: "Low level of blood oxygen induced by changing from a recumbent to an upright position." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:27669319]

fields.label: Platypnea
fields.definition: "A type of dyspnea that occurs when the affected person changes from a recumbent to an upright position." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:27669319]

fields.label: Cavitating leukodystrophy
fields.definition: "A type of leukodystrophy characterized by multiple small cavitations typically in the periventricular and deep cerebral white matter. The cavitations are visible as a central cavity with cerebrospinal fluid-like signal intensity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32522799]

fields.label: Bronchial telangiectasia
fields.definition: "Telangiectasias (small dilated blood vessels located near the surface of the skin or mucous membranes) located in the trachoebronchial system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:31466963, PMID:3359830]
fields.synonyms_concat: Endobronchial telangiectasia

fields.label: Bronchocentric granulomatosis
fields.definition: "Granulomatous inflammation that surrounds the bronchi and bronchioles, replacing bronchial walls and mucosa. In bronchocentric granulomatosis, the lumen of the airway contains necrotic debris, and palisaded histiocytes surround the lumen." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:26744680]

fields.label: Abnormal KCO
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of KCO. The KCO is a measurement of the rate constant for alveolar uptake of CO during breath-holding in the single breath measurement of DLCO at full inflation. The DLCO is derived as the product of the KCO and the single breath alveolar volume (VA) divided by PB-PH2O." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:11334115]

fields.label: Increased KCO
fields.definition: "Increased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:11334115]

fields.label: Decreased KCO
fields.definition: "Decreased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:11334115]

fields.label: Anthracosis
fields.definition: "Anthracosis is the deposition of black carbon pigment. It is commonly seen in perihilar lymph nodes as well as within lung parenchyma. There can be prominent storiforming (i.e., spiral patterning) of histiocytes, to such an extent as to mimic a neoplastic lesion histologically. Anthracosis is a common finding in smokers and polluted city dwellers." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:29892540]

fields.label: Alveolar septal thickening
fields.definition: "Increased width of the alveolar septum, which is the structure that separates neighboring alveoli. This finding can be appreciated on histology." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158]

fields.label: Increased airway neuroendocrine cells
fields.definition: "Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cells (NECs) within distal airways. There are no formal criteria for an increase (which is also dependent on the sensitivity of the staining method), findings of neuroendocrine cells in at least 70% of bronchioles by lung biopsy and at least 10% NECs in an individual airway are consistent with the diagnosis of Neuroendocrine cell hyperplasia of infancy in the appropriate clinical setting. Increases are also seen in other clinical settings. Neuroendocrine neoplasms of the lung encompass NE tumors (NETs), which split into typical and atypical carcinoids, and NE carcinomas (NECs)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:20884725, PMID:26474448, PMID:30521210, PMID:32558323, PMID:33306420]

fields.label: Increased airway neuroepithelial bodies
fields.definition: "Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cell cluster (neuroepithelial bodies) in the alveolar ducts." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:10623675]

fields.label: Bilateral superior vena cava
fields.definition: "The presence of a left and a right superior vena cava." [PMID:18847480]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bilateral SVC

fields.label: Nasal chondritis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the cartilage of the nose." [PMID:33108101]
fields.synonyms_concat: Nose chondritis

fields.label: Elevated circulating stearoylcarnitine concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased concentration of O-stearoylcarnitine in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating C18:0 acylcarnitine concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating palmitoylcarnitine concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased concentration of palmitoylcarnitine in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating 16:0 acylcarnitine concentration

fields.label: Decreased compound muscle action potential amplitude
fields.definition: "Reduced level of the compound muscle action potential (CMAP), which is recorded following electrical stimulation of a nerve from surface electrodes overlying a muscle supplied by that nerve." [PMID:15961865]
fields.label_normalized: decreased compound muscle action potential amplitude
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased CMAP amplitude

fields.label: Elevated urinary collagen degradation products
fields.definition: "Increased level in the urine of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease." []

fields.label: Elevated urine pyridinoline level
fields.definition: "An increased amount of pyridinoline in the urine." [PMID:26306627]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urine hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline level

fields.label: Abnormal circulating collagen degradation product concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormal concentration in the blood circulation of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal circulating collagen degradation product concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating pyridinoline concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline (pyridinoline) in the blood circulation." [PMID:26306627]

fields.label: Abnormal bronchial artery morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural abnormality of a bronchial artery." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:25590386]

fields.label: Bronchopulmonary anastomosis
fields.definition: "Abnormal arterial anastomosis (connection) between bronchial and pulmonary arteries." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:10598843]

fields.label: Bronchial artery dilatation
fields.definition: "Increased caliber of a bronchial artery, which can be defined as a bronchial artery diameter that exceeds 2 mm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:25590386, PMID:32430593]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bronchial artery enlargement; Dilatation of a bronchial artery

fields.label: Bronchial artery hypertrophy
fields.definition: "Increase in the volume of bronchial artery wall due to the enlargement of its component cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:25590386]

fields.label: Perivascular pre-capillary pulmonary artery inflammation
fields.definition: "Inflammatory cell infiltration surrounding precapillary pulmonary arteries (arterioles; 20-70 micrometer)." []
synonyms: Perivascular inflammation of arterioles in the pulmonary circulation
Perivascular inflammation of pre-capillary pulmonary arteries
fields.synonyms_concat: Perivascular inflammation of arterioles in the pulmonary circulation; Perivascular inflammation of pre-capillary pulmonary arteries

fields.label: Irregularly shaped sperm tail
fields.definition: "Irregular or changing caliber (diameter) along the tail of the sperm." [PMID:26472152]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sperm flagella with irregular caliber; Sperm flagella with irregular calibre

fields.label: Anti-carbonic anhydrase II antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against carbonic anhydrase II." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:16932997]

fields.label: Antilactoferrin antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against lactoferrin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:16932997]

fields.label: Glomerular extracapillary fibrin
fields.definition: "Presence of ropey, eosinophilic material (brght red on Trichrome staining) consistent with extracapillary fibrin outside of capillary lumina." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Bowman-space proteinaceous debris
fields.definition: "The presence of eosinophilic Periodic Acid Schiff (PAS)-positive cell free, protein-derived material occupying Bowman's space." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Pleural plaque
fields.definition: "Deposits of hyalinized collagen fibers in the parietal pleura (preferentially pleura adjacent to ribs, particularly the sixth through ninth ribs)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:929215]

fields.label: Persistent fever
fields.definition: "Fever that persists longer than expected for an acute infectious disease. No precise threshold exists, and the clinical interpretation of fever is context-dependent, but as a rule of thumb, this term refers to fever that persists longer than 2-3 weeks." [PMID:14677667]

fields.label: Acute abdomen
fields.definition: "A sudden onset of abdominal pain with associated nausea or vomiting. The acute abdomen may be caused by an infection, inflammation, vascular occlusion, or obstruction." [PMID:29083722]
fields.synonyms_concat: Acute abdominal pain

fields.label: Tissue ischemia
fields.definition: "Ischemia is defined as a restriction of arterial blood supply to a tissue associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolis requirements of the tissue. Depending on the involved tissues, clinical manifestations may include pain, pallor, lack of pulse, coldness, paresthesia, and paralysis. Additional associated manifestations include hemodynamic parameters (reduced blood pressure distal to the site of restricted arterial supply) and angiographic evidence of arterial occclusion." [PMID:10720362, PMID:26858079]

fields.label: Digital ischemia
fields.definition: "Restriction of arterial blood supply to a digit (finger or toe) associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the digit. Clinical manifestations may include pain, pallor, lack of pulse, coldness, paresthesia, and paralysis." []

fields.label: Testicular ischemia
fields.definition: "Restriction of arterial blood supply to a testis associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the tissue. Clinical manifestations may include pain and swelling of the affected testis." [PMID:33102026]

fields.label: Intestinal ischemia
fields.definition: "Restriction of arterial blood supply to the intestine associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the tissue. Acute intestinal ischemia can involve the small or large intestine, and usually presents with sudden severe non-specific abdominal pain." [PMID:30306080]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating organic amino compound concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of an organic amino compound, defined as a compound formally derived from ammonia by replacing one, two or three hydrogen atoms by organyl groups." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal circulating organic amino compound concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating phosphoethanolamine concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of o-phosphoethanolamine in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating o-phosphoethanolamine concentration

fields.label: Elevated urine acetoacetic acid level
fields.definition: "Elevated amount of acetoacetic acid in the urine." [PMID:11344564]

fields.label: Elevated circulating acetoacetic acid concentration
fields.definition: "An increased level of acetoacetic acid in the blood circulation. Acetoacetic acid is one of the predominant ketone bodies." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary 2-hydroxybutyric acid
fields.definition: "An increased amount of 2-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating cartilage oligomeric matrix protein concentration
fields.definition: "An increased blood concentration of cartilage oligomeric matrix protein (COMP)." [PMID:25317315]
fields.label_normalized: elevated circulating cartilage oligomeric matrix protein concentration

fields.label: Lower extremity akinesia
fields.definition: "Inability to initiate changes in activity or movement and to perform ordinary volitional movements rapidly and easily in the lower extremities." []

fields.label: Upper extremity akinesia
fields.definition: "Inability to initiate changes in activity or movement and to perform ordinary volitional movements rapidly and easily in the upper extremities." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Akinesia of the upper extremities

fields.label: Upper extremity hypokinesia
fields.definition: "Abnormally diminished movement of the upper extremities. In contrast to paralysis, hypokinesia is not characterized by a lack of motor strength, but rather by a poverty of movement. The typical habitual movements (e.g., folding the arms, crossing the legs) are reduced in frequency." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypokinesia of the upper extremities

fields.label: Lower extremity hypokinesia
fields.definition: "Abnormally diminished movement of the lower extremities. In contrast to paralysis, hypokinesia is not characterized by a lack of motor strength, but rather by a poverty of movement. The typical habitual movements (e.g., folding the arms, crossing the legs) are reduced in frequency." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypokinesia of the lower extremities

fields.label: Cardiac tamponade
fields.definition: "The accumulation of pericardial fluid with subsequent compression of all cardiac chambers which prevents cardiac filling." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:12917306, PMID:28613742]

fields.label: Hip adductor weakness
fields.definition: "Reduced ability to bring the leg toward the midline of the body." [PMID:28914719]

fields.label: Elevated circulating hydroxybutyric acid concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration in the blood circulation of a hydroxybutyric acid, that is, of a compound comprising a butyric acid core carrying at least one hydroxy substituent." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating 2-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
fields.definition: "Elevation of the 2-hydroxybutyric acid concentration in the blood above the normal range." [PMID:27208342]

fields.label: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
fields.definition: "Elevation of the 3-hydroxybutyric acid concentration in the blood above the normal range." []

fields.label: Pulmonary arterial plexiform lesion
fields.definition: "Focal proliferation of pulmonary artery endothelial cells, leading to the formation of complex capillary-like channels." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:8504682]

fields.label: Pulmonary artery intimal thickening
fields.definition: "Increased thickness of the intimal layer of the pulmonary artery. Throughout the pulmonary arterial tree, the thin intima consists of a non-fenestrated monolayer of endothelial cells lining the vessel lumen, as well as a sub-endothelial interstitium that extends to the internal elastic lamina. Intimal thickness in human lung ranges from 1-16% of total wall thickness. Pulmonary artery intimal thickening can be defined as a relative intima thickness to the thickness of the vessel wall of over 10%." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:23606929, PMID:28025704]

fields.label: Pulmonary artery adventitial fibrosis
