Pulmonary blood flow redistribution is indicated by a decrease in the size and/or number of visible pulmonary vessels in one or more lung regions, with a corresponding increase in number and/or size of pulmonary vessels in other parts of the lung." [PMID:18195376]

fields.label: Frailty
fields.definition: "A clinically recognizable state of increased vulnerability resulting from a decline in reserve and function across multiple physiologic systems such that the ability to cope with everyday or acute stressors is compromised." [PMID:11253156]

fields.label: Posttraumatic stress symptom
fields.definition: "A behavioral or psychological symptom that typically occurs following exposure to one or more traumatic events is posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Symptoms of PTSD include intrusive recollections, such as re-experiencing the trauma through flashbacks, memories, or nightmares. Additionally, individuals may experience avoidant and numbing symptoms, which can include diminished emotions and avoidance of situations that serve as reminders of the traumatic event. Hyperarousal is another symptom, characterized by increased irritability, exaggerated startle reactions, and difficulties with sleeping or concentrating." []
fields.synonyms_concat: PTSD

fields.label: Acute respiratory distress syndrome
fields.definition: "Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is defined as an acute disorder that starts within seven days of the inciting event and is characterized by bilateral lung infiltrates and severe progressive hypoxemia in the absence of any evidence of cardiogenic pulmonary edema. ARDS is defined by the patient's oxygen in arterial blood (PaO2) to the fraction of the oxygen in the inspired air (FiO2). These patients have a PaO2/FiO2 ratio of less than 300." [PMID:28613773]
fields.synonyms_concat: ARDS

fields.label: Acute coronary syndrome
fields.definition: "The term acute coronary syndrome (ACS) refers to any group of clinical symptoms compatible with acute myocardial ischemia and includes unstable angina (UA), non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI), and ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI)." [PMID:19797781]

fields.label: Abnormal red nucleus morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the red nucleus, a part of the midbrain involved in control of movement." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]

fields.label: Pilocytic astrocytoma
fields.definition: "The most common form of astrocytoma (WHO Grade I) in childhood. These typically have MAPK signaling pathway abnormalities." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:23817572]

fields.label: Oligodendroglioma
fields.definition: "Oligodendroglioma is a type of diffusely infiltrating glioma and constitutes approximately 5% of primary intracranial tumors. They often involve the cortical gray matter and are most commonly seen in the frontal lobes. OGs are generally low grade WHO grade II neoplasms that are slow-growing tumors and have a favorable treatment response when compared to other gliomas. Grade III anaplastic OG is a more malignant form of the tumor which portends a less favorable prognosis and may occur de novo or as degeneration from the lower grade OG." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:32644610]

fields.label: Pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma
fields.definition: "Pleomorphic xanthoastrocytomas (PXA) are rare low-grade astrocytomas (WHO Grade II) typically found in the temporal lobe and classically presenting with epilepsy. PXA is an astrocytic neoplasm that most often presents in children or young adults but can also occur in adults. The diagnosis of anaplastic PXA is made based upon tumor histopathologic characteristics and requires increased proliferative activity (mitotic index at least 5 mitoses/10 HPF), which is associated with worse overall survival. In general, anaplastic PXAs acquire features of a more aggressive astrocytic neoplasm that can include increased proliferation, necrosis, microvascular proliferation, loss of pericellular reticulin, and increased infiltrative growth." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:30051528, PMID:31535562]

fields.label: Jaw hyperreflexia
fields.definition: "Increased intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in jaw." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Brisk jaw jerk

fields.label: Abnormal muscle fiber-type distribution
fields.definition: "Ay deviation from the normal distribution of fiber types in skeletal muscle. The skeletal muscle groups of the mammalian body are made up of bundles of muscle fibers. These fibers can be assigned to different Types, with characteristic movement rates, response to neural inputs, and metabolic styles. Skeletal muscle fibers are broadly classified as slow-twitch (type 1) and fast-twitch (type 2). Multiple fiber types are generally intermingled within a single muscle group, and different muscle groups have varying proportions of fiber types" [PMID:27199166]

fields.label: Fiber type grouping
fields.definition: "An abnormal distribution of muscle fiber types in muscle tissue. Human skeletal muscle contains at least two fiber types recognizable by histochemical techniques. In transverse sections of normal skeletal muscle, type 1 and type 2 fibers are distributed in a random fashion. Grouping of fibers of the same type can be seen in certain peripheral neuropathies, thought to be due to reinnervation of denervated muscle fibers by sprouting axons. With grouping, motor units enlarge. The fibers of a motor unit, which are normally scattered, come to lie adjacent to one another. Histochemical examination shows groups of muscle fibers of the same histochemical type." [PMID:32715519]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fibre type grouping

fields.label: Mitochondrial hypertrophy
fields.definition: "Enlargement of mitochondria. Mitochondrial hypertrophy is not discernible by light microscopy. By electron microscopy (EM), hypertrophic mitochondria have normal cristae and normal matrix density. In contrast, swollen mitochondria display swollen cristae and irregular matrix densities in EM." [PMID:32715519]
fields.synonyms_concat: Megamitochondria

fields.label: Short term memory impairment
fields.definition: "A deficit in the retention of pieces of information (memory chunks) for a relatively short time (usually up to 30 seconds)." [PMID:18394484, PMID:31424720]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short term memory loss

fields.label: Long term memory impairment
fields.definition: "A deficit in the ability to retrieve information from long-term memory, which can be defined as a seemingly unlimited capacity to store memories can last years and relate to the performance of actions or skills (i.e., procedural memories, knowing how) and memories of facts, rules, concepts, and events (i.e., declarative memories, knowing that)." [PMID:18394484, PMID:31424720]
fields.synonyms_concat: Long term memory loss

fields.label: Anterograde memory impairment
fields.definition: "The impaired ability to establish new long-term memories." [PMID:24041667]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anterograde amnesia

fields.label: Retrograde memory impairment
fields.definition: "Inability to retrieve information from the long-term memory that was acquired before the onset of amnesia." [PMID:24041667]
fields.synonyms_concat: Retrograde amnesia

fields.label: Procedural memory loss
fields.definition: "A reduction in the ability to retrieve information about how to perform activities, such as how to ride a bike or drive a car, how to perform activities of daily living, or how to play a musical instrument." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Impaired procedural memory; Procedural memory deficit

fields.label: Declarative memory loss
fields.definition: "Impaired ability to remember facts and events." [PMID:33524264]
fields.synonyms_concat: Impaired declarative memory

fields.label: Phantosmia
fields.definition: "Perception of an odor in the absence of any stimuli in the surrounding environment that could emit the odor." [PMID:28334095]
fields.synonyms_concat: Phantom odor; Phantom odour; Phantom smell

fields.label: Tactile hallucination
fields.definition: "Perception of touch without a tactile stimulus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Tactile hallucinations

fields.label: Occupational disability
fields.definition: "This is a general term that denotes a reduced ability to perform the work that one performed prior to an illness, and may be related to pain, cognitive dysfunction, fatigue or other physical disabilities." []

fields.label: Pseudo-chilblain
fields.definition: "Acral areas of erythema with vesicles or pustules. The lesions resemble chilblains and have purpuric areas, affecting hands and feet." [PMID:32348545, PMID:33479703]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chilblain-like lesion

fields.label: Vesicular eruption
fields.definition: "A type of acute-onset skin rash characterized by multiple vesicles, which are circumscribed, fluid-containing, epidermal elevation generally considered less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point. The fluid contained in a vesicle may be clear, serous, or hemorrhagic." [PMID:33008676]

fields.label: Monomorphic vesicular eruption
fields.definition: "A type of vesicular eruption in which the vesicles are at same stages." [PMID:32348545]

fields.label: Polymorphic vesicular eruption
fields.definition: "A type of vesicular eruption in which the vesicles are at different stages." []

fields.label: Papulovesicular eruption
fields.definition: "An acute onset rash characterized by by multiple vesicles, which are circumscribed, fluid-containing, epidermal elevations with a diameter less than 10mm at the widest point, and by multiple papules, which are circumscribed, solid epidermal elevations with no visible fluid with a diameter less than 10mm at the widest point." [PMID:32579185]
fields.synonyms_concat: Papulo-vesicular eruption

fields.label: Cortical sclerosis of the iliac wing
fields.definition: "Increased density related to increased bone mass in the outermost layer (edge) of the iliac wing." [PMID:17404618]
fields.label_normalized: cortical sclerosis of the iliac wing

fields.label: Subpleural curvilinear line
fields.definition: "This finding is a thin curvilinear opacity, 1-3 mm in thickness, lying less than 1 cm from and parallel to the pleural surface. It corresponds to atelectasis of normal lung if seen in the dependent posteroinferior portion of lung of a patient in the supine position and is subsequently shown to disappear on CT sections acquired with the patient prone. It may also be encountered in patients with pulmonary edema or fibrosis (other signs are usually present)." [PMID:18195376]

fields.label: Dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor
fields.definition: "Dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor (DNT) is a benign glioneuronal neoplasm that most commonly occurs in children and young adults and may present with medically intractable, chronic seizures. Lesions vary in size from 10 to 25 mm, although occasionally larger tumors of up to 70 mm have been reported. Grossly, tumors appear as well-defined, solitary nodular masses or poorly demarcated lesions. On the cut section, most tumors are cortically located and may extend into the underlying subcortical white matter in larger tumors. Multi-nodular appearance or cystic changes are commonly found" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:25408925, PMID:26493957]
fields.synonyms_concat: DNET; DNT

fields.label: Elevated urinary homogentisic acid
fields.definition: "An increased amount of homogentisic acid in the urine." [PMID:32809406]

fields.label: Tearfulness
fields.definition: "A feeling of sadness characterized by episodes of crying that can occur suddenly and are not easily controlled in social situations." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Crying episodes

fields.label: Progressive massive fibrosis
fields.definition: "This condition is caused by slow-growing conglomeration of dust particles and collagen deposition in individuals (mostly coal workers) heavily exposed to inorganic dust. Progressive massive fibrosis manifests as masslike lesions, usually bilateral and in the upper lobes. Background nodular opacities reflect accompanying pneumoconiosis, with or without emphysematous destruction adjacent to the massive fibrosis. Lesions similar to progressive massive fibrosis sometimes occur in other conditions, such as sarcoidosis and talcosis." [PMID:18195376]

fields.label: Perioral hyperkeratosis
fields.definition: "Increased thickness of the stratum corneum (the outer layer of the skin) in the skin surrounding the mouth." [PMID:32965877]

fields.label: Anti-3-hydroxy- 3-methylglutaryl-coA reductase antibody positivity
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-3-hydroxy- 3-methylglutaryl-coA reductase antibodies; Anti-HMGCR autoantibodies

fields.label: Increased sputum production
fields.definition: "An increase in the amount of airway mucus. This feature may be characterized by frequent or excessive throat clearing (exhalation through tightly constricted laryngopharyngeal tissues accompanied by vibration of the palatoglossal arch and the vocal folds serving to clear mucus from the airway)." [PMID:16983448, PMID:21121836]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased phlegm

fields.label: Rest dyspnea
fields.definition: "A perception of shortness of breath that occurs independently of exertion." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Breathlessness at rest; Dyspnea at rest; Dyspnoea at rest; Shortness of breath at rest

fields.label: Pulmonary interstitial thickening
fields.definition: "Pathological thickening of the pulmonary interstitium visualized radiographically and divided into interlobular and intralobular septal thickening." []

fields.label: Repeated implantation failure
fields.definition: "Repeated implantation failure refers to a situation in which embryos of good quality fail to implant following several in vitro fertilization (IVF) treatment cycles." [PMID:22976427, PMID:25473625]
fields.synonyms_concat: Recurrent implantation failure

fields.label: Anti-signal recognition particle antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against anti-signal recognition particle." [PMID:29582188, PMID:30639649, PMID:33093664]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-SRP antibody positivity

fields.label: Multiple meningiomas
fields.definition: "The occurrence of multiple distinct meningiomas in the same individual." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:15635074]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multifocal meningiomata; Multiple meningiomata

fields.label: Hippocampal sclerosis
fields.definition: "Hippocampal sclerosis is a neuropathologic finding characterized by neuronal loss and gliosis in the CA-1 and subiculum of the hippocampus." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:12117357, PMID:24762203, PMID:26060898]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mesial temporal sclerosis

fields.label: EEG with frontal epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the frontal region." []

fields.label: EEG with temporal epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the temporal region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]

fields.label: EEG with central epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the central region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]

fields.label: EEG with parietal epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the parietal region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]

fields.label: EEG with occipital epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the occipital region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]

fields.label: EEG with centrotemporal epileptiform discharges
fields.definition: "Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the centrotemporal region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]

fields.label: Autonomic epileptic aura
fields.definition: "An autonomic epileptic aura is a purely subjective manifestation of an epileptic seizure pertaining to autonomic nervous system function. Autonomic auras include cardiorespiratory (e.g., palpitations and shortness of breath), gastrointestinal, genitourinary (genital sensations, urinary urge), and cutaneous (feeling of warmth or cold) sensations. Abdominal auras constitute the most common type of autonomic aura. These include sensations of nausea, pain, or indescribable discomfort in the abdominal or periumbilical area that can be static, rise to the chest and throat, or descend into the lower abdominal region." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:20926350]
fields.synonyms_concat: Autonomic aura; Autonomic auras; Vegetative aura

fields.label: Abnormal cerebral venous sinus morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structure of the venous sinuses that drain blood from the cerebral veins and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the arachnoid granulations to the internal jugular veins." []
synonyms: Abnormality of the cerebral venous sinuses
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal dural venous sinus morphology; Abnormality of the cerebral venous sinuses

fields.label: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
fields.definition: "An intracranial thrombosis of the venous sinuses. These typically present with headache, seizures or venous stroke secondary to raised cerebral venous pressure. Cerebral venous sinus thromboses usually affect larger areas of brain parenchyma than those affected by cerebral vein thromboses." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:29923367]

fields.label: Thin corpus callosum
fields.definition: "An abnormally thin corpus callous, due to atrophy, hypoplasia or agenesis. This term is intended to be used in situations where it is not known if thinning of the corpus callosum (for instance, as visualized by magnetic resonance tomography) is due to abnormal development (e.g. a leukodystrophy) or atrophy following normal development (e.g. neurodegeneration)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]
fields.synonyms_concat: Small corpus callosum; Thinning of the corpus callosum

fields.label: Lupus nephritis
fields.definition: "Lupus nephritis is a type of glomerulonephritis that constitutes one of the most severe organ manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus. Lupus nephritis is subclassified in six distinct classes, that represent different manifestations and severities of renal involvement and guide the therapeutic management." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:31974366]

fields.label: Diffuse lupus nephritis
fields.definition: "A subclass of lupus nephritis with active or inactive diffuse, segmental or global endocapillary or extracapillary glomerulonephritis involving at least 50% of all glomeruli, typically with diffuse subendothelial immune deposits, with or without mesangial alterations." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:31974366]
fields.synonyms_concat: Class IV lupus nephritis

fields.label: Mesangial proliferative lupus nephritis
fields.definition: "A subclass of lupus nephritis with purely mesangial hypercellularity of any degree or mesangial matrix expansion by lightmicroscopy, with mesangial immune deposits. A few isolated subepithelial or subendothelial deposits may be visible by immunoflourescence or electron microscopy, but not by light microscopy." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:31974366]
fields.synonyms_concat: Class II lupus nephritis

fields.label: Minimal mesangial lupus nephritis
fields.definition: "A subclass of lupus nephritis with normal glomeruli by light microscopy, but mesangial immune deposits by immunofluorescence." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:31974366]
fields.synonyms_concat: Class I lupus nephritis

fields.label: Membranous lupus nephritis
fields.definition: "A lupus nephritis subclass with global or segmental subepithelial immune deposits or their morphological sequelae by light microscopy and by immunofluorescence or electron microscopy, with or without mesangial alterations. May occur in combination with class III or IV, in which case both classes are diagnosed. May show advanced sclerosis" [PMID:31974366]
fields.synonyms_concat: Class V lupus nephritis

fields.label: Focal lupus nephritis
fields.definition: "A subclass of lupus nephritis with active or inactive focal, segmental or global endocapillary or extracapillary glomerulonephritis involving less than 50% of all glomeruli, typically with focal subendothelial immune deposits, with or without mesangial alterations" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:31974366]
fields.synonyms_concat: Class III lupus nephritis

fields.label: Advanced sclerotic lupus nephritis
fields.definition: "A subclass of lupus nephritis with at least 90% of glomeruli globally sclerosed without residual activity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:31974366]
fields.synonyms_concat: Class VI lupus nephritis

fields.label: Low-grade vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux without dilation of the renal calyces (Grade I-II)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164]

fields.label: High-grade vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux with dilation of the renal calyces (Grade III - V)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164]

fields.label: Grade I vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux into the ureter only." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade I VUR; VUR I

fields.label: Grade II vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux into a non-dilated pyelocalyceal system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164, PMID:3975102]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade II VUR; VUR II

fields.label: Grade III vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux with dilatation of the collecting system." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164, PMID:3975102]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade III VUR; VUR III

fields.label: Primary vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux due to abnormalities in ureterovesical junction, e.g. ectopic insertion of the ureter or short intravesical tunnel at the ureterovesical junction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164, PMID:19668250]

fields.label: Secondary vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux induced by increased bladder pressures in patients with voiding dysfunction e.g. in case of congenital posterior urethral valves or neurogenic bladder dysfunction." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164, PMID:19668250]

fields.label: Grade V vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux with massive dilation of the collecting system and severe tortuosity of the ureter." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164, PMID:3975102]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade V VUR; VUR V

fields.label: Grade IV vesicoureteral reflux
fields.definition: "Vesicoureteral reflux with more-extensive dilation with blunting of the calyces and tortuosity of the ureter." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164, PMID:3975102]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade IV VUR; VUR IV

fields.label: Intrarenal reflux
fields.definition: "Severe vesicoureteral reflux reaching the kidney parenchyma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:18322164, PMID:33738272]

fields.label: Macular agenesis
fields.definition: "A congenital defect characterized by lack of development of the macula." []

fields.label: Global cerebellar dysplasia
fields.definition: "A type of cerebellar dysplasia that affects the entire cerebellum." [PMID:26331051]

fields.label: Dysplasia of the superior cerebellar vermis
fields.definition: "A type of cerebellar dysplasia that affects the upper part of the cerebellar vermis." [PMID:26331051]
fields.label_normalized: dysplasia of the superior cerebellar vermis

fields.label: Intrascapular pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the area between the shoulder blades." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pain between shoulder blades

fields.label: Abnormal exteroceptive sensation
fields.definition: "A type of somatic sensory dysfunction characterized by abnormality of superficial sensation that is mediated by receptors in skin and mucous membranes." []

fields.label: Hypoesthesia
fields.definition: "Decreased ability to perceive touch." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoaesthesia; Numbness

fields.label: Abnormal functional residual capacity
fields.definition: "A deviation from normal values for the functional residual capacity, which is defined as the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation." [PMID:29763183]

fields.label: Reduced functional residual capacity
fields.definition: "An abnormal reduction in the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation." [PMID:29763183]

fields.label: Elevated functional residual capacity
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation." [PMID:29763183]

fields.label: Abnormal residual volume
fields.definition: "Any deviation from normal values of the residual volume, which is defined as the volume of air left in the lungs at the end of maximal expiration (ie. the volume of air which you cannot voluntarily exhale from your lungs)." []

fields.label: Reduced residual volume
fields.definition: "Abnormal decrease in the amount of air remaining in a person's lungs after full exhalation." []

fields.label: Abnormal left ventricular end-diastolic volume
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of end-diastolic volume of the left ventricle, which is the volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole)." [PMID:19159437, PMID:29446315]

fields.label: Increased left ventricular end-diastolic volume
fields.definition: "Abnormally high volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole)." []

fields.label: Decreased left ventricular end-diastolic volume
fields.definition: "Abnormally low volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole)." []

fields.label: Pancreatic steatosis
fields.definition: "Fat infiltration in the pancreas." [PMID:32490903]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fatty pancreas; Non-alcoholic fatty pancreatic disease; Pancreatic fatty infiltration; Pancreatic fatty replacement; Pancreatic lipomatosis; Pancreatic lipomatous pseudohypertrophy

fields.label: Labial abscess
fields.definition: "A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the labia." [PMID:7598776]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abscess of the labia

fields.label: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of magnesium
fields.definition: "Decreased renal tubular reabsorption of magnesium." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:25287933]
fields.label_normalized: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of magnesium

fields.label: Decreased maximal oxygen uptake
fields.definition: "Maximum oxygen uptake (VO2max) is defined as the highest rate of oxygen uptake and utilization by the body during intense, maximal exercise, whereby further increases in work rate do not bring on additional rises in VO2 (i.e. plateau). VO2Max is typically measured with a treadmill and ergometer and the participant exercises with increasing levels of intensity. VO2Max is the point at which oxygen uptake no longer increases despite an increase in workload." [PMID:29506981]

fields.label: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis
fields.definition: "Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis is a granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate composed of neutrophils, lymphocytes, plasma cells, xanthomatous histiocytes, and multinucleated giant cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:21526966]

fields.label: Middle cerebral artery stroke
fields.definition: "Acute onset neurological deficits such as weakness, dizziness, numbness, issues with speech, or visual changes related to sudden impairment of blood flow to a part of the brain due to occlusion or rupture of the middle cerebral artery to the brain." [PMID:32310592]

fields.label: Death in adulthood
fields.definition: "Cessation of life at the age of 16 years or later." []

fields.label: Death in middle age
fields.definition: "Death between the age of 40 and 60 years." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]

fields.label: Death in late adulthood
fields.definition: "Death at an age of at least 60 years." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]

fields.label: Polymelia
fields.definition: "Polymelia is a congenital anomaly, which is defined as the presence of accessory limbs attached to various body regions and could be classified as cephalomelia (extra-limb attached to the head), notomelia (extra-limb attached to the back bone), thoracomelia (extra-limb attached to the thorax), and pyromelia (extra-limb attached to the pelvis)." [PMID:23814690]

fields.label: Abnormal single motor unit action potential
fields.definition: "Abnormally high or low single motor unit action potential reading (-Pk Amps)." [PMID:15961866]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal single motor unit action potential

fields.label: Penile thrush
fields.definition: "Overgrowth of candida albicans in the penis." [PMID:27659805]
fields.synonyms_concat: Penile candidiasis

fields.label: Fundic gland polyposis
fields.definition: "Multiple polyps in the acid-secreting mucosa of the gastric body and fundus. Fundic gland polyps (FGP) are usually 1 to 5 mm in size, though larger polyps have been found. FGPs are typically sessile, shiny, translucent, pale to pinkish in color (resembling the surrounding mucosa), and often exhibit tiny surface blood vessels. These polyps have characteristically been observed to chunk off or detach entirely at the base when removed with cold forceps, in contrast to other types of gastric polyps." [PMID:20567540]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fundic gland polyps; Gastric polyposis; Proximal polyposis of the stomach

fields.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
fields.definition: "An adenocarcinoma arising from the stomach glandular epithelium. Gastric carcinoma often produces no specific symptoms when it is superficial and potentially surgically curable, although up to 50% of patients may have nonspecific gastrointestinal complaints such as dyspepsia." [NCIT:C4004, PMID:15621988, PMID:28569272]

fields.label: Pleuritic chest pain
fields.definition: "Pleuritic chest pain is characterized by sudden and intense sharp, stabbing, or burning pain in the chest when inhaling and exhaling." [PMID:28925655]

fields.label: Abnormal RV/TLC ratio
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining aftermaximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in theungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and body plethysmography." [PMID:12934788]

fields.label: Decreased RV/TLC ratio
fields.definition: "An abnormally low ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining after maximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in the lungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and body plethysmography." [PMID:12934788]

fields.label: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of uric acid
fields.definition: "Decreased renal tubular reabsorption of uric acid." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:27105641, PMID:31474092]
fields.label_normalized: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of uric acid

fields.label: Pulmonary imaging sign
fields.definition: "An abnormal pulmonary imaging finding defined by eponym or reference to signs, symbols, or naturalistic images." [PMID:31802270]

fields.label: Enamel pearls
fields.definition: "Small nodules of enamel on the root of a tooth." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Supernumerary cusp
fields.definition: "Additional cusps of a dental crown." [PMID:31468724]
fields.synonyms_concat: Additional cusp; Extra cusp

fields.label: Leung cusp
fields.definition: "An additional cusp located in the middle of the occlusal surface." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Barrel-shaped tooth
fields.definition: "A tooth crown with convex mesial and distal surfaces." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Bulbous tooth
fields.definition: "A tooth crown with a marked cervical area constriction." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Tapered tooth
fields.definition: "A tooth with a crown that narrows from proximal toward the incisal edge. Tapering of teeth typically involves incisors." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Semilunar tooth
fields.definition: "An incisor with a half-moon shape incisal edge." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Crescent-shape tooth; Hutchinson incisor; Semicircular tooth; Tooth, semilunar

fields.label: Molar incisor malformation
fields.definition: "Molar incisor malfomation (MIM) is composed of normal crown with marked cervical constriction, thin, narrow short roots which is a combination of signs that occurs in deciduous and permanent molars." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Dentin dysplasia
fields.definition: "This is a bundled term as dentin dysplasia is composed of short roots with pointed ends and taurodontism and intrapulpal calcifications." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Enamel agenesis
fields.definition: "Complete or almost complete absence of enamel." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Hypomature enamel
fields.definition: "Enamel with a white or brown discoloration without hypoplasia." [PMID:31468724]
fields.synonyms_concat: Enamel opacity

fields.label: Cementum hypoplasia
fields.definition: "The decrease or absence of cementum. The cementum anchors the periodontal ligament attachment fiber between the tooth root and the alveolar bone. Its absence leads to early loss of teeth." [PMID:31468724]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cementum aplasia

fields.label: Cementum overgrowth
fields.definition: "Excess of cementum on the tooth root surface." [PMID:31468724]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cementation hyperplasia; Cementum hypertrophy; Cementum overdeveloped; Drumstick-shaped root; Hypercementosis

fields.label: Triggered by cheese ingestion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating cheese." [PMID:9398858]

fields.label: Thistle tube shaped pulp
fields.definition: "A thistle tube shape of the pulp chamber, meaning an enlarged coronal pulp chamber with narrow pulp canals giving a radiographic appearance of the shape of a thistle tube or a flame. It may occur isolated or associated with other dental anomalies and rare diseases such as dentinogenesis imperfecta, which should be assessed and coded separately. The diagnosis thistle tube shape pulp requires clinical and radiographic examinations." [PMID:31468724]
fields.synonyms_concat: Flame-shaped pulp

fields.label: Tooth ankylosis
fields.definition: "Fusion of a tooth with alveolar bone." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Cross bite
fields.definition: "Lingual occlusion of buccal cusps and/or incisal edge of maxillary teeth to the buccal cusps and/or incisal edge of mandibular teeth." [PMID:31468724]

fields.label: Triggered by food ingestion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating a certain food." []

fields.label: Acral overgrowth
fields.definition: "Excessive growth of hands and feet (predominantly due to soft tissue swelling). Typical manifestations include shoe size increase, foot enlargement, glove tightness, and hand enlargement." [PMID:27477558, PMID:27812777, PMID:30853479]
fields.synonyms_concat: Acral enlargement; Acral hypertrophy; Acromegalic growth; Acromegaly

fields.label: Abnormal leukocyte physiology
fields.definition: "A functional abnormality of a white blood cell." []

fields.label: Leukocyte migration defect
fields.definition: "Any abnormality of leukocyte motility in response to chemokines, which is required for the inflammatory response to infections, and for organ development, tissues homeostasis, and vascularization." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal leukocyte migration; Defects of leukocyte migration

fields.label: Abnormal circulating sex hormone concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of a sex hormone in the blood circulation" []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal circulating gonadal steroid concentration; Abnormal circulating gonadocorticoid concentration; Abnormal circulating sex steroid concentration

fields.label: Blistering by anatomical location
fields.definition: "Blistering (presence of multiple fluid filled blisters) categorized according to the body site where they occur." []

fields.label: Blistering by histological location
fields.definition: "Blistering (presence of multiple fluid filled blisters) categorized according to the layer of the skin in which the blister originates. The skin is divided into three layers. The epidermis (outermost layer, which mainly consists of keratinocytes), the dermis, and a subcutaneous layer. The epidermis is divided into five layers: the basal lamina (innermost layer), the basal cell layer, the stratum spinosum, the stratum granulosum, and the stratum corneum (outermost layer). Cleavage in epidermolysis bullosa (EB) simplex occurs within the basal keratinocytes; in junctional EB, within the lamina lucida; and in dystrophic EB occurs in the sublamina densa, in the upper portion of the dermis (papillary dermis). In Kindler's EB, cleavage can occur in the basal keratinocytes, in the lamina lucida, or below the lamina densa." [PMID:20055907]

fields.label: Intra-epidermal blistering
fields.definition: "A type of blistering in which the lesions are located within the epidermis with loss of cell-cell adhesion of keratinocytes. In simplex EB, cleavage occurs in the basal layer, which is the innermost layer of the epidermis and consists of a single layer of basal germinative cells (mostly epidermal Keratinocytes) that proliferate and thereby produce new cells for other epidermal layers. As the cells move towards the upper layers of the epidermis they mature and eventually form cornified cells. The suprabasal cell layer lies directly above the basal layer and is composed of five to ten layers of cells." []

fields.label: Sub-lamina densa cleavage
fields.definition: "A type of blistering in which the cleavage plane of blisters is located below the lamina densa." []
synonyms: Blistering with sub-lamina densa plane of cleavage
fields.synonyms_concat: Blistering with sub-lamina densa plane of cleavage

fields.label: Subepidermal blistering
fields.definition: "A type of blistering in which the lesions are located beneath the epidermis." []

fields.label: Non-necrotizing granuloma
fields.definition: "A granuloma which is not associated with necrotic changes." [PMID:32476832]

fields.label: Abnormal epidermis stratum granulosum morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormal structure of the stratum granulosum, which is is a thin layer of cells in the epidermis lying above the stratum spinosum and below the stratum corneum." []

fields.label: Absent keratohyalin granules
fields.definition: "Lack of keratohyalin granules, which are normally present in the stratum granulosum of the epidermal layer of the skin." [PMID:30725734]

fields.label: Spermatocele
fields.definition: "A cystic structure arising from the epididymis, rete testis or efferent ductuli. These structures are filled with spermatozoa containing fluid that may be milky. These cysts are usually outside the tunica vaginalis and, as with hydrocele, transluminate easily." [PMID:21592287]

fields.label: Increased circulating 17 hydroxypregnenolone concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of 17alpha-hydroxypregnenolone in the blood circulation. 17alpha-hydroxypregnenolone is a 21-carbon steroid that is converted from pregnenolone by steroid 17-alpha-hydroxylase, as an intermediate in the biosynthesis of gonadal steroid hormones and adrenal corticosteroids." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating dihydrotestosterone concentration
fields.definition: "A reduced concentration of dihydrotestosterone in the blood circulation." [PMID:20301592, PMID:31888681]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating androstenedione concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of androstenedione in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating androstenedione concentration
fields.definition: "Reduced concentration of androstenedione in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Perilobular
fields.definition: "Situated or occurring around a lobe of an organ." []

fields.label: Paraseptal
fields.definition: "Characterized by predominant involvement of the distal alveoli and their ducts and sacs. It is characteristically bounded by any pleural surface and the interlobular septa." []

fields.label: Bronchocentric
fields.definition: "Centered in bronchi or bronchioles." []

fields.label: Centrilobular
fields.definition: "Located in the center of the secondary pulmonary lobules, which are the functional units of the lungs." []

fields.label: Miliary
fields.definition: "Characterized by numerous small lesions said to resemble millet seed." []

fields.label: Reticular
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles a net or network-like structure." []

fields.label: Perilymphatic
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at or near lymphatic structures (node or vessel)." []

fields.label: Apical
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at the apex of an organ. For instance, apical refers to the superior portion of the lung." []

fields.label: Pulmonary mass
fields.definition: "A mass in the lung seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics)." []

fields.label: Mass on thoracic imaging
fields.definition: "A mass is any pulmonary, pleural, or mediastinal lesion seen on chest radiographs as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics). Mass usually implies a solid or partly solid opacity. CT allows more exact evaluation of size, location, attenuation, and other features." []

fields.label: Mediastinal mass
fields.definition: "A mass in the mediastinum seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics)." []

fields.label: Pleural mass
fields.definition: "A mass in the pleura seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics)." []

fields.label: Superior mediastinal mass
fields.definition: "A type of mediastinal mass that is located above the thoracic plane (a horizontal line that runs from the manubriosternal joint (sternal angle or angle of Louis) to the inferior endplate of T4)." []

fields.label: Inferior mediastinal mass
fields.definition: "A type of mediastinal mass that is located below the thoracic plane (a horizontal line that runs from the manubriosternal joint (sternal angle or angle of Louis) to the inferior endplate of T4)." []

fields.label: Anterior mediastinal mass
fields.definition: "A type of inferior mediastinal mass that is located in front of the pericardium." []

fields.label: Middle mediastinal mass
fields.definition: "A type of inferior mediastinal mass that is located withinthe pericardium." []

fields.label: Posterior mediastinal mass
fields.definition: "A type of inferior mediastinal mass that is located behind the pericardium." []

fields.label: Hyperdense pulmonary mass
fields.definition: "A type of pulmonary mass with high attenuation." []

fields.label: Cavitating pulmonary mass
fields.definition: "Thick-walled abnormal gas-filled interstitial mass within a lung with a diameter greater than 30 mm." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489]

fields.label: Livedo
fields.definition: "A reddish-blue mottled condition of skin caused by inflammation of the cutaneous blood vessels." [PMID:17143977]
fields.synonyms_concat: Livedoid dermatitis

fields.label: Elevated circulating sCD25 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of sCD25 (= soluble CD25, = soluble interleukin-2 receptor alpha-chain, = soluble IL-2 receptor alpha) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating interleukin-2 receptor alpha-chain

fields.label: Malaise
fields.definition: "A feeling of general discomfort, weakness, or lack of health." []

fields.label: Abnormal renal vascular morphology
fields.definition: "Anomalous structure of a blood vessel in the kidney." []

fields.label: Abnormal intrarenal artery morphology
fields.definition: "An anomalous structure of an artery located in the kidney." []
synonyms: Abnormal kidney arterial blood vessel morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal kidney arterial blood vessel morphology

fields.label: Abnormal arcuate artery morphology
fields.definition: "Anomalous structure of the arc-shaped arteries located at the border of the renal cortex and renal medulla." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormalities of arcuate arteries

fields.label: Dysphoria
fields.definition: "A pervasive state of negatively valenced emotional unease and dissatisfaction along with an inner discomfort that is disproportionate to external circumstances and may include heightened emotional reactivity. It is associated with a mixture of overlapping negative emotions that are difficult to disentangle." [PMID:30439852]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dysphoric mood; Emotional discomfort; Emotional discontent; Emotional discord; Emotional unrest; Emotionally unsettled; Feeling off inside; Ill at ease; Inner distress; Inner turmoil; Psychological unease

fields.label: Testicular pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to one or both testes." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pain in testicles

fields.label: Postmenopausal bleeding
fields.definition: "Uterine bleeding that occurs after at least one year of amenorrhea in a woman who is not receiving hormone therapy." [PMID:17339971]

fields.label: Ocular pruritus
fields.definition: "Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching in the region of the eye." [PMID:29862322, PMID:29988128]
fields.synonyms_concat: Itchy eyes; Ocular itch

fields.label: Early satiety
fields.definition: "The condition of being unable to eat a full meal because of a feeling of fullness (satiety), or or feeling very full after eating only a small amount of food." [PMID:21369493, PMID:27781342]
synonyms: Not able to finish a normal-sized meal
fields.synonyms_concat: Feeling full quickly when eating; Not able to finish a normal-sized meal

fields.label: Postprandial fullness
fields.definition: "Feeling excessively full after meals." [PMID:27781342]

fields.label: Racing thoughts
fields.definition: "An inner sense (from the self) that thoughts are moving abnormally fast and in a manner that the individual typically feels that the rate is beyond their control, i.e. they feel unable to slow the rate of thoughts. Racing thoughts by themselves have a linear progression, following a line of thinking or logic, which distinguishes racing thoughts from flight of ideas. Racing thoughts may however, co-occur with or be independent from flight of ideas, they may be associated with pressured speech or be an internal perception of the rate of thinking. The core element being the rate of the thoughts themselves." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Racing thoughts; Tachyphrenia

fields.label: Sense of impending doom
fields.definition: "A feeling that something life-threatening or tragic is about to occur." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Sense of doom

fields.label: Spinal hypomyelination
fields.definition: "Reduced amount of myelin in the spinal cord resulting from defective myelinogenesis." [PMID:23643384]

fields.label: Phantageusia
fields.definition: "A form of altered taste sensation in which the affected person perceives a taste, usually an unpleasant one, in the absence of a corresponding stimulus in the environment." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Phantom taste

fields.label: Receptive aphasia
fields.definition: "A type of aphasia that is characterized by impaired language comprehension." [PMID:28722980]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fluent aphasia; Wernicke aphasia

fields.label: Bilingual aphasia
fields.definition: "The term bilingual aphasia is used to refer to aphasia in persons who speak two or more languages. When a multilingual speaker has aphasia following a stroke, the languages spoken premorbidly may show comparable or differential patterns of impairment. Differential patterns may manifest as greater impairment in one language compared to another, or as differences in the characteristics of aphasia. Clinical reports of bilingual aphasia show dissociations in the processing of the language learned first (L1) and and second (L2), with one language more impaired than the other. Other cases show a pattern of differential recovery where L2 is recovered only after L1. Another pattern is alternating antagonism; i.e., patients access one language in spontaneous speech and inhibit the other language for alternating periods. This term should be used for a type of aphasia in a person who speaks multiple languages in which the impairment is different for different languages." [PMID:31024369]

fields.label: Coldness
fields.definition: "Relative coldness of a body part to palpitation, often acccompanied by feelings of coldness." [PMID:16770929, PMID:32491414]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cold skin temperature; Cool skin; Cool skin temperature; Coolness to palpation

fields.label: Oculomotor synkinesis
fields.definition: "Elevation of the upper eyelid on attempted downward gaze or adduction, adduction of the eye on attempted upward or downward gaze, and constriction of the pupil on attempted adduction." [PMID:18004962]

fields.label: Abnormal intrarenal vein morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structure of a vein located inside the kidney parenchyma." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Abnormal arcuate vein morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the arcuate vein. The arcuate veins cross traverse along the corticomedullary junction (at the border of the kideny cortex and medulla)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Abnormal interlobular vein morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the interlobular veins of the kidney. An interlobular vein is surrounded by the renal cortex and located between renal lobules (consisting of the nephrons surrounding a single medullary ray and draining into a single collecting duct)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Abnormal interlobular vein lumen morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly located in the the inside space of the interlobular veins of the kidney." []
synonyms: Abnormal morphology of the interlobular vein lumen
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal morphology of the interlobular vein lumen

fields.label: Cholesterol emboli within interlobular vein lumen
fields.definition: "Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of interlobular veins. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:27012950]
fields.label_normalized: cholesterol emboli within interlobular vein lumen

fields.label: Intraluminal thrombi within interlobular veins
fields.definition: "Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding vascular lumen of the interlobular veins of the kidney." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Organized thrombi within interlobular vein lumen
fields.definition: "Thrombi containing fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the interlobular veins of the kidney." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.label_normalized: organized thrombi within interlobular vein lumen

fields.label: Abnormal peritubular capillary morphology
fields.definition: "Anomalous structure of the capillaries that are derived from the efferent arteriole, forming a capillary network that surrounds the distal portions of the nephron tubule," []

fields.label: Abnormal cortical peritubular capillary morphology

fields.label: Multilamellation of cortical peritubular capillary basement membranes
fields.definition: "Duplicated basement membranes of the peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney and arranged in multiple concentric layers." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:21720964]
synonyms: Multilamellation of basement membranes within cortical peritubular capillaries
fields.label_normalized: multilamellation of cortical peritubular capillary basement membranes
fields.synonyms_concat: Multilamellation of basement membranes within cortical peritubular capillaries

fields.label: Cortical peritubular capillaritis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the peritubular capillaries in the cortex of the kidney characterized by Inflammatory cells in over 10 percent of the interstitial capillaries in the cortex with at least some capillaries having three or more luminal cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:25738252]

fields.label: Abnormal cortical peritubular capillary lumen morphology
fields.definition: "Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the peritubular capillary in the cortex of the kidney." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal cortical peritubular capillary lumen morphology

fields.label: Abnormal medullary peritubular capillary morphology
fields.definition: "Anomalous structure of the peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Medullary peritubular capillaritis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the peritubular capillaries in the medulla of the kidney characterized by Inflammatory cells in over 10 percent of the interstitial capillaries in the cortex with at least some capillaries having three or more luminal cells." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]

fields.label: Medullary peritubular capillary erythrocyte congestion
fields.definition: "Substantially increased numbers of red blood cells within capillaries surrounding tubules in the medulla of the kidney. This feature is assessed in histological images as the presence of numerous erythrocytes in a segment of the capillary such that the vessel appears to be congested (not open)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:28794065]

fields.label: Multilamellation of medullary peritubular capillary basement membranes
fields.definition: "Duplicated basement membranes of the peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney and arranged in multiple concentric layers." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]
synonyms: Multilamellation of basement membranes within medullary peritubular capillaries

fields.synonyms_concat: Multilamellation of basement membranes within medullary peritubular capillaries

fields.definition: "Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the peritubular capillary in the medulla of the kidney." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal medullary peritubular capillary lumen morphology

fields.label: Medullary peritubular capillary lumen cholesterol emboli
fields.definition: "Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. fields.label: Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor
fields.definition: "A rare, endocrine active tumor that causes severe renal phosphate wasting, which in turn can lead to critical osteomalacia. Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumors (PMTs) are typically small and mostly benign tumors producing fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF-23). FGF-23 lowers the expression of sodium/phosphate cotransporters, which are the primary transport proteins responsible for phosphate reabsorption in the kidneys. The paraneoplastic overproduction of FGF-23 lowers reabsorption of phosphate and causes severe paraneoplastic renal phosphate wasting and hypophosphatemia. FGF-23 also affects vitamin D levels by lowering 25-hydroxyvitamin D 1-alpha-hydroxylase in the proximal renal tubules and by increasing the expression of vitamin D 24-hydroxylase, a mitochondrial enzyme responsible for inactivating vitamin D metabolites." [PMID:33442358]

Viral encephalitis is associated with neurological dysfunction." [PMID:21960712, PMID:30366550]
