fields.definition: "An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 22 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 22 concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 22 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating interleukin 23 concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 23 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Reduced circulating interleukin 23 concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 23 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 23 concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 23 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating interleukin 27 concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 27 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Reduced circulating interleukin 27 concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 27 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 27 concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 27 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating interleukin 17A concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 17A in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Reduced circulating interleukin 17A concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 17A in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 17A concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 17A in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Vertebral artery aneurysm
fields.definition: "Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the vertebral artery ." []

fields.label: Fusion of the caudate and putamen
fields.definition: "Abnormal joined appearance of the caudate and putamen with an absence of the anterior limb of the internal capsule." [PMID:26251641, PMID:31194327]
fields.label_normalized: fusion of the caudate and putamen

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the liver
fields.definition: "Absence or underdevelopment of the liver." []

fields.label: Segmental hypoplasia of liver
fields.definition: "Anatomically the liver is divided into right and left lobes based on the attachment of its peritoneal ligaments. This term refers to a developmental anomaly characterzied by the underdevelopment of one of the lobes of the liver. This is a rare and usually asymptomatic anomaly that can be detected incidentally on cross sectional imaging with computed tomography or magnetic resonance imaging." [PMID:23573097]

fields.label: Spastic triplegia
fields.definition: "Spastic weakness found in both lower extremities and one upper extremity." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157, PMID:27188686, PMID:32821558]

fields.label: Increased insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
fields.definition: "An abnormally elevated concentration of insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit level in the blood circulation." []
fields.label_normalized: increased insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating IGFALS contration

fields.label: Median pseudocleft lip
fields.definition: "A type of mild median cleft lip in which the central tubercle of the upper lip is replaced by a mucosal cleft in the midline." [PMID:25535458]

fields.label: Patella alta
fields.definition: "Patella alta is a patella that rides abnormally high in relation to the femur, the femoral trochlea, or the tibia, with decreased bony stability requiring increased knee flexion angles to engage the trochlea." [PMID:29309446]

fields.label: Clavicular pseudarthrosis
fields.definition: "A developmental defect in a the clavicule leading to bending and pathologic fracture, with inability to form a normal bony callus with subsequent fibrous nonunion, leading to the pseudarthrosis (or false joint)." [PMID:19232556]

fields.label: Midline liver
fields.definition: "Position of the liver across the middle of the body instead of being in its normal position to the right of the stomach." [PMID:12432114]

fields.label: Anti-thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against thyroid-stimulating hormone." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:10874533, PMID:26293122, PMID:3018097, PMID:30224035, PMID:32459722]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-thyrotropin receptor antibody; Anti-TSH receptor antibody positivity; TRAbs

fields.label: Abnormal fetal cardiovascular physiology
fields.definition: "Abnormal functionality of the fetal cardiovascular system." []

fields.label: Elevated fetal middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity
fields.definition: "Increased peak systolic velocity of the fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA) as evaluated by Doppler ultrasound." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8593-2186, PMID:28191060]
fields.label_normalized: elevated fetal middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity

fields.label: Pulmonary thromboembolism
fields.definition: "Pulmonary embolism is caused by emboli, which have originated from venous thrombi, traveling to and occluding the arteries of the lung." [PMID:29770793]

fields.label: Stratum basale cleavage
fields.definition: "Cleavage within the epidermal keratinocytes, which is the innermost layer of the epidermis and consists of proliferating cells that give rise to the outer layers of the epidermis." []
synonyms: Blistering with cleavage within basal keratinocytes
Cleavage within the basal keratinocyte layer
fields.synonyms_concat: Blistering with cleavage within basal keratinocytes; Cleavage within the basal keratinocyte layer

fields.label: Suprabasal cleavage
fields.definition: "Cleavage within the suprabasal cell layer of the epidermis, which lies directly above the basal layer and is composed of five to ten layers of cells." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Blistering with suprabasal clefting

fields.label: Triggered by muscle relaxant
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a muscle relaxant such as suxamethonium and mivacurium." []

fields.label: Ductus venosus agenesis
fields.definition: "A developmental defect characterized by lack of formation of the ductus venosus (a shunt that allows oxygenated blood in the umbilical vein to bypass the liver in the fetal circulation)." [PMID:10765517, PMID:21335936, PMID:24871613, PMID:24931552]
fields.synonyms_concat: Agenesis of the ductus venosus

fields.label: Third trimester onset
fields.definition: "This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth during the third trimester, which is defined as 28 weeks and zero days (28+0) of gestation and beyond." []

fields.label: Second trimester onset
fields.definition: "This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth during the second trimester, which comprises the range of gestational ages from 14 0/7 weeks to 27 6/7 (inclusive)." []

fields.label: Late first trimester onset
fields.definition: "This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth in the first trimester during the early fetal period, which is defined as 11 0/7 to 13 6/7 weeks of gestation (inclusive)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Early fetal onset; Early foetal onset

fields.label: Abnormal CSF homovanillic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of homovanillic acid (HVA) in the cerebrospinal fluid. HVA is a metabolite of dopamine." []

fields.label: Increased CSF homovanillic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Elevated concentration of homovanillic acid (HVA) in the cerebrospinal fluid. HVA is a metabolite of dopamine." []

fields.label: Decreased iduronate sulfatase level
fields.definition: "An decreased level of iduronate-2-sulfatase activity in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating C1-esterase inhibitor concentration
fields.definition: "Decreased concentration of C1-esterase inhibitor (C1INH) in the blood circulation." [PMID:30844193]

fields.label: Iniencephaly
fields.definition: "Iniencephaly is a rare neural tube defect involving dysmorphic spine and abnormal fusion of the portion of the occipital skull with the back. It results in extreme fixed head retroflexion." [PMID:33294089]

fields.label: Abnormal fetal central nervous system morphology
fields.definition: "An anomalous structural finding of the fetal central nervous system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal fetal central nervous system morphology
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal fetal CNS morphology; Abnormal foetal CNS morphology

fields.label: Abnormal fetal gastrointestinal system morphology
fields.definition: "An anomalous structural finding of the fetal gastrointestinal system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes." []

fields.label: Fetal intracranial hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Abnormal bleeding inside the skull (cranium) of a fetus." []

fields.label: Fetal subependymal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage located in the subependymal germinal matrix below the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles in the caudothalamic notch." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade I fetal intracranial hemorrhage; Grade I foetal intracranial haemorrhage

fields.label: Fetal intraventricular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding into the ventricular system of the brain." [PMID:16082722, PMID:27734711]

fields.label: Fetal cerebral parenchymal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding into the parenchyma (tissue) of the brain." [PMID:16082722]

fields.label: Fetal extra-axial hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding that occurs within the skull but outside of the brain tissue itself (into the epidural, subdural, or arachnoid space)." []

fields.label: Fetal posterior fossa hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the posterior cranial fossa, which is the part of the cranial cavity that is located between the foramen magnum and tentorium cerebelli and contains the brainstem and cerebellum." []

fields.label: Fetal intraventricular hemorrhage without ventriculomegaly
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage characterized by clear hemorrhage spillover to the ventricles filling less than 50% of the lateral ventricle and without ventriculomegaly of greater than 15 mm in the transverse diameter of the lateral ventricular atrium." [PMID:16082722]
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade II fetal intracranial hemorrhage; Grade II foetal intracranial haemorrhage

fields.label: Fetal cerebellar hemisphere hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the hemisphere of the cerebellum." [PMID:12795563, PMID:26426778]

fields.label: Fetal cerebellar vermis hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the vermis of the cerebellum." [PMID:26426778]

fields.label: Sonographic non-visualized fetal bladder
fields.definition: "Inability to visualize the fetal bladder on targeted prenatal sonography examination. The fetal bladder can be visualized with sonography as a midline, fluid-filled structure in the pelvis as early as 10-12 weeks of gestation. The normal fetus voids at least once an hour but never completely empties the urinary bladder. The fetal bladdder should be consistently imaged after 13 weeks of gestation." [PMID:8915088]

fields.label: Fetal intraventricular hemorrhage with ventriculomegaly
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) characterized by spillover to ventricles with flooding of 50% or more of one or both lateral ventricles accrued accompanying ventriculomegaly, but with no apparent brain parenchymal injury. This type of IVH may be defined as a diameter exceeding 15 mm in the transverse diameter of the lateral ventricular atrium as visualiuzed by prenatal sonography." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade III fetal intracranial hemorrhage; Grade III foetal intracranial haemorrhage

fields.label: Fetal intraventricular hemorrhage with periventricular hemorrhage
fields.definition: "A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage that additionally includes hemorrhage in a large part of the periventricular parenchyma." [PMID:12905503]
fields.label_normalized: fetal intraventricular hemorrhage with periventricular hemorrhage
fields.synonyms_concat: Grade IV fetal intracranial hemorrhage; Grade IV foetal intracranial haemorrhage

fields.label: Temporal lobe megalencephaly
fields.definition: "Expansion of the temporal lobes of the brain along all axes, including rostrocaudal, superoinferior, and mediolateral, resulting in a globular appearance of the brain." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8612-1062, PMID:19098178]

fields.label: Abnormal temporal lobe morphology
fields.definition: "An abnormal structural of the zone (lobe) of the cerebral cortex that is located inferior to the lateral fissure on other cerebral hemispheres." []

fields.label: Temporal lobe dysplasia
fields.definition: "A developmental defect of the temporal lobe of the cerebral cortex that is characterized by prominent sulcations and radially directed gyrations." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8612-1062, PMID:24585534]

fields.label: Elevated umbilical artery pulsatility
fields.definition: "Human umbilical artery (UA) blood flow pulsatility measured by Doppler ultrasound is a widely used biomarker for the detection of elevated placental vascular resistance. Elevated UA pulsatility, which in the most extreme cases manifests as absent or even reversed end-diastolic velocity, is associated with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) and still-birth." [PMID:32746120]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated umbilical artery Dopplers; Increased umbilical artery pulsatility index

fields.label: Absent end-diastolic umbilical artery flow
fields.definition: "An anomaly that is visualized by umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry. Flow in the umbilical artery should be in the forward direction in normal circumstances. This anomaly is characterized by an absence of flow in the umbilical artery at the end of diastole." []

fields.label: Reversed end-diastolic umbilical artery flow
fields.definition: "An anomaly that is visualized by umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry. Flow in the umbilical artery should be in the forward direction in normal circumstances. This anomaly is characterized by an reversal of flow in the umbilical artery at the end of diastole (i.e., backwards flow)." [PMID:19797010]

fields.label: Champagne cork sign
fields.definition: "Characteristic appearance of the chest and abdomen in the sagittal view on prenatal ultrasound when the chest is small and the abdomen protruding." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8612-1062, PMID:23408600, PMID:31173381]

fields.label: Aortic isthmus hypoplasia
fields.definition: "A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the isthmus (arch between the left subclavian and insertion of the patent ductus arteriosus/ligamentum arteriosum) has a diameter of less than 40% of the diameter of the ascending aorta." [PMID:27860551]

fields.label: Proximal aortic arch hypoplasia
fields.definition: "A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the proximal aortic arch (arch proximal to the origin of the left subclavian artery) has a diameter of less than 60% of the diameter of the ascending aorta." [PMID:27860551]

fields.label: Distal aortic arch hypoplasia
fields.definition: "A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the distal aortic arch (arch distal to the ductus arteriosus) has a diameter of less than 60% of the diameter of the ascending aorta." []

fields.label: Inferior crossed fused renal ectopia
fields.definition: "A type of cross fused renal ectopia characterized by fusion between the upper pole of the cross-fused ectopic kidney (located more inferiorly relative to the other kidney) and the lower pole of the other orthotopic kidney (located in a more superior position)." [PMID:29446682]
synonyms: Type A cross fused renal ectopia
fields.synonyms_concat: Type A cross fused renal ectopia

fields.label: Sigmoid kidney
fields.definition: "A type of cross fused renal ectopia where the normal side kidney is present superiorly and the direction of pelvic is medial, the kidney which crosses positioned inferiorly with direction of pelvic toward the lateral side. As kidneys fuse after complete rotation on the vertical axis, both renal pelves lie in correct orientation." [PMID:23599575, PMID:29446682]
synonyms: Type B cross fused renal ectopia
fields.synonyms_concat: S-shaped kidney; Type B cross fused renal ectopia

fields.label: Unilateral lump kidney
fields.definition: "A type of cross fused renal ectopia where fusion occurs over a wide margin, both renal pelves anteriorly directed and placed more inferiorly." [PMID:29446682]
synonyms: Type C cross fused renal ectopia
fields.synonyms_concat: Type C cross fused renal ectopia

fields.label: Disc kidney
fields.definition: "A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which kidneys fuse along their medial borders." []
synonyms: Type D cross fused renal ectopia
fields.synonyms_concat: Type D cross fused renal ectopia

fields.label: L-shaped kidney
fields.definition: "A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which the crossed kidney lies inferiorly and transversely, fused with the lower pole of the normal kidney." [PMID:29446682]
synonyms: Type E cross fused renal ectopia
fields.synonyms_concat: Tandem kidney; Type E cross fused renal ectopia

fields.label: Superior crossed-fused renal ectopia
fields.definition: "A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which the ectopic kidney lies superiorly and its lower pole fuses with the upper pole of the normal kidney. The renal pelvis of both kidneys lies anteriorly." [PMID:29446682]

fields.label: Apnea of prematurity
fields.definition: "Recurrent episodes of apnea occurring in infants born less than 37 weeks of gestation, defined specifically as a pause of breathing for more than 15-20 s, or accompanied by oxygen desaturation (SpO2 not more than 80% for at least 4 s) and bradycardia (heart rate less than 2/3 of baseline for at least 4 s), in infants born less than 37 weeks of gestation." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157, PMID:21301866]
fields.synonyms_concat: AOP

fields.label: Open neural tube defect
fields.definition: "A type of neural tube defect that is not covered by skin." [PMID:23456749]

fields.label: Closed neural tube defect
fields.definition: "A type of neural tube defect that is covered by skin." [PMID:23456749]

fields.label: Renal vein thrombosis
fields.definition: "The presence of a thrombus (blood clot) in the major renal veins or its tributaries, generally leading to passive congestion that develops causes the affected kidney to swell and become engorged, leading to degeneration of nephrons and causing symptoms of flank pain, hematuria, and decreased urine output." [PMID:30725656]

fields.label: Fetal neck mass
fields.definition: "An abnormal growth (lump) of tissue in the neck region of a fetus. Masses may be simple cystic,, cystic with a few simple septations (fewer than three septations and less than 3-mm thick), cystic with multiple or thick septations (greater than three septations or septations 3-mm-thick or more), a mass that is than is less than 50% solid, and a mass that is 50% solid or more." [PMID:30422714]

fields.label: Prenatal death
fields.definition: "Death of a fetus in the uterus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Death before birth; Intrauterine death

fields.label: Abnormal fetal genitourinary system morphology
fields.definition: "An anomalous structural finding of the fetal genitourinary system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes." []

fields.label: Abnormal fetal pulmonary morphology
fields.definition: "An anomalous structural finding of the fetal lungs. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes." []

fields.label: Gastric pseudomass
fields.definition: "At US examination from the second trimester onward, the fetal stomach appears as a uniformly anechoic, sharply circumscribed round structure in the left upper quadrant. However, debris is commonly visualized in the stomach, forming a pseudomass." [PMID:15888614]

fields.label: Fetal scalp mass
fields.definition: "An abnormal growth (lump) of tissue that projects from the fetal scalp." [PMID:24767653]

fields.label: Fetal lower urinary tract obstruction
fields.definition: "An obstruction in the ureter leading to bladder outlet obstruction. Special criteria are used for lower urinary tract obstruction (LUTO) in the fetus. Prenatal LUTO has classically been suspected on the basis of three ultrasonographic findings: megacystis, dilated posterior urethra (known as the keyhole sign) and hydronephrosis." [PMID:35136187]

fields.label: Increased fetal lens echogenicity
fields.definition: "Increased echogenicity (increased brightness in the gray-scale sonography image) of the lens of a fetus." [PMID:27433255]

fields.label: Severe influenza infection
fields.definition: "An unusually severe infection by an influenza virus." [PMID:25814066]

fields.label: Fetal nuchal edema
fields.definition: "Nuchal edema is considered present in a fetus at gestational week 14 or more if in the midsagittal plane of the neck, there is subcutaneous edema that produces a characteristic tremor on ballotment of the fetal head. This constitutes the severe end of the spectrum of increased nuchal fold thickness, which is defined as soft-tissue thickening of 6 mm or more, seen in the suboccipitobregmatic view of the fetal head. Nuchal edema may be confined to the neck or it may be generalized, as part of hydrops fetalis." [PMID:16507941, PMID:9880279]

fields.label: Abnormal corneal reflex
fields.definition: "An anomaly of the corneal reflex that normally induces involuntary blinking of the eyelids following contact of the cornea." [PMID:30480980]

fields.label: Absent corneal reflex
fields.definition: "Absence of the corneal blinking reflex, which normally induces involuntary blinking of the eyelids following contact of the cornea. The corneal blink reflex is caused by a loop between the trigeminal sensory nerves and the facial motor (VII) nerve innervation of the orbicularis oculi muscles." [PMID:30480980]

fields.label: Eosinophil nuclear hypersegmentation
fields.definition: "An excessive division of the lobes of the nucleus of eosinophils. Eosinophils with more than two nuclear lobes are commonly regarded as hypersegmented, because seventy to ninety percent of peripheral blood eosinophils have two nuclear lobes." [PMID:10732836, PMID:25313414]

fields.label: Face of the giant panda sign
fields.definition: "The face of the giant panda sign on T2-weighted MRI is characterized by preservation of normal signal intensity in the red nuclei and lateral portion of the pars reticulata of the substantia nigra, high signal in the tegmentum, and hypointensity of the superior colliculus. The findings are said to resemble the face of a giant panda." [PMID:14557570]
fields.label_normalized: face of the giant panda sign
fields.synonyms_concat: Midbrain panda sign

fields.label: Colovesical fistula
fields.definition: "An aberrant, pathological communication between the colon and the bladder." [PMID:30085532]
fields.synonyms_concat: Colovesicular fistula; Vesicocolic fistula

fields.label: Absent dermoepidermal hemidesmosomes
fields.definition: "Lack of demonstrable hemidesmosomes at the dermoepidermal junction. Hemidesmosomes are the specialized junctional complexes, that contribute to the attachment of epithelial cells to the underlying basement membrane in stratified and other complex epithelia, such as the skin." [PMID:19945618]

fields.label: C4 nephritic factor positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that recognize C4b2a, the C3 convertase of the classical pathway of complement." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:23117396, PMID:27146825, PMID:28838767]

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the midbrain
fields.definition: "Absence or underdevelopment of the midbrain (mesencephalon)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the mesencephalon

fields.label: Hypoplasia of the midbrain
fields.definition: "A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the mesencephalon." [PMID:25561519]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplasia of the mesencephalon; Hypoplastic mesencephalon

fields.label: Aplastic zygomatic arch
fields.definition: "Developmental defect characterized by the absence of the zygomatic arch." [PMID:26119818]

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of facial bones
fields.definition: "A developmental defect characterized by absence or underdevelopment of one or more facial bone." []

fields.label: Absent lanugo
fields.definition: "Lack of development of lanugo, the fine, soft, unpigmented hair on the body of a fetus or newborn baby." [PMID:26119818, PMID:30252348]

fields.label: Abnormal vaginal bleeding
fields.definition: "Abnormal vaginal bleeding occurs between menstrual periods, after sex, or after menopause. Menstrual periods that are heavier or last longer than usual or last more than seven days also are considered abnormal." [PMID:21250125]

fields.label: Postcoital vaginal bleeding
fields.definition: "Postcoital bleeding (PCB) consists of spotting or bleeding after sexual intercourse that is not related to a person's menstrual cycle." [PMID:25045355]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bleeding after sex

fields.label: Mastalgia
fields.definition: "Pain in the breast." [PMID:16533457]
fields.synonyms_concat: Breast pain; Painful breast

fields.label: Vaginal bleeding during sex
fields.definition: "Bleeding during sex." []

fields.label: Pelvic pain
fields.definition: "Pain perceived in the area of the pelvis, the lower part of the abdomen located between the hip bones." [PMID:32119472]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pain in the pelvis

fields.label: Abnormal vaginal physiology
fields.definition: "Any anomaly of vagina function." []

fields.label: Abnormal vaginal discharge
fields.definition: "Anomalous amount, odor, or consistency of the fluid or mucus that comes from the vagina" []

fields.label: Serrated incisors
fields.definition: "Incisor teeth with irregular edges said to resemble a saw." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3475-564X, PMID:25439729]
fields.synonyms_concat: Jagged incisors

fields.label: Copper beaten skull
fields.definition: "Diffuse prominent gyral impressions on the inner table of skull vault said to resemble beaten copper." [PMID:31466955]

fields.label: Perifoveal hypoautofluorescence
fields.definition: "Decreased amount of autofluorescence (emission of fluorescent light from ocular structures in the absence of sodium fluorescein) in the retina in the region surrounding the fovea." [PMID:34800980]

fields.label: Premature sagging cheeks
fields.definition: "Drooping or sinking of tissues of the cheeks more than would be expected at a given age. Sagging can occur due to a relative excess of skin and/or lack of elastic recoil as well as fat accumulation." [PMID:19338976]
fields.synonyms_concat: Premature facial sagging

fields.label: Gastrointestinal ulcer
fields.definition: "A deep defect in the esophageal, gastric, duodenal or intestinal wall involving the entire mucosal thickness and penetrating through the muscularis mucosae." [PMID:16184417]

fields.label: Verrucous epidermal nevus
fields.definition: "A type of epidermal nevus (which represent Blaschkoid hamartomas of the skin that result from mosaic post-zygotic mutations) that appears as skin-colored-to-brown, sharply demarcated, papillomatous papules that coalesce into plaques. The majority of these nevi are either present at birth or occur within the first year of life." [PMID:24364998]

fields.label: Elevated circulating thymidine concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of thymidine in the blood circulation above the normal range." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased serum thymidine

fields.label: Elevated circulating deoxyuridine concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of 2-deoxyuridine in the blood circulation is above the normal range." []

fields.label: Multinucleated erythroblast
fields.definition: "Erythroblasts with multiple nuclei. Erythroblasts are nucleated precrusor cells of erythrocytes that are localized to the bone marrow. Normally, erythroblasts have a single nucleus. The abnormal finding of erythrocytes with two or more nuclei may be related to defects in cytokinesis." [PMID:11994986, PMID:23744492]
fields.synonyms_concat: Binucleated erythroblast; Bone marrow: multinucleated erythroblasts; Double-nucleated erythroblast; Multinucleate erythroblast

fields.label: 2,8-dihydroxyadenine crystalluria
fields.definition: "The presence of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine crystals in the urine. The crystals appear as round, yellow-brown crystals." []
fields.synonyms_concat: 2,8-dihydroxyadenine urinary crystals

fields.label: Target cells
fields.definition: "Target cells (codocytes) have a centrally located disk of hemoglobin surrounded by an area of pallor with an outer rim of hemoglobin adjacent to the cell membrane giving the cell the appearance of a target." [PMID:27372866, PMID:32965812]
fields.synonyms_concat: Codocytes

fields.label: Phalangeal cone-shaped epiphyses
fields.definition: "Cone-shaped epiphyses of the phalanges of the hands or feet. Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. That is, the epiphysis has a cone-shaped distal extension resulting from increased growth of the central portion of the epiphysis relative to its periphery." [PMID:22503633]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cone-shaped epiphyses of phalanges; Cone-shaped phalangeal epiphyses

fields.label: Subcutaneous ossification
fields.definition: "Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue in the soft tissue beneath the skin. Subcutaneous ossifications may be observed by radiography or by palpation." [PMID:29059381]

fields.label: Increased fecal protoporphyrin concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormally high concentration of protoporphyrin (derivative of porphyrin with propionic acid groups) in feces." [PMID:8852667]

fields.label: Recurrent gingivitis
fields.definition: "Repeated occurrences of inflammatory condition of the gums (gingival tissue), most commonly caused by bacterial infection." [PMID:32491354]

fields.label: Enteroviral encephalitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the brain related to infection by an enterovirus." []

fields.label: Afibrinogenemia
fields.definition: "Lack of detectable fibrinogen in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating reverse T3 concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of reverse T3 (3,3',5'-triiodothyronine or rT3) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:29883303]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating reverse triiodothyronine concentration; Elevated rT3

fields.label: Elevated circulating rT3/T3 ratio
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased ratio of the concentrations of reverse T3 to T3 in the blood circulation." [PMID:29883303]

fields.label: Elevated circulating tiglylglycine concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of tiglylglycine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:12696021]

fields.label: Elevated circulating creatine concentration
fields.definition: "An elevation above the normal range of creatine in the blood circulation." [PMID:11326334]

fields.label: Reduced circulating creatine concentration
fields.definition: "An reduction below the normal range of creatine in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Temporal lobe calcification
fields.definition: "The presence of calcium deposition within the temporal lobe of the brain." [PMID:20027545]

fields.label: Ductal bile plugs
fields.definition: "Bile thrombi that form an obstruction (plug) in a dilated bile duct." [PMID:2028872, PMID:22152905]

fields.label: Reduced cerebral white matter volume
fields.definition: "An abnormally low volume of the white matter of the brain." []
fields.synonyms_concat: White matter loss

fields.label: Elevated urine 3,5,6-trichloro-2-pyridinol level
fields.definition: "Detection of 3,5,6-trichloro-2-pyridinol in the urine." [PMID:15367928]

fields.label: Elevated circulating tetracosanoic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Elevated concentration of tetracosanoic acid (a C24 straight-chain saturated fatty acid) in the blood circulation." [PMID:17336976]

fields.label: Elevated circulating hexacosanoic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Elevated concentration of hexacosanoic acid (a C26 straight-chain saturated fatty acid) in the blood circulation." [PMID:17336976]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating cerotic acid concentration

fields.label: Sertoli cell-only phenotype
fields.definition: "A histological phenotype observed on testicular biopsy in which only Sertoli cells line the seminiferous tubules of the testis." [PMID:30484998]

fields.label: Decreased acid sphingomyelinase activity
fields.definition: "Reduced activity of the enzyme acid sphingomyelinase activity in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Congenital pouch colon
fields.definition: "A malformation of the colon in which a pouch-like dilatation of a varying degree of shortened colon is associated with an anorectal malformation. The pouch usually terminates in a fistulous communication with the genitourinary tract." [PMID:28413299]

fields.label: Megalopapilla
fields.definition: "A congenitally anomalous enlarged optic disc (surface area greater than 2.50 square millimeters). It is considered to be a normal variant without physiological defects." [PMID:31926369]

fields.label: Notched T wave
fields.definition: "A bifid T-wave with a notch duration between the 2 peaks at least 0.04 sec and an amplitude at least 0.05 mV." [PMID:29699857]
fields.synonyms_concat: Notched T-wave

fields.label: Epsilon wave
fields.definition: "An electric signal of depolarization observed between the end of the QRS complex and the beginning of the T wave." [PMID:30796961]

fields.label: 2:1 atrioventricular block
fields.definition: "A type of second-degree atrioventricular block in which every other P wave is not conducted through the AV node such that only every other P wave is followed by a QRS complex." [PMID:23388215]
fields.synonyms_concat: 2:1 AV block

fields.label: Ventricular bigeminy
fields.definition: "An electrocardiographic finding of a normal QRS followed by a premature ventricular contraction; a rhythmic pairing of normal and atypical beats originating in the ventricles in a 1-1 ratio such that an ectopic ventricular beat follows each regular heartbeat." [PMID:19043599]

fields.label: Elevated left ventricular end-diastolic diameter
fields.definition: "The LV end-diastolic internal diameter was measured from two-dimensional (2D) images in the parasternal long-axis view, timed with mitral valve closure at the level of the mitral valve chordae." [PMID:25525505]

fields.label: Prolonged P wave
fields.definition: "Abnormal increased in the duration of the P wave, which is a marker of delayed inter-atrial conduction." [PMID:25425321]

fields.label: Multiflagellar spermatozoa
fields.definition: "Spermatozoa with multiple flagella attached to the sperm head." [PMID:21733974]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multi-tailed spermatozoa

fields.label: Post-vaccination yellow fever
fields.definition: "Infection with the yellow fever virus of the live-attenuated vaccine." [PMID:31270247]
fields.synonyms_concat: Postvaccination yellow fever

fields.label: Hypoplastic optic chiasm
fields.definition: "Developmental defect characterized by undergrowth of the optic chiasm." [PMID:23312594, PMID:23591992]
fields.synonyms_concat: Optic chiasm hypoplasia

fields.label: Nocturnal hypoxemia
fields.definition: "Abnormally reduced oxyhemoglobin saturation during sleep (nocturnal). Different thresholds are used in the literature, including more than 10 percent of total sleep time below a SpO2 of 90 percent." [PMID:34630163]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sleep hypoxemia; Sleep-related hypoxemia

fields.label: Hyperdynamic left ventricular ejection fraction
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased ejection fraction of the left ventricle, usually defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction greater than 70 percent." [PMID:26250903, PMID:29083812]

fields.label: Abnormal left ventricular ejection fraction
fields.definition: "Any abnormality of the left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), which is the fraction of chamber volume ejected in systole (stroke volume) in relation to the volume of the blood in the ventricle at the end of diastole (end-diastolic volume). Stroke volume (SV) is calculated as the difference between end-diastolic volume (EDV) and end-systolic volume (ESV). LVEF is calculated as [SV/EDV] in percent." [PMID:29083812]

fields.label: Chronic cough
fields.definition: "A persistent cough, defined as a cough lasting longer than eight weeks in adults or longer than four weeks in children." [PMID:29094873]

fields.label: Thinning of the substantia nigra pars compacta
fields.definition: "Reduced volume of pars compacta of the substantia nigra." [PMID:26209139]
fields.label_normalized: thinning of the substantia nigra pars compacta

fields.label: Unusual virus reactivation
fields.definition: "Reactivation is the mechanism whereby a latent virus that has infected a host cell switches to a lytic stage, undergoing productive viral replication and allowing the virus to spread. This term refers to reactivation regarded as unusual because of frequency, intensity, location, or nature of the virus, in the sense that the reactivation would not be observed in an immunocompetent host." [PMID:21799704]

fields.label: CNS vasculitis with reactivation of varicella-zoster virus
fields.definition: "A vasculopathy in the central nervous system (CNS) following reactivation of varicella-zoster virus due to a productive viral infection of both large and small cerebral arteries." [PMID:30400213]
fields.label_normalized: cns vasculitis with reactivation of varicella-zoster virus

fields.label: Muscle fiber intracytoplasmic reducing inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "Intracytoplasmic inclusions in myofibers that reduce nitro-blue tetrazolium (NBT) and thus stain strongly with the menadione-NBT stain." [PMID:18274675]
fields.label_normalized: muscle fiber intracytoplasmic reducing inclusion bodies
fields.synonyms_concat: Intracytoplasmic myofiber reducing inclusion bodies

fields.label: Elevated circulating guanidinoacetic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:15651030]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased circulating guanidinoacetic acid concentration

fields.label: Reduced tissue galactocerebrosidase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of galactocerebrosidase (EC 3.2.1.46) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:34015306]
synonyms: Reduced galactocerebrosidase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced circulating galactocerebrosidase activity; Reduced galactocerebrosidase activity in cultured fibroblasts; Reduced leukocyte galactocerebrosidase activity

fields.label: Reduced circulating growth hormone concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of growth hormone in the blood circulation below normal limits." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Growth hormone deficiency; Somatotropin deficiency

fields.label: Brachiocephalic artery aneurysm
fields.definition: "An abnormal widening (dilatation) of the brachiocephalic artery" [PMID:33743755]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dilatated brachiocephalic artery; Innominate artery aneurysm

fields.label: Common carotid artery aneurysm
fields.definition: "An abnormal widening (dilatation) of the common carotid artery." []

fields.label: Adenomyosis
fields.definition: "Inappropriate (ectopic) endometrial tissue proliferation within the uterine myometrium, often presenting clinically with painful menses and heavy menstrual bleeding." [PMID:24771944, PMID:30969690]

fields.label: Posterior corneal stroma punctiform multicolored opacities
fields.definition: "Thin, punctiform elements of various colors in the posterior stroma of the cornea, immediately anterior to Descemet membrane. The elements are visible to direct and indirect illumination." [PMID:29728753]
synonyms: Punctiform multicolored opacities in the posterior corneal stroma
Punctiform multicoloured opacities in the posterior corneal stroma
fields.label_normalized: posterior corneal stroma punctiform multicolored opacities
fields.synonyms_concat: Punctiform multicolored opacities in the posterior corneal stroma; Punctiform multicoloured opacities in the posterior corneal stroma

fields.label: Fibro-obliterative bile-duct lesion
fields.definition: "A condition in which the lumen of a bile duct has been filled by fibrous scar material, in effect replacing the bile duct with a fibrous scar." [PMID:18701947]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fibro-obliterative bile-duct scarring; Fibro-obliterative loss of bile ducts

fields.label: Dysplastic megalencephaly
fields.definition: "A congenital brain malformation characterized by marked overgrowth and dysplasia affecting one or both cerebral hemispheres, and, in some cases, subcortical brain regions as well. The presence of dysplasia in dysplastic megalencephaly distinguishes it from other forms of generalized megalencephaly." [PMID:29594439]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bilateral hemimegalencephaly

fields.label: Regional right ventricular hypokinesis
fields.definition: "Decreased range of right ventricular motion in a portion of the right ventricle of the heart." [PMID:16549640]

fields.label: McConnell sign
fields.definition: "Severe hypokinesia of the mid-free wall of the right ventricle of the heart with a normal contraction of the apical segment of the right ventricle." [PMID:15664548]

fields.label: Cognitive regression
fields.definition: "Loss of cognitive developmental skills, as manifested by loss of developmental cognitive milestones." []

fields.label: Increased circulating hypoxanthine concentration
fields.definition: "Elevated concentration of hypoxanthine in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoxanthine high in blood

fields.label: Inheritance qualifier
fields.definition: "The terms in this hierarchy can be used to specify the context in which inheritance of a disease is typically observed." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Inheritance modifier

fields.label: Splenic infarction
fields.definition: "Ischemia and necrosis of part or all of the spleen resulting from compromise of blood supply resulting from arterial or venous occlusion." [PMID:23281181, PMID:28613652]
fields.synonyms_concat: Spleen infarct; Spleen infarction; Splenic infarct

fields.label: Claw hand deformity
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the hand characterized by metacarpophalangeal (MCP) hyperextension and proximal interphalangeal (PIP) and distal interphalangeal (DIP) flexion. The position of the affected hand is said to resemble a claw." [PMID:29939558]

fields.label: Imprinted
fields.definition: "Requires that the abnormal allele be paternal or maternal in origin, depending on the disease-gene relationship. Imprinting refers to a normal developmental process in which either the paternal or maternal allele is inactivated, depending on the specific locus, thus leading to expression from only one copy of the gene. Disease typically manifests when a deleterious variant is inherited from a parent whose copy of the gene would normally be expressed, but not when a deleterious variant is inherited from a parent whose copy of the gene would normally be inactivated." []

fields.label: Pseudoautosomal inheritance
fields.definition: "A pattern of inheritance observed for alleles in the X-Y identical regions is referred to as pseudoautosomal inheritance, because it resembles the pattern seen for alleles located on autosomes." [PMID:18660847]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pseudoautosomal region inheritance

fields.label: Pseudoautosomal dominant inheritance
fields.definition: "A type of pseudoautosomal inheritance that is dominant and in which heterozygous males and females both manifest a disease phenotype." []
fields.synonyms_concat: monoallelic_PAR

fields.label: Pseudoautosomal recessive inheritance
fields.definition: "A type of pseudoautosomal inheritance that is recessive and in which biallelic males and females both manifest a disease phenotype." []
fields.synonyms_concat: biallelic_PAR

fields.label: Trapezius muscle aplasia
fields.definition: "A developmental defect characterized by lack of formation of the trapezius muscle, which is broad superficial muscle that extends from the posterior neck to the posterior part of the trunk (thorax)." []

fields.label: Requires heterozygosity
fields.definition: "A rarely encountered phenomenon in which condition is most severe in the heterozygous state. Such disorders are rare and currently all are X-linked. Most X-linked recessive conditions manifest if hemizygous in males, or biallelic in females, though may have a mild phenotype in the heterozygous state in females." []

fields.label: Female-limited expression
fields.definition: "Used to refer to a monogenic trait linked to an autosomal locus in which the phenotypic effects of allelic differences are expressed only in the female sex." []

fields.label: Mendelian inheritance
fields.definition: "A mode of inheritance of diseases whose pathophysiology can be traced back to deleterious variants in a single gene. The inheritance patterns of these single-gene (monogenic) diseases are often referred to as Mendelian in honor of Gregor Mendel." []

fields.label: Nesidioblastosis
fields.definition: "An abnormality of pancreatic beta cells characterized by a proliferation of abnormal beta cells throughout the entire pancreas, with enlarged islet size and number (hypertrophic islets), increased periductular islets, enlarged beta-cell nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm. Occasionally beta cells with pleomorphic nuclei, ductuloinsular complexes, and neoformation of islets from ducts are observed." [PMID:15517495, PMID:24645840]

fields.label: Greater auricular nerve thickening
fields.definition: "Increase in thickness of the great auricular nerve, a cutaneous nerve of the head. It originates from the cervical plexus, with branches of spinal nerves C2 and C3. Thickening may lead to the nerve being palpable or even visible in this region." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Palpable great auricular nerve

fields.label: Subpulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing of the outflow tract of the right ventricle immediately below the pulmonary valve." [PMID:34304616]
fields.synonyms_concat: Infundibular pulmonary stenosis; Infundibular pulmonic stenosis; Subvalvar pulmonary stenosis; Subvalvar pulmonic stenosis; Subvalvular pulmonary stenosis; Subvalvular pulmonic stenosis

fields.label: Supravalvar pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing at the level of the pulmonary sinotubular junction above the pulmonic valve." [PMID:34304616]
fields.synonyms_concat: Supravalvar pulmonnic stenosis; Supravalvular pulmonary stenosis; Supravalvular pulmonic stenosis

fields.label: Valvular pulmonary stenosis
fields.definition: "A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing of the outflow tract of the right ventricle immediately at the level of the pulmonary valve." []

fields.label: Neuromyotonia
fields.definition: "Peripheral nerve hyperexcitability manifesting as spontaneous discharges originating from motor axons or their terminals, lead to overactivity of muscles, typically manifesting as twitches, cramps and stiffness." [PMID:29554580]
fields.synonyms_concat: Peripheral nerve hyperexcitability

fields.label: Bile duct polyp
fields.definition: "An elevated growth from the the mucosa of the bile duct." []

fields.label: Appendicular spasticity
fields.definition: "A type of spasticity that affects one or more limbs (arms or legs)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Extremity spasticity; Limb spasticity; Spastic extremities; Spastic limb; Spastic limbs; Spasticity of extremities; Spasticity of extremity; Spasticity of limbs

fields.label: Trichoschisis
fields.definition: "Transverse fractures through the hair shafts (trichoschisis). Trichoschisis is characterized by a sharp transverse fracture of the hair shaft." [PMID:23180925]

fields.label: White cerebellum sign
fields.definition: "On computed tomography of the brain,the white (or dense) cerebellum sign is seen when the cerebellum appears dense with respect to the cerebral parenchyma. The increase in attenuation of cerebellum is in fact a relative hyperdensity caused by decreased attenutation of the brain. It represents anoxic-ischemic cerebral injury, and has a very poor prognosis." [PMID:29089832]

fields.label: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of low molecular weight protein
fields.definition: "Increased loss of low-molecular weight proteins by the kidneys, measured in terms of the fractional excretion (FE). The FE of low-molecular-weight proteins such as beta2-microglobulin can be measured in terms of plasma and urine concentrations, since urinary low-molecular-weight protein concentrations can vary with water reabsorption." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248]
synonyms: Increased low molecular weight protein excretion
fields.label_normalized: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of low molecular weight protein
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased low molecular weight protein excretion

fields.label: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of glucose
fields.definition: "Increased fractional excretion (FE) of glucose in the urine. The FE of glucose is the percentage of the glucose filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine glucose, rather than by the interpretation of urinary glucose concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248]
fields.label_normalized: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of glucose

fields.label: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of sodium
fields.definition: "Increased fractional excretion (FE) of sodium in the urine. The FE of sodium is the percentage of the sodium filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine sodium, rather than by the interpretation of urinary glucose concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248]
fields.label_normalized: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of sodium

fields.label: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of phosphate
fields.definition: "Increased fractional excretion (FE) of glucose in the phosphate. The FE of glucose is the percentage of the phosphate filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine phosphate, rather than by the interpretation of urinary phosphate concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption." [PMID:25287933, PMID:31474092]
fields.label_normalized: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of phosphate

fields.label: Action myoclonus
fields.definition: "A type of myoclonus (arrhythmic muscular jerking) that is induced by voluntary movement. It is made worse by attempts at precise or coordinated movement (intention myoclonus) and may also be provoked by certain sensory stimuli." [PMID:3080851]

fields.label: Redundant umbilical skin
fields.definition: "Greater than normal amount of skin surrounding the umbilicus (belly button) with protrusion of the umbilicus above the plane of the abdomen." [PMID:8944018]

fields.label: Dull foveal reflex
fields.definition: "Reduced brightness of the foveal reflex, which normally is a bright pinpoint of light that is observed to move sideways or up and down in response to movement of the opthalmoscope." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased foveal light reflex; Muted foveal light reflex; Poor foveal light reflex

fields.label: Corneal pterygium
fields.definition: "Corneal pterygium is an ocular surface disease characterized mainly by a wing-shaped growth of limbal and conjunctival tissue over the adjacent cornea." [PMID:34104871]
fields.synonyms_concat: Surfer's eye; Wing-shaped conjunctiva

fields.label: Fibrofatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium
fields.definition: "Replacement of the myocardium of the right ventricular free wall by fat and fibrous tissue." [PMID:9691102]
fields.label_normalized: fibrofatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium

fields.label: Elevated circulating alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde in the blood circulation." [PMID:17560822]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating piperideine-6-carboxylic acid concentration

fields.label: Fracture blister
fields.definition: "Fracture blister is a type of blister that forms following acute bone fractures, typically near the ankle, wrist elbow or foot, where skin adheres tightly to bone with little subcutaneous fat cushioning. The blister that results resembles that of a second degree burn." [PMID:21691490]

fields.label: Decreased circulating beta-mannosidase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase below the lower limit of normal. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides." []

fields.label: Urolithiasis
fields.definition: "Renal stones are formed within the kidneys, and this is called nephrolithiasis. Urolithiasis is a condition that occurs when these stones exit the renal pelvis and move into the remainder of the urinary collecting system, which includes the ureters, bladder, and urethra." [PMID:32644527]

fields.label: Decreased level of coenzyme Q10 in skeletal muscle
fields.definition: "Reduced amount of coenzyme Q10,a naturally occurring quinone, in skeletal muscle tissue." [PMID:16400613]
fields.label_normalized: decreased level of coenzyme q10 in skeletal muscle

fields.label: Decreased circulating prekallikrein concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of prekallikrein in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Internal tibial torsion
fields.synonyms_concat: Internal tibial rotation

fields.label: External tibial torsion
fields.definition: "External twisting of the tibia resulting in the toes of each foot pointing outward (outtoeing) ." []
fields.synonyms_concat: External tibial rotation

fields.label: Trident acetabulum
fields.definition: "Abnormal appearance of the acetabulum characterized by spurs at the medial and lateral acetabular margin and in the center of the acetabulum, giving rise to shape resembling a three-pronged spear sadi to resemble a trident." [PMID:28744080]
fields.synonyms_concat: Trident acetabula

fields.label: Spherophakia
fields.definition: "Spherophakia is a rare congenital condition that presents with weak zonules around a more spherical crystalline lens with an increased anteroposterior thickness of the lens, and highly myopic eye. The lens zonules are developmentally hypoplastic and abnormally weak and due to non-attachment of the posterior zonules to the equatorial zone of the lens, the lens changes its normal shape to spherical." []

fields.label: Atrioventricular valve regurgitation
fields.definition: "Regurgitation of a heart valve that controls blood flow from a an atrium to a ventricle, including mitral, tricuspid, or, rarely, single atrioventicular valve." []

fields.label: Single atrioventricular valve regurgitation
fields.definition: "Regurgitation of the single atrioventricular valve regurgitation (AVVR) in the context of a congenital heart defect with a single ventricle. Roughly three quarters of patients following Fontan procedure display AVVR." [PMID:32419552]

fields.label: Urethrovesical occlusion
fields.definition: "Blockage of the flow of urine from the bladder into the urethra." []

fields.label: Juvenile type testicular granulosa cell tumor
fields.definition: "Juvenile granulosa cell tumor of the testis of neonates and infants is an uncommon lesion frequently associated with abnormal sex chromosome and ambiguous genitalia." [NCIT:C4207, PMID:17652550]
fields.label_normalized: juvenile type testicular granulosa cell tumor

fields.label: Central nervous system axonal spheroid
fields.definition: "Axonal spheroids are bubble-like biological features that form on most degenerating axons. During neurodegeneration, bubble-like swellings form along the length of the axon, a primary and early effect of dynamic axonal deformation. These varicosities, spheroids, or swellings have been described as beads on a string and branches bearing fruit, and they frequently appear on degenerating axons. The focal swellings on degenerating axons, axonal spheroids, are often filled with cellular debris such as organelles, pathological proteins, and disorganized cytoskeletal elements." [PMID:27423618, PMID:34678457]
fields.synonyms_concat: CNS axonal spheroid

fields.label: Disease remission
fields.definition: "A decrease in or disappearance of signs and symptoms typically associated with a disease course." [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8314-2140]

fields.label: Elevated circulating biliverdin concentration
fields.definition: "Increased concentration of biliverdin, a green tetrapyrrolic bile pigment, in the blood circulation." [PMID:19580635]

fields.label: Elevated circulating insulin:C-peptide ratio
fields.definition: "Increased ratio of insulin to C-peptide in the blood circulation." [PMID:15161766]

fields.label: Abnormal left ventricular endsystolic diameter
fields.definition: "A deviation from the normal range of the left ventricular endsystolic diameter." [PMID:24451180]

fields.label: Reduced left ventricular endsystolic diameter
fields.definition: "A lower than normal left ventricular endsystolic diameter." []

fields.label: Bacterial encephalitis
fields.definition: "Encephalitis caused by bacterial infection." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6310-0434, PMID:20952256]

fields.label: Hilar lymph node enlargement
fields.definition: "Hilar lymphadenopathy is swelling or enlargement of lymph nodes localized in hila, wedge-shaped anatomical structures containing pulmonary vessels, major bronchi, nerves and lymph nodes. Hilar lymph nodes are not visible on chest X-ray if they are not enlarged. Hilar lymph node enlargement can be caused by benign and malignant conditions and can be symmetrical (bilateral) or asymmetrical (unilateral)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hilar adenopathy; Hilar lymphadenopathy

fields.label: Pulmonary vein varix
fields.definition: "Pulmonary vein varix (PVV), refers to a localized dilatation of a pulmonary vein. PVV is a rare condition and can be congenital or acquired. PVV typically occur at the confluence of the veins adjacent to the left atrium. PVVs are sometimes classified into three morphological types: saccular, tortuous and confluent." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pulmonary vein dilatation

fields.label: Decreased CSF glycine concentration
fields.definition: "Abnormally decreased levels of glycine in cerebrospinal fluid." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Glycine low in CSF

fields.label: Elbow contracture
fields.definition: "A limitation in the passive range of motion of the elbow resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin." []

fields.label: Joint contracture
fields.definition: "A limitation in the passive range of motion of a joint resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin. A contracture prevents movement of the associated body part." [PMID:22938881, PMID:26247029, PMID:30928194]
fields.synonyms_concat: Contracture

fields.label: Elbow extension contracture
fields.definition: "An elbow contracture that limits the ability of the elbow joint to flex (flexion of the the elbow joint refers to bending the elbow joint to bring the hand closer to the shoulder), meaning that the elbow is fixed in an extended (straight) position." []

fields.label: Forearm supination contracture
fields.definition: "A contracture that limits the ability of the forearm to stabilize the hand in pronation (pronation refers to a rotation of the forearm that causes the palm and forearm to face downwards), meaning that the palm is fixed in a upward orientation. Restriction of supination/pronation can occur at the elbow (radial-humeral joint), at the wrist (radial-ulnar joint), and anywhere in between." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Supination contracture of the forearm

fields.label: Forearm pronation contracture
fields.definition: "A contracture that limits the ability of the forearm to stabilize the hand in supiation (supination refers to a rotation of the forearm that causes the palm and forearm to face upwards), meaning that the palm is fixed in a downward orientation. Restriction of supination/pronation can occur at the elbow (radial-humeral joint), at the wrist (radial-ulnar joint), and anywhere in between." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pronation contracture of the forearm

fields.label: Hippocampal malrotation
fields.definition: "Hippocampal malrotation, also termed incomplete inversion of the hippocampus or hippocampal malformation, is an increasingly recognized neuroimaging finding of undetermined clinical significance. It is characterized by features including (i) Round or pyramidal shape instead of ovoid shape; (ii) Medial position of the hippocampus on the hippocampal sulcus; (iii) The collateral sulcus is excessively deep or verticalized; (iv) Fimbria located medial to the hippocampus; (v) Small or displaced fornix; (vi) Enlarged temporal horn and empty choroid fissure; (vii) Thickened subiculum; (viii) Reduced upper horizontal portion of the parahippocampal gyrus." [PMID:33916495]

fields.label: Claw toe deformity
fields.definition: "Claw toes are characterized by hyperextension at the metatarsal-phalangeal joints and flexion of the interphalangeal joints." [PMID:28461920]

fields.label: Toe deformity
fields.definition: "Abnormal positioning of toe phalanges. Deformities of the lesser toes often occur gradually, though they can be brought on by trauma. The main adult sagittal plane deformities consist of claw toes, hammer toes and mallet toes. Axial plane deformities include crossover toes." [PMID:28461920]

fields.label: Prolonged central motor conduction time
fields.definition: "Increased duration of the central motor conduction time (CMCT). The CMCT estimates the conduction time of corticospinal fibers between motor cortex and spinal (or bulbar) motoneurons. It includes the times for excitation of cortical cells, conduction via the corticobulbar-corticospinal tract and excitation of the motoneuron sufficient to reach its firing threshold. CMCT is calculated by subtracting the peripheral conduction time from the MEP latency recorded after cortical stimulation." [PMID:24752292]

fields.label: Circumferential skin creases on extremities
fields.definition: "Ringed creases of the skin of the extremities related to folding of excess skin." [PMID:26637975]

fields.label: Atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor
fields.definition: "An aggressive malignant embryonal neoplasm arising from the central nervous system. It is composed of cells with a large eccentric nucleus, prominent nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm. Mutations of the SMARCB1 gene or very rarely SMARCA4 (BRG1) gene are present. The vast majority of cases occur in childhood. Symptoms include lethargy, vomiting, cranial nerve palsy, headache, and hemiplegia." []

fields.label: Rhabdoid tumor of the kidney
fields.definition: "A highly aggressive, extremely rare neoplasm of the kidney that is usually seen in children. The term rhabdoid is used because the tumor cells resemble rhabdomyoblasts but lack myogenic markers, and pathologic diagnosis requires familiarity with these microscopic features plus awareness that adult onset is possible. It can be associated with abnormalities of chromosome 22. It is characterized by the presence of cells with a large eccentric nucleus, prominent nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm." [NCIT:C8715, PMID:24982576, PMID:33692948]
synonyms: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of the kidney
Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the kidney
fields.synonyms_concat: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of the kidney; Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the kidney

fields.label: Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma
fields.definition: "A form of T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma in which cytotoxic CD8+ T cells infiltrate adipose tissue forming subcutaneous nodules." []

fields.label: Fungal hyphae in sputum
fields.definition: "Presence of hyphae (long, branching, filamentous structures produced by fungi) in sputum." []

fields.label: Enlarged tectum
fields.definition: "Increasaed size of the tectum, which is the region of the midbrain posterior to the cerebral aqueduct of Sylvius. The midbrain is the most superior portion of the brainstem." [PMID:23518331]
fields.synonyms_concat: Thick tectum

fields.label: Elevated CSF angiotensin-converting enzyme concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) high in CSF; Angiotensin-converting enzyme high in CSF

fields.label: Reduced circulating 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase concentration
fields.definition: "Decreased concentration of 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase in th blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase (THIO) deficiency

fields.label: Solitary angiokeratoma
fields.definition: "A dark, keratotic papule about 2-10 mm in diameter, usually occurring on the lower extremeities. Usually the lesions begin as bright, soft, and nonkeratotic paules which grow larger and change to a firm, blue to black and keratotic stage." [PMID:8993949]

fields.label: Fordyce angiokeratoma
fields.definition: "A type of angiokeratoma that most commonly occurs on the scrotum of patients who are 40 years old or older. The typical single lesion is a dark red to blue dome-shaped papule 2-4 mm in diameter with a very discrete keratotic surface. Typically, they are multiple and arranged in a line parallel to the raphe mediana of the scrotum. They also occur on the vulva and less commnly on the penis." [PMID:8993949]

fields.label: Angiokeratoma circumscriptum naeviforme
fields.definition: "A type of angiokeratoma that typically presents in childhood as a large, mostly linear and unilateral hyperkeratotic plaque which is composed of confluent keratotic papules. The size ranges from a few centimeters up to a major part of the body surface. Initially the lesions present as multiple reddish macules, clinically similar to a nevus flammeus. Within several years they develop into acanthokeratotic papules that agrregate into plaques which may have a hyperkeratotic surface." [PMID:8993949]

fields.label: Angiokeratoma of Mibelli
fields.definition: "A type of angiokeratoma that typically presents in women on the dorsa of fingers and toes and multiple dark red papules with a slightly verrucous surface, each measuring about 3-5 mm in diameter." [PMID:8993949]

fields.label: Laryngeal mass
fields.definition: "A lump in the region of the larynx. A mass is any lump in the body that can be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes or an immune reaction. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup. Laryngeal masses can be visualized by multiple methods include computed tomography." []

fields.label: Palate mass
fields.definition: "A lump in the region of the palate. A mass is any lump in the body that can be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes or an immune reaction. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup." []

fields.label: Thick oral frenulum
fields.definition: "Increased thickness of an oral frenulum, flaps of mucous membrane that extend from the midline gingiva to the upper or lower lip." []
fields.synonyms_concat: oral frenulum, thick

fields.label: Tooth avulsion
fields.definition: "A type of dental trauma characterized by total dislocation of the tooth from its socket." [PMID:30969698]
fields.synonyms_concat: Avulsed tooth; Teeth: avulsion

fields.label: Torn oral frenulum
fields.definition: "Laceration or tear of an oral frenulum, flaps of mucous membrane that extend from the midline gingiva to the upper or lower lip." [PMID:25426684]
fields.synonyms_concat: Laceration of oral frenulum; Oral frenulum, torn

fields.label: Intraoral laceration
fields.definition: "A wound of the mucosa within the oral cavity covering lips, tongue, palate, gingiva, pharynx, or retropharynx." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Intraoral lacerations

fields.label: Erythematous oral mucosa
fields.definition: "An erythematous lesion of the oral mucosa may result from a variety of tissue alterations, including inflammation, erythrocyte extravasation, and atrophy or reduced keratinization of the surface epithelium." [PMID:30693460]
fields.synonyms_concat: Oral mucosa erythema

fields.label: Mitral chordae tendinae rupture
fields.definition: "Breakage of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve. This can lead to loss of tension of one of the mitral valve leaflets and mitral regurgitation." [PMID:30470812]
fields.synonyms_concat: Flail mitral valve leaflet; Mitral chordae tendineae rupture

fields.label: History of cardiovascular procedure
fields.definition: "Indicates that a cardiovascular procedure such as stenting, bypass, catherization was performed on a patient." []

fields.label: Ejection click
fields.definition: "A high-pitched sound that occurs at the moment of maximal opening of the aortic or pulmonary valves. They are heard just after the first heart sound. The sounds occur in the presence of a dilated aorta or pulmonary artery or in the presence of a bicuspid or flexible stenotic aortic or pulmonary valve. Ejection clicks may also be called ejection sounds." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cardiac click sound on auscultation

fields.label: Cryofibrinogenemia
fields.definition: "Cryofibrinogen is an abnormal protein that forms precipitate only in plasma. consisting of fibrinogen, fibronectin, alpha1-antitrypsin and alpha2-macroglobulin." [PMID:27789759]

fields.label: Triggered by allergens
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to allergens." []

fields.label: Clicking tinnitus
fields.definition: "A type of tinnitus that presents as clicks, resembling the noise made by the snapping together of 2 fingers." [PMID:34147152]

fields.label: Reduced hair sulfur content

fields.synonyms_concat: Hair sulfur content reduced; Hair sulphur content reduced

fields.label: Chromhidrosis
fields.definition: "Secretion of colored sweat." [PMID:32119282]

fields.label: Purulent eye discharge

fields.synonyms_concat: Mucopurulent discharge from the eye

fields.label: Megaloblepharon
fields.definition: "Disproportionately large eyelids" [PMID:4236972]

fields.label: Bacteria in cerebrospinal fluid
fields.definition: "Presence of bacteria in the cerebrospinal fluid, as manifested by visual inspection or bacterial culture results." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bacteria in CSF

fields.label: Joint crepitus
fields.definition: "A popping, clicking or crackling sound that accompaniees movement of a joint." []

fields.label: Intertriginous distribution
fields.definition: "Applies to the localization of a skin lesion involving any area of the body where two opposing skin surfaces can touch and rub or chaff." [PMID:21396557]
fields.synonyms_concat: Intertriginous distribution of skin lesions

fields.label: Distributed along skin tension lines
fields.definition: "Applies to the localization of a skin lesion that correspond to skin tension lines, which are linear clefts in the skin that indicate the direction of orientation of the underlying collagen fibers. Skin tension lines are also known as Langer's lines or lines of cleavage." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Distributed along Langer's lines; Lesions follow lines of cleavage

fields.label: Abnormal communication
fields.definition: "Presence of any form of communication (e.g., verbal or non-verbal) that does not align with cultural expectations or developmental level." []

fields.label: Abnormal eye contact
fields.definition: "Any abnormality of eye contact behavior. We define eye contact as a form of nonverbal communication between two individuals who are facing each other in which an individual directs the eyes towards the eyes or face of the other individual. Eye contact occurs frequently and voluntarily during face-to-face verbal communication. The duration and frequency of eye contact that is interpreted to be appropriate may follow social and situational norms." []

fields.label: Gaze avoidance
fields.definition: "A deliberate avoidance of eye contact." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Gaze aversion

fields.label: Excessive eye contact
fields.definition: "Tendency to maintain sustained eye contact for an inappropriately long period of time." [PMID:29182643]

fields.label: Balanitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of glans penis" []

fields.label: Instep location
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the arched middle portion of the foot in front of the ankle joint (i.e., instep)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Instep localization to skin abnormality

fields.label: Ameliorated by ultraviolet light exposure
fields.definition: "Applies to a skin lesion that is improved or made more bearable by exposure to ultraviolet light (sunshine or phototherapy)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ultraviolet exposure improves condition

fields.label: Decreased circulating aspartic acid concentration
fields.definition: "An reduced concentration of aspartic acid in the blood circulation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Aspartic acid low in blood

fields.label: Abnormal circulating erythropoietin concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of erythropoietin in the blood circulation. Erythropoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the peritubular cells of the kidney that stimulates red blood cell production." []

fields.label: Reduced circulating erythropoietin concentration

fields.synonyms_concat: Erythropoietin low in blood

fields.label: Abnormal gamma-glutamyltransferase level
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal level of the enzyme gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT). GGT is mainly present in kidney, liver, and pancreatic cells, but small amounts are present in other tissues." []

fields.label: Reduced gamma-glutamyltransferase level
fields.definition: "Decreased level of the enzyme gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT). GGT is mainly present in kidney, liver, and pancreatic cells, but small amounts are present in other tissues." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Gamma-glutamyl transferase low in blood

fields.label: Elevated circulating histamine concentration

fields.synonyms_concat: Histamine high in blood

fields.synonyms_concat: IL-18 high in blood

fields.label: Arachnoid granulation

The lesions are primarily located in the parasagittal region along the superior sagittal sinus, which is occasionally seen at the transverse sinus. Normally dural venous sinus AGs typically range from 2 to 8 mm in size, but may grow enough to expand the dural sinuses, and even the inner table, diploic space and outer table of the skull." [PMID:22900137]

fields.label: Increased CSF taurine concentration

fields.synonyms_concat: Taurine high in CSF

fields.label: Elevated circulating glutathione concentration

fields.synonyms_concat: Glutathione high in blood

fields.label: Hawkinsinuria

fields.synonyms_concat: L-alloisoleucine high in CSF

fields.label: Hydroxylysinemia
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of hydroxylysine in the blood circulation. Hydroxylysine arises from a post-translational hydroxy modification of lysine and is unique to collagen and proteins containing collagen-like sequences. Elevated concentrations of hydroxylysine may indicate increased bone turnover." [PMID:404321]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hydroxylysine present in blood

fields.label: Homocitrullinuria
fields.definition: "An increased amount of L-homocitrulline in the urine. L-homocitrulline is an L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine having a carbamoyl group at the N(6)-position. It is found in individuals with urea cycle disorders." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Homocitrulline present in urine

fields.label: 2-hydroxyadipic aciduria
fields.definition: "The concentration of 2-hydroxyadipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: 2-hydroxyadipic acid high in urine

fields.synonyms_concat: Gastric xanthomas; Gastric xanthomata

fields.synonyms_concat: Clostridium botulinum toxin in stool

fields.label: Perihepatic adhesions

fields.synonyms_concat: Peri-hepatic adhesions

fields.label: Dilated vas deferens

fields.synonyms_concat: Vas deferens dilated

fields.label: Atypical gestures
fields.definition: "Spontaneous production of communicative gestures that are perceived as odd or mechanical, or are poorly integrated with other means of communication. This may include inaccurate mimicry of typical gestures." []

fields.label: Bone marrow vacuolated lymphocytes
fields.definition: "The presence of lymphocytes with multilple vacuoles (a membrane-bound cell organelle) in the bone marrow." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bone marrow: vacuolated lymphocytes

fields.label: Spinal cord calcifications
