fields.definition: "A type of hydrocele testis in which both the proximal and distal portions of processus vaginalis get obliterated while the central portion remains patent and fluid accumulates within it." [PMID:32644551]

fields.label: Congenital hydrocele
fields.definition: "Congenital hydrocele occurs when processus vaginalis is patent and communicates with the peritoneal cavity. This communication allows the movement of peritoneal fluid but is too small to allow the intra-abdominal contents to herniate through." [PMID:32644551]

fields.label: Infantile hydrocele
fields.definition: "Infantile Hydrocele is a type pf hydrocele in which the processus vaginalis gets obliterated at the level of the deep inguinal ring. However, the portion distal to it remains patent and allows fluid accumulation." [PMID:32644551]

fields.label: Decreased mucosal-associated invariant T cell proportion
fields.definition: "A decreased proportion of circulating mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells relative to total T cell count." [PMID:32161190]
synonyms: Reduced mucosal-associated invariant T cell proportion
Reduced proportion of mucosal-associated invariant T cells
fields.label_normalized: decreased mucosal-associated invariant t cell proportion
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced mucosal-associated invariant T cell proportion; Reduced proportion of mucosal-associated invariant T cells

fields.label: Puerpural onset
fields.definition: "Onset of a phenotypic abnormality or a disease during childbirth or in the period immediately following." []

fields.label: AA amyloidosis
fields.definition: "Extracellular tissue deposition of fibrils that are composed of fragments of and/or intact serum amyloid A protein, a hepatic acute phase reactant." [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3411-9598, PMID:29261990]

fields.label: Fracture type
fields.definition: "Category of fracture. Terms from this subontology can be used together with terms in the subontology that descends from Bone fracture (HP:0020110)." []

fields.label: Greenstick fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which the broken bone is not completely separated." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Incomplete fracture

fields.label: Transverse fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which the break is in a straight line across the bone." []

fields.label: Spiral fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which the break spirals around the bone." []

fields.label: Oblique fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which there is a diagonal break across the bone." []

fields.label: Compression fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which the bone is crushed, causing the broken bone to be wider or flatter in appearance." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Wedge fracture

fields.label: Comminuted fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which the break is in three or more pieces and fragments are present at the fracture site." []

fields.label: Segmental fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which the same bone is fractured in two places, so there is a floating segment of bone." []

fields.label: Open fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which there is an open wound or break in the skin near the site of the broken bone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Compound fracture

fields.label: Closed fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which the broken bone that does not penetrate the skin." []

fields.label: Avulsion fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture that is localied near to a a tendon or ligament and a small fragment of bone is separated from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma." []

fields.label: Displaced fracture
fields.definition: "A type of fracture in which the ends of the fractured bone are no longer aligned." []

fields.label: Exanthem
fields.definition: "A widespread rash." []

fields.label: Intestinal inflammation
fields.definition: "A reaction characterizeds by capillary dilatation, leukocytic infiltration, redness, heat, pain, swelling localized to the in the intestinal tract." [PMID:9897960]

fields.label: Abnormal apoptosis
fields.definition: "Any abnormality of programmed cell death (apoptosis), which is defined as the orchestrated collapse of a cell characterized by membrane blebbing, cell shrinkage, condensation of chromatin, and fragmentation of DNA followed by rapid engulfment of the corpse by neighboring cells. Apoptosis is distinguished from death by necrosis by the absence of an associated inflammatory response." [PMID:11420279]

fields.label: Decreased FasL-mediated apoptosis
fields.definition: "A reduced amount of programmed cell death upon stimulation of the FAS receptor, which normally induces caspase-8 dependent apoptosis." [PMID:29617412]

fields.label: Glomerular proteinuria
fields.definition: "A type of proteinuria characterized by increased permeability of the glomerular capillary wall to macromolecules (particularly albumin), whereby protein excretion can reach 20 g/24 h and consists mainly of albumin." [PMID:19634399]

fields.label: Abnormal lung development
fields.definition: "A structural defect associated with abnormal development of the lung." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Developmental pulmonary anomaly

fields.label: Pancreatic alpha-cell hyperplasia
fields.definition: "A diffuse and specific increase in the number of alpha-cells." [PMID:24285676]

fields.label: 3-4 metacarpal synostosis
fields.definition: "A congenital hand malformation characterized by the coalescence of the coalescence of third and fourth metacarpals (i.e., those corresponding to the middle and ring fingers)." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27698627]
synonyms: Middle and ring finger metacarpal synostosis
Synostosis of third and the fourth metacarpal bones
fields.synonyms_concat: Fused third and fourth metacarpals; Middle and ring finger metacarpal synostosis; Synostosis of third and the fourth metacarpal bones

fields.label: Sleep related hallucination
fields.definition: "Hallucination during onset/falling asleep in any sensory modality, usually auditory, visual, or tactile." []

fields.label: Poor sleep
fields.definition: "Subjectively or observationally reported sleep that is insufficiently restorative, disrupted, or of inadequate quality, regardless of duration. Poor sleep may involve difficulty maintaining sleep continuity, frequent awakenings, a sense of light or shallow sleep, or waking up feeling unrefreshed. It is typically identified through self-report or clinical interview and not by objective measurements." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Low-quality sleep; Poor sleep quality; Sleeping badly

fields.label: Abnormal iliac artery morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the iliac artery." []

fields.label: Iliac artery aneurysm
fields.definition: "Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the iliac artery." [PMID:9685125]

fields.label: Abnormal interest
fields.definition: "Any deviation from normal intensity or subject of a person's interests, which can be defined as a state of giving selective attention to something." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4422-1708]

fields.label: Persistent preoccupation with parts of objects
fields.definition: "A type of abnormal interest characterized by a persistent and intense focus on parts of a toy/object. For example, affected individuals may spin the wheels on a toy car rather than drive the toy car." []
synonyms: Fixated interest with parts of objects
fields.label_normalized: persistent preoccupation with parts of objects
fields.synonyms_concat: Fixated interest in unusual objects; Fixated interest with parts of objects; Fixation with parts of objects

fields.label: Fixated interests
fields.definition: "Highly restricted, fixated interests that are abnormal in intensity or focus (e.g., strong attachment to or preoccupation with unusual objects, excessively circumscribed or perseverative interests)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Circumscribed interests; Restricted interests

fields.label: Abnormal language feature
fields.definition: "The presence of any atypical form of expressive language." []

fields.label: Pronoun reversal
fields.definition: "Atypical language features characterized by first vs. second or third person pronoun errors such as using 'you' or 'he/she' in place of 'I'." []

fields.label: Involuntary vocalization
fields.definition: "Production of sound done without will or conscious control. Involuntary vocalizations include tics, stereotypies vocalizations as part of dystonia or chorea, continuous vocalizing behaviors such as groaning or grunting, pathological laughter and crying, and others. These vocalizations are not recognized as socially or culturally appropriate." [PMID:31651053]

fields.label: Reduced frequency of facial expressions
fields.definition: "The number of times facial expressions are produced in a given period is lower than expected given the social and cultural context." [PMID:26803417]

fields.label: Use of another person's body to communicate
fields.definition: "Moving another person's hand, body part, or body to communicate a desire, e.g. pushing or pulling someone toward a desired object or placing someone's hand on something." [PMID:25388062]
fields.label_normalized: use of another person's body to communicate
fields.synonyms_concat: Hand-leading gesture; Hand-taking gestures

fields.label: Fixated interest with abnormal focus
fields.definition: "A fixated interest in a specific topic that is atypical for the social context of the individual, such as topics of a non-social nature like fossils or vacuum cleaners." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Unusual preoccupations

fields.label: Fixated interest with abnormal intensity
fields.definition: "An abnormally intense interest in a topic or object that is not atypical for the social context of the affected person." [PMID:23880382]

fields.label: Sensory seeking
fields.definition: "Unusual interest in sensory aspects of the environment." [PMID:29112858]

fields.label: Reduced production of gestures
fields.definition: "Diminished use of typical non-verbal conversational gestures such as shaking the head to indicate no or nodding the head to indicate yes." [PMID:21182208]

fields.label: Reduced cooperative play
fields.definition: "Impairment in a child's ability to be able to play in a way that involves peer collaboration. Collaborative play involves things such as verbal and non-verbal communication (e.g., self-initiated interactions), turn-taking, sharing, reciprocity, and collaborative problem-solving. It is often contrasted to parallel play, which involves a form of social play in which two children do similar activities near each other and often mimic each other. Typically developing children develop collaborative play between the ages of 4 and 5." [PMID:10817421]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced collaborative play

fields.label: Lack of interest in peers
fields.definition: "Lack of interest in peers of comparable age and social groups is evident when an individual, such as a child, shows more interest in socializing with adults rather than children their own age." [PMID:34169757]
synonyms: Reduced desire to interact with peers
fields.synonyms_concat: Ignores peers; Reduced desire to interact with peers; Reduced interest in other children

fields.label: Reduced sharing of interests
fields.definition: "An absence or abnormally low frequency of engaging with others to share personal interests or topics. Interest sharing includes offers of information about oneself as a form of social interaction." []

fields.label: Reduced object sharing
fields.definition: "An absence or reduction in object sharing. Object sharing is an early emerging social skill in which a child will share objects such as toys, balls, or books with parents or peers during object play." [PMID:26803417]

fields.label: Abnormal communicative facial expressions
fields.definition: "Abnormal expressions (movements or position of muscles of the face that convey the emotional state of an individual to observers during social interactions) comprising abnormalities of quantity, range, context-appropriateness, and quality." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal facial expression use

fields.label: Facial expressions that do not match the context
fields.definition: "Production of facial expressions that are misaligned with the social context." []
fields.label_normalized: facial expressions that do not match the context

fields.label: Abnormal quality of facial expression
fields.definition: "Spontaneous production of communicative facial expressions that have poor quality or are exaggerated or muted." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Atypical facial expressions

fields.label: Abnormal gesture use
fields.definition: "Abnormality in the use of gestures defined as hand, shoulder, and head movements that convey a shared meaning within a culture that replace or supplement verbal communication." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal communicative gesture use; Abnormal communicative gestures; Abnormal gestures

fields.label: Poor conversational reciprocity
fields.definition: "Reduced use of reciprocal (back and forth) conversation, as compared to what would be expected for language level." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Failure of normal back-and-forth conversation

fields.label: Ectopic tooth eruption
fields.definition: "A condition in which the permanent teeth, because of deficiency of growth in the jaw or segment of jaw, assume a path of eruption that intercepts a primary tooth, causes its premature loss and produces a consequent malposition of the permanent tooth." [PMID:22114445]

fields.label: Corpus cavernosum hypoplasia
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly characterized by undergrowth of the corpus cavernosum." [PMID:21220346]

fields.label: Elevated circulating thymine concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of the nucleobase thymine in the blood circulation above the normal range." [PMID:33916495]

fields.label: Positive lactose hydrogen breath test
fields.definition: "Elevated hydrogen gas level in exhaled breath following oral administration of lactose. In individuals with lactose intolerance, undigested lactose in the colon will be metabolized by colonic bacteria, releasing hydrogen gas." [PMID:18985811]

fields.label: Triggered by exposure to medication
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by administration of a medication." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Triggered by medication exposure

fields.label: Triggered by allopurinol
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to allopurinol." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Allopurinol exposure

fields.label: Ameliorated by oral zinc supplementation
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by oral zinc supplementation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Zinc oral supplementation produces improvement

fields.label: Curved dental root
fields.definition: "A root of a tooth that is more rounded than normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Dental roots curved

fields.label: Abnormal four chamber view of the fetal heart
fields.definition: "The four-chamber (4Ch) view of the fetal heart is the most widely used screening examination for the detection of structural cardiac abnormalities during routine fetal ultrasonography. In the healthy normal fetus, the apical 4Ch view demonstrates four well-developed chambers, a concordant atrioventricular (AV) connection, unobstructed AV valves (mitral and tricuspid valves), the foramen ovale flap opening into left atrium (LA), and an intact interventricular septum. Additionally, the pulmonary venous opening can be visualized at the LA wall. Any structural deviations from normal anatomy may lead to congenital heart disease that can be determined by the 4Ch view of the fetal heart's ultrasound imaging." [PMID:7932993]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal four chamber view of the fetal heart
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal four chamber view

fields.label: Spleen hamartoma
fields.definition: "A hamartomatous lesion (benign focal lesions composed of disorganized tissue elements) localized in the spleen." []

fields.label: Positive lupus band test
fields.definition: "Deposits of immunoglobulins and complement components along the dermoepidermal junction." [PMID:21339940]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lupus band test positive

fields.label: Bone marrow erythroid vacuolization
fields.definition: "Formation of vacuoles (a space within a cell that is empty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in the cytoplasm of erythroid precursors in the bone marrow." [PMID:29716882]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bone marrow: erythroid vacuolization

fields.label: Triggered by electromagnetic field
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to an electromagnetic field." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Electromagnetic field triggers symptoms

fields.label: Exposure history
fields.definition: "Information about current and past exposure to metals, dust, fibers, fumes, chemicals, biologic hazards, radiation, noise, and/or vibration at work or home." []

fields.label: Asbestos exposure
fields.definition: "History of exposure to asbestos, a fibrous mineral with physical and chemical properties that make it resistant to heat and degradation." [PMID:28706902]

fields.label: Medication history
fields.definition: "Information about current or past medications taken by an individual." [PMID:16129874]

fields.label: Aminoglycoside exposure
fields.definition: "History of having taken aminoglycoside antibiotics." []

fields.label: Statin exposure
fields.definition: "History of having taken statins, also known as HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors." []

fields.label: Potassium-sparing diuretic exposure
fields.definition: "History of having taken a potassium-sparing diuretic exposure such as amiloride, eplerenone, spironolactone, and triamterene." []

fields.label: Carbamazepine exposure
fields.definition: "History of having taken carbamazepine." []

fields.label: Valproate exposure
fields.definition: "History of having taken valproate (valproic acid)." []

fields.label: Hydralazine exposure
fields.definition: "History of having taken hydralazine." []

fields.label: Calcium channel blocker exposure
fields.definition: "History of having taken a calcium channel blocker such as amlodipine, nicardipine, nifedipine, verapamil, or diltiazem." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Calcium channel blocking drug use

fields.label: Triggered by nickel
fields.synonyms_concat: Contact with nickel

fields.label: Triggered by poison ivy, poson oak, or sumac
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure (cutaneous contact) to poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac. These three plants each contain urushiol. Contact with these plants is the most common causes of clinically diagnosed allergic contact dermatitis." []
synonyms: Contact with poison ivy, poison oak, or sumac
fields.label_normalized: triggered by poison ivy, poson oak, or sumac
fields.synonyms_concat: Contact with poison ivy, poison oak, or sumac

fields.label: History of exclusive breast feeding
fields.definition: "A past medical history of having been fed exclusively by breast feeding." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Breast feeding, exclusive

fields.label: Nutrition history
fields.definition: "A part of the past medical history consisting of information about the typical food intake of an individual." [PMID:10193594]

fields.label: High dietary oxalate intake
fields.definition: "A history of ingestion of a relatively high amount of foods containing high levels of oxalate, such as green-leaf vegetables, tea, nuts, chocolate and rhubarb." [PMID:32887293]
synonyms: Foods high in oxalate, high intake
fields.synonyms_concat: Foods high in oxalate, high intake

fields.label: Recent honey ingestion
fields.definition: "A history of ingestion of honey in recent weeks." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Honey ingestion in recent weeks

fields.label: Raw egg-white ingestion
fields.definition: "A history of eating raw egg whites." []

fields.label: Exacerbated by sodium channel blocking agent exposure
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by administration of sodium channel blocking agents such as phenytoin, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, lamotrigine, topiramate, and zonisamide." []
synonyms: Sodium channel blocking drugs aggravate findings
fields.label_normalized: exacerbated by sodium channel blocking agent exposure
fields.synonyms_concat: Sodium channel blocking drugs aggravate findings

fields.label: Addictive nitrous oxide use
fields.definition: "Addiction to inhaled nitrous oxide gas (N2O) is a growing concern." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Nitrous oxide abuse; Nitrous oxide addiction

fields.label: Recent blood transfusion
fields.definition: "A past medical history of a recent blood transfusion." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Blood transfusion, recent

fields.label: Ameliorated by colchicine
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of colchizine." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Colchicine ameliorates symptoms

fields.label: Ameliorated by vitamin D
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of vitamin D." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Vitamin D reduces manifestations

fields.label: Exacerbated by phenytoin exposure
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by administration of phenytoin." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Phenytoin produces worsening

fields.label: Triggered by angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to anngiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor such as benazepril, captopril, enalapril, fosinopril, and lisinopril." []
fields.synonyms_concat: ACE inhibitors trigger attacks

fields.label: Prostaglandin E1 exposure
fields.definition: "History of having been treateed with prostaglandin E1." [PMID:31536236]

fields.label: 5-fluorouracil exposure
fields.definition: "History of having been treated with 5-fluorouracil." []

fields.label: 6-mercaptopurine exposure
fields.definition: "History of having been treateed with 6-mercaptopurine." []

fields.label: Isoniazid exposure
fields.definition: "History of having been treateed with isoniazid." []

fields.label: Absent cavum septum pellucidum
fields.definition: "The cavum septum pellucidum (CSP) is an important fetal midline forebrain landmark that is normally visible by prenatal sonography. This term refers to the lack of visibility of the CSP on prenatal sonography. The CSP normally can be visualized between 18 and 37 weeks of gestation. Lack of visualization of the CSP in this time period generally requires follow up and may indicate the presence of underlying malformations such as malformations of the corpus callosum. The lack of CSP before 18 weeks or after 37 weeks of gestation (or postnatally) is considered a normal finding." [PMID:26123886]

fields.label: Fetal abdominal cyst
fields.definition: "Fetal abdominal cysts are usually detected during the second trimester anomaly scan or discovered incidentally at later gestations. However, a definitive diagnosis is often not made until postnatal life. The most common etiologies of fetal abdominal cysts are: ovarian, gastrointestinal cystic duplication, liver and choledochal, meconium pseudocysts, mesenteric and adrenal. Following identification of a cyst, careful morphological assessment allows the prediction of their natural history and importantly, the likelihood of surgical intervention being required postnatally." [PMID:12780436, PMID:30763268, PMID:34189111]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fetal cystic abdominal mass; Foetal abdominal cyst; Foetal cystic abdominal mass

fields.label: Fetal bowel dilatation
fields.definition: "Fetal bowel dilatation is characterized by fluid-filled intestinal loops which measure at least fifteen millimeters long or seven millimeters in diameter. Ultrasonographic image of dilated fetal bowel is a sign of intestinal mechanical or functional obstruction and its prevalence will depend on the underlying condition: bowel atresia or stenosis, malrotation with volvulus, meconium ileus, total colonic aganglionosis, and meconium plug syndrome. The etiology of fetal bowel dilatation is a difficult prenatal diagnosis since ultrasound has limited accuracy for bowel evaluation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Foetal bowel dilatation; Prenatal ultrasound: bowel loops dilated

fields.label: Left ventricular dilatation
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the chamber of the left heart ventricle." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Dilated left heart ventricle

fields.label: Fetal trigonocephaly
fields.definition: "A fetal ultrasound finding defined by flattening of the occiput with pointing of the frontal bones and brachycephaly with an increased cephalic index. It is characterized by keel shaped deformity of forehead with midline ridge, bilateral fronto temporal constriction with compensatory biparietal expansion, supra orbital and lateral orbital retrusion and hypotelorism. This finding is said to resemble a strawberry." [PMID:25250065, PMID:26498670, PMID:30363185]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foetal trigonocephaly; Strawberry sign; Strawberry skull; Strawberry-shaped skull

fields.label: Abnormal fetal heart outflow tract
fields.definition: "A prenatal anomaly of the outflow tract. Fetal ultrasound may not always be able to easily and accurately describe the outflow anomaly, but can detect abnormal anatomy. Often, follow up with a fetal echo is recommended, but fetal ultrasound is limited." []

fields.label: Recent past medical history
fields.definition: "History of events that precede the current presenting condition and are thought to be of potential relevance, having occurred in the hours, days, or weeks before the current condition." []

fields.label: History of recent viral illness
fields.definition: "Medical history of a viral illness in recent weeks." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Antecedent viral illness

fields.label: History of recent dental procedure
fields.definition: "Medical history of a dental procedure in recent weeks." []

fields.label: Abnormal hepatic artery morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the hepatic artery or its branches." []

fields.label: Hepatic artery hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase in size of the hepatic arteries." []

fields.label: Lymph node necrosis
fields.definition: "Areas of necrotic tissue within a lymph node." [PMID:3317224]
fields.synonyms_concat: Necrosis in lymph node

fields.label: Multinucleated neuron
fields.definition: "Neurons that contain more than one nucleus." []

fields.label: History of recent contralateral injury
fields.definition: "A history of an injury that occurred several hours, days, or weeks before the current presenting complaint and is located on the other side of the body relative to the current presenting complaint." []

fields.label: Alternating laterality
fields.definition: "Occurring on the left and right in succession. This term can refer to alternating sides of the body (e.g., Alternating hemiplegia) or alternative sides of the visual field (e.g., some migraine auras)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Alternating sides of the body

fields.label: Cervical squamous cell papilloma
fields.definition: "A benign tumor arising from the epithelial surface of the cervix and usually caused by Human Papillomavirus infection." [PMID:32809572]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cervix squamous papilloma

fields.label: Liver leiomyoma
fields.definition: "A benign smooth muscle neoplasm that arises in the liver." [PMID:33139985]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hepatic leiomyoma

fields.label: Typified by high penetrance
fields.definition: "Description of conditions in which only an incomplete but relatively high proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for incomplete, but high penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least 80 percent but less than 100 percent of individuals with the given genotype would manifest the disease with a full lifespan." []

fields.label: Typified by moderate penetrance
fields.definition: "Description of conditions in which only a moderate proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for moderate penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least 20 percent but less than 80 percent of individuals with the given genotype would manifest the disease with a full lifespan." []

fields.label: Typified by low penetrance
fields.definition: "Description of conditions in which only a low proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for low penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least some but less than 20 percent of carriers would manifest the disease with a full lifespan." []

fields.label: Decreased Succinyl-CoA 3-ketoacid CoA transferase activity
fields.definition: "Decreased activity of the enzyme succinyl-CoA 3-ketoacid CoA transferase." [PMID:21296660]
fields.synonyms_concat: SCOT activity low in fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced phytanic acid oxidase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of the enzyme phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase (PhyH; EC 1.14.11.18) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts. PhyH plays a role in the catabolism of phytanic acid, a branched-chain fatty acid that is a normal constituent of the human diet." [PMID:10767344, PMID:2433405]
fields.label_normalized: reduced phytanic acid oxidase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase activity; PhyH activity low in fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced bifunctional protein activity
fields.definition: "Diminished activity of hydroxysteroid 17-beta dehydrogenase 4 (HSD17B4), also known as D-bifunctional protein (DBP), a peroxisomal enzyme that catalyzes multiple steps of beta-oxidation of very long chain fatty acids." [PMID:32904102]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced 17-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase 4 activity

fields.label: Decreased circulating plasmalogen concentration
fields.definition: "Reduced plasmalogen concentration in the blood circulation." [PMID:30974122]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced circulating plasmalogen concentration

fields.label: Post-vaccination varicella zoster virus infection
fields.definition: "Infection with live, attenuated varicella-zoster virus following vaccination. This is an extremely rare event that may indicate immunocompromise." [PMID:31527188]
synonyms: Varicella zoster virus infection after vaccination
fields.synonyms_concat: Varicella zoster virus infection after vaccination

fields.label: Recent steroid exposure
fields.definition: "History of having been treated with corticosteroid medications in recent weeks." []
fields.synonyms_concat: History of recent steroid use

fields.label: Shark teeth
fields.definition: "Eruption of permanent teeth behind deciduous (baby) teeth before they have fallen out, resulting in a double row of teeth. This phenomen is typically observed between the ages of 5 to 7 years." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cauliflower teeth; Double-parked teeth; Teeth: double row

fields.label: Pontine T2 hypointensity
fields.definition: "A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the pons." [PMID:23497566]

fields.label: Anti-platelet antigen antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against antigens present on the surface of thrombocytes such as the glycoproteins GPIIb/IIIa, GPIb/IX, and GPIa/IIa." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Antiplatelet antibodies present

fields.label: Anti-voltage-gated potassium channel antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against a voltage-gated potassium channel." [PMID:20816272]
synonyms: Voltage gated potassium channel antibodies in blood
fields.synonyms_concat: Voltage gated potassium channel antibodies in blood

fields.label: Vegan diet
fields.definition: "A history of following a vegan diet characterized by avoidance of food sourced from animals including meat, fish, and dairy products." []

fields.label: History of previous pregnancy with hydrops fetalis
fields.definition: "One or more previous pregnancies in which the fetus developed hydrops fetalis." []
synonyms: History of hydrops fetalis in newborn offspring

fields.label: Reduced awareness of convention
fields.definition: "Reduced awareness of expected conventions, which are normal and expected for particular social settings or interactions." []

fields.label: Abnormal relationship
fields.definition: "The state of having abnormal relationships with others. This does not describe specific aspects of one's social aptitudes but rather a state which may come about from these aptitudes, such as lacking peer relationships, lacking close friends, or having a relational network that is abnormal given one's cultural context." []

fields.label: Impaired social imitation
fields.definition: "Reduced use of imitation of tasks or movements of others in play or learning." [PMID:18221343]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased imitation of others; Reduced immediate imitation of others

fields.label: Infrequent social initiations
fields.definition: "Social initiation refers to the ability to begin interactions with other people. This term refers to a reduction in the frequency with which an individual attempts to begin interactions. The term should only be used for individuals who are assessed to have sufficient intellectual and language skills to interact with others." [PMID:14622895]
synonyms: Infrequent attempts to direct the attention of another person
Reduced attempt to get or direct the attention of another person
fields.synonyms_concat: Infrequent attempts to direct the attention of another person; Reduced attempt to get or direct the attention of another person; Reduced social initiation

fields.label: Reduced responsiveness to social cues
fields.definition: "A tendency to display responces to social cues that are interpreted (e.g., by family members, peers, or caregivers) as diminished compared to what would be expected based on the developmental stage and cultural context of an individual." []
synonyms: Lack of response to verbal cues
fields.synonyms_concat: Lack of response to verbal cues; Reduced response to social cues; Reduced responsiveness to verbal cues

fields.label: Social disinhibition
fields.definition: "A tendency to violate social norms because of a failure to resist temptations or urges in social settings." [PMID:27696753]

fields.label: Diminished integration of verbal and non-verbal communicative behavior
fields.definition: "A communicative abnormality where one's nonverbal and verbal communication are poorly integrated. This may occur when verbal and nonverbal communication are intact alone but are abnormal when used together, or an abnormality in the use of typically integrated communication such as the use of beat gestures during speech." []
fields.label_normalized: diminished integration of verbal and non-verbal communicative behavior

fields.label: Reduced cooperative imaginative play
fields.definition: "Failure of a child to engage with peers games that involve creating imaginary scenarios or narratives, for instance, in which children pretend to be characters or act out adventurous scenarios." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced collaborative imaginative play

fields.label: Lack of expressed empathy
fields.definition: "The observation that an affected person tends not to provide situationally appropriate responses to other people in times when these people are in emotional need. For instance, failure to provide comfort to a person who is sad or crying." [PMID:23929944, PMID:37852203]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lack of empathy; Lack of expressed sympathy; Reduced empathic arousal; Reduced sympathetic expression

fields.label: Bradylalia
fields.definition: "Speech that is abnormally slow as compared to the perceived cultural norm." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bradylogia; Slow speech

fields.label: Excessively loud speech
fields.definition: "Speech which is persistently abnormally and noticeably loud or high volume for the social and cultural context and is not due to a structural or muscular abnormality. Those around the person often consider them to be shouting." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Speech too loud for context

fields.label: Excessively quiet speech
fields.definition: "Speech which is persistently abnormally quiet, or of low in volume for the social and cultural context. This includes persistent and inappropriate whispering. It is not due to a medical or surgical condition that results in hoarseness, nor structural or muscular abnormality that results in low speech volume." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Excessively quiet voice; Excessively soft voice; Speech to soft for context

fields.label: Abnormal speech volume
fields.definition: "Speech that is abnormally loud or quiet for the social and cultural context in which it is spoken. It is clinically noted by others, including family, friends, or clinical providers." []

fields.label: Reduced attention regulation
fields.definition: "An abnormality in one's ability to control their attention towards a specific subject or task can include difficulties in changing or maintaining attention." []

fields.label: Reduced impulse control
fields.definition: "Reduced ability to control, or a failure to resist a temptation, urge, or impulse." [PMID:16263865]
fields.synonyms_concat: Impaired self-restraint

fields.label: Sensory behavioral abnormality
fields.definition: "Abnormal sensory behavior, including avoiding or seeking sensory input or difficulty modulating sensory stimuli." []

fields.label: Idiosyncratic gesture
fields.definition: "When one uses gestures that are unique to them and have no apparent meaning to others." [PMID:22954367]

fields.label: Atypical sorting
fields.definition: "Atypical focus on arranging, balancing, or positioning objects; may be atypical in focus or intensity." [PMID:31016439]
fields.synonyms_concat: Arranging; Ordering

fields.label: Excessive checking
fields.definition: "Checking behavior that is excessive for the situational context." [PMID:31016439]
fields.synonyms_concat: Checking behaviors; Checking behaviours

fields.label: Excessive hand washing
fields.definition: "Hand washing behavior that is excessive for the situational context." []

fields.label: Resistance to trivial environmental changes
fields.definition: "Distress in response to minor changes in one's environmental expectations." []

fields.label: Reduced co-speech gestures
fields.definition: "Reduced use of speech-integrated gestures such as the use of beat gestures." []

fields.label: Limited head nodding or shaking
fields.definition: "Absence or reduction in the use of head nodding to indicate agreement or head shaking to indicate disagreement." []

fields.label: Limited pointing
fields.definition: "Absence or reduction in the use of pointing to request or direct another's attention." []

fields.label: Sensory hypersensitivity
fields.definition: "A decreased tolerance to sensory stimuli that triggers emotional and/or physical distress." [PMID:29112858]

fields.label: Sensory hyposensitivity unexplained by sensory deficit
fields.definition: "Increased tolerance to sensory stimuli due to diminished sensory ability." [PMID:29112858]
fields.label_normalized: sensory hyposensitivity unexplained by sensory deficit

fields.label: Auditory hypersensitivity
fields.definition: "Hyperresponsive to sound that is abnormal in intensity and/or frequency." [PMID:29112858]
fields.synonyms_concat: Loudness intolerance; Sensitivity to noise

fields.label: Tactile hypersensitivity
fields.definition: "A decreased tolerance to physical touch." [PMID:29112858]

fields.label: Auditory sensory seeking
fields.definition: "Pursuit of specific sounds or noises that is abnormal in intensity and/or frequency." [PMID:29112858]

fields.label: Gustatory sensory seeking
fields.definition: "Pursuit of a particular taste that is abnormal in intensity and/or frequency." [PMID:29112858]

fields.label: Olfactory sensory seeking
fields.definition: "Pursuit of specific scents, smells, or fragrances that is abnormal in intensity and/or frequency." [PMID:29112858]
fields.synonyms_concat: Smell seeking

fields.label: Tactile sensory seeking
fields.definition: "Pursuit of a specific texture that is abnormal in intensity and/or frequency." [PMID:29112858]

fields.label: Vestibular sensory seeking
fields.definition: "Pursuit of vestibular stimulation that is abnormal in intensity and/or frequency." [PMID:29112858]

fields.label: Visual sensory seeking
fields.definition: "Pursuit visual stimulation by looking at specific sights, images, and/or colors that is abnormal in intensity and/or frequency." [PMID:29112858]

fields.label: Socially inappropriate questioning
fields.definition: "A tendency to ask questions that are overly personal or otherwise inappropriate in the social situation in which they are asked." []

fields.label: Spinning
fields.definition: "An excessive frequency of spinning one's body." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Twirling

fields.label: Delayed Echolalia
fields.definition: "Repetition of borrowed words or phrases outside of the context in which they were originally heard. E.g., scripting from TV shows or movies." []

fields.label: Immediate Echolalia
fields.definition: "Immediate repetition of another person's speech." []

fields.label: Excessive cleaning
fields.definition: "Excessive cleaning of surfaces, living space, or environment that is excessive for the situational context." []

fields.label: Facial expressions not directed to others
fields.label_normalized: facial expressions not directed to others

fields.label: Reduced social smiling
fields.definition: "Reduced production of smiles during engagement with an interactive parent, caregiver, or peer." [PMID:17682330]

fields.label: Abnormal play
fields.definition: "An abnormality in a child's ability play." []

fields.label: Reduced imaginative play skills
fields.definition: "Reduced or lack of pretending in play (does not assign abstract properties to objects, use invisible objects, or use objects in nonliteral ways other than their intended purpose in play)." [PMID:26263228]

fields.label: Nonfunctional or atypical use of objects in play
fields.definition: "Use of objects in atypical, unimaginitive ways other than for which they are intended (banging, throwing, shaking, sorting, lining up, spinning)." []
fields.label_normalized: nonfunctional or atypical use of objects in play

fields.label: Infrequent social engagement with peers
fields.definition: "Lower than typical number of attempts to engage peers in conversation, play, or other interactions." [PMID:25328380, PMID:36601420]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aloneness; Infrequent attempting to engage peers; Marked preference for solitude; Poor social engagement; Prefers being alone

fields.label: Avoidance of emotional intimacy
fields.definition: "An atypically high tendency to avoid interpersonal exchanges characterizing by sharing of personal feelings, expressions of understanding, affirmation, and demonstrations of caring." [PMID:21337211]

fields.label: Failure to offer information to initiate social interaction
fields.definition: "An atypically low tendency to offer information as a means to initiate or sustain social interactions or direct another's attention." []
fields.label_normalized: failure to offer information to initiate social interaction

fields.label: Difficulty understanding nonliteral meaning of conversation
fields.label_normalized: difficulty understanding nonliteral meaning of conversation

fields.label: Difficulty recognizing another's emotions
fields.definition: "A difficulty in recognizing or interpreting the emotional states of other individuals." []

fields.label: Abnormal social emotional interactions
fields.definition: "An atypically low production of emotion social communications including those produced by communicative behaviors such as facial expressions, body language, and verbal communication." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormality in emotional social interactions

fields.label: Objectification of others
fields.definition: "A tendency to interact with others as if they are objects with functional purpose rather than engaging in social/emotional interactions." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Treats people like objects

fields.label: Abnormal response to social norms
fields.definition: "An atypical understanding or application of social rules and conventions that guide interpersonal behavior. This may include reduced awareness of social norms or rigid, context-insensitive adherence to them." []

fields.label: Indifference to social norms
fields.definition: "Failure to follow social norms (shared standards of acceptable behavior) even though one has awareness of these norms and the ability to follow them." [PMID:32484000]

fields.label: Aggression towards others
fields.definition: "Aggression that is directed towards other individuals, as opposed to oneself." []

fields.label: Aggression towards caregivers
fields.definition: "Aggression that is directed towards caregivers." []

fields.label: Aggression toward non-caregivers
fields.definition: "Aggression that is directed towards non-caregivers." []

fields.label: Abnormal rituals
fields.definition: "Insistence on rituals which are self-imposed on a person's environment including directing the behavior of those around them." []

fields.label: Jumping
fields.definition: "An excessive frequency of jumping in place." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bouncing; Hopping; Pogo-ing

fields.label: Delay in the acquisition of cooperative play skills
fields.definition: "Failure to acquire the ability to play cooperatively, a type of play in whichchildren work together towards a common goal and in which a child displays interest both in the play and in the the other child or children involved in playing. This ability is observed in neurotypical children from the age of 3 to 6 years." [PMID:35052266]
fields.label_normalized: delay in the acquisition of cooperative play skills

fields.label: Reduced social reciprocity
fields.definition: "Reduced responses to other people's emotions and/or a lack of modulation of behaviour according to social context." [PMID:21769705]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced friendship reciprocity; Reduced social reciprocity with peers

fields.label: Olfactory hallucination
fields.definition: "Perception of smell without olfactory stimulus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hallucinations of smell; Smell hallucination

fields.label: Gustatory hallucination
fields.definition: "Perception of taste without gustatory stimulus." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hallucinations of taste; Taste hallucination

fields.label: Abnormal interpretation of external stimuli
fields.definition: "Abnormal perception of reality is characterized by an abnormal or inaccurate experience of external stimuli." []

fields.label: Proprioceptive hallucination
fields.definition: "A type of hallucination that involves the perception of distorted or abnormal sensations related to one's body position or movement." []

fields.label: Disturbed perception with a stimulus
fields.definition: "A perceptual experience in which an individual's perception of sensory stimuli is altered or disrupted in some way, resulting in abnormal or distorted sensory perceptions despite the presence of actual external stimuli." []

fields.label: Illusions
fields.definition: "Perceptual experiences that involve misinterpretations or distortions of sensory stimuli." []

fields.label: Inattentiveness illusion
fields.definition: "Instances in which individuals fail to perceive or notice salient or significant stimuli in their visual field due to a lack of attention." []

fields.label: Illusions due to affect
fields.definition: "Perceptual distortions or misinterpretations of sensory information arise as a result of the individual's emotional or affective state." []

fields.label: Pareidolia
fields.definition: "Apophenia is a psychological phenomenon in which individuals perceive familiar patterns or meaningful images in random or ambiguous stimuli, such as clouds, shadows, or inanimate objects." []

fields.label: Autoscopy
fields.definition: "A phenomenon in which an individual perceives themselves from an external perspective, as if they are observing their own body or self from a location outside of their physical body." []

fields.label: Subjective eidetic images
fields.definition: "A mental phenomenon is when an individual can vividly visualize or recall visual information from memory with exceptional detail and accuracy. These images are experienced subjectively by the individual, meaning they are not physically present or visible to others." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Photographic memory

fields.label: Amplification of social interactions
fields.definition: "A increase in the tendency of a person to seek or maintain social connections or interactions with others compared to previous norms for an individual." [PMID:18622776, PMID:27862615]
fields.synonyms_concat: Amplified socialising; Amplified socializing; Increase in social interactions

fields.label: Diminishment of emotional responsiveness
fields.definition: "A reduction in the tendency of a person to display emotional responsiveness or empathy towards others during interpersonal interactions as compared to that person's previous norm." [PMID:33370320]
fields.synonyms_concat: Diminishment of empathy

fields.label: Somatic hallucination
fields.definition: "A type of hallucination that involves the perception of sensory experiences related to the body or its internal organs, systems, or processes. It is a hallucinatory experience that primarily affects bodily sensations rather than external sensory perceptions." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hallucination of bodily sensation; Somatic bodily hallucination

fields.label: Visceral hallucination
fields.definition: "A type of hallucination that involves the perception of internal bodily sensations or processes that do not actually exist." []

fields.label: Abnormal perceptual state
fields.definition: "Temporary alteration of the awareness of reality or self-perception." []

fields.label: Depersonalization
fields.definition: "A psychological experience or symptom characterized by a sense of detachment or estrangement from oneself or one's surroundings." []

fields.label: Derealization
fields.definition: "A subjective experience in which an individual feels a sense of detachment or estrangement from their surroundings, leading to a distorted perception of the external world. It is characterized by a feeling of unreality or unfamiliarity with one's environment, as if things are dreamlike, artificial, or lacking in significance." [PMID:16230322, PMID:18438947]

fields.label: Decreased facial expression mirroring
fields.definition: "Diminished mirroring or reflection of facial expressions in another person during social interactions." [PMID:20636189, PMID:21264050, PMID:34541953]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased facial expression reciprocity; Lack of facial mirroring

fields.label: Diminishment of comfort with casual physical contact
fields.definition: "A reduction in the tendency of a person to accept casual physical contact with others as compared to that person's previous norm." []
fields.label_normalized: diminishment of comfort with casual physical contact
fields.synonyms_concat: Discomfort with physical contact; Discomfort with physical touch; Touch avoidance

fields.label: Thought blocking
fields.definition: "The experience of sudden cessation of the thought/thinking process, the person often describes the mind going blank and there is frequently a period of silence that is accompanied by a perplexed state, not understanding what transpired. Some may describe the experience as an abrupt emptying of the mind or the belief that an external force removed their thoughts from their head." [PMID:24261209]
fields.synonyms_concat: Thought withdrawal; Thought-blocking

fields.label: Maladaptive fear-related cognitions
fields.definition: "Threat-based cognitive biases result in a skewed perception, experience, or processing of internal or external stimuli." [PMID:18304519]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal fear; Abnormal fear-related cognitions

fields.label: Hypervigilance
fields.definition: "A heightened alertness is characterized by a broad awareness and/or excessive scanning of environmental stimuli." [PMID:30273899]

fields.label: Phobia
fields.definition: "Extreme, irrational, and persistent fears of certain objects, situations, activities, or persons can impede functioning in day-to-day life." [PMID:28814472]

fields.label: Anticipatory anxiety
fields.definition: "A state characterized by future-oriented worry, accompanied by negative affect and autonomic arousal." [PMID:36221311]

fields.label: Flight of ideas
fields.definition: "Successive thoughts and speech are easily diverted by external stimuli or internal superficial associations. Unable to maintain a constant train of thought and lose themselves in side issues, losing the thread and are unable to recover it. Superficial connections appear to drive the subject matter." [PMID:30416391]
fields.synonyms_concat: Clang associations; Distracted speech; Rhyming puns

fields.label: Delayed spoken language comprehension
fields.synonyms_concat: Delayed verbal comprehension

fields.label: Recurrent maladaptive behavior
fields.definition: "A repeating behavior that is either immediately unproductive or has negative long-term consequences. This includes harmful coping mechanisms such as addictive behavior and failure to control impulses and compulsions." []

fields.label: Cognitive distortion
fields.definition: "A cognitive distortion is a maladaptive, exaggerated, or irrational thought pattern." []

fields.label: Abnormal change in social behavior
fields.definition: "An alternation in the habits and emotional tendencies of an individual with a change in behavior that is typically noticed by family members or peers." [PMID:35491774]

fields.label: Abnormal demeanor
fields.definition: "An anomaly in demeanor, which refers to the outward behavior, manner, or conduct of a person. It encompasses how an individual presents themselves to others in terms of attitude, posture, and general comportment." []

fields.label: Abnormally increased volition
fields.definition: "An excessive increase in motivated and goal directed as well as non-goal directed behaviors that are usually accompanied by elevated energy and interest that allows individuals to get started, be energized to perform a sustained and directed action. The increase is often disruptive and typically results in unfavorable consequences." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormally increased energy; Abnormally increased motivation; Abnormally increased personal volitional state

fields.label: Pressured speech
fields.definition: "Speech pattern that is excessive and intense that often imparts a sense of urgency, the individual appears to be driven to communicate with many words that are spoken very quickly and may run into each other. The person is frequently difficult to interrupt and appears to not respond to social cues for the conversational partner(s) to take their turn in speaking." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Excessive speech output

fields.label: Leaden paralysis
fields.definition: "The sensation of having heavy arms and legs, or feeling a heaviness in the limbs." []

fields.label: Grandiosity
fields.definition: "Persistently exaggerated feelings and thoughts of an inflated sense of self-importance, superiority, uniqueness, or invulnerability. The affected individual may project arrogance with a dismissive behavioral pattern towards others the individual deems inferior." []

fields.label: Hopelessness
fields.definition: "Persistent and excessive feelings of despair with an overwhelming lack of hope. While hopelessness is primarily a personal experience, the sense of hopelessness becomes pervasive and affects most aspects of the personal experience in relation to the world. For example the person may communicate a sense of hopelessness for family and friends (who themselves do not experience hopelessness), as well as the world in general." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Exaggerated pessimism; Hopeless

fields.label: Pathological sadness
fields.definition: "A negative emotional state characterized by sadness, unhappiness, or sorrow that is excessive in intensity, duration, or resistance to self-regulation compared with culturally appropriate norms or the individual's usual emotional range. It may arise spontaneously or in response to significant life events, but when reactive, it is disproportionate to or persists beyond what is typically expected for the context. Pathological sadness can be associated with feelings of hopelessness, helplessness, anhedonia, and a pessimistic outlook, but these features are not invariably present. It may also be accompanied by increased tearfulness, low energy, cognitive difficulties such as impaired concentration, and somatic changes including disrupted sleep or appetite." [PMID:32001274]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal grief reaction; Abnormal grief response; Abnormal sadness; Abnormal sorrow; Affective depression; Deep emotional pain; Depressed mood; Down in the dumps; Dysregulated negative affect; Dysregulated sadness; Dysthymia; Emotional pain; Extreme affective distress; Feeling hopeless all the time; Has the blues; Intense anguish; Low self attitude; Low self-attitude; Low spirits; Melancholy; Morbid sadness; Overpowering grief; Pathological dysthymia; Pathological grief; Persistent despair; Profound despair; Profound feelings of unhappiness; Profound sorrow; Profound unhappiness; Severe unhappiness; Sustained sadness; Unrelenting despondency

fields.label: Decreased need for sleep
fields.definition: "There has been a noticeable decrease in the need for sleep, where individuals feel refreshed even with minimal or no sleep." []

fields.label: Sleep-related breathing disorders
fields.definition: "Conditions of abnormal and difficult respiration during sleep, including chronic snoring and sleep apnea." [PMID:29779616, PMID:34191224]
fields.synonyms_concat: Difficult respiration during sleep

fields.label: Recurrent distressing nightmares
fields.definition: "Repeated occurrence of nightmares that cause clinically significant distress or impairment in social, occupational or other important areas of functioning, which are not attributable to the physiological effects of a substance (e.g. drug abuse or medication) and which cannot be adequately explained by coexisting mental and medical disorders." [PMID:30697860, PMID:33185995]
fields.synonyms_concat: Disturbing dreams; Nightmare disorder

fields.label: Sleep-related eating behavior
fields.definition: "Eating during sleep with limited to no recall of involuntary eating while asleep." [PMID:37234216]
fields.synonyms_concat: Consuming food while asleep; Nocturnal sleep-related eating disorder (NS-RED); Sleep eating; Sleep-related eating disorder; SRED

fields.label: Microsleep
fields.definition: "Sudden onset of extreme drowsiness or falling asleep during the day for a short period of time." [PMID:31553690, PMID:33205754]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short duration sleep

fields.label: Exploding head syndrome
fields.definition: "Sleep disorder in which one hears a loud noise or explosive crashing sound in one's head. The sound is not real or heard by anyone else. The episode typically happens suddenly, either when beginning to fall asleep or when waking up during the night." [PMID:32757464]

fields.label: REM sleep behavior disorder
fields.definition: "REM Sleep Behavior Disorder (RBD) is a chronic sleep condition characterized by dream enactment and loss of REM atonia." [PMID:32733361, PMID:36515157]
synonyms: Rapid eye movement sleep behavior disorder
Rapid eye movement sleep behaviour disorder
fields.synonyms_concat: Rapid eye movement sleep behavior disorder; Rapid eye movement sleep behaviour disorder; RBD; REM sleep behavior disorder; REM sleep behaviour disorder; Sleep enactment

fields.label: Non-restorative sleep
fields.definition: "Sleep that is subjectively reported as unrefreshing even though the duration is adequate." [PMID:22560828, PMID:23997705]
fields.synonyms_concat: Non-refreshing sleep; Unrefreshing sleep; Waking up tired

fields.label: Sleep-wake transition abnormality
fields.definition: "A parasomnia that occurs with awareness and recollection during the transition between sleep and and awake states." [PMID:30252388, PMID:32949545]
synonyms: Disturbance during transitions between sleep and wake states
fields.synonyms_concat: Disturbance during transitions between sleep and wake states; Sleep state switching; Sleep-wake transition disorders

fields.label: Sexsomnia
fields.definition: "Unintentional sexual behavior during sleep, such as masturbation, initiation of sex, or making sexual noises, is known as sexsomnia. Sexsomnia predominantly occurs during NREM sleep." [PMID:35388549, PMID:36866491]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sexual behavior during sleep; Sexual behaviour during sleep

fields.label: Periodic limb movements of sleep
fields.definition: "Repetitive, stereotyped limb movements occurring during sleep, typically involving brief flexion of the toes, ankles, knees, or hips. These movements recur at regular intervals, often every 20-40 seconds, and may cause sleep fragmentation or daytime fatigue. PLMS commonly co-occurs with restless legs syndrome but may also occur independently." [PMID:32809562, PMID:36507891]
fields.synonyms_concat: Rhythmic limb movements during sleep

fields.label: Abnormal transition from sleep to wakefulness
fields.definition: "Abnormal transition of consciousness from sleeping to wakefulness." [PMID:36515157]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal transition from sleep to wakefulness
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal hypnopompia; Abnormality waking up

fields.label: Abnormal transition from wakefulness to sleep
fields.definition: "Abnormal transition of consciousness from wakefulness to sleep." [PMID:36515157]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal transition from wakefulness to sleep
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal falling asleep; Abnormal hypnagogia

fields.label: Abnormal sleep architecture
fields.definition: "Interruptions during the various stages of sleep." [PMID:30252388]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sleep architecture disturbances; Sleep stage disturbances

fields.label: REM parasomnia
fields.definition: "Parasomnia occurs during REM sleep." [PMID:30252388]
fields.synonyms_concat: Disturbance in REM; Rapid eye movement parasomnia

fields.label: Abnormal movement during sleep
fields.definition: "Periodic Limb Movement Disorder, also known as Sleep-Related Myoclonus Syndrome or Nocturnal Myoclonus Syndrome, refers to the periodic and stereotypic movements of the legs or upper limbs during sleep." [PMID:35659081]
fields.synonyms_concat: Nocturnal myoclonus syndrome; Periodic limb movement disorder

fields.label: Short N1 sleep
fields.definition: "Decreased duration of phase N1 of nonrapid eye movement (NREM) sleep." [PMID:30252388]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short light sleep of NREM

fields.label: Paradoxical insomnia
fields.definition: "Paradoxical insomnia is a condition in which individuals with a normal or near-normal sleep macrostructure tend to severely underestimate the quantity and quality of their sleep." [PMID:25179115]
synonyms: Disturbance in perception related to sleep
fields.synonyms_concat: Disturbance in perception related to sleep; Sleep misperception; Sleep state misperception

fields.label: Short N2 sleep
fields.definition: "Decreased duration of phase N2 of nonrapid eye movement (NREM) sleep." [PMID:30252388]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short subdued state of NREM

fields.label: Short N3 sleep
fields.definition: "Decreased duration of phase N3 of nonrapid eye movement (NREM) sleep." [PMID:30252388]
fields.synonyms_concat: Short slow wave sleep

fields.label: Diminishment of social interactions
fields.definition: "A reduction in the tendency of a person to seek or maintain social connections or interactions with others compared to previous norms for an individual." [PMID:17391357, PMID:31997686]
synonyms: Reduced, declined or lessened social interactions
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced, declined or lessened social interactions

fields.label: Amplification of interpersonal communication
fields.definition: "An increase in the tendency of a person to share information or emotions compared to that person's previous norms." [PMID:34958814]
synonyms: Heightened, amplified social expression and social connectedness
fields.synonyms_concat: Heightened, amplified social expression and social connectedness; Increase in interpersonal communication

fields.label: Amplification of relationship seeking
fields.definition: "Increased frequency or duration in social outings and interactions as part of relationship-seeking or maintenance compared to the previous norms of an individual. May be considered to be overfamiliar and have a tendency to engage strangers in a presumptive manner." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Extraversion; Increased seeking of relationships

fields.label: Diminishment of interpersonal communication
fields.definition: "A reduction in the tendency of a person to share information or emotions compared to that person's previous norms." [PMID:19602917]
synonyms: A decline or reduced social expression and social connectedness
fields.synonyms_concat: A decline or reduced social expression and social connectedness; Decreased interpersonal communication

fields.label: Diminishment of relationship seeking
fields.definition: "A reduction in the tendency of a person to seek new interpersonal relationships or maintain existing relationships." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased seeking of relationships; Introversion; Self-isolation; Social isolation

fields.label: Amplification of sexual behavior
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase of libido (sexual desire), typically accompanied by a higher frequency of sexual activity compared to from a person's previous norm." [PMID:24001164, PMID:26851616]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypersexuality; Increase in sexual behavior; Increased sexual behavior; Increased sexual behaviour

fields.label: Amplification of emotional expression
fields.definition: "An increase in the tendency of a person to express emotions compared to that person's previous norm." [PMID:26851616]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increase in emotional expression; Increased emotional display

fields.label: Amplification of emotional responsiveness
fields.definition: "An increase in the tendency of a person to display emotional responsiveness or emotional empathy towards others during interpersonal interactions as compared to that person's previous norm. May be considered to be overreactive or over-engaged with interpersonal situations that may take on a persistent preoccupation and would appear to be relatively unrelated to the person, and beyond the expression of normal empathy." [PMID:33991121]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increase in emotional responsiveness

fields.label: Amplification of comfort with casual physical contact
fields.definition: "An increase in the tendency of a person to be comfortable with physical contact with others compared to that person's previous norm. Often considered to be intrusive and encroaching on personal space of others less known to the person, frequently causing discomfort and may result in argument or altercation." []
synonyms: Increase in comfort with casual physical contact
fields.label_normalized: amplification of comfort with casual physical contact
fields.synonyms_concat: Increase in comfort with casual physical contact

fields.label: Diminishment of sexual behavior
fields.definition: "A reduction of libido (sexual desire), typically accompanied by a reduction in the frequency of sexual activity , and/or activity compared to the affected individual's previous state." [PMID:36735118]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased sexual behavior; Decreased sexual behaviour; Hyposexuality

fields.label: Diminishment of emotional expression
fields.definition: "A reduction in the tendency of a person to express emotions that is typically noticed as a change in behavior by family members or peers." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased emotional display

fields.label: Problematic alcohol consumption
fields.definition: "Impaired ability to stop or control alcohol use despite adverse social, occupational, or health consequences." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Excessive alcohol consumption

fields.label: Suicide behaviors
fields.definition: "Suicide attempts or preparations" [PMID:18653727]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sucidality; Suicidal actions

fields.label: Addictive sedative use
fields.definition: "Misuse and/or abuse of sedative drugs." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Sedative addiction

fields.label: Addictive non-substance behaviors
fields.definition: "Uncontrolled use or problematic behaviors of dependency without the use of drugs or substances can be detrimental." [PMID:29098666]
fields.synonyms_concat: Addiction to a behavior; Addiction to a behaviour; Addiction to an activity; Addictive activity

fields.label: Addictive spending behavior
fields.definition: "An uncontrollable urge to shop and spend money can lead to distress or impairment." [PMID:17342214]
fields.synonyms_concat: Shopaholic; Shopping addiction; Spending addiction

fields.label: Addictive gambling behavior
fields.definition: "The act of taking chances or engaging in behaviors without restraint, typically involving the wagering of something valuable, in pursuit of acquiring something of higher value." [PMID:29098666]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gambling addiction

fields.label: Addictive sex behavior
fields.definition: "Inability to control or manage sexual urges, fantasies, or behaviors that impair one's ability to function." [PMID:26893127]
fields.synonyms_concat: Sex addiction

fields.label: Addictive video game use
fields.definition: "The inability to regulate persistent gaming behavior is characterized by a heightened prioritization of gaming activities over regular daily tasks and responsibilities." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Excessive video game playing; Video game addiction

fields.label: Compulsive stealing
fields.definition: "Irresistible impulses to take easily affordable items." [PMID:25696786]
fields.synonyms_concat: Kleptomania

fields.label: Excessive fire setting
fields.definition: "The inability to control urges of deliberately setting fires for pleasure and gratification, without any criminal intent." [PMID:18052565]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pyromania

fields.label: Self-cutting
fields.definition: "Deliberate harm to one's body, in the form of cutting that results in tissue damage, without a conscious intent to die." [PMID:7754789]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cutting; Deliberate cutting of skin; Self cutting

fields.label: Addictive cannabis use
fields.definition: "A persistent and compulsive need to use cannabis, despite negative consequences." [PMID:29556883]
fields.synonyms_concat: Addictive marijuana use; Cannabis addiction; Marijuana addiction

fields.label: Autophagia
fields.definition: "The habitual action of inflicting pain upon oneself by biting and/or devouring portions of one's body." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Self-consumption

fields.label: Hypnagogic sleep paralysis
fields.definition: "Sleep paralysis that occurs when falling asleep." [PMID:28735779]
synonyms: Inability to move while falling asleep
fields.synonyms_concat: Inability to move while falling asleep; Predormital sleep paralysis

fields.label: Hypnopompic sleep paralysis
fields.definition: "Sleep paralysis that occurs when waking up from sleep." [PMID:28735779]
fields.synonyms_concat: Inability to move while awakening; Postdormital paralysis; Postdormital sleep paralysis

fields.label: Sleep onset rapid eye movement period
fields.definition: "Entering REM sleep immediately upon falling asleep." [PMID:36592569]
fields.label_normalized: sleep onset rapid eye movement period
fields.synonyms_concat: Sleep-onset (REM) period; Sleep-onset rapid eye movement (REM) period; SOREMP

fields.label: Prolonged N1 sleep
fields.definition: "Increased duration of phase N1 of nonrapid eye movement (NREM) sleep." [PMID:30252388]

fields.label: Prolonged N2 sleep
fields.definition: "Increased duration of phase N2 of nonrapid eye movement (NREM) sleep." [PMID:30252388]

fields.label: Prolonged N3 sleep
fields.definition: "Increased duration of phase N3 of nonrapid eye movement (NREM) sleep." [PMID:30252388]

fields.label: Short REM sleep
fields.synonyms_concat: Short rapid eye movement sleep

fields.label: Prolonged REM sleep
fields.synonyms_concat: Prolonged rapid eye movement sleep

fields.label: Abnormal judgment
fields.definition: "Beliefs that deviate from what is considered rational or within the range of normal human judgment and belief formation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal beliefs

fields.label: Overvalued idea
fields.definition: "A solitary belief that may be held by others in the society that is maintained by the person to an abnormal and morbid degree and overtly drives behaviors that are considered unhealthy, intrusive, or illegal. This includes fads and cults that the person may adhere to and practice to a morbid degree. The content may vary and ranges from religion, health, romance, or politics." [PMID:34972814]
fields.synonyms_concat: Overvalued ideas

fields.label: Time agnosia
fields.definition: "The inability to perceive the passage of time is usually due to a disorder involving the temporal area of the brain." []

fields.label: Olfactory agnosia
fields.definition: "The inability to recognize certain smells or types of odors that you previously recognized." []

fields.label: Tactile agnosia
fields.definition: "The inability to recognize objects by touch is called tactile agnosia." []

fields.label: Topographical agnosia
fields.definition: "The inability to rely on visual cues to guide one's direction is due to the inability to recognize objects." []

fields.label: Delusional memory
fields.definition: "Delusional memory is a memory that is false or fantastically distorted, but held with firm and irrefutable conviction despite evidence to the contrary. It is often seen in psychiatric conditions such as delusional disorders, schizophrenia, and sometimes in severe mood disorders. These memories can be completely fabricated or have a basis in an actual event that has been grossly misinterpreted or altered by the individual's mind." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Retrospective delusion

fields.label: Auditory agnosia
fields.definition: "The condition is characterized by the inability to recognize spoken languages and/or nonverbal environmental sounds and music, despite having adequate hearing. However, spontaneous speech, reading, and writing abilities remain intact." []

fields.label: Gustatory agnosia
fields.definition: "People cannot identify tastes, even though they can experience them." []

fields.label: Allesthesia
fields.definition: "Referral of a sensory stimulus from one side of the body to the other." []

fields.label: Autotopagnosia
fields.definition: "The loss of the ability to localize, recognize, or identify specific parts of one's body." []

fields.label: Persecutory delusion
fields.definition: "False beliefs (or judgements) that are held with extraordinary conviction and subjective certainty that are impervious to other experiences or counterarguments and the content is generally considered impossible for the context and circumstance. Delusional beliefs may arise meaningfully from personal or social experiences, yet are impossible, held with conviction, and irrefutable; more commonly they may be psychologically irreducible, appearing with no logical or meaningful connection to the individual experience." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Delusion of persecution

fields.label: Morbid jealousy
fields.definition: "A disorder of delusional content wherein the affected individual believes they are a victim of their partner's infidelity. It is often based on delusional evidence of an erotic or romantic nature. There may be an affective (mood related) component or may be associated with substance use disorders. It may also occur on its own. There may be associated behaviors to monitor or gather evidence of the perceived infidelity." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Delusion of infidelity; Pathological jealousy

fields.label: Grandiose delusion
fields.definition: "Delusional beliefs of a fantastical, expansive, or supernatural quality related to power, ability, wealth, or station. They are often related to origin (aristocratic lineage, royal birth, being raised as a foster child), possessions (owning vast estates, castles, etc., which are withheld through intrigue), abilities (being great inventors, discoverers, artists, possessors of special wisdom, gifted with inspiration), and status (adviser to prominent diplomats, the true director of political destinies). Grandiose delusions may be related to affective states, substance use, or may occur independently." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Megalomania

fields.label: Folie à deux
fields.definition: "Delusional beliefs are transmitted from one individual to another." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Shared psychosis

fields.label: Disorder of thought control
fields.definition: "A false belief that another person, group of people, or external force controls one's general thoughts, feelings, impulses, or behaviors." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Delusion of control

fields.label: Delusion of love
fields.definition: "A delusional belief that the person is secretly loved by another individual who is often of recognized fame or authoratative significance. There is typically no overt evidence and the delusional belief may be driven by falsely perceived indicators. Often there is a blend of erotic delusions and morbid infatuation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: De Clérambault syndrome; Erotomania; Psychose passionelle

fields.label: Nihilistic delusion
fields.definition: "A delusion that elements of the self, body, or world no longer exist. The person typically recognizes that the entity did in fact exist at one time, but has ceased to exist. The cause of which may be related to disease, decay, or may have been removed or taken by unknown forces." []

fields.label: Cotard delusion
fields.definition: "A false belief that you or your body parts are dead, dying, or do not exist." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Cotard syndrome

fields.label: Abnormal experience of reality
fields.definition: "Subjective phenomena or perceptions that deviate from what is considered correct or are outside the range of normal human experiences." []

fields.label: Delusional perception
fields.definition: "A true perception, to which a patient attributes a false and usually bizarre meaning or interpretation. It is often a revelatory experience that is sudden and is a profound realization of the delusional belief.
