It often occurs in the context of delusional mood or atmosphere wherein vague and mysterious hunches or concerns with nebulous meaning evolve into clear, delusional observations, and expresses delusions of reference." []

fields.label: Hypochondriac delusion
fields.definition: "Delusion quality to belief that one is suffering from an illness despite reassurances based on medical examination and testing. The person may (or not) express pain or discomfort that they attribute to the disease. They are frequently treatment seeking, but do not induce illness features (which is termed Munchhausen syndrome)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Munchhausen syndrome

fields.label: Delusions of infestation
fields.definition: "A persistent belief that a person is infested with living or non-living pathogens, such as parasites, insects, or bugs, when no such infestation is present." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ekbom's syndrome

fields.label: Delusional atmosphere
fields.definition: "A persistent sense or a hunch that something is different in an imperceptible manner. Typically the perception is one of a sinister, portentous , uncanny, mysterious, or peculiar sense of foreboding in an indefinable way. There is an innate sense of inexplicable self-relevance to the person. There is often a feeling of anticipation, sometimes even excitement, that soon the mystery may be revealed and all the separate parts of their experience will fit together to reveal something immensely significant. The duration of this experience may vary, lasting from hours to days. It may be intermittent over an extended period of time (months to years)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Delusional mood

fields.label: Delusional misidentification
fields.definition: "A group of complex, monothematic delusional phenomena in which subjects hold a belief that the identity of a familiar person, object, location, or self has been altered or replaced. The majority of misidentifications are spouses or first degree relatives, i.e. someone well-known to the person." []

fields.label: Religious delusion
fields.definition: "Delusions with a religious content that are considered delusional in nature based on how the belief is held and the evidence offered to support it, which is generally considered impossible or fantastical in the cultural setting of the person. It differs from unusual beliefs that are held with tenacity or conviction and are typically associated with other phenomena consistent with mental illness." []

fields.label: Abnormal psychotic pattern
fields.definition: "Any abnormal pattern of psychotic experiences, where an individual has significant disturbances in their thoughts, perceptions, emotions, and behavior, resulting in a loss of touch with reality." []

fields.label: Incomplete unilateral cleft lip
fields.definition: "Unilateral cleft lip cleft that starts from the bottom of the upper lip but does not reach the nasal cavity." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570]

fields.label: Complete unilateral cleft lip
fields.definition: "Unilateral cleft lip cleft that starts from the bottom of the upper lip and reaches the nasal cavity." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570]

fields.label: Microform unilateral cleft lip
fields.definition: "Notch, groove, or scar of the upper lip without noticeable rupture of the lip. Microforms are sometimes associated with disruption of the continuity of the orbicularis oris muscle." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570, PMID:33729631]

fields.label: Complete cleft hard palate
fields.definition: "Cleft hard palate in which the cleft goes through the entire length of the hard palate, ie. from the incisor foramen to the anterior border of the soft palate." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570]

fields.label: Incomplete cleft hard palate
fields.definition: "Cleft hard palate in which the cleft does not go through the entire length of the hard palate, ie. the cleft does not go from the incisor foramen to the anterior border of the soft palate." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570]

fields.label: Complete cleft soft palate
fields.definition: "Cleft soft palate in which the cleft goes through the entire length of the soft palate, i.e. from the posterior border of the hard palate until the uvula." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570]

fields.label: Incomplete cleft soft palate
fields.definition: "Cleft soft palate in which the cleft does not go through the entire length of the soft palate, i.e. the cleft does not go from the posterior border of the hard palate until the uvula." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570]

fields.label: Incomplete cleft maxillary alveolar ridge
fields.definition: "Cleft maxillary alveolar ridge in which the cleft does not go through the entire length of the maxillary alveolar ridge." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570]

fields.label: Complete cleft maxillary alveolar ridge
fields.definition: "Cleft maxillary alveolar ridge in which the cleft goes through the entire length of the maxillary alveolar ridge." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570]

fields.label: Complete cleft of the upper lip
fields.definition: "Cleft of the upper lip that starts from the bottom of the upper lip and reaches the nasal cavity." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570, PMID:33729631]
fields.label_normalized: complete cleft of the upper lip

fields.label: Microform cleft of the upper lip
fields.definition: "Notch, groove, or scar of the upper lip without noticeable rupture of the lip." [PMID:21331089, PMID:26171570, PMID:33729631]
fields.label_normalized: microform cleft of the upper lip

fields.label: Complete bilateral cleft lip
fields.definition: "Bilateral cleft lip in which the cleft lip on both sides is complete, i.e. start from the bottom of the upper lip and reach the nasal cavity." [PMID:19884685]

fields.label: Incomplete bilateral cleft lip
fields.definition: "Bilateral cleft lip in which the cleft lip on both sides are incomplete (i.e. start from the bottom of the upper lip but do not reach the nasal cavity), or the cleft lip on one is incomplete and a microform on the other side." [PMID:19884685]

fields.label: Microform bilateral cleft lip
fields.definition: "Bilateral cleft lip in which the cleft lip on both sides are microform, i.e. a notch, groove, or scar without noticeable rupture of the lip." [PMID:19884685]

fields.label: Asymmetric bilateral cleft lip
fields.definition: "Bilateral cleft lip in which the cleft lip on one side is complete (i.e. starts from the bottom of the upper lip and reaches the nasal cavity), and the one on the other side is incomplete (i.e. starts from the bottom of the upper lip but does not reach the nasal cavity) or microform (i.e. a notch, groove, or scar without noticeable rupture of the lip)." [PMID:19884685]

fields.label: Craniofacial cleft
fields.definition: "Congenital abnormality with cleft (gap or opening) in the craniofacial bones. Craniofacial cleft includes facial cleft, orofacial clef, and cleft of the jaw." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4142-7153]

fields.label: Submucous cleft palate
fields.definition: "A cleft of the muscular portion of the palate that is covered by mucous membrane." [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4142-7153, PMID:21112097]
fields.synonyms_concat: Submucosal cleft palate; Submucous clefting

fields.label: Left-right disorientation
fields.definition: "A tendency to mix up left and right in one's own body space, typically elicited by asking a person to perform a two-stage command involving specified lateralized anatomy." [PMID:19903731]
fields.synonyms_concat: Left-right confusion; Right-left confusion; Right-left disorientation

fields.label: Elevated circulating DNAJB9 protein concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 (DNAJB9) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:29340314]
synonyms: DNAJB9 protein level in serum elevated
fields.synonyms_concat: DNAJB9 protein level in serum elevated

fields.label: Olecranon fracture
fields.definition: "A partial or complete break in the olecranon,which is the proximal articular portion of the ulna and makes up part of the elbow." [PMID:30725980]

fields.label: History of mastectomy
fields.definition: "Past medical history of surgical breast removal." []

fields.label: Lymphangiosarcoma
fields.definition: "A malignant neoplasm arising from the endothelial cells of the lymphatic vessels." [PMID:22682884]

fields.label: Exposure to inhaled lipids
fields.definition: "Aspiration or inhalation of lipid-containing products." []

fields.label: Holster sign
fields.definition: "Symmetric poikiloderma of hips and lateral thighs below the greater trochanter." [PMID:31279808, PMID:32644343]

fields.label: Salivary basal cell adenoma
fields.definition: "A rare neoplasm consisting of a monomorphic population of basaloid epithelial cells, and it accounts for approximately 1-2% of all salivary gland tumors." [PMID:26693465]

fields.label: Hemidiaphragm elevation
fields.definition: "Elevated Hemidiaphragm is a condition where one portion of the diaphragm is higher than the other. Elevated hemidiaphragm occurs when one side of the diaphragm becomes weak from muscular disease or loss of innervation due to phrenic nerve injury." [PMID:32644681]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated hemidiaphragm

fields.label: Cerebriform connective tissue nevus
fields.definition: "The cerebriform connective tissue nevus (CCTN) is one of the most characteristic skin findings. It commonly occurs on the soles of the feet, and frequently causes problems because of pain, pruritus, infection, bleeding,exudation, odor, and walking impairment." [PMID:20709429]

fields.label: Linear Hyperpigmentation along Blaschko's lines
fields.definition: "Linear streaks and swirls of macular hyperpigmentation along the lines of Blaschko." [PMID:33447068]

fields.label: Guilt
fields.definition: "The experience of remorse, self-reproach, or perceived culpability for a real or perceived unfavorable outcome. Guilt may be proportionate to the context or disproportionate, and it may occur in the absence of an identifiable act, event, or offense. It reflects the interplay of cognitive processes, such as judgments about responsibility, and emotional responses, which can lead to persistent rumination or preoccupation. Guilt may extend to situations outside the individual's control and, in some cases, be accompanied by inaccurate or exaggerated beliefs about one's role in an outcome." [PMID:20451312, PMID:8204541]
fields.synonyms_concat: Excessive self-reproach; Feelings of worthlessness; Inappropriate sense of responsibility; Obsessive remorse over imagined wrongs; Remorse; Self-blame; Unfounded sense of culpability; Unrealistic self-blame; Unwarranted self-blame

fields.label: Mediastinal shift
fields.definition: "A deviation of the mediastinum from its normal position in the midline of the thoracic cavity. The mediastinum is a compartment of the thoracic cavity that contains the heart and its blood vessels, the esophagus, trachea, thymus, as well as nerves and lymph nodes." [PMID:35990927, PMID:37680422]

fields.label: Bendopnea
fields.definition: "Dyspnea as a result of bending forward while not holding one's breath; dyspnea or shortness of breath onset within 30 seconds of bending forward." [PMID:31543202]

fields.label: Pain worse when lying flat
fields.definition: "Refers to pain that is worse when the affected individual lies down (flat)." [PMID:31941732]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pain worse when lying down

fields.label: Tympanic membrane hypermobility
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased ability to move of the tympanic membrane." [PMID:11556853, PMID:32901364]

fields.label: Elevated circulating vitamin B12 concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of vitamin B12 in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:14636871, PMID:20301287]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated plasma vitamin B12 level; Elevated serum cobalamin level; Elevated serum vitamin B12 level

fields.label: Elevated circulating sFASL concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of sFASL (soluble FASL, soluble FAS-ligand) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Internal anal sphincter achalasia
fields.definition: "A disorder of the internal anal sphincter (IAS) in which the IAS fails to relax that manifests clinically as intractable constipation." [PMID:19782306, PMID:33301220]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anal achalasia

fields.label: Anthracycline exposure
fields.definition: "History of treatment with an anthracycline chemotherapy agent." []

fields.label: Binge drinking
fields.definition: "A pattern of episodic heavy alcohol use characterized by the consumption of a high number of drinks per occasion." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating thrombopoietin concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of thrombopoietin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Thrombopoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the liver and kidney that stimulates the production and differentiation of megakaryocytes." [PMID:32150607]

fields.label: Collagenoma
fields.definition: "A rare hamartomatous malformation characterized by the predominant proliferation of normal collagen fibers and normal, decreased, or increased elastic fibers. Collagenomas may be solitary or multiple, sporadic, acquired or inherited." [PMID:29445568]

fields.label: Lack of sufficient daily physical activity
fields.definition: "Physical activity levels less than those required for optimal health and prevention of premature death." [PMID:23798298]
fields.label_normalized: lack of sufficient daily physical activity
fields.synonyms_concat: physical inactivity

fields.label: Synesthesia
fields.definition: "A phenomenon whereby stimulation of one sensory or cognitive pathway leads to automatic, involuntary experiences in a second sensory or cognitive pathway. For instance, people with synaesthesia may experience unusual colors, tastes, and other sensations when engaged in everyday activities like reading or listening to music." [PMID:32114456]

fields.label: Dark cerumen
fields.definition: "Abnormally dark color of cerumen (earwax), which is a waxy substance secreted in the ear canal that normally has a brown, orange, red, yellowish or gray." [PMID:37395296]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dark earwax; Pigmented cerumen

fields.label: History of spicy food intake
fields.definition: "A history of high intake of spciy foods with ingrediaents such as capsaicin, pepper, chili, ginger, garlic, onion, fenugreek, and turmeric." []

fields.label: Oil-drop brown pigmentation of the corneal limbus
fields.definition: "Brown pigment spots in the limbus (border between the cornea and the sclera)." [PMID:24479547]
fields.label_normalized: oil-drop brown pigmentation of the corneal limbus

fields.label: Hazardous alcohol use
fields.definition: "Hazardous drinking is defined as a quantity or pattern of alcohol consumption that places individuals at risk for adverse health events. This could include alcohol use despite potentially hazardous or risky consequences, such as operating heavy machinery or drunk driving." [PMID:10448769]

fields.label: Social anxiety
fields.definition: "Excessive fear of embarrassment, humiliation, or rejection when exposed to possible negative evaluation by others when engaged in a public performance or social interaction." [PMID:32310350]

fields.label: Placidity
fields.definition: "Flat affect and reduced response to emotional stimuli. Fear and anger responses that are normally present are blunted." [PMID:31334941]

fields.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
fields.definition: "Phaeohyphomycosis refers to infections due to a large group of heterogenous organisms called dematiaceous or melanized fungi. These fungi are distinguished by the predominance of melanin in their cell walls, which likely acts as a virulence factor. Virtually, everyone is exposed to dematiaceous fungi through inhalation, as they are ubiquitous in the environment, although the development of infection is extremely uncommon." [PMID:28217468, PMID:36377664]

fields.label: Autophony
fields.definition: "Hearing one's own voice resonating loudly in the ear." [PMID:31750425, PMID:34993986]

fields.label: High altitude exposure
fields.definition: "A history of being at high altitude in situations such hiking, mountain climbing, travel to mountains, or air travel." []

fields.label: History of recent hospitalization
fields.definition: "A past medical history of recently being hospitalized." []

fields.label: Palpitations terminated by Valsava maneuver
fields.definition: "Cessation of palpitations can be induced by Valsava maneuver." [PMID:28613787]

fields.label: Long telomere length
fields.definition: "Abnormally long telomeres in somatic cells." [PMID:37140166]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elongated telomeres

fields.label: Reduced circulating aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase activity
fields.definition: "The activity of aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (also known as DOPA decarboxylase, tryptophan decarboxylase, and 5-hydroxytryptophan decarboxylase) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:17240182]
fields.label_normalized: reduced circulating aromatic l-amino acid decarboxylase activity
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced circulating 5-hydroxytryptophan decarboxylase activity; Reduced circulating DOPA decarboxylase, activity

fields.label: Subclavian artery stenosis
fields.definition: "Abnormal narrowing of the subclavian artery." [PMID:21078767]

fields.label: Pulsatile liver
fields.definition: "Cardiac synchronous pulsation on palpation." [PMID:8427187]

fields.label: Neuropathic pain
fields.definition: "Neuropathic pain is triggered by lesions to the somatosensory nervous system that alter its structure and function so that pain occurs spontaneously and responses to noxious and innocuous stimuli are pathologically amplified." [PMID:19400724]

fields.label: Repeated cold water exposure
fields.definition: "A history of repeated exposure to cold water, as may result, for instance, from surfing, diving, kayaking, or swimming." []

fields.label: Tinnitus exacerbated by swallowing
fields.definition: "Tinnitus (sound heard by a subjhect when no corresponding external sound is present) that is made worse by swallowing." [PMID:30085597]

fields.label: Rhythmic movements of the tympanic membrane
fields.definition: "Regularly occurring motion of the tympanic membrane (eardrum), which is located between the inner and middle ear. This can be a manifestation of tensor tympani myoclonus, which can also be ascertained as sawtooth patterns on long-term tympanometry." [PMID:30085597]
fields.label_normalized: rhythmic movements of the tympanic membrane

fields.label: Elongated temporal styloid process
fields.definition: "The length of the temporal styloid process is above the upper limit of normal. The styloid process is a cylindrical, slender, needle-like projection of varying lengths averaging 2 to 3 cm. The styloid process projects from the inferior part of the petrous temporal bone and offers attachment to the stylohyoid ligament and the stylohyoid, stylopharyngeus, and styloglossus muscles." [PMID:31082019]
fields.synonyms_concat: Temporal styloid process elongated

fields.label: Ameliorated by nitroglycerin
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with nitroglycerin." []

fields.label: Pulsus paradoxus
fields.definition: "Pulsus paradoxus refers to a systolic pressure drop greater than 10mmHg during inspiration." [PMID:29493917]
fields.synonyms_concat: Kussmaul pulse; Paradoxical pulse; Paradoxical pulse volume

fields.label: Chest pain triggered by palpation
fields.definition: "Chest pain can be induced by palpation of the chest, which may be an indication of costochondritis." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Chest pain reproducible on palpation

fields.label: Chest pain described as pressure
fields.definition: "Discomfort in the chest described as pressure, heaviness, or tightness." [PMID:21250256]

fields.label: Chest pain described as ripping or tearing
fields.definition: "Chest pain described as a tearing or ripping sensation." [PMID:21250256]
fields.label_normalized: chest pain described as ripping or tearing

fields.label: Ameliorated by flexion
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by bending (flexing) a joint." []

fields.label: Located on the chest
fields.definition: "Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring around the thorax (chest)." []

fields.label: Localized to the penis
fields.definition: "Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring in or on the penis." []

fields.label: Snowstorm pattern of uterus on ultrasound
fields.definition: "A sonographic snowstorm pattern of the uterus that results from the presence of a complex vesicular intrauterine mass containing many grape-like cysts." [PMID:23599844]
fields.label_normalized: snowstorm pattern of uterus on ultrasound

fields.label: Multiparity
fields.definition: "History of multiple previous births." []

fields.label: Exposure to aquatic animals
fields.definition: "History of exposure to aquatic animals." [PMID:29493404]

fields.label: Superficial blush-like subcutaneous fatty lesions
fields.definition: "Multiple, oblong, fatty lesions in the superficial subcutaneous fatty tissue. They are mostly under 2 cm in long axis diameter. They demonstrate nodular (blush-like) increased fluid signal at unenhanced MRI and are markedly hyperechoic at ultrasound." [PMID:23809264]

fields.label: Dermal multinucleated giant cells
fields.definition: "Presence of giant cells in the dermis. Giant cells are formed by fusion of various cells such as macrophage, epithelioid cells, monocytes, etc., These are multi-nucleated, large in size, and generally present at the site of chronic inflammation and other granulomatous conditions." [PMID:25284855, PMID:35478968]
fields.synonyms_concat: Multinucleated giant cells in skin

fields.label: Exacerbation of eyelid lesion by crying
fields.definition: "Applies to an eyelid lesion such as hemangiomas or varices that swells upon crying." []
fields.label_normalized: exacerbation of eyelid lesion by crying

fields.label: Localized to upper eyelid
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the upper eyelid." []

fields.label: Aerophagia
fields.definition: "Repetitive air swallowing and belching and that may result in abdominal distention." [PMID:12095473]

fields.label: Vaginal passage of hydatidiform mole tissue
fields.definition: "Passage from the vagina of hyatidiform tissue, appearing as clusters of vesicles (similar to small grapes) developed from the transformation of chorionic villi. This is a manifestation of a molar pregnancy (hyatidiform mole)." [PMID:29083593]
synonyms: Solid tissue passed by the vagina
fields.label_normalized: vaginal passage of hydatidiform mole tissue
fields.synonyms_concat: Solid tissue passed by the vagina

fields.label: Abnormal nipple discharge
fields.definition: "Abnormal fluid that seeps out of the nipple of the breast. Nipple discharge is categozied as lactational, physiologic, or pathologic." [PMID:36335926]

fields.label: Hepatolithiasis
fields.definition: "The presence of gallstones within the intrahepatic bile ducts proximal to the right and left hepatic ducts." [PMID:26730152]

fields.label: Excessive eructation
fields.definition: "Abnormally frequent belching (expelling gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Excessive belching; Excessive burping

fields.label: Esophageal fibrosis
fields.definition: "Fibrosis located in the subepithelial portion of the esophagus. Fibrosisis is defined by the overgrowth, hardening, and/or scarring of various tissues and is attributed to excess deposition of extracellular matrix components including collagen." [PMID:18161745, PMID:33230074]

fields.label: Triggered by extension of leg
fields.definition: "This term refers to pain that is triggered by extending (straightening) the leg." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Straight leg raising produces pain

fields.label: Increased myocardial pyrophosphate uptake
fields.definition: "Amount of pyrophosphate uptake by the myocardium as demonstrated by by technetium pyrophosphate (99mTc-PYP) scintigraphy above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:22149423]

fields.label: Ameliorated by nerve block
fields.definition: "Refers to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by anesthetic block of a nerve." []

fields.label: Brief tear break-up time
fields.definition: "Tear film break up time (number of seconds that elapse between the last blink and the appearance of the first dry spot in the tear film) below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:30481808]

fields.label: Cutaneous granuloma
fields.definition: "A granuloma localized to the skin, that is, a chronic inflammatory manifestation with localized aggregation of histiocytes with or without other inflammatory cells (such as plasma cells, eosinophils, or neutrophils), with or without necrosis, with or without vasculitis, with or without calcification, and with or without foreign bodies. Granulomas may be due to infection or chronic inflammatory disease or reactions to foreign material." [PMID:36902053]

fields.label: Heterotopic dermal ossification
fields.definition: "Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue in the dermis (i.e., the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer)." []

fields.label: Thinning of outer muscular layer of small bowel
fields.definition: "The depth of the outer muscular layer of the small bowel is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:717927]
fields.label_normalized: thinning of outer muscular layer of small bowel

fields.label: Renal lymphangiectasia
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly of renal lymphatics that results from a failure of the lymphatics to make communication with the rest of the lymph trunks. The abnormal lymphatics thus dilate and form cystic spaces at the renal sinus and in the perinephric space." [PMID:17684071]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hygroma renale; Peripelvic lymphangiectasia; Renal lymphangiomatosis

fields.label: Pharyngeal myxoma
fields.definition: "A myxoma (benign, locally infiltrative neoplasms arising from mesenchymal origin) localized to the pharynx." [PMID:23984217]

fields.label: Subcutaneous arteriolar thrombosis
fields.definition: "Fibrin thrombi inside subcutaneous arterioles." []

fields.label: Renal vasculitis
fields.definition: "Vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessels) in the kidney. Renal vasculitis can be observed with numerous disorders and presents clinically as rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis (RPGN) which is characterized by acute kidney injury (AKI), haematuria and proteinuria. Histological examination of the kidney reveals severe inflammation in the form of crescent formation, glomerular necrosis and vasculitis of small and medium sized vessels within the kidney." [PMID:31927782]

fields.label: Pancreatic islet beta cell iron deposition
fields.definition: "Accumulation of abnormally high amounts of iron in beta cells of the pancreas." [PMID:36882414]
fields.label_normalized: pancreatic islet beta cell iron deposition

fields.label: Nasal hamartoma
fields.definition: "A hamartoma (tissue malformation consisting of an abnormal mixture of constitutive components) originating in the nose." []

fields.label: Metachromatic intraneuronal lipid deposits
fields.definition: "A type of metachromasia localized to a peripheral nerve. Metachromasia may be defined as the staining of tissue or tissue components such that the color of the tissue-bound dye complex differs significantly from the color of the original dye complex to give a marked contrast in color. For instance in metachromatic leukodystrophy, bloated Schwann cells, containing granularmetachromatic storage material May display a characteristic yellow green dichroism under crossed polarised light." [PMID:16291896, PMID:29152458]
fields.synonyms_concat: Peripheral nerve metachromasia

fields.label: Reduced phosphoserine phosphatase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of phosphoserine phosphatase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:9222972]
fields.label_normalized: reduced phosphoserine phosphatase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." []
synonyms: Alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase low in fibroblasts
fields.label_normalized: reduced alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.synonyms_concat: Alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase low in fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced hepatic beta-ureidopropionase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of beta-ureidopropionase in the liver below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:15385443]
fields.synonyms_concat: Liver biopsy: beta-ureidopropionase activity low

fields.label: Reduced hepatic dihydropyrimidinase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of dihydropyrimidinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:9323563]

fields.label: Sunken fontanelle
fields.definition: "Fontanelle that is more deeply set than normal. Fontanelles are normally relatively firm and curve only slightly inward. A sunken fontanelle can be a sign of dehydration or marasmus." [PMID:12825844]

fields.label: Angulation of penis
fields.definition: "Formation of an angle (tilt) along the shaft of the penis." [PMID:31869082]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bent penis

fields.label: History of urethral procedure or catheterization
fields.definition: "A past medical history of a procedure or catheterization involving the urethra." []
fields.label_normalized: history of urethral procedure or catheterization

fields.label: Penile swelling
fields.definition: "Abormal enlargement of the penis owing to accumulation of fluid." [PMID:11142469]
fields.synonyms_concat: Penile edema; Penile oedema

fields.label: Reduced muscle alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of the enzyme alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Brown tumor
fields.definition: "A brown tumor is a bone lesion that results from bony resorption by excess osteoclastic activity, and replacement by fibrous tissue and giant cells. Brown tumor is an uncommon pathognomonic sign of hyperparathyroidism." [PMID:26354493]
fields.synonyms_concat: Osteitis fibrosa cystica

fields.label: Dermal flame figures
fields.definition: "Flame-figures are composed of a central part consisting of collagen fibers and eosinophilic granules, surrounded by a histiocytic and eosinophilic infiltrate. Subsequently, eosinophils tend to disappear and are replaced by phagocytic granulomas, consisting of histiocytes and sometimes giant cells, around the flame figures." [PMID:30335327]

fields.label: Postpartum exacerbation
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is present during pregnancy and becomes worse following birth." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Symptoms worsen in post-partum state

fields.label: Retinoid exposure
fields.definition: "History of having taken retinoids." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Exposure to retinoids

fields.label: Propylthiouracil exposure
fields.definition: "History of having been treated with propylthiouracil." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Exposure to propylthiouracil

fields.label: History of outdoor activities
fields.definition: "History of spending a substantial amount of time outdoors with occupation or hobbies related to the outdoors, including hunting, gardening, farming, agriculture, horticulture, miners, working in wet fields." []

fields.label: Draining sinus tract in skin
fields.definition: "A sinus tract is an abnormal channel that originates from the skin or a mucous surface to a deep-seated focus of suppuration." [PMID:34145466]
synonyms: Tract under skin draining associated abscess
fields.synonyms_concat: Discharging sinus; Draining tract in skin; Tract under skin draining associated abscess

fields.label: Corneal transplant history
fields.definition: "Past medical history of surgical replacement of the cornea with corneal tissue from a donor." []
fields.synonyms_concat: History of corneal transplantation

fields.label: Spontaneous lens capsule rupture
fields.definition: "Breakage of the capsule of the lens. This is most often observed as a complication of lens surgery, but this term refers to lens capsule rupture not related to surgery or major trauma." [PMID:35198824]

fields.label: Contact lens wearer
fields.definition: "A past medical history of wearing contact lenses." [PMID:26292204]

fields.label: Airway mucosal thickening
fields.definition: "Increase in thickness of the mucosa of the airways above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:32957425]

fields.label: Hyperpolarized transepithelial nasal potential difference
fields.definition: "Increased (more negative) voltage across the nasal epithelium." [PMID:21594779]

fields.label: Corneopalpebral synechiae
fields.definition: "An adhesion between the conjunctiva of the eyelid and the cornea." [PMID:20301721]

fields.label: Breast intraductal papilloma
fields.definition: "Intraductal papilloma is a benign tumor found within breast ducts. The abnormal proliferation of ductal epithelial cells causes growth. A solitary intraductal papilloma is usually found centrally posterior to the nipple affecting the central duct. Multiple intraductal papillomas are located peripherally, found in any breast quadrant affecting the peripheral ducts." [PMID:30137824]

fields.label: Precipitous labor
fields.definition: "Precipitous labor is extremely rapid labor and delivery, usually defined as expulsion of the fetus within less than 3 hours of commencement of regular contractions." [PMID:25584099, PMID:30940371]
fields.synonyms_concat: Precipitous delivery

fields.label: Twin pregnancy
fields.definition: "Maternal history of a pregnancy with two fetuses in the uterus." [PMID:33622004]

fields.label: Vaginal mass
fields.definition: "A swelling or enlargement localized to the vagina. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." []

fields.label: Costovertebral angle tenderness
fields.definition: "Pain that is elicited by palpation of the region inside of the costovertebral angle, which is formed by the 12th rib and the spine." [PMID:36605912]
fields.synonyms_concat: Costovertebral angle pain

fields.label: Cervical motion tenderness
fields.definition: "Pain that is elicited by moving the uterine cervix. This finding can be ascertained by pelvic exam. Cervical motion tenderness is a gynecological exam finding that could be indicative of peritoneal infection." [PMID:31424870]
fields.synonyms_concat: Chandelier sign

fields.label: Abnormal urethral discharge
fields.definition: "Fluid that originates from the urethra that is not urine, pre-ejaculate or semen." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal penile discharge; Abnormal urethral discharge

fields.label: Supernumerary finger flexion crease
fields.definition: "The presence of an extra digital crease in and individual with normal joint anatomy." [PMID:12244551]

fields.label: Large joint predominance
fields.definition: "Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that mainly affect large joints." []

fields.label: Monoarticular
fields.definition: "Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that affects a single joint." []

fields.label: Hockey-stick palmar crease
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the upper palmar crease whereby the crease widens and ends between the second and third fingers and is said to resemble a hockey stick." [PMID:29094891]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hockey-stick crease

fields.label: Elevated urinary succinyladenosine level
fields.definition: "The amount of succinyladenosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:23937257]

fields.label: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxymethyluracil level
fields.definition: "The amount of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: 5-hydroxymethyluracil high in urine

fields.label: Decreased urine creatinine level
fields.definition: "The amount of creatinine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary deoxyuridine level
fields.definition: "The amount of deoxyuridine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Deoxyuridine high in urine

fields.label: Elevated urinary dihydrouracil level
fields.definition: "The amount of dihydrouracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:9323563]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dihydrouracil high in urine

fields.label: Elevated urinary dihydrothymine level
fields.definition: "The amount of dihydrothymine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Dihydrothymine in urine high

fields.label: Elevated urinary sulfatide level
fields.definition: "The amount of sulfatides in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Sulfatides are derived from GalCer via esterification of a sulfate group to 3-hydroxyl of the galactose moiety." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary xanthurenic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of xanthurenic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Increased urinary N-acetylglucosamine-rich oligosaccharide level
fields.definition: "Presence of N-acetylglucosamine-rich oligosaccharides in the urine." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary 2'-deoxyadenosine level
fields.definition: "The amount of 2'-deoxyadenosine (dAdo) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: 2'-deoxyadenosine (dAdo) elevated in urine; Elevated urinary dAdo level

fields.label: Positive 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine urine test
fields.definition: "Positive (abnormal) result of the 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine urine test, which indicates the presence of alpha-ketoacids in the urine." [PMID:32491705]

fields.label: Elevated urinary dolichol level
fields.definition: "The amount of dolichol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Dolichol levels high in urine

fields.label: Decreased urinary bile acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of bile acids in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary creatine/creatinine ratio
fields.definition: "The ratio of creatine to creatinine concentration in the urine is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:27096572]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased urine Cr/Crn ratio

fields.label: Elevated urinary thymidine level
fields.definition: "The amount of thymidine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary glutarylglycine level
fields.definition: "The amount of glutarylglycine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary indican level
fields.definition: "Detection of indican in the urine. Urinary indican concentration may be elevated in small bowel bacterial overgrowth. Indican is produced by bacterial deconjugation of dietary tryptophan to indole which is absorbed at all levels of the intestine, but principally from the small bowel." [PMID:6417635]

fields.label: Dacrolith
fields.definition: "Dacryolith is a concretion (accumulation of sediment) within the nasolacrimal system." [PMID:17536093]
fields.synonyms_concat: Lacrimal calculus; Tear stone

fields.label: Reduced erythrocyte gamma-glutamyl cysteine synthetase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of gamma-glutamylcysteine synthetase (EC 6.3.2.2) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:12663448]
synonyms: Gamma-glutamyl cysteine synthetase low in erythrocytes
fields.label_normalized: reduced erythrocyte gamma-glutamyl cysteine synthetase activity
fields.synonyms_concat: Gamma-glutamyl cysteine synthetase low in erythrocytes

fields.label: Decreased erythrocyte nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide-cytochrome b5 reductase activity
fields.definition: "The activity of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH)-cytochrome b5 reductase in erythrocytes (red blood cells) is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:8874222]
fields.label_normalized: decreased erythrocyte nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide-cytochrome b5 reductase activity
fields.synonyms_concat: NADH-cytochrome b5 reductase low

fields.label: Reduced alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase (AMACR; EC 5.1.99.4) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:10655068]
fields.label_normalized: reduced alpha-methylacyl-coa racemase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Low semen volume
fields.definition: "Volume of semen in ejaculate below the lower limit of normal. This finding can be ascertained by semen analysis. Comment: Sperm are produced within the testis, in the process of spermatogenesis, then travel through the male reproductive tract (the seminiferous tubules, epididymis, vas deferens, prostate and urethra). As the sperm travel, seminal fluid is added from the seminal vesicles, prostate, testis and epididymis and periurethral glands. The function of the ejaculate is to transport sperm into the female genital tract and to provide a suitable environment for sperm survival during this transit." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypospermia

fields.label: Elbow localization
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the elbow." []

fields.label: Enlarged lunula
fields.definition: "Abnormal enlargement of the visible portion of the distal nail matrix that extends beyond the proximal nail fold, which is referred to as the lunula." [PMID:30245952]
fields.synonyms_concat: Macrolunula; Nails: lunulae enlarged

fields.label: Heel localization
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the heel." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Heel predominance

fields.label: Splinter hemorrhages
fields.definition: "Thin, red to reddish-brown lines of blood (hemorrhages) under the nails. Splinter hemorrhages run vertically under the nails." [PMID:36050132]

fields.label: Lateral thrust
fields.definition: "Lateral thrust (LT) refers to an abnormal knee joint motion in the early stance phase where the knee joint center moves laterally. Also known as varus thrust, LR is defined as the dynamic worsening or abrupt onset of varus (bow-leg) alignment as the limb accepts weight (stance phase), with a return to less varus and more neutral alignment during lift-off and the non-weight-bearing (swing) phase of gait, varus thrust is a potent mechanical risk factor for medial knee osteoarthritis progression." [PMID:23948980, PMID:37266363]
fields.synonyms_concat: Varus thrust

fields.label: Cerebral contusion
fields.definition: "A contusion is a region of injured tissue in which blood capillaries have been ruptured without laceration (bruise). Brain contusions are bruises of the cortical surface that damage the surface from the outside inward, producing disruption of tissue and vessels. The term cerebral contusion describes the pathology of focal necrosis and hemorrhage, typically observed in older children, involving particularly cerebral cortex and subcortical white matter. Such lesions are usually found in coup and contrecoup, as well as inferior orbital, frontal, and temporal locations. Cerebral contusions cause permanent damage to tissues of the cerebrum. The etiology of cerebral contusion is trauma to the head." [PMID:32965818]

fields.label: Fecolith
fields.definition: "A mass of accumulated hardened fecal matter." [PMID:37706403, PMID:8906682]
fields.synonyms_concat: Coprolith; Fecaloma; Stercolith

fields.label: Appendicitis
fields.definition: "Appendicitis is an inflammation of the vermiform appendix, which is a hollow organ located at the tip of the cecum, usually in the right lower quadrant of the abdomen." [PMID:29630245]

fields.label: Left ventricular aneurysm
fields.definition: "A severely scarred portion of infarcted ventricular myocardium that does not contract normally but instead bulges outward while the rest of the ventricle contracts during systole." [PMID:32310415]

fields.label: Boot-shaped cardiac silhouette
fields.definition: "An abnormal form of the heart seen upon chest radiography in which the heart displays an upturned apex and slight concave pulmonary artery segment. This configuration is said to resemble a boot." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Boot shaped cardiac silhouette

fields.label: Hydrosalpinx
fields.definition: "Hydrosalpinx is a distension or dilatation of the fallopian tube in the presence of a distal tubal occlusion." [PMID:30824209]

fields.label: Elevated methylhex-dienedioic level by MRS
fields.definition: "An increase in the level of 3-methylhex-2,4-dienedioic acid or 3-methylhex-3,4-dienedioic acid in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS)." [PMID:32027475]

fields.label: Perihepatic enhancement
fields.definition: "Increased signal (contrast enhancement) surrounding the liver observed on computer tomography or magnetic resonance imaging following administration of contrast agents." [PMID:35528764]
fields.synonyms_concat: Peri-hepatic enhancement

fields.label: Reduced in vitro contracture test threshold
fields.definition: "The in vitro contracture test determines the sensitivity of freshly obtained skeletal muscle specimens to caffeine or halothane applied to a bathing solution. Muscles from persons susceptible to malignant hyperthermia have lower contracture thresholds for these agents than do normal muscle." [PMID:1833602]
synonyms: Caffeine in vitro contracture test positive
Halothane in vitro contracture test positive
fields.label_normalized: reduced in vitro contracture test threshold
fields.synonyms_concat: Caffeine in vitro contracture test positive; Halothane in vitro contracture test positive

fields.label: Reduced F-wave amplitude
fields.definition: "Reduced strength (amplitude) of the F-wave, which is an electrophysiological artifact produced by antidromic activation of motoneurons following distal electrical stimulation of motor nerve fibers." [PMID:17334607]

fields.label: Enlarged peroxisomes
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase in size of peroxisomes." [PMID:2894756]
fields.synonyms_concat: Peroxisomal enlargement

fields.label: Adrenocortical hyperplasia
fields.definition: "A non-malignant growth, or enlargement, of the adrenal glands, specifically the cortex, although the cortex cannot be definitively identified by conventional imaging. Adrenal cortical hyperplasia is defined radiologically as a non-malignant growth, or enlargement, of the adrenal glands." [PMID:28707538]

fields.label: Lymphocytic infiltration of the parotid gland
fields.definition: "Accumulation of lymphocytes in the parotid gland. This feature is generally defined as a count of lymphocytes per area that is above normal limits on histopathological examination." []
fields.label_normalized: lymphocytic infiltration of the parotid gland

fields.label: Bone marrow granuloma
fields.definition: "A granuloma (a focal aggregate of immune cells that forms in response to a persistent inflammatory stimulus) localiyed to the bone marrow. A granuloma characteristically demonstrates the compact organization of mature macrophages, which may or may not be associated with other inflammatory cell types." [PMID:32119473]

fields.label: Neuronal intranuclear inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "The presence of intracellular inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in neurons." [PMID:27797808]

fields.label: Pancreatic atrophy
fields.definition: "Wasting (shrinking) of the pancreas." [PMID:22787562]

fields.label: Decreased pancreatic acinar cell density
fields.definition: "Number (count) of pancreatic acinar cells reduced below normal. This feature can be ascertained by pancreas biopsy." [PMID:32388592]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pancreatic biopsy: acinar structures reduced

fields.label: Unesterified cholesterol accumulation in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "An abnormal result of the filipin test. This test is based on the reaction of unesterified cholesterol with fluorescent antibiotic filipin giving a strongly fluorescent, stable cholesterol-filipin complex suitable for in situ detection. An abnormal test result is present if there is a perinuclear accumulation of staining in lysosomal storage organelles (LSOs)." [PMID:25665455]
fields.label_normalized: unesterified cholesterol accumulation in cultured fibroblasts
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive filipin test

fields.label: Splenic lipid-laden macrophage infiltration
fields.definition: "Accumulation of foamy cells (lipid-laden macrophages) in the parenchyma of the spleen." [PMID:32382506]
fields.synonyms_concat: Spleen biopsy: lipid-laden macrophages; Splenic foamy cells

fields.label: Reduced hepatic N-acetylglutamate synthase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of N-acetylglutamate synthase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:12594532]

fields.label: Excessive licorice consumption
fields.definition: "Ingestion of large amounts of licorice." [PMID:23185686, PMID:35321787]

fields.label: Shoulder localization
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the shoulder." []

fields.label: Pregnancy conceived despite intrauterine device
fields.definition: "Intrauterine devices (IUDs) are used for contraception. Rarely pregnancy occurs despite the presence of an IUD. Such pregnancies are associated with an increased risk of spontaneous abortion and preterm delivery due to infection, and a higher risk of maternal septic complications." [PMID:19650756]

fields.label: Maternal folate deficiency
fields.definition: "The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of folate deficiency during the corresponding pregnancy." [PMID:31093652]

fields.label: Maternal zinc deficiency
fields.definition: "The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of abnormally low zinc levels during the corresponding pregnancy." [PMID:26053136]

fields.label: Use of intrauterine device
fields.definition: "Intrauterine devices (IUD) are commonly used for contraception. IUD complications are rare, but include perforation, pelvic infection, expulsion, missing strings, and difficult IUD removal." [PMID:32491335]

fields.label: History of recent central venous catheter
fields.definition: "A past medical history of a recent central venous catheter (CVC). A CVC is an indwelling device inserted into a large, central vein (most commonly the internal jugular, subclavian, or femoral) and advanced until the terminal lumen resides within the inferior vena cava, superior vena cava, or right atrium. CVCs can be a necessary producre for critically ill patients with indications such as total parenteral nutrition administration, dialysis, plasmapheresis, medication administration, and hemodynamic monitoring, and to facilitate further complex interventions such as transvenous pacemaker placement. Complications include arrhythmia, central vein stenosis, and sepsis." [PMID:32491730]
fields.label_normalized: history of recent central venous catheter

fields.label: History of total parenteral nutrition dependence
fields.definition: "A past medical history of a recent depence on total parenteral nutrition (TPN), which refers to intravenously administered nutrition being the only source of nutrition the patient is receiving." [PMID:32644462]
fields.label_normalized: history of total parenteral nutrition dependence

fields.label: Pain alleviated by testicle elevation

Since the pulmonary vascular impedance increases with age, many normal patients over age 50 have a single S2 or at most a narrow physiologic split on inspiration because P2 occurs early. A single second sound, however, is usually due to inability to auscultate a relatively soft pulmonic component. Such inability is rare in healthy infants, children, and young adults and is uncommon even in older persons under good auscultatory conditions using a rigid stethoscopic diaphragm." [PMID:21250183]

fields.definition: "Hyperoxia test is the initial method to distinguish critical congenital heart disease (CCHD) from pulmonary disease. The test consists in measuring an arterial blood gas at room air and 100% inspired oxygen after 10 minutes. Neonates with congenital heart disease are usually not able to increase PaO2 above 100 mm Hg during 100% oxygen administration. In patients with pulmonary disease, PaO2 generally increased greater than or equal to 100 mm Hg with 100% oxygen as ventilation-perfusion discrepancies are overcome. A positive result indicates the cardiac origin and further cardiac workup is indicated to rule out CCHD." [PMID:29763177]
