fields.definition: "Increase in the anterior posterior dimension of the prevertebral space, which is located in the neck region between the anterior part of the cervical spine and the deep layer of the deep cervical fascia running between the transverse processes of the spine." [PMID:19001541]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased pre-vertebral space

fields.label: Third cranial nerve thickening
fields.definition: "Increase in diameter of the third cranial nerve (oculomotor nerve). This feature can be observed by magnetic resonance imaging and may be accompanied by contrast enhancement." [PMID:22241707]
fields.synonyms_concat: Oculomotor nerve thickening

fields.label: Elevated tissue sphingomyelin concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of sphoingomyelin in tissues above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: History of recent iodated contrast medium administration
fields.definition: "Medical history of recent iodinated or radioiodine contrast use." [PMID:23148056, PMID:33948409]
fields.label_normalized: history of recent iodated contrast medium administration

fields.label: Difficulty passing nasogastric tube
fields.definition: "Difficulty inserting a nasogastric tube (NGT), a flexible plastic tube that is placed through the nose and esophagus into the stomach and used to administer drugs or for feeding. There are certain circumstances that may make NGT insertion difficult. They are esophageal narrowing, comatose or intubated patients, and patients who have sustained severe facial or skull injuries." [PMID:2917506]

fields.label: Persistent falcine venous sinus
fields.definition: "A falcine sinus that does not involute but persists beyond birth is defined as a persistent falcine sinus. In the 20-mm embryo stage, the primitive falx cerebri contains the sagittal plexus, a meshwork of anastomotic venous channels from which the superior sagittal sinus and straight sinus are thought to develop. A persistent falcine sinus represents a persistent channel of the caudal anastomotic loops of the sagittal plexus." [PMID:19779000]

fields.label: Penis uncircumcised
fields.definition: "A medical history in a male of not having been circumcized." [PMID:25011345]
fields.synonyms_concat: Foreskin present; Prepuce present

fields.label: History of facial cosmetic use
fields.definition: "A medical history of use of facial makeup." [PMID:28722951]
fields.synonyms_concat: Use of makeup on face

fields.label: Snapping sensation at metacarpophalangeal joint
fields.definition: "A feeling of clicking or snapping at the knuckle (metacarpophalangeal joint) upon extension of flexion of the finger." []

fields.label: Forearm pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the forearm." []

fields.label: Rotational fracture
fields.definition: "A type of displaced fracture in which there has been a rotation of the distal fracture fragment in relation to the proximal portion." []

fields.label: Localized over bony prominences
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated on the skin in areas where bones are close to the surface (bony prominences)." []

fields.label: History of compressive footwear
fields.definition: "A past medical history of wearing tight shoes, toe-box shoes, or high heel shoes." [PMID:20934103]

fields.label: Decreased skin turgor
fields.definition: "Reduced skin turgor means reduced elastic recoil of the skin to its normal contour after being pinched in a fold." [PMID:30705869]

fields.label: Recent foraged mushroom consumption
fields.definition: "Medical history of recently eating wild mushrooms." [PMID:29262102]

fields.label: Proximal to distal progression
fields.definition: "Refers to symptomatology that begins in the proximal limbs and subsequently affects the distal limbs." []

fields.label: Autonomic-voluntary dissociation of facial movements
fields.definition: "The selective paralysis of voluntary fascio-pharyngo-glosso-masticatory movements with preservation of reflexive and automatic functions is referred to as autonomic-voluntary dissociation, which is a distinctive feature of Anterior opercular syndrome (also known as Foix-Chavany-Marie syndrome)." [PMID:23809752]

fields.label: Jaw mass
fields.definition: "A swelling or enlargement localized to the jaw. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." []

fields.label: Excessive nocturnal light exposure
fields.definition: "Exposure to continuous light at night, including night-shift work or a nocturnal lifestyle." [PMID:34903129]

fields.label: Menstruating female between menarche and menopause
fields.definition: "Past medical history of a woman who is menstruating, i.e., not premenstrual or post-menopause." []
fields.label_normalized: menstruating female between menarche and menopause

fields.label: Preterm premature rupture of membranes
fields.definition: "PPROM (preterm premature rupture of membranes) occurs at less than 37 weeks of gestation. PPROM can happen spontaneously, during preterm labor, or following a procedure such as amniocentesis." [PMID:15167875]
fields.synonyms_concat: PPROM

fields.label: History of abdominal surgery
fields.definition: "A past medical history that indicates that the patient had a surgical procedure involving the abdomen." []

fields.label: Thickened Descemet membrane
fields.definition: "The thickness of the Descement membrane is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Thick Descemet membrane

fields.label: Incomplete right bundle branch block
fields.definition: "Right bundle branch block (RBBB) represents an abnormality in the intraventricular electrical conduction system of the human heart, generating enlarged QRS and modified vectors on the electrocardiogram (ECG). Incomplete RBBB (IRBBB) is defined by (i) QRS duration between 110 and 120 ms in adults; (ii) rsr, rsR, or rSR in leads V1 or V2. The R or r deflection is usually wider than the initial R wave. In a minority of patients, a wide and often notched R wave pattern may be seen in leads V1 and/or V2; (iii) S wave of greater duration than R wave or greater than 40 ms in leads I and V6 in adults; and (iv) Normal R peak time in leads V5 and V6 but greater than 50 ms in lead V1. The first 3 criteria should be present to make the diagnosis. When a pure dominant R wave with or without a notch is present in V1, criterion 4 should be satisfied." [PMID:34100724]

fields.label: Perimenopausal onset
fields.definition: "Onset of signs or symptoms of disease during the period of a woman's life shortly before the occurrence of the menopause." []

fields.label: Postmenopausal onset
fields.definition: "Onset of signs or symptoms of disease during the period of a woman's life after the occurrence of the menopause." []

fields.label: Spastic monoplegia
fields.definition: "Spastic weakness found in only one upper or lower extremity." [PMID:24111874]

fields.label: Mosaic attenuation pattern in lung
fields.definition: "Mosaic attenuation pattern in the lung is a term used to describe regions of differing pulmonary attenuation on CT imaging. It is a non-specific finding, although is associated with several conditions such as obstructive small airway disease, occlusive vascular disease (in which case is called mosaic perfusion pattern), pulmonary edema, and parenchymal diseases." []

fields.label: Elevated aldosterone:renin ratio
fields.definition: "The ratio of aldosterone concentration to renin concentration is above the upper limit of normal. If aldosterone is expressed in ng/dl and plasma renin activity is expressed as ng/ml/hr, then values above 20 with aldosterone level above 15 are considered indicative of primary aldosteronism." [PMID:25907736]

fields.label: Meteorism
fields.definition: "An increase in the gas content inside the bowel associated with distension of the abdomen and hydroaeric noises. The most common symptom of meteorism is a bloated sensation. It may be associated with abdominal discomfort. Some individuals may also complain of a distended stomach and excessive belching and/or passage of flatus." [PMID:28613601]

fields.label: Failure to elevate ammonia on ischemic exercise
fields.definition: "Normal subjects display an increase in the concentration of ammonia in the blood following an ischemic exercise test. This term refers to an increase in ammonia that is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:3476851]
fields.label_normalized: failure to elevate ammonia on ischemic exercise

fields.label: Labile Hypertension
fields.definition: "Frequent fluctuations of blood pressure between normal and high levels, changing more dramatically than normal." []

fields.label: Absent axon flare response after intradermal histamine injection
fields.definition: "The axon reflex (also known as the flare response) is a response that is stimulated by peripheral nerves of the body that travels away from the nerve cell body and branches to stimulate target organs. In the human skin, there are three different phenomena mediated by axon reflex mechanism; flare, sweating and pilomotion. Stroking or intradermal injection of histamine or substance P into the human skin pro- duces widespread vasodilatation (flare) and plasma extravasation (wheal). This term refers to the failure of intradermal hista injection to elicit flare." [PMID:2456128]
fields.label_normalized: absent axon flare response after intradermal histamine injection

fields.label: Reduced sympathoneural responses to the cold pressor test
fields.definition: "Response to the cold pressor test below the lower limit of normal. The cold pressor test is a simple and validated test in which the subject immerses one hand or foot into ice water for 1 to 3 minutes while blood pressure (BP) and heart rate are monitored. The cold stimulus activates afferent sensory pathways that, in turn, trigger a sympathetic response resulting in an increase in BP." [PMID:33712946]
fields.label_normalized: reduced sympathoneural responses to the cold pressor test

fields.label: Positive stool Giardia antigen test
fields.definition: "Fecal analysis for Giardia antigen is abnormal. Tests include direct fluorescent-antibody (DFA), which detects intact organisms, and enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), which detect soluble stool antigens." [PMID:12574257]

fields.label: Excessive blood loss during delivery
fields.definition: "Loss of a substantial amount of blood during delivery (some definitions stipulate 1000 ml or more), typically associated with manifestations such as low blood pressure, a rapid heart rate, dizziness, light-headedness, fatigue, and weakness." [PMID:33913640]

fields.label: Cardiac valve vegetations
fields.definition: "Endocarditis infection occurs along the edges of the heart valves. Damage to the cardiac endothelium followed by platelet and fibrin deposition results in a sterile lesion known as nonbacterial thrombotic endocarditis (NBTE) or vegetation. Microbes entering the bloodstream via routine or invasive procedures adhere to the vegetation and are engulfed in an outer meshwork of fibrin and platelets. Subsequent rapid microbial multiplication in a protected area of impaired host defense leads to vegetation growth and continuous bacteremia." [PMID:17678415]

fields.label: Thoracic cage flatness
fields.definition: "The anteroposterior dimension of the chest on the lateral radiograph is often relatively narrow compared with the chest width on the frontal radiograph." [PMID:3500611]
fields.synonyms_concat: Flat chest

fields.label: Absent zona pellucida
fields.definition: "Lack of the oocyte extracellular matrix region (zona pellucida). This feature can be observed following follicular aspiration (retrieval of eggs for fertility treatments)." [PMID:24670168]

fields.label: Umbilical cord prolapse
fields.definition: "The presence of the umbilical cord (UC) between the fetal presenting part and the cervix, regardless of the membrane status (intact or ruptured). Descent of the UC through the cervix is essential for diagnosing cord prolapse. It can be either overt (past the presenting part) or occult (alongside the presenting part)." [PMID:31194398]

fields.label: Increased ratio of deoxypyridinoline to pyridinoline cross-links in urine
fields.definition: "The relative concentration of deoxypyridinoline (Dpyr) to that of pyridinoline (Pyr) cross-links in urine is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:20301635]
fields.label_normalized: increased ratio of deoxypyridinoline to pyridinoline cross-links in urine

fields.label: Elevated urinary thymine level
fields.definition: "The amount of thymine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary indoleacetic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of indoleacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:4228120]

fields.label: Reduced hepatic phosphorylase kinase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of phosphorylase kinase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal. Phosphorylase kinase (PhK) has a major regulatory role in the breakdown of glycogen. The enzyme PhK comprises four copies each of four subunits, encoded by PHKA1, PHKA2, PHKB, and PHKG." [PMID:21634085]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased hepatic phosphorylase kinase activity

fields.label: Reduced hepatic ornithine transcarbamylase activity
fields.definition: "Activity or concentration of ornithine transcarbamylase in the liver below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:6733950]

fields.label: Elevated urinary quinolinic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of quinolinic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Quinolinic acids is a pyridinedicarboxylic acid that is pyridine substituted by carboxy groups at positions 2 and 3. It is a metabolite of tryptophan." [PMID:29517768]

fields.label: Rectal duplication
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly characterized by an additional rectum that is typically lined with intestinal mucosa with one or more cell types of the gastrointestinal tract overlying submucosa and smooth muscle layer." [PMID:26691370]

fields.label: Thinned small intestinal mucosa
fields.definition: "Abrnormal reduction in the height of the mucosa of the small intestine. The mucosa is arranged in regular circular folds (the circular valves of Kerckrin), the mucosal surface is covered with small projections called villi, which are slender, about 1.5-2 mm long projections of the mucosa into the lumen. In between the villi are the crypts. This term refers to a pathological thinning of these structures." []

fields.label: Seminal vesicle hypoplasia
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly characterized by underdevelopment of one or both seminal vesicles, which are the two small glands that store and produce the majority of the fluid that makes up semen." []

fields.label: Decreased fetal abdominal circumference
fields.definition: "The distance around the abdomen of a fetus, generally as measured by prenatal sonography, is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:30646865]
fields.synonyms_concat: Small fetal abdominal circumference

fields.label: Prenatal flattened diaphragm
fields.definition: "The diaphragm normally projects up into the thoracic cavity. In the presence of malformations such as enlarged lungs, the diaphragm may appear abnormally flat or even everted (with the middle of the diaphragm projecting downwards into the abdominal cavity)." [PMID:30319217]

fields.label: Snowflake effect in amniotic cavity
fields.definition: "Dense floating particles in amniotic fluid, said to resemble snowflakes. This finding can result from shedding of the epidermis in conditions such as Harlequin ichthyosis." [PMID:33569485]
fields.synonyms_concat: Snowflake sign

fields.label: Thickened mitral valve cusp
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased thickness of a leaflet of the mitral valve." []

fields.label: Antiparietal cell antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against parietal cell antigens." [PMID:34913949]

fields.label: Anti-intrinsic factor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against intrinsic factor." [PMID:34913949]

fields.label: Anti-human immunodeficiency virus antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-HIV antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-polio virus antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of poliovirus." [PMID:32644370]

fields.label: Anti-NR2A antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the N-Methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor NR2A subunit." [PMID:28154472]

fields.label: Antistreptolysin O antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against streptolysin O." []

fields.label: Reduced tissue tissue AICAR transformylase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase; EC 2.1.2.3) a in a tissue is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:15114530]
fields.label_normalized: reduced tissue tissue aicar transformylase activity

fields.label: Ameliorated by gastric acid-reducing therapy
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with an agent that reduces gastric acidity such as proton pump inhibitors, histamine receptor blockers,omeprazole, esomeprazole, dexlansoprazole, pantoprazole, lansoprazole, famotidine, or ranitidine." []

fields.label: Anti-coagulation factor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against a coagulation factor." []

fields.label: Tachyphagia
fields.definition: "Excessively rapid eating of food." [PMID:28011862, PMID:34487332]

fields.label: Reduced tissue argininosuccinate synthetase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration of argininosuccinate synthetase (EC 6.3.4.5) in body tissues is below the lower limit of normal. Clinically, argininosuccinate synthetase is measured in the liver or in cultered skin fibroblasts." [PMID:28111830]
synonyms: Reduced argininosuccinate synthetase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced argininosuccinate synthetase activity in cultured fibroblasts; Reduced hepatic argininosuccinate synthetase activity

fields.label: Reduced aspartoacylase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of aspartoacylase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts. Aspartoacylase (EC 3.5.1.15), also called aminoacylase-2, is an enzyme that hydrolyzes N-acetyl-L-aspartic acid (NAA) to aspartate and acetate." [PMID:8252036]
fields.label_normalized: reduced aspartoacylase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced malonyl-CoA decarboxylase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of malonyl-CoA decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.9) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:9869665]
fields.label_normalized: reduced malonyl-coa decarboxylase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced tissue medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (EC 1.3.8.7;MCAD) in tissues is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:2393404]
synonyms: Reduced MCAD activity in cultured fibroblasts
Reduced medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.label_normalized: reduced tissue medium-chain acyl-coa dehydrogenase activity
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced MCAD activity in cultured fibroblasts; Reduced medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced cystathionine beta-synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of cystathionine beta-synthase (EC 4.2.1.22) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:5647845]
fields.label_normalized: reduced cystathionine beta-synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced muscle glycogen phosphorylase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of the enzyme glycogen phosphorylase in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. Glycogen phosphorylase (EC 2.4.1.1) is also known as amylophosphorylase, muscle phosphorylase a and b, polyphosphorylase, and myophosphorylase." [PMID:21880526]

fields.label: Reduced muscle 6-phosphofructokinase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of the enzyme 6-phosphofructokinase in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. 6-phosphofructokinase (EC 2.7.1.11) is also known as phosphofructokinase I and phosphohexokinase. The PFKM gene encodes the muscle isoform of phosphofructokinase. PFK catalyzes the irreversible conversion of fructose-6-phosphate to fructose-1,6-bisphosphate and is a key regulatory enzyme in glycolysis." [PMID:6227635]

fields.label: Reduced tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase." [PMID:12202988]

fields.label: Reduced succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid-CoA transferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid-CoA transferase (SCOT, or OXCT1; EC 2.8.3.5) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:11757586]
fields.label_normalized: reduced succinyl-coa:3-oxoacid-coa transferase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Blunted aldosterone response to aldosterone suppression test
fields.definition: "A non-suppressible aldosterone excess, defined as an abnormal result of one of any four suppression tests. These tests use oral sodium loading, oral fludrocortisone, oral captopril, or saline infusion to suppress aldosterone secretion." [PMID:20482833]
fields.label_normalized: blunted aldosterone response to aldosterone suppression test

fields.label: Flank mass
fields.definition: "An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the flank, which is the fleshy part of the side of the body between the ribs and the hip." []

fields.label: Synovial cyst
fields.definition: "A fluid-filled sac or pouch-like mass that is a distention of a preexisting bursa in a joint, tendon sheaths or bursae. Synovial cysts contain synovial fluid and are lined by synovial membrane." []

fields.label: Brown pigmentation of the conjunctiva
fields.definition: "Deposition of brown pigmentation in the conjunctiva." [PMID:15249376, PMID:20301627]

fields.label: Gastrocnemius contracture
fields.definition: "Limitation of simultaneous ankle dorsiflexion and knee extension during mid-stance of gait." [PMID:22819670]

fields.label: Central thinning of the outer nuclear layer of the retina
fields.definition: "Reduced thickness of the outer nuclear layer in the middle region of the retina. The outer nuclear layer (ONL) of the retina contains the nuclei of the cone and rod photoreceptors. Loss of the cellular machinery found in these nuclei causes irreparable loss of the photoreceptors and the capacity for visual function. This feature can be appreciated by directional optical coherence tomography." [PMID:25829348]
fields.label_normalized: central thinning of the outer nuclear layer of the retina
fields.synonyms_concat: Central thinning of the ONL

fields.label: Sonographic renal salt and pepper pattern
fields.definition: "Heterogeneous, increased parenchymal echogenicity. This imaging appearance is caused by multiple tiny cysts smaller than or just approaching the size necessary for detection, which disrupt the echo pattern without being clearly distinguishable, and appear as white grains on renal ultrasound, mainly in a subcapsular location." [PMID:22034641, PMID:30599104]
fields.label_normalized: sonographic renal salt and pepper pattern

fields.label: Ductus venosus agenesis with intrahepatic drainage
fields.definition: "A form of ductus venosus agenesis in which the umbilical vein connects via the portal sinus to the portal venous system (PVS) without giving rise to the ductus venosus. In some cases an intrahepatic shunt from a portal to a hepatic vein can be detected prenatally. This variant has been reported to have a favorable prognosis." [PMID:28934814]
fields.label_normalized: ductus venosus agenesis with intrahepatic drainage

fields.label: Ductus venosus agenesis with extrahepatic drainage and liver bypass
fields.definition: "A form of ductus venosus agenesis in which umbilical vein does not connect to the portal venous system. The liver is bypassed and the umbilical vein drains into a systemic vein such as the inferior vena cava. This variant has been reported to have an unfavorable prognosis due to a presumed association with congestive heart failure and hydrops." [PMID:28934814]
fields.label_normalized: ductus venosus agenesis with extrahepatic drainage and liver bypass

fields.label: Elevated circulating D-glyceric acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of D-gyceric acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated CSF D-glyceric acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of D-carboxylic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: D-glyceric acid high in CSF

fields.label: Ameliorated by riboflavin
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingestion of riboflavin (Vitamin B2)." []

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 1beta concentration
fields.definition: "An increased concentration of interleukin-1beta in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Reduced neutrophil myeloperoxidase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of myeloperoxidase (EC 1.11.1.7) as measured in neutrophils is below the limits of normal." [PMID:5796360]

fields.label: Jugular foramen stenosis
fields.definition: "Reduction in diameter of the jugular foramen, an opening in the base of the skull that is located behind the carotid canal and is formed by the temporal bone and the occipital bone. The inferior petrosal sinus, three cranial nerves, the sigmoid sinus, and meningeal arteries pass through the jugular foramen." [PMID:17236138]

fields.label: Intramural intestinal gas
fields.definition: "The presence of extraluminal gas within the bowel wall." [PMID:25400871]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pneumatosis intestinalis

fields.label: Delayed scintigraphic gallbladder filling
fields.definition: "Hepatobiliary scintigraphy is a nuclear imaging technique that permits evaluation of the liver and biliary system for acute and chronic cholecystitis, biliary atresia, biliary obstruction, and post-surgical biliary leak. With this investigation, a radiotracer is administered intravenously, bound to albumin, transported to the liver, and excreted into the biliary system. This term refers to a longer than normal time for the radiotracer to be visualized in the gallbladder. This finding may be a sign of chronic gallbladder disease or partial obstruction of the common bile duct." [PMID:30855831]

fields.label: Pancreatic arteriovenous malformation
fields.definition: "Pancreatic arteriovenous malformation is defined as an abnormal vascular net, developed from one or more feeding arteries and enlarged early draining veins, creating an arteriovenous shunting." [PMID:29904461]

fields.label: Anti-perilipin-1 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against perilipin-1 (PLIN1)." [PMID:30283460, PMID:35709010, PMID:35771980, PMID:36538601]

fields.label: Splenic calcification
fields.definition: "Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the spleen." []

fields.label: Short esophagus
fields.definition: "Abnormal reduction in the length of the esophagus." [PMID:29262377]

fields.label: Gastric perforation
fields.definition: "A full-thickness injury of the wall of the stomach." [PMID:30137838]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gastric rupture

fields.label: Gastric volvulus
fields.definition: "A gastric volvulus occurs when the stomach rotates on itself at least 180 degrees along its transverse or longitudinal axis." [PMID:29939663]

fields.label: Elevated circulating sCD163 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of sD163 (= soluble cluster of differentiation 163, = soluble CD163) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Positive cold agglutinin test
fields.definition: "Cold agglutinin are erythrocyte antibodies which possess the property of agglutinating red blood cells at temperatures of below 37 degrees C, this phenomenon is reversible after heating." [PMID:34285751]

fields.label: Anti-D-L antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of Donath-Landsteiner (D-L) autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum." [PMID:34433582]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-Donath-Landsteiner antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-erythrocyte autoantibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against an antigen on the surface of erythrocytes (red-blood cells)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Antierythrocyte autoantibody positivity

fields.label: Non-glucose reducing substance in urine
fields.definition: "Abnormal result for this screening test for urinary reducing substances including glucose, fructose, galactose, lactose, pentose and maltose, as well as amino acids, cysteine, tyrosine, homogentisic acid, ketone bodies, ascorbic acid and many drugs. This term is applied if the urine stick test for glucose was negative (normal)." [PMID:17127733]

fields.label: Elevated urinary succinylaminoimidazole carboxamide riboside level
fields.definition: "Presence of succinylaminoimidazole carboxamide riboside (SAICAr). SAICAr is a toxic intermediate metabolite of purine synthesis." [PMID:22180458]
fields.label_normalized: elevated urinary succinylaminoimidazole carboxamide riboside level

fields.label: Elevated urine hyaluronic acid level
fields.definition: "Excessive amount of hyaluronic acid in urine." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyaluronic acid high in urine

fields.label: Elevated urinary methylmalonylcarnitine level
fields.definition: "The amount of methylmalonylcarnitine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urine trihydroxycholestanoic acid level
fields.definition: "Presence of trihydroxycholestanoic acid in the urine. Trihydroxycholestanoic acid is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of cholic acid. Elevated plasma levels of trihydroxycholestanoic acid have been found in patients with Zellweger syndrome." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urine THCA level; Elevated urine trihydroxycoprostanic acid level

fields.label: Elevated CSF ammonia concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of amonia in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Positive CSF VDRL test
fields.definition: "An abnormal (positive) result of the Venereal Disease Research Laboratory (VDRL) test performed in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), suggesting past or present neurosyphilis." [PMID:32869202]

fields.label: Elevated CSF guanidinoacetic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:12701824]

fields.label: CSF oligoclonal immunoglobulin G bands
fields.definition: "Oligoclonal immunoglobulin G (IgG) bands (OCBs) are a useful diagnostic tool to detect a central humoral response. In particular, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)-restricted OCBs represent a hallmark of multiple sclerosis (MS)." [PMID:35277112]

fields.label: Decreased CSF 3-methoxy-4-hydroxyphenylglycolaldehyde concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of 3-methoxy-4-hydroxyphenylglycolaldehyde in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:6539879]

fields.label: Elevated CSF alpha-crystallin B chain concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of alpha-crystallin B chain in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.label_normalized: elevated csf alpha-crystallin b chain concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Alphabeta-crystallin high in CSF

fields.label: Reduced CSF creatine concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of creatine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Reduced circulating protein Z concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of protein Z in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating 27-hydroxycholesterol concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of 27-hydroxycholesterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:24288332]

fields.label: Elevated circulating lysophosphatidylcholine concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of lysophosphatidylcholines in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:32717772]

fields.label: Reduced circulating insulin-like growth factor 2 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of insulin-like growth factor 2 (IGF2) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal. IGF2 is a peptide hormone regulating various cellular processes such as proliferation and apoptosis." []
fields.label_normalized: reduced circulating insulin-like growth factor 2 concentration

fields.label: Decreased circulating nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []
fields.label_normalized: decreased circulating nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide concentration

fields.label: Diminished circulating reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH) concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []
fields.label_normalized: diminished circulating reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (nadh) concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:29892265]
fields.label_normalized: elevated circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated FGF23

fields.label: Reduced CSF asparagine concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of asparagine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Pancreatic mass
fields.definition: "A swelling or enlargement localized to the pancreas. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." []

fields.label: Small intestine mass
fields.definition: "A swelling or enlargement localized to the small intestine. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." []

fields.label: Facial nerve compression
fields.definition: "Impingement of another object such as a blood vessel upon the facial nerve, causing it to lose volume in the compressed region." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Compression of seventh cranial nerve

fields.label: Pulmonary perfusion defect
fields.definition: "Lack of blood perfusion in a specific area of the lung. Pulmonary ventilation (V) and Perfusion (Q) scan, also known as lung V/Q scan, is a nuclear test that uses the perfusion scan to delineate the blood flow distribution and the ventilation scan to measure airflow distribution in the lungs." [PMID:33232086]

fields.label: Ectopic ureteral orifice
fields.definition: "Drainage of the ureter on one or both sides into an abnormal location. Normally the ureter drains via the internal ureteral orifice at the trigone of the urinary bladder. Ectopic ureteral orifice can be either intravesical (bladder neck) or, more often, extravesical. Ectopia in women is more frequently found in the urethra and the vaginal vestibule; much less frequently in vagina and in uterus. In men it is mostly found in the posterior urethra; in the male genital tract is very rare." [PMID:2762191]

fields.label: Duplicate uterine cervix
fields.definition: "A congenital developmental defect characterized by the presence of two cervices on the uterus." [PMID:30644250]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cervical duplication

fields.label: Intradural spinal lipoma
fields.definition: "Intradural spinal lipoma (ISL) constitutes approximately 1% of all spinal tumors and is usually associated with lumbo-sacral spinal dysraphism. ISLs unassociated with spinal dysraphism are rare with only a few cases being reported in literature. They are seen in children and young adults and are situated on the posterior aspect of the spinal cord in the cervico-thoracic or thoracic regions. They represent intradural, subpial, juxtamedullary lesions." [PMID:21887183]

fields.label: T2 hyperintense cerebellar lesion
fields.definition: "A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the cerebellum. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the cerebellum." []
fields.synonyms_concat: T2 hyperintensities in cerebellum

fields.label: Inferior vena cava obstruction
fields.definition: "Physical invasion or compression of the inferior vena cava by a pathological process or by thrombosis within the vein itself." [PMID:32809720]

fields.label: Rheumatoid nodule
fields.definition: "A well-demarcated, flesh colored, subcutaneous and usually freely movable lump or mass. Rheumatoid nodules can vary in size from small, pea sized lesions up to the size of a lemon and are most often round. The nodules usually are doughy or firm however and not tender. Typically rheumatoid nodules are distributed over areas of repeated trauma or pressure and occur adjacent to joints on extensor surfaces, such as the elbow, fingers and forearms." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating proinsulin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of proinsulin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:9207799]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated plasma proinsulin

fields.label: Burning eye sensation
fields.definition: "A feeling of stinging or irritation of the eyes." []

fields.label: Collarettes
fields.definition: "Buildup of waxy flesh-colored scales on the margin of the eyelid." []

fields.label: Tympanic membrane bulla
fields.definition: "Presence of blisters (bullae) on the tympanic membrane, often accompanied by fever, thickening, and erythematous appearance of the tympanic membrane, decreased or absent light reflex, and decreased mobility." [PMID:31971705]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bullous myringitis; Tympanic membrane blister

fields.label: Beard and mustache distribution
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at regions of the male face covered by a beard or mustache." []

fields.label: Kerion
fields.definition: "Kerion is an erythematous, boggy, tender, often sterile, weeping nodule or plaque with pustules and draining sinuses. Hair in these areas appears lusterless, brittle, and is easily plucked. Kerion can be solitary or multiple but is usually unilateral. Patients with inflammatory tinea barbae may have constitutional symptoms like fever and malaise. Kerion is a coalesced sterile pustule, but occasionally they can get superinfected with cutaneous bacteria and develop regional lymphadenopathy." [PMID:33085351]

fields.label: Truncal location
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the trunk of the body. The trunk is the main part of a person's body, not including the head, legs, or arms." []

fields.label: Reduced Acyl-CoA:dihydroxyacetone phosphate acyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of acyl-CoA:dihydroxyacetone phosphate acyltransferase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:11152660]
fields.label_normalized: reduced acyl-coa:dihydroxyacetone phosphate acyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Reduced alkyl-dihydroxyacetonephosphate synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Activity of alkyl-dihydroxyacetonephosphate (DHAP) synthase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:9553082]
synonyms: Reduced alkyl-DHAP synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.label_normalized: reduced alkyl-dihydroxyacetonephosphate synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced alkyl-DHAP synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Glomerular fibronectin deposits
fields.definition: "Accumulation of fibronectin in the glomerulus." [PMID:35774511]

fields.label: Renal tubular karyomegaly
fields.definition: "Marked enlargement of nuclei observed predominantly in the proximal convoluted tubule cells." [PMID:15311851]

fields.label: Reduced tissue acetyl-CoA carboxylase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of acetyl-CoA carboxylase in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including liver." [PMID:34552920]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced hepatic acetyl-CoA carboxylase activity

fields.label: Elevated urinary glycolic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of glycolic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:4701948]

fields.label: Elevated urine propionic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of propionic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary butyric acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of butyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary isovaleric acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of isovaleric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of alpha-ketoglutarate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Alpha-ketoglutarate high in blood

fields.label: Elevated circulating ghrelin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of ghrelin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Ghrelin is a 28-amino-acid peptide predominantly secreted in the stomach and stimulates appetite and growth hormone (GH) release." [PMID:29632576]

fields.label: Reduced circulating stearoylcarnitine concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of stearoylcarnitine (C18:0) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Reduced urinary iodine level
fields.definition: "The amount of iodine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Increased circulating interleukin 15 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of interleukin 15 (IL-15) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:22064066]
fields.synonyms_concat: IL-15 high in blood

fields.label: Reduced circulating squalene concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of squalene in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Abnormal circulating interleukin 6 concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 6 (IL-6) in the blood circulation." [PMID:32235786]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating interleukin 12 concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 12 in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Elevated blood mercury concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of mercury in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects." [PMID:26644501]

fields.label: Elevated blood cadmiun concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of cadmium in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects." [PMID:27486374]

fields.label: Elevated thallium concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of thallium in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects." [PMID:30020612]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating CC chemokine concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration in the blood circulation of a member of the CC chemokine family is outside of normal limits." []

fields.label: Decreased CSF asialotransferrin to transferrin ratio
fields.definition: "The concentration of asialotransferrin relative to that of transferrin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:18519871]
fields.label_normalized: decreased csf asialotransferrin to transferrin ratio

fields.label: Anti-desmocollin antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmocollin." [PMID:34567003]

fields.label: Occupational exposure to raw nonsynthetic textiles
fields.definition: "A history of exposure by inhalation of airborne particles generated during the processing of raw, nonsynthetic textiles, particularly cotton. Classically, exposure to cotton dust during the spinning and manufacturing process causes byssinosis. However, exposure to jute, flax, and hemp fibers has also been implicated in its development." [PMID:30137833]
fields.label_normalized: occupational exposure to raw nonsynthetic textiles

fields.label: Rokitansky-Aschoff gallbladder sinuses
fields.definition: "Localized or diffuse epithelial proliferation with hypertrophy of the muscularis layer and invagination of the mucosa through the muscularis, forming intramural diverticula (i.e., small, bulging pouches in the wall of the gallbladder)." [PMID:31984708]
synonyms: Epithelial invaginations of the gallbladder forming cystic pockets
fields.synonyms_concat: Adenomyomatosis of the gallbladder; Epithelial invaginations of the gallbladder forming cystic pockets

fields.label: Porcelain gallbladder
fields.definition: "Porcelain gallbladder refers to the condition in which the inner gallbladder wall is encrusted with calcium. The wall becomes brittle, hard, and often takes on a bluish hue. It is usually found incidentally on plain abdominal x-rays or other imaging because most patients are asymptomatic." [PMID:30085521]
fields.synonyms_concat: Calcified gallbladder; Calcifying cholecystitis; Cholecystopathia chronica calcarea

fields.label: Gallbladder adhesions
fields.definition: "Strands of scar tissue bands of scar tissue that form an abnormal connection between the gallbladder and another abdominal structure. Adhesions can form followiing gallbladder inflammation (cholecystitis)." [PMID:34386223]

fields.label: Bilioduodenal fistula
fields.definition: "An abnormal connection between the gallbladder and the duodenum." [PMID:28613489]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bouveret syndrome

fields.label: Pneumobilia
fields.definition: "Accumulation of gas in the biliary tree." [PMID:16567248]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aerobilia; Air in the biliary system

fields.label: Ectopic gallstone
fields.definition: "A gallstone located outside of the gallbladder." [PMID:27471576]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gallstone outside of the gallbladder

fields.label: Sleep drunkeness
fields.definition: "Sleep drunkenness refers to the prolonged and pronounced difficulty with awakening from nocturnal sleep and daytime naps. This symptom should be distinguished from the milder and physiologic state of sleep inertia seen even in healthy controls." [PMID:28778232, PMID:35985125, PMID:36401976]
synonyms: Slow speech or confused thinking upon waking
fields.synonyms_concat: Confusional arousal; Excessive sleep inertia; Slow speech or confused thinking upon waking

fields.label: Mallory bodies
fields.definition: "Cytoplasmic hyaline inclusions of hepatocytes that are predominantly filamentous ranging from a diameter of 3 to 24 nm vs. 10 nm of classical IF. Mallory-Denk bodies can be classified as type I (parallels filaments), II (randomly orient filaments), or III (granular and amorphous). Type II occurs in the periphery while type III occurs around the center. MDB occur in ballooned hepatocytes." [PMID:31424884]
fields.synonyms_concat: Mallory-Denk bodies

fields.label: Sulfur-containing abscess
fields.definition: "An abscess containing tiny yellow clumps (sulfur granules), formed by infection with Actinomyces and generally associated with a granulomatous and suppurative infection." [PMID:29489261]

fields.label: Retracted tympanic membrane
fields.definition: "A condition in which part of the tympanic membrane is pull backed into the middle ear cavity (also called retraction pocket)." [PMID:32890292]

fields.label: Ectopic testis
fields.definition: "Localization of the testis in an anatomic location other than the scrotum." [PMID:31211064]

fields.label: Cerebral subcortical cyst
fields.definition: "A fluid-filled sac (cyst) in the region below the cortex of the cerebrum. In magnetic resonance imaging, the fluid within the cyst has the same appearance as cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." [PMID:21977097]

fields.label: Anti-ADAMTS13 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against A Disintegrin and Metalloprotease with ThromboSpondin type 1 repeats, member 13 (ADAMTS13)." [PMID:28416507, PMID:31107120, PMID:33540569]

fields.label: Habitual mouth breathing
fields.definition: "A tendency to breathe through the mouth. Defined as over 25-30 percent of the air passing through the mouth instead of the nose, mouth breathing often occurs due to upper airway obstruction which reduces the nasal airflow and forces the air to enter completely or partially through oral cavity." [PMID:29799704, PMID:36159237]

fields.label: Squared off shoulders
fields.definition: "An appearance of the shoulders whereby the neck-trapezius angle (angle between the neck and the shoulder) and the angle formed by the shoulder and the arms hanging at the side of the body are both close to 90 degrees. This gives the should the appearance of the corner of a square." [PMID:33258289]

fields.label: Elevated urine mesaconic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of mesaconic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:29909962]

fields.label: Elevated urine 3-methyladipic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of 3-methyladipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:29909962]

fields.label: Elevated urine D-lactate level
fields.definition: "The amount of D-lactate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. L-lactate is a familiar molecule to the human body and is also produced in large amounts in human tissues, depending on metabolic conditions. In contrast, D-lactate is produced only in minute quantities in human tissues, and is therefore not detectable in the bloodstream under normal physiological conditions." [PMID:30931947]

fields.label: Elevated CSF alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of alpha-ketoglutarate in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:30635937]

fields.label: Elevated urine 2,3-dihydroxy-2-methylbutanoic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of 2,3-dihydroxy-2-methylbutanoic acidin the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:29575569]
fields.synonyms_concat: 2-methyl-2,3-dihydroxybutyrate high in urine; Elevated urine 2-methyl-2,3-dihydroxybutyrate level

fields.label: Fetal oral mass
fields.definition: "A swelling or enlargement localized to the oral cavity of a fetus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined. This finding is generally first observed by prenatal sonography or magnetic resonance imaging." [PMID:33904194]

fields.label: Dilated ejaculatory duct
fields.definition: "Increase in diameter of the ejeculatory duct. The ejaculatory duct delivers sperm into the urethra, adding secretions from the prostate and is formed by the union of the vas deferens with the duct of the seminal vesicle." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Ejaculatory duct dilated

fields.label: Decreased Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome protein concentration in hematopoietic cells
fields.definition: "The concentration of Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome protein in hematopoietic cells is below the lower limit of normal. This feature is measured by flow cytometry or Western blotting." []
fields.label_normalized: decreased wiskott-aldrich syndrome protein concentration in hematopoietic cells

fields.label: Decreased FOXP3-expressing T cell count
fields.definition: "The number of T cells in peripheral blood that express FOXP3-expressing is below the lower limit of normal. This finding is determined by flow cytometry." [PMID:20301297]

fields.label: Elevated circulating complement component concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of a complement component in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Anti-beta fodrin antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a component of beta-fodrin." [PMID:11673564]

fields.label: Elevated circulating tetradecenoylcarnitine concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of tetradecenoylcarnitine (C14:1) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urine 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine level
fields.definition: "The amount of 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:15344554, PMID:19578400, PMID:2332510]

fields.label: Elevated urine N-acetyltyrosine level
fields.definition: "The amount of N-acetyltyrosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:20301688]

fields.label: Elevated urine manganese level
fields.definition: "The amount of manganese in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:1577529]

fields.label: Reduced urinary manganese level
fields.definition: "The amount of manganese in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:1577529]

fields.label: Decreased circulating catecholamine concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of a catecholamine in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Empty sella turcica
fields.definition: "Empty sella or arachnoidocele has been defined as the herniation of the subarachnoid space within the sella turcica, associated with elongated pituitary stalk and flattening of the pituitary gland." [PMID:22875743]
fields.synonyms_concat: Arachnoidocele

fields.label: Elevated brain guanidinoacetate level by MRS
fields.definition: "An increase in the level of guanidinoacetate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS)." [PMID:9386672]
fields.label_normalized: elevated brain guanidinoacetate level by mrs

fields.label: Elevated circulating beta chorionic gonadotropin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of beta chorionic gonadotropin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:11919246]
fields.label_normalized: elevated circulating beta chorionic gonadotropin concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating CXCL10 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of C-X-C motif chemokine 10 (CXCL10) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:22038159]

fields.label: Reduced circulating interleukin 12 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of interleukin 12 (IL-12) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Reduced circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []
synonyms: Fibroblast growth factor 23 hormone low in blood
fields.label_normalized: reduced circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Fibroblast growth factor 23 hormone low in blood; Reduced FGF23

fields.label: Abnormal circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is outside of the limits of normal." []
fields.label_normalized: abnormal circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal FGF23 concentration

fields.label: Impaired heel-walking ability
fields.definition: "Difficulty or reduced ability to walk on heels. Heel-walking can be tested as a part of the neurological examination. Foot dorsal extension weakness leads to difficulties in walking on heels." [PMID:29291292]

fields.label: Anti-prothrombin antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against prothrombin." [PMID:3116540]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FII antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-factor V antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against factor V." [PMID:33505468]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FV antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-factor VII antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor VII." [PMID:26962982]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FVII antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-factor VIII antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor VIII." [PMID:3116540]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FVIII antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-factor IX antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor IX." [PMID:27501440, PMID:28594432]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FIX antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-factor X antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor X." [PMID:24074948]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FX antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-factor XI antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor XI." [PMID:18519152]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FXI antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-factor XIII antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor XIII." [PMID:29460500, PMID:32759568]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FXIII antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-factor H antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor H." [PMID:21051740, PMID:30989342]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-FH antibody positivity

fields.label: Extremities cold to touch
fields.definition: "Cool or cold arms or legs related to peripheral vasoconstriction, the narrowing of blood vessels resulting from the contraction of muscular walls in large arteries and the small arterioles of skin and most internal organs. Following exposure to low ambient temperatures, vasoconstriction decreases heat dissipation from skin surfaces, thus preventing life-threatening hypothermia." [PMID:34645109]
fields.synonyms_concat: Peripheral vasoconstriction

fields.label: Ruffled acrosome
fields.definition: "An irregular wavy appearance of sperm acrosomes." [PMID:12095502]

fields.label: Elevated circulating calprotectin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of calprotectin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: 4-5 toe cutaneous syndactyly
fields.definition: "A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 4 and 5." [PMID:37352860]

fields.label: Poly-hill sign
fields.definition: "A typical physical examination in patients with muscular dystrophies and selective weakness and atrophy of the trapezius muscle and proximal deltoid muscle. The contour of the back shows unique hills and drops." [PMID:11994973]

fields.label: 3-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
fields.definition: "A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the third to the fifth fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints." [PMID:37352860]
synonyms: Webbed third, fourth, and fifth finger
fields.synonyms_concat: Soft tissue syndactyly of fingers 3-5,; Webbed 3th, 4th, and 5th finger; Webbed third, fourth, and fifth finger

fields.label: Radioulnar subluxation
fields.definition: "Partial dislocation of the radioulnar joint." [PMID:7747190]

fields.label: Non-pitting edema
fields.definition: "Non-pitting edema occurs when excess fluid builds up in the body causing swelling that does not indent when pressure is applied. It usually occurs in the limbs, and often results from underlying medical conditions affecting lymphatic system function." [PMID:32119339]

fields.label: Anti-human ferritin peptide antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the human ferritin peptide." [PMID:22228484, PMID:36344353]

fields.label: Elevated CSF L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated erythrocyte inosine triphosphate concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of inosine triphosphate in red blood cells is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:12384777]

fields.label: Reduced erythrocyte inosine triphosphatase activity
fields.definition: "Activity or concentration of inosine triphosphate pyrophosphohydrolase (EC 3.6.1.19) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Reduced circulating alpha-1,3-fucosyltransferase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of alpha-1,3-fucosyltransferase is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation." [PMID:9448836]

fields.label: Diminished neutrophil myeloperoxidase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of the enzyme myeloperoxidase (EC 1.11.1.7) in neutrophils below the lower limit of normal. This feature can be measured by peroxidase cytochemistry or biochemical assays. Myeloperoxidase is a lysosomal hemoprotein located in the azurophilic granules of polymorphonuclear leukocytes and monocytes." [PMID:9354683]

fields.label: Reduced erythrocyte uroporphyrinogen III cosynthase activity
fields.definition: "Activity or concentration of in the level of uroporphyrinogen III (EC 4.2.1.75) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:3674403]
fields.label_normalized: reduced erythrocyte uroporphyrinogen iii cosynthase activity

The cells possess microscopic features of glandular cells with pale to clear vacuolated cytoplasm, and nuclei are usually high-grade with prominent nucleoli." [PMID:33085375]

fields.label: Recent temporal region trauma

The mucinous material is similar in density to water. There are also islands of higher attenuation due to scattered solid elements and calcification within mucinous material." [PMID:31082160]

Scalloping of the surface of the liver and spleen
