fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoechoic breast nodule

fields.label: Unilocular ovarian cyst
fields.definition: "An ovarian cyst without septa and a solid component." [PMID:25797108]

fields.label: Mesenteric torsion
fields.definition: "Mesenteric torsion is a pathological rotation of the intestinal tract around the axis of the mesenteric root, resulting in rapid occlusion of the cranial mesenteric artery." []

fields.label: High-pitched bowel sounds
fields.definition: "Abnormal bowel sounds of an unually high frequency." [PMID:30252358]

fields.label: Exacerbated by opiate medication
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign orr symptom that is worsed by administration of opiate medications." []

fields.label: Breast granuloma
fields.definition: "Formation of a non-necrotizing granuloma in breat tissue typically in combination with a localized infiltrate of multi-nucleated giant cells, epithelioid histiocytes, lymphocytes, and plasma cells." [PMID:30800035]
fields.synonyms_concat: Granulomatous mastitis

fields.label: Exposure to cosmetic fragrances
fields.definition: "A history of exposure to fragrances found in cosmetic products." []

fields.label: Sweating and flushing in the preauricular area in response to mastication
fields.definition: "Sweating and flushing in the preauricular area in response to mastication or a salivary stimulus. Facial warmth, flushing, and sweating in the territory of the auriculotemporal nerve overlying the parotid gland, which may include the preauricular skin, the temporal skin, the scalp, and the temporomandibular joint region. Symptoms occur during meals, especially with spicy and sour foods. This feature is inferred to be a consequence of injury to the auriculotemporal nerve, a branch if the trigeminal nerve." [PMID:32965918]
fields.label_normalized: sweating and flushing in the preauricular area in response to mastication
fields.synonyms_concat: Frey syndrome

fields.label: Reduced hepatic glyoxylate reductase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of glyoxylate reductase/hydroxypyruvate reductase (GRHPR; EC 1.1.1.79) in liver below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:12185464]
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced hepatic hydroxypyruvate reductase activity

fields.label: PAS-positive lymphocyte vacuolization
fields.definition: "Presence of lymphocytes with positive staining for periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) cytoplasmic vacuoles." [PMID:20107902]

fields.label: Lipid-laden bone-marrow macrophages
fields.definition: "Bone marrow with increased numbers of macrophages heavily laden with lipids." []

fields.label: Bone marrow monocytosis
fields.definition: "Increased count of monocytes in the bone marrow." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bone marrow monocytes increased

fields.label: Sunflower cataract
fields.definition: "Sunflower cataract (SC) is a type of anterior subcapsular cataract almost only seen in Wilson disease, an autosomal-recessive condition with a defect in the metabolism of copper leading to accumulation of copper in the liver and basal ganglia. SC consists of a thin, centralized opacification that is located directly under the anterior capsule and encompasses between one-third and one-half of the anterior lens pole surface area. In all cases, the central opacification is surrounded by additional, secondary opacifications arranged in ray-like structures around it. This pattern is said to resemble a sunflower, with a large central disk surrounded by petals." [PMID:25609909, PMID:26577266]

fields.label: Anti-lamin A antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against lamin A." [PMID:1959878, PMID:2271902]
fields.synonyms_concat: ki-67 antibody positivity; LMNA antibody positivity; PCNA antibody positivity; Prelamin A antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-lamin C antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against human lamin C." [PMID:1290474, PMID:1959878]
fields.synonyms_concat: Prelamin C antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-vinculin antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against vinculin." [PMID:33411141, PMID:35876914]

fields.label: Anti-annexin A5 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against annexin A5." [PMID:15652780, PMID:9067499]

fields.label: Bulging fontanelle
fields.definition: "An outward curving of a fontanelle, which occurs when fluid builds up in the brain or the brain swells, causing increased pressure inside the skull." [PMID:12825844]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tense fontanelle

fields.label: 3-4 toe cutaneous syndactyly
fields.definition: "A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 3 and 4." [PMID:25251565]

fields.label: Triangular nail
fields.definition: "Nail so wide as long with a distal part presenting an acute angle." [PMID:20579456, PMID:25251565, PMID:27660117]
fields.synonyms_concat: Triangular shaped nail

fields.label: Distal tibiofibular synostosis
fields.definition: "Fusion of the distal (i.e.., located away from the trunk) part of the tibia and fibula." [PMID:27326275, PMID:27577507]
fields.synonyms_concat: Distal tibial and fibular fusion

fields.label: Abnormal metacarpal ossification
fields.definition: "Any abnormal process of ossification of the metacarpal bones, which normally are each ossified from two centers: one for the body, and one for the head (metacarpal II,III,IV, and V) and one for the body and one for the base (metacarpal I). At the eighth to ninth week of fetal life, ossification commences in the middle of the body. At the third year the distal extremities of the metacarpals of the fingers and the base of the metacarpal of the thumb begin to ossify; they unite with the bodies at about the twentieth year." [PMID:12624140]
synonyms: Abnormal maturation of long bone of hand
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal maturation of long bone of hand; Abnormal ossification involving metacarpal bones

fields.label: Rib spur
fields.definition: "A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from a rib." [PMID:36388615]

fields.label: Crescent-shaped iliac bone
fields.definition: "Deficient mineralization of the iliac wings, giving a paraglider/crescent shape to the iliac bone." [PMID:28744080]
fields.synonyms_concat: Crescent-shaped iliac wing; Paraglider shape iliac bone

fields.label: Abnormal ischium ossification
fields.definition: "An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of ischial bones." [PMID:9933334]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal ossification of the ischium

fields.label: Femoral neck fracture
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the neck of femur." [PMID:30726032]
fields.synonyms_concat: Broken femoral neck; Fractured neck of femur

fields.label: Papillary dermis eosinophilic hyaline material
fields.definition: "Accumulation of eosinophilic hyaline material observed around the papillary dermis and the blood vessels located in it. The papillary dermis is the uppermost layer of the dermis. It intertwines with the rete ridges of the epidermis and is composed of fine and loosely arranged collagen fibers." [PMID:26803878]

fields.label: Pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
fields.definition: "Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm (IPMN) is an exocrine neoplasm of the pancreas consisting of epithelial cells growing within the pancreatic ducts (main pancreatic duct or its major branches) and producing mucin. IPMN is a mucin-producing pancreatic cystic tumor. IPMN contains epithelial cells that can create papillary projections." [PMID:35070031]

fields.label: Medium vessel vasculitis
fields.definition: "A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects medium-sized blood vessels. By common usage, vasculitis predominantly refers to arterial disease. Medium-sized vasculitis is observed in diseases including polyarteritis nodosa, Kawasaki disease, and cutaneous polyarteritis nodosa." [PMID:19946711]
fields.synonyms_concat: Medium-size-vessel vasculitis

fields.label: Elevated muscle fiber laminin alpha 5 expression
fields.definition: "A decreased amount of laminin alpha-5 in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue. Laminin subunit alpha-5 is a protein encoded by the LAMA5 gene." [PMID:21953594]
fields.label_normalized: elevated muscle fiber laminin alpha 5 expression

fields.label: Paravertebral mass
fields.definition: "A swelling or enlargement localized next to the vertebral column. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." [PMID:30517335]

fields.label: Phlebolith
fields.definition: "A calcified structure that forms within a vein. The pathogenesis of phleboliths is thought to involve an organized thrombus produced when the peripheral blood flow slows. The thrombus calcifies, form- ing the core of the phlebolith. Then, the fibrinous com- ponent undergoes secondary calcification and becomes attached. Repetition of this process causes enlargement of the phlebolith." [PMID:37981851]

fields.label: Bladder rupture
fields.definition: "A perforation in the wall of the urinary bladder. Bladder rupture, a relatively rare condition, is most commonly due to abdominal or pelvic trauma but may be spontaneous or iatrogenic in association with surgical or endoscopic procedures. In most cases, patients with bladder rupture have gross hematuria. Other symptoms of bladder rupture include pelvic pain, lower abdominal pain, and difficulty voiding." [PMID:29262195]

fields.label: Elevated myocardial iron load
fields.definition: "Increased amount of iron in myocardial tissue." [PMID:16888797, PMID:28458697]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cardiac iron overload; MRI: heart iron content increased

fields.label: Right ventricular regional wall motion abnormality
fields.definition: "The occurrence of abnormal or absent contractility of a region of the heart muscle of the right ventricule. Conventional assessment of RWMA is based on visual interpretation of endocardial excursion and myocardial thickening from the echocardiogram videos." [PMID:36700970]
fields.label_normalized: right ventricular regional wall motion abnormality

fields.label: Right ventricular regional akinesia
fields.definition: "A region of the right ventricle exhibits absent contraction (akinesia) compared to the rest of the ventricle." [PMID:20172912]

fields.label: Right ventricular regional dyskinesia
fields.definition: "A region of the right ventricle exhibits abnormal contraction (dyskinesia) compared to the rest of the ventricle, leading to outward bulging or ballooning during contraction or inadequate inward movement." [PMID:20172912]

fields.label: Right ventricular aneurysm
fields.definition: "A localized, abnormal dilation or bulging of a portion of the right ventricular wall." [PMID:34256889]
fields.synonyms_concat: Right ventricular outpouching

fields.label: Glomerular immune-complex deposition
fields.definition: "Accumulation of immune deposits, containing immunoglobulins, complement, and other proteins, at various intraglomerular locations. This can lead to glomerulonephritis, with the type of injury that results being dependent on four factors: the mechanism of the deposit formation, the site of deposit formation, the composition of the deposits and the amount of the deposits." [PMID:16189625]

fields.label: Glomerular PLA2R immune-complex deposition
fields.definition: "Accumulation of immune deposits, containing auto-antibodies against the podocyte antigen M-type phospholipase A2 receptor (PLA2R) in intraglomerular locations." [PMID:21323563, PMID:25997506]

fields.label: Elevated urinary L-glycerate level
fields.definition: "The amount of L-glycerate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:24116921]

fields.label: Breast myxoma
fields.definition: "A rare, benign mesenchymal tumor of the breast characterized histologically by stellate, round, and spindle-shaped cells with vesicular nuclei and scant cytoplasm that are scattered in the myxoid stroma." [PMID:17214801]

fields.label: Ovarian cystadenoma
fields.definition: "A common, benign ovarian tumor that carries a good prognosis. The two most frequent types of cystadenomas are serous and mucinous cystadenomas whereas endometrioid and clear cell cystadenomas are rare." [PMID:30725635]

fields.label: Abnormal CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urine 2-betanone level

fields.label: Decreased CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased CSF N-acetylaspartate acid concentration; N-acetylaspartate absent in CSF

fields.label: Elevated urinary mevalonate lactone level
fields.definition: "The amount of mevalonate lactone in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:29909962]

fields.label: Anti-von Willebrand factor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to von Willebrand factor (VWF)." [PMID:23297130]

fields.label: Increased total natural killer cell count
fields.definition: "The absolute count of natural killer cells in the blood, per microlitre, is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.label_normalized: increased total natural killer cell count
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated natural killer cell count

fields.label: Myositis-specific autoantibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that display a high degree of specificity for idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (myositis-specific autoantibodies (MSAs)). MSAs are clinically useful biomarkers to help the diagnosis of polymyositis/dermatomyositis (PM/DM). Many of these are also associated with a unique clinical subset of PM/DM, making them useful in predicting and monitoring certain clinical manifestations." [PMID:26424665]

fields.label: Abnormal serum osmolality
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal range of the serum osmolality, defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea." [PMID:35779183]

fields.label: Low serum osmolality
fields.definition: "Serum osmolality, which is defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea, is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:35779183]

fields.label: High serum osmolality
fields.definition: "Serum osmolality, which is defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:35779183]

fields.label: History of compressive dressings
fields.definition: "A past medical history of having been treated with tight bandages, compression sleeve, tight casts or splints, immobilizers, or similar items such as overly tight clothes, watch bands, or handcuffs." []

fields.label: Triggered by overhead motions
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is induced by repeatedly performing overhead motions, such as painting a ceiling or working on objects located above the head, or some types of athletics." [PMID:23040553]
fields.synonyms_concat: Triggered by overhead activity

fields.label: Radiating pain
fields.definition: "Pain that is perceived to extend or spread out from one area of the body to another." []

fields.label: Mitral opening snap
fields.definition: "Opening snap is an additional sound heard in the diastole that is related to the opening of a stenotic but mobile mitral valve. It is described as an early diastolic, high-pitched sound, which is associated with opening of the mitral and/or tricuspid valve." [PMID:17448551]

fields.label: Mucus in stool
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased amount of mucus in the feces. Mucus is a slippery aqueous secretion produced by mucous membranes including those of the intestines." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating CCL3 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of C-C Motif Ligand 3 (CCL3) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating CCL4 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of C-C Motif Ligand 4 (CCL4) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated CSF 14-3-3 protein concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of 14-3-3 protein in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:22993290]

fields.label: Elevated CSF dihydrobiopterin concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of dihydrobiopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Left atrial fibrosis
fields.definition: "Atrial fibrosis is an hallmark of atrial structural remodelling, characterized by the aberrant activation, proliferation and differentiation of fibroblasts, and subsequent excessive synthesis and irregular deposition of extracellular matrix proteins." [PMID:28882227, PMID:33448312]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating proANP concentration
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal concentration of proANP (atrial natriuretic peptide pro-hormone) in the blood circulation." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating NT-proANP concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of NT-proANP (= N-terminal proatrial natriuretic peptide) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced long-acting natriuretic peptide concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:9700195]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate concentration

fields.label: Reduced tissue delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase (P5CDH; EC 1.5.1.12) below the lower limit of normal. P5CDH can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. P5CDH is a mitochondrial matrix NAD(+)-dependent dehydrogenase which catalyzes the second step of the proline degradation pathway, converting pyrroline-5-carboxylate to glutamate." [PMID:2624476]

fields.label: Elevated circulating N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:15385443]

fields.label: Low tissue ferrochelatase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of Ferrochelatase (FECH; EC 4.99.1.1) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. FECH is the terminal enzyme of the heme biosynthetic pathway, and catalyzes the insertion of iron into protoporphyrin to form heme." [PMID:8571955]

fields.label: Elevated circulating heptacarboxylporphyrin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of heptacarboxylporphyrin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:11929047]

fields.label: Aggravated by menstruation
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is more severe during mensutruation." [PMID:30523495, PMID:32966006]

fields.label: Reduced breast milk zinc concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of zinc in breast milk is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:35230756]

fields.label: Elevated urinary bile acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of bile acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased urinary bile acid level

fields.label: Elevated urinary glyoxylic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of glyoxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. The conjugate base of glyoxylic acid is known as glyoxylate." [PMID:449695]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urinary alpha-ketoacetic acid level; Elevated urinary glyoxylate level; Elevated urinary oxoacetic acid level

fields.label: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:22084587]

fields.label: Elevated circulating CXCL9 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of chemokine (C-X-C motif) ligand 9 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:32060845]
synonyms: Elevated circulating monokine induced by gamma-interferon concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating monokine induced by gamma-interferon concentration

fields.label: Thickened fibular cortex
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase in the thickness (distance between the inner and outer boundaries) of the outer layer (cortex) of the fibula." [PMID:24389367]
fields.synonyms_concat: Broad cortex of fibula; Cortical thickening of the fibula; Thickened cortex of the fibula; Thickened cortices of fibula

fields.label: New medication added in recent weeks
fields.definition: "Medical history of starting a new medication recently." []
fields.label_normalized: new medication added in recent weeks

fields.label: Noctural pain
fields.definition: "Pain at night." [PMID:37214788]

fields.label: Femoral osteosclerosis
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase of bone mineral density of the femur. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity." [PMID:15326622]
fields.synonyms_concat: Osteosclerosis of the femur

fields.label: Absent Bell phenomenon
fields.definition: "The Bell phenomenon is the reflex upward movement of the front of the eyeball when the eyelids close (or blink). It protects the eye by helping to keep the cornea moist. This term refers to a lack of this phenomenon, which can be observed with certain conditions such as congenital fibrosis of the extraocular muscles." [PMID:16815872, PMID:36780505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Absent palpebral-oculogyric reflex

fields.label: Dalen-Fuchs nodules
fields.definition: "Nodules (yellow-white subretinal pigment epithelium lesions) that form between Bruch membrane and the retinal pigment epithelium." [PMID:35145783]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dalen Fuchs nodules

fields.label: Triggering by ocular trauma
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by trauma to the eye." [PMID:30081702, PMID:35647958]

fields.label: Gelatinous drop-like dystrophic cornea
fields.definition: "Deposition of amyloid material in the subepithelial space of the cornea." [PMID:23038033]

fields.label: Hepatic reticuloendothelial system cell iron deposition
fields.definition: "Abnormal accumulation of iron in reticuloendothelial cells of the liver. This feature can be appreciated on liver biopsy by Perls iron stain for granular iron deposition, based on agreement that only discernible hemosiderin granules represent significant iron deposition." [PMID:21274866]
fields.label_normalized: hepatic reticuloendothelial system cell iron deposition

fields.label: Reduced epidermal kindlin-1 expression
fields.definition: "Lower than normal amount of kindlin-1 in the epidermis." [PMID:14962093]

fields.label: Central giant cell lesion of the jaw
fields.definition: "A benign proliferative and asymptomatic intraosseous lesion of the jaw formed by fibrous tissue that contains multiple focus of hemorrhage and an aggregation of multinucleated giant cells." [PMID:20301316, PMID:28316283, PMID:29988246]
fields.label_normalized: central giant cell lesion of the jaw

fields.label: Terminal hepatic lobular vascular occlusion
fields.definition: "A type of Hepatic venous outflow obstruction characterized by fibrous concentric narrowing of zone 3 terminal hepatic venules, centrilobular hepatocyte necrosis, and sinusoidal congestion, accomapnied by necrosis of pericentral hepatocytes, and narrowing and eventual fibrosis of central veins." [PMID:17461490, PMID:20301448]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome; Hepatic veno-occlusive disease

fields.label: Axonal spheroids
fields.definition: "During neurodegeneration, bubble-like swellings form along the length of the axon, a primary and early effect of dynamic axonal deformation. These varicosities, spheroids, or swellings have been described as beads on a string and branches bearing fruit, and they frequently appear on degenerating axons." [PMID:20301718, PMID:34678457]

fields.label: Decreased liver bile salt export pump expression
fields.definition: "Amount of bile salt export pump (BSEP, coded by the ABCB11 gene) in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:20800306, PMID:22795478]
fields.label_normalized: decreased liver bile salt export pump expression

fields.label: Reduced tissue type II iodothyronine deiodinase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of type II iodothyronine deiodinase below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in tissues such as cultured fibroblasts." []
fields.label_normalized: reduced tissue type ii iodothyronine deiodinase activity

fields.label: Reduced tissue fatty aldehyde dehydrogenase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of fatty aldehyde dehydrogenase (EC 1.2.1.3) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts and leukocytes." [PMID:1939650]
fields.label_normalized: reduced tissue fatty aldehyde dehydrogenase activity

fields.label: Decreased circulating pancreatic isoamylase activity
fields.definition: "The activity of alpha-Amylase (1,4-alpha-D-glucan-4-glucanohydrolase E. C. 3.2.1.1, pancreatic isoamylase) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:30675141]

fields.label: Reduced tissue guanidinoacetate methyltransferase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of the mitochondrial enzyme guanidinoacetate methyltransferase in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts." [PMID:15651030]

fields.label: Reduced erythrocyte galactokinase activity
fields.definition: "Activity or concentration of in the level of galactokinase (EC 2.7.1.6) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:7670469]

fields.label: Auspitz sign
fields.definition: "The appearance of small bleeding points after successive layers of scale have been removed from the surface of psoriatic papules or plaques." [PMID:2370333]

fields.label: Salty tasting skin
fields.definition: "Skin tastes marked salty without an obvious explanation such as heat or exercise. This finding can be observed in infants with cystic fibrosis." [PMID:25640976]

fields.label: Scalp nodule
fields.definition: "A small firm lump located in the skin of the scalp that is greater than one cm in diameter." [PMID:29494084, PMID:30607043]
fields.synonyms_concat: Scalp nodules

fields.label: History of undercooked pork ingestion
fields.definition: "A history of ingestion of undercooked pork. This is particularly relevant in areas with a high prevalence of cysticercosis." [PMID:23265549]

fields.label: History of recent rodent exposure
fields.definition: "A history of exposed to rodents (mice, rats, prarie dogs) within several weeks of the current presenting complaint." []

fields.label: Positive CSF fungus test
fields.definition: "Any kind of test for a fungal infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) positive." []

fields.label: Positive CSF human T-lymphotropic virus type I antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of human T-lymphotropic virus type I." []
fields.label_normalized: positive csf human t-lymphotropic virus type i antibody positivity
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive CSF HTLV-1 antibody positivity

fields.label: Positive chlamydia trachomatis urine nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of Chlamydia trachomatis nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction." []
fields.label_normalized: positive chlamydia trachomatis urine nucleic acid test

fields.label: Anti-streptococcus deoxyribonuclease-B antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against streptococcal deoxyribonuclease-B (ADN-B). Almost all group A streptococci have this antigen and a strong elevation of the antibody is observed in patients with acute rheumatic fever, acute glomerulonephritis and other streptococcal infections." [PMID:6752453]

fields.label: Positive streptococcus A rapid antigen detection test
fields.definition: "Positive detection of a group A streptococcal antigen in a test perforned on a throat swab." [PMID:36941540]
fields.label_normalized: positive streptococcus a rapid antigen detection test

fields.label: Positive synovial mycobacterial culture
fields.definition: "Growth of a mycobacteria in a culture derived from synovial fluid." []

fields.label: Positive mycobacterial synovial nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of mycobacteria in the synovial fluid by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." []
fields.label_normalized: positive mycobacterial synovial nucleic acid test

fields.label: Positive bloodstream babesia nucleic acid pathogen test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of genus Babesia (parasite) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." []
fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream babesia nucleic acid pathogen test

fields.label: Positive bloodstream influenza nucleic test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of an influenza virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." []

fields.label: Positive bloodstream parainfluenza virus nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of parainfluenza virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." []
fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream parainfluenza virus nucleic acid test

fields.label: Positive bloodstream adenovirus nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of an adenovirus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." []
fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream adenovirus nucleic acid test

fields.label: Anti-Francisella tularensis antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Francisella tularensis." []

fields.label: Positive bloodstream MERS coronavirus nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of Middle East Respiratory Syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." []
fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream mers coronavirus nucleic acid test

fields.label: Positive nasopharyngeal corynebacterium diphtheriae nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of Corynebacterium diphtheriae in nasopharyngeal secretions by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." []
fields.label_normalized: positive nasopharyngeal corynebacterium diphtheriae nucleic acid test

fields.label: Pediculosis capitis

fields.label: Premature glabellar skin wrinkling

fields.label: Flexural reticulate hyperpigmentation

fields.label: Elevated fractional excretion of urate

fields.label: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid level

fields.label: Decreased CSF N-acetyl-aspartyl-glutamate concentration

fields.label: Abnormal peripapillary microvascular network
fields.definition: "The density of the deep peripapillary microvascular network (i.e., the number of blood vessels) is below the lower limit of normal. This finding is observable by optical coherence tomography angiography." []

fields.label: Auriculitis

fields.label: Recent history of moisture in external ear canal

fields.label: Osteoporotic femoral neck
fields.definition: "Low bone mass localized in the neck of the femur. Osteoporosis is defined based on a T-score of -2.5 or lower (bone mineral density of 2.5 or more standard deviations below that of a normal young adult)." [PMID:35378630]

fields.label: Olanzapine exposure

fields.label: Reduced tissue phosphomannomutase activity

fields.label: Reduced tissue phosphomannose isomerase activity

fields.label: Reduced tissue palmitoyl-protein thioesterase activity

fields.label: Maternal household cat exposure
fields.definition: "The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of regular exposure to one or more cats, e.g., in the household." []

fields.label: Protein craving
fields.definition: "Unusually strong preference for protein-rich foods." [PMID:20301360]

fields.label: Absent superficial temporal artery pulse
fields.definition: "The pulsation of the superficial temporal artery cannot be detected on physical examination." []

fields.label: Basilar artery fenestration
fields.definition: "A fenestration affecting the basilar artery. Basilar fenestration typically occurs at the lower end of the basilar artery just as the vertebral arteries join Fenestrations of intracranial arteries are segmental duplications of the lumen into two distinct endothelium-lined channels, which may or may not share their adventitial layer. They can range from a small focus of divided tissue to long-segment duplication. Fenestrations are the result of partial failure of fusion of paired primitive embryologic vessels or incomplete obliteration of different anastomosis in a primitive vascular network. The association of fenestrations with aneurysms has been suggested in many small case series, though the exact relationship is not well defined." [PMID:23250566]
fields.synonyms_concat: Basilar fenestration

fields.label: Displacement of the extensor tendon in metacarpophalangeal joint
fields.definition: "Dislocation of the extensor tendons from their central position on the metacarpal heads can be traumatic, congenital, spontaneous, or degenerative." [PMID:37425263]
fields.label_normalized: displacement of the extensor tendon in metacarpophalangeal joint

fields.label: Heloma
fields.definition: "A corn, also known as a clavus, heloma, or focal intractable plantar hyperkeratosis, is a type of callosity. Corns are uncomfortable, thickened skin lesions that result from repeated mechanical trauma due to friction or pressure forces." [PMID:29262147]
fields.synonyms_concat: Clavus; Corn; Focal intractable plantar hyperkeratosis

fields.label: Exacerbated by pronation
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by (or made more painful by) pronation. Pronation of the hand involves the rotation of the forearm and wrist so that the palm of the hand faces downwards or towards the back (posteriorly)." []

fields.label: Distortion of the anterior part of the interhemispheric fissure
fields.definition: "Change in the normal shape (displacement, asymmetry) of the anterior part of the interhemispheric fissure. This finding can be identified prenatally by sonography or magnetic resonance imaging." [PMID:23640781, PMID:34984691]
fields.label_normalized: distortion of the anterior part of the interhemispheric fissure

fields.label: Positive lacrimal tract actinomyces culture

fields.label: Eschar

fields.synonyms_concat: Black eschar; Black spot; Tache noire

fields.label: History of wearing tightly fitted clothing
fields.definition: "History of wearing tight clothing such as compression shorts, sports bras, bike shorts, wet suits, spandex, veils, and tight hats." []
fields.label_normalized: history of wearing tightly fitted clothing

fields.label: Anti-folate receptor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the folate receptor in the blood circulation." [PMID:38068740]

fields.label: Positive bloodstream VDRL test
fields.definition: "An abnormal (positive) result of the Venereal Disease Research Laboratory (VDRL) test performed in peripheral blood, suggesting past or present syphilis." []
fields.synonyms_concat: VDRL positive in blood; VDRL reactive in blood circulation

fields.label: Positive bloodstream rapid plasma reagin test

fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream rapid plasma reagin test

fields.label: Positive bloodstream HIV p24 antigen test

fields.label: Tzanck smear with multinucleated giant cells
fields.definition: "Tzanck smear demonstrates multinucleated giant cells, a sign that is suggestive for herpetic infections. Such smears are taken from skin lesions and display multinucleated cells with ground glass nuclei, nuclear moulding, and margination of nuclear chromatin typical of herpes simplex and varicella infection." [PMID:29118470]
fields.label_normalized: tzanck smear with multinucleated giant cells

fields.label: Positive Mazzotti test

fields.label: Positive bloodstream Tropheryma whipplei nucleic acid test

fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream tropheryma whipplei nucleic acid test

fields.label: Elevated urinary 2,8-dihydroxyadenine level

fields.label: Elevated urinary phosphohydroxylysine level

fields.label: Cervical C6/C7 vertebrae fusion

[PMID:25206089]

fields.label: Thickened tibial cortex

fields.label: Thickened cortex of the ulna

fields.label: Elevated circulating aspartate aminotransferase to alanine aminotransferase ratio

fields.label: Temporomandibular joint dislocation

fields.synonyms_concat: Temporomandibular malocclusion

fields.label: Amyloid goiter

fields.synonyms_concat: Thyroid gland amyloidosis

fields.label: Transverse terminal limb defect

If the difference between the measured osmolality (MO) and calculated osmolality (CO) is known as the osmolar gap (OG) is large (greater than 15) osmolar gap can help identify the presence in plasma of substances such as ethanol, methanol, isopropanol, ethylene glycol, propylene glycol.." [PMID:36000112]

fields.label: Elevated circulating bile alcohol concentration

fields.label_normalized: reduced procollagen-lysine,2-oxoglutarate 5-dioxygenase 1 activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Diminished tissue fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase (FAH; EC 3.7.1.2) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts." []

fields.label: Reduced tissue peptidase D activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of Peptidase D (EC 3.4.13.9; also known as prolidase, imidodipeptidase, proline dipeptidase, and aminoacyl-L-proline hydrolase) below the lower limit of normal. fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced tissue prolidase activity

fields.label: Reduced tissue glycine cleavage enzyme activity

fields.label: Increased circulating dihydroxycholestanoic acid concentration

fields.label: Reduced tissue phosphorylase kinase activity

fields.label: Hyperkalemia while symptomatic

fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperkalemia during attack

fields.label: Elevated urinary gamma-glutamylcysteine level
fields.definition: "The amount of gamma-glutamylcysteine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:17397529]

fields.label: Positive CSF mycobacterial culture
fields.definition: "Growth of mycobacteria in a culture derived from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive CSF mycobacterium culture

fields.label: Positive respiratory tract nucleic acid pathogen test
fields.definition: "Positive (abnormal) result of a sputum or pharyngeal sample test such as polymerase chain reaction that is targeted against a nucleic acid sequence specific for a pathogen." []

fields.label: Positive respiratory tract SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus nucleic acid in the sputum or pharyngeal sample by a method such as polymerase chain reaction." []
fields.label_normalized: positive respiratory tract sars-cov-2 coronavirus nucleic acid test

fields.label: Positive fecal cryptosporidium antigen test

fields.synonyms_concat: Positive stool Cryptosporidium antigen test

fields.label: Horizontal position of testicle
fields.definition: "The Bell Clapper deformity is one of the causes for the testicular torsion. In this condition, testis lacks a normal attachment to tunica vaginalis and hangs freely, causing it to sit horizontally rather than vertically in the scrotum." [PMID:22606621]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bell-clapper deformity

fields.label: Localized soft-tissue swelling on extremity
fields.definition: "Abnormal enlargement (swelling) that is restricted to a specific part of a limb." []

fields.label: Abnormal scleral thickness
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal height of the sclera, the white part of the eye that forms the tough, fibrous outer layer of the exterior of the eyeball." []

fields.label: Multiple eyelid beaded papules
fields.definition: "Multiple beaded papules along the eyelid margins and inner canthus." [PMID:26655007]
fields.synonyms_concat: Moniliform blepharosis

fields.label: Nonexudative conjunctivitis
fields.definition: "A type of conjunctivitis that is not characterized by appreciable exudate, i.e., fluid, cells, or other substances that have escaped from blood vessels and have been deposited around the eyelids." []

fields.label: Nematode in retina

fields.label: Vascular compression of the eighth cranial nerve

[PMID:9452229]

fields.label_normalized: vascular compression of the eighth cranial nerve
fields.synonyms_concat: Neurovascular compression syndrome of the vestibulocochlear nerve; Vestibulocochlear nerve compression syndrome

fields.label: Beaded bile ducts
fields.definition: "Multifocal intra- and extra-hepatic bile duct strictures alternating with normal caliber or slightly dilated segments, resembling beads on a string." [PMID:30600377]

fields.label: Cardiac mass
fields.definition: "An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized in the heart. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." []

fields.label: Superior olive hypertrophy
fields.definition: "Abnormal increase in size of the superior olive, also known as the superior olivary complex. The superior olive is a collection of brainstem nuclei that is located in pons, functions in multiple aspects of hearing and is an important component of the ascending and descending auditory pathways of the auditory system." []

fields.label: Spinal extradural arachnoid cyst
fields.definition: "Spinal extradural arachnoid cyst is a cyst in the spinal canal that protrudes into the epidural space from a defect in the dura mater." [PMID:24278289]
fields.synonyms_concat: SEDAC

fields.label: Temporal cortex localization
fields.definition: "Localization to or predominance in the temporal cortex of the brain." []

fields.label: Basilar meningeal enhancement
fields.definition: "Abnormal enhancement of CT or MIR contrast medium in the basilar meninges, that is, those located in the basal cisterns or spaces at the base of the brain, due to increased permeability of blood vessels in these areas." []

fields.label: Megacolon
fields.definition: "Persistent and substantial increase in diameter diameter and length of the colon." []

fields.label: Thyroid cyst
fields.definition: "A fluid-filled sac or cavity that develops due to fluid accumulation within the thyroid tissue." []

fields.label: Decreased circulating sulfate concentration

fields.label: Cold intolerance

fields.synonyms_concat: Cold sensitivity

fields.label: Head and neck distribution

fields.label: Symmetric distribution
