fields.label: Muscle extensor surface location
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in extensor surface of an extremity." []

fields.label: Dermal foam cells
fields.definition: "Presence of lipid-laden macrophages (foam cells) in the inner layer of the skin (dermis)." [PMID:37333211]

fields.label: Diminished tissue very long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
fields.definition: "Diminished activity of Very long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), an enzyme that catalyzes the initial step of mitochondrial beta-oxidation of long-chain fatty acids with a chain length of 14 to 20 carbons. VLCAD activity can be measured with biochemical testing using cultured fibroblasts or lymphocytes." [PMID:20301763]
fields.label_normalized: diminished tissue very long-chain acyl-coa dehydrogenase activity

fields.label: Diminished tissue glycogen branching enzyme activity
fields.definition: "Activity of glycogen branching enzyme in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts." [PMID:26199317]
fields.label_normalized: diminished tissue glycogen branching enzyme activity

fields.label: Parotid adenoma
fields.definition: "A benign tumor of the parotid salivary gland." [PMID:26124628]

fields.label: Elevated serum-ascites albumin gradient (SAAG)
fields.definition: "An elevation of the serum ascites albumin gradient (SAAG), which is based on the difference between the albumin level of serum and of ascitic fluid, may be used to assess the extent of ascites. The SAAG is thought to reflect the colloid osmotic pressure gradient and the degree of portal hypertension. It has been shown that SAAG is a better discriminator of portal hypertension than ascites. A SAAG of 1.1 gm/dL or higher is considered as high, indicating the presence of portal hypertension, while SAAG less than 1.1 gm/dL is low, indicating the absence of portal hypertension." [PMID:29201716]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormally high serum-ascites albumin gradient (SAAG)

fields.label: Transverse smile
fields.definition: "Inability to raise the corners of the mouth during the act of smiling due to facial muscle weakness. The act of smiling is accompanied by a horizontal movement of the mouth." [PMID:25037087]

fields.label: Hyperphalangy of the 4th finger
fields.definition: "An accessory phalanx of the fourth (ring) finger that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges. Hyperphalangy results from an accessory ossification center at the metacarpophalangeal joint." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hyperphalangy of fourth finger

fields.label: Delayed distal femoral epiphyseal ossification
fields.definition: "Developmental delay of ossification of the distal epiphysis of the femur." []

fields.label: Delayed tibial epiphyseal ossification
fields.definition: "Developmental delay of ossification of an epiphysis of the tibia." [PMID:24144387, PMID:9559711]

fields.label: Toe hyperphalangy
fields.definition: "Hyperphalangy is a digit morphology in which increased numbers of phalanges are arranged linearly within a toe. That is, there is an accessory phalanx that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges." [PMID:15032905]

fields.label: Sclerotic ilium
fields.definition: "An elevation in bone density in the ilium. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity." [PMID:22084176]
synonyms: Increased bone density of the ilium
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased bone density of the ilium; Sclerosis of iliac bone

fields.label: Metaphyseal chevron deformity
fields.definition: "The chevron sign refers to an inverted V-shape metaphyses. It is most commonly seen in the distal femur and tends to disappear with age." [PMID:25349664, PMID:25808063]

fields.label: Popcorn calcification
fields.definition: "Popcorn calcifications are areas of amorphous calcifications often with rings and arcs that resemble popped corn kernels in the metaphysis and epiphysis around the growth plate." [PMID:12432108]

fields.label: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the calvaria
fields.definition: "A developmental defect characterized by absence or underdevelopment of the calvaria." []

fields.label: Bowdler spurs
fields.definition: "Transverse long bone midshaft spurs or osteochondral projections typically occuring in the fibulae and less commonly in the forearms." [PMID:15782022]

fields.label: Delayed ossification of the clavicle
fields.definition: "Delayed maturation and calcification of the clavicle." []

fields.label: Wide sacroiliac joint
fields.definition: "Distance between the sacrum and the ilium bones of the pelvis at the sacroiliac joint is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Anti-Glutamate Receptor delta2 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against glutamate receptor delta2." [PMID:17049194, PMID:36696031]

fields.label: Anti-dachshund family transcription factor 1 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against dachshund-homolog 1 (DACH1) autoantigen." [PMID:35150165]
fields.label_normalized: anti-dachshund family transcription factor 1 antibody positivity
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-neuronal nuclear antibody-type 3 positivity

fields.label: Anti-potassium channel tetramerization domain containing 16 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against potassium channel tetramerization domain containing 16 (KCTD16)." [PMID:31009048]
fields.label_normalized: anti-potassium channel tetramerization domain containing 16 antibody positivity
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-KCTD16

fields.label: Anti-regulator of G protein signaling 8 antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against regulator of G-protein signaling 8 (RGS8)." [PMID:33782191]
fields.label_normalized: anti-regulator of g protein signaling 8 antibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-neurochondrin antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against neurochondrin ." [PMID:36437687]

fields.label: Anti-DCC netrin 1 receptor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against Netrin-1 receptors DCC (deleted in colorectal carcinoma)." [PMID:28251919]

fields.label: Anti-recoverin antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against recoverin. Recoverins are calcium-binding proteins primarily expressed in retinal rod photoreceptors and primarily involved in phototransduction." [PMID:38054667]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-retinal CAR antigen antibody

fields.label: Recent history of sedation by propofol infusion
fields.definition: "A history of exposure to anesthesia by propofanol infusion recently before the presenting complaint." [PMID:17567345]
fields.label_normalized: recent history of sedation by propofol infusion

fields.label: Enlarged humeral head
fields.definition: "Size (volume) of the head of the humerus above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Enlarged radial head
fields.definition: "Size (volume) of the head of the radius above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:12624140]

fields.label: Enlarged distal tibial epiphysis
fields.definition: "Size (volume) of the distal epiphysis of the tiba above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:12624140]
fields.synonyms_concat: Large distal tibial epiphysis

fields.label: Elevated blood bismuth concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of bismuth in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood bismuth concentrations that implies possible injurious effects." []

fields.label: Elevated urine bismuth level
fields.definition: "Detection of a level of bismuth in the urine high enough to raise the suspicion of bismuth toxicity, usually greater than 20microgram per deciliter." []

fields.label: Distal radioulnar joint dislocation
fields.definition: "Distal radioulnar joint dislocation is more commonly displaced dorsally (i.e. the distal ulna is dorsally dislocated with respect to the distal radius), but can be volarly displaced." [PMID:23162140]

fields.label: Proximal radioulnar joint dislocation
fields.definition: "he proximal radioulnar translocation means that both the radius and ulna are dislocated from the humerus." [PMID:20660242]

fields.label: Absent toe phalanx flexion crease
fields.definition: "Absence of one or more interphalangeal creases of a toe (i.e., of the transverse lines in the skin between the phalanges of the toes)." []

fields.label: White matter globoid cells
fields.definition: "Multinucleated phagocytes in the cerebral white matter, typically are 10-15 micrometers in diameter, that contain fatty filamentous inclusions that stain positive for periodic acid-Schiff (PAS), which may be phagocytized myelin, as these cells are often found in proximity to sites where demyelination is prominent. Globoid cells have been to thought to originate from CNS resident microglia and/or infiltrating peripheral macrophages." [PMID:27638591]

fields.label: Gaucher cells
fields.definition: "Glucosylceramide forms fibrillar aggregates that accumulate in macrophages and result in the cell cytoplasm presenting a characteristic crumpled tissue paper appearance. These cells, known as Gaucher cells, infiltrate various organs (e.g., bone marrow, spleen, and liver) and are responsible for the major signs of Gaucher disease." [PMID:28218669]

fields.label: Breast adenoma
fields.definition: "A benign, well circumscribed neoplasm that arises from the breast." []

fields.label: Breast apocrine adenoma
fields.definition: "A type of breast adenoma composed of benign apocrine cells." [PMID:18491794]
fields.synonyms_concat: Apocrine adenoma of the breast

fields.label: Fibrocystic breast lesion
fields.definition: "A type of benign cyst or cysts in breast tissue that are typically mobile within the glandular breast tissue, chest wall, and skin and are rubber-like in texture. The main histological features are an extracellular matrix of collagen, peri canalicular patterns of stromal cells with the presence of florid epithelial hyperplasia." [PMID:31869073]

fields.label: Pancreatic VIPoma
fields.definition: "A type of neuroendocrine tumor that originates in the pancreas and secretes excessive amounts of vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP)." [PMID:25905195]
synonyms: Vasoactive intestinal peptide-secreting tumor of the pancreas
fields.synonyms_concat: Vasoactive intestinal peptide-secreting tumor of the pancreas

fields.label: Gastric carcinoid tumor
fields.definition: "Originating from enterochromaffin-like cells, gastric carcinoid tumors are rare tumors that develop within the gastric mucosa. They can present as an isolated lesion or there can be multiple lesions. The tumor can invade locally into deeper structures of the gastrointestinal tract wall. Solitary gastric carcinoids have a greater chance for the development of malignancy and metastasis as compared to multiple gastric carcinoids due to hypergastrinemia." [PMID:21603501]

fields.label: Positive skin scabies test
fields.definition: "Identification of scabies by means of an examination of the skin such as microscopic identification of scabies mites, eggs, or feces from obtained scales by skin scraping." [PMID:37233429]

fields.label: Positive mumps virus PCR test in the blood circulation
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of the mumps virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR." []
fields.label_normalized: positive mumps virus pcr test in the blood circulation

fields.label: Positive bloodstream tuberculosis-induced T-cell-based interferon-gamma release assay
fields.definition: "Detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in the bloodstream by means of detection of interferon-gamma secreted by T cells in response to specific antigens from Mycobacterium tuberculosis, commonly 6kD early secretory antigenic target-6 and 10kD culture filtrate protein-10." [PMID:28798488]
synonyms: Positive T-SPOT-tuberculosis test in the bloodstream
fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream tuberculosis-induced t-cell-based interferon-gamma release assay
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive T-SPOT-tuberculosis test in the bloodstream

fields.label: Positive blood Neisseria gonorrhoeae culture
fields.definition: "Growth of Neisseria gonorrhoeae in a culture derived from circulating blood." []

fields.label: Anti-mumps antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Mumps virus." []

fields.label: Positive Vibrio cholerae stool culture
fields.definition: "Growth of Vibrio cholerae in a culture derived from a feces sample." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive Vibrio cholerae fecal culture

fields.label: Positive cutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of mucocutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid in the skin by a method such as polymerase chain reaction. The sample is usually obtained by swab from skin or mucous membranes." []
fields.label_normalized: positive cutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid test

fields.label: Positive bloodstream cryptococcus culture
fields.definition: "Growth of Cryptococcus in a culture derived from a blood sample." []

fields.label: Positive bloodstream Borrelia miyamotoi nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of Borrelia miyamotoi in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." [PMID:29664394]
fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream borrelia miyamotoi nucleic acid test

fields.label: Positive bloodstream Coxsackievirus nucleic acid pathogen test
fields.definition: "Detection of nucleic acid of Coxsackievirus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR)." []
fields.label_normalized: positive bloodstream coxsackievirus nucleic acid pathogen test

fields.label: Diminished tissue alpha-L-iduronidase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of alpha-L-iduronidase (IDUA; EC 3.2.1.76) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts and leukocytes." [PMID:818611]

fields.label: Reduced tissue neuraminidase activity
fields.definition: "Activity of neuraminidase (EC 3.2.1.18)in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts. Neuraminidase is also known as lysosomal sialidase." [PMID:610423]

fields.label: Nummular keratitis
fields.definition: "Nummular keratitis consists of multiple scattered small round anterior corneal superficial stromal infiltrates." [PMID:34816054]

fields.label: Swelling of inguinal region
fields.definition: "Bulging in the area of the lower abdomen, just above the thigh and near the groin." []

fields.label: Single lesion
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are solitary and localized to a part of the skin, a tissue or an organ that differs from the surrounding healthy tissue." []

fields.label: Dysorthography
fields.definition: "A specific disorder of spelling. A score on a standardized spelling test is at least two standard errors of prediction below the level expected on the basis of the child's chronological age and general intelligence in the context of scores on reading accuracy and comprehension and on arithmetic that are within the normal range (within two standard deviations from the mean)." [PMID:21348173]

fields.label: Echogenic fetal colon
fields.definition: "A type of echogenic fetal bowel in which the hyperechogenicity is strictly limited to the colon." [PMID:17202504]

fields.label: Bone marrow edema
fields.definition: "Accumulation of excess fluid in the bone marrow." [PMID:35522786]

fields.label: Transverse terminal upper limb defect
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the arm, e.g. humerus, proximal forearm, wrist or finger. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment." [PMID:34263545]
fields.synonyms_concat: Transverse terminal upper limb reduction

fields.label: Trousseau sign
fields.definition: "After inflating a blood pressure cuff from 10 mm Hg to 20 mm Hg over the patient's systolic blood pressure, the Trousseau sign is considered positive if carpal spasm develops, with flexion of the thumb and adduction of the finger within 3 minutes. However, this can be painful, so the time should be noted, and the cuff should be deflated once the test is positive." [PMID:28722928]
fields.synonyms_concat: Carpal spasm

fields.label: Craniocervical junction constriction
fields.definition: "Congenital or acquired abnormalities of the occipital bone, foramen magnum, or first two cervical vertebrae that decrease the space for the lower brain stem and cervical cord. These malformations can lead to cranial nerve compression, vertebral artery compression, and obstructive hydrocephalus." [PMID:1566672]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tight craniocervical junction; Tight craniovertebral junction

fields.label: Fibular torsion
fields.definition: "Excessively rotated (also called torsion) position of the fibula (calf bone). An increased external rotation of the fibula in the incisura tibiofibularis of more than 5 degrees may lead to an increased pressure and will negatively affect the cartilage." [PMID:24796832, PMID:9409794]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fibular rotation

fields.label: Abnormal finger phalanx ossification
fields.definition: "Any abnormal process of ossification of the phalangeal bones, which normally are ossified from the body and proximal extremity. Ossification of the body commences during the eighth week of fetal development. Ossification of the proximal extremity commences in the bones between the third and fourth years." []

fields.label: Positive bloodstream EBV monospot test
fields.definition: "The monospot test is a latex agglutination test which utilizes equine erythrocytes as the primary substrate and tests for specific heterophile antibodies produced by the human immune system in response to EBV infection. When these specific antibodies are present in the patient's blood specimen, exposure to equine erythrocytes will lead to clumping of the sample, thus signaling a positive agglutination reaction." [PMID:30969561]

fields.label: Positive CSF Toxoplasma gondii antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of Toxoplasma gondii." []
fields.label_normalized: positive csf toxoplasma gondii antibody positivity

fields.label: Positive tuberculin skin test
fields.definition: "A positive result of the tuberculin skin test suggesting previous expouse or infection with mycobacterium teberculosis. A standard dose of five tuberculin units (TU) (0.1ml) is injected intradermally (into the skin) and read 48 to 72 h later. A person who has been exposed to the bacteria is expected to mount an immune response in the skin containing the bacterial proteins. The volar aspect of the forearm is the preferred site of test. The basis of reading is the presence or absence of induration, which may be determined by inspection (from a side view against the light as well as by direct light) and by palpation. For standardization, the diameter of induration should be measured transversely to the long axis of the forearm and recorded in millimeters." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive Mantoux tuberculosis test; Tuberculosis skin test positive

fields.label: Anti-Treponema pallidum antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Treponema pallidum." []
synonyms: Positive Fluorescent treponemal antibody absorption test
Treponemal antibody titer high in blood
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive Fluorescent treponemal antibody absorption test; Positive Treponema pallidum hemoagglutination assay; Treponemal antibody titer high in blood

fields.label: Positive CSF Borrelia burgdorferi antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of Borrelia burgdorferi." []
fields.label_normalized: positive csf borrelia burgdorferi antibody positivity

fields.label: Positive CSF JC-virus antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of JC-virus (also known as JC-polyomavirus and John Cunningham virus)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive CSF JC-polyomavirus antibody positivity

fields.label: Neutralizing anti-rabies virus antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that act against the rabies virus function by blocking the binding of the glycoprotein to a receptor or preventing the membrane fusion process." [PMID:38075404]

fields.label: Impaired hepatobiliary scintigraphy tracer uptake
fields.definition: "An abnormal reduction in the amount of radioactive tracer uptake upon hepatobiliary scintigraphy." [PMID:15347715]

fields.label: Calcified pulmonary nodule
fields.definition: "A pulmonary nodule with calcium deposits. On radiography, these nodules appear dense." [PMID:20582171]

fields.label: Postprandial exacerbation
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is more severe following a meal." []

fields.label: Koebner Phenomenon
fields.definition: "The appearance of new skin lesions on previously unaffected skin secondary to trauma. This phenomenon is also termed the isomorphic (from Greek, equal shape) response, given the fact that the new lesions that appear are clinically and histologically identical to the patient's underlying cutaneous disease." [PMID:31971748]

fields.label: Glenoid dysplasia
fields.definition: "Glenoid dysplasia is a developmental anomaly of the scapula that is characterized by a bony deficiency of the posteroinferior glenoid and the adjacent scapular neck." [PMID:27055054]
fields.synonyms_concat: Glenohumeral dysplasia

fields.label: Prolonged retraction of penile foreskin
fields.definition: "A past medical history of recently having retracted the penile foreskin for a prolonged period of time. Paraphimosis commonly occurs iatrogenically, when the foreskin is retracted for cleaning, placement of a urinary catheter, a procedure such as a cystoscopy, or for penile examination. Failure to return the retracted foreskin over the glans promptly after the initial retraction can lead to paraphimosis." [PMID:29083645]

fields.label: Thickened cortex of the clavicle
fields.definition: "Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the clavicle." [PMID:24389367, PMID:24390061]
fields.synonyms_concat: Broad cortex of clavicle; Cortical thickening of the clavicle; Thickened cortices of clavicle

fields.label: Thickened cortex of the mandible
fields.definition: "Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the mandible." [PMID:24389367, PMID:24390061]
fields.synonyms_concat: Broad cortex of mandible; Cortical thickening of the mandible; Thickened cortices of mandible

fields.label: Thumb hypoplasia grade 1
fields.definition: "Minor hypoplasia (developmental undergrowth) of the thumb, whereby all musculoskeletal and neurovascular components of the digit are present, just small in size (Blauth classification)." [PMID:24362256]

fields.label: Thumb hypoplasia grade 2
fields.definition: "A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby all of the osseous structures are present (may be small), and there is metacarpophalangeal joint ulnar collateral ligament instability and thenar hypoplasia." [PMID:24362256]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade 2

fields.label: Thumb hypoplasia grade 3A
fields.definition: "A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby there are musculotendinous and osseous deficiencies with the carpometacarpal (CMC) joint intact. Absence of active motion at the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) or interphalangeal (IP) joint." [PMID:24362256]
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IIIA
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IIIA

fields.label: Thumb hypoplasia grade 3B
fields.definition: "A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby there are musculotendinous and osseous deficiencies characterized by basal metacarpal aplasia with deficient carpometacarpal (CMC) joint, and absence of metacarpophalangeal (MCP) or interphalangeal (IP) joint." [PMID:24362256]
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IIIB
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IIIB

fields.label: Thumb hypoplasia grade 4
fields.definition: "A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb characterized by attachment to the hand only by the skin and digital neurovascular structures." [PMID:24362256]
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IV
fields.synonyms_concat: Floating thumb; Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IV

fields.label: Femoral osteopoikilosis
fields.definition: "Multiple multiple, small, well-defined radiodense foci of cortical-like bone in the medullary space parallel to the trabeculae located in the femur. The loci correspond to condensations of the lamellar trabeculae on histology." [PMID:30430046]
fields.synonyms_concat: Femoral slcerotic foci; Sclerotic foci of the femur

fields.label: Carotidynia
fields.definition: "Pain or tenderness in the region of the carotid artery." [PMID:32809676, PMID:38522944]

fields.label: Asymmetric blood pressure between arms
fields.definition: "A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left arms." [PMID:36351705, PMID:37525862]

fields.label: Transverse terminal lower limb defect
fields.definition: "A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the leg, e.g. femur, foreleg, ankle or toe. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment." [PMID:34263545]

fields.label: Hemimelia of lower leg
fields.definition: "A developmental defect leading to a transverse deficiency with absence of the lower leg (eg tibia and fibula), ankle and foot." [PMID:26172360]

fields.label: Hemimelia of forearm
fields.definition: "A developmental defect leading to a transverse deficiency with absence of the forearm (eg ulna and radius), wrist and hand." [PMID:32954639]

fields.label: Sodium glucose transport inhibitor exposure
fields.definition: "History of having been treateed with a sodium glucose transport inhibitors such as dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, canagliflozin, sglt-i, SGLT2, bexagliflozin, ertugliflozin, sotagliflozin, jardiance, invokana, forxiga, brenzavvy, steglatro, inpefa." []
fields.synonyms_concat: SGLT2i exposure

fields.label: Breath-holding spell
fields.definition: "A benign paroxysmal nonepileptic disorder occurring in healthy children 6 to 48 months of age. The episodes start with a provocation such as emotional upset or minor injury, and might progress to breath holding, cyanosis, and syncope." [PMID:1736640]

fields.label: Flared proximal tibial metaphysis
fields.definition: "The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of the proximal tibia." []

fields.label: Delayed toe phalanx ossification
fields.definition: "Delayed maturation and calcification of any of the toe phalanges." [PMID:23401428, PMID:33364240]

fields.label: Sorbitol ingestion
fields.definition: "A history of ingestion of a relatively high amount of foods containing sorbitol." []

fields.label: Positive peritoneal fluid bacterial culture
fields.definition: "Growth of bacteria in a culture dervied from ascites fluid." []

fields.label: Ocular cystine crystal deposition
fields.definition: "Accumulation of cystine crsytals in the eye. Patients present with crystal accumulation affecting the cornea and conjunctiva, but crystals can also be deposited in the iris, ciliary body, choroid and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE), and lens capsule. Corneal crystal deposition starts in infancy in the anterior periphery of the cornea, and progresses centrally and posteriorly. The crystals, which have a fine, uniform needle-shaped structure, are diffusely distributed within the corneal tissues." [PMID:30242621]

fields.label: Exuberant granulation tissue
fields.definition: "A manifestation of abnormal wound healing in which there is formation of excessive granulation tissue, with the granulation tissue rising above the level of surrounding skin and creating a raised, reddish, moist, and bumpy surface." [PMID:28492007]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hypergranulating wound; Overgranulation

fields.label: Oral mucosal papule
fields.definition: "A small (less than 5 mm in diameter), elevated, circumscribed, solid, palpable mass located in thte mucosa of the oral cavity." []

fields.label: Excessive piloerection
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased degree of goose bump formation, that is, of involuntary formation of bumps on a person's skin at the base of body hairs." [PMID:30252268]
fields.synonyms_concat: Excessive cutis anserina; Excessive goose bumps

fields.label: Scalp edema
fields.definition: "A palpable swelling in the scalp caused by an increase in interstitial fluid volume (excess fluid)." []

fields.label: Serpiginous burrow
fields.definition: "A slightly raised and often reddish serpentine or curvilinear path in the skin." [PMID:34615594]

fields.label: Positive brain-tissue rabies nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of rabies nucleic acid in brain tissue by a method such as polymerase chain reaction." []
fields.label_normalized: positive brain-tissue rabies nucleic acid test

fields.label: Positive respiratory tract Bordetella pertussis nucleic acid test
fields.definition: "Detection of Bordetella pertussis PCR nucleic acid in in nasopharyngeal secretions by a method such as polymerase chain reaction." []
fields.label_normalized: positive respiratory tract bordetella pertussis nucleic acid test

fields.label: Demonstration of acid-fast bacilli in wound tissue
fields.definition: "Demonstration of acid-fast bacilli by microscopic examination of wound tissue. Acid fastness is a physical property that gives a bacterium the ability to resist decolorization by acids during staining procedures." [PMID:30725806]
fields.label_normalized: demonstration of acid-fast bacilli in wound tissue

fields.label: Positive tissue encapsulated budding yeast test
fields.definition: "Identification of encapsulated budding yeasts in smears of body fluids, secretions, exudates, or other specimens." []
fields.label_normalized: positive tissue encapsulated budding yeast test

fields.label: Positive tissue coccidioidomycosis culture
fields.definition: "Growth of coccidioidomycosis in a culture derived from skin or an organ." []

fields.label: Diminished tissue dihydropteridine reductase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of dihydropteridine reductase (EC 1.6.99.7) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and erythrocytes." [PMID:7627180]

fields.label: Decreased circulating transcobalamin I concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of transcobalamin I in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal." []
synonyms: Decreased circulating R vitamin B12 binder protein concentration
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased circulating cobalophilin concentration; Decreased circulating haptocorrin concentration; Decreased circulating R vitamin B12 binder protein concentration

fields.label: Diminished circulating cationic trypsinogen concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of cationic trypsinogen in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:3792918]

fields.label: Diminished circulating hyaluronidase activity
fields.definition: "The activity or concentration of hyaluronidase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:8793927]

fields.label: Diminished sulfotransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Rate of proteoglycan sulfation (sulfotransferase activity) is below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts." [PMID:18513679]
fields.label_normalized: diminished sulfotransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Elevated tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) above the upper limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase." [PMID:30046013]

fields.label: Abnormal tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) outside of the limits of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase." []

fields.label: Elevated circulating trihydroxycholestanoic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of trihydroxycholestanoic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating THCA concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating glyoxylic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of glyoxylic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated CSF sepiapterin concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of sepiapterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:18502672]

fields.label: Intrahepatic inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within hepatocytes." []

fields.label: Muscle vacuoles
fields.definition: "Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. The vacuoles are often associated with cytoplasmic and occasionally intranuclear eosinophilic inclusions." []

fields.label: Nonrimmed muscle vacuoles
fields.definition: "Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. On histological staining with hematoxylin and eosin, non-rimmed vacuoles lack the prominent dark border (rim) seen in rimmed vacuoles." []

fields.label: Reduced hepatic glycogen phosphorylase activity
fields.definition: "Activity or concentration of glycogen phosphorylase L in the liver below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Bone marrow hemophagocytosis
fields.definition: "Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the bone marrow." []

fields.label: Splenic granulomatosis
fields.definition: "Splenic inflammation involving a granulomatous response, i.e., a non-specific inflammatory response involving granulomas, defined as a compact organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes including epithelioid and giant cells." []

fields.label: Immediate detumescence of penis at time of symptom onset
fields.definition: "Loss of erection at the time point of pain or other symptom onset." []
fields.label_normalized: immediate detumescence of penis at time of symptom onset

fields.label: History of aortic valve replacement
fields.definition: "History of having received a surgical replacement of the aortic valve." [PMID:31354937]

fields.label: Coved type ST segment elevation
fields.definition: "An ST-segment elevation of at least 2 mm in at least one right precordial lead (V1 to V3), followed by an r'-wave and a concave or straight ST segment. The descending ST segment crosses the isoelectric line and is followed by a negative and symmetric T-wave." [PMID:30139433]

fields.label: Saddle-back type ST segment elevation
fields.definition: "An ST-segment elevation of at least 0.5 mm (generally at least 2 mm in V2) in at least one right precordial lead (V1 to V3), followed by a convex ST. The r'-wave may or may not overlap the J point, but it has a slow downward slope. The ST segment is followed by a positive T-wave in V2 and is of variable morphology in V1." [PMID:30139433]

fields.label: Substantially elevated circulating ethanol concentration
fields.definition: "A blood concentration of ethanol that is consistent with alcohol intoxication, generally assumed to be 0.0800 g/dL or higher." [PMID:33209539]

fields.label: Tortuous appearance of the stomach
fields.definition: "Abnormal twisting or winding of the stomach." []

fields.label: Cochlear nerve aplasia
fields.definition: "A developmental defect causing an absence of the cochlear nerve resulting in sensorineural hearing loss." [PMID:37591623]

fields.label: Slit-like lateral ventricle
fields.definition: "Abnormally small lateral ventricle with a slit-like appearance." [PMID:38054405]

fields.label: Fetal methamphetamine exposure
fields.definition: "A history of exposure during pregnancy (including during the period of conception) of the mother of a fetus or child to methamphetamine." [PMID:26212684]
fields.synonyms_concat: Antenatal methamphetamine exposure; Antenatal methamphetamine use; Fetal meth exposure; Methamphetamine use during pregnancy; Prenatal methamphetamine exposure; Prenatal methamphetamine use

fields.label: Elevated circulating 4-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:9683595]

fields.label: Elevated urinary 2,4-dihydroxybutyric acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of 2,4-dihydroxybutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Pupillary hypersensitivity to parasympathomimetic agents
fields.definition: "A higher than normal tendency of parasympathomimetic agents to induce miosis." [PMID:16754691, PMID:20301359]

fields.label: Lack of pupillary response to hydroxyamphetamine
fields.definition: "4-hydroxyamphetamine is used in eye drops to dilate the pupil, e.g.., to induce mydriasis for fundus examinations. This term refers to a lack of response of the pupil to topical application of 4-hydroxyamphetamine." [PMID:20301647]
fields.label_normalized: lack of pupillary response to hydroxyamphetamine

fields.label: Subcortical U fiber lesion
fields.definition: "Abnormal morphology of subcortical U fibers, typically as assessed by abnromal intensity on magnetic resonance imaging of the brain." [PMID:38223048]
fields.synonyms_concat: Subcortical U fiber involvement

fields.label: Intraspinal extradural lipoma
fields.definition: "A lipoma (a benign encapsulated mass with lobulated mature adipose tissue enclosed by fibrous tissue) located within the spine but outside of the dura mater." [PMID:30488010]

fields.label: Intranasal mass
fields.definition: "An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the nasal cavity. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." []

fields.label: Liver rupture
fields.definition: "Subcapsular hepatic rupture is characterized by the development of a hematoma, often quite large, beneath the liver capsule. An interval of days or hours may elapse between the time of injury and the first appearance of symptoms. A history of injury may be entirely lacking, or may be so unremarkable that it is elicited only by diligent interrogation. The hematoma tends to increase in size." [PMID:13915569]

fields.label: Elevated urinary mandelic acid
fields.definition: "The amount of mandelic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urine malic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of malic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urine 3-hydroxysebacic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of 3-hydroxysebacic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urinary vanillactic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of vanillactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urine 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." []

fields.label: Elevated urine hydroxyphenyllactic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of hydroxyphenyllactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:4720815]

fields.label: Positive gastric CMV intranuclear inclusions
fields.definition: "Demonstration of the presence of cytomegalovirus in the stomach by means of a method such as in-situ hybridization." [PMID:24010116]

fields.label: Elevated urine dihydroxycholestanoic acid level
fields.definition: "The amount of dihydroxycholestanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:27647924]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated urine DHCA level

fields.label: Elevated urinary bile alcohol level
fields.definition: "The amount of bile alcohol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:20301583]

fields.label: Elevated urine glucose tetrasaccharide level
fields.definition: "The amount of glucose tetrasaccharide in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:20301438]

fields.label: Increased urine 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate level
fields.definition: "The amount of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:26401545]

fields.label: Inability to protrude lips
fields.definition: "Lack of ability to purse or pucker the lips." [PMID:30804066]

fields.label: Wet voice
fields.definition: "Wet voice is a perceptual vocal quality that is gurgly or liquid sounding and is due to the voice being produced through moisture. It is commonly used as an indicator of penetration and/or aspiration in clinical swallowing assessments and bedside screening tests." [PMID:25001523]

fields.label: Erythema marginatum
fields.definition: "An erythematous (pink-red, depending on the skin color of the affected individual) macule that spreads peripherally and coalesces to form polycyclic or serpentine patches or plaques. Lesions occur in crops over days to weeks and are evanescent. The rate of migration is 2 to 12 mm over a period of a few hours. Erythema marginatum tends to affect the trunk more than the extremities and to not be accompanied by pruritus." [PMID:32491767]

fields.label: Mechanic's hands
fields.definition: "Mechanic's hands are fissured, erythematous, hyperkeratotic eruptions on the hands, resembling the type of occupational dermatosis said to resemble the hands of a manual laborer. The lesions are classically on the lateral edges of the fingers and thumbs, largely sparing the palmar, and dorsal aspects of the digits." [PMID:32284267, PMID:36186825]

fields.label: Hiker's feet
fields.definition: "Hyperkeratotic scaly fissured plaques on the fingers/palms or soles, generally more evident on the lateral aspect of index fingers." [PMID:32284267, PMID:35382516]

fields.label: Anti-HLA-DQ antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen (HLA-DQ). DQ is one of several antigens involved in antibody-mediated rejection of organ transplants." [PMID:23260706]

fields.label: Inappropriate normal or low erythropoietin
fields.definition: "Erythropoietin is produced and released into the blood by the kidneys in response to hypoxemia, and would normally be expected to increase with decreasing hemoglobin levels. This term applies if the increase fails to occur, as may be seen in conditions including chronic kidney disease." [PMID:32311841]

fields.label: Rapid gastric emptying
fields.definition: "A condition in which food moves through the stomach into the small intestine at an abnormally fast rate." [PMID:16207692]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dumping syndrome

fields.label: Mediastinal lymph node calcification
fields.definition: "Abnormal deposition of calcium in mediastinal lymph nodes." [PMID:29791561]
fields.synonyms_concat: Calcified mediastinal lymph nodes

fields.label: Eggshell calcification of lymph nodes
fields.definition: "Eggshell calcification refers to fine calcification seen at the periphery of a mass and usually relates to lamellar lymph node calcification." [PMID:29791561, PMID:6779537]
fields.synonyms_concat: Peripheral calcification of lymph nodes

fields.label: Knee joint effusion
fields.definition: "Abnormal accumulation of fluid within the knee joint or around the knee. Symptoms maye include, pain, swelling, and stiffness." [PMID:31575400]

fields.label: Subcutaneous emphysema
fields.definition: "Skin emphysema/Subcutaneous emphysema occurs when gas or air accumulates and seeps under the skin, where normally no gas should be present. While the presence of air in subcutaneous or mediastinal tissue is not dangerous in itself, prompt recognition of the underlying cause is essential." [PMID:31194349]
fields.synonyms_concat: Skin emphysema

fields.label: Elevated bone scintigraphy uptake
fields.definition: "Bone scintigraph is performed with technetium 99m-labeled diphosphonates. The uptake of these radiopharmaceuticals depicts osteoblastic activity and regional blood flow to bone." [PMID:21889871]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bone scan (scintigraphy): abnormally increased uptake; Increase bone scan uptake

fields.label: Diminished long-chain-enoyl-CoA hydratase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of long-chain-enoyl-CoA hydratase (EC 4.2.1.74) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal." []
fields.label_normalized: diminished long-chain-enoyl-coa hydratase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Diminished acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.definition: "Concentration or activity of acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase (EC 2.3.1.16) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme catalyzes the reaction acetyl-CoA + an acyl-CoA = a 3-oxoacyl-CoA + CoA. It is also known as 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase and beta-ketothiolase." []
synonyms: Reduced 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.label_normalized: diminished acetyl-coa c-acyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
fields.synonyms_concat: Reduced 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase activity in cultured fibroblasts

fields.label: Pathological inclusion body
fields.definition: "Pathological inclusion bodies are are composed of glycogen, proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, hemosiderin, and calcium, that accumulate as metabolic by-products, catabolic products of macromolecular complexes, or in the context of cell injury." []

fields.label: Reduced epidermal collagen IV alpha 5 chain staining
fields.definition: "Diminished or absent collagen alpha5(IV) chain staining pattern in the epidermal basement membrane." [PMID:22921432]
fields.label_normalized: reduced epidermal collagen iv alpha 5 chain staining

fields.label: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 3 chain staining
fields.definition: "Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 3 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney." [PMID:8793804]
fields.label_normalized: diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen iv alpha 3 chain staining

fields.label: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 4 chain staining
fields.definition: "Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 4 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney." []
fields.label_normalized: diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen iv alpha 4 chain staining

fields.label: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 5 chain staining
fields.definition: "Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 5 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney." []
fields.label_normalized: diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen iv alpha 5 chain staining

fields.label: Cystine nephrolithiasis
fields.definition: "Deposition of cystine crystals in kidney tissue. Cystine crystals display a pathognomic hexagonal shape." [PMID:25383320, PMID:32494553]

fields.label: Hepatic cystine accumulation
fields.definition: "Accumulation of cystine in the liver." [PMID:32727395]

fields.label: Bone marrow cystine accumulation
fields.definition: "The presence of cystine crystals in bone marrow cells as demonstrated in a fresh bone marrow aspiration sample." [PMID:28871612]

fields.label: Desmoid tumor
fields.definition: "Desmoid tumors are rare, locally aggressive, fibroblastic soft-tissue tumors that are characterized by infiltrative growth and tendency to recur. Desmoid tumors do not metastasize but can arise in any part of the body: extra-abdominal (appear in the head and neck, chest, extremities), and abdominal wall or intra-abdominal (originating in tissue that connects abdominal organs)." [PMID:32004793, PMID:37436594]
fields.synonyms_concat: Aggressive fibromatosis; Desmoid-type fibromatosis

fields.label: Tubular jejunal duplication
fields.definition: "A segment of the jejunum that runs parallel to the normal jejunum and communicates with the jejunal lumen at one or both ends." [PMID:1773546]

fields.label: Left ventricular rupture
fields.definition: "A full thickness tear or breakage of the myocardium of the left ventricle." [PMID:20301667, PMID:32644697]

fields.label: Punctate pontine perivascular enhancement
fields.definition: "Multiple punctate (speckled, patchy spot-like) and/or curvilinear areas of gadolinium enhancement distributed around blood vessels in the pons." [PMID:24028073]

fields.label: Intestinal worm
fields.definition: "Presence of one or more adult worms in the intestine as demonstrated by sonography or passage of a worm in the stool. On sonography, worms may appear as linear, echogenic structures within the intestines." [PMID:27551336]

fields.label: Scrotal worm
fields.definition: "Demonstration of one or more worms in the scrotum. This finding can be appreciated by sonography, where echogenic, linear structures could be seen moving within the scrotum." [PMID:12636874]
fields.synonyms_concat: Filaria dance sign

fields.label: Small intestinal adenoma
fields.definition: "A small bowel tumor with adenomatous epithelium." [PMID:7248908]

fields.label: Maternal retinal mottling
fields.definition: "Mottling (spots or blotches with different shades) of the retinal pigment epithelium in the mother of the index patient. Retinal mottling may indicate a mosaic X-linked inactivation state in the mother." [PMID:17460294]

fields.label: Twisted gallbladder pedicle
fields.definition: "A stretched conical-shaped structure found at the gallbladder neck with several linear echoes converging towards its tip. This finding is demonstrated by sonography and can indicate gallbladder volvulus." [PMID:35355530]
synonyms: Conical structure at the gallbladder neck
fields.synonyms_concat: Conical structure at the gallbladder neck

fields.label: Cholecyst-enteric fistula
fields.definition: "Fistula between the gallbladder and the intestine." [PMID:28613584]

fields.label: Dyschronometria
fields.definition: "Impaired ability to accurately measure or estimate time intervals." [PMID:17214571, PMID:19874739, PMID:27127597, PMID:31526769, PMID:37622046]

fields.label: History of recent intermittent breastfeeding
fields.definition: "History of recently intermittent breastfeeding an infant (i.e., on and off)." []

fields.label: Breast cyst
fields.definition: "A benign, fluid-filled sac in the breast." []

fields.label: Circumscribed
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are well-defined and localized to a specific area." []

fields.label: Lobulated
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that displays multiple indentations and/or elevations producing an irregular surface contour." []

fields.label: Spiculated
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality with irregular, radiating, or spiky edges." [PMID:32809592]

fields.label: Whorled
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles series of a concentric circles or spirals." []

fields.label: Delta brush pattern on EEG
fields.definition: "Delta brushes are transient patterns characterised by a slow delta wave with superimposed fast activity." [PMID:30214965]

fields.label: Tibiotalar synostosis
fields.definition: "Fusion of the junction between the distal tibia, fibula and the talus." [PMID:27577507, PMID:27594929]

fields.label: Vertebra plana
fields.definition: "he term given when a vertebral body has lost almost its entire height anteriorly and posteriorly, representing a very advanced compression fracture." [PMID:12432108]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pancake vertebra; Silver dollar vertebra

fields.label: Intoeing
fields.definition: "An abnormal gait caused by a rotational variation anywhere in the lower extremity that causes the foot to point inward, instead of pointing straight ahead or outward, when walking or running." [PMID:28925669, PMID:29148202]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pigeon-toed

fields.label: Palpable thrill on extremity
fields.definition: "A vibration felt upon palpation of a blood vessel over an extremity." []

fields.label: Out-toeing
fields.definition: "The feet turn excessively outward when walking, caused by a rotational variation in the leg." [PMID:36098609]
fields.synonyms_concat: Duck feet; External rotated feet; Toeing out

fields.label: Ankle dislocation
fields.definition: "An abnormal separation between the talo-tibial joint." [PMID:32119497]

fields.label: Anti-neuronal intermediate filament antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against neuronal intermediate filament." [PMID:30282771]

fields.label: Anti-DREBRIN antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against dendritic spine scaffolding protein Drebrin." [PMID:32196746]

fields.label: Anti-lipoprotein lipase autoantibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against anti-lipoprotein lipase." [PMID:15840743, PMID:28916403, PMID:29784574, PMID:36123759]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-LPL autoantibody positivity

fields.label: Anti-apolipoprotein CII autoantibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against apoCII." [PMID:30706594]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anti-apoCII autoantibody positivity

fields.label: Eosinophilic neuronal inclusion bodies
fields.definition: "The presence of intracellular inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in neurons that stain with eosin, a red or pink dye." [PMID:11138927]

fields.label: Sweaty foot-like odor
fields.definition: "A characteristic smell said to resemble the odor of dirty socks." [PMID:16602101, PMID:33521113, PMID:38484105]

fields.label: Anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against acetylcholine receptor." [PMID:18474849]

fields.label: Hair shaft lesion
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is located on hair shafts." []

fields.label: Prolonged use of tightly fitting footwear
fields.definition: "History of use of tightly fitting shoes for a long period of time." [PMID:29262247]
fields.label_normalized: prolonged use of tightly fitting footwear

fields.label: Triggered by high protein intake
fields.definition: "Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about ingestion of high quantities of protein." [PMID:32373372, PMID:38484105]
fields.synonyms_concat: Triggered by protein-rich foods

fields.label: Thickened tricuspid valve cusp
fields.definition: "An abnormally increased thickness of a leaflet of the tricuspid valve." [PMID:28706876]

fields.label: Displaced anterior fontanelle
fields.definition: "Abnormal shifting of the anterior fontanelle fropm its normal central position." [PMID:20216454, PMID:24123776, PMID:31691965]
fields.synonyms_concat: Displacement of the anterior fontanelle

fields.label: Subdural hygroma
fields.definition: "Accumulation of cerebral spinal fluid in the subdural space." [PMID:9653522]

fields.label: Incus ankylosis
fields.definition: "Incus ankylosis refers to congenital or acquired fixation of the incus, which is associated with conductive hearing resulting from impairment of the sound-conduction mechanism (the external auditory canal, tympanic membrane, and/or middle-ear ossicles)." [PMID:24969066]

fields.label: Excessive diet restriction
fields.definition: "A tendency to reject a variety of foods and/or to eat a restricted range of foods." [PMID:33171966]

fields.label: Left ventricular apical dyskinesis
fields.definition: "Dyskinesis is used to describe ventricular muscle segments that bulge outside the left ventricular cavity during systole, as opposed to contracting inwards with the rest of the segments." [PMID:37184762]

fields.label: Longitudinal erythronychia
fields.definition: "A longitudinal red band extending from the proximal nail fold or lunula to the distal nail plate." [PMID:30137841, PMID:38705197]

fields.label: Exacerbated by exposure to sunlight
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by exposure to sunlight." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Aggravated by ultraviolet radiation exposure

fields.label: Exacerbated by heat
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is made worse by exposure to heat (high ambient temperatures)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Aggravated by high temperatures

fields.label: Exacerbated by excessive sweating
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is made worse by excessive sweating." [PMID:26945535]

fields.label: Malignant pleural effusion
fields.definition: "The accumulation of a significant amount of exudate in the pleural space, accompanied by the presence of malignant cells or tumour tissue." [PMID:27246596]
fields.synonyms_concat: Malignant cells in pleural fluid

fields.label: Inappropriately low urine osmolality following challenge
fields.definition: "In diabetes insipidus, affected individuals produce large quantities of dilute urine. In nephrogenic DI, the kidneys do not respond to vasopressin. In a water deprivation test or with administration of exogenous vasopressin, the osmolaltiy of the urine does not increase as normally." [PMID:16461963]
fields.label_normalized: inappropriately low urine osmolality following challenge

fields.label: Reduced urine tetrahydrocortisol plus 5-alpha-THF to tetrahydrocortisone ratio
fields.definition: "Abnormally low ratio of tetrahydrocortisol (THF) plus 5-alpha-THF to tetrahydrocortisone (THE)." [PMID:21325058]
fields.label_normalized: reduced urine tetrahydrocortisol plus 5-alpha-thf to tetrahydrocortisone ratio

fields.label: Elevated urinary 2,4-dihydroxyglutarate level
fields.definition: "The amount of 2,4-dihydroxyglutarate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:34821949]

fields.label: Abnormal urine D-xylose test
fields.definition: "An abnormal result of the xylose absorption test that is used to assess the ability of the intestines to absorb D-xylose. D-xylose is a five-carbon monosaccharide found in some plants. The patient drinks a solution containing a specific amount of D-xylose and the concentration of xylose is measured in the blood circulation and then in the urine. A low amount of D-xylose indicates reduced small intestinal absorbtion." [PMID:11418788]

fields.label: Cerebral hemisphere mass lesion
fields.definition: "An abnormal growth or accumulation of tissue in a hemisphere of the cerebrum. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup." []

fields.label: T2-hyperintense putaminal rim
fields.definition: "Increased signal on T2 magnetic resonance imaging characterized by a linear region of high signal surrounding the lateral aspect of the putamen at 1.5 Tesla." [PMID:19147717]

fields.label: Posterior fossa mass lesion
fields.definition: "An abnormal growth or accumulation of tissue in the posterior fossa, affecting the cerebellum or fourth ventricle. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup." []

fields.label: Irregular RR interval
fields.definition: "Abnormal increased variability in the timing between consecutive R-waves on an electrocardiogram." [PMID:30725696, PMID:35813391]

fields.label: Irregular P-P interval
fields.definition: "Abnormally increased variability in the timing between consecutive P-waves on an electrocardiogram." [PMID:35813391]

fields.label: Fungal hair infection
fields.definition: "Demonstration of fungi growing on hair by a method such as microscopy of hairs mounted on slides with 10% potassium hydroxide." [PMID:29494084, PMID:31424762, PMID:32644450]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fungal infection of hair

fields.label: Long hairstyle
fields.definition: "A past medical history of having long, full hair." [PMID:31424762]

fields.label: Conjunctival subepithelial fibrosis
fields.definition: "fine white linear scars under intact conjunctival epithelium. This scarring appears in areas of previous conjunctival ulceration or pseudomembrane formation, weeks to months after the insult is healed." [PMID:28789979]

fields.label: Conjunctival fornix foreshortening
fields.definition: "Abnormal reduction in depth of the fornix of the conjunctiva. The fornix is the area where the conjunctiva folds back upon itself, thereby creating a recessed space." [PMID:24314841]

fields.label: Strong ultraviolet light exposure
fields.definition: "History of exposure to ultraviolet light, such as may be encountered with outdoor activities, living near equator, radiation." []

fields.label: Exposure to vaginal douching
fields.definition: "A history of intravaginal cleansing with a liquid solution for personal hygiene or aesthetic reasons." [PMID:12762087]

fields.label: Exposure to oily lotions or creams
fields.definition: "A history of applying oily lotions or creams to the skin." [PMID:29494106]
fields.label_normalized: exposure to oily lotions or creams

fields.label: Elevated circulating pristanic acid concentration following branched-chain fatty acid ingestion
fields.definition: "Concentration of pristanic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. This finding can be observed in Zellweger syndrome. Note that branched-chain fatty acid accumulation depends on dietary intake of phytanic acid, which is minimal in formula- and breast-fed infants. Thus, phytanic and pristanic acid levels are normal in a neonate with Zellweger spectrum disorder." [PMID:20301621]
fields.label_normalized: elevated circulating pristanic acid concentration following branched-chain fatty acid ingestion

fields.label_normalized: snapping sensation at time of injury

fields.label: Pagetoid spread
fields.definition: "Pagetoid spread connotes the spread of single neoplastic cells, and small nests of them above the basal layer in a variety of melanocytic and nonmelanocytic neoplasms similar to the pattern seen in Paget's and in extramammary Paget disease." [PMID:20431478]

fields.label: Central scarring
fields.definition: "Central scarring of skin lesions." [PMID:29261968, PMID:36911588]

fields.label: Scapholunate ligament tear
fields.definition: "A breakage (partial or complete tear) of the scapholunate ligament. The most common cause is physical trauma to the wrist such as a fall onto an outstretched hand. Tear of the scapholunate ligament may lead to carpal instability." [PMID:32684689, PMID:38817761]
fields.synonyms_concat: Scapholunate ligament injury; Scapholunate ligament rupture

fields.label: Lunotriquetral ligament tear
fields.definition: "A breakage (partial or complete tear) of the lunotriquetral ligament. The most common cause is physical trauma to the wrist such as a fall onto an outstretched hand. Rupture or tear of the the lunotriquetral ligament may lead to carpal instability." [PMID:36689137]

fields.label: Pisotriquetral arthritis
fields.definition: "Arthritis at the pisotriquetral joint. Radiographic evidence of arthritis at the pisotriquetral joint includes joint space narrowing, osteophytes, subchondral cysts, and/or subchondral sclerosis." [PMID:27777815]

fields.label: Volar intercalated segment instability
fields.definition: "A type of carpal instability characterized by volar tilt of the lunate bone." [PMID:32491661]

fields.label: Inaccurate finger pulse oximetry oxygen saturation measurement
fields.definition: "Any substantial discrepancy between the measurement of oxygen saturation with finger probe pulse oximetry as compared to an arterial blood gas, which is considered the gold standard." [PMID:34652479]
fields.label_normalized: inaccurate finger pulse oximetry oxygen saturation measurement

fields.label: Finger pulse oximetry lower than arterial blood gas analysis measurement of oxygen saturation
fields.definition: "Inaccurately reduced oxygen saturation as measured by finger or toe pulse oximetry compared to oxygen saturation as measured by venous or arterial blood gas analysis." [PMID:38340159]
fields.label_normalized: finger pulse oximetry lower than arterial blood gas analysis measurement of oxygen saturation

fields.label: Finger pulse oximetry higher than arterial blood gas analysis measurement of oxygen saturation
fields.definition: "Inaccurately elevated oxygen saturation as measured by finger or toe pulse oximetry compared to oxygen saturation as measured by venous or arterial blood gas analysis." [PMID:9792574]
fields.label_normalized: finger pulse oximetry higher than arterial blood gas analysis measurement of oxygen saturation

fields.label: History of thumb sucking past the age of four years
fields.definition: "Thumb sucking is a behavior that ceases spontaneously in most children between 2 and 4 years of age. If thumb sucking continues, negative consequences can occur, such as a deformity of the nail or paronychia. This term refers to a history of habitual thumb sucking past the age of 4 years of life." [PMID:32310572]
fields.label_normalized: history of thumb sucking past the age of four years

fields.label: Cutaneous granulomatosis
fields.definition: "Skin inflammatory reaction triggered by a wide variety of stimuli, including infections, foreign bodies, malignancy, metabolites, and chemicals. From a pathogenic point of view, they are divided into non-infectious and infectious granulomas. From a clinical point of view, it is useful to divide cutaneous granulomatosis into localized and more disseminated forms, although this distinction can be sometimes artificial." [PMID:29352388]

fields.label: Ureteric stricture
fields.definition: "Obstruction of urine flow through one or both ureters caused by issues such as injury, infection, tumours and surgery." [PMID:25100183]

fields.label: Arteriovenous crossing sign
fields.definition: "A retinal vascular abnormality characterized by indentation or compression of a retinal vein at an arteriovenous crossing, leading to changes in venous caliber. AV crossing signs are commonly associated with hypertensive retinopathy and may contribute to retinal vein occlusion. They are indicative of vascular remodeling due to chronic hypertension or other systemic vascular diseases." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Arteriovenous nicking; AV crossing changes; AV nicking; Gunn sign

fields.label: Haab striae
fields.definition: "Curvilinear or circumferential breaks in Descemet membrane, typically associated with congenital glaucoma. Haab striae result from elevated intraocular pressure during corneal development, leading to the formation of horizontal or arcuate lines that may be visible on slit-lamp examination. They can contribute to corneal astigmatism and visual impairment." [PMID:27993263, PMID:30554872]
fields.synonyms_concat: Haab's striae

fields.label: Positive Legionella sputum culture
fields.definition: "Growth of Legionella bacteria in a sputum culture." [PMID:38501659]

fields.label: Positive Streptococcus pneumoniae sputum culture
fields.definition: "Streptococcus pneumoniae growth in sputum culture." [PMID:24475349]

fields.label: Positive Blastomyces dermatitidis sputum fungal stain
fields.definition: "Demonstration of Blastomyces dermatitidis by microscopic examination of a stained sputum specimen." [PMID:28723016]
synonyms: Blastomyces dermatitidis on sputum fungal stain
fields.label_normalized: positive blastomyces dermatitidis sputum fungal stain
fields.synonyms_concat: Blastomyces dermatitidis on sputum fungal stain

fields.label: Posterior shoulder pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the posterior (back) part of the shoulder." []

fields.label: Superior shoulder pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the superior or proximal aspect of the shoulder over the acromion, distal clavicle, and/or acromioclavicular (AC) joint." []

fields.label: Lateral shoulder pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the localized aspect (on the side) of the shoulder." []

fields.label: Shoulder instability
fields.definition: "Subjective or objective feeling of clunking/clicking in the shoulder with movement, shoulder 'giving way', or sensation of shoulder dislocating." []

fields.label: Shoulder labrum tear
fields.definition: "A injury with a team (rip, split, or disruption) to the labrum, which is the ring of cartilage that surrounds the socket of the shoulder joint (the glenoid)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Glenoid labral tear; Labral tear in the shoulder

fields.label: Positive modified dynamic labral shear test
fields.definition: "Sensation of a pain with or without clicking or clunking sensation with the following test. Flex patients elbow to 90 degrees and abduct the arm 120 degrees while maximally externally rotating the arm, then examiner lowers the arm to 60 degrees of abduction. A positive test occurs with pain and/or a painful click along the posterior joint line between 120 degrees and 90 degrees of abduction." [PMID:19509414]
fields.label_normalized: positive modified dynamic labral shear test

fields.label: Positive O'Brien active compression test
fields.definition: "Pain in shoulder reproduced when examiner applies downward pressure on the arm while patient resists pressure in the following position: elbow extended, shoulder forward flexed to 90 degrees and 10-15 degrees adducted with palm facing down. This can be compared to the same position but with the palm facing up which should be less painful." [PMID:17936025]

fields.label: Positive shoulder apprehension test
fields.definition: "The individual being investigated displays noticeable apprehension (unease) during a test for shoulder instability in which the individual is laying supine with shoulder abducted to 90 degrees, elbow flexed to 90 degrees, and an external rotation pressure with combined downward pressure is applied on the upper arm." [PMID:14977651]

fields.label: Foamy tear film
fields.definition: "A condition characterized by the presence of foam or bubbles within the tear film, often associated with meibomian gland dysfunction or ocular surface diseases." [PMID:35508212]
fields.synonyms_concat: Frothy tear film; Tear bubbles; Tear foam

fields.label: Salzmann corneal nodules
fields.definition: "The formation of large, bluish, nodular lesions in the superficial corneal stroma, often associated with chronic keratitis or aging. These nodules may lead to visual impairment." [PMID:22228492]
fields.synonyms_concat: Salzmann nodular corneal degeneration; Salzmann nodular corneal dystrophy; Salzmann's nodules

fields.label: Corneal stromal vascularisation
fields.definition: "The abnormal growth of blood vessels into the corneal stroma, often associated with ocular herpes, chronic inflammation, infection, or hypoxia. This condition can lead to corneal scarring and vision impairment." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Corneal stromal neovascularization; Stromal vascularization of the cornea

fields.label: Corneal iron line
fields.definition: "Linear or arcuate deposition of iron within the corneal epithelium or stroma, typically associated with conditions such as keratoconus, corneal degeneration, or postsurgical corneal changes." [PMID:21599747]

fields.label: Conjunctivochalasis
fields.definition: "A condition characterized by redundant, loose conjunctival tissue, typically located between the globe and the lower eyelid, which may cause ocular discomfort, tear film instability, or epiphora." []

fields.label: Conjunctival hyperpigmentation
fields.definition: "Increased pigmentation of the conjunctiva, characterized by brown or black discoloration due to melanocytic proliferation or pigment deposition. It may be associated with benign conditions such as primary acquired melanosis or malignant transformation into conjunctival melanoma." [PMID:34424954]
fields.synonyms_concat: Conjunctival melanosis; Hyperpigmentation of the conjunctiva; Pigmented conjunctiva

fields.label: Anti-Saccharomyces cerevisiae antibodies
fields.definition: "Antibodies against antigens presented by the cell wall of the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae." [PMID:3143445]
fields.synonyms_concat: ASCA

fields.label: Elevated fraction exhaled nitric oxide
fields.definition: "The fractional exhaled nitric oxide (FeNO) is elevated above the upper limit of normal. FeNO is an endogenous gaseous molecule which can be measured in the human breath test because of airway inflammation. It has been studied extensively as a marker of inflammation and has been incorporated into an algorithm for asthma management." [PMID:31417809]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fraction exhaled nitric oxide elevated

fields.label: Iris hyperemia
fields.definition: "A condition characterized by increased blood flow and congestion of the iris vasculature, leading to a reddish discoloration of the iris. Iris hyperemia is commonly associated with anterior uveitis, angle-closure glaucoma, or ocular inflammation." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Congested iris vessels; Increased iris vascularity; Iris hyperaemia,

fields.label: Elevated circulating reticulated platelet count
fields.definition: "The number of reticulated platelets per volume of blood in the peripheral circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:24807169]

fields.label: Reduced circulating reticulated platelet count
fields.definition: "The number of reticulated platelets per volume of blood in the peripheral circulation is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:24807169]
fields.synonyms_concat: Decreased immature platelet fraction

fields.label: Abnormal circulating reticulated platelet count
fields.definition: "The number of reticulated platelets per volume of blood in the peripheral circulation is outside the limits of normal." [PMID:24807169]

fields.label: Flexed posturing of finger
fields.definition: "A sign that can be observed in diseases such as Pyogenic or suppurative flexor tenosynovitis in which the affected finger is held in a flexed position. Often, there is pain on any attempt at passive finger extension. This finding is to be distinguished from a contracture of a finger joint in which the flexed positions is fixed." [PMID:35015439]

fields.label: Positive synovial fluid alpha-defensin
fields.definition: "Elevation of the the alpha-defensin concentration in synovial aspirate is above the upper limit of normal. The alpha-defensin test is a qualitative immunoassay optimized and validated for synovial fluid. The alpha-defensin protein is an antimicrobial peptide that is naturally released by neutrophils responding to a pathogen in the synovial fluid." [PMID:25631170]

fields.label: Physeal fracture
fields.definition: "Salter-Harris fractures (physeal fractures) refer to fractures through a growth plate (physis) and are, therefore, specifically applied to bone fractures in children." [PMID:28613461]

fields.label: Salter I fracture
fields.definition: "A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture in which the fracture line extends through the physis or within the growth plate. Type I fractures are due to the longitudinal force applied through the physis, which splits the epiphysis from the metaphysis." [PMID:28613461]
fields.synonyms_concat: Slipped physeal fracture; Type I Salter-Harris fracture

fields.label: Salter II fracture
fields.definition: "A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture in which the fracture extends through both the physis and metaphysis. These are most common and occur away from the joint space. When the small corner of the metaphysis is visible, this is known as a corner sign or Thurston-Holland fragment." [PMID:28613461]
fields.synonyms_concat: Type II Salter-Harris fracture

fields.label: Salter III fracture
fields.definition: "A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture in which the fracture is intra-articular and extends from the physis into the epiphysis." [PMID:28613461]
fields.synonyms_concat: Type III Salter-Harris fracture

fields.label: Salter IV fracture
fields.definition: "A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture in which the fracture is intra-articular and passes through the epiphysis, physis, and metaphysis." [PMID:28613461]
fields.synonyms_concat: Type IV Salter-Harris fracture

fields.label: Salter V fracture
fields.definition: "A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture that is due to a crush or compression injury of the growth plate. In type V, the force is transmitted through the epiphysis and physis, potentially disrupting the germinal matrix, hypertrophic region, and vascular supply." [PMID:28613461]
fields.synonyms_concat: Type V Salter-Harris fracture

fields.label: Nail bed laceration
fields.definition: "A cut or injury to the soft tissue under the fingernail or toenail." [PMID:34633779]

fields.label: History of distal radius fracture
fields.definition: "Recent or remote history of distal radius fracture of the symptomatic arm." []

fields.label: History of triangular fibrocartilage complex tear
fields.definition: "Recent or remote history of a tear in the triangular fibrocartilage complex (TFCC). The TFCC is a load-bearing structure between the lunate, triquetrum, and ulnar head. The function of the TFCC is to act as a stabilizer for the ulnar aspect of the wrist. The TFCC is at risk for either acute or chronic degenerative injury." [PMID:30725740]
fields.label_normalized: history of triangular fibrocartilage complex tear
fields.synonyms_concat: History of TFCC tear

fields.label: Reduced plantar creases
