fields.definition: "The creases (wrinkles) on the soles of the feet are less pronounced than normal, or absent." [PMID:6869501]

fields.label: Skin burn
fields.definition: "Damage to the skin and underlying tissues caused by an agents such as heat, chemicals, electricity, radiation, or friction, resulting in pain, redness, swelling, and sometimes blisters or charring." []

fields.label: Elevanted carboxysterol concentration in cultured lymphoblasts
fields.definition: "The concentration of carboxysterols in lymphoblastoid cells cultured in cholesterol-depleted medium is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:21290788]
fields.label_normalized: elevanted carboxysterol concentration in cultured lymphoblasts

fields.label: Superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition
fields.definition: "An anomaly that can be ascertained by iron-specific magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences such as gradient-echo (GRE) and susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI). Superficial siderosis of the central nervous system is a chronic condition due to persistent or repeated long-term bleeding into the subarachnoid space, leading to subpial hemosiderin deposition. Hemosiderin deposition on MRI is seen as a T2 hypointensity and preferentially outlines the cerebellum and brainstem surface." [PMID:38753899]
fields.synonyms_concat: Superficial siderosis

fields.label: Cortical superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition
fields.definition: "A type of superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition that most commonly occurs due to iron deposits in the superficial cortical layers following bleeding from leptomeningeal vessels, most often from cerebral amyloid angiopathy in patients aged 55 or older." [PMID:33860558, PMID:38753899]
fields.synonyms_concat: Cortical superficial siderosis

fields.label: Infratentorial superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition
fields.definition: "A type of superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition that involves the cerebellum and brainstem, most commonly the superior vermis, quadrigeminal plate, and basal cerebral surfaces. Cerebellar atrophy, particularly the superior vermis and anterior cerebellar hemispheres, can also be seen on a computed tomography scan of the head. The MRI of the spinal cord may reveal myelomalacia, syringomyelia, owl-eyes, or snake-eyes signs. The most common etiology for classic or primary infratentorial superficial siderosis is spinal dural defects, often dural tears." [PMID:33860558, PMID:38753899]
fields.synonyms_concat: Infratentorial superfiicial siderosis

fields.label: Pulmonary hyperplasia
fields.definition: "Pulmonary Hyperplasia is an absolute increase in the number of alveoli, which are mildly enlarged. Pulmonary hyperplasia has been also referred to as polyalveolar lobe and type 3 cystic adenomatoid malformation." [PMID:7747754]

fields.label: Positive protozoan parasite CSF wet mount test
fields.definition: "Demonstration of protozoan parasites in a cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) specimen by microscopy." [PMID:19635883]
fields.label_normalized: positive protozoan parasite csf wet mount test

fields.label: Gallbladder polyp
fields.definition: "A gallbladder (GB) polyp is a growth that projects from the lining of the inside wall of the gallbladder into the lumen of the GB. GB polyps are a common incidental sonographic finding, the vast majority of which are benign." [PMID:38411693]

fields.label: Gallbladder polyposis
fields.definition: "Multiple polyps arising from the gallbladder mucosal wall." [PMID:29262128]

fields.label: Biceps tendon rupture
fields.definition: "Discontinuity of the biceps tendon as observed by ultrasound or magnetic resonance (MR) imaging." [PMID:30020607]
fields.synonyms_concat: Biceps tendon tear

fields.label: Medial epicondyle apophysitis
fields.definition: "Medial epicondyle apophysitis (MEA), also known as little league elbow, is an overuse injury prevalent among adolescent athletes whose sport involves repetitive overhand throwing, racket use, or other overhead arm motions. The medial epicondyle is a bony protrusion on the medial elbow with its own ossification center, separate from the main distal humeral physis, known as an apophysis. Medial epicondyle apophysitis occurs due to excessive and repetitive valgus stress placed on the apophysis before its closure. Over time, the repetitive strain results in a traction-type injury and may cause pathologic widening and inflammation of the apophysis or even an avulsion fracture." [PMID:34033354]
fields.synonyms_concat: Little league elbow

fields.label: Thumb carpometacarpal subluxation
fields.definition: "A partial (subluxation) loss of alignment at the base of the thumb, where the first metacarpal bone meets the trapezium bone of the wrist. Thumb radiographs showing carpometacarpal (CMC) joint space widening and/or incongruity of the joint space between thumb metacarpal bone and the trapezium bone." [PMID:33927510]
fields.synonyms_concat: Thumb carpometacarpal dislocation; Thumb CMC subluxation

fields.label: Localized to the lower eyelid
fields.definition: "A descriptor indicating that a condition, lesion, or abnormality is confined to the lower eyelid. This localization may be relevant for various ocular conditions, including infections, structural abnormalities, or dermatological diseases affecting the lower eyelid region." []

fields.label: Localized to eyelid
fields.definition: "Applies to an abnormality that is situated in an eyelid." []

fields.label: Halo vision
fields.definition: "A visual phenomenon characterized by the perception of bright rings or halos surrounding light sources. Halo vision is often associated with optical irregularities such as corneal edema, cataracts, or intraocular lens complications. It may also occur in conditions affecting the tear film or due to the presence of glare from light scattering within the ocular media." [PMID:12499461]

fields.label: Hematospermia
fields.definition: "The presence of blood in the seminal fluid." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hemospermia

fields.label: Choledocholithiasis
fields.definition: "Choledocholithiasis is the presence of stones within the common bile duct." [PMID:28722990]

fields.label: Axillary nerve distribution
fields.definition: "Paresthesias on the lateral aspect of the shoulder and upper arm. Weakness in shoulder abduction (deltoid) and shoulder external rotation (teres minor)." []

fields.label: Pelvic ring fracture
fields.definition: "X-ray of the pelvis (AP, inlet, and outlet views) showing fracture of the pelvic ring, including iliac wing (ilium), superior or inferior pubic ramus, or ischium, and/or displacement of the pubic symphysis or sacroiliac joints." []

fields.label: Scapulothoracic dissociation
fields.definition: "An injury consisting of a laterally displaced scapula with separation of the ipsilateral acromioclavicular joint, disruption of the ipsilateral subclavian vessels and brachial plexus, and an intact overlying skin." [PMID:31046412]

fields.label: Pain exacerbated by weight bearing
fields.definition: "Refers to pain that is worse when the individual bears weight with the affected body part." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pain on weight bearing

fields.label: Thumb sign
fields.definition: "The distal phalanx of the adducted thumb extends beyond the ulnar border of the palm (The thumb protrudes from the clenched fist)." [PMID:7616992]
fields.synonyms_concat: Steinberg sign

fields.label: Tibialis anterior tendon rupture
fields.definition: "Partial or complete breakage (rupture) of the tibialis anterior tendon (TAT). The TAT is the principal dorsiflexor of the ankle joint and secondary invertor of the foot. It has important roles in the different stages of gait; in the swing phase, it concentrically dorsiflex the ankle for foot clearance and during plantarflexion of the ankle in the stance phase, it eccentrically contract to stabilize the ankle and prevent damage to the foot and ankle. Clinically, presentations in acute lacerations or direct trauma cases are straight forward, in chronic and atraumatic cases usually the symptoms at the time of TAT rupture are more subtle. Other manifestations include mild pain, localized mass, palpable gap, loss of strength, instability during gait, gait disturbances with forefoot dropping and stumbling and high stepping gait." [PMID:31501017]

fields.label: Decreased circulating ADAMTS13 activity
fields.definition: "Activity of the enzyme von Willebrand factor-cleaving protease (ADAMTS13) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:12637323, PMID:30208220]

fields.label: Abnormal methacholine challenge test
fields.definition: "An abnormal result of the methacholine challenge test, which is a bronchoprovocation technique used to evaluate airway hyperresponsiveness, particularly in patients with suspected asthma." [PMID:31613496]

fields.label: Positive stool glutamate dehydrogenase test
fields.definition: "Detection of the presence of glutamate dehydrogenase produced by Clostridium difficile in a stool sample." [PMID:24145018, PMID:35634999]
synonyms: Detection of C. difficile glutamate dehydrogenase
Positive C. difficile glutamate dehydrogenase test
fields.synonyms_concat: Detection of C. difficile glutamate dehydrogenase; Positive C. difficile glutamate dehydrogenase test

fields.label: Retrocorneal membrane
fields.definition: "A retrocorneal membrane is an abnormal, fibrous or cellular tissue layer that forms on the posterior surface of the cornea, typically on or adjacent to the Descemet membrane. It may result from trauma, surgery (e.g., penetrating keratoplasty), inflammation, or endothelial cell dysfunction, and can lead to visual impairment depending on its density and extent." [PMID:20579631]
fields.synonyms_concat: Membrane behind the cornea; Retrocorneal fibrosis; Retrocorneal fibrous membrane

fields.label: Adrenal hemorrhage
fields.definition: "Adrenal hemorrhage is bleeding within the capsule of the adrenal gland." [PMID:36404284, PMID:38432745]

fields.label: Optic nerve sheath dilatation
fields.definition: "An abnormal increase in the diameter of the optic nerve sheath, typically due to elevated intracranial pressure or local pathology affecting cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) dynamics. It can be detected via imaging modalities such as ultrasound or MRI and may be associated with papilledema, idiopathic intracranial hypertension, or optic nerve tumors." [PMID:39585390]
synonyms: Dilation of the optic nerve sheath
fields.synonyms_concat: Dilation of the optic nerve sheath; Enlarged optic nerve sheath; Optic nerve sheath expansion

fields.label: Right ventricular thrombus
fields.definition: "A blood clot (thrombus) localized in the right ventricle." [PMID:38746065]

fields.label: Disseminated candidiasis
fields.definition: "A systemic fungal infection by Candida species (most commonly, C. albicans)." [PMID:38448809]
fields.synonyms_concat: Hepatosplenic candidiasis

fields.label: Phrenic neuropathy
fields.definition: "A functional deficit of the phrenic nerve. Phrenic neuropathy (PhN) is a debilitating condition characterized by impairment of the diaphragm muscle, the primary inspiratory muscle. Diaphragm muscle ultrasound is a noninvasive tool that appears to offer both high sensitivity and specificity for diagnosis. Alternatively, electrodiagnostic studies can assess phrenic nerve health. PhN is commonly diagnosed via diaphragm muscle US or fluoroscopy (sniff test) with paradoxical or significantly decreased diaphragm muscle movement." [PMID:39205612]
fields.synonyms_concat: Phrenic nerve neuropathy

fields.label: Glomerular basement membrane subendothelial remodeling
fields.definition: "New glomerular basement membrane matrix formation under the endothelial cell." [PMID:32866505]

fields.label: Glomerular endothelium swelling
fields.definition: "Enlargement of the glomerular endothelium (the innermost layer of the glomerular filtration barrier) causing capillary lumen narrowing and loss of fenetrations." [PMID:32866505]
fields.synonyms_concat: Glomerular endothelial swelling

fields.label: Medullary collecting duct ectasia
fields.definition: "Widening of the lumen of the lumen of the collecting ducts in the renal medulla." [PMID:30523303]

fields.label: Corneal keloid
fields.definition: "A raised, opaque, and fibrous lesion on the cornea resembling a dermal keloid, typically composed of disorganized collagen and fibrovascular tissue. Corneal keloids can impair vision and are often secondary to trauma, surgery, or underlying congenital disorders." [PMID:35598901]

fields.label: Podocytic mitochondrial proliferation
fields.definition: "An ultrastructural abnormality of the kidney glomeruli characterized by an excessive number or abnormal aggregation of mitochondria in podocytes." [PMID:28117207]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal mitochondrial proliferation in podocytes

fields.label: Elevated vitamin D metabolite ratio
fields.definition: "The ratio of 24,25(OH)2D to 25(OH)D (also known as vitamin D metabolite ratio or VMR) is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:26501157, PMID:37220642]

fields.label: Aggravated by vitamin D supplementation
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment or supplementation with vitamin D." [PMID:31188746]

fields.label: Aggravated by sun exposure
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that becomes worse with exposure to sunlight." [PMID:31188746]

fields.label: Tubular accumulation of uromodulin
fields.definition: "Accumulation of uromodulin within renal tubular cells or lumina." [PMID:31488840]

fields.label: Elevated stool reducing substances
fields.definition: "Elevated level of reducing substances in the feces. If carbohydrate malabsorption is suspected, a reducing substance should be investigated in the stool using the Benedict or Fehling test. The presence of reducing substances may indicate an abnormality in carbohydrate (e.g., sucrose, lactase) metabolism. The unabsorbed sugars in stool are measured as reducing substances." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated fecal reducing substances; Increased reducing substances in stool

fields.label: Osteochondral lesion of talus
fields.definition: "Osteochondral lesion of the talus (OLT) is an injury involving the articular cartilage and subchondral bone, defined as any damage involving both articular cartilage and subchondral bone of the talar dome. OLT can cause ankle joint pain and can sometimes lead to instability and manifest as an area of abnormal, damaged cartilage and bone on the top of the talus bone (the lower bone of the ankle joint)." [PMID:30498800, PMID:34386361]

fields.label: Mallet toe
fields.definition: "A mallet toe involves the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint [such that] the distal phalanx is flexed on the middle phalanx." [PMID:32211125]

fields.label: Bunionette deformity
fields.definition: "The bunionette, or tailor's bunion, is a lateral prominence of the fifth metatarsal head. Most commonly, bunionettes are the result of a widened 4-5 intermetatarsal angle with associated varus of the metatarsophalangeal joint." [PMID:17478753]
fields.synonyms_concat: Bunionette toe deformity; Tailor's bunion

fields.label: Elevated CSF beta chorionic gonadotropin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of beta chorionic gonadotropin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:11007160]
fields.label_normalized: elevated csf beta chorionic gonadotropin concentration

fields.label: Pigment epithelium detachment
fields.definition: "Separation of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) from the underlying Bruch membrane." [PMID:28280989]

fields.label: Retinal gliosis
fields.definition: "A pathological condition characterized by the proliferation of glial cells in the retina, often occurring as a reactive response to injury, inflammation, or degenerative changes, and typically resulting in structural and functional alterations in the retina." [PMID:26175331]

fields.label: Aphakia
fields.definition: "Absence of the crystalline lens in the eye, which may be congenital or acquired (e.g., following surgical removal of the lens for cataracts or trauma)." []

fields.label: Pain on thumb extension
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort that is triggered upon extension (straightening) of the thumb." []

fields.label: Fractured lunate bone
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the lunate bone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Lunate bone fracture; Lunate fracture

fields.label: Fractured triquetrum bone
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the triquetrum bone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Triquetrum bone fracture; Triquetrum fracture

fields.label: Fractured pisiform bone
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the pisiform bone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Pisiform bone fracture; Pisiform fracture

fields.label: Fractured trapezium bone
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the trapezium bone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Trapezium bone fracture; Trapezium fracture

fields.label: Fractured trapezoid bone
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the trapezoid bone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Trapezoid bone fracture; Trapezoid fracture

fields.label: Fractured capitate bone
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the capitate bone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Capitate bone fracture; Capitate fracture

fields.label: Fractured hamate bone
fields.definition: "A partial or complete breakage of the hamate bone." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Hamate bone fracture; Hamate fracture

fields.label: Pulsatile abdominal mass
fields.definition: "An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the abdomen that pulses or throbs." [PMID:22644671]
fields.synonyms_concat: Pulsating abdominal mass

fields.label: Nonpulsatile abdominal mass
fields.definition: "An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the abdomen that does not pulse or throb." []

fields.label: Iatrogenic anophthalmos
fields.definition: "A form of acquired anophthalmos resulting from surgical removal of the eye (enucleation or evisceration), typically performed due to trauma, intraocular tumors, intractable pain in a blind eye, or severe infection. Unlike congenital anophthalmos, the orbit may have previously developed normally and prosthetic rehabilitation is often pursued." []

fields.label: Reduced erythrocyte glutathione peroxidase
fields.definition: "Activity or concentration of in the level of glutathione peroxidase (EC 1.11.1.9) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Glutathione peroxidase low in erythrocytes

fields.label: Elevated circulating malonyl carnitine concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of malonylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:37144154, PMID:39069445]
synonyms: Elevated levels of malonylcarnitine in blood acylcarnitine profile
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated Blood C3DC level; Elevated C3DC in plasma; Elevated levels of malonylcarnitine in blood acylcarnitine profile; Elevated plasma malonylcarnitine level

fields.label: Sertoli cell hypoplasia
fields.definition: "Abnormal decrease in the number of Sertoli cells in the testis." []

fields.label: Positive talar tilt test
fields.definition: "An abnormal result of the talar tilt test. This test assesses ankle ligament integrity, particularly the calcaneofibular ligament (CFL) and the deltoid ligaments. To perform the test, the foot is placed at an angle of 90 degrees with the leg, the calcaneofibular ligament is perpendicular and the anterior talofibular ligament is parallel to the long axis of the talus. Therefore, inversion in this position results in strain on the calcaneofibular ligament." [PMID:24995627, PMID:33543095]

fields.label: Plantar ecchymosis
fields.definition: "A purpuric lesion that is larger than 1 cm in diameter and is located on the sole of the foot." [PMID:37692589]

fields.label: Prolonged exposure to axillary pressure
fields.definition: "History of prolonged compressive pressure in the axillary region." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Prolonged axillary pressure

fields.label: Lateral ankle pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the outer side of the ankle." []

fields.label: Medial ankle pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the inner side of the ankle." []

fields.label: Posterior ankle pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the back of the ankle." []

fields.label: Anterior ankle pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the front of the ankle." []

fields.label: Exacerbated by colchicine
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with colchizine." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Colchicine worsens symptoms

fields.label: Retinal periphlebitis
fields.definition: "A condition characterized by inflammation of the outer walls of retinal veins, often presenting as vascular sheathing or exudates along the venous walls." []

fields.label: Purulent pericardial effusion
fields.definition: "Elevated leukocyte count in the pericardial fluid ranging from a a microscopic purulent pericardial effusion to gross pus in the pericardial space." [PMID:15725041]

fields.label: Conjunctival erosion
fields.definition: "A condition characterized by the localized loss or breakdown of the conjunctival epithelium, often resulting in exposure of the underlying tissue. Conjunctival erosion may cause symptoms such as redness, irritation, foreign body sensation, and tearing. It can result from trauma, chemical injuries, ocular surface diseases, or prolonged use of contact lenses." []

fields.label: Positive Mycobacterium tuberculosis sputum culture
fields.definition: "Growth of mycobacterium tuberculosis in a sputum culture." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Acid fast bacteria sputum culture

fields.label: Increased external rotation of shoulder
fields.definition: "Increased rotation of the lower part of the arm away from the body (tested with the elbow flexed and the elbow held next to the side of the body or shoulder 90 degrees abducted to the side)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Shoulder increased external rotation

fields.label: Positive trunk flexion test
fields.definition: "The proband is asked to flex the trunk forward with knees straight. The result of the test is considered positive (abnormal) if the palms can be made to rest flat on the floor." [PMID:33738549]
synonyms: Abnormal forward flexion of the trunk manoeuvre
Increased forward flexion of the trunk
Trunk flexion with palms on floor
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal forward flexion of the trunk manoeuvre; Increased forward flexion of the trunk; Positive palms-to-floor maneuver; Trunk flexion with palms on floor

fields.label: Tibiotalar arthritis
fields.definition: "AP, oblique, or lateral view x-ray of the ankle showing radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis such as joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, and/or osteophyte formation in the tibiotalar joint." [PMID:26660651]
fields.synonyms_concat: Ankle arthritis

fields.label: Anterior ankle osteophyte
fields.definition: "Imaging study of the ankle revealing osteophyte (bone spur) formation at the anterior aspect of the ankle (tibial or talar neck)." [PMID:22403038]
fields.synonyms_concat: Tibiotalar spur

fields.label: Midfoot arthritis
fields.definition: "AP, oblique, or lateral view x-ray of the foot showing radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis in the midfoot (tarsometatarsal (TMT) joints, naviculocuneiform joint, intercuneiform joints, and/or metatarsal cuneiform joints), such as joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, and/or osteophyte formation in the tibiotalar joint." [PMID:32405198]

fields.label: Decreased circulating reverse T3 concentration
fields.definition: "Concentration of reverse T3 (3,3',5'-triiodothyronine or rT3) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." []

fields.label: Stocking-glove distribution
fields.definition: "Distribution of findings in hands and feet with a distal to proximal gradient of severity (being more severe in the more distal locations)." []

fields.label: Hairy kidney sign
fields.definition: "A radiological sign related to infiltration of histiocytes into the kidneys and perirenal fat. This infiltration, along with thickening of fibrous bands within the perirenal fat, creates a hairy appearance on cross-sectional imaging studies." [PMID:29728208]
fields.synonyms_concat: Perinephric infiltration

fields.label: White appearance of duodenal mucosa
fields.definition: "On a typical diet (e.g., no dietary fat restriction), the intestinal mucosa may have a gelee blanche or white hoar frosting appearance on endoscopy." [PMID:33983694]
synonyms: Gelee blanche appearance of duodenal mucosa
White hoar frosting appearance of duodenal mucosa
fields.synonyms_concat: Gelee blanche appearance of duodenal mucosa; White hoar frosting appearance of duodenal mucosa

fields.label: Acromioclavicular joint separation
fields.definition: "An acromioclavicular (AC) joint joint separation, often called a shoulder separation, is a dislocation of the clavicle from the acromion. This feature is ascertainable radiographically by AC joint x-ray views including bilateral anteroposterior (AP) view, axillary lateral view, and/or Zanca view showing either superior, posterior, or inferior displacement of the distal clavicle in relation to the acromion at the AC joint." [PMID:23242975]

fields.label: Acromioclavicular joint arthritis
fields.definition: "Degenerative disease of the acromioclavicular (AC) joint that manifests radiographically as Zanca view X-ray of the AC joint showing radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis such as joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, and/or osteophyte formation in the AC joint." [PMID:23649008]
fields.synonyms_concat: Osteoarthritis of the acromioclavicular joint

fields.label: Positive shoulder cross-body adduction test
fields.definition: "A test used with suspected chronic acromioclavicular joint lesions (which are a common source of pain and disability in the shoulder). The test is considered positive with pain in the ipsilateral acromioclavicular joint when patient straightens the affected arm forward and reaches for the contralateral shoulder with extra manual cross body (adduction) pressure on the arm from the examiner." [PMID:15090381]
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive scarf test

fields.label: Proximal humeral epiphysiolysis
fields.definition: "Proximal humeral epiphysiolysis (Little League shoulder) is a shear or stress injury of the epiphyseal cartilage of the proximal humerus. Anteroposterior (AP) view of the shoulder in external rotation showing widening of the proximal humerus physis in comparison to contralateral shoulder with possible metaphyseal bony irregularity." [PMID:30485006]
fields.synonyms_concat: Little league shoulder

fields.label: Positive anterior drawer test
fields.definition: "A test for ankle instability in which an anterior pull on the calcaneus with is applied with one hand while stabilizing the end of the tibia/fibula with the other hand. The test is considered positive (abnormal) if it results in more than one cm of anterior translation of the foot compared to the healthy, contralateral ankle." [PMID:36849957]
fields.synonyms_concat: Anterior drawer test positive

fields.label: Peroneal tendon tear
fields.definition: "Injury to a peroneal tendon, as can be ascertained by an MRI study of the ankle showing partial or complete tear of one or both of the peroneal tendons." [PMID:23255535]

fields.label: Fifth metatarsal apophysitis
fields.definition: "Iselin's disease is a traction apophysitis of base of fifth metatarsal. The apophysis is within the peroneus brevis tendon insertion site and appears radiographically at about age 10 in female and age 12 in male and usually fuses by age 11 in female and by age 14 in male. Repetitive microtrauma from the peroneus brevis tendon, as occurs in sports activities is the cause of traction apophysitis. It can be ascertained by oblique foot radiographs showing apophyseal irregularity (enlarged apophysis, disordered ossification, widened chondro-osseous junction) at the base of the fifth metatarsal." [PMID:27546974]
fields.synonyms_concat: Iselin disease

fields.label: Tibial tubercle apophysitis
fields.definition: "Lateral knee radiograph showing tibial tuberosity apophysis irregularity and fragmentation; tibial tubercle osteochondrosis; traction apophysitis of the tibial tubercle." [PMID:28723024]
fields.synonyms_concat: Osgood-Schlatter disease

fields.label: Enteric anendocrinosis
fields.definition: "Near absence of small intestinal and colonic endocrine cells. This feature can be ascertained histopathologically and may also be manifested as a lack of staining for enteroendocrive markers such as synaptophysin." [PMID:16855267, PMID:39346060]

fields.label: Metatarsal head osteochondrosis
fields.definition: "Avascular necrosis of a metatarsal head, most commonly involving the second, but also the third or fourth, metatarsal.\nComment: Affected individuals may present with foot pain on weight-bearing, swelling, and tenderness. Radiological features include widening of the metatarsophalangeal joint space and flattening of the affected metatarsal head, at later stages metatarsal head sclerosis, cortical thickening, and intra-articular loose bodies. Osteochondrosis is a condition resulting from an epiphysis injury that alters enchondral ossification and produces irregularity at the joint surface. Freiberg disease is characterized as osteochondrosis of the metatarsal heads (primarily the second)." [PMID:30685014, PMID:30725993]
fields.synonyms_concat: Freiberg disease; Freiberg infarction; Metatarsal head osteonecrosis

fields.label: Hallux sesamoiditis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the sesamoid bones of the hallux ( two ovoid-shaped ossicles embedded within the tendons under the big toe). This feature can be ascertained by MRI of the foot, revealing edema within one or both of the hallux sesamoids." [PMID:32583133]

fields.label: Os trigonum
fields.definition: "Os trigonum (OT) is one of the most common accessory ossicles in the foot and ankle region. In clinical practice, OT is a considerable factor that may predispose patients to posterior ankle impingement syndrome (PAIS). Lateral ankle x-ray with foot in plantarflexion reveals an accessory ossicle at the posterior aspect of the talus, between the posterior distal tibia and calcaneal tuberosity." [PMID:39586987]

fields.label: Positive heel squeeze test
fields.definition: "The squeeze test is the most common examination for diagnosing calcaneal apophysitis (Sever disease) and is conducted by compressing the medial and lateral aspects of the calcaneus. The test is considered positive (abnormal) if squeezing elicits pain." [PMID:24072363, PMID:39430116]
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive calcaneal squeeze test

fields.label: Calcaneal apophysitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the calcaneal apophysis (bony projection where the Achilles tendon attaches to the heel). Lateral foot x-ray shows increased density in the calcaneal apophysis or fragmentation of the apophysis." [PMID:38544602]

fields.label: Decreased circulating guanidinoacetic acid concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:20301745]
fields.synonyms_concat: Low serum GAA concentration; Reduced circulating guanidinoacetic acid concentration

fields.label: Elevated circulating C-triol concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of cholestane-3beta, 5alpha, 6beta-triol (C-triol) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. C-triol is a diagnostic biomarker for Niemann-Pick disease type C." [PMID:32178982]
fields.synonyms_concat: Elevated circulating cholestane-3beta,5alpha,6beta-triol concentration

fields.label: Germinal vesicle oocyte maturation arrest
fields.definition: "A type of oocyte maturation arrest that occurs prior to the breakdown of the germinal vesicle (which is a hallmark of reinitiation of meiosis I and entry into M phase)." [PMID:20378111]

fields.label: Metaphase II oocyte maturation arrest
fields.definition: "The morphologic classification of MII generally denotes an oocyte that is mature, having arrested in metaphase II and is presumed to be capable of fertilization. However, there are subsets of women who produce oocytes with MII morphology that are not capable of embryo formation even with fertilization. This incongruence between morphologic maturity and capacity could be attributed to either the inclusion within the morphologic classification immature oocytes arrested at any stage between PBI formation and metaphase II, which are not capable of fertilization, or oocytes arrested normally at metaphase II that do not possess the ability to complete meiosis." [PMID:20378111]
fields.synonyms_concat: Metaphase II oocyte meiotic arrest; Oocyte arrest at metaphase II

fields.label: Mixed oocyte maturation arrest
fields.definition: "A type of oocyte maturation failure whereby oocytes arrest at more than one stage of meiosis." [PMID:20378111]

fields.label: Dorsal forearm pain
fields.definition: "Pain localized to dorsal (non-palmar) aspect of the forearm." []

fields.label: Volar forearm pain
fields.definition: "Pain on the volar (palmar) aspect of the forearm." []

fields.label: Cholesterol gallbladder polyp
fields.definition: "A non-neoplastic gallbladder polyp that is hyperplastic and consists of a lipid deposit. Cholesterol polyps are generally less than 10 mm. often multiple cholesterol polyps are present. They are often associated with vesicular cholesterolosis and are thought to have no malignant potential." [PMID:22655278]

fields.label: Hyperlordotic gait
fields.definition: "A gait abnormality characterized by excessive lumbar lordosis (swayback posture, i.e., an inward curvature of the lower spine) and gait pattern with forward tilt of the pelvis and increased lumbar curvature. Hyperlordotic gait is often as a compensatory mechanism for hip extensor weakness, proximal muscle weakness, or hip flexion contracture." [PMID:11166162, PMID:30713909]
fields.synonyms_concat: Gait with exaggerated lumbar lordosis

fields.label: Radioulnar interosseous membrane tear
fields.definition: "A tear in the fibrous sheet connecting the radius and ulna bones in the forearm." [PMID:27468369]

fields.label: Fleck sign of elbow
fields.definition: "A radiograpzhic sign in which small bone fragments detached from the olecranon are seen on lateral radiographs in cases with avulsion of the tendon." [PMID:28461956]
fields.synonyms_concat: Dunn-Kusnezov sign; Flake sign of the elbow

fields.label: Resisted wrist flexion provokes pain
fields.definition: "Active wrist flexion against resistance increases pain in the arm." []

fields.label: Lateral epicondylitis of the elbow
fields.definition: "A chronic symptomatic degeneration of the wrist extensor tendons involving their attachment to the lateral epicondyle of the humerus, and is associated clinically with lateral elbow pain (tennis elbow). This term refers to the associated imaging finding. Ultrasound imaging showing extensor carpi radialis brevis (ECRB) tendon thickening and hypoechoic areas with increased vascularity or MRI showing increased signal intensity or tear at the insertion site of the ECRB on the lateral aspect of the elbow." [PMID:28461918]

fields.label: Medial epicondylitis of the elbow
fields.definition: "Medial epicondylitis, often referred to as golfer's elbow, is a common pathology. Flexor-pronator tendon degeneration occurs with repetitive forced wrist extension and forearm supination during activities involving wrist flexion and forearm pronation. This term refers to the associated imaging finding. Ultrasound imaging showing ECRB tendon thickening and hypoechoic areas with increased vascularity or MRI showing increased signal intensity or tear at the insertion site of the common flexor tendon." [PMID:26001427]
fields.synonyms_concat: Golfer's elbow

fields.label: Popeye sign
fields.definition: "Exaggerated bulging of the belly of the biceps muscle upon contraction." [PMID:35288410]

fields.label: Distal biceps tendon rupture
fields.definition: "Rupture (tear) of the distal biceps tendon. Ultrasound imaging showing complete discontinuity of the distal biceps tendon or MRI revealing complete distal biceps tendon discontinuity or increased signal intensity in the distal biceps tendon." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Distal biceps tendon tear

fields.label: Proximal biceps tendon rupture
fields.definition: "Rupture (tear) of the proximal biceps tendon. MRI reveals a tear of the proximal aspect of the biceps tendon near its site of origin at the supraglenoid tubercle." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Proximal biceps tendon tear

fields.label: Positive bursal fluid infectious agent test
fields.definition: "Detection of an infectious agent, or evidence thereof, in aspirated bursal fluid using microbiological, molecular, or antigen-based testing methods." []
fields.label_normalized: positive bursal fluid infectious agent test

fields.label: Acute retinal necrosis
fields.definition: "A condition characterized by the death of retinal tissue due to ischemia, infection, or inflammation." [PMID:29262034]
fields.synonyms_concat: Acute necrosis of the retina

fields.label: Cystic changes in greater tuberosity of the humerus
fields.definition: "Cystic lesions of the proximal humerus are commonly encountered on routine shoulder magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). True cysts are defined as fluid-filled structures or lesions with an epithelial lining, whereas pseudocysts are fluid-filled lesions without epithelial lining. Cystic lesion encompasses both true cysts, pseudocysts and other lesions which could mimic the appearance of a cyst on MRI, with increased signal on fluid sensitive sequences." [PMID:35919060]
fields.label_normalized: cystic changes in greater tuberosity of the humerus

fields.label: Positive Hawkins test
fields.definition: "Manual internal rotation on the forearm with the shoulders flexed forward to 90 degrees, elbows bent to 90 degrees so that the forearm is parallel to the ground, and palm facing down recreates pain in the shoulder region; named after Dr. Hawkins." [PMID:10979525]
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive Hawkins impingement test; Positive Kennedy impingement test

fields.label: Hallux weakness
fields.definition: "Reduced ability to exert force or power with the hallux (big toe), i.e., reduced strength of the hallux." []

fields.label: Hallux dorsiflexion weakness
fields.definition: "Reduced ability to lift the big toe (hallux) upward toward the shin." []

fields.label: Hallux plantarflexion weakness
fields.definition: "Reduced ability to push the big toe (hallux) downward, away from the shin." []

fields.label: Forefoot pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized about the metatarsal heads in the front part of the foot." [PMID:28109624]
fields.synonyms_concat: Metatarsalgia

fields.label: Spur at inferior pole of patella
fields.definition: "A bone spur (osteophyte), i.e., de novo bone formation at the lower edge of the patella (knee cap). Radiographically, it is visible as calcification at inferior pole of the patella." [PMID:39346060]
fields.label_normalized: spur at inferior pole of patella

fields.label: Urinary ascites
fields.definition: "The presence of urine in the peritoneal cavity, an entity that typically results from bladder rupture or damage to the ureters." [PMID:23190938, PMID:37580961]

fields.label: Abnormal mixed venous oxygen saturation
fields.definition: "Abnormal oxygen saturation in mixed venous blood (SvO2). SvO2 can be measured in a sample of mixed venous blood drawn from the distal lumen of a catheter placed in the pulmonary artery. The SvO2 is dependent on arterial oxygen saturation, hemoglobin concentration, cardiac output, and tissue oxygen demands." [PMID:6870412]

fields.label: Elevated circulating lysosphingomyelin concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of lysosphingomyelin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Acid sphingomyelinase deficiency (ASMD) or Niemann-Pick type A/B is a lysosomal disorder caused by the deficiency of acid sphingomyelinase (ASM) due to pathogenic variants in the SMPD1 gene. Sphingomyelin (SM) is the substrate for ASM that cleaves the phosphorylcholine linkage of SM producing ceramide. SM is a major compound of most cell membranes and coupled with cholesterol constitutes most of the membrane rafts. In the deficiency of ASM, there is primary storage of SM, and the concentration of lysosphingomyelin in dried blood spots and in the blood circulation is typically elevated." [PMID:36348386]

fields.label: Abnormal lens capsule morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the lens capsule, the smooth, transparent, acellular basement membrane that envelops the lens of the eye and serves as the attachment site for the lens zonules and the lens epithelium." []

fields.label: Posterior capsule opacification
fields.definition: "Posterior capsule opacification, also known as secondary cataract, is the most frequent complication following manual extracapsular cataract extraction. Secondary cataract results from the proliferation and migration of residual epithelial cells in the posterior region of the lens capsule into the visual axis, leading to thickening and reduction in transparency (opacification), which in turn can cause a decrease in visual acuity." [PMID:21750620]
fields.synonyms_concat: Secondary cataract

fields.label: Bronchial stenosis
fields.definition: "A narrowing (constriction) of the lumen of a bronchus, which may involve one or more of the major airways branching from the trachea." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bronchial narrowing

fields.label: Skin tenting due to fracture
fields.definition: "Skin tenting may occur in the setting of a fracture when a displaced bone fragment pushes on the skin, causing it to bulge outward in a tent-like shape." [PMID:34423090]

fields.label: Follicular conjunctivitis
fields.definition: "A type of conjunctivitis characterized by the formation of conjunctival follicles, which appear as raised domes on the are round collections of lymphocytes, and are often most prominent in the inferior fornix (interior part of the lower eyelid)." []

fields.label: Granulomatous conjunctivitis
fields.definition: "A type of conjunctivitis characterized by the formation of conjunctival granulomata, i.e., localized nodular inflammatory lesions of the conjunctiva, characterized histologically by aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes, often with multinucleated giant cells, surrounded by lymphocytes and fibroblasts." [PMID:37318529]

fields.label: Areas of hypopigmentation and hyperpigmentation that follow Blaschko lines
fields.definition: "Linear streaks of hypopigmentation or hyperpigmentation that are distributed according to Blaschko lines, which are V-shaped, S-shaped, or linear patterns on the skin that reflect the embryonic migration pathways of epidermal cells (keratinocytes, melanocytes, etc.) during early development." [PMID:9125765]
fields.label_normalized: areas of hypopigmentation and hyperpigmentation that follow blaschko lines

fields.label: Retinal drusen
fields.definition: "Small focal extracellular deposits underneath the retina, visible ophthalmoscopically as yellow dots." [PMID:19726434, PMID:30404862]

fields.label: Intrauterine amputation
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly characterized by partial or complete absence of a limb or digit at birth, resulting from interruption of normal limb development in utero." [PMID:25531236, PMID:31407870, PMID:40818398]
fields.synonyms_concat: Congenital amputation; Intra-uterine amputation

fields.label: Intrauterine digital amputation
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly characterized by partial or complete absence of a finger or toe at birth, resulting from interruption of normal development in utero." []

fields.label: Intrauterine limb amputation
fields.definition: "A developmental anomaly characterized by partial or complete absence of an arm or leg at birth, resulting from interruption of normal development in utero." [PMID:31407870, PMID:31424867, PMID:31787161]

fields.label: Proximal interphalangeal joint arthritis
fields.definition: "Inflammation and deterioration of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints. Radiographically, PIP arthritis can be characterized by PIP joint space narrowing, subchondral cysts, and osteophytes." [PMID:31312517]

fields.label: Dorsal intercalated segment instability
fields.definition: "A nondissociative form of carpal instability, in which the lunate bone angulates to the dorsal side of the hand." [PMID:23790423]

fields.label: Disruption of carpal arcs
fields.definition: "The arcs of the Gilula are used on PA wrist radiographs as part of assessing the normal alignment of the carpus. The 1st arc (red) outlines the proximal surfaces and the 2nd arc (yellow) the distal surfaces of the scaphoid, lunate and triquetrum. The 3rd arc (white) outlines the proximal surfaces of the capitate and hamate. Disruption of carpal arcs (i.e., the arcs appear broken or discontinuous on radiographs) indicates a fracture or ligamentous injury in the wrist." [PMID:37511801]
fields.synonyms_concat: Disruption of Gilula carpal arcs

fields.label: Spilled teacup sign of the wrist
fields.definition: "Dislocation of the lunate bone, generally as a result of trauma. Volar displacement of the lunate is said to result a tipped teacup." [PMID:23616330, PMID:37511801]
fields.label_normalized: spilled teacup sign of the wrist

fields.label: Positive Finkelstein sign
fields.definition: "Finkelstein's test produces severe tenderness and usually pain on the radial aspect of the wrist when the thumb is flexed into the palm and the wrist is ulnar deviated." [PMID:30969590]

fields.label: Forefoot abduction
fields.definition: "Outward deviation or turning of the front part of the foot away from the body's midline. An anteroposterior foot x-ray shows increased Simmon angle (angle between the talus and first metatarsal, normal is 7 degrees plus/minus 4 to 5 degrees) or increased talonavicular uncoverage of over 30 to 40 percent. A common clinical observation is the too many toes sign; when viewed from behind, more than two toes will flare out laterally due to the valgus alignment of the foot." [PMID:31194317]

fields.label: Posterior tibial tendon injury
fields.definition: "Damage to the posterior tibialis tendon, which runs along the inside of the ankle and foot, supporting the arch of the foot. MRI or ultrasound of the ankle/foot shows posterior tibial tendon degeneration such as tendinosis, tenosynovitis, edema around the tendon, or tendon tear." [PMID:28979585, PMID:31194317]

fields.label: Plantar pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to palpation of plantar aspect of the foot (the sole)." []

fields.label: Flexor hallucis longus tendon injury
fields.definition: "Damage to the flexor hallucis longus (FHL) tendon. The FHL tendon is a long tendon that runs from the deep calf muscle down through the ankle to the big toe, enabling toe flexion and supporting foot mechanics.. MRI or ultrasound of the ankle/foot shows degenerative changes of the FHL tendon such as fluid around the tendon at the level of the ankle joint, intra-substance tendinous signal, tendon thickening, tendonitis, or tenosynovitis, or tendon rupture." []

fields.label: Hallux pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the big toe (hallux)." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Big toe pain; First toe pain; Great toe pain; Pain in hallux

fields.label: Pain on the medial aspect of the foot
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the side of the foot nearest to the big toe (hallux)." []
fields.label_normalized: pain on the medial aspect of the foot

fields.label: Hallux sesamoid injury
fields.definition: "Damage affecting one or both of the two small, pea-shaped bones (sesamoids) embedded in the tendons beneath the first metatarsophalangeal joint of the big toe. Foot x-ray shows fracture, subluxation, or dislocation of the sesamoid of the hallux." [PMID:19232995]

fields.label: Radial wrist pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the radial side of the wrist." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Radial-sided wrist pain

fields.label: Volar wrist pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the volar side of the wrist (i.e., to the palm side - front - of the wrist)." []

fields.label: Dorsal wrist pain
fields.definition: "An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the dorsal side (back) of the wrist." []

fields.label: Peroneal tendon tenderness
fields.definition: "Pain elicited with palpation along the course of the peroneal tendons, located posterior to the lateral malleolus and extending distally toward the base of the fifth metatarsal." [PMID:31335074]

fields.label: Peroneal tendon subluxation
fields.definition: "Dynamic ultrasound of the lateral ankle showing subluxation or dislocation of one or both of the peroneal tendons out of the peroneal groove." [PMID:31335074]

fields.label: Peroneal tendon injury
fields.definition: "Ankle MRI or ultrasound showing edema or thickening of peroneal tendon(s), fluid within peroneal tendon sheath, or a partial or complete tear in one or both of the peroneal tendons." [PMID:31335074]

fields.label: Elevated circulating succinylacetone concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of succinylacetone in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:16448836, PMID:32832707]
fields.synonyms_concat: Succinylacetone high in blood

fields.label: Flat palate
fields.definition: "Reduced height of the palate. A flat palate is present with a palatal index angle below 30 degrees, a normal palate with an angle between 30 and 45 degrees, and a steep palate with an angle above 45 degrees." [PMID:18402092]

fields.label: Elevated circulating C-terminal telopeptide cross-link of type1 collagen concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of C-terminal telopeptide cross-link of type1 collagen in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:40638774]
fields.label_normalized: elevated circulating c-terminal telopeptide cross-link of type1 collagen concentration

fields.label: Exacerbated by pulmonary vasodilator exposure
fields.definition: "Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with a pulmonary vasodilator medication such as prostacyclin analogs, endothelin receptor antagonists, and phosphodiesterase-5 (PDE5) inhibitors." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Exacerbated by pulmonary vasodilators

fields.label: Mercury exposure
fields.definition: "History of exposure to mercury." [PMID:40287162]

fields.label: Urinoma
fields.definition: "Encapsulated collections of urine around the kidney in the retroperitoneum, most commonly in the perirenal space, as a consequence of renal tract leakage caused by urinary obstruction, trauma, or post-instrumentation." [PMID:34507797]

fields.label: Umbilical discharge
fields.definition: "Abnormal fluid draining from the umbilicus (from wounds, surgical sites, or fistulas)." [PMID:34277280]

fields.label: Abnormal biparietal diameter
fields.definition: "Abnormal biparietal diameter (BPD) refers to a fetal head width measurement, taken between the outer edge of the proximal parietal bone and the inner edge of the distal parietal bone on an ultrasound image, that lies outside the expected range for a given gestational age. The expected range typically falls between the 10th and 90th percentiles, with microcephaly defined as a BPD below the 3rd percentile (or more than 2 standard deviations below the mean) and macrocephaly defined as a BPD above the 97th percentile (or more than 2 standard deviations above the mean)." [PMID:6152941, PMID:6979175]
fields.synonyms_concat: Abnormal BPD

fields.label: Abnormal fetal femur length
fields.definition: "Femur length is measured between the outer border of one end of the the femoral diaphysis to the other outer border, excluding the epiphysis or other artifact. Abnormal femur length is defined as being more than two standard deviations away from the mean." []

fields.label: Pain exacerbated by wrist ulnar deviation
fields.definition: "Pain worsens with wrist ulnar deviation (i.e., the pain is exacerbated if the hand is moved towards the side with the fifth finger)." []
fields.label_normalized: pain exacerbated by wrist ulnar deviation

fields.label: Pain exacerbated by wrist radial deviation
fields.definition: "Pain worsens with wrist radial deviation (i.e., the pain is exacerbated if the hand is moved towards the side with the thumb)." []
fields.label_normalized: pain exacerbated by wrist radial deviation

fields.label: Ulnar positive variance
fields.definition: "A phenomenon whereby the distal ulna articular surface is more distal than the distal radius articular surface." [PMID:36752828]

fields.label: Negative ulnar variance
fields.definition: "Negative ulnar variance is a condition in which the ulna is relatively shorter than the radius at the carpus. AP wrist X-ray shows the distal ulna articular surface more proximal than the distal radius articular surface." []

fields.label: Flexor carpi radialis tendonitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon, which traverses the carpus through a narrow fibro-osseous tunnel." [PMID:39166186]
fields.synonyms_concat: FCR inflammation

fields.label: Transillumination test shows high light transmission
fields.definition: "A transillumination test involves shining light through an area of the body or a mass. This term refers to a transillumination test that shows especially high (positive) transillumination, which may be observed when a mass or swelling contains clear fluid rather than solid tissue or blood." [PMID:20124823]
fields.label_normalized: transillumination test shows high light transmission
fields.synonyms_concat: Bright transillumination

fields.label: Hyperleukocytosis
fields.definition: "Hyperleukocytosis is commonly defined as a white blood cell (WBC) count of greater than 100,000 luekocytes per microliter." [PMID:33080779]

fields.label: Elbow instability
fields.definition: "Impairment of the ability of the elbow joint to maintain proper anatomical alignment and functional mechanics. Elbow instability is a spectrum from subluxation to dislocation, with corresponding clinical and pathologic features and therapeutic implications." [PMID:28160902, PMID:7962147]

fields.label: Valgus instability of the elbow
fields.definition: "A type of elbow instability that arises through injuries to the medial collateral ligament (MCL), specifically the anterior bundle (AMCL). In the valgus stress test, the elbow is placed in 20 to 30 degrees of flexion with the forearm supinated and a valgus stress is applied. The test is positive when no firm end point is palpated, greater than 1 mm of medial joint opening is noted (fluoroscopically), or there is reproduction of the patient's pain." [PMID:28160902]

fields.label: Varus instability of the elbow
fields.definition: "A type of elbow insttability characterized by abnormal widening or gapping of the lateral (radial) side of the elbow joint when a varus stress is applied, due to insufficiency of the lateral collateral ligament complex." [PMID:28160902]

fields.label: Limited foot eversion
fields.definition: "Decreased foot eversion secondary to pain, weakness, or mechanical block." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Foot eversion limited

fields.label: Limited foot inversion
fields.definition: "Decreased foot inversion secondary to pain, weakness, or mechanical block." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Foot inversion limited

fields.label: Positive synovial Tropheryma whipplei bacteria microscopy
fields.definition: "Demonstration of Tropheryma whipplei bacteria in the synovial (joint) fluid by microscopic analysis." []
fields.label_normalized: positive synovial tropheryma whipplei bacteria microscopy

fields.label: Positive calf squeeze test
fields.definition: "An abnormal result of the calf-squeeze test (also known as the Thompson test), which is considered a sign of Achilles tendon rupture. The test is positive (abnormal) if no plantar flexion of the foot occurs at calf squeezing." [PMID:25409728]
fields.synonyms_concat: Positive Simmonds-Thompson test; Positive Thompson test

fields.label: Achilles tendon tear
fields.definition: "A partial or complete break in the Achilles tendon (the tendon that connects the gastrocnemius and soleus to the calcaneus). This feature can be ascertained by magnetic resonance imaing (MRI) of the foot/ankle showing partial or complete tear of the achilles tendon." []

fields.label: Positive bursa fluid gram stain
fields.definition: "Demonstration of the presence of bacteria by gram staining of bursa fluid. The sample is generally obtained by bursal fluid aspiration." []

fields.label: Abnormal medial epicondyle morphology
fields.definition: "A structural anomaly of the medial epicondyle, which is the site of the attachment of various muscles, including the radial and ulnar flexor of the wrist, the superficial flexor of the fingers, the palmaris longus and the pronator teres muscle." [PMID:37344531]

fields.label: Medial humerus epicondyle avulsion fracture
fields.definition: "An avulsion fracture of the medial epicondyle of the elbow. Radiological examination in the anteroposterior and lateral projection can be used to make the diagnosis and to determine the degree and direction of the fracture displacement." [PMID:37344531]

fields.label: Hand mass
fields.definition: "A swelling or enlargement localized to the hand. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Bump on the hand; Hand cyst; Hand growth; Hand nodule; Hand tumor; Lump on the hand

fields.label: Tenosynovitis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the synovial sheath that surrounds a tendon." [PMID:16331793]

fields.label: Tigroid fundus
fields.definition: "Enhanced visibility of large choroidal vessels through the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE). This reticulated pattern is commonly observed on fundus examination and color fundus photography. Such hypopigmented areas alternate with hyperpigmented zones in a tigroid pattern. Fundus tessellation is often associated with myopia and choroidal thinning." [PMID:40914444]
fields.synonyms_concat: Fundus tesselation; Mosaic fundus; Tessellated fundus

fields.label: Decreased myocardial glycogen content
fields.definition: "The amount of glycogen in the myocardial tissue of the heart is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:17928598, PMID:21958591, PMID:40536305]
synonyms: Glycogen depletion in cardiac muscle tissue
fields.synonyms_concat: Glycogen depletion in cardiac muscle tissue

fields.label: CSF anti-myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody positivity
fields.definition: "The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein." [PMID:39318613, PMID:40327177]
fields.label_normalized: csf anti-myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody positivity

fields.label: Spinal cord H sign
fields.definition: "The H sign can be ascertained by spinal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and represents spinal cord myelitis isolated to the gray matter. A longitudinally extensive T2 hyperintense spinal cord lesion from C6 to T10, predominantly involving the gray matter. The appearance of the anomaly is said to resemble the letter H." [PMID:39318613, PMID:40327177]
synonyms: H sign in the spinal cord
fields.synonyms_concat: H sign in the spinal cord

fields.label: Abnormal testosterone: estradiol ratio
fields.definition: "Any deviation from the normal ratio of testosterone and estradiol (the primary sex steroids) to each other. The testosterone:estradiol ratio is derived from total testosterone in ng/dL and total estradiol in pg/mL, and expressed as T:E. Normal ranges are affected by sex, age, and other factors." [PMID:39344113]

fields.label: Abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor 3 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of IGFBP-3 (Insulin-like Growth Factor-Binding Protein 3) in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal." [PMID:37008935]
fields.label_normalized: abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor 3 concentration

fields.label: Decreased circulating insulin-like growth factor 3 concentration
fields.definition: "The concentration of IGFBP-3 (Insulin-like Growth Factor-Binding Protein 3) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:1373347]
fields.label_normalized: decreased circulating insulin-like growth factor 3 concentration

fields.label: Airway chondritis
fields.definition: "Inflammation of the cartilage of the airway, including especially the trachea and bronchi." [PMID:40271291]
fields.synonyms_concat: Respiratory tract chondritis

fields.label: inflammation of the costal cartilage, the cartilage that connects the ribs to the sternum (breastbone).
fields.definition: "inflammation of the costal cartilage (the cartilage that connects the ribs to the sternum). The typical presentation of costochondritis is bilateral parasternal chest wall pain exacerbated by deep breaths, coughing, and stretching. The upper (predominantly second through fifth) costochondral and/or costosternal junctions are most commonly involved. The areas of tenderness are not generally accompanied by heat, erythema, or localized swelling." [PMID:34264599]
fields.label_normalized: inflammation of the costal cartilage, the cartilage that connects the ribs to the sternum (breastbone).

fields.label: History of ocular surgery
fields.definition: "Past medical history of surgical procedure on the eye or its surroundings." []

fields.label: Increased plantar fascia thickness
fields.definition: "Increased thickness of the plantar fascia. This finding can be ascertained by ultrasound or magnetic resonance imaging." [PMID:27957702]
fields.synonyms_concat: Plantar fasciitis

fields.label: Increased mixed venous oxygen saturation
fields.definition: "Oxygen saturation in mixed venous blood (SvO2), as measured in a sample of mixed venous blood drawn from the distal lumen of a catheter placed in the pulmonary artery, is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:6870412]

fields.label: Decreased mixed venous oxygen saturation
fields.definition: "Oxygen saturation in mixed venous blood (SvO2), as measured in a sample of mixed venous blood drawn from the distal lumen of a catheter placed in the pulmonary artery, is below the lower limit of normal." [PMID:6870412]

fields.label: Chocolate brown blood
fields.definition: "Characteristic chocolate-brown color of circulating blood with an elevated methemoglobin content." [PMID:30726002]
fields.synonyms_concat: Circulating blood brown or black

fields.label: Elevated pCO2 gap
fields.definition: "The difference between the venous-to-arterial carbon dioxide saturation (Pv-aCO2) is above the upper limit of normal." [PMID:32377433]
fields.synonyms_concat: Increased pCO2 gap

fields.label: Putaminal eye sign
fields.definition: "An imaging anomly of the putamen that is thought to be pathognomic for MEGDEL syndrome (3-MethylGlutaconic aciduria, Deafness, Encephalopathy, Leigh-like syndrome MIM #614739). In stage 1 of the disease, T2 signal changes of the pallidum are present. In stage 2, swelling of the putamen and caudate nucleus is seen. The dorsal putamen contains an eye that shows no signal alteration and (thus) seems to be spared during this stage of the disease. It later increases, reflecting progressive putaminal involvement. Sparing of the mid dorsal putamen (showing normal signal surrounded by T2 hyperintense signal) is referred to as the putaminal eye." [PMID:25642805, PMID:37996139]

fields.label: Decreased coracohumeral distance
fields.definition: "Axial view on shoulder X-ray or MRI showing decreased distance between posterior border of the coracoid process and anterior border of the humeral head of less than 6 mm; subcoracoid impingement; decreased coracohumeral interval." []
fields.synonyms_concat: Coracohumeral distance decreased

fields.label: Abnormal deltoid muscle morphology
fields.definition: "Any structural anomaly of the deltoid muscle, the large triangular intrinsic shoulder muscle, so named because its shape resembles the inverted Greek letter delta." [PMID:30725741]

fields.label: Deltoid muscle tear
fields.definition: "An injury of the deltoid muscle of the shoulder or its tendon characterized by partial or complete rupture." []

fields.label: Glenohumeral arthritis
fields.definition: "Anteropostrior (AP), axillary, or Grashey (true AP) view X-ray of the shoulder showing radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis such as joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, and/or osteophyte formation in the glenohumeral joint." [PMID:32662351]
fields.synonyms_concat: Shoulder arthritis
